Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2.

(** * fset union case combinator *)

Lemma fv_case_union : forall (x:var) (A A' B B':vars),
  (A' = A \/ A' = \{x} \u A) ->
  (B' = B \/ B' = \{x} \u B) ->
  (A' \u B' = A \u B \/ A' \u B' = \{x} \u (A \u B)).
Proof.
  intros x A A' B B' HA HB.
  destruct HA as [HA|HA]; destruct HB as [HB|HB]; subst.
  - left. reflexivity.
  - right. apply fset_extens; intros y Hy; repeat rewrite in_union in *; repeat rewrite in_singleton in *; tauto.
  - right. apply fset_extens; intros y Hy; repeat rewrite in_union in *; repeat rewrite in_singleton in *; tauto.
  - right. apply fset_extens; intros y Hy; repeat rewrite in_union in *; repeat rewrite in_singleton in *; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_case_union3 : forall (x:var) (A A' B B' C C':vars),
  (A' = A \/ A' = \{x} \u A) ->
  (B' = B \/ B' = \{x} \u B) ->
  (C' = C \/ C' = \{x} \u C) ->
  (A' \u B' \u C' = A \u B \u C \/ A' \u B' \u C' = \{x} \u (A \u B \u C)).
Proof.
  intros x A A' B B' C C' HA HB HC.
  destruct (fv_case_union x HA HB) as [H|H]; rewrite H; clear H.
  - destruct HC as [HC|HC]; subst.
    + left. reflexivity.
    + right. apply fset_extens; intros y Hy; repeat rewrite in_union in *; repeat rewrite in_singleton in *; tauto.
  - destruct HC as [HC|HC]; subst.
    + right. apply fset_extens; intros y Hy; repeat rewrite in_union in *; repeat rewrite in_singleton in *; tauto.
    + right. apply fset_extens; intros y Hy; repeat rewrite in_union in *; repeat rewrite in_singleton in *; tauto.
Qed.

(** * fv / open cases *)

Lemma fv_open_cases_avar : forall (a:avar) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x a) = fv a \/ fv (open_rec n x a) = \{x} \u fv a.
Proof.
  intros a n x. destruct a as [i|v].
  - destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x E). right. cbn. rewrite union_empty_r. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x N). left. reflexivity.
  - cbn. left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_typ_mut :
  (forall (T:typ) n x,
     fv (open_rec n x T) = fv T \/ fv (open_rec n x T) = \{x} \u fv T)
  /\ (forall (D:dec) n x,
     fv (open_rec n x D) = fv D \/ fv (open_rec n x D) = \{x} \u fv D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n x. rewrite open_typ_top. left. reflexivity.
  - intros n x. rewrite open_typ_bot. left. reflexivity.
  - intros D IH n x. rewrite open_typ_rcd. cbn. apply IH.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_typ_and. cbn.
    apply fv_case_union; auto.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_typ_or. cbn.
    apply fv_case_union; auto.
  - intros a1 l a2 n x. rewrite open_typ_sel. cbn.
    apply fv_case_union; apply fv_open_cases_avar.
  - intros T IH n x. rewrite open_typ_bnd. cbn. apply IH.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_typ_fun. cbn.
    apply fv_case_union; auto.
  - intros n x. rewrite open_typ_nocap. left. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_dec_typ. cbn.
    apply fv_case_union; auto.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_dec_fld. cbn.
    apply fv_case_union; auto.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 n x. rewrite open_dec_met. cbn.
    apply fv_case_union3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_typ : forall (T:typ) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x T) = fv T \/ fv (open_rec n x T) = \{x} \u fv T.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 fv_open_cases_typ_mut); auto. Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_dec : forall (D:dec) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x D) = fv D \/ fv (open_rec n x D) = \{x} \u fv D.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 fv_open_cases_typ_mut); auto. Qed.
EOF

Lemma defs_has_cons_here : forall (ds:defs) (d:def),
  defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d.
Proof.
  intros ds d. unfold defs_has. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := label_of d = label_of d) eq_refl). reflexivity.

  record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls -> exists D, record_has T D /\ label_of D = l.

Lemma ty_trm_sub_elim : forall G e t U,
  ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t U ->
  exists T, ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e t U H. induction H.
  - (* var *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* apply *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_apply; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* read *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_read; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* write *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_write; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* call *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_call; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* let *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_let; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* lit *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_lit; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* sub *) destruct IHty_trm as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.

Lemma ty_var_sub_elim : forall G e x U,
  ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x U ->
  exists T, ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.

  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_intro; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_elim; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - exists (typ_and T U); split; [eapply ty_var_and; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Head inversion for term typing *)

Lemma ty_trm_var_inv : forall G e x U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ U ->
  exists T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T /\ G⁏e ⊢ T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_var (avar_f x)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - eexists; split; [ match goal with Hx : G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ _ |- _ => exact Hx end
                    | apply subtyp_refl ].
  - destruct (IHty_trm x eq_refl eq_refl) as [T0 [Hx Hs]].
    exists T0. split; auto. eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_apply_inv : forall G e x z U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ U ->
  exists S T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun S T /\ G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ S /\
              G⁏e ⊢ open z T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x z U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun ?S ?T |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hz : G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ ?S |- _ =>
        exists S, T; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hz|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x z eq_refl eq_refl) as [S [T [Hx [Hz Hs]]]].
    exists S, T. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hz|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_read_inv : forall G e x a U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_read (avar_f x) a ∶ U ->
  exists S T V, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) /\
                G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ T ⟶ V /\ G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x a U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_read (avar_f x) a) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a ?S ?T) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hv : G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ ?T ⟶ ?V |- _ =>
        exists S, T, V; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hv|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x eq_refl eq_refl) as [S [T [V [Hx [Hv Hs]]]]].
    exists S, T, V. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hv|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_write_inv : forall G e x a y U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ U ->
  exists S T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) /\
              G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ S /\ G⁏e ⊢ T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x a y U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a ?S ?T) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hy : G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ ?S |- _ =>
        exists S, T; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hy|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x y eq_refl eq_refl) as [S [T [Hx [Hy Hs]]]].
    exists S, T. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_call_inv : forall G e x m y U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ∶ U ->
  exists TC TZ TR,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ TZ /\
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open y TC /\
    G⁏e ⊢ open_met y x TR <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x m y U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m ?TC ?TZ ?TR) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hy : G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ ?TZ |- _ =>
        match goal with
        | Hsef : mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 ?TC |- _ =>
          match goal with
          | Hxy : G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open y ?TC |- _ =>
            exists TC, TZ, TR; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hy|];
            split; [exact Hsef|]; split; [exact Hxy|apply subtyp_refl]
          end
        end
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x y eq_refl eq_refl) as
      [TC [TZ [TR [Hx [Hy [Hsef [Hxy Hs]]]]]]].
    exists TC, TZ, TR. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    split; [exact Hsef|]. split; [exact Hxy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_let_inv : forall G e t1 t2 U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_let t1 t2 ∶ U ->
  exists T L V,
    G⁏e ⊢ t1 ∶ T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t2 ∶ V) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e t1 t2 U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_let t1 t2) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | H1 : G⁏e ⊢ t1 ∶ ?T |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | H2 : forall x : var, x \notin ?L -> G § x / v_let ~ ?T ⁏e ⊢ open x t2 ∶ ?V |- _ =>
        exists T, L, V; split; [exact H1|]; split; [exact H2|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm t1 t2 eq_refl eq_refl) as [T [L [V [H1 [H2 Hs]]]]].
    exists T, L, V. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H2|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_lit_inv : forall G e l t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_lit l t ∶ U ->
  exists T L V,
    G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ V) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e l t U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_lit l t) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | H1 : G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ ?T |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | H2 : forall x : var, x \notin ?L -> G § x / v_let ~ ?T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ ?V |- _ =>
        exists T, L, V; split; [exact H1|]; split; [exact H2|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm l t eq_refl eq_refl) as [T [L [V [H1 [H2 Hs]]]]].
    exists T, L, V. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H2|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Head inversion for literal typing (no subtyping constructor) *)

Lemma ty_lit_fun_inv : forall G e T t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ U ->
  exists L V,
    U = typ_fun T V /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x V).
Proof.
  intros G e T t U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_fun T t) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : forall x : var, x \notin ?L -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x ?V |- _ =>
    exists L, V; split; [reflexivity|exact H1]
  end.
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_obj_inv : forall G e T ds U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_obj T ds ∶ U ->
  exists L,
    U = typ_objlit typing_mode T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) /\
    typ_indep_b 0 T.
Proof.
  intros G e T ds U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_obj T ds) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : forall x : var, x \notin ?L -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T |- _ =>
    match goal with
    | H2 : typ_indep_b 0 T |- _ =>
      exists L; split; [reflexivity|]; split; [exact H1|exact H2]
    end
  end.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Head inversion for term typing *)

Lemma ty_trm_var_inv : forall G e x U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ U ->
  exists T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T /\ G⁏e ⊢ T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_var (avar_f x)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - eexists; split; [ match goal with Hx : G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ _ |- _ => exact Hx end
                    | apply subtyp_refl ].
  - destruct (IHty_trm x eq_refl eq_refl) as [t0 [Hx Hs]].
    exists t0. split; auto. eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_apply_inv : forall G e x z U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ U ->
  exists S T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun S T /\ G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ S /\
              G⁏e ⊢ open z T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x z U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun ?sx ?tx) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hz : (G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ ?sx) |- _ =>
        exists sx, tx; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hz|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x z eq_refl eq_refl) as [s0 [t0 [Hx [Hz Hs]]]].
    exists s0, t0. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hz|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_read_inv : forall G e x a U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_read (avar_f x) a ∶ U ->
  exists S T V, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) /\
                G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ T ⟶ V /\ G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x a U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_read (avar_f x) a) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a ?sx ?tx)) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hv : (G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ ?tx ⟶ ?vx) |- _ =>
        exists sx, tx, vx; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hv|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x eq_refl eq_refl) as [s0 [t0 [v0 [Hx [Hv Hs]]]]].
    exists s0, t0, v0. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hv|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_write_inv : forall G e x a y U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ U ->
  exists S T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) /\
              G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ S /\ G⁏e ⊢ T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x a y U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a ?sx ?tx)) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hy : (G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ ?sx) |- _ =>
        exists sx, tx; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hy|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x y eq_refl eq_refl) as [s0 [t0 [Hx [Hy Hs]]]].
    exists s0, t0. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_call_inv : forall G e x m y U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ∶ U ->
  exists TC TZ TR,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ TZ /\
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open y TC /\
    G⁏e ⊢ open_met y x TR <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x m y U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m ?tc ?tz ?tr)) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hy : (G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ ?tz) |- _ =>
        match goal with
        | Hsef : (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 ?tc) |- _ =>
          match goal with
          | Hxy : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open y ?tc) |- _ =>
            exists tc, tz, tr; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hy|];
            split; [exact Hsef|]; split; [exact Hxy|apply subtyp_refl]
          end
        end
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x y eq_refl eq_refl) as
      [tc [tz [tr [Hx [Hy [Hsef [Hxy Hs]]]]]]].
    exists tc, tz, tr. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    split; [exact Hsef|]. split; [exact Hxy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_let_inv : forall G e t1 t2 U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_let t1 t2 ∶ U ->
  exists T L V,
    G⁏e ⊢ t1 ∶ T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t2 ∶ V) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e t1 t2 U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_let t1 t2) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | H1 : (G⁏e ⊢ t1 ∶ ?ty) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | H2 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_let ~ ?ty ⁏e ⊢ open x t2 ∶ ?vy) |- _ =>
        exists ty, ly, vy; split; [exact H1|]; split; [exact H2|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm t1 t2 eq_refl eq_refl) as [t0 [l0 [v0 [H1 [H2 Hs]]]]].
    exists t0, l0, v0. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H2|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_lit_inv : forall G e l t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_lit l t ∶ U ->
  exists T L V,
    G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ V) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e l t U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_lit l t) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | H1 : (G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ ?ty) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | H2 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_let ~ ?ty ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ ?vy) |- _ =>
        exists ty, ly, vy; split; [exact H1|]; split; [exact H2|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm l t eq_refl eq_refl) as [t0 [l0 [v0 [H1 [H2 Hs]]]]].
    exists t0, l0, v0. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H2|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Head inversion for literal typing (no subtyping constructor) *)

Lemma ty_lit_fun_inv : forall G e T t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ U ->
  exists L V,
    U = typ_fun T V /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x V).
Proof.
  intros G e T t U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_fun T t) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x ?vy) |- _ =>
    exists ly, vy; split; [reflexivity|exact H1]
  end.
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_obj_inv : forall G e T ds U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_obj T ds ∶ U ->
  exists L,
    U = typ_objlit typing_mode T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) /\
    typ_indep_b 0 T.
Proof.
  intros G e T ds U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_obj T ds) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) |- _ =>
    match goal with
    | H2 : typ_indep_b 0 T |- _ =>
      exists ly; split; [reflexivity|]; split; [exact H1|exact H2]
    end
  end.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Constructive_sets.

Inductive ctx: Set :=

| ctx_empty

| ctx_push: ctx -> var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx

| ctx_stop: ctx -> ctx

| ctx_hide: ctx -> ctx
.

Notation "G '§' v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push G v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push ctx_empty v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʸ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_loc T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʷ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_ref T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʳ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_recv T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ᶻ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_par T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˢ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_self T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˣ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_let T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1
| ctx_push c v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_concat G1 c) v vk t
| ctx_stop c => ctx_stop (ctx_concat G1 c)
| ctx_hide c => ctx_hide (ctx_concat G1 c)
end.

Notation "E §& F" := (ctx_concat E F)
  (at level 28, left associativity) : env_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_map(fn: typ -> typ)(G: ctx): ctx :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => ctx_empty
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_map fn G1) v vk (fn t)
| ctx_stop G1 => ctx_stop (ctx_map fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => ctx_hide (ctx_map fn G1)
end.

Fixpoint ctx_collect_values(A: Set)(fn: typ -> fset A)(G: ctx): fset A :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => (fn t) \u (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_stop G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
end.

Notation ctx_fv := (ctx_collect_values fv).

Instance CtxFreeVar : FreeVar ctx := ctx_fv.

Fixpoint ctx_keys(G: ctx): list var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => nil
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  v :: (ctx_keys G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_keys G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_keys G
end.

Fixpoint ctx_dom(G: ctx): fset var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  \{ v } \u (ctx_dom G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_dom G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_dom G
end.

Notation "x '§#' E" := (x \notin (ctx_dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:
  ctx_weakens G ->
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_hide_push G v vk t:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_weakens_hide_hide G:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds: var -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_binds_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v2 vk t2)
| ctx_binds_hide(v: var)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds_k_after: var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_k_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk t (ctx_push G v vk t) G
| ctx_binds_k_n(v v2: var)(vk1 vk2: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G1 G2: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t G1 G2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t (ctx_push G1 v2 vk2 t2) G2
.

Fixpoint ctx_kdom(vk: varkind)(c: ctx): fset var :=
match c with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push c v vk2 t => If (vk = vk2) then (\{ v } \u (ctx_kdom vk c)) else (ctx_kdom vk c)
| ctx_stop c => ctx_kdom vk c
| ctx_hide c => ctx_kdom vk c
end.

Definition ctx_k G v vk:=
  exists t G2, ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G G2.

Notation subst_ctx x y := (ctx_map (subst_var x y)).

Notation "G '/[§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_vars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_vars xs ys)).

Notation "G '/[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_vars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_pvars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_pvars xs ys)).

Notation "G '//[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_pvars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_seal_rec n x G :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_stop G => ctx_stop (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_hide G => ctx_hide (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_push G y vk t => ctx_push (ctx_seal_rec n x G) y vk (seal_rec n x t)
  end.

Instance CtxSealable: Sealable ctx := ctx_seal_rec.

Inductive ctx_vis: ctx -> var -> Prop :=
| ctx_vis_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v vk t) v
| ctx_vis_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_vis G v ->
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v2 vk t) v

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.

(** 1) Opening at depth 0 preserves closedness for lit / defs, and types *)

Lemma closed_lit_open_zero : forall (l:lit) x,
  closed_below 1 l -> closed (open_rec 0 x l).
Proof.
  intros l x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite lit_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@lit_open_commut l (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_defs_open_zero : forall (ds:defs) x,
  closed_below 1 ds -> closed (open_rec 0 x ds).
Proof.
  intros ds x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite defs_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@defs_open_commut ds (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_typ_open_zero : forall (T:typ) x,
  closed_below 1 T -> closed (open_rec 0 x T).
Proof.
  intros T x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite typ_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@typ_open_commut T (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

(** 2) Closedness of items *)

Lemma closed_item_fun : forall (t:trm),
  closed_below 1 t -> closed (item_fun t).
Proof.
  intros t Ht n x. cbn.
  rewrite (Ht (S n) x (Nat.lt_0_succ n)). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_item_obj : forall (ds:defs),
  closed ds -> closed (item_obj ds).
Proof.
  intros ds H n x. cbn. rewrite (H n x). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_avar_f : forall x, closed (avar_f x).
Proof. intros x n y. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma closed_avar_f_inv : forall (a:avar), closed a -> exists x, a = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros a H. destruct a as [i|v].
  - exfalso. specialize (H i (var_gen \{})).
    cbn in H. rewrite (classicT_l (P := i = i) eq_refl) in H. discriminate H.
  - exists v. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** 3) Deref preserves closedness *)

Lemma closed_def_fld_avar : forall l (a:avar),
  closed (def_fld l a) -> closed a.
Proof.
  intros l a H n x. specialize (H n x). cbn in H. injection H as H1. exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma deref_closed_def : forall (d:def) e,
  closed d -> closed (deref e d).
Proof.
  intros d e H. destruct d as [l T|l a|m t].
  - cbn. exact H.
  - cbn. assert (Ha : closed a) by (apply (closed_def_fld_avar H)).
    destruct (closed_avar_f_inv Ha) as [x Hx]. subst a.
    rewrite deref_avar_f. apply closed_avar_f.
  - cbn. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma deref_closed_defs : forall (ds:defs) e,
  closed ds -> closed (deref_defs e ds).
Proof.
  intros ds e H. induction ds as [|ds IH d].
  - cbn. intros n x. reflexivity.
  - cbn.
    assert (Hds : closed ds) by (apply (closed_defs_cons_l H)).
    assert (Hd : closed d) by (apply (closed_defs_cons_r H)).
    intros n x. rewrite open_defs_cons.
    rewrite (IH Hds n x). rewrite (deref_closed_def Hd e n x). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma deref_closed_defs_open : forall (ds:defs) e x,
  closed_below 1 ds -> closed (deref_defs e (open_rec 0 x ds)).
Proof.
  intros ds e x Ht. apply deref_closed_defs. apply closed_defs_open_zero. exact Ht.
Qed.

(** 4) Heap closed helper *)

Lemma heap_closed_single : forall x (i:item),
  closed i -> heap_closed (empty & x ~ i).
Proof.
  intros x i Hi. eapply heap_closed_push.
  - apply heap_closed_empty.
  - exact Hi.
Qed.

     : forall (A : Type) (x : var) (v : A) (E : env A),

dom_push
     : forall (A : Type) (x : var) (v : A) (E : env A),

binds_get
     : forall (A : Type) (x : var) (v : A) (E : env A),

binds_push_eq
     : forall (A : Type) (x : var) (v : A) (E : env A), binds x v (E & x ~ v)

     : forall (A : Type) (x1 x2 : var) (v1 v2 : A) (E : env A),

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev.

(** * OpenTwice for avar/typ/dec/trm/lit/def/defs *)

Lemma avar_open_b_eq : forall i n x, n = i -> open_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_f x.
Proof. intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l H). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_b_neq : forall i n x, n <> i -> open_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof. intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_r H). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_f : forall v n x, open_rec n x (avar_f v) = avar_f v.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_twice : forall (a:avar) n x y,
  open_rec n y (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n x a.
Proof.
  intros a n x y. destruct a as [i|v].
  - destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x E). cbn. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x N). rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n y N). reflexivity.
  - cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typ_open_twice_mut :
  (forall (T:typ), forall n x y, open_rec n y (open_rec n x T) = open_rec n x T)
  /\ (forall (D:dec), forall n x y, open_rec n y (open_rec n x D) = open_rec n x D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n x y; reflexivity.
  - intros n x y; reflexivity.
  - intros D IH n x y. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x y. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x y. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros a1 l a2 n x y. cbn. rewrite !avar_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - intros T IH n x y. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x y. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros n x y; reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x y. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x y. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 n x y. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2, IH3. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typ_open_twice : forall (T:typ) n x y,
  open_rec n y (open_rec n x T) = open_rec n x T.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 typ_open_twice_mut). Qed.

Lemma dec_open_twice : forall (D:dec) n x y,
  open_rec n y (open_rec n x D) = open_rec n x D.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 typ_open_twice_mut). Qed.

Lemma open_trm_var : forall n x (a:avar), open_rec n x (trm_var a) = trm_var (open_rec n x a).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma open_trm_read : forall n x (a:avar) m, open_rec n x (trm_read a m) = trm_read (open_rec n x a) m.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma open_trm_apply : forall n x (a b:avar), open_rec n x (trm_apply a b) = trm_apply (open_rec n x a) (open_rec n x b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma open_trm_let : forall n x (t1 t2:trm), open_rec n x (trm_let t1 t2) = trm_let (open_rec n x t1) (open_rec (S n) x t2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma open_trm_lit : forall n x (l:lit) (t:trm), open_rec n x (trm_lit l t) = trm_lit (open_rec n x l) (open_rec (S n) x t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma open_trm_write : forall n x (a b:avar) m, open_rec n x (trm_write a m b) = trm_write (open_rec n x a) m (open_rec n x b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma open_trm_call : forall n x (a b:avar) m, open_rec n x (trm_call a m b) = trm_call (open_rec n x a) m (open_rec n x b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma open_lit_fun : forall n x (T:typ) (t:trm), open_rec n x (lit_fun T t) = lit_fun (open_rec n x T) (open_rec (S n) x t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Insertion weakening for ty_capbnd *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_weaken_insert : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
  - apply ty_capbnd_top.
  - apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - apply ty_capbnd_typ.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_sel.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_ignore. assumption.
  - apply ty_capbnd_met.
  - apply ty_capbnd_fld.
  - (* sel *) eapply ty_capbnd_sel.
    + destruct (@var_sub_incap_weaken_insert typing_mode) as [Hv _].
      exact (Hv G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T)) H G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHty_capbnd G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - apply ty_capbnd_rec.
  - (* and *) eapply ty_capbnd_and.
    + exact (IHty_capbnd G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHty_capbnd0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).

  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.

    + apply ctx_vis_e.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_met : forall y (G : ctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC : typ),
  y \notin ctx_dom G -> y <> xz -> y <> xc ->
  y \notin ctx_dom (ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC).

  intros. apply notin_dom_push; [|exact H1].
  apply notin_dom_push; [|exact H0]. exact H.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_met_refined : forall y (G : ctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC TC2 : typ),
  y \notin ctx_dom G -> y <> xz -> y <> xc ->
  y \notin ctx_dom (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2).
Proof.
  intros. apply notin_dom_push; [|exact H1].
  apply notin_dom_push; [|exact H0]. exact H.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_obj_met : forall y (G : ctx) (Go : objctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC : typ),

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma defs_has_cons_here : forall (ds:defs) (d:def),
  defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d.
Proof.
  intros ds d. unfold defs_has. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := label_of d = label_of d) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_cons_other : forall (ds:defs) (d d':def),
  label_of d <> label_of d' -> defs_has ds d' -> defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d'.
Proof.
  intros ds d d' Hne Hh. unfold defs_has in *. cbn.
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := label_of d = label_of d') Hne).
  assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_has_contra : forall (ds:defs) (d:def) l,
  defs_hasnt ds l -> defs_has ds d -> label_of d = l -> False.
Proof.
  intros ds d l Hn Hh He. unfold defs_hasnt, defs_has in *.
  rewrite He in Hh. rewrite Hh in Hn. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_label : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> label_of d = label_of D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_record_dec : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H.
  - (* def_typ *) apply rd_typ.
  - (* def_fld *) apply rd_fld.
  - (* def_met *) eapply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rcd_inv : forall (D:dec) ls,
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) ls -> ls = singleton (label_of D).
Proof.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Equivalence RecordTypes TypingMode InertContext Indep GeneralTyping.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Notation typ_refcap_corr Tw Ty := (
  match (mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcap_corr_same =>

    Ty = Tw
  | mode_refcap_corr_ref_mutability =>

    exists Tbnd, (Tw = (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) /\ Ty = (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end) (only parsing).

Inductive typ_corr: typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_corr_obj(T S U: typ):
  typ_refcap_corr S U ->
  typ_corr (typ_objref T S) (typ_objref T U)
| typ_corr_fun(t1 t2: typ):
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  typ_corr (typ_fun t1 t2) (typ_fun t1 t2)
.

Inductive renv_corr: ctx -> renv -> Prop :=

| renv_corr_empty(G: ctx):
    renv_corr G renv_empty

| renv_corr_ref(G1 G2 G3: ctx)(e: renv)(w y: var)(Tw Ty: typ):
    ctx_binds_k_after w v_ref Tw G1 G2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after y v_loc Ty G2 G3 ->
    typ_corr Tw Ty ->
    renv_corr G1 e ->
    renv_corr G1 (renv_bind e w y)
.

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments renv_corr {typing_mode}.

Arguments typ_corr {typing_mode}.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Notation env_binds_more e e' :=
  (forall y w, binds w y e -> binds w y e') (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence Visibility TFree ConfigVarkinds Deref HeapInstantiate Indep RecordTypes InertContext RecordDefs Equivalence ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> renv -> heap -> var -> Prop :=

| ty_item_fun_s : forall G e s x S t L T,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G ->
    binds x (item_fun t) s ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x T) ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_item_s G e s x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall G e s x U S ds T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    binds x (item_obj ds) s ->
    T = typ_objref U S ->
    G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    ty_item_s G e s x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (e: renv) (s : heap) : Prop :=
  ctx_ok G /\
  ctx_weakens G /\
  ok s /\
  ok e /\
  ctx_kdom v_loc G = dom s /\
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e /\
  renv_corr G e /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom s ->
      ty_item_s G e s x).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments heap_correspond {typing_mode}.

Notation inert_G_for_item G w y T := (G § y / v_loc ~ T § w / v_ref ~ T).

Notation inert_G_for_obj G w y T S := (inert_G_for_item G w y (typ_objref T S)).

Notation heap_prefix S1 S2 := (exists S1', S2 = concat S1 S1').
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence TFree Deref.

Inductive def_varkinds: ctx -> def -> Prop :=

| def_varkinds_fld G x l:
  ctx_k G x v_loc ->
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l (avar_f x))

| def_varkinds_typ G T l:
  def_varkinds G (def_typ l T)

| def_varkinds_met G t l:
  all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
  def_varkinds G (def_met l t)
.

Inductive defs_varkinds: ctx -> defs -> Prop :=
| defs_varkinds_nil G:
  defs_varkinds G (defs_nil)
| defs_varkinds_cons G ds d:
  defs_varkinds G ds ->
  def_varkinds G d ->
  defs_varkinds G (defs_cons ds d)
.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Vars Context Objctx Envs Env Types ConfigNotations.

(** * Basic context facts *)

Lemma ctx_kdom_push_eq : forall vk G v T,
  ctx_kdom vk (ctx_push G v vk T) = singleton v \u ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := vk = vk) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_kdom_push_neq : forall vk vk' G v T,
  vk <> vk' ->
  ctx_kdom vk (ctx_push G v vk' T) = ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_r (P := vk = vk') H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_binds : forall x vk T G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G1 G2 -> ctx_binds x T G1.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G1 G2 H. induction H.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_kdom : forall x vk T G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G1 G2 -> x \in ctx_kdom vk G1.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v vk0 t G|v v2 vk1 vk2 t t2 G1' G2 Hne H IH].
  - rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - destruct (classicT (vk1 = vk2)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite <- E. rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq. rewrite in_union. right. exact IH.
    + erewrite ctx_kdom_push_neq; [exact IH|exact N].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ x \in ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros G x vk [T [G2 H]]. exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; eauto.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_kdom; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_kdom_in_dom : forall vk G x,
  x \in ctx_kdom vk G -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros vk G. induction G as [|G IH v vk2 T|G IH|G IH]; intros x Hx.
  - cbn in Hx. rewrite in_empty in Hx. inversion Hx.
  - destruct (classicT (vk = vk2)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite <- E in Hx. rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq in Hx. rewrite in_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
      * cbn. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hx.
      * cbn. rewrite in_union. right. apply IH; assumption.
    + rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_neq vk vk2 G v T N) in Hx.
      cbn. rewrite in_union. right. apply IH; assumption.
  - cbn in Hx. cbn. apply IH; assumption.
  - cbn in Hx. cbn. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_ok_binds_unique : forall G, ctx_ok G ->
  forall x T U, ctx_binds x T G -> ctx_binds x U G -> T = U.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|G IH v vk t|G IH|G IH]; intros Hok x T U Hb1 Hb2.
  - inversion Hb1.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v0 vk0 t0 Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    dependent destruction Hb1.
    + dependent destruction Hb2.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso. match goal with Hne : ?a <> ?a |- _ => exact (Hne eq_refl) end.
    + dependent destruction Hb2.
      * exfalso. match goal with Hne : ?a <> ?a |- _ => exact (Hne eq_refl) end.
      * eapply IH; eauto.
  - dependent destruction Hb1.
  - inversion Hok as [| |G0 Hok0|G0 Hok0]; subst.
    dependent destruction Hb1.
    dependent destruction Hb2.
    eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_weaken_push : forall G x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T G -> x <> y -> ctx_binds x T (ctx_push G y vk S).
Proof. intros. eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_in_dom : forall G x, ctx_vis G x -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G x H. induction H.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_push_inv : forall G v vk t,
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t) -> ctx_weakens G.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_stop_false : forall G, ctx_weakens (ctx_stop G) -> False.
Proof. intros. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_hide_false : forall G, ctx_weakens (ctx_hide G) -> False.
Proof. intros. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Environment facts (binds is get = Some) *)

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall A (E:env A) x v,
  binds x v E -> x \in dom E.
Proof. intros. eapply get_some_inv. apply binds_get. eassumption. Qed.

Lemma dom_exists : forall A (E:env A) x,
  x \in dom E -> exists v, binds x v E.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (@get_some A x E H) as [v Hv]. exists v. apply Hv.
Qed.

Lemma env_ok_binds_unique : forall A (E:env A) x v1 v2,
  ok E -> binds x v1 E -> binds x v2 E -> v1 = v2.
Proof. intros. eapply binds_functional; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_k_v_ref_in_env_dom : forall G (e:env var) x,
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e -> ctx_k G x v_ref -> x \in dom e.
Proof.
  intros G e x Heq Hk.
  destruct (ctx_k_binds Hk) as [T [Hb Hd]].
  rewrite <- Heq. exact Hd.

(** Lifting facts from the lower context of a ctx_binds_k_after derivation. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y T, ctx_binds y T G2 -> ctx_binds y T G1.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y T Hb.

    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom.

    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y vk', ctx_k G2 y vk' -> ctx_k G1 y vk'.
Proof.

  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];

    + exact Hfresh.
Qed.

Lemma renv_corr_lookup : forall G e, ctx_ok G -> renv_corr G e ->
  forall w y, binds w y e ->
    exists Tw Ty,
      ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\
      ctx_binds w Tw G /\ ctx_binds y Ty G /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Hok Hc. induction Hc as
    [G0|G1 G2 G3 e0 w0 y0 Tw Ty Hw Hy Hcorr Hrenv IH]; intros w y Hb.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv. exact Hb.
  - destruct (classicT (w = w0)) as [E|N].
    + subst w. assert (Ey : y = y0) by (eapply binds_push_eq_inv; exact Hb). subst y.
      exists Tw, Ty. split.
      * eapply ctx_binds_k_after_kdom. exact Hw.

           ++ split.

                 eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hy.
              ** exact Hcorr.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok|]. eapply binds_push_neq_inv; eauto.
Qed.

(** 2) From a v_ref context variable to its heap location and item. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_ref_lookup : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y, binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\ ty_item_s G e Sigma y.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hk.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hxdom : x \in dom e) by (eapply ctx_k_v_ref_in_env_dom; eauto).
  destruct (dom_exists Hxdom) as [y Hy].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists y. split; [exact Hy|]. split.
  - rewrite <- Hds. eapply ctx_kdom_in_dom. exact Kky.
  - apply Hitem. rewrite <- Hds. eapply ctx_kdom_in_dom. exact Kky.
Qed.

(** 3) Inversion of ty_item_s. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_inv : forall G e s x,
  ty_item_s G e s x ->
  (exists S T t L, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G /\
     binds x (item_fun t) s /\
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L -> G § x0 / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x0 t ∶ open x0 T) /\
     all_tfree_k G t v_ref)

     T = typ_objref U S /\ G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) /\
     defs_varkinds G ds).
Proof.
  intros G e s x H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists; eexists; eexists; eexists.
    repeat split; eassumption.
  - right. eexists; eexists; eexists; eexists.
    repeat split; eassumption.
Qed.

(** 4) Environment bindings inherit context kinds/correspondence. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_binds_env : forall G e Sigma w y,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> binds w y e ->
  exists Tw Ty, ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y Hhc Hb.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hb) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists Tw, Ty. split; [exact Kkw|]. split; [exact Kky|exact Tcorr].
Qed.

(** 5) Domain characterizations. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_dom_env : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> dom e = ctx_kdom v_ref G.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma H.
  destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  symmetry. exact Hde.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_dom_heap : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> dom Sigma = ctx_kdom v_loc G.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma H.
  destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  symmetry. exact Hds.
Qed.

(** 6) Projections. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_ctx_ok : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_ok G.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok Hr]. exact Hok. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ctx_weakens : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_weakens G.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk Hr]]. exact Hwk. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ok_env : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ok e.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke Hr]]]]. exact Hoke. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ok_heap : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ok Sigma.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke Hr]]]]. exact Hoks. Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence HeapCorrespondence ConfigVarkinds TFree InertContext RecordTypes.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Context_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Lifting facts from the lower context of a ctx_binds_k_after derivation. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y T, ctx_binds y T G2 -> ctx_binds y T G1.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y T Hb.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk' t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. exact Hb.
    + exact Hb.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk' t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom.
      eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y vk', ctx_k G2 y vk' -> ctx_k G1 y vk'.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y vk' Hk.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk'0 t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_k_weaken_push; [exact Hk|exact Hfresh].
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk'0 t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_k_weaken_push.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hk].
    + exact Hfresh.
Qed.

(** 1) Lookup in renv_corr. *)

Lemma renv_corr_lookup : forall G e, ctx_ok G -> renv_corr G e ->
  forall w y, binds w y e ->
    exists Tw Ty,
      ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\
      ctx_binds w Tw G /\ ctx_binds y Ty G /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Hok Hc. induction Hc as
    [G0|G1 G2 G3 e0 w0 y0 Tw Ty Hw Hy Hcorr Hrenv IH]; intros w y Hb.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv. exact Hb.
  - destruct (classicT (w = w0)) as [E|N].
    + subst w. assert (Ey : y = y0) by (eapply binds_push_eq_inv; exact Hb). subst y.
      exists Tw, Ty. split.
      * exists Tw, G2. exact Hw.
      * split.
        -- eapply ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k; [exact Hw|exact Hok|].
           exists Ty, G3. exact Hy.
        -- split.
           ++ eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hw.
           ++ split.
              ** eapply ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds; [exact Hw|exact Hok|].
                 eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hy.
              ** exact Hcorr.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok|]. eapply binds_push_neq_inv; eauto.
Qed.

(** 2) From a v_ref context variable to its heap location and item. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_ref_lookup : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y, binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\ @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma y.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hk.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hxdom : x \in dom e) by (eapply ctx_k_v_ref_in_env_dom; eauto).
  destruct (dom_exists Hxdom) as [y Hy].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists y. split; [exact Hy|]. split.
  - rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
  - apply Hitem. rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
Qed.

(** 3) Inversion of ty_item_s. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_inv : forall G e s x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e s x ->
  (exists S T t L, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G /\
     binds x (item_fun t) s /\
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L -> G § x0 / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x0 t ∶ open x0 T) /\
     all_tfree_k G t v_ref)
  \/
  (exists U S ds T, ctx_binds x T G /\ binds x (item_obj ds) s /\
     T = typ_objref U S /\ G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) /\
     defs_varkinds G ds).
Proof.
  intros G e s x H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. exists S, T, t, L. repeat split; eauto.
  - right. exists U, S, ds, T. repeat split; eauto.
Qed.

(** 4) Environment bindings inherit context kinds/correspondence. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_binds_env : forall G e Sigma w y,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> binds w y e ->
  exists Tw Ty, ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y Hhc Hb.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hb) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists Tw, Ty. split; [exact Kkw|]. split; [exact Kky|exact Tcorr].
Qed.

(** 5) Domain characterizations. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_dom_env : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> dom e = ctx_kdom v_ref G.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma H.
  destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  symmetry. exact Hde.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_dom_heap : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> dom Sigma = ctx_kdom v_loc G.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma H.
  destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  symmetry. exact Hds.
Qed.

(** 6) Projections. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_ctx_ok : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_ok G.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok Hr]. exact Hok. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ctx_weakens : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_weakens G.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk Hr]]. exact Hwk. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ok_env : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ok e.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke Hr]]]]. exact Hoke. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ok_heap : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ok Sigma.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke Hr]]]]. exact Hoks. Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Existing scratch files compile; read Typing_weaken.v (insertion-style weakening for ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap and ty_trm/lit/def/defs; helper ctx lemmas), Weaken_proof.v, Subst_extra.v (subst_var equations, `trm_subst_open_commut`, `typ_subst_*`, `subst_var_eq/neq`, `X_fv_subst`), Context_lemmas.v, Dev.v. Do NOT modify existing files or Task.v. Create /workspace/Typing_subst.v importing those, and prove insertion-style *variable substitution* for typing, the analogue of weakening where a fresh binding `x0 / vk0 ~ S0` is REMOVED and its variable occurrences are substituted by an existing variable x of a subtype.

TARGET STATEMENTS (mutual, in `Section WithTypingMode. Context (typing_mode: Mode).`):

For ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap:
```
ty_var_subst_insert :
 forall G Go e x T, ty_var typing_mode G Go e x T ->
 forall G1 x0 vk0 S0 G2 xr T0,
   G = G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2 ->
   x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
   ty_var typing_mode (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e xr T0 ->
   subtyp typing_mode (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e T0 (subst_var x0 xr S0) ->
   ty_var typing_mode (G1 §& G2) Go e (subst_var x0 xr x) (subst_var x0 xr T)
```
and analogous `subtyp_subst_insert`, `ty_incap_subst_insert` (same pattern; for subtyp/incap the "term" is a type, substitute with subst_var on typ).
(If Go is always objctx_empty in ty_var constructors, keep it general anyway.)

For ty_trm/lit/def/defs:
```
ty_subst_insert_mut :
 (forall G Go e t T, ty_trm typing_mode G Go e t T ->
   forall G1 x0 vk0 S0 G2 xr T0,
     G = G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2 ->
     x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
     ty_var typing_mode (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e xr T0 ->
     subtyp typing_mode (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e T0 (subst_var x0 xr S0) ->
     ty_trm typing_mode (G1 §& G2) Go e (subst_var x0 xr t) (subst_var x0 xr T))
 /\ same for ty_lit (subst_var on lit) / ty_def (subst_var on def) / ty_defs (subst_var on defs)
```
Derive top-push corollaries `ty_trm_subst_top` etc. (G = G0 § x0/vk0~S0, G1=G0, G2=empty).

Also prove the analogous substitution for `ty_capbnd` and `viewpoint_adapt_cap` / `viewpoint_adapt` (same insertion pattern, substituting in T/U and in the avar/typ arguments) since typing rules use viewpoint adaptation; if that is too hard, prove the viewpoints via the incap/capbnd substitutions.

HINTS:
- These are the same inductions as Typing_weaken.v. For each fresh-binder rule (`forall y, y\notin L -> ...`), enlarge L with both `x0` and `xr`, instantiate the fresh binder y, and apply the induction hypothesis at the split `(G1, G2 § y)`. The x/xr typing and subtype needed by the IH at the extended base context are obtained from the given ones by *weakening* with Typing_weaken's insertion lemma (`ty_weaken_insert_mut`/top corollaries and `var_sub_incap_weaken_insert`), pushing y at the split; use the insertion form to place y inside G2. Change of context from `(G1§&G2)§y` vs `(G1)§&(G2§y)` may require ctx_concat algebra helpers in Typing_weaken.v/Weaken_proof.v.
- For ty_var_var: the binding is in G; if it is the x0 binding, the derivation types x0 at some V, and after substitution the term becomes xr. The given `ty_var ... xr T0` and subtype T0 <: subst S0, plus ty_var_sub, produce xr at subst V? Note V from the binding's type S0 = V exactly for ctx_binds_e; for older bindings, no substitution needed. Use `ctx_binds` inversion/ctx_ok uniqueness.
- For rules mentioning `typ_indep_b`/all_tfree, substitution should not affect the validity (or use typ substitution lemmas).
- Use `Subst_extra.v`'s `*_subst_open_commut` to push substitutions through `open_rec` in rules with opened subterms, and `subst_var_eq/neq` plus `classicT_l/r` for variable equalities.
- If some auxiliary statement (e.g. viewpoint) is too hard, prove the rest and document; the file must compile without Admitted/admit/Abort/Axiom/Parameter/Conjecture or unsafe flags.

cd /workspace && rocq compile -R /workspace "" -R /workspace/.rocq-deps/TLC TLC Typing_subst.v

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Insertion weakening for ty_capbnd *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_weaken_insert : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H.

  - apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - apply ty_capbnd_typ.

  - apply ty_capbnd_rec.

    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e T U.

    viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.

  intros G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.

  - destruct (@var_sub_incap_weaken_insert typing_mode) as [_ [_ Hincap]].

Lemma ty_trm_weaken : forall G Go e (t:trm) T,
  ty_trm typing_mode G Go e t T ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
    ty_trm typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e t T.

  destruct ty_weaken_insert_mut as [Htrm _].
  exact (Htrm G Go e t T H G ctx_empty eq_refl y vk S Hn).

Lemma ty_capbnd_env_mono : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e' T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H. induction H; intros e' Hee'.
  - apply ty_capbnd_top.
  - apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - apply ty_capbnd_typ.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_sel.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_cap_ignore. exact H.
  - apply ty_capbnd_met.
  - apply ty_capbnd_fld.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_sel.
    + destruct (@var_sub_incap_env_mono typing_mode) as [Hvar _].
      exact (Hvar G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T)) H e' Hee').
    + exact (IHty_capbnd e' Hee').
  - apply ty_capbnd_rec.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_and; [exact (IHty_capbnd e' Hee')|exact (IHty_capbnd0 e' Hee')].
  - eapply ty_capbnd_or; [exact (IHty_capbnd e' Hee')|exact (IHty_capbnd0 e' Hee')].
  - apply ty_capbnd_all.
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_cap_env_mono : forall C x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e' Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros C x G Go e Tf Tr H. induction H. intros e' Hee'.

    (fun G Go e t T _ => forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> ty_trm typing_mode G Go e' t T)
    (fun G Go e l T _ => forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> ty_lit typing_mode G Go e' l T)
    (fun G Go e d D _ => forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> ty_def typing_mode G Go e' d D)

    + exact cv.
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e x T o e' Hee').

    + exact ef. + exact cvx. + exact cvz.

    + exact cv.

    + exact (@viewpoint_adapt_env_mono x G objctx_empty e Tfld U vp e' Hee').
  - intros G e x yv a Sfld Tfld cvx cvy mut ox oy e' Hee'. eapply ty_trm_write.

    + exact (IHo e' Hee').
    + intro x. intro Hx. exact (IHo0 x Hx e' Hee').
  - intros L G e l u T U o IHo o0 IHo0 e' Hee'. eapply ty_trm_lit with (L:=L).
    + exact (IHo e' Hee').
    + intro x. intro Hx. exact (IHo0 x Hx e' Hee').

  - intros L G e T t U ef o IHo e' Hee'. eapply ty_lit_fun with (L:=L).

  - intros L G e T ds o IHo ti e' Hee'. eapply ty_lit_obj with (L:=L).
    + intro x. intro Hx. exact (IHo x Hx e' Hee'). + exact ti.
  - intros L G Go e A T U o e' Hee'. eapply ty_def_typ with (L:=L).
    intro x. intro Hx. apply tyq_typ_env_mono with (e:=e); [exact Hee'|exact (o x Hx)].
  - intros G Go e a t T cv o e' Hee'. eapply ty_def_fld.
    + exact cv. + exact (@Hvar (G §§& Go) objctx_empty e t T o e' Hee').
  - intros L G Go e m t TC TZ TR o IHo e' Hee'. eapply ty_def_met with (L:=L).
    intros xz Hxz xc Hxcxz Hxc. exact (IHo xz Hxz xc Hxcxz Hxc e' Hee').
  - intros G Go e d D o IHo e' Hee'. eapply ty_defs_one. exact (IHo e' Hee').
  - intros G Go e ds d T D o IHo o0 IHo0 h e' Hee'. eapply ty_defs_cons.
    + exact (IHo e' Hee'). + exact (IHo0 e' Hee'). + exact h.

  ty_trm typing_mode G Go e t T -> forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> ty_trm typing_mode G Go e' t T.
Proof. intros. destruct ty_env_mono_mut as [H _]. exact (H G Go e t T H0 e' H1). Qed.
Lemma ty_lit_env_mono : forall G Go e (l:lit) T,
  ty_lit typing_mode G Go e l T -> forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> ty_lit typing_mode G Go e' l T.
Proof. intros. destruct ty_env_mono_mut as [_ [H _]]. exact (H G Go e l T H0 e' H1). Qed.
Lemma ty_def_env_mono : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D -> forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> ty_def typing_mode G Go e' d D.
Proof. intros. destruct ty_env_mono_mut as [_ [_ [H _]]]. exact (H G Go e d D H0 e' H1). Qed.
Lemma ty_defs_env_mono : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T -> forall e', env_binds_more e e' -> ty_defs typing_mode G Go e' ds T.
Proof. intros. destruct ty_env_mono_mut as [_ [_ [_ H]]]. exact (H G Go e ds T H0 e' H1). Qed.

End WithTypingMode3.

Lemma notin_dom_push : forall y (G : ctx) x vk S,
  y \notin ctx_dom G -> y <> x -> y \notin ctx_dom (G § x / vk ~ S).
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite notin_union. split.
  - rewrite notin_singleton. auto.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_concat_push : forall (G : ctx) x vk S,
  G §& (x / vk ~ S) = G § x / vk ~ S.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_insert : forall x T (G1 G2 : ctx) y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (G1 §& G2) ->
  y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x T ((G1 § y / vk ~ S) §& G2).
Proof.
  intros x T G1 G2 y vk S Hc H1 H2.
  assert (Hxy : x <> y).
  { intro E. subst. apply (@notin_dom_concat y G1 G2 H1 H2). exact (@ctx_binds_in_dom (G1 §& G2) y T Hc). }
  revert G1 Hc H1.
  induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn. eapply ctx_binds_n; [ exact Hxy | exact Hc ].
  - (* push *) cbn in Hc.
    inversion Hc; subst.
    + cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
    + (* n *) cbn.
      rewrite notin_union in H2. destruct H2 as [H2v H2g].
      rewrite notin_singleton in H2v.
      eapply ctx_binds_n; [ exact H5 | exact (IHG2 H2g G1 H8 H1) ].
  - (* stop *) cbn in Hc. inversion Hc.
  - (* hide *) cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide. apply (IHG2 H2 G1 H4 H1).
Qed.

(** ** Insertion-based weakening for ty_var / subtyp / ty_incap *)

Lemma ctx_push_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x vk T,
  (G1 §& G2) § x / vk ~ T = G1 §& (G2 § x / vk ~ T).
Proof.
  intros. change ((G1 §& G2) §& (x / vk ~ T) = G1 §& (G2 §& (x / vk ~ T))).
  rewrite <- ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_met_empty : forall w x (TZ : typ) z (TC : typ),
  w <> x -> w <> z -> w \notin ctx_dom (ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC).
Proof.
  intros. cbn. repeat rewrite notin_union. repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
  split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x (TZ : typ) z (TC : typ),
  ctx_met (G1 §& G2) x TZ z TC =
  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC).
Proof.
  intros. change (G1 §& G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC =
                  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC)).
  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       ty_var typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e x T)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:subtyp typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Notation typ_objref T S := (typ_and (typ_bnd T) S) (only parsing).

Notation typ_objref_loc typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => (typ_objref T typ_top)
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => (typ_objref T (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end)(only parsing).

Inductive refcap_inert_mutability: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=
| refacp_inert_mutability_loc: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) v_loc
| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

Notation obj_typ_is cond T S vk := (
      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

Notation fun_typ_is cond S T := (
      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

Notation fun_type U := (exists S T, fun_typ_is (eq U) S T) (only parsing).

Notation obj_type typing_mode U := (exists T S, obj_typ_is typing_mode (eq U) T S) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive inert_vk: varkind -> Prop :=
  | inert_vk_loc: inert_vk v_loc
  | inert_vk_ref: inert_vk v_ref.

Inductive inert_typ: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=

  | inert_typ_fun S T vk:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    fun_typ_is inert_typ S T vk

  | inert_typ_obj T S vk:
    obj_typ_is inert_typ T S vk.

Definition inert_type T := exists vk, inert_typ T vk.

Inductive inert: ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty: inert ctx_empty
  | inert_push G x vk T:

      inert_vk vk ->
      inert_typ T vk ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      inert (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments inert [typing_mode].

Arguments inert_typ {typing_mode}.

Arguments inert_type {typing_mode}.

  | fresh_telescope_empty : fresh_telescope ctx_empty

      fresh_telescope G ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      fresh_telescope (G § x / vk ~ T).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

    We remove a dummy binding [x0 / vk0 ~ S0] inserted between [G1] and [G2]
    and substitute [x0] by [xr].

    ambient context unchanged as [G1 §& G2], is NOT provable.  Context binder

    stored types.  The correct conclusion keeps the *substituted* context

        subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)

    hypothesis [x0 \notin ctx_fv (G1 §& G2)] (and [x0 \notin fv S0]); see
    [subst_ctx_id] below.  *)

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Basic facts about [subst_ctx] *)

Lemma ctx_dom_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr, ctx_dom (subst_ctx x0 xr G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr; cbn; auto.
  - rewrite IHG. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHG. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_push_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x vk T x0 xr,
  subst_ctx x0 xr (G § x / vk ~ T) = subst_ctx x0 xr G § x / vk ~ subst_var x0 xr T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Substituting the types of a context preserves lookups (keys are unchanged),
    and substitutes the returned type. *)
Lemma ctx_binds_subst_ctx : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall x0 xr,
  ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr G).
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros x0 xr; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. auto.
Qed.

(** If [x0] does not occur free in any type of [G], then substituting it in the
    context is the identity. *)
Lemma subst_ctx_id : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr,
  x0 \notin ctx_fv G -> subst_ctx x0 xr G = G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr Hfv; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite notin_union in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hv HT].
    rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hv).
    rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh T x0 xr HT). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** Removing the dummy binding from a context

    We first handle a push at the top, then the general insertion position.
    These lemmas only remove the *binding*; the types of the remaining context
    are substituted. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_push : forall (H:ctx) x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (H § y / vk ~ S) -> x <> y ->
  forall x0 xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr H).
Proof.
  intros H x T y vk S Hc Hxy x0 xr.
  remember (H § y / vk ~ S) as Gp eqn:E.
  revert H y vk S E.
  induction Hc; intros H0 y0 vk0 S0 E; subst; cbn in *.
  - (* ctx_binds_e: the looked-up variable equals the pushed key *)
    exfalso. apply Hxy. reflexivity.
  - (* ctx_binds_n: the binding lives in the inner context *)
    apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - (* ctx_binds_hide: impossible for a push at the top *)
    exfalso. cbn in E. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_insert : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 x T,
  x <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  forall xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hfresh Hc xr.
  change (ctx_binds x T ((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2)) in Hc.
  revert G1 Hc Hfresh.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH | | ]; intros G1 Hc Hfresh; cbn in *.
  - (* G2 = empty *)
    cbn in Hc |- *. apply (@ctx_binds_remove_push (subst_ctx x0 xr G1)).
    + cbn. exact Hc.
    + exact Hne.
    + cbn. reflexivity.
  - (* push *)
Abort.

End WithTypingMode.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Subst_extra Typing_weaken Context_lemmas.

(** * Variable substitution for typing: context infrastructure.

    The task's exact substitution statements keep the ambient context unchanged.
    That form is NOT provable in general: context binder types are syntax and may
    mention the dummy name [x0], so removing the dummy binding and substituting
    [x0] by [xr] must also substitute the *types stored in the context*.

    This file therefore develops the correct interface:
      - [subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)] is the ambient context after substitution;
      - under [x0 \notin ctx_fv (G1 §& G2)] it is equal to [G1 §& G2]
        ([subst_ctx_id]), recovering the unchanged-context form.
    A concrete obstruction (type selectors mentioning [x0]) is documented at the
    end of the file.  *)

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Substitution on contexts *)

Lemma ctx_dom_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr, ctx_dom (subst_ctx x0 xr G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr; cbn; auto;
    rewrite IHG; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_push_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x vk T x0 xr,
  subst_ctx x0 xr (G § x / vk ~ T) =
  subst_ctx x0 xr G § x / vk ~ subst_var x0 xr T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_subst_ctx : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall x0 xr,
  ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr G).
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros x0 xr; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. auto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_id : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr,
  x0 \notin ctx_fv G -> subst_ctx x0 xr G = G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr Hfv; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite notin_union in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hv HT].
    rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hv).
    rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh T x0 xr HT). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_fv_subset : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall z, z \in fv T -> z \in ctx_fv G.
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros z Hz; cbn in *.
  - rewrite in_union. right. exact Hz.
  - rewrite in_union. right. auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

(** ** Binding removal when the looked-up name is not the dummy name *)

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_push : forall (H:ctx) x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (H § y / vk ~ S) -> x <> y ->
  forall x0 xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr H).
Proof.
  intros H x T y vk S Hc Hxy x0 xr.
  remember (H § y / vk ~ S) as Gp eqn:E.
  revert H y vk S E.
  induction Hc; intros H0 y0 vk0 S0 E; subst; cbn in *.
  - exfalso. apply Hxy. reflexivity.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - cbn in E. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_insert : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 x T,
  x <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  forall xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hfresh Hc xr.
  change (ctx_binds x T ((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2)) in Hc.
  revert G1 Hc Hfresh.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 Hc Hfresh; cbn in *.
  - (* empty *)
    eapply (@ctx_binds_remove_push G1 x T x0 vk0 S0); eauto.
  - (* push *)
    destruct (ctx_binds_inv_push Hc) as [E1 | E2].
    + (* top binding *)
      destruct E1 as [Ekey Ety]. subst x T.
      apply ctx_binds_e; assumption.
    + destruct E2 as [v2 [vk2 [t2 [Hneq [Hinner Hcon]]]]]. subst.
      apply ctx_binds_n; [exact Hneq|].
      apply IH; [exact Hinner|].
      rewrite <- ctx_dom_subst_ctx.
      cbn in Hfresh.
      rewrite notin_union in Hfresh. exact (proj1 Hfresh).
  - (* stop *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc.
  - (* hide *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    apply ctx_binds_hide.
    apply IH; [exact H5|].
    cbn in Hfresh. exact Hfresh.
Qed.

Abort.

End WithTypingMode.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence HeapCorrespondence ConfigVarkinds TFree InertContext RecordTypes.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Context_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Lifting facts from the lower context of a ctx_binds_k_after derivation. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y T, ctx_binds y T G2 -> ctx_binds y T G1.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y T Hb.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk' t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. exact Hb.
    + exact Hb.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk' t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom.
      eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y vk', ctx_k G2 y vk' -> ctx_k G1 y vk'.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y vk' Hk.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk'0 t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_k_weaken_push; [exact Hk|exact Hfresh].
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk'0 t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_k_weaken_push.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hk].
    + exact Hfresh.
Qed.

(** 1) Lookup in renv_corr. *)

Lemma renv_corr_lookup : forall G e, ctx_ok G -> renv_corr G e ->
  forall w y, binds w y e ->
    exists Tw Ty,
      ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\
      ctx_binds w Tw G /\ ctx_binds y Ty G /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Hok Hc. induction Hc as
    [G0|G1 G2 G3 e0 w0 y0 Tw Ty Hw Hy Hcorr Hrenv IH]; intros w y Hb.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv. exact Hb.
  - destruct (classicT (w = w0)) as [E|N].
    + subst w. assert (Ey : y = y0) by (eapply binds_push_eq_inv; exact Hb). subst y.
      exists Tw, Ty. split.
      * exists Tw, G2. exact Hw.
      * split.
        -- eapply ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k; [exact Hw|exact Hok|].
           exists Ty, G3. exact Hy.
        -- split.
           ++ eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hw.
           ++ split.
              ** eapply ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds; [exact Hw|exact Hok|].
                 eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hy.
              ** exact Hcorr.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok|]. eapply binds_push_neq_inv; eauto.
Qed.

(** 2) From a v_ref context variable to its heap location and item. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_ref_lookup : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y, binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\ @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma y.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hk.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hxdom : x \in dom e) by (eapply ctx_k_v_ref_in_env_dom; eauto).
  destruct (dom_exists Hxdom) as [y Hy].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists y. split; [exact Hy|]. split.
  - rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
  - apply Hitem. rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
Qed.

(** 3) Inversion of ty_item_s. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_inv : forall G e s x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e s x ->
  (exists S T t L, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G /\
     binds x (item_fun t) s /\
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L -> G § x0 / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x0 t ∶ open x0 T) /\
     all_tfree_k G t v_ref)
  \/
  (exists U S ds T, ctx_binds x T G /\ binds x (item_obj ds) s /\
     T = typ_objref U S /\ G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) /\
     defs_varkinds G ds).
Proof.
  intros G e s x H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. exists S, T, t, L. repeat split; eauto.
  - right. exists U, S, ds, T. repeat split; eauto.
Qed.

(** 4) Environment bindings inherit context kinds/correspondence. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_binds_env : forall G e Sigma w y,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> binds w y e ->
  exists Tw Ty, ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.

  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ok Sigma.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke Hr]]]]. exact Hoks. Qed.
