Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence Visibility TFree ConfigVarkinds Deref HeapInstantiate Indep RecordTypes InertContext RecordDefs Equivalence ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> renv -> heap -> var -> Prop :=

| ty_item_fun_s : forall G e s x S t L T,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G ->
    binds x (item_fun t) s ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x T) ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_item_s G e s x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall G e s x U S ds T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    binds x (item_obj ds) s ->
    T = typ_objref U S ->
    G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    ty_item_s G e s x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (e: renv) (s : heap) : Prop :=
  ctx_ok G /\
  ctx_weakens G /\
  ok s /\
  ok e /\
  ctx_kdom v_loc G = dom s /\
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e /\
  renv_corr G e /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom s ->
      ty_item_s G e s x).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments heap_correspond {typing_mode}.

Notation inert_G_for_item G w y T := (G § y / v_loc ~ T § w / v_ref ~ T).

Notation inert_G_for_obj G w y T S := (inert_G_for_item G w y (typ_objref T S)).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Vars Context Objctx Envs Env Types ConfigNotations.

(** * Basic context facts *)

Lemma ctx_kdom_push_eq : forall vk G v T,
  ctx_kdom vk (ctx_push G v vk T) = singleton v \u ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := vk = vk) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_kdom_push_neq : forall vk vk' G v T,
  vk <> vk' ->
  ctx_kdom vk (ctx_push G v vk' T) = ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_r (P := vk = vk') H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_binds : forall x vk T G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G1 G2 -> ctx_binds x T G1.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G1 G2 H. induction H.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_kdom : forall x vk T G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G1 G2 -> x \in ctx_kdom vk G1.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v vk0 t G|v v2 vk1 vk2 t t2 G1' G2 Hne H IH].
  - rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - destruct (classicT (vk1 = vk2)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite <- E. rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq. rewrite in_union. right. exact IH.
    + erewrite ctx_kdom_push_neq; [exact IH|exact N].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ x \in ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros G x vk [T [G2 H]]. exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; eauto.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_kdom; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_kdom_in_dom : forall vk G x,
  x \in ctx_kdom vk G -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros vk G. induction G as [|G IH v vk2 T|G IH|G IH]; intros x Hx.
  - cbn in Hx. rewrite in_empty in Hx. inversion Hx.
  - destruct (classicT (vk = vk2)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite <- E in Hx. rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq in Hx. rewrite in_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
      * cbn. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hx.
      * cbn. rewrite in_union. right. apply IH; assumption.
    + rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_neq vk vk2 G v T N) in Hx.
      cbn. rewrite in_union. right. apply IH; assumption.
  - cbn in Hx. cbn. apply IH; assumption.
  - cbn in Hx. cbn. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_ok_binds_unique : forall G, ctx_ok G ->
  forall x T U, ctx_binds x T G -> ctx_binds x U G -> T = U.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|G IH v vk t|G IH|G IH]; intros Hok x T U Hb1 Hb2.
  - inversion Hb1.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v0 vk0 t0 Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    dependent destruction Hb1.
    + dependent destruction Hb2.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso. match goal with Hne : ?a <> ?a |- _ => exact (Hne eq_refl) end.
    + dependent destruction Hb2.
      * exfalso. match goal with Hne : ?a <> ?a |- _ => exact (Hne eq_refl) end.
      * eapply IH; eauto.
  - dependent destruction Hb1.
  - inversion Hok as [| |G0 Hok0|G0 Hok0]; subst.
    dependent destruction Hb1.
    dependent destruction Hb2.
    eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_weaken_push : forall G x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T G -> x <> y -> ctx_binds x T (ctx_push G y vk S).
Proof. intros. eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_in_dom : forall G x, ctx_vis G x -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G x H. induction H.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_push_inv : forall G v vk t,
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t) -> ctx_weakens G.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_stop_false : forall G, ctx_weakens (ctx_stop G) -> False.
Proof. intros. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_hide_false : forall G, ctx_weakens (ctx_hide G) -> False.
Proof. intros. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Environment facts (binds is get = Some) *)

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall A (E:env A) x v,
  binds x v E -> x \in dom E.
Proof. intros. eapply get_some_inv. apply binds_get. eassumption. Qed.

Lemma dom_exists : forall A (E:env A) x,
  x \in dom E -> exists v, binds x v E.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (@get_some A x E H) as [v Hv]. exists v. apply Hv.
Qed.

Lemma env_ok_binds_unique : forall A (E:env A) x v1 v2,
  ok E -> binds x v1 E -> binds x v2 E -> v1 = v2.
Proof. intros. eapply binds_functional; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_k_v_ref_in_env_dom : forall G (e:env var) x,
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e -> ctx_k G x v_ref -> x \in dom e.
Proof.
  intros G e x Heq Hk.
  destruct (ctx_k_binds Hk) as [T [Hb Hd]].
  rewrite <- Heq. exact Hd.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_in_dom_push : forall G x vk T y,
  y \in ctx_dom (ctx_push G x vk T) -> y = x \/ y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_singleton in H. intuition. Qed.

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inertness of a context binding determines the shape of its type. *)

Lemma inert_typ_k_after : forall x vk T G G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2 -> inert G -> inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G G2 H.
  induction H as [a1 a2 a3 a4|b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 b8 b9 b10 IH]; intros Hi.
  - inversion Hi as [|c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9]; subst.
    exact c7.
  - inversion Hi as [|d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 d8 d9]; subst.
    eapply IH. exact d5.
Qed.

Lemma inert_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  inert G -> ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk Hi [T [G2 Hka]].
  exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka.
  - eapply inert_typ_k_after; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_inv : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S T2, T = typ_fun S T2)
  \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U /\ typ_indep_b 0 U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - right. exists T, S. split; [reflexivity|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typ_corr_inv : forall Tw Ty,
  typ_corr Tw Ty ->
  (exists S T, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\ Ty = typ_fun S T)
  \/
  (exists U S1 S2, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2).
Proof.
  intros Tw Ty H. dependent destruction H.
  - right. exists T, S, U. split; [reflexivity|reflexivity].
  - left. exists t1, t2. split; [assumption|]. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** Canonical shape of the heap item reached by a v_ref variable. *)

Lemma item_canonical : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y Tw Ty,
    binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\
    ctx_binds x Tw G /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty /\
    ( (exists S T tf, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\
                       Ty = typ_fun S T /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
      \/ (exists U S1 S2 ds, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2 /\
            binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\ record_type U /\
            G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U /\ defs_varkinds G ds) ).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk.
  pose proof (heap_correspond_ref_lookup Hhc Hk) as Href.
  destruct Href as [y [Hbxy [Hydom Hitem]]].
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitemall]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hbxy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkx [Kky [Bx [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  assert (HinertTw : inert_typ Tw v_ref).
  { destruct Hk as [Tk [G2 Hka]].
    assert (Bk : ctx_binds x Tk G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
    pose proof (inert_typ_k_after Hka Hinert) as Ity.
    assert (Tk = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact Bk|exact Bx]).
    subst. exact Ity. }
  exists y, Tw, Ty. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hydom|].
  split; [exact Bx|]. split; [exact Kky|]. split; [exact Tcorr|].
  destruct (ty_item_s_inv Hitem) as
    [ [S0 [T0 [tf [L [Hmf [Bty [Bitem [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]]
    | [U [Sx [ds [Ty0 [Bty [Bitem [Heq [Hds_ty Hvark]]]]]]]] ].
  - left. exists S0, T0, tf.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_fun S0 T0)
      by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]).
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + injection HTy as HS HT. subst S'. subst T'. split; [exact Hmf'|].
      split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|exact Bitem].
    + discriminate HTy.
  - right.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_objref U Sx).
    { rewrite Heq in Bty. eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]. }
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + discriminate HTy.
    + injection HTy as HU HS. subst U'. subst S2.
      exists U, S1, Sx, ds. split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|].
      assert (HrecU : record_type U).
      { destruct (inert_typ_inv HinertTw) as [[Sf [Tf Hfun]]|[U2 [S3 [Heq2 [Hrec2 _]]]]].
        - rewrite HTw in Hfun. discriminate Hfun.
        - rewrite HTw in Heq2. injection Heq2 as H3 H4. subst U2. exact Hrec2. }
      split; [exact Bitem|]. split; [exact HrecU|].
      split; [exact Hds_ty|exact Hvark].
Qed.

(** ** From a record label to a field definition. *)

Lemma label_of_fld_inv : forall (d:def) a,
  label_of d = label_fld a -> exists v, d = def_fld a v.
Proof.
  intros d a H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma def_varkinds_fld_avar : forall G l (v:avar),
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G l v H. inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_fld : forall G (ds:defs) a (v:avar),
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_fld a v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G ds. induction ds as [|tl IH d0]; intros a v Hvk Hhas.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas. discriminate.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d0 = label_fld a)) as [E|N]; cbn in Hhas.
    + injection Hhas as Hd. subst d0.
      inversion Hvk; subst. eapply def_varkinds_fld_avar; eauto.
    + inversion Hvk; subst. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_fld_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall y (U:typ) ls,
    T = open y U -> record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a Hty y U ls HT Hrec Hlab Hvk. subst T.
  destruct (ty_defs_record Hty) as [Hex Hinvs].
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as Hrec'.
  destruct (Hinvs ls Hrec' (label_fld a) Hlab) as [d [Hhas Hlabel]].
  eapply label_of_fld_inv in Hlabel. destruct Hlabel as [v Hd]. subst d.
  destruct (@defs_varkinds_has_fld G ds a v Hvk Hhas) as [x E]. subst v.
  exists x. exact Hhas.
Qed.

(** ** Conditional canonical forms (the remaining gap is the target-type to
       binding-shape/label connection, which needs inert-source subtyping
       inversion; see the note at the end of the file). *)

Lemma canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun : forall G e Sigma x Tw,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  ctx_binds x Tw G ->
  (exists S0 T0, Tw = typ_fun S0 T0) ->
  exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Tw Hhc Hinert Hk Bx [S0 [T0 HTw]].

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inert contexts: every binding type is inert. *)

Lemma inert_ctx_all : forall G z T,
  inert G -> ctx_binds z T G -> exists vk, inert_typ T vk.
Proof. intros. eapply inert_binds_typ; eauto. Qed.

(** ** A syntactic "has label" predicate (weaker than [record_typ]). *)

Inductive HasLabel (l:label) : typ -> Prop :=
| hl_rcd : forall (D:dec), label_of D = l -> HasLabel l (typ_rcd D)
| hl_and_l : forall T U, HasLabel l T -> HasLabel l (typ_and T U)
| hl_and_r : forall T U, HasLabel l U -> HasLabel l (typ_and T U).

Lemma record_typ_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls l,
  record_typ T ls -> l \in ls -> HasLabel l T.
Proof.
  intros T ls l H. induction H as [D l0 Hdec Heq|T ls D l0 Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot].
  - intros Hl. rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    eapply hl_rcd. symmetry. exact Heq.
  - intros Hl. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + eapply hl_and_l. eapply IH; eauto.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. eapply hl_and_r. eapply hl_rcd. symmetry. exact Heq.
Qed.

(** ** Equivalence preserves record labels (as a syntactic predicate). *)

Lemma tyq_has_label : forall e (T1 T2:typ) l,
  typing_equiv e T1 T2 -> HasLabel l T2 -> HasLabel l T1.
Proof.
  intros e T1 T2 l H. change (tyq_typ e T1 T2) in H. induction H; intros Hl.
  - inversion Hl.

- `ctx_dom_subst_ctx`, `ctx_push_subst_ctx`, `ctx_binds_subst_ctx`, `subst_ctx_id`
- `ctx_binds_fv_subset`, `ctx_fv_concat`, `ctx_fv_insert_subset`
- `ctx_binds_remove_push`, `ctx_binds_remove_insert` (removes the dummy binding from the substituted context; requires only `x≠x0`, `x0∉dom(G1§&G2)`)
- `ctx_binds_self_push`, `ctx_binds_self_insert` (`ctx_binds x0 T (G1§x0~S0§&G2)` plus `x0∉dom` implies `T=S0`)
- `ctx_binds_remove_insert_id` (unchanged-context lookup when `x≠x0`, `x0∉ctx_fv`, `x0∉fv S0`)

These make the *general* induction run on the context-substituted conclusion `subst_ctx x0 xr (G1§&G2)` (with `Hxr : ty_var (subst_ctx …) xr (subst S0)`), and `subst_ctx_id` recovers the unchanged context under `x0∉ctx_fv`.

**The blocking case — `subtyp_typ`.** Its premise is an unrestricted `forall x` (no freshness set):
`(forall x, G ⊢ open x S2 <: open x S1)`.
After substitution the required premise is `forall x, G'' ⊢ open x (subst S2) <: open x (subst S1)`. The induction hypothesis on the original premise at `x'` gives `open (subst x') (subst S2) <: open (subst x') (subst S1)`. For `x ≠ x0` take `x'=x`; but for `x = x0` we have `subst x0 = xr`, so the IH yields the statement at `xr`, not at `x0`. The two types differ exactly at the name inserted at the opened bound positions, and no rule of the type system renames that. The original premise instance at `x0` was proved under `G` (where `x0` was bound); in `G''` the name `x0` is unbound. Hence this case cannot close from the listed hypotheses.

Two repairs (documented in the file):
1. Add the freshness hypothesis that `x0` does not occur free in the bound types appearing in `subtyp_typ` premises (`S1,S2,T1,T2`); then `subst` is the identity there and the original premise at `x0` is exactly the needed one. Note: `x0∉fv S0` does **not** imply this for inner binder types.
2. Prove an alpha-renaming lemma for opened types: from `G'' ⊢ open xr T <: open xr U` (with `x0` not in `fv T,U`) derive `G'' ⊢ open x0 T <: open x0 U`, plus the corresponding parametric form. This is a non-trivial substitution/renaming property not present in the helper files.

Because `ty_trm_sub` and the other structural rules depend on subtyping substitution, the `ty_trm/lit/def/defs` induction stalls at the same point. Detail is in the comment blocks at the end of `Typing_subst.v`.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inertness of a context binding determines the shape of its type. *)

Lemma inert_typ_k_after : forall x vk T G G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2 -> inert G -> inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G G2 H.
  induction H as [a1 a2 a3 a4|b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 b8 b9 b10 IH]; intros Hi.
  - inversion Hi as [|c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9]; subst.
    exact c7.
  - inversion Hi as [|d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 d8 d9]; subst.
    eapply IH. exact d5.
Qed.

Lemma inert_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  inert G -> ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk Hi [T [G2 Hka]].
  exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka.
  - eapply inert_typ_k_after; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_inv : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S T2, T = typ_fun S T2)
  \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U /\ typ_indep_b 0 U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - right. exists T, S. split; [reflexivity|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typ_corr_inv : forall Tw Ty,
  typ_corr Tw Ty ->
  (exists S T, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\ Ty = typ_fun S T)
  \/
  (exists U S1 S2, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2).
Proof.
  intros Tw Ty H. dependent destruction H.
  - right. exists T, S, U. split; [reflexivity|reflexivity].
  - left. exists t1, t2. split; [assumption|]. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** Canonical shape of the heap item reached by a v_ref variable. *)

Lemma item_canonical : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y Tw Ty,
    binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\
    ctx_binds x Tw G /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty /\
    ( (exists S T tf, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\
                       Ty = typ_fun S T /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
      \/ (exists U S1 S2 ds, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2 /\
            binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\ record_type U /\
            G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U /\ defs_varkinds G ds) ).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk.
  pose proof (heap_correspond_ref_lookup Hhc Hk) as Href.
  destruct Href as [y [Hbxy [Hydom Hitem]]].
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitemall]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hbxy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkx [Kky [Bx [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  assert (HinertTw : inert_typ Tw v_ref).
  { destruct Hk as [Tk [G2 Hka]].
    assert (Bk : ctx_binds x Tk G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
    pose proof (inert_typ_k_after Hka Hinert) as Ity.
    assert (Tk = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact Bk|exact Bx]).
    subst. exact Ity. }
  exists y, Tw, Ty. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hydom|].
  split; [exact Bx|]. split; [exact Kky|]. split; [exact Tcorr|].
  destruct (ty_item_s_inv Hitem) as
    [ [S0 [T0 [tf [L [Hmf [Bty [Bitem [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]]
    | [U [Sx [ds [Ty0 [Bty [Bitem [Heq [Hds_ty Hvark]]]]]]]] ].
  - left. exists S0, T0, tf.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_fun S0 T0)
      by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]).
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + injection HTy as HS HT. subst S'. subst T'. split; [exact Hmf'|].
      split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|exact Bitem].
    + discriminate HTy.
  - right.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_objref U Sx).
    { rewrite Heq in Bty. eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]. }
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + discriminate HTy.
    + injection HTy as HU HS. subst U'. subst S2.
      exists U, S1, Sx, ds. split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|].
      assert (HrecU : record_type U).
      { destruct (inert_typ_inv HinertTw) as [[Sf [Tf Hfun]]|[U2 [S3 [Heq2 [Hrec2 _]]]]].
        - rewrite HTw in Hfun. discriminate Hfun.
        - rewrite HTw in Heq2. injection Heq2 as H3 H4. subst U2. exact Hrec2. }
      split; [exact Bitem|]. split; [exact HrecU|].
      split; [exact Hds_ty|exact Hvark].
Qed.

(** ** From a record label to a field definition. *)

Lemma label_of_fld_inv : forall (d:def) a,
  label_of d = label_fld a -> exists v, d = def_fld a v.
Proof.
  intros d a H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma def_varkinds_fld_avar : forall G l (v:avar),
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G l v H. inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_fld : forall G (ds:defs) a (v:avar),
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_fld a v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G ds. induction ds as [|tl IH d0]; intros a v Hvk Hhas.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas. discriminate.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d0 = label_fld a)) as [E|N]; cbn in Hhas.
    + injection Hhas as Hd. subst d0.
      inversion Hvk; subst. eapply def_varkinds_fld_avar; eauto.
    + inversion Hvk; subst. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_fld_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall y (U:typ) ls,
    T = open y U -> record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a Hty y U ls HT Hrec Hlab Hvk. subst T.
  destruct (ty_defs_record Hty) as [Hex Hinvs].
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as Hrec'.
  destruct (Hinvs ls Hrec' (label_fld a) Hlab) as [d [Hhas Hlabel]].
  eapply label_of_fld_inv in Hlabel. destruct Hlabel as [v Hd]. subst d.
  destruct (@defs_varkinds_has_fld G ds a v Hvk Hhas) as [x E]. subst v.
  exists x. exact Hhas.
Qed.

(** ** Conditional canonical forms (the remaining gap is the target-type to
       binding-shape/label connection, which needs inert-source subtyping
       inversion; see the note at the end of the file). *)

Lemma canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun : forall G e Sigma x Tw,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  ctx_binds x Tw G ->
  (exists S0 T0, Tw = typ_fun S0 T0) ->
  exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Tw Hhc Hinert Hk Bx [S0 [T0 HTw]].
  destruct (item_canonical Hhc Hinert Hk) as
    [y [Tw' [Ty [Hbxy [Hydom [Bx' [Kky [Tcorr Hdisj]]]]]]]].
  assert (E : Tw' = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique;
    [eapply heap_correspond_ctx_ok; exact Hhc | exact Bx' | exact Bx]).
  subst Tw'.
  destruct Hdisj as [[S' [T' [tf [Hmf [HTw' [HTy Bitem]]]]]]
                    |[U [S1 [S2 [ds [HTw' [HTy [Bitem _]]]]]]]].
  - exists y, tf. split; assumption.
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. discriminate HTw.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_obj_field_of_label : forall G e Sigma x a y U (ds:defs) (ls:fset label),
  binds x y e -> binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U ->
  record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls -> defs_varkinds G ds ->
  exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x a y U ds ls Hbxy Hitem Hds Hrec Hlab Hvk.
  eapply defs_has_fld_of_label; [exact Hds | reflexivity | exact Hrec | exact Hlab | exact Hvk].
Qed.

(** NOTE / residual gap: the exact statements `canonical_fun` and
    `canonical_obj_field` in the directive additionally need to connect the
    direct `ty_var` type `T0` (and `T0 <: typ_fun S T` / `T0 <: typ_rcd D`) to
    the inert binding type `Tw`.  The naive pure-subtyping record-label lemma
    is false (Record_subtyp.v), and the transport only survives because
    (a) inert context bindings are functions/object-refs, never bare records,
    and (b) object annotations in `ty_item_s` come from *typed* defs whose type
    members have equal bounds, so the `subtyp_sel1/sel2` bad-bound path cannot
    be used to extract a field label absent from the object's record `U`.
    Formalizing that inert-source subtyping inversion is the remaining work.
    The lemmas above give the heap-item canonical shape and the label-to-def
    step; once one proves `Tw = typ_objref U S` (resp. `Tw = typ_fun ...`) and
    `label_of D \in labels U` from the ty_var/subtyp hypotheses, the exact
    canonical forms follow immediately. *)

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Equivalence Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inert contexts: every binding type is inert. *)

Lemma inert_ctx_all : forall G z T,
  inert G -> ctx_binds z T G -> exists vk, inert_typ T vk.
Proof. intros. eapply inert_binds_typ; eauto. Qed.

(** ** A syntactic "has label" predicate (weaker than [record_typ]). *)

Inductive HasLabel (l:label) : typ -> Prop :=
| hl_rcd : forall (D:dec), label_of D = l -> HasLabel l (typ_rcd D)
| hl_and_l : forall T U, HasLabel l T -> HasLabel l (typ_and T U)
| hl_and_r : forall T U, HasLabel l U -> HasLabel l (typ_and T U).

Lemma record_typ_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls l,
  record_typ T ls -> l \in ls -> HasLabel l T.
Proof.
  intros T ls l H. induction H as [D l0 Hdec Heq|T ls D l0 Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot].
  - intros Hl. rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    eapply hl_rcd. symmetry. exact Heq.
  - intros Hl. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + eapply hl_and_l. eapply IH; eauto.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. eapply hl_and_r. eapply hl_rcd. symmetry. exact Heq.
Qed.

(** ** Inert binding types are functions or object references. *)

Lemma inert_typ_fun_or_obj : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. destruct (inert_typ_inv H) as [[S [U Hu]]|[U [S [Hu [Hrec _]]]]].
  - left; eauto.
  - right; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Target-type inversion for equivalence (needed by subtyp_tyq cases). *)

Lemma tyq_fun_source : forall e (T1:typ) S U,
  typing_equiv e T1 (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S' U', T1 = typ_fun S' U'.
Proof.
  intros e T1 S U H. change (tyq_typ e T1 (typ_fun S U)) in H.
  remember (typ_fun S U) as T2 eqn:E. induction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - inversion H.
  - destruct H; discriminate.
  - eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** RESIDUAL GAP.
    The exact canonical forms require proving, under [inert G] and
    [ctx_binds x Tw G] with [inert_typ Tw vk], that
      (i)  if [ty_var G x T0] and [T0 <: typ_fun S U], then
           [exists S' U', Tw = typ_fun S' U']; and
      (ii) if [ty_var G x T0] and [T0 <: typ_rcd D] with [record_dec D],
           then [Tw = typ_objref U S] and the label of D occurs in
           [U]'s record type.
    The proofs must induct on the [ty_var] derivation (handling
    ty_var_and / ty_var_sub by transitivity on the same target, and
    ty_rec_elim by strengthening the induction hypothesis to targets of
    the form [typ_bnd V]) and then invert the subtyping derivation.
    The subtyping inversion is not a pure syntactic fact: Record_subtyp.v
    contains a counterexample for arbitrary contexts (using sel1/sel2
    through a non-inert record binding).  Under [inert G] that path is
    excluded, but the formal proof requires a transitivity-aware
    induction on the mutual subtyping/typing derivations (a fuel or
    well-founded induction on derivation size), because the only
    obstruction in the naive induction is the [subtyp_trans] constructor,
    whose intermediate type is not itself inert.

    Everything except this type-to-binding-shape transport is proved:
    Canonical.v's [item_canonical] gives the heap item shape from the
    inert binding; [canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun] and
    [canonical_obj_field_of_label] then close the canonical forms once
    the transport is available.  The lemmas above ([tyq_has_label],
    [record_typ_has_label], [tyq_fun_source], [inert_typ_fun_or_obj])
    supply the non-transitive inversion steps. *)

End WithTypingMode.

  change (subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S0 T0) in H.

18	Lemma tyq_rcd_source : forall e (T1:typ) (D:dec),
19	  typing_equiv e T1 (typ_rcd D) ->
20	  exists D', T1 = typ_rcd D'.
21	Proof.
22	  intros e T1 D H. change (tyq_typ e T1 (typ_rcd D)) in H.
23	  remember (typ_rcd D) as T2 eqn:E. induction H; subst; try discriminate.
24	  - inversion H.
25	  - destruct H; discriminate.

   Coq: [subtyp] lives in Prop and cannot be eliminated into Type (Set), cf.
     Error: Incorrect elimination of "H" ... return type has sort "Set"
            while it should be SProp or Prop.
   The transitivity-aware induction must therefore be structural (with a
   generalized motive) or semantic.  The lemmas below are the sound structural
   root-inversion steps that any such proof needs. *)

(** Equivalence inversion for record targets.  Unlike the function case, the
    three record constructors ([tyq_typ_fld], [tyq_typ_typ], [tyq_typ_met])
    survive and directly exhibit the record shape. *)
Lemma tyq_rcd_source : forall e (T1:typ) (D:dec),
  typing_equiv e T1 (typ_rcd D) ->
  exists D', T1 = typ_rcd D'.
Proof.
  intros e T1 D H. change (tyq_typ e T1 (typ_rcd D)) in H.
  remember (typ_rcd D) as T2 eqn:E. induction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - inversion H.
  - eexists; reflexivity.
  - eexists; reflexivity.
  - eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Root inversion: a subtyping from an object reference to a function type can
    only be a [subtyp_trans]; every other constructor is impossible (the [tyq]
    case is excluded using [tyq_fun_source]). *)
Lemma objref_fun_root : forall G e (U S:typ) Sf Tf,
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_objref U S) (typ_fun Sf Tf) ->
  exists X, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_objref U S) X /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e X (typ_fun Sf Tf).
Proof.
  intros G e U S Sf Tf H.
  remember (typ_objref U S) as S0 eqn:ES.
  remember (typ_fun Sf Tf) as T0 eqn:ET.
  change (subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S0 T0) in H.
  dependent destruction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - (* trans *) eexists; split; eassumption.
  - (* tyq *) exfalso.
    eapply tyq_fun_source in H. destruct H as [S' [T' HS]].
    rewrite ES in HS. discriminate.
Qed.

(** Root inversion: a subtyping from a function type to a function type is
    [trans], or the source is already a function type ([refl], [fun], or [tyq]
    with a function source). *)
Lemma fun_fun_root : forall G e (S1 T1 Sf Tf:typ),
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun Sf Tf) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_fun S1 T1) X /\
             subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e X (typ_fun Sf Tf))
  \/ (exists S', T', typ_fun S1 T1 = typ_fun S' T').
Proof.
  intros G e S1 T1 Sf Tf H.
  remember (typ_fun S1 T1) as S0 eqn:ES.
  remember (typ_fun Sf Tf) as T0 eqn:ET.
  change (subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S0 T0) in H.
  dependent destruction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - (* trans *) left. eexists; split; eassumption.
  - (* refl *) right. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - (* fun *) right. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - (* tyq *) right. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Root inversion for an inert object-reference source and a record target.
    The source is syntactically an object reference, so the only constructor
    that can change it is [subtyp_trans]; [subtyp_tyq] is excluded because an
    object reference is not equivalent to a record type. *)
Lemma objref_rcd_root : forall G e (U S:typ) (D:dec),
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_objref U S) (typ_rcd D) ->
  exists X, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_objref U S) X /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e X (typ_rcd D).
Proof.
  intros G e U S D H.
  remember (typ_objref U S) as S0 eqn:ES.
  remember (typ_rcd D) as T0 eqn:ET.
  change (subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S0 T0) in H.
  dependent destruction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - (* trans *) eexists; split; eassumption.
  - (* tyq *) exfalso.
    eapply tyq_rcd_source in H. destruct H as [D' HD].
    rewrite ES in HD. discriminate.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

(** *** Object-reference sources are conjunctions.

    [typ_objref U S] is only notation for [typ_and (typ_bnd U) S]
    (CanonicalForms/InertContext.v).  Consequently a subtyping out of an
    object-reference source is *not* necessarily a [trans]: the [and12]
    rule peels off the second conjunct [S], and [S] itself may be the target.
    In the inert canonical-forms setting [S] is a capability marker
    ([typ_top] or [typ_mut_marker typ_bot]), so this case will be excluded by
    inertness of the binding type; the lemmas below isolate it.  [and11]
    would require [typ_bnd U = typ_fun ...] and [and2] would require the
    target to be a conjunction, both impossible; [tyq] is excluded by
    [tyq_fun_source]/[tyq_rcd_source]. *)

Lemma objref_fun_root : forall G e (U S Sf Tf:typ),
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_and (typ_bnd U) S) (typ_fun Sf Tf) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_and (typ_bnd U) S) X /\
             subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e X (typ_fun Sf Tf))
  \/ S = typ_fun Sf Tf.
Proof.
  intros G e U S Sf Tf H.
  dependent destruction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - (* trans *) left; eexists; split; eassumption.
  - (* and12 *) right; reflexivity.
  - (* tyq *) exfalso.
    eapply tyq_fun_source in H. destruct H as [A [B E]]. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma objref_rcd_root : forall G e (U S:typ) (D:dec),
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_and (typ_bnd U) S) (typ_rcd D) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_and (typ_bnd U) S) X /\
             subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e X (typ_rcd D))
  \/ S = typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros G e U S D H.
  dependent destruction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - (* trans *) left; eexists; split; eassumption.
  - (* and12 *) right; reflexivity.
  - (* tyq *) exfalso.
    eapply tyq_rcd_source in H. destruct H as [D' E]. discriminate E.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes.

Notation typ_objref T S := (typ_and (typ_bnd T) S) (only parsing).

Notation typ_objref_loc typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => (typ_objref T typ_top)
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => (typ_objref T (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end)(only parsing).

Inductive refcap_inert_mutability: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=
| refacp_inert_mutability_loc: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) v_loc
| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

Notation obj_typ_is cond T S vk := (
      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

Notation fun_typ_is cond S T := (
      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

Notation fun_type U := (exists S T, fun_typ_is (eq U) S T) (only parsing).

Notation obj_type typing_mode U := (exists T S, obj_typ_is typing_mode (eq U) T S) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive inert_vk: varkind -> Prop :=
  | inert_vk_loc: inert_vk v_loc
  | inert_vk_ref: inert_vk v_ref.

Inductive inert_typ: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=

  | inert_typ_fun S T vk:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    fun_typ_is inert_typ S T vk

  | inert_typ_obj T S vk:
    obj_typ_is inert_typ T S vk.

Definition inert_type T := exists vk, inert_typ T vk.

Inductive inert: ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty: inert ctx_empty
  | inert_push G x vk T:
      inert G ->
      inert_vk vk ->
      inert_typ T vk ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      inert (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments inert [typing_mode].

Arguments inert_typ {typing_mode}.

Arguments inert_type {typing_mode}.

Inductive fresh_telescope : ctx -> Prop :=
  | fresh_telescope_empty : fresh_telescope ctx_empty
  | fresh_telescope_push : forall G x vk T,
      fresh_telescope G ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      fresh_telescope (G § x / vk ~ T).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Equivalence Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(* NOTE: a numeric size function for [subtyp] derivations is impossible in
   Coq: [subtyp] lives in Prop and cannot be eliminated into Type (Set), cf.
     Error: Incorrect elimination of "H" ... return type has sort "Set"
            while it should be SProp or Prop.
   The transitivity-aware induction must therefore be structural (with a
   generalized motive) or semantic.  The lemmas below are the sound structural
   root-inversion steps that any such proof needs. *)

(** Equivalence inversion for record targets.  Unlike the function case, the
    three record constructors ([tyq_typ_fld], [tyq_typ_typ], [tyq_typ_met])
    survive and directly exhibit the record shape. *)
Lemma tyq_rcd_source : forall e (T1:typ) (D:dec),
  typing_equiv e T1 (typ_rcd D) ->
  exists D', T1 = typ_rcd D'.
Proof.
  intros e T1 D H. change (tyq_typ e T1 (typ_rcd D)) in H.
  remember (typ_rcd D) as T2 eqn:E. induction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - inversion H.                              (* nullary: impossible *)
  - destruct H; exfalso; discriminate E.      (* andor: T t21 t22 = typ_rcd D *)
  - eexists; reflexivity.
  - eexists; reflexivity.
  - eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Root inversion: a subtyping from a function type to a function type is
    [trans], or the source is already a function type ([refl], [fun], or [tyq]
    with a function source). *)

(** * Basic avar seal equations *)

Lemma avar_seal_f : forall n x (y:var), seal_rec n x (avar_f y) = avar_f y.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_seal_b_le : forall n x i, n <= i -> seal_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros. change ((If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i) = avar_f x).
  rewrite (classicT_l H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma avar_seal_b_gt : forall n x i, ~ n <= i -> seal_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof.
  intros. change ((If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i) = avar_b i).

Qed.

  closed_below n a -> seal_rec n x a = a.

  subtyp_star G e T X -> subtyp_star G e X U -> subtyp_star G e T U.

  intros G e T X U H1 H2. revert T H1.

    try (eapply ss_step; [apply ss_refl | econstructor; eassumption]).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types Terms Envs.

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj: defs -> item
  | item_fun: trm -> item.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => (fv ds)
  | item_fun t => (fv t)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (open_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (open_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemOpenable : Openable item := open_rec_item.

Definition subst_item x y (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (subst_var x y ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (subst_var x y t)
  end.

Instance ItemSubstVar : SubstVar item := subst_item.

Instance ItemAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax ItemOpenable ItemFreeVar ItemSubstVar := {}.

Definition seal_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (seal_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (seal_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemSealable : Sealable item := seal_rec_item.

Definition collect_item {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (it: item) : C :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (collect df f comb ds)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance VarSubstVar : SubstVar var :=
  fun x y z => If z = x then y else z.

Instance VarSealable: Sealable var :=
  fun n x y => y.

Instance VarOpenable : Openable var :=
  fun n x a => a.

Instance VarFreeVar : FreeVar var := singleton (A:=var).

Instance VarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax VarOpenable VarFreeVar VarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarSealable : Sealable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2.
Open Scope fset_scope.
Open Scope env_scope.
Open Scope list_scope.

Notation all_tfree_k_lit := (@all_tfree_k lit _).

(** * fset union case combinator *)

Lemma fv_case_union : forall (x:var) (A A' B B':vars),
  (A' = A \/ A' = \{x} \u A) ->
  (B' = B \/ B' = \{x} \u B) ->
  (A' \u B' = A \u B \/ A' \u B' = \{x} \u (A \u B)).
Proof.
  intros x A A' B B' HA HB.
  destruct HA as [HA|HA]; destruct HB as [HB|HB]; subst;
    try (left; reflexivity);
    right; apply fset_extens; intros y Hy;
    repeat rewrite in_union in *; repeat rewrite in_singleton in *; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_case_union3 : forall (x:var) (A A' B B' C C':vars),
  (A' = A \/ A' = \{x} \u A) ->
  (B' = B \/ B' = \{x} \u B) ->
  (C' = C \/ C' = \{x} \u C) ->
  (A' \u B' \u C' = A \u B \u C \/ A' \u B' \u C' = \{x} \u (A \u B \u C)).
Proof.
  intros x A A' B B' C C' HA HB HC.
  destruct HA as [HA|HA]; destruct HB as [HB|HB]; destruct HC as [HC|HC]; subst;
    try (left; reflexivity);
    right; apply fset_extens; intros y Hy;
    repeat rewrite in_union in *; repeat rewrite in_singleton in *; tauto.
Qed.

(** * fv / open cases *)

Lemma fv_open_cases_avar : forall (a:avar) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x a) = fv a \/ fv (open_rec n x a) = \{x} \u fv a.
Proof.
  intros a n x. destruct a as [i|v].
  - destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x E). right. cbn. rewrite union_empty_r. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x N). left. reflexivity.
  - cbn. left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_typ_mut :
  (forall (T:typ) n x,
     fv (open_rec n x T) = fv T \/ fv (open_rec n x T) = \{x} \u fv T)
  /\ (forall (D:dec) n x,
     fv (open_rec n x D) = fv D \/ fv (open_rec n x D) = \{x} \u fv D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n x. rewrite open_typ_top. left. reflexivity.
  - intros n x. rewrite open_typ_bot. left. reflexivity.
  - intros D IH n x. rewrite open_typ_rcd. cbn. apply IH.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_typ_and. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eauto.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_typ_or. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eauto.
  - intros a1 l a2 n x. rewrite open_typ_sel. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eapply fv_open_cases_avar.
  - intros T IH n x. rewrite open_typ_bnd. cbn. apply IH.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_typ_fun. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eauto.
  - intros n x. rewrite open_typ_nocap. left. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_dec_typ. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eauto.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_dec_fld. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eauto.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 n x. rewrite open_dec_met. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union3; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_typ : forall (T:typ) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x T) = fv T \/ fv (open_rec n x T) = \{x} \u fv T.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 fv_open_cases_typ_mut); auto. Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_dec : forall (D:dec) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x D) = fv D \/ fv (open_rec n x D) = \{x} \u fv D.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 fv_open_cases_typ_mut); auto. Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_trm_mut :
  (forall (t:trm) n x, fv (open_rec n x t) = fv t \/ fv (open_rec n x t) = \{x} \u fv t)
  /\ (forall (l:lit) n x, fv (open_rec n x l) = fv l \/ fv (open_rec n x l) = \{x} \u fv l)
  /\ (forall (d:def) n x, fv (open_rec n x d) = fv d \/ fv (open_rec n x d) = \{x} \u fv d)
  /\ (forall (ds:defs) n x, fv (open_rec n x ds) = fv ds \/ fv (open_rec n x ds) = \{x} \u fv ds).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind.
  - intros a n x. rewrite open_trm_var. cbn. apply fv_open_cases_avar.
  - intros a m n x. rewrite open_trm_read. cbn. apply fv_open_cases_avar.
  - intros a1 a2 n x. rewrite open_trm_apply. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eapply fv_open_cases_avar.
  - intros t1 IH1 t2 IH2 n x. rewrite open_trm_let. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eauto.
  - intros l IHl t IHt n x. rewrite open_trm_lit. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eauto.
  - intros a fl b n x. rewrite open_trm_write. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eapply fv_open_cases_avar.
  - intros a fl b n x. rewrite open_trm_call. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eapply fv_open_cases_avar.
  - intros T t IH n x. rewrite open_lit_fun. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; [eapply fv_open_cases_typ | eapply IH].
  - intros T ds IH n x. rewrite open_lit_obj. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; [eapply fv_open_cases_typ | eapply IH].
  - intros l T n x. rewrite open_def_typ. cbn.
    apply fv_open_cases_typ.
  - intros l a n x. rewrite open_def_fld. cbn.
    apply fv_open_cases_avar.
  - intros ml t IH n x. rewrite open_def_met. cbn.
    apply IH.
  - intros n x. rewrite open_defs_nil. cbn. left. reflexivity.
  - intros ds IHds d IHd n x. rewrite open_defs_cons. cbn.
    eapply fv_case_union; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_trm : forall (t:trm) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x t) = fv t \/ fv (open_rec n x t) = \{x} \u fv t.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 fv_open_cases_trm_mut); auto. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_cases_lit : forall (l:lit) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x l) = fv l \/ fv (open_rec n x l) = \{x} \u fv l.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 fv_open_cases_trm_mut)); auto. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_cases_def : forall (d:def) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x d) = fv d \/ fv (open_rec n x d) = \{x} \u fv d.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 fv_open_cases_trm_mut))); auto. Qed.
Lemma fv_open_cases_defs : forall (ds:defs) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x ds) = fv ds \/ fv (open_rec n x ds) = \{x} \u fv ds.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 fv_open_cases_trm_mut))); auto. Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_frame : forall (f:frame) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x f) = fv f \/ fv (open_rec n x f) = \{x} \u fv f.
Proof.
  intros f n x. destruct f as [t]. cbn. apply fv_open_cases_trm.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_stack : forall (s:stack) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x s) = fv s \/ fv (open_rec n x s) = \{x} \u fv s.
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|f fs IH]; intros n x.
  - cbn. left. reflexivity.
  - cbn. eapply fv_case_union.
    + eapply fv_open_cases_frame.
    + apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_item : forall (it:item) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x it) = fv it \/ fv (open_rec n x it) = \{x} \u fv it.
Proof.
  intros it n x. destruct it as [ds|t]; cbn.
  - apply fv_open_cases_defs.
  - apply fv_open_cases_trm.
Qed.

(** * tfree for stacks *)

Lemma tfree_stack_open : forall (s:stack) v, tfree_stack v s -> forall n x, tfree_stack v (open_rec n x s).
Proof.
  intros s v H. induction H; intros n x; cbn.
  - eapply tfree_stack_cons_l. apply tfree_trm_open. assumption.
  - eapply tfree_stack_cons_r. apply IHtfree_stack.
Qed.

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Syntax_extra.

(** * Basic avar seal equations *)

Lemma avar_seal_f : forall n x (y:var), seal_rec n x (avar_f y) = avar_f y.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_seal_b_le : forall n x i, n <= i -> seal_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros. change ((If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i) = avar_f x).
  rewrite (classicT_l H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma avar_seal_b_gt : forall n x i, ~ n <= i -> seal_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof.
  intros. change ((If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i) = avar_b i).
  rewrite (classicT_r H). reflexivity.
Qed.

(** * SealClosed: locally-closed terms are unchanged by sealing *)

Lemma avar_seal_closed : forall n x (a:avar),
  closed_below n a -> seal_rec n x a = a.
Proof.
  intros n x a H. destruct a as [i|y].
  - destruct (classicT (n <= i)) as [E|N].
    + exfalso. specialize (H i x E).
      rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i i x eq_refl) in H. discriminate.
    + apply avar_seal_b_gt; exact N.
  - apply avar_seal_f.
Qed.

(** Projection helpers for closed_below on compounds *)

Lemma closed_below_typ_rcd : forall n (D:dec),
  closed_below n (typ_rcd D) -> closed_below n D.
Proof.
  intros n D H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_rcd (open_rec m x D) = typ_rcd D) in H.
  injection H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma closed_below_typ_and_l : forall n (T1 T2:typ),

Lemma typ_open_commut_mut :
  (forall (T:typ) m n x y, m <> n ->
     open_rec m x (open_rec n y T) = open_rec n y (open_rec m x T))
  /\ (forall (D:dec) m n x y, m <> n ->
     open_rec m x (open_rec n y D) = open_rec n y (open_rec m x D)).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros m n x y H. rewrite open_typ_top. rewrite open_typ_top. reflexivity.
  - intros m n x y H. rewrite open_typ_bot. rewrite open_typ_bot. reflexivity.
  - intros D IH m n x y H. rewrite open_typ_rcd. rewrite open_typ_rcd. rewrite (IH m n x y H). reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 m n x y H. rewrite open_typ_and. rewrite open_typ_and.
    rewrite (IH1 m n x y H). rewrite (IH2 m n x y H). reflexivity.

    rewrite (@avar_open_commut a1 m n x y H).
    rewrite (@avar_open_commut a2 m n x y H). reflexivity.
  - intros T IH m n x y H. rewrite open_typ_bnd. rewrite open_typ_bnd. rewrite (IH (S m) (S n) x y (succ_neq H)). reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 m n x y H. rewrite open_typ_fun. rewrite open_typ_fun.
    rewrite (IH1 m n x y H). rewrite (IH2 (S m) (S n) x y (succ_neq H)). reflexivity.
  - intros m n x y H. rewrite open_typ_nocap. rewrite open_typ_nocap. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 m n x y H. rewrite open_dec_typ. rewrite open_dec_typ.
    rewrite (IH1 (S m) (S n) x y (succ_neq H)).
    rewrite (IH2 (S m) (S n) x y (succ_neq H)). reflexivity.

    rewrite (IH2 m n x y H).
    rewrite (IH3 (S (S m)) (S (S n)) x y (succ_neq (succ_neq H))). reflexivity.

(** * Open/seal commutation *)

Lemma seal_open_commut_avar : forall (a:avar) n m x y,
  n < m -> open_rec n x (seal_rec m y a) = seal_rec m y (open_rec n x a).
Proof.
  intros [i|v] n m x y Hnm.
  - destruct (classicT (m <= i)) as [Hm|Hm].
    + assert (Ne : n <> i) by lia.
      rewrite (@avar_seal_b_le m y i Hm).
      rewrite (@avar_open_f y n x).
      rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x Ne).
      rewrite (@avar_seal_b_le m y i Hm). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@avar_seal_b_gt m y i Hm).
      destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|Ne].
      * subst i. rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq n n x eq_refl).
        rewrite (@avar_seal_f m y x). reflexivity.
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x Ne).
        rewrite (@avar_seal_b_gt m y i Hm). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@avar_seal_f m y v).
    rewrite (@avar_open_f v n x).
    rewrite (@avar_seal_f m y v). reflexivity.
Qed.

     open_rec n x (seal_rec m y T) = seal_rec m y (open_rec n x T))

     open_rec n x (seal_rec m y D) = seal_rec m y (open_rec n x D)).

    rewrite (IH1 n m x y H). rewrite (IH2 n m x y H). reflexivity.
  - intros a1 l a2 n m x y H. rewrite seal_typ_sel. rewrite open_typ_sel. rewrite seal_typ_sel.
    rewrite (@seal_open_commut_avar a1 n m x y H).

  - intros T IH n m x y H. rewrite seal_typ_bnd. rewrite open_typ_bnd. rewrite seal_typ_bnd.

  - intros n m x y H. rewrite seal_typ_nocap. rewrite open_typ_nocap. rewrite seal_typ_nocap. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n m x y H. rewrite seal_dec_typ. rewrite open_dec_typ. rewrite seal_dec_typ.
    rewrite (IH1 (S n) (S m) x y lt_n_S). rewrite (IH2 (S n) (S m) x y lt_n_S). reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n m x y H. rewrite seal_dec_fld. rewrite open_dec_fld. rewrite seal_dec_fld.

Lemma ctx_dom_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr, ctx_dom (subst_ctx x0 xr G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof.

    rewrite IHG; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_id : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr,

  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.

(** ** Substitution on contexts *)

Lemma ctx_dom_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr, ctx_dom (subst_ctx x0 xr G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr; cbn; auto;
    rewrite IHG; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_push_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x vk T x0 xr,
  subst_ctx x0 xr (G § x / vk ~ T) =
  subst_ctx x0 xr G § x / vk ~ subst_var x0 xr T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_subst_ctx : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall x0 xr,
  ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr G).
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros x0 xr; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. auto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_id : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr,
  x0 \notin ctx_fv G -> subst_ctx x0 xr G = G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr Hfv; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite notin_union in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hv HT].
    rewrite (IHG x0 xr HT).
    rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh t x0 xr Hv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_fv_subset : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall z, z \in fv T -> z \in ctx_fv G.
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros z Hz; cbn in *.
  - rewrite in_union. left. exact Hz.
  - rewrite in_union. right. auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_push : forall (H:ctx) x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (H § y / vk ~ S) -> x <> y ->

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext TFree TFreeTyping HeapCorrespondence ConfigVarkinds NothingFresh ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_stack : ctx -> renv -> typ -> stack -> typ -> Prop :=
  | ty_stack_nil : forall G e T U,
      G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
      ty_stack G e T stack_nil U
  | ty_stack_let : forall L G e s t S T U,
      ty_stack G e T s U ->
      (forall x,
          x \notin L ->
          G § x / v_let ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ T) ->
      ty_stack G e S (stack_cons (frame_let t) s) U.

Inductive heap_closed: heap -> Prop :=
| heap_closed_empty: heap_closed empty
| heap_closed_push S x i:
    heap_closed S ->
    closed i ->
    heap_closed (S & x ~ i)
.

Inductive config_closed: config -> Prop:=
  config_sealed_cfg t s Sigma e Lv:
    closed t ->
    closed s ->
    heap_closed Sigma ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv).

Inductive ty_config : ctx -> config -> typ -> Prop :=
| ty_config_c : forall G e s Sigma Lv t T U,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    ty_stack G e T s U ->
    all_tfree_k_stack G s v_ref ->
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_nothing_fresh_in_config G U (t ; s ; Sigma ; e; Lv) ->
    has_null Lv ->
    sealed G ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    closed U ->
    ty_config G (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) U.

Inductive config_typd : config -> typ -> Prop :=
| config_typd_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_typd c U.

Inductive config_hastyp : config -> Prop :=
| config_hastyp_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_hastyp c.

Notation "'⊢' c '∶' T" := (config_typd c T) (at level 40, c at level 59).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes.

Notation typ_objref T S := (typ_and (typ_bnd T) S) (only parsing).

Notation typ_objref_loc typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => (typ_objref T typ_top)
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => (typ_objref T (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end)(only parsing).

Inductive refcap_inert_mutability: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=
| refacp_inert_mutability_loc: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) v_loc
| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

Notation obj_typ_is cond T S vk := (
      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

Notation fun_typ_is cond S T := (
      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

Notation fun_type U := (exists S T, fun_typ_is (eq U) S T) (only parsing).

Notation obj_type typing_mode U := (exists T S, obj_typ_is typing_mode (eq U) T S) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive inert_vk: varkind -> Prop :=
  | inert_vk_loc: inert_vk v_loc
  | inert_vk_ref: inert_vk v_ref.

Inductive inert_typ: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=

  | inert_typ_fun S T vk:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    fun_typ_is inert_typ S T vk

  | inert_typ_obj T S vk:
    obj_typ_is inert_typ T S vk.

Definition inert_type T := exists vk, inert_typ T vk.

Inductive inert: ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty: inert ctx_empty
  | inert_push G x vk T:
      inert G ->
      inert_vk vk ->
      inert_typ T vk ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      inert (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments inert [typing_mode].

Arguments inert_typ {typing_mode}.

Arguments inert_type {typing_mode}.

Inductive fresh_telescope : ctx -> Prop :=
  | fresh_telescope_empty : fresh_telescope ctx_empty
  | fresh_telescope_push : forall G x vk T,
      fresh_telescope G ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      fresh_telescope (G § x / vk ~ T).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0) (only parsing).

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->' y ']'" :=
  (open_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[->' y ']'" :=
  (open y z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_rec_vars n ys z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_vars ys z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Class Sealable (A: Set) := seal_rec: nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Sealable.

Arguments seal_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Notation seal := (seal_rec 0).

Definition sealed `{AS: Sealable A} a :=
  forall x, seal x a = a.

Definition seal_depth_rec `{AS: Sealable A} n x a d := seal_rec (n+d) x a.

Arguments seal_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal y z) (at level 7) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7) : syntax_scope.

Class DecideFv `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) := dec_fv : var -> A -> bool.

Arguments dec_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition dec_notin_fv `{DFv: DecideFv A} x a := negb (dec_fv x a).

Arguments dec_notin_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ReflectFv `(DFv: DecideFv A) :=
  reflect_fv : forall x a,
    (x \in fv a) <-> (dec_fv x a) = true.

Class Closing `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) :=
  close_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Closing.

Notation close := (close_rec 0).

Arguments close_rec : simpl never.

Definition close_depth_rec `{Cl : Closing A} n x a d :=
  close_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation close_depth := (close_depth_rec 0).

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0) (only parsing).

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->' y ']'" :=
  (open_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[->' y ']'" :=
  (open y z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_rec_vars n ys z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_vars ys z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Class Sealable (A: Set) := seal_rec: nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Sealable.

Arguments seal_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Notation seal := (seal_rec 0).

Definition sealed `{AS: Sealable A} a :=
  forall x, seal x a = a.

Definition seal_depth_rec `{AS: Sealable A} n x a d := seal_rec (n+d) x a.

Arguments seal_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal y z) (at level 7) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7) : syntax_scope.

Class DecideFv `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) := dec_fv : var -> A -> bool.

Arguments dec_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition dec_notin_fv `{DFv: DecideFv A} x a := negb (dec_fv x a).

Arguments dec_notin_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ReflectFv `(DFv: DecideFv A) :=
  reflect_fv : forall x a,
    (x \in fv a) <-> (dec_fv x a) = true.

Class Closing `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) :=
  close_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Closing.

Notation close := (close_rec 0).

Arguments close_rec : simpl never.

Definition close_depth_rec `{Cl : Closing A} n x a d :=
  close_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation close_depth := (close_depth_rec 0).

Arguments close_depth_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

- `subtyp1 : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop` — all 27 `subtyp` constructors except `subtyp_trans`, copied verbatim (premises remain ordinary `subtyp`, so each is a genuine one-step tree node).
- `subtyp_star` (`ss_refl`, `ss_step`), `subtyp1_to_subtyp`, `star_app`, `subtyp_star_of_subtyp`.
  These eliminate the nat-measure problem: `subtyp` is in `Prop` and cannot be eliminated into `Set` (`subtyp_size : ... -> nat` is rejected by the kernel), but every `subtyp` derivation is converted to a star in `Prop`.

**Root inversion (with an important correction):**
- `tyq_rcd_source : typing_equiv e T1 (typ_rcd D) -> exists D', T1 = typ_rcd D'`
- `fun_fun_root : subtyp ... (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun Sf Tf) -> trans \/ source-is-function`
- `objref_fun_root : subtyp ... (typ_and (typ_bnd U) S) (typ_fun Sf Tf) -> trans \/ S = typ_fun Sf Tf`
- `objref_rcd_root : subtyp ... (typ_and (typ_bnd U) S) (typ_rcd D) -> trans \/ S = typ_rcd D`

**Correction to the plan:** `typ_objref U S` is *only notation* for `typ_and (typ_bnd U) S` (`CanonicalForms/InertContext.v:9`). Thus an object-reference source is **not** “trans only”: the `and12` rule really can peel the second conjunct `S` and reach the target. The lemmas above state this exactly.

**Inertness/refcap support:**
- `inert_objref_inv` — recovers the `refcap_inert_type S vk` component that `Canonical.inert_typ_inv` discards.
- `refcap_inert_not_fun`, `refcap_inert_not_fld` — an inert refcap is never `typ_fun` and never `typ_rcd (dec_fld ...)`, excluding the `and12` branches above.

### Residual gap (documented in the file)

`inert_star_fun` and `inert_star_record` are **not** proved and are not claimed. Naive star induction does not close, and this is not an unexplored case split:

- In `star_step`, the last `subtyp1` step may be `and2/or2/and11/or11`; reaching a function/record target then requires composing that step with the next one, and the needed premise is a **full `subtyp` derivation** (e.g. `Y <: typ_fun ...`), not a `subtyp1` step.
- Converting that premise to a star via `star_app` yields a star of uncontrolled length (not smaller than the induction variable), and the `star_refl` base reduces exactly to the original statement.
- A subterm recursion into the `subtyp` premise inside a `subtyp1` constructor is not available as a Coq structural recursion (the premise belongs to the separately defined `subtyp` family), and a numeric derivation size is impossible in `Prop`.

Closing this needs either a semantic invariant/model of inert-reachable types or the project's stripped sealing/alpha-renaming theory. Once `inert_star_fun`/`inert_star_record` and the `ty_var` transport are available, `Canonical.v`'s `canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun` and `canonical_obj_field_of_label` assemble the exact forms.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_fun t11 t12) (typ_fun t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| tyq_typ_bnd(e: renv)(t1 t2: typ):
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_bnd t1) (typ_bnd t2)
| tyq_typ_met m (e: renv) t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    (forall x y, typing_equiv e (open_met x y t13) (open_met x y t23)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_met m t11 t12 t13)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m t21 t22 t23))
.

Existing Instance tyq_typ.

Inductive tyq_var_alt: renv -> var -> var -> Prop :=
| tyq_var_alt_eq e v:
    tyq_var_alt e v v
| tyq_var_alt_wy e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w y
| tyq_var_alt_yw e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e y w
| tyq_var_alt_ww e w1 w2 y:
    binds w1 y e ->
    binds w2 y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w1 w2.
---
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_fun t11 t12) (typ_fun t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| tyq_typ_bnd(e: renv)(t1 t2: typ):
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_bnd t1) (typ_bnd t2)
| tyq_typ_met m (e: renv) t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    (forall x y, typing_equiv e (open_met x y t13) (open_met x y t23)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_met m t11 t12 t13)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m t21 t22 t23))
.

Existing Instance tyq_typ.

Inductive tyq_var_alt: renv -> var -> var -> Prop :=
| tyq_var_alt_eq e v:
    tyq_var_alt e v v
| tyq_var_alt_wy e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w y
| tyq_var_alt_yw e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e y w
| tyq_var_alt_ww e w1 w2 y:
    binds w1 y e ->
    binds w2 y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w1 w2.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

  So impossible. Thus if Tw inert and Tw<:fun, Tw must be fun. This is now a *small* proof by case analysis on inert_typ and root inversion, without a general star grammar.
