Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inertness of a context binding determines the shape of its type. *)

Lemma inert_typ_k_after : forall x vk T G G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2 -> inert G -> inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G G2 H.
  induction H as [a1 a2 a3 a4|b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 b8 b9 b10 IH]; intros Hi.
  - inversion Hi as [|c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9]; subst.
    exact c7.
  - inversion Hi as [|d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 d8 d9]; subst.
    eapply IH. exact d5.
Qed.

Lemma inert_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  inert G -> ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk Hi [T [G2 Hka]].
  exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka.
  - eapply inert_typ_k_after; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_inv : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S T2, T = typ_fun S T2)
  \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U /\ typ_indep_b 0 U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - right. exists T, S. split; [reflexivity|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typ_corr_inv : forall Tw Ty,
  typ_corr Tw Ty ->
  (exists S T, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\ Ty = typ_fun S T)
  \/
  (exists U S1 S2, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2).
Proof.
  intros Tw Ty H. dependent destruction H.
  - right. exists T, S, U. split; [reflexivity|reflexivity].
  - left. exists t1, t2. split; [assumption|]. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** Canonical shape of the heap item reached by a v_ref variable. *)

Lemma item_canonical : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y Tw Ty,
    binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\
    ctx_binds x Tw G /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty /\
    ( (exists S T tf, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\
                       Ty = typ_fun S T /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
      \/ (exists U S1 S2 ds, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2 /\
            binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\ record_type U /\
            G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U /\ defs_varkinds G ds) ).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk.
  pose proof (heap_correspond_ref_lookup Hhc Hk) as Href.
  destruct Href as [y [Hbxy [Hydom Hitem]]].
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitemall]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hbxy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkx [Kky [Bx [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  assert (HinertTw : inert_typ Tw v_ref).
  { destruct Hk as [Tk [G2 Hka]].
    assert (Bk : ctx_binds x Tk G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
    pose proof (inert_typ_k_after Hka Hinert) as Ity.
    assert (Tk = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact Bk|exact Bx]).
    subst. exact Ity. }
  exists y, Tw, Ty. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hydom|].
  split; [exact Bx|]. split; [exact Kky|]. split; [exact Tcorr|].
  destruct (ty_item_s_inv Hitem) as
    [ [S0 [T0 [tf [L [Hmf [Bty [Bitem [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]]
    | [U [Sx [ds [Ty0 [Bty [Bitem [Heq [Hds_ty Hvark]]]]]]]] ].
  - left. exists S0, T0, tf.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_fun S0 T0)
      by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]).
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + injection HTy as HS HT. subst S'. subst T'. split; [exact Hmf'|].
      split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|exact Bitem].
    + discriminate HTy.
  - right.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_objref U Sx).
    { rewrite Heq in Bty. eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]. }
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + discriminate HTy.
    + injection HTy as HU HS. subst U'. subst S2.
      exists U, S1, Sx, ds. split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|].
      assert (HrecU : record_type U).
      { destruct (inert_typ_inv HinertTw) as [[Sf [Tf Hfun]]|[U2 [S3 [Heq2 [Hrec2 _]]]]].
        - rewrite HTw in Hfun. discriminate Hfun.
        - rewrite HTw in Heq2. injection Heq2 as H3 H4. subst U2. exact Hrec2. }
      split; [exact Bitem|]. split; [exact HrecU|].
      split; [exact Hds_ty|exact Hvark].
Qed.

(** ** From a record label to a field definition. *)

Lemma label_of_fld_inv : forall (d:def) a,
  label_of d = label_fld a -> exists v, d = def_fld a v.
Proof.
  intros d a H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma def_varkinds_fld_avar : forall G l (v:avar),
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G l v H. inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_fld : forall G (ds:defs) a (v:avar),
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_fld a v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G ds. induction ds as [|tl IH d0]; intros a v Hvk Hhas.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas. discriminate.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d0 = label_fld a)) as [E|N]; cbn in Hhas.
    + injection Hhas as Hd. subst d0.
      inversion Hvk; subst. eapply def_varkinds_fld_avar; eauto.
    + inversion Hvk; subst. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_fld_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall y (U:typ) ls,
    T = open y U -> record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a Hty y U ls HT Hrec Hlab Hvk. subst T.
  destruct (ty_defs_record Hty) as [Hex Hinvs].
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as Hrec'.
  destruct (Hinvs ls Hrec' (label_fld a) Hlab) as [d [Hhas Hlabel]].
  eapply label_of_fld_inv in Hlabel. destruct Hlabel as [v Hd]. subst d.
  destruct (@defs_varkinds_has_fld G ds a v Hvk Hhas) as [x E]. subst v.
  exists x. exact Hhas.
Qed.

(** ** Conditional canonical forms (the remaining gap is the target-type to
       binding-shape/label connection, which needs inert-source subtyping
       inversion; see the note at the end of the file). *)

Lemma canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun : forall G e Sigma x Tw,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  ctx_binds x Tw G ->
  (exists S0 T0, Tw = typ_fun S0 T0) ->
  exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Tw Hhc Hinert Hk Bx [S0 [T0 HTw]].
  destruct (item_canonical Hhc Hinert Hk) as
    [y [Tw' [Ty [Hbxy [Hydom [Bx' [Kky [Tcorr Hdisj]]]]]]]].
  assert (E : Tw' = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique;
    [eapply heap_correspond_ctx_ok; exact Hhc | exact Bx' | exact Bx]).
  subst Tw'.
  destruct Hdisj as [[S' [T' [tf [Hmf [HTw' [HTy Bitem]]]]]]
                    |[U [S1 [S2 [ds [HTw' [HTy [Bitem _]]]]]]]].
  - exists y, tf. split; assumption.
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. discriminate HTw.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_obj_field_of_label : forall G e Sigma x a y U (ds:defs) (ls:fset label),
  binds x y e -> binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U ->
  record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls -> defs_varkinds G ds ->
  exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x a y U ds ls Hbxy Hitem Hds Hrec Hlab Hvk.
  eapply defs_has_fld_of_label; [exact Hds | reflexivity | exact Hrec | exact Hlab | exact Hvk].
Qed.

(** NOTE / residual gap: the exact statements `canonical_fun` and
    `canonical_obj_field` in the directive additionally need to connect the
    direct `ty_var` type `T0` (and `T0 <: typ_fun S T` / `T0 <: typ_rcd D`) to
    the inert binding type `Tw`.  The naive pure-subtyping record-label lemma
    is false (Record_subtyp.v), and the transport only survives because
    (a) inert context bindings are functions/object-refs, never bare records,
    and (b) object annotations in `ty_item_s` come from *typed* defs whose type
    members have equal bounds, so the `subtyp_sel1/sel2` bad-bound path cannot
    be used to extract a field label absent from the object's record `U`.
    Formalizing that inert-source subtyping inversion is the remaining work.
    The lemmas above give the heap-item canonical shape and the label-to-def
    step; once one proves `Tw = typ_objref U S` (resp. `Tw = typ_fun ...`) and
    `label_of D \in labels U` from the ty_var/subtyp hypotheses, the exact
    canonical forms follow immediately. *)

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma inert_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  inert G -> ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk Hi [T [G2 Hka]].
  exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka.
  - eapply inert_typ_k_after; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_inv : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S T2, T = typ_fun S T2)
  \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U /\ typ_indep_b 0 U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - right. exists T, S. split; [reflexivity|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typ_corr_inv : forall Tw Ty,
  typ_corr Tw Ty ->
  (exists S T, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\ Ty = typ_fun S T)
  \/
  (exists U S1 S2, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2).
Proof.
  intros Tw Ty H. dependent destruction H.
  - right. exists T, S, U. split; [reflexivity|reflexivity].
  - left. exists t1, t2. split; [assumption|]. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** Canonical shape of the heap item reached by a v_ref variable. *)

Lemma item_canonical : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y Tw Ty,
    binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\
    ctx_binds x Tw G /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty /\
    ( (exists S T tf, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\
                       Ty = typ_fun S T /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
      \/ (exists U S1 S2 ds, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2 /\
            binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\ record_type U /\
            G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U /\ defs_varkinds G ds) ).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk.
  pose proof (heap_correspond_ref_lookup Hhc Hk) as Href.
  destruct Href as [y [Hbxy [Hydom Hitem]]].
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitemall]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hbxy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkx [Kky [Bx [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  assert (HinertTw : inert_typ Tw v_ref).
  { destruct Hk as [Tk [G2 Hka]].
    assert (Bk : ctx_binds x Tk G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
    pose proof (inert_typ_k_after Hka Hinert) as Ity.
    assert (Tk = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact Bk|exact Bx]).
    subst. exact Ity. }
  exists y, Tw, Ty. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hydom|].
  split; [exact Bx|]. split; [exact Kky|]. split; [exact Tcorr|].
  destruct (ty_item_s_inv Hitem) as
    [ [S0 [T0 [tf [L [Hmf [Bty [Bitem [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]]
    | [U [Sx [ds [Ty0 [Bty [Bitem [Heq [Hds_ty Hvark]]]]]]]] ].
  - left. exists S0, T0, tf.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_fun S0 T0)
      by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]).
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + injection HTy as HS HT. subst S'. subst T'. split; [exact Hmf'|].
      split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|exact Bitem].
    + discriminate HTy.
  - right.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_objref U Sx).
    { rewrite Heq in Bty. eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]. }
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + discriminate HTy.
    + injection HTy as HU HS. subst U'. subst S2.
      exists U, S1, Sx, ds. split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|].
      assert (HrecU : record_type U).
      { destruct (inert_typ_inv HinertTw) as [[Sf [Tf Hfun]]|[U2 [S3 [Heq2 [Hrec2 _]]]]].
        - rewrite HTw in Hfun. discriminate Hfun.
        - rewrite HTw in Heq2. injection Heq2 as H3 H4. subst U2. exact Hrec2. }
      split; [exact Bitem|]. split; [exact HrecU|].
      split; [exact Hds_ty|exact Hvark].
Qed.

(** ** From a record label to a field definition. *)

Lemma label_of_fld_inv : forall (d:def) a,
  label_of d = label_fld a -> exists v, d = def_fld a v.
Proof.
  intros d a H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma def_varkinds_fld_avar : forall G l (v:avar),
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G l v H. inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_fld : forall G (ds:defs) a (v:avar),
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_fld a v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G ds. induction ds as [|tl IH d0]; intros a v Hvk Hhas.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas. discriminate.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d0 = label_fld a)) as [E|N]; cbn in Hhas.
    + injection Hhas as Hd. subst d0.
      inversion Hvk; subst. eapply def_varkinds_fld_avar; eauto.
    + inversion Hvk; subst. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_fld_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall y (U:typ) ls,
    T = open y U -> record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a Hty y U ls HT Hrec Hlab Hvk. subst T.
  destruct (ty_defs_record Hty) as [Hex Hinvs].
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as Hrec'.
  destruct (Hinvs ls Hrec' (label_fld a) Hlab) as [d [Hhas Hlabel]].
  eapply label_of_fld_inv in Hlabel. destruct Hlabel as [v Hd]. subst d.
  destruct (@defs_varkinds_has_fld G ds a v Hvk Hhas) as [x E]. subst v.
  exists x. exact Hhas.
Qed.

(** ** Conditional canonical forms (the remaining gap is the target-type to
       binding-shape/label connection, which needs inert-source subtyping
       inversion; see the note at the end of the file). *)

Lemma canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun : forall G e Sigma x Tw,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  ctx_binds x Tw G ->
  (exists S0 T0, Tw = typ_fun S0 T0) ->
  exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Tw Hhc Hinert Hk Bx [S0 [T0 HTw]].
  destruct (item_canonical Hhc Hinert Hk) as
    [y [Tw' [Ty [Hbxy [Hydom [Bx' [Kky [Tcorr Hdisj]]]]]]]].
  assert (E : Tw' = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique;
    [eapply heap_correspond_ctx_ok; exact Hhc | exact Bx' | exact Bx]).
  subst Tw'.
  destruct Hdisj as [[S' [T' [tf [Hmf [HTw' [HTy Bitem]]]]]]
                    |[U [S1 [S2 [ds [HTw' [HTy [Bitem _]]]]]]]].
  - exists y, tf. split; assumption.
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. discriminate HTw.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_obj_field_of_label : forall G e Sigma x a y U (ds:defs) (ls:fset label),
  binds x y e -> binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U ->
  record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls -> defs_varkinds G ds ->
  exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x a y U ds ls Hbxy Hitem Hds Hrec Hlab Hvk.
  eapply defs_has_fld_of_label; [exact Hds | reflexivity | exact Hrec | exact Hlab | exact Hvk].
Qed.

(** NOTE / residual gap: the exact statements `canonical_fun` and
    `canonical_obj_field` in the directive additionally need to connect the
    direct `ty_var` type `T0` (and `T0 <: typ_fun S T` / `T0 <: typ_rcd D`) to
    the inert binding type `Tw`.  The naive pure-subtyping record-label lemma

End WithTypingMode.

Require Import LibExtra.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)

.

  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->

| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext Defs Defs_lemmas.

(** * Record label structure and subtyping *)

Lemma record_typ_labels_eq : forall (T:typ) ls1 ls2,
  record_typ T ls1 -> record_typ T ls2 -> ls1 = ls2.
Proof.
  intros T ls1 ls2 H1. generalize dependent ls2. induction H1; intros ls2 H2r.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate.
    assert (Hls : ls = ls0) by (apply IHrecord_typ; assumption).
    subst ls0. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_record_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls D,
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of D \in ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrec. generalize dependent D. induction Hrec; intros Dh Hhas.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* andl *) rewrite in_union. left. apply IHHrec. assumption.
    + (* andr *) rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton.
      inversion H5; subst; try discriminate. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** The unrestricted statement
    [record_typ T ls -> T <: typ_rcd D -> record_dec D -> label_of D \in ls]
    is FALSE in the raw subtyping system, because [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2]
    can transport a label out of a type-member bound without the label being
    structurally present in the source record type.  We record an explicit
    counterexample. *)

Section Counterexample.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).
Variables (A: typ_normal_label) (a: fld_label) (x y: var).

Definition ce_target : typ := typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
Definition ce_source : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot ce_target).
Definition ce_G : ctx := ctx_push ctx_empty x v_ref (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) ce_source ce_target)).

Lemma ce_typing : ce_G⁏empty ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) ce_source ce_target).
Proof. eapply ty_var_var. eapply ctx_binds_e. Qed.

Lemma ce_open_source : (ce_source /[-> y]) = ce_source.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ce_open_target : (ce_target /[-> y]) = ce_target.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext Defs Defs_lemmas.

(** * Record label structure and subtyping *)

Lemma record_typ_labels_eq : forall (T:typ) ls1 ls2,
  record_typ T ls1 -> record_typ T ls2 -> ls1 = ls2.
Proof.
  intros T ls1 ls2 H1. generalize dependent ls2. induction H1; intros ls2 H2r.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate.
    assert (Hls : ls = ls0) by (apply IHrecord_typ; assumption).
    subst ls0. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_record_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls D,
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of D \in ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrec. generalize dependent D. induction Hrec; intros Dh Hhas.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* andl *) rewrite in_union. left. apply IHHrec. assumption.
    + (* andr *) rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton.
      inversion H5; subst; try discriminate. reflexivity.
Qed.

    [record_typ T ls -> T <: typ_rcd D -> record_dec D -> label_of D \in ls]
    is FALSE in the raw subtyping system, because [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2]

  - eapply subtyp_sel2 with (S := ce_source) (T := ce_target). apply ce_typing.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1 with (S := ce_source) (T := ce_target). apply ce_typing.
Qed.

Lemma ce_record_source : record_typ ce_source (singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))).
Proof.

Qed.

Lemma ce_record_dec_target : record_dec (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
Proof. apply rd_fld. Qed.

Lemma label_fld_not_in_source :
  ~ (label_fld a \in singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))).
Proof.
  rewrite in_singleton. intro E. inversion E.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_record_has_false :
  exists (G:ctx) (e:renv) (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),

    record_dec D /\ ~ (label_of D \in ls).
Proof.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence Visibility TFree ConfigVarkinds Deref HeapInstantiate Indep RecordTypes InertContext RecordDefs Equivalence ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> renv -> heap -> var -> Prop :=

| ty_item_fun_s : forall G e s x S t L T,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G ->
    binds x (item_fun t) s ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x T) ->
    all_tfree_k G t v_ref ->
    ty_item_s G e s x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall G e s x U S ds T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    binds x (item_obj ds) s ->
    T = typ_objref U S ->
    G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    ty_item_s G e s x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (e: renv) (s : heap) : Prop :=
  ctx_ok G /\
  ctx_weakens G /\
  ok s /\
  ok e /\
  ctx_kdom v_loc G = dom s /\
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e /\
  renv_corr G e /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom s ->
      ty_item_s G e s x).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments heap_correspond {typing_mode}.

Notation inert_G_for_item G w y T := (G § y / v_loc ~ T § w / v_ref ~ T).

Notation inert_G_for_obj G w y T S := (inert_G_for_item G w y (typ_objref T S)).

Notation heap_prefix S1 S2 := (exists S1', S2 = concat S1 S1').
---
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import GeneralTyping TypingMode Defs RecordTypes Indep InertContext.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.
---
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Equivalence RecordTypes TypingMode InertContext Indep GeneralTyping.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Notation typ_refcap_corr Tw Ty := (
  match (mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcap_corr_same =>

    Ty = Tw
  | mode_refcap_corr_ref_mutability =>

    exists Tbnd, (Tw = (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) /\ Ty = (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end) (only parsing).

Inductive typ_corr: typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_corr_obj(T S U: typ):
  typ_refcap_corr S U ->
  typ_corr (typ_objref T S) (typ_objref T U)
| typ_corr_fun(t1 t2: typ):
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  typ_corr (typ_fun t1 t2) (typ_fun t1 t2)
.

Inductive renv_corr: ctx -> renv -> Prop :=

| renv_corr_empty(G: ctx):
    renv_corr G renv_empty

| renv_corr_ref(G1 G2 G3: ctx)(e: renv)(w y: var)(Tw Ty: typ):
    ctx_binds_k_after w v_ref Tw G1 G2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after y v_loc Ty G2 G3 ->
    typ_corr Tw Ty ->
    renv_corr G1 e ->
    renv_corr G1 (renv_bind e w y)
.

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments renv_corr {typing_mode}.

Arguments typ_corr {typing_mode}.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Notation env_binds_more e e' :=
  (forall y w, binds w y e -> binds w y e') (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Equivalence Indep.

Require Export TypingMode TypingContext.

Notation EnvProperty A B := (forall (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Notation TypingProperty A B := (forall (G:ctx) (Go: objctx) (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Class DecTyping (A : Set) := obj_dec_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> dec -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (obj_dec_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Typing (A : Set) := obj_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (obj_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation typing G e a t := (obj_typing G objctx_empty e a t).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation dec_typing G e a d := (obj_dec_typing G objctx_empty e a d).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (dec_typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Subtyping := subtyping: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '⁏' e '⊢' T '<:' U" := (subtyping G objctx_empty e T U) (at level 40, e at level 39, T at level 59).

Class ReferenceIncapacitate := obj_ref_incap :
                                 ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" := (obj_ref_incap G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation ref_incap G e T1 T2 := (obj_ref_incap G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" :=
  (ref_incap G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Class CapabilityBound (C : typ_refcap_label) :=
  obj_cap_bnd :
     ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧  T2" := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation cap_bnd C G e T1 T2 := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧ T2" := (cap_bnd C G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_cap_adapt C x Tcap := (
  typ_cap_marker C (typ_or Tcap
    (typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_refcap C) (avar_b 0))
  )).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y S) <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: (open y T)

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <: typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G⁏e ⊢
     typ_and
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
     <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2))

| subtyp_dist: forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    G⁏e ⊢
      typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3)
      <: typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3)

| subtyp_nocap_bnd G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T

| subtyp_nocap_typ G e A T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_met G e a TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR)

| subtyp_nocap_fun G e TZ TR:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_fun TZ TR

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_boundless G e T1 T2:
    mode_has_top_nm_subtype_boundless typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability) T1 T2)))

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_complement G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) )

| subtyp_nocap_mut_bot G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (typ_and typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) <: typ_bot

| subtyp_mut_top G e:
    mode_has_mut_top typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with ty_incap : ReferenceIncapacitate :=

| ty_incap_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶icp typ_nocap

| ty_incap_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)
     ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)

| ty_incap_cap G e M S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
     ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)

| ty_incap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| ty_incap_sel G e x B y S T T':
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶icp T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶icp T'

| ty_incap_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶icp typ_bnd T

| ty_incap_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶icp typ_and S2 T2

| ty_incap_or G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶icp typ_or S2 T2

| ty_incap_fun G e S T:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶icp typ_fun S T

| ty_incap_nocap G e T:
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp T
.

Require Import Equivalence Indep.

Require Export TypingMode TypingContext.

Notation EnvProperty A B := (forall (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Notation TypingProperty A B := (forall (G:ctx) (Go: objctx) (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Class DecTyping (A : Set) := obj_dec_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> dec -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (obj_dec_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Typing (A : Set) := obj_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (obj_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation typing G e a t := (obj_typing G objctx_empty e a t).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation dec_typing G e a d := (obj_dec_typing G objctx_empty e a d).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (dec_typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Subtyping := subtyping: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '⁏' e '⊢' T '<:' U" := (subtyping G objctx_empty e T U) (at level 40, e at level 39, T at level 59).

Class ReferenceIncapacitate := obj_ref_incap :
                                 ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" := (obj_ref_incap G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation ref_incap G e T1 T2 := (obj_ref_incap G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" :=
  (ref_incap G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Class CapabilityBound (C : typ_refcap_label) :=
  obj_cap_bnd :
     ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧  T2" := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation cap_bnd C G e T1 T2 := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧ T2" := (cap_bnd C G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_cap_adapt C x Tcap := (
  typ_cap_marker C (typ_or Tcap
    (typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_refcap C) (avar_b 0))
  )).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y S) <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: (open y T)

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <: typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G⁏e ⊢
     typ_and
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
     <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2))

| subtyp_dist: forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    G⁏e ⊢
      typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3)
      <: typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3)

| subtyp_nocap_bnd G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_bnd T

| subtyp_nocap_typ G e A T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| subtyp_nocap_met G e a TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR)

| subtyp_nocap_fun G e TZ TR:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: typ_fun TZ TR

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_boundless G e T1 T2:
    mode_has_top_nm_subtype_boundless typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability) T1 T2)))

| subtyp_nocap_mut_top_complement G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) )

| subtyp_nocap_mut_bot G e:
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (typ_and typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) <: typ_bot

| subtyp_mut_top G e:
    mode_has_mut_top typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top <: (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with ty_incap : ReferenceIncapacitate :=

| ty_incap_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶icp typ_nocap

| ty_incap_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)
     ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T)

| ty_incap_cap G e M S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap M) S T)
     ∶icp typ_top

| ty_incap_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)

| ty_incap_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶icp typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2)

| ty_incap_sel G e x B y S T T':
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶icp T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶icp T'

| ty_incap_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶icp typ_bnd T

| ty_incap_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶icp typ_and S2 T2

| ty_incap_or G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶icp S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶icp T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶icp typ_or S2 T2

| ty_incap_fun G e S T:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶icp typ_fun S T

| ty_incap_nocap G e T:
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp T
.

match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
seal_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (seal_rec_typ k u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (seal_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (seal_rec_typ k u TZ) (seal_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSealable : Sealable typ := seal_rec_typ.

Instance DecSealable : Sealable dec := seal_rec_dec.

Instance TypAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypOpenable TypFreeVar TypSubstVar := {}.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance VarSubstVar : SubstVar var :=
  fun x y z => If z = x then y else z.

Instance VarSealable: Sealable var :=
  fun n x y => y.

Instance VarOpenable : Openable var :=
  fun n x a => a.

Instance VarFreeVar : FreeVar var := singleton (A:=var).

Instance VarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax VarOpenable VarFreeVar VarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarSealable : Sealable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
  (subst_ctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_vars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_vars xs ys)).

Notation "G '/[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_vars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_pvars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_pvars xs ys)).

Notation "G '//[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_pvars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_seal_rec n x G :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_stop G => ctx_stop (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_hide G => ctx_hide (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_push G y vk t => ctx_push (ctx_seal_rec n x G) y vk (seal_rec n x t)
  end.

Instance CtxSealable: Sealable ctx := ctx_seal_rec.

Inductive ctx_vis: ctx -> var -> Prop :=

| ctx_vis_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Context Defs Heap.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
.

Scheme tfree_trm_mut    := Induction for tfree_trm Sort Prop
with   tfree_lit_mut    := Induction for tfree_lit Sort Prop
with   tfree_def_mut    := Induction for tfree_def Sort Prop
with   tfree_defs_mut   := Induction for tfree_defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme tfree_mutind from tfree_trm_mut, tfree_lit_mut,
tfree_def_mut, tfree_defs_mut.

Inductive tfree_stack: TFree stack :=

| tfree_stack_cons_l v t st:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons (frame_let t) st)
| tfree_stack_cons_r v f st:
  tfree_stack v st ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons f st)
.

Existing Instance tfree_trm.

Existing Instance tfree_lit.

Existing Instance tfree_def.

Existing Instance tfree_defs.

Existing Instance tfree_stack.

Definition all_tfree_k {A: Set} {AT: TFree A} G (t:A) vk :=
  forall v, tfree v t -> ctx_k G v vk.

Notation all_tfree_k_trm := (@all_tfree_k trm _).

Notation all_tfree_k_def := (@all_tfree_k def _).

Notation all_tfree_k_defs := (@all_tfree_k defs _).

Notation all_tfree_k_stack := (@all_tfree_k stack _).

Definition TFreeInFV (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AF: FreeVar A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    v \in fv t.

Local Definition TFreeOpenInvInd (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AO: Openable A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    forall k x tR,
      t = (open_rec k x tR) ->
      tfree v tR \/ v = x.

Class TFreeOpenInv(A : Set)(AT: TFree A){AO: Openable A} :=
  tfree_open_inv v x (t:A) n:
    tfree v (open_rec n x t) ->
    tfree v t \/ v = x
.

Local Definition TFreeOpenInd (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AO: Openable A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    forall k x,
    tfree v (open_rec k x t).

Class TFreeOpen(A : Set)(AT: TFree A){AO: Openable A} :=
  tfree_open v x (t:A) n:
    tfree v t ->
    tfree v (open_rec n x t).

Section TFreeOpenLemmata.

End TFreeOpenLemmata.

  match e with
  | nil => X
  | cons (w,y) ys => (deref_base su ys (subst_var w y X))
  end.

  deref (e: renv) (a: A): A.

Instance deref_var: Deref var := deref_base VarSubstVar.

Instance deref_avar: Deref avar := deref_base AvarSubstVar.

Instance deref_def: Deref def :=
fun e d => match d with
| def_fld l x => def_fld l (deref e x)
| def_met l t => def_met l t
| def_typ l T => def_typ l T
end.

Fixpoint deref_defs_fix(e: renv)(ds: defs) :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => defs_nil
| defs_cons ds d => defs_cons (deref_defs_fix e ds) (deref_def e d)
end.

| defs_update_push : forall ds d a x ds',
    defs_update ds a x ds' ->
    label_of d <> (label_fld a) ->
    defs_update (defs_cons ds d) a x (defs_cons ds' d).

Definition heap_update (s : heap) (x : var) (a : fld_label) (y : var) (s' : heap) :=
  ok s /\
  ok s' /\
  (dom s) = (dom s') /\
  (forall z v, z <> x ->
          binds z v s ->
          binds z v s') /\
  exists ds ds', binds x (item_obj ds) s /\
              defs_update ds a y ds' /\
              binds x (item_obj ds') s'.

Require Import RecordTypes InertContext HeapCorrespondence.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

    subst.

    + eapply closed_trm_let_l. apply Hct.
    + eapply closed_stack_cons_let; [apply Hct|apply Hcs].
    + apply Hch.
  - apply HcU.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ty_item_s_weaken_push : forall G e Sigma x y vk S e' Sigma',
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma x ->
  y \notin ctx_dom G ->
  env_binds_more e e' ->
  (forall z it, binds z it Sigma -> binds z it Sigma') ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) e' Sigma' x.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x y vk S e' Sigma' Hitem Hy Hee' HSig.
  destruct (@ty_item_s_inv typing_mode G e Sigma x Hitem) as [HF|HO].
  - (* function item *)
    destruct HF as [S0 [T0 [t [L [Hmf [Hcb [Hbind [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]].
    assert (Hxy : x <> y).
    { intro E. subst y. apply Hy. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. exact Hcb. }
    eapply ty_item_fun_s.
    + exact Hmf.
    + eapply ctx_binds_weaken_push; eauto.
    + apply HSig; exact Hbind.
    + intros x0 Hx0. rewrite notin_union in Hx0. destruct Hx0 as [Hx0L Hx0y].
      pose proof (@ty_weaken_insert_mut typing_mode) as [Wtrm _].
      assert (Hyfull : y \notin ctx_dom ((G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) §§& objctx_empty)).
      { intro Hin. change (y \in ctx_dom (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0)) in Hin.
        pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G x0 v_par S0 y Hin) as [E|HinG].
        - subst y. apply Hx0y. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
        - apply Hy. exact HinG. }
      specialize (Wtrm _ _ _ _ _ (Hbody x0 Hx0L) G (ctx_push ctx_empty x0 v_par S0) eq_refl
                    y vk S Hyfull).
      pose proof (@ty_trm_env_mono typing_mode _ _ _ _ _ Wtrm e' Hee') as Wtrm'.
      change (ty_trm typing_mode ((G § y / vk ~ S) § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e'
                (open_rec 0 x0 t) (open_rec 0 x0 T0)).
      exact Wtrm'.
    + eapply all_tfree_k_trm_weaken; [exact Htf|].
      intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref y vk S); eauto.
  - (* object item *)
    destruct HO as [U0 [S0 [ds [T0 [Hcb [Hbind [Heq [Hds Hvk]]]]]]]].
    assert (Hxy : x <> y).
    { intro E. subst y. apply Hy. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. exact Hcb. }
    eapply ty_item_obj_s.
    + eapply ctx_binds_weaken_push; eauto.
    + apply HSig; exact Hbind.
    + exact Heq.
    + pose proof (@ty_defs_weaken typing_mode G (objctx_heap x U0) e ds (open_rec 0 x U0) Hds
                    y vk S Hy) as Hds'.
      pose proof (@ty_defs_env_mono typing_mode _ _ _ _ _ Hds' e' Hee') as Hds''.
      exact Hds''.
    + eapply (@defs_varkinds_weaken G ds y vk S); eauto.
Qed.


(** * renv_corr is monotone under pushing fresh context bindings *)

Lemma renv_corr_push : forall G e x vk T,
  renv_corr G e -> x \notin ctx_dom G -> renv_corr (G § x / vk ~ T) e.
Proof.
  intros G e x vk T H. induction H as [G0|G1 G2 G3 e0 w0 y0 Tw Ty Hw Hy Hcorr Hrenv IH]; intros Hx.
  - eapply renv_corr_empty.
  - eapply renv_corr_ref with (G2:=G2) (G3:=G3) (Tw:=Tw) (Ty:=Ty).
    + eapply ctx_binds_k_n.
      * intro E. subst x. apply Hx. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hw.
      * exact Hw.
    + exact Hy.
    + exact Hcorr.
    + eapply IH. exact Hx.

  all_tfree_k_trm G tf v_ref ->

    (e & w ~ y) (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf) y.

  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V))).

  - exact Hmf.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E. subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    + eapply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply binds_push_eq.
  - intros x0 Hx0. rewrite notin_union in Hx0. destruct Hx0 as [Hx0L Hx0wy].

(** * Helper: renv_corr after the double push *)

Lemma renv_corr_extend_fun : forall G e w y T0 V,
  renv_corr G e -> mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
  renv_corr (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) (e & w ~ y).
Proof.
  intros G e w y T0 V Hrenv Hmf HwG HyG Hwy.
  set (Tfun := typ_fun T0 V).
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tfun w Hin) as [E|Hw].
    - subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    - apply HwG. exact Hw. }
  assert (HR : renv_corr ((G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun) § w / v_ref ~ Tfun) e).
  { eapply renv_corr_push.
    - eapply renv_corr_push; [exact Hrenv|exact HyG].
    - exact HwGy. }
  unfold Tfun in *.
  eapply renv_corr_ref with (G2:=G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) (G3:=G)
     (Tw:=typ_fun T0 V) (Ty:=typ_fun T0 V).
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
  - eapply typ_corr_fun. exact Hmf.
  - exact HR.

(** * Helper: all items of the extended heap *)

Lemma ty_item_s_extend_items : forall G e Sigma w y (L:fset var) T0 V tf,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T0 ⁏e ⊢ open_rec 0 x tf ∶ open_rec 0 x V) ->
  all_tfree_k_trm G tf v_ref ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
  y \notin dom Sigma -> w \notin dom e ->
  forall z, z \in dom (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf) ->
    @ty_item_s typing_mode
      ((G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
      (e & w ~ y) (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf) z.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y L T0 V tf Hhc Hmf Hbody Htf HwG HyG Hwy HySigma Hwe z Hz.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  set (Tfun := typ_fun T0 V).
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tfun w Hin) as [E|Hw].
    - subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    - apply HwG. exact Hw. }
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply Hwe. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  assert (HSig : forall z0 it, binds z0 it Sigma -> binds z0 it (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf)).
  { intros z0 it Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply HySigma. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  rewrite dom_push in Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
  - rewrite in_singleton in Hz. subst z. unfold Tfun.
    eapply ty_item_s_new_fun with (L:=L); eauto.
  - assert (HzSigma : z \in dom Sigma) by exact Hz.
    assert (Hitemz : @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma z) by (apply Hitem; exact HzSigma).
    pose proof (@ty_item_s_weaken_push G e Sigma z y v_loc Tfun e (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf)
                  Hitemz HyG (fun a b H => H)
                  (fun z0 it Hb => ltac:(eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|];
                     intro E; apply HySigma; rewrite <- E; eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb)))
      as Hitem1.
    unfold Tfun in *.
    pose proof (@ty_item_s_weaken_push (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
                  e (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf) z w v_ref (typ_fun T0 V)
                  (e & w ~ y) (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf) Hitem1 HwGy
                  Hee' (fun z0 it Hb => Hb)) as Hitem2.
    exact Hitem2.
Qed.

(** * Extending heap_correspond with a fresh function location *)

Lemma heap_correspond_extend_fun : forall G e Sigma w y (L:fset var) T0 V tf,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T0 ⁏e ⊢ open_rec 0 x tf ∶ open_rec 0 x V) ->
  all_tfree_k_trm G tf v_ref ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
  y \notin dom Sigma -> w \notin dom e ->
  heap_correspond (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
                  (e & w ~ y) (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y L T0 V tf Hhc Hmf Hbody Htf HwG HyG Hwy HySigma Hwe.
  assert (Hhc0 : heap_correspond G e Sigma) by exact Hhc.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V))).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V))) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc (typ_fun T0 V) w Hin) as [E|Hw].
    - subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    - apply HwG. exact Hw. }
  repeat split.
  - (* ctx_ok *) eapply ctx_ok_push.
    + eapply ctx_ok_push; [exact Hok|exact HyG].
    + exact HwGy.
  - (* ctx_weakens *) eapply ctx_weakens_push. eapply ctx_weakens_push. exact Hwk.
  - (* ok Sigma' *) eapply ok_push; [exact Hoks|exact HySigma].
  - (* ok e' *) eapply ok_push; [exact Hoke|exact Hwe].
  - (* ctx_kdom v_loc *)
    assert (Hneq : v_loc <> v_ref) by (intro E; discriminate).
    change (ctx_kdom v_loc ((G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
              = dom (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf)).
    rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_neq v_loc v_ref (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
               w (typ_fun T0 V) Hneq).
    rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_eq v_loc G y (typ_fun T0 V)).
    rewrite Hds. rewrite dom_push. reflexivity.
  - (* ctx_kdom v_ref *)
    assert (Hneq : v_ref <> v_loc) by (intro E; discriminate).
    change (ctx_kdom v_ref ((G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
              = dom (e & w ~ y)).
    rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_eq v_ref (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) w (typ_fun T0 V)).
    rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_neq v_ref v_loc G y (typ_fun T0 V) Hneq).
    rewrite Hde. rewrite dom_push. reflexivity.
  - (* renv_corr *) eapply renv_corr_extend_fun; eauto.
  - (* items *) intros z Hz. eapply ty_item_s_extend_items; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Equivalence Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inert contexts: every binding type is inert. *)

Lemma inert_ctx_all : forall G z T,
  inert G -> ctx_binds z T G -> exists vk, inert_typ T vk.
Proof. intros. eapply inert_binds_typ; eauto. Qed.

(** ** A syntactic "has label" predicate (weaker than [record_typ]). *)

Inductive HasLabel (l:label) : typ -> Prop :=
| hl_rcd : forall (D:dec), label_of D = l -> HasLabel l (typ_rcd D)
| hl_and_l : forall T U, HasLabel l T -> HasLabel l (typ_and T U)
| hl_and_r : forall T U, HasLabel l U -> HasLabel l (typ_and T U).

Lemma record_typ_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls l,
  record_typ T ls -> l \in ls -> HasLabel l T.
Proof.
  intros T ls l H. induction H as [D l0 Hdec Heq|T ls D l0 Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot].
  - intros Hl. rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    eapply hl_rcd. symmetry. exact Heq.
  - intros Hl. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + eapply hl_and_l. eapply IH; eauto.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. eapply hl_and_r. eapply hl_rcd. symmetry. exact Heq.
Qed.

(** ** Inert binding types are functions or object references. *)

Lemma inert_typ_fun_or_obj : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. destruct (inert_typ_inv H) as [[S [U Hu]]|[U [S [Hu [Hrec _]]]]].
  - left; eauto.
  - right; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Target-type inversion for equivalence (needed by subtyp_tyq cases). *)

Lemma tyq_fun_source : forall e (T1:typ) S U,
  typing_equiv e T1 (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S' U', T1 = typ_fun S' U'.
Proof.
  intros e T1 S U H. change (tyq_typ e T1 (typ_fun S U)) in H.
  remember (typ_fun S U) as T2 eqn:E. induction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - inversion H.
  - destruct H; discriminate.
  - eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** RESIDUAL GAP.
    The exact canonical forms require proving, under [inert G] and
    [ctx_binds x Tw G] with [inert_typ Tw vk], that
      (i)  if [ty_var G x T0] and [T0 <: typ_fun S U], then
           [exists S' U', Tw = typ_fun S' U']; and
      (ii) if [ty_var G x T0] and [T0 <: typ_rcd D] with [record_dec D],
           then [Tw = typ_objref U S] and the label of D occurs in
           [U]'s record type.
    The proofs must induct on the [ty_var] derivation (handling
    ty_var_and / ty_var_sub by transitivity on the same target, and
    ty_rec_elim by strengthening the induction hypothesis to targets of
    the form [typ_bnd V]) and then invert the subtyping derivation.
    The subtyping inversion is not a pure syntactic fact: Record_subtyp.v
    contains a counterexample for arbitrary contexts (using sel1/sel2
    through a non-inert record binding).  Under [inert G] that path is
    excluded, but the formal proof requires a transitivity-aware
    induction on the mutual subtyping/typing derivations (a fuel or
    well-founded induction on derivation size), because the only
    obstruction in the naive induction is the [subtyp_trans] constructor,
    whose intermediate type is not itself inert.

    Everything except this type-to-binding-shape transport is proved:
    Canonical.v's [item_canonical] gives the heap item shape from the
    inert binding; [canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun] and
    [canonical_obj_field_of_label] then close the canonical forms once
    the transport is available.  The lemmas above ([tyq_has_label],
    [record_typ_has_label], [tyq_fun_source], [inert_typ_fun_or_obj])
    supply the non-transitive inversion steps. *)

End WithTypingMode.

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inertness of a context binding determines the shape of its type. *)

Lemma inert_typ_k_after : forall x vk T G G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2 -> inert G -> inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G G2 H.
  induction H as [a1 a2 a3 a4|b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 b8 b9 b10 IH]; intros Hi.
  - inversion Hi as [|c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9]; subst.
    exact c7.
  - inversion Hi as [|d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 d8 d9]; subst.
    eapply IH. exact d5.
Qed.

Lemma inert_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  inert G -> ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk Hi [T [G2 Hka]].
  exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka.
  - eapply inert_typ_k_after; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_inv : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S T2, T = typ_fun S T2)
  \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U /\ typ_indep_b 0 U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - right. exists T, S. split; [reflexivity|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typ_corr_inv : forall Tw Ty,
  typ_corr Tw Ty ->
  (exists S T, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\ Ty = typ_fun S T)
  \/
  (exists U S1 S2, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2).
Proof.
  intros Tw Ty H. dependent destruction H.
  - right. exists T, S, U. split; [reflexivity|reflexivity].
  - left. exists t1, t2. split; [assumption|]. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** Canonical shape of the heap item reached by a v_ref variable. *)

Lemma item_canonical : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y Tw Ty,

    assert (Bk : ctx_binds x Tk G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
    pose proof (inert_typ_k_after Hka Hinert) as Ity.

Qed.

(** ** From a record label to a field definition. *)

Lemma label_of_fld_inv : forall (d:def) a,
  label_of d = label_fld a -> exists v, d = def_fld a v.
Proof.
  intros d a H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma def_varkinds_fld_avar : forall G l (v:avar),
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G l v H. inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_fld : forall G (ds:defs) a (v:avar),
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_fld a v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G ds. induction ds as [|tl IH d0]; intros a v Hvk Hhas.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas. discriminate.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d0 = label_fld a)) as [E|N]; cbn in Hhas.
    + injection Hhas as Hd. subst d0.
      inversion Hvk; subst. eapply def_varkinds_fld_avar; eauto.
    + inversion Hvk; subst. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_fld_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->

  destruct (@defs_varkinds_has_fld G ds a v Hvk Hhas) as [x E]. subst v.
  exists x. exact Hhas.
Qed.

       binding-shape/label connection, which needs inert-source subtyping
       inversion; see the note at the end of the file). *)

Lemma canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun : forall G e Sigma x Tw,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma defs_has_cons_here : forall (ds:defs) (d:def),
  defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d.
Proof.
  intros ds d. unfold defs_has. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := label_of d = label_of d) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_cons_other : forall (ds:defs) (d d':def),
  label_of d <> label_of d' -> defs_has ds d' -> defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d'.
Proof.
  intros ds d d' Hne Hh. unfold defs_has in *. cbn.
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := label_of d = label_of d') Hne).
  assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_has_contra : forall (ds:defs) (d:def) l,
  defs_hasnt ds l -> defs_has ds d -> label_of d = l -> False.
Proof.
  intros ds d l Hn Hh He. unfold defs_hasnt, defs_has in *.
  rewrite He in Hh. rewrite Hh in Hn. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_label : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> label_of d = label_of D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_record_dec : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H.
  - (* def_typ *) apply rd_typ.
  - (* def_fld *) apply rd_fld.
  - (* def_met *) eapply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rcd_inv : forall (D:dec) ls,
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) ls -> ls = singleton (label_of D).
Proof.
  intros D ls H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_and_inv : forall (T:typ) (D:dec) ls,
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) ls ->
  exists ls' l, ls = ls' \u singleton l /\ record_typ T ls' /\
                l = label_of D /\ l \notin ls'.
Proof.
  intros T D ls H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  exists ls0, (label_of D). split; [reflexivity|]. split; [eassumption|]. split; [reflexivity|eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_record : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  (exists ls, record_typ T ls) /\
  (forall ls, record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls ->
     exists d, defs_has ds d /\ label_of d = l).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T H.
  change (ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T) in H.
  induction H.
  - (* one *) pose proof (ty_def_record_dec H) as Hdec.
    pose proof (ty_def_label H) as Hlab.
    split.
    + exists (singleton (label_of D)). eapply rt_one; eauto.
    + intros ls Hrec l Hl. rewrite (record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) in Hl.
      rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. exists d. split.
      * apply defs_has_cons_here.
      * exact Hlab.
  - (* cons *) pose proof (ty_def_record_dec H0) as Hdec.
    pose proof (ty_def_label H0) as Hlab.
    destruct IHty_defs as [Hex Hinvs].
    split.
    + destruct Hex as [ls' Hrec'].
      assert (Hnotin : label_of D \notin ls').
      { intro Hl. destruct (Hinvs ls' Hrec' (label_of D) Hl) as [d' [Hhas Heq]].
        eapply (@defs_hasnt_has_contra ds d' (label_of D));
          [ match goal with Hn : defs_hasnt ds (label_of d) |- _ =>
              rewrite <- Hlab; exact Hn end
          | exact Hhas | exact Heq ]. }
      exists (ls' \u singleton (label_of D)).
      eapply rt_cons; [exact Hrec'|exact Hdec|reflexivity|exact Hnotin].
    + intros ls Hrec l Hl.
      destruct (record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as [ls' [l' [Hls [Hrec' [Hl' Hnot]]]]].
      subst ls. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
      * destruct (Hinvs ls' Hrec' l Hl) as [d' [Hhas Heq]]. exists d'. split; auto.
        eapply defs_has_cons_other.
        -- intro E. apply Hnot. rewrite Hl'. rewrite <- Hlab. rewrite E. rewrite Heq. exact Hl.
        -- exact Hhas.
      * rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
        exists d. split.
        -- apply defs_has_cons_here.
        -- rewrite Hlab. symmetry. exact Hl'.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma record_typ_has : forall (T:typ) ls,
  record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls -> exists D, record_has T D /\ label_of D = l.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H as [D l0 Hdec Heq|T ls D l0 Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot].
  - intros l Hl. rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    exists D. split; [eapply rh_one|]. symmetry. exact Heq.
  - intros l Hl. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + destruct (IH l Hl) as [D' [Hhas Heq']]. exists D'.
      split; [eapply rh_andl; eauto| exact Heq'].
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. exists D.
      split; [eapply rh_andr; eapply rh_one| symmetry; exact Heq].
Qed.

Lemma label_of_open_dec : forall (D:dec) n x,
  label_of (open_rec n x D) = label_of D.
Proof. intros D n x. destruct D; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open : forall (D:dec) n x, record_dec D -> record_dec (open_rec n x D).
Proof.
  intros D n x H. destruct H.
  - cbn. apply rd_typ.
  - cbn. apply rd_typb.
  - cbn. apply rd_fld.
  - cbn. apply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open : forall (T:typ) ls n x,
  record_typ T ls -> record_typ (open_rec n x T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls n x H. induction H.
  - eapply rt_one; [apply record_dec_open; eauto | rewrite label_of_open_dec; assumption].
  - eapply rt_cons; [exact IHrecord_typ | apply record_dec_open; eauto | rewrite label_of_open_dec; assumption | assumption].
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ref_lookup : forall G e Sigma x,

Proof.

  exists y. split; [exact Hy|]. split.

  - apply Hitem. rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
Qed.

(** 3) Inversion of ty_item_s. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_inv : forall G e s x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e s x ->

     binds x (item_fun t) s /\

Proof.

Qed.
