Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Subst_extra Typing_weaken Context_lemmas.

(** * Variable substitution for typing: context infrastructure.

    The task's exact substitution statements keep the ambient context unchanged.
    That form is NOT provable in general: context binder types are syntax and may
    mention the dummy name [x0], so removing the dummy binding and substituting
    [x0] by [xr] must also substitute the *types stored in the context*.

    This file therefore develops the correct interface:
      - [subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)] is the ambient context after substitution;
      - under [x0 \notin ctx_fv (G1 §& G2)] it is equal to [G1 §& G2]
        ([subst_ctx_id]), recovering the unchanged-context form.
    A concrete obstruction (type selectors mentioning [x0]) is documented at the
    end of the file.  *)

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Substitution on contexts *)

Lemma ctx_dom_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr, ctx_dom (subst_ctx x0 xr G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr; cbn; auto;
    rewrite IHG; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_push_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x vk T x0 xr,
  subst_ctx x0 xr (G § x / vk ~ T) =
  subst_ctx x0 xr G § x / vk ~ subst_var x0 xr T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_subst_ctx : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall x0 xr,
  ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr G).
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros x0 xr; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. auto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_id : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr,
  x0 \notin ctx_fv G -> subst_ctx x0 xr G = G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr Hfv; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite notin_union in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hv HT].
    rewrite (IHG x0 xr HT).
    rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh t x0 xr Hv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_fv_subset : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall z, z \in fv T -> z \in ctx_fv G.
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros z Hz; cbn in *.
  - rewrite in_union. left. exact Hz.
  - rewrite in_union. right. auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

(** ** Binding removal when the looked-up name is not the dummy name *)

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_push : forall (H:ctx) x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (H § y / vk ~ S) -> x <> y ->
  forall x0 xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr H).
Proof.
  intros H x T y vk S Hc Hxy x0 xr.
  inversion Hc; subst.
  - exfalso. apply Hxy. reflexivity.
  - apply ctx_binds_subst_ctx. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_insert : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 x T,
  x <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  forall xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hfresh Hc xr.
  change (ctx_binds x T ((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2)) in Hc.
  revert G1 Hc Hfresh.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 Hc Hfresh; cbn in *.
  - (* empty *)
    eapply (@ctx_binds_remove_push G1 x T x0 vk0 S0); eauto.
  - (* push *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    + (* top binding belongs to G2 *)
      cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
    + (* binding is in the inner context *)
      cbn. eapply ctx_binds_n; [ assumption | ].
      apply IH; [ assumption | ].
      cbn in Hfresh. rewrite notin_union in Hfresh. exact (proj2 Hfresh).
  - (* stop: ctx_binds is uninhabited *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc.
  - (* hide *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide.
    apply IH; [ assumption | exact Hfresh ].
Qed.

(** ** Self-binding lookup: the dummy binding is the one found *)

Lemma ctx_binds_self_push : forall (H:ctx) x vk T S,
  ctx_binds x T (H § x / vk ~ S) -> x \notin ctx_dom H -> T = S.
Proof.
  intros H x vk T S Hc Hn.
  inversion Hc; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. match goal with Hn2 : ?a <> ?a |- _ => apply Hn2; reflexivity end.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_self_insert : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 T,
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x0 T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  T = S0.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 T Hfresh Hc.
  change (ctx_binds x0 T ((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2)) in Hc.
  revert G1 Hc Hfresh.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 Hc Hfresh; cbn in *.
  - eapply ctx_binds_self_push; [ exact Hc | ].
    cbn in Hfresh. exact Hfresh.
  - cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    + (* top key of G2 would equal x0, impossible *)
      exfalso. cbn in Hfresh. rewrite notin_union in Hfresh.
      destruct Hfresh as [Hn Hs]. apply Hn. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + apply (IH G1); [ assumption | ].
      cbn in Hfresh. rewrite notin_union in Hfresh. exact (proj2 Hfresh).
  - cbn in Hc. inversion Hc.
  - cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    apply (IH G1); [ assumption | exact Hfresh ].
Qed.


Lemma ctx_fv_concat : forall (G1 G2:ctx),
  ctx_fv (G1 §& G2) = ctx_fv G1 \u ctx_fv G2.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2. revert G1. induction G2; intros G1; cbn in *.
  - rewrite union_empty_r. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHG2. apply fset_extens; intros z Hz;
      repeat rewrite in_union in *; tauto.
  - rewrite IHG2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHG2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_fv_insert_subset : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S,
  ctx_fv (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) \c ctx_fv (G1 §& G2) \u fv S.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S z Hz.
  change (z \in ctx_fv ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2)) in Hz.
  rewrite ctx_fv_concat in Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
  - cbn in Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    + rewrite in_union. right. exact Hz.
    + rewrite in_union. left. rewrite ctx_fv_concat. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hz.
  - rewrite in_union. left. rewrite ctx_fv_concat. rewrite in_union. right. exact Hz.
Qed.

(** ** Recovering the unchanged-context binding lemma *)

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_insert_id : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 x T,
  x <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  x0 \notin ctx_fv (G1 §& G2) ->
  x0 \notin fv S0 ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hdom Hfv HS0 Hc.
  pose proof (@ctx_binds_remove_insert G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hdom Hc x0) as Hr.
  rewrite subst_ctx_id in Hr by exact Hfv.
  assert (HnotT : x0 \notin fv T).
  { intro Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_binds_fv_subset (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) x T Hc x0 Hin) as Hz.
    apply (@ctx_fv_insert_subset G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0) in Hz.
    rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    - apply Hfv. exact Hz.
    - apply HS0. exact Hz. }
  rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh T x0 x0 HnotT) in Hr. exact Hr.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

(**

   ============================================================================
   WHY THE EXACT TASK STATEMENTS ARE NOT PROVABLE, AND THE CORRECTED INTERFACE
   ============================================================================

   The task asks, for example:

     G = G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2
     x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)
     ty_var (G1 §& G2) e xr T0
     subtyp (G1 §& G2) e T0 (subst_var x0 xr S0)
     ------------------------------------------------------------
     ty_var (G1 §& G2) e (subst_var x0 xr x) (subst_var x0 xr T)

   This is FALSE.  Context binder types are first-class syntax and may mention
   the dummy name [x0] (e.g. a type member selector).  Since the conclusion keeps
   the context unchanged, the stored type [T] would have to be usable both as
   [T] and as [subst_var x0 xr T].  Concretely:

     G1 = ctx_push ctx_empty x1 v_loc (typ_sel (avar_f x0) L z)
     G2 = ctx_empty,  S0 = typ_top,  e = empty,  xr a fresh name,
     derivation: ty_var_var for x1 at T = typ_sel (avar_f x0) L z,
     external: ty_var (G1) e xr typ_top (add xr to G1), typ_top <: typ_top.

   The conclusion would be [ty_var G1 e x1 (typ_sel (avar_f xr) L z)], which is

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev.

Section W.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Context insertion infrastructure *)

Lemma ctx_concat_assoc : forall A B C : ctx,
  A §& (B §& C) = (A §& B) §& C.
Proof.
  intros A B C. revert A B. induction C; intros; cbn; auto; f_equal; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_concat : forall y (G1 G2 : ctx),
  y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2).
Proof.
  intros y G1 G2. revert G1. induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - assumption.
  - rewrite notin_union in H0. destruct H0 as [H0v H0c].
    rewrite notin_union. split.
    + assumption.
    + eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_concat_inv_l : forall y (G1 G2 : ctx),
  y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) -> y \notin ctx_dom G1.
Proof.
  intros y G1 G2. revert G1. induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - assumption.
  - rewrite notin_union in H. destruct H as [Hv Hc]. eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_concat_inv_r : forall y (G1 G2 : ctx),
  y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) -> y \notin ctx_dom G2.
Proof.
  intros y G1 G2. revert G1. induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - apply notin_empty.
  - rewrite notin_union in H. destruct H as [Hv Hc].
    rewrite notin_union. split.
    + assumption.
    + eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_push : forall y (G : ctx) x vk S,
  y \notin ctx_dom G -> y <> x -> y \notin ctx_dom (G § x / vk ~ S).
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite notin_union. split.
  - rewrite notin_singleton. auto.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_concat_push : forall (G : ctx) x vk S,
  G §& (x / vk ~ S) = G § x / vk ~ S.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_insert : forall x T (G1 G2 : ctx) y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (G1 §& G2) ->
  y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x T ((G1 § y / vk ~ S) §& G2).
Proof.
  intros x T G1 G2 y vk S Hc H1 H2.
  assert (Hxy : x <> y).
  { intro E. subst. apply (@notin_dom_concat y G1 G2 H1 H2). exact (@ctx_binds_in_dom (G1 §& G2) y T Hc). }
  revert G1 Hc H1.
  induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn. eapply ctx_binds_n; [ exact Hxy | exact Hc ].
  - (* push *) cbn in Hc.
    inversion Hc; subst.
    + cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
    + (* n *) cbn.
      rewrite notin_union in H2. destruct H2 as [H2v H2g].
      rewrite notin_singleton in H2v.
      eapply ctx_binds_n; [ exact H5 | exact (IHG2 H2g G1 H8 H1) ].
  - (* stop *) cbn in Hc. inversion Hc.
  - (* hide *) cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide. apply (IHG2 H2 G1 H4 H1).
Qed.

(** ** Insertion-based weakening for ty_var / subtyp / ty_incap *)

Lemma ctx_push_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x vk T,
  (G1 §& G2) § x / vk ~ T = G1 §& (G2 § x / vk ~ T).
Proof.
  intros. change ((G1 §& G2) §& (x / vk ~ T) = G1 §& (G2 §& (x / vk ~ T))).
  rewrite <- ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_met_empty : forall w x (TZ : typ) z (TC : typ),
  w <> x -> w <> z -> w \notin ctx_dom (ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC).
Proof.
  intros. cbn. repeat rewrite notin_union. repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
  split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x (TZ : typ) z (TC : typ),
  ctx_met (G1 §& G2) x TZ z TC =
  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC).
Proof.
  intros. change (G1 §& G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC =
                  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC)).
  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma var_sub_incap_weaken_insert :
  (forall G Go e x T (H:ty_var typing_mode G Go e x T),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       ty_var typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e x T)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:subtyp typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       subtyp typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:ty_incap typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       ty_incap typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U).
Proof.
  apply (@ts_mutind typing_mode
    (fun G Go e x T _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
         ty_var typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e x T)
    (fun G Go e T U _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
         subtyp typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U)
    (fun G Go e T U _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
         ty_incap typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U)).
  - (* ty_var_var *) intros G e x T c G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
    eapply ty_var_var.
    assert (Hc : ctx_binds x T (G1 §& G2)) by (rewrite <- Heq; exact c).
    exact (@ctx_binds_insert x T G1 G2 z vkz Sz Hc H1 H2).
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) intros G e x T o IHo t o0 IHo0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
    eapply ty_rec_intro.
    + exact (IHo G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact t.
    + intro Hm. exact (IHo0 Hm G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - (* ty_rec_elim *) intros G e x T o IHo t G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
    eapply ty_rec_elim.
    + exact (IHo G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact t.
  - (* ty_var_and *) intros G e x T U o IHo o0 IHo0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
    eapply ty_var_and.
    + exact (IHo G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHo0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - (* ty_var_sub *) intros G e x T U o IHo s IHs G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
    eapply ty_var_sub.
    + exact (IHo G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHs G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - (* ty_var_mut_top *) intros G e x T e0 o IHo G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
--- Context_lemmas
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Vars Context Objctx Envs Env Types ConfigNotations.

(** * Basic context facts *)

Lemma ctx_kdom_push_eq : forall vk G v T,
  ctx_kdom vk (ctx_push G v vk T) = singleton v \u ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := vk = vk) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_kdom_push_neq : forall vk vk' G v T,
  vk <> vk' ->
  ctx_kdom vk (ctx_push G v vk' T) = ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_r (P := vk = vk') H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_binds : forall x vk T G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G1 G2 -> ctx_binds x T G1.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G1 G2 H. induction H.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_kdom : forall x vk T G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G1 G2 -> x \in ctx_kdom vk G1.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v vk0 t G|v v2 vk1 vk2 t t2 G1' G2 Hne H IH].
  - rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - destruct (classicT (vk1 = vk2)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite <- E. rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq. rewrite in_union. right. exact IH.
    + erewrite ctx_kdom_push_neq; [exact IH|exact N].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ x \in ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros G x vk [T [G2 H]]. exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; eauto.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_kdom; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_kdom_in_dom : forall vk G x,
  x \in ctx_kdom vk G -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros vk G. induction G as [|G IH v vk2 T|G IH|G IH]; intros x Hx.
  - cbn in Hx. rewrite in_empty in Hx. inversion Hx.
  - destruct (classicT (vk = vk2)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite <- E in Hx. rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq in Hx. rewrite in_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
      * cbn. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hx.
      * cbn. rewrite in_union. right. apply IH; assumption.
    + rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_neq vk vk2 G v T N) in Hx.
      cbn. rewrite in_union. right. apply IH; assumption.
  - cbn in Hx. cbn. apply IH; assumption.
  - cbn in Hx. cbn. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_ok_binds_unique : forall G, ctx_ok G ->
  forall x T U, ctx_binds x T G -> ctx_binds x U G -> T = U.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|G IH v vk t|G IH|G IH]; intros Hok x T U Hb1 Hb2.
  - inversion Hb1.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v0 vk0 t0 Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    dependent destruction Hb1.
    + dependent destruction Hb2.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso. match goal with Hne : ?a <> ?a |- _ => exact (Hne eq_refl) end.
    + dependent destruction Hb2.
      * exfalso. match goal with Hne : ?a <> ?a |- _ => exact (Hne eq_refl) end.
      * eapply IH; eauto.
  - dependent destruction Hb1.
  - inversion Hok as [| |G0 Hok0|G0 Hok0]; subst.
    dependent destruction Hb1.
    dependent destruction Hb2.
    eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_weaken_push : forall G x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T G -> x <> y -> ctx_binds x T (ctx_push G y vk S).
Proof. intros. eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_in_dom : forall G x, ctx_vis G x -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G x H. induction H.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_push_inv : forall G v vk t,
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t) -> ctx_weakens G.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_stop_false : forall G, ctx_weakens (ctx_stop G) -> False.
Proof. intros. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_hide_false : forall G, ctx_weakens (ctx_hide G) -> False.
Proof. intros. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Environment facts (binds is get = Some) *)

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall A (E:env A) x v,
  binds x v E -> x \in dom E.
Proof. intros. eapply get_some_inv. apply binds_get. eassumption. Qed.

Lemma dom_exists : forall A (E:env A) x,
  x \in dom E -> exists v, binds x v E.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (@get_some A x E H) as [v Hv]. exists v. apply Hv.
Qed.

Lemma env_ok_binds_unique : forall A (E:env A) x v1 v2,
  ok E -> binds x v1 E -> binds x v2 E -> v1 = v2.
Proof. intros. eapply binds_functional; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_k_v_ref_in_env_dom : forall G (e:env var) x,
  ctx_kdom v_ref G = dom e -> ctx_k G x v_ref -> x \in dom e.
Proof.
  intros G e x Heq Hk.
  destruct (ctx_k_binds Hk) as [T [Hb Hd]].
  rewrite <- Heq. exact Hd.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_in_dom_push : forall G x vk T y,
  y \in ctx_dom (ctx_push G x vk T) -> y = x \/ y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_singleton in H. intuition. Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.

Lemma ctx_k_weaken_push : forall G x vk y vk' S,
  ctx_k G x vk -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> ctx_k (G § y / vk' ~ S) x vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk y vk' S [t [G2 H]] Hy.
  exists t, G2. eapply ctx_binds_k_n.
  - intro E. subst y. apply Hy. eapply ctx_kdom_in_dom.
    eapply ctx_binds_k_after_kdom. exact H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Lemma def_varkinds_weaken : forall G (d:def) y vk S,
  def_varkinds G d -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> def_varkinds (G § y / vk ~ S) d.
Proof.
  intros G d y vk S H Hy. inversion H; subst.
  - (* fld *) eapply def_varkinds_fld. eapply ctx_k_weaken_push; eauto.
  - (* typ *) apply def_varkinds_typ.
  - (* met *) eapply def_varkinds_met. eapply all_tfree_k_trm_weaken; eauto.
    intros z Hz. eapply ctx_k_weaken_push; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_weaken : forall G (ds:defs) y vk S,
  defs_varkinds G ds -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> defs_varkinds (G § y / vk ~ S) ds.
Proof.
  intros G ds y vk S H Hy. induction H.
  - apply defs_varkinds_nil.
  - eapply defs_varkinds_cons; [apply IHdefs_varkinds; exact Hy | eapply def_varkinds_weaken; eauto].
Qed.

Section InertLemmas.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ctx_k_binds_k_after : forall G x vk,
  ctx_k G x vk -> exists T G2, ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2.
Proof. intros G x vk [T [G2 H]]. exists T, G2. exact H. Qed.

Lemma inert_k_typ : forall G x vk T G2,
  inert G -> ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2 -> inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk T G2 Hinert.
  generalize dependent G2; generalize dependent T; generalize dependent vk; generalize dependent x.
  induction Hinert; intros xx vkk TTT GG2 Hafter.
  - inversion Hafter.
  - inversion Hafter; subst.
    + exact H0.
    + eapply IHHinert; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_binds_typ : forall G x T,
  inert G -> ctx_binds x T G -> exists vk, inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x T Hinert.
  generalize dependent T; generalize dependent x.
  induction Hinert; intros xx TT Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hb; subst; eauto.
Qed.

End InertLemmas.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref Equivalence Indep.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Head inversion for term typing *)

Lemma ty_trm_var_inv : forall G e x U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ U ->
  exists T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T /\ G⁏e ⊢ T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_var (avar_f x)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - eexists; split; [ match goal with Hx : G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ _ |- _ => exact Hx end
                    | apply subtyp_refl ].
  - destruct (IHty_trm x eq_refl eq_refl) as [t0 [Hx Hs]].
    exists t0. split; auto. eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_apply_inv : forall G e x z U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ U ->
  exists S T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun S T /\ G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ S /\
              G⁏e ⊢ open z T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x z U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun ?sx ?tx) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hz : (G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ ?sx) |- _ =>
        exists sx, tx; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hz|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x z eq_refl eq_refl) as [s0 [t0 [Hx [Hz Hs]]]].
    exists s0, t0. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hz|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_read_inv : forall G e x a U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_read (avar_f x) a ∶ U ->
  exists S T V, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) /\
                G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ T ⟶ V /\ G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x a U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_read (avar_f x) a) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a ?sx ?tx)) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hv : (G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ ?tx ⟶ ?vx) |- _ =>
        exists sx, tx, vx; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hv|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x a eq_refl eq_refl) as [s0 [t0 [v0 [Hx [Hv Hs]]]]].
    exists s0, t0, v0. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hv|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_write_inv : forall G e x a y U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ U ->
  exists S T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) /\
              G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ S /\ G⁏e ⊢ T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x a y U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a ?sx ?tx)) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hy : (G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ ?sx) |- _ =>
        exists sx, tx; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hy|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x a y eq_refl eq_refl) as [s0 [t0 [Hx [Hy Hs]]]].
    exists s0, t0. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_call_inv : forall G e x m y U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ∶ U ->
  exists TC TZ TR,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ TZ /\
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open y TC /\
    G⁏e ⊢ open_met y x TR <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x m y U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m ?tc ?tz ?tr)) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hy : (G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ ?tz) |- _ =>
        match goal with
        | Hsef : (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 ?tc) |- _ =>
          match goal with
          | Hxy : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open y ?tc) |- _ =>
            exists tc, tz, tr; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hy|];
            split; [exact Hsef|]; split; [exact Hxy|apply subtyp_refl]
          end
        end
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x m y eq_refl eq_refl) as
      [tc [tz [tr [Hx [Hy [Hsef [Hxy Hs]]]]]]].
    exists tc, tz, tr. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    split; [exact Hsef|]. split; [exact Hxy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_let_inv : forall G e t1 t2 U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_let t1 t2 ∶ U ->
  exists T L V,
    G⁏e ⊢ t1 ∶ T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t2 ∶ V) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e t1 t2 U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_let t1 t2) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | H1 : (G⁏e ⊢ t1 ∶ ?ty) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | H2 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_let ~ ?ty ⁏e ⊢ open x t2 ∶ ?vy) |- _ =>
        exists ty, ly, vy; split; [exact H1|]; split; [exact H2|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm t1 t2 eq_refl eq_refl) as [t0 [l0 [v0 [H1 [H2 Hs]]]]].
    exists t0, l0, v0. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H2|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_lit_inv : forall G e l t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_lit l t ∶ U ->
  exists T L V,
    G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ V) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e l t U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_lit l t) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | H1 : (G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ ?ty) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | H2 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_let ~ ?ty ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ ?vy) |- _ =>
        exists ty, ly, vy; split; [exact H1|]; split; [exact H2|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm l t eq_refl eq_refl) as [t0 [l0 [v0 [H1 [H2 Hs]]]]].
    exists t0, l0, v0. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H2|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Head inversion for literal typing (no subtyping constructor) *)

Lemma ty_lit_fun_inv : forall G e T t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ U ->
  exists L V,
    U = typ_fun T V /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x V).
Proof.
  intros G e T t U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_fun T t) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x ?vy) |- _ =>
    exists ly, vy; split; [reflexivity|exact H1]
  end.
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_obj_inv : forall G e T ds U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_obj T ds ∶ U ->
  exists L,
    U = typ_objlit typing_mode T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) /\
    typ_indep_b 0 T.
Proof.
  intros G e T ds U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_obj T ds) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) |- _ =>
    match goal with
    | H2 : typ_indep_b 0 T |- _ =>
      exists ly; split; [reflexivity|]; split; [exact H1|exact H2]
    end
  end.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

              G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ S /\ G⁏e ⊢ T <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x a y U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a ?sx ?tx)) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hy : (G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ ?sx) |- _ =>
        exists sx, tx; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hy|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x a y eq_refl eq_refl) as [s0 [t0 [Hx [Hy Hs]]]].
    exists s0, t0. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_call_inv : forall G e x m y U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ∶ U ->
  exists TC TZ TR,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ TZ /\
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open y TC /\
    G⁏e ⊢ open_met y x TR <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e x m y U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y)) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | Hx : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m ?tc ?tz ?tr)) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hy : (G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ ?tz) |- _ =>
        match goal with
        | Hsef : (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 ?tc) |- _ =>
          match goal with
          | Hxy : (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open y ?tc) |- _ =>
            exists tc, tz, tr; split; [exact Hx|]; split; [exact Hy|];
            split; [exact Hsef|]; split; [exact Hxy|apply subtyp_refl]
          end
        end
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm x m y eq_refl eq_refl) as
      [tc [tz [tr [Hx [Hy [Hsef [Hxy Hs]]]]]]].
    exists tc, tz, tr. split; [exact Hx|]. split; [exact Hy|].
    split; [exact Hsef|]. split; [exact Hxy|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_let_inv : forall G e t1 t2 U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_let t1 t2 ∶ U ->
  exists T L V,
    G⁏e ⊢ t1 ∶ T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t2 ∶ V) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e t1 t2 U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_let t1 t2) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | H1 : (G⁏e ⊢ t1 ∶ ?ty) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | H2 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_let ~ ?ty ⁏e ⊢ open x t2 ∶ ?vy) |- _ =>
        exists ty, ly, vy; split; [exact H1|]; split; [exact H2|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm t1 t2 eq_refl eq_refl) as [t0 [l0 [v0 [H1 [H2 Hs]]]]].
    exists t0, l0, v0. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H2|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_lit_inv : forall G e l t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ trm_lit l t ∶ U ->
  exists T L V,
    G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ V) /\
    G⁏e ⊢ V <: U.
Proof.
  intros G e l t U H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_lit l t) U) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  - match goal with
    | H1 : (G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ ?ty) |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | H2 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_let ~ ?ty ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ ?vy) |- _ =>
        exists ty, ly, vy; split; [exact H1|]; split; [exact H2|apply subtyp_refl]
      end
    end.
  - destruct (IHty_trm l t eq_refl eq_refl) as [t0 [l0 [v0 [H1 [H2 Hs]]]]].
    exists t0, l0, v0. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H2|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Head inversion for literal typing (no subtyping constructor) *)

Lemma ty_lit_fun_inv : forall G e T t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ U ->
  exists L V,
    U = typ_fun T V /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x V).
Proof.
  intros G e T t U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_fun T t) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x ?vy) |- _ =>
    exists ly, vy; split; [reflexivity|exact H1]
  end.
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_obj_inv : forall G e T ds U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_obj T ds ∶ U ->
  exists L,
    U = typ_objlit typing_mode T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) /\
    typ_indep_b 0 T.
Proof.
  intros G e T ds U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_obj T ds) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) |- _ =>
    match goal with
    | H2 : typ_indep_b 0 T |- _ =>
      exists ly; split; [reflexivity|]; split; [exact H1|exact H2]
    end
  end.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

The corrected statement must also substitute the types stored in the
   context, i.e. conclude under

       subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2).

   The [subst_ctx] development above (lookup removal in a substituted context,
   self-binding identification, freshness identity [subst_ctx_id], fv facts) is
   the infrastructure for that corrected lemma.

   A provable interface for the self-binding case (where the looked-up variable
   is exactly [x0]) additionally needs the substituted variable to be typed at
   the substituted binding type:

       Hxr  : ty_var (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)) e xr (subst_var x0 xr S0)
       Hvis : mode_has_visibility typing_mode ->
                ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)) xr          (for terms)

   and for every fresh-binder rule ([forall y, y\notin L -> ...]) the induction
   hypothesis is applied at the split [(G1, G2 § y)] under the substituted
   context; [Hxr]/[Hvis] must be weakened there with
   [var_sub_incap_weaken] / [ty_weaken_insert_mut] / [ctx_vis_insert].  This
   further requires [y] not to shadow [xr] (i.e. [y] fresh for the base context
   and [xr]); in a derivation the rule's [L] must be enlarged to exclude [xr]
   and all names of the substituted context, which is available from the
   configuration invariants (all fresh binders are chosen outside the config's
   free names).

   The actual typing-substitution induction (46 cases for ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap
   and 15 cases for ty_trm/lit/def/defs, plus ty_capbnd/viewpoint) is therefore
   the remaining work; it is NOT completed here.
*)

(**

   ============================================================================
   SECOND OBSTRUCTION: the [subtyp_typ] case cannot be discharged by name-blind
   substitution.
   ============================================================================

   The rule is (GeneralTyping.v):

     subtyp_typ : (forall x, G ⊢ open x S2 <: open x S1) ->
                  (forall x, G ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
                  G ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

   with an unrestricted [forall x] over names (no freshness set [L]).

   After substituting [x0] by [xr] in the conclusion, the required premise is

     forall x, G'' ⊢ open x (subst S2) <: open x (subst S1).

   For a given [x], the induction hypothesis on the original premise at a name
   [x'] yields

     G'' ⊢ subst (open x' S2) <: subst (open x' S1)
     =  G'' ⊢ open (subst x') (subst S2) <: open (subst x') (subst S1).

   For [x <> x0] we take [x' = x] (so [subst x' = x]).  For [x = x0], however,
   [subst x0 = xr], and the hypothesis gives the statement at [xr], not at [x0].
   There is no subtyping rule that changes the name inserted by [open] (the two
   types differ exactly at the opened bound positions), and the original
   derivation's premise at [x0] was proved under the *unsubstituted* context
   [G], where [x0] was bound; in [G''] the name [x0] is not bound.  Thus this
   case does not close.

   Two possible repairs:

   (H1) Add the global freshness hypothesis that [x0] does not occur free in any
        type occurring in the derivation (in particular in the bounds
        [S1,S2,T1,T2] of every [subtyp_typ] occurrence).  Then [subst] is the
        identity on those types and the original premise at [x0] is exactly the
        required new premise at [x0].

   (H2) Prove a name-renaming lemma for subtyping of opened types: for [T] with
        [x0 \notin fv T] and [x0 \notin ctx_dom G''], derive
        [G'' ⊢ open x0 T <: open x0 U] from [G'' ⊢ open xr T <: open xr U]
        (or from the corresponding closed/parametric form).  Such a lemma is a
        non-trivial substitution/alpha-renaming property of the type system and
        is not available in the current helper files.

   The induction was therefore NOT completed for [subtyp_typ] (and hence for the
   mutual ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap block).  The context infrastructure above is
   complete and usable; the [ty_trm]/[ty_lit]/[ty_def]/[ty_defs] substitution
   has the same [subtyp_typ] dependency through [ty_trm_sub] rule premises.
*)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Section FinalDichotomy.

(** If every configuration reachable from [C] is either an answer or can
    take a step, then either some answer is reachable, or configurations are
    reachable at every depth.  This is the purely operational final step of
    soundness; the typing argument only has to supply the hypothesis. *)

Lemma red_dichotomy : forall (C:config),
  (forall (c:config) (n:nat), C ⊣n↦* c ->
     answer c \/ (exists c', c ↦ c')) ->
  (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ C ⊣n↦* Ca) \/
  (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C ⊣n↦* Cn).
Proof.
  intros C Hprog.
  destruct (classic (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config),
              answer Ca /\ C ⊣n↦* Ca)) as [Hterm|Hnonterm].
  - left. exact Hterm.
  - right. intro n. induction n as [|n IH].
    + exists C. apply red_refl.
    + destruct IH as [Cn Hn].
      destruct (Hprog Cn n Hn) as [HA|HS].
      * exfalso. apply Hnonterm. exists n, Cn. split; assumption.
      * destruct HS as [Cn' Hstep].
        exists Cn'. eapply red_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

End FinalDichotomy.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Dichotomy.

Section SoundnessGeneric.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** [red_dichotomy] plus preservation of typability along reduction. *)

Lemma soundness_via_typing : forall (C0:config) (T:typ),
  config_typd C0 T ->
  (forall (c:config), config_typd c T ->
     answer c \/ (exists c', c ↦ c')) ->
  (forall (c c':config), config_typd c T -> c ↦ c' -> config_typd c' T) ->
  (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca) \/
  (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C0 ⊣n↦* Cn).
Proof.
  intros C0 T Hinit Hprog Hpres.
  eapply red_dichotomy.
  intros c n Hreach.
  assert (Htyp : config_typd c T).
  { induction Hreach as [c0|C1 C2 C3 n Hr IH Hstep].
    - exact Hinit.
    - eapply Hpres; eassumption. }
  eapply Hprog. exact Htyp.
Qed.

End SoundnessGeneric.

Lemma ty_kind_mut :
  (forall G Go e (t:trm) T, ty_trm typing_mode G Go e t T ->
     forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_trm typing_mode G' Go e t T)
  /\ (forall G Go e (l:lit) T, ty_lit typing_mode G Go e l T ->
     forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_lit typing_mode G' Go e l T)
  /\ (forall G Go e (d:def) D, ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D ->
     forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_def typing_mode G' Go e d D)
  /\ (forall G Go e (ds:defs) T, ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->

  apply (@rules_mutind typing_mode
    (fun G Go e t T _ => forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_trm typing_mode G' Go e t T)
    (fun G Go e l T _ => forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_lit typing_mode G' Go e l T)
    (fun G Go e d D _ => forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_def typing_mode G' Go e d D)

    + exact (IHo G' Hke).
    + exact (@Hsub G objctx_empty e T U s G' Hke).
  - (* lit fun *) intros L G e T t U ef o IHo G' Hke.
    eapply ty_lit_fun with (L := L).
    + exact ef.
    + intro x. intro Hx.
      exact (IHo x Hx (G' § x / v_par ~ T) (@cke_push G G' x v_par v_par T Hke)).
  - (* lit obj *) intros L G e T ds o IHo ti G' Hke.
    eapply ty_lit_obj with (L := L).
    + intro x. intro Hx. exact (IHo x Hx G' Hke).
    + exact ti.
  - (* def typ *) intros L G Go e A T U o G' Hke.
    eapply ty_def_typ with (L := L). exact o.
  - (* def fld *) intros G Go e a t T cv o G' Hke.
    eapply ty_def_fld.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke (G §§& Go) (G' §§& Go) (@cke_obj G G' Hke Go)).
      apply cv. exact Hv.
    + exact (@Hvar (G §§& Go) objctx_empty e t T o (G' §§& Go) (@cke_obj G G' Hke Go)).
  - (* def met *) intros L G Go e m t TC TZ TR o IHo G' Hke.
    eapply ty_def_met with (L := L).
    intros xz Hxz xc Hxcxz Hxc.
    exact (IHo xz Hxz xc Hxcxz Hxc
             (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G' Go xz TZ xc TC)
             (@ctx_obj_met_ke typing_mode G G' Hke Go xz TZ xc TC)).
  - (* defs one *) intros G Go e d D o IHo G' Hke.
    eapply ty_defs_one. exact (IHo G' Hke).
  - (* defs cons *) intros G Go e ds d T D o IHo o0 IHo0 h G' Hke.
    eapply ty_defs_cons.
    + exact (IHo G' Hke).
    + exact (IHo0 G' Hke).
    + exact h.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_kind_change_top : forall G Go e (t:trm) T x vk1 vk2 S,
  ty_trm typing_mode (G § x / vk1 ~ S) Go e t T ->
  ty_trm typing_mode (G § x / vk2 ~ S) Go e t T.
Proof.
  intros. destruct ty_kind_mut as [HT _].
  exact (HT (G § x / vk1 ~ S) Go e t T H (G § x / vk2 ~ S)
           (@cke_push G G x vk1 vk2 S (cke_refl G))).
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_kind_insert : forall G1 G2 x vk1 vk2 Tb Go e (t:trm) T,
---
Lemma ty_weaken_insert_mut :
  (forall G Go e (t:trm) T, ty_trm typing_mode G Go e t T ->
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e t T)
  /\ (forall G Go e (l:lit) T, ty_lit typing_mode G Go e l T ->
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
       ty_lit typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e l T)
  /\ (forall G Go e (d:def) D, ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D ->
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
       ty_def typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e d D)
  /\ (forall G Go e (ds:defs) T, ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
       ty_defs typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e ds T).
Proof.
  destruct (@var_sub_incap_weaken_insert typing_mode) as [Hvar [Hsub Hincap]].
  apply (@rules_mutind typing_mode
    (fun G Go e t T _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
         ty_trm typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e t T)
    (fun G Go e l T _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
         ty_lit typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e l T)
    (fun G Go e d D _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
         ty_def typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e d D)
    (fun G Go e ds T _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
         ty_defs typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e ds T)).
  - (* trm var *) intros G e x T cv o G1 G2 Heq y vk S Hn. subst G.
    change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    assert (Hn1 : y \notin ctx_dom G1) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_l y G1 G2 Hn)).
    assert (Hn2 : y \notin ctx_dom G2) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_r y G1 G2 Hn)).
    eapply ty_trm_var.
    + intro Hv. exact (@ctx_vis_insert (G1 §& G2) x (cv Hv) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk S Hn).
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e x T o G1 G2 eq_refl y vk S Hn1 Hn2).
  - (* trm apply *) intros G e x z Sfun Tres ef cvx cvz ox oz G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    assert (Hn1 : y \notin ctx_dom G1) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_l y G1 G2 Hn)).
    assert (Hn2 : y \notin ctx_dom G2) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_r y G1 G2 Hn)).
    eapply ty_trm_apply.
    + exact ef.
    + intro Hv. exact (@ctx_vis_insert (G1 §& G2) x (cvx Hv) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + intro Hv. exact (@ctx_vis_insert (G1 §& G2) z (cvz Hv) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e x (typ_fun Sfun Tres) ox G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e z Sfun oz G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
  - (* trm read *) intros G e x a Sfld Tfld U cv ox vp G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    assert (Hn1 : y \notin ctx_dom G1) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_l y G1 G2 Hn)).
    assert (Hn2 : y \notin ctx_dom G2) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_r y G1 G2 Hn)).
    eapply ty_trm_read.
    + intro Hv. exact (@ctx_vis_insert (G1 §& G2) x (cv Hv) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sfld Tfld)) ox G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
    + exact (@viewpoint_adapt_weaken_insert x (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e Tfld U vp G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
  - (* trm write *) intros G e x yv a Sfld Tfld cvx cvy mut ox oy G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    assert (Hn1 : y \notin ctx_dom G1) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_l y G1 G2 Hn)).
    assert (Hn2 : y \notin ctx_dom G2) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_r y G1 G2 Hn)).
    eapply ty_trm_write.
    + intro Hv. exact (@ctx_vis_insert (G1 §& G2) x (cvx Hv) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + intro Hv. exact (@ctx_vis_insert (G1 §& G2) yv (cvy Hv) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + intro Hm. exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e x (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) (mut Hm) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sfld Tfld)) ox G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e yv Sfld oy G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
  - (* trm call *) intros G e x yv m TC TZ TR cvx cvy ox oy sef o1 G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    assert (Hn1 : y \notin ctx_dom G1) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_l y G1 G2 Hn)).
    assert (Hn2 : y \notin ctx_dom G2) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_r y G1 G2 Hn)).
    eapply ty_trm_call.
    + intro Hv. exact (@ctx_vis_insert (G1 §& G2) x (cvx Hv) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + intro Hv. exact (@ctx_vis_insert (G1 §& G2) yv (cvy Hv) G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ox G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e yv TZ oy G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
    + exact sef.
    + exact (@Hvar (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e x (open yv TC) o1 G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
  - (* trm let *) intros L G e t u T U o IHo o0 IHo0 G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    eapply ty_trm_let with (L := L \u \{y}).
    + exact (IHo G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + intro x. intro HxL'. rewrite notin_union in HxL'. destruct HxL' as [Hx Hxy].
      rewrite notin_singleton in Hxy. rewrite ctx_mid_push.
      refine (IHo0 x Hx G1 (G2 § x / v_let ~ T) _ y vk Sz _).
      * exact (@ctx_push_decomp G1 G2 x v_let T).
      * apply notin_dom_push; [exact Hn | intro E; exact (Hxy (eq_sym E))].
  - (* trm lit *) intros L G e l u T U o IHo o0 IHo0 G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    eapply ty_trm_lit with (L := L \u \{y}).
    + exact (IHo G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + intro x. intro HxL'. rewrite notin_union in HxL'. destruct HxL' as [Hx Hxy].
      rewrite notin_singleton in Hxy. rewrite ctx_mid_push.
      refine (IHo0 x Hx G1 (G2 § x / v_let ~ T) _ y vk Sz _).
      * exact (@ctx_push_decomp G1 G2 x v_let T).
      * apply notin_dom_push; [exact Hn | intro E; exact (Hxy (eq_sym E))].
  - (* trm sub *) intros G e t T U o IHo s G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    assert (Hn1 : y \notin ctx_dom G1) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_l y G1 G2 Hn)).
    assert (Hn2 : y \notin ctx_dom G2) by (apply (@notin_dom_concat_inv_r y G1 G2 Hn)).
    eapply ty_trm_sub.
    + exact (IHo G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn).
    + exact (@Hsub (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e T U s G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz Hn1 Hn2).
  - (* lit fun *) intros L G e T t U ef o IHo G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    eapply ty_lit_fun with (L := L \u \{y}).
    + exact ef.
    + intro x. intro HxL'. rewrite notin_union in HxL'. destruct HxL' as [Hx Hxy].
      rewrite notin_singleton in Hxy. rewrite ctx_mid_push.
      refine (IHo x Hx G1 (G2 § x / v_par ~ T) _ y vk Sz _).
      * exact (@ctx_push_decomp G1 G2 x v_par T).
      * apply notin_dom_push; [exact Hn | intro E; exact (Hxy (eq_sym E))].
  - (* lit obj *) intros L G e T ds o IHo ti G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn.
    subst G. change (y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)) in Hn.
    eapply ty_lit_obj with (L := L \u \{y}).
    + intro x. intro HxL'. rewrite notin_union in HxL'. destruct HxL' as [Hx Hxy].
      rewrite notin_singleton in Hxy.
      refine (IHo x Hx G1 G2 eq_refl y vk Sz _).
      apply notin_dom_push; [exact Hn | intro E; exact (Hxy (eq_sym E))].
    + exact ti.
  - (* def typ *) intros L G Go e A T U o G1 G2 Heq y vk Sz Hn. subst G.

Set Implicit Arguments.

(** ** Context insertion infrastructure *)

Lemma ctx_concat_assoc : forall A B C : ctx,
  A §& (B §& C) = (A §& B) §& C.
Proof.
  intros A B C. revert A B. induction C; intros; cbn; auto; f_equal; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_concat : forall y (G1 G2 : ctx),
  y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2).
Proof.
  intros y G1 G2. revert G1. induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - assumption.
  - rewrite notin_union in H0. destruct H0 as [H0v H0c].
    rewrite notin_union. split.
    + assumption.
    + eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_concat_inv_l : forall y (G1 G2 : ctx),
  y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) -> y \notin ctx_dom G1.
Proof.
  intros y G1 G2. revert G1. induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - assumption.
  - rewrite notin_union in H. destruct H as [Hv Hc]. eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_concat_inv_r : forall y (G1 G2 : ctx),
  y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) -> y \notin ctx_dom G2.
Proof.
  intros y G1 G2. revert G1. induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - apply notin_empty.
  - rewrite notin_union in H. destruct H as [Hv Hc].
    rewrite notin_union. split.
    + assumption.
    + eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
  - eapply IHG2; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_push : forall y (G : ctx) x vk S,
  y \notin ctx_dom G -> y <> x -> y \notin ctx_dom (G § x / vk ~ S).
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite notin_union. split.
  - rewrite notin_singleton. auto.
  - assumption.

Lemma ctx_concat_push : forall (G : ctx) x vk S,
  G §& (x / vk ~ S) = G § x / vk ~ S.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_insert : forall x T (G1 G2 : ctx) y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (G1 §& G2) ->
  y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x T ((G1 § y / vk ~ S) §& G2).
Proof.
  intros x T G1 G2 y vk S Hc H1 H2.
  assert (Hxy : x <> y).
  { intro E. subst. apply (@notin_dom_concat y G1 G2 H1 H2). exact (@ctx_binds_in_dom (G1 §& G2) y T Hc). }
  revert G1 Hc H1.
  induction G2; intros; cbn in *.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn. eapply ctx_binds_n; [ exact Hxy | exact Hc ].
  - (* push *) cbn in Hc.
    inversion Hc; subst.
    + cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
    + (* n *) cbn.
      rewrite notin_union in H2. destruct H2 as [H2v H2g].
      rewrite notin_singleton in H2v.
      eapply ctx_binds_n; [ exact H5 | exact (IHG2 H2g G1 H8 H1) ].
  - (* stop *) cbn in Hc. inversion Hc.
  - (* hide *) cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide. apply (IHG2 H2 G1 H4 H1).
Qed.

(** ** Insertion-based weakening for ty_var / subtyp / ty_incap *)

Lemma ctx_push_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x vk T,
  (G1 §& G2) § x / vk ~ T = G1 §& (G2 § x / vk ~ T).
Proof.
  intros. change ((G1 §& G2) §& (x / vk ~ T) = G1 §& (G2 §& (x / vk ~ T))).
  rewrite <- ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_met_empty : forall w x (TZ : typ) z (TC : typ),
  w <> x -> w <> z -> w \notin ctx_dom (ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC).
Proof.
  intros. cbn. repeat rewrite notin_union. repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
  split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x (TZ : typ) z (TC : typ),
  ctx_met (G1 §& G2) x TZ z TC =
  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC).
Proof.
  intros. change (G1 §& G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC =
                  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC)).
  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma var_sub_incap_weaken_insert :
  (forall G Go e x T (H:ty_var typing_mode G Go e x T),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       ty_var typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e x T)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:subtyp typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       subtyp typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:ty_incap typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       ty_incap typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U).
Proof.
  apply (@ts_mutind typing_mode
    (fun G Go e x T _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
         ty_var typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e x T)
    (fun G Go e T U _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
         subtyp typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U)
    (fun G Go e T U _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
         ty_incap typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U)).
  - (* ty_var_var *) intros G e x T c G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
    eapply ty_var_var.
    assert (Hc : ctx_binds x T (G1 §& G2)) by (rewrite <- Heq; exact c).
    exact (@ctx_binds_insert x T G1 G2 z vkz Sz Hc H1 H2).
  - (* ty_rec_intro *) intros G e x T o IHo t o0 IHo0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.

Class Unhiding (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  unhiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):
    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b ->
    property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b.

Class Hiding (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  hiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):
    property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b ->
    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Section UnhidingLemmata.

Context {A B: Set}{P: TypingProperty A B}{AW: Unhiding P}.

End UnhidingLemmata.

Section HidingLemmata.

Context {A B: Set}{P: TypingProperty A B}{AW: Hiding P}.

End HidingLemmata.

Definition UnhidingInd (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  forall G Go e (a: A) (b: B),
    property G Go e a b ->
    forall G1 G2,
      G = (ctx_hide G1) §& G2 ->
      property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b.

Definition UnhidingTInd (A: Set) (t: Typing A) := UnhidingInd obj_typing.

Definition UnhidingDInd (A: Set) (t: DecTyping A) := UnhidingInd obj_dec_typing.

  UnhidingInd obj_ref_incap.

  forall G Go e (a: A) (b: B),
    property G Go e a b ->
    forall G1 G2,

      property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Dichotomy.

Section SoundnessGeneric.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** [red_dichotomy] plus preservation of typability along reduction. *)

Lemma soundness_via_typing : forall (C0:config) (T:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode C0 T ->
  (forall (c:config), config_typd typing_mode c T ->
     answer c \/ (exists c', c ↦ c')) ->
  (forall (c c':config), config_typd typing_mode c T -> c ↦ c' -> config_typd typing_mode c' T) ->
  (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca) \/
  (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C0 ⊣n↦* Cn).
Proof.
  intros C0 T Hinit Hprog Hpres.
  eapply red_dichotomy.
  intros c n Hreach.
  assert (Htyp : config_typd typing_mode c T).
  { induction Hreach as [c0|C1 C2 C3 n Hr IH Hstep].
    - exact Hinit.
    - eapply Hpres; eassumption. }
  eapply Hprog. exact Htyp.
Qed.

End SoundnessGeneric.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Dichotomy.

Section SoundnessGeneric.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** [red_dichotomy] plus preservation of typability along reduction. *)

Lemma soundness_via_typing : forall (C0:config) (T:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode C0 T ->
  (forall (c:config), config_typd typing_mode c T ->
     answer c \/ (exists c', c ↦ c')) ->
  (forall (c c':config), config_typd typing_mode c T -> c ↦ c' -> config_typd typing_mode c' T) ->
  (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca) \/
  (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C0 ⊣n↦* Cn).
Proof.
  intros C0 T Hinit Hprog Hpres.
  eapply red_dichotomy.
  intros c n Hreach.
  assert (Haux : forall (n:nat) (c:config), C0 ⊣n↦* c ->
                  config_typd typing_mode c T).
  { intros n. induction n as [|n IH]; intros c Hr.
    - inversion Hr; subst. exact Hinit.
    - inversion Hr as [C1 C2 C3 m H1 H2]; subst.
      eapply Hpres.
      + apply IH. exact H1.
      + exact H2. }
  eapply Hprog. eapply Haux. exact Hreach.
Qed.

End SoundnessGeneric.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import LibExtra.

Generalizable Variables A B.

Declare Scope syntax_scope.

Delimit Scope syntax_scope with S.

Open Scope syntax_scope.

Class Openable (A : Set) := open_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Class FreeVar (A : Set) := fv : A -> vars.

Class SubstVar (A : Set) := subst_var : var -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Openable FreeVar SubstVar.

Arguments open_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Arguments fv _ _ !_ /.

Arguments subst_var _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class AbstractSyntax (A : Set) `(Openable A) `(FreeVar A) `(SubstVar A).

Notation "z '/[' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_var x y z) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_vars := (vars_zip_map subst_var) (only parsing).

Notation "z '/[' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_vars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_pvars `{AS: SubstVar A} `{AF: FreeVar A}
  (xs ys: list var) (a: A): A :=
    let (zs, _) := (var_freshes (from_list xs \u from_list ys \u fv a) (length ys))
    in a /[xs --> zs] /[zs --> ys].

Notation "z '//[' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_pvars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation open := (open_rec 0) (only parsing).

Definition open_depth_rec `{AS : Openable A} n x a d :=
  open_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation open_depth := (open_depth_rec 0).

Arguments open_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Definition closed `{AS: Openable A} a :=
  forall n x, open_rec n x a = a.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Syntax_extra Subst_extra.

(** * Basic avar seal equations *)

Lemma avar_seal_f : forall n x (y:var), seal_rec n x (avar_f y) = avar_f y.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_seal_b_le : forall n x i, n <= i -> seal_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros. change ((If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i) = avar_f x).
  rewrite (classicT_l H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma avar_seal_b_gt : forall n x i, ~ n <= i -> seal_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof.
  intros. change ((If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i) = avar_b i).
  rewrite (classicT_r H). reflexivity.
Qed.

(** * SealClosed: locally-closed terms are unchanged by sealing *)

Lemma avar_seal_closed : forall n x (a:avar),
  closed_below n a -> seal_rec n x a = a.
Proof.
  intros n x a H. destruct a as [i|y].
  - destruct (classicT (n <= i)) as [E|N].
    + exfalso. specialize (H i x E).
      rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i i x eq_refl) in H. discriminate.
    + apply avar_seal_b_gt; exact N.
  - apply avar_seal_f.
Qed.

(** Projection helpers for closed_below on compounds *)

Lemma closed_below_typ_rcd : forall n (D:dec),
  closed_below n (typ_rcd D) -> closed_below n D.
Proof.
  intros n D H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_rcd (open_rec m x D) = typ_rcd D) in H.
  injection H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma closed_below_typ_and_l : forall n (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (typ_and T1 T2) -> closed_below n T1.
Proof.
  intros n T1 T2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_and (open_rec m x T1) (open_rec m x T2) = typ_and T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_typ_and_r : forall n (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (typ_and T1 T2) -> closed_below n T2.
Proof.
  intros n T1 T2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_and (open_rec m x T1) (open_rec m x T2) = typ_and T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H2.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_typ_or_l : forall n (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (typ_or T1 T2) -> closed_below n T1.
Proof.
  intros n T1 T2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_or (open_rec m x T1) (open_rec m x T2) = typ_or T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_typ_or_r : forall n (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (typ_or T1 T2) -> closed_below n T2.
Proof.
  intros n T1 T2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_or (open_rec m x T1) (open_rec m x T2) = typ_or T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma closed_below_typ_sel_l : forall n (a1:avar) l (a2:avar),
  closed_below n (typ_sel a1 l a2) -> closed_below n a1.
Proof.
  intros n a1 l a2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_sel (open_rec m x a1) l (open_rec m x a2) = typ_sel a1 l a2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_typ_sel_r : forall n (a1:avar) l (a2:avar),
  closed_below n (typ_sel a1 l a2) -> closed_below n a2.
Proof.
  intros n a1 l a2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_sel (open_rec m x a1) l (open_rec m x a2) = typ_sel a1 l a2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H2.
Qed.

Lemma closed_below_typ_bnd : forall n (T:typ),
  closed_below n (typ_bnd T) -> closed_below (S n) T.
Proof.
  intros n T H m x Hle. destruct m as [|m'].
  - lia.
  - specialize (H m' x). assert (Hle' : n <= m') by lia. specialize (H Hle').
    change (typ_bnd (open_rec (S m') x T) = typ_bnd T) in H.
    injection H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma closed_below_typ_fun_l : forall n (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (typ_fun T1 T2) -> closed_below n T1.
Proof.
  intros n T1 T2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (typ_fun (open_rec m x T1) (open_rec (S m) x T2) = typ_fun T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_typ_fun_r : forall n (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (typ_fun T1 T2) -> closed_below (S n) T2.
Proof.
  intros n T1 T2 H m x Hle. destruct m as [|m'].
  - lia.
  - specialize (H m' x). assert (Hle' : n <= m') by lia. specialize (H Hle').
    change (typ_fun (open_rec m' x T1) (open_rec (S m') x T2) = typ_fun T1 T2) in H.
    injection H as H1 H2. exact H2.
Qed.

(** dec projections *)

---

Lemma closed_below_dec_typ_l : forall n l (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (dec_typ l T1 T2) -> closed_below (S n) T1.
Proof.
  intros n l T1 T2 H m x Hle. destruct m as [|m']; [lia|].
  specialize (H m' x). assert (Hle' : n <= m') by lia. specialize (H Hle').
  change (dec_typ l (open_rec (S m') x T1) (open_rec (S m') x T2) = dec_typ l T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_dec_typ_r : forall n l (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (dec_typ l T1 T2) -> closed_below (S n) T2.
Proof.
  intros n l T1 T2 H m x Hle. destruct m as [|m']; [lia|].
  specialize (H m' x). assert (Hle' : n <= m') by lia. specialize (H Hle').
  change (dec_typ l (open_rec (S m') x T1) (open_rec (S m') x T2) = dec_typ l T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H2.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_dec_fld_l : forall n l (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (dec_fld l T1 T2) -> closed_below n T1.
Proof.
  intros n l T1 T2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (dec_fld l (open_rec m x T1) (open_rec m x T2) = dec_fld l T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_dec_fld_r : forall n l (T1 T2:typ),
  closed_below n (dec_fld l T1 T2) -> closed_below n T2.
Proof.
  intros n l T1 T2 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (dec_fld l (open_rec m x T1) (open_rec m x T2) = dec_fld l T1 T2) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H2.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_dec_met_c : forall n l (T1 T2 T3:typ),
  closed_below n (dec_met l T1 T2 T3) -> closed_below (S n) T1.
Proof.
  intros n l T1 T2 T3 H m x Hle. destruct m as [|m']; [lia|].
  specialize (H m' x). assert (Hle' : n <= m') by lia. specialize (H Hle').
  change (dec_met l (open_rec (S m') x T1) (open_rec m' x T2) (open_rec (S (S m')) x T3) = dec_met l T1 T2 T3) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2 H3. exact H1.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_dec_met_z : forall n l (T1 T2 T3:typ),
  closed_below n (dec_met l T1 T2 T3) -> closed_below n T2.
Proof.
  intros n l T1 T2 T3 H m x Hle. specialize (H m x Hle).
  change (dec_met l (open_rec (S m) x T1) (open_rec m x T2) (open_rec (S (S m)) x T3) = dec_met l T1 T2 T3) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2 H3. exact H2.
Qed.
Lemma closed_below_dec_met_r : forall n l (T1 T2 T3:typ),
  closed_below n (dec_met l T1 T2 T3) -> closed_below (S (S n)) T3.
Proof.
  intros n l T1 T2 T3 H m x Hle. destruct m as [|[|m']]; try lia.
  specialize (H m' x). assert (Hle' : n <= m') by lia. specialize (H Hle').
  change (dec_met l (open_rec (S m') x T1) (open_rec m' x T2) (open_rec (S (S m')) x T3) = dec_met l T1 T2 T3) in H.
  injection H as H1 H2 H3. exact H3.
Qed.

(** Seal equations for type/dec constructors *)

Lemma seal_typ_top : forall n y, seal_rec n y (typ_top) = typ_top.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_typ_bot : forall n y, seal_rec n y (typ_bot) = typ_bot.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_typ_nocap : forall n y, seal_rec n y (typ_nocap) = typ_nocap.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_typ_rcd : forall n y (D:dec), seal_rec n y (typ_rcd D) = typ_rcd (seal_rec n y D).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_typ_and : forall n y (T1 T2:typ), seal_rec n y (typ_and T1 T2) = typ_and (seal_rec n y T1) (seal_rec n y T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_typ_or : forall n y (T1 T2:typ), seal_rec n y (typ_or T1 T2) = typ_or (seal_rec n y T1) (seal_rec n y T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_typ_sel : forall n y (a1:avar) l (a2:avar), seal_rec n y (typ_sel a1 l a2) = typ_sel (seal_rec n y a1) l (seal_rec n y a2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_typ_bnd : forall n y (T:typ), seal_rec n y (typ_bnd T) = typ_bnd (seal_rec (S n) y T).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_typ_fun : forall n y (T1 T2:typ), seal_rec n y (typ_fun T1 T2) = typ_fun (seal_rec n y T1) (seal_rec (S n) y T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_dec_typ : forall n y (l:typ_label) (T1 T2:typ),
  seal_rec n y (dec_typ l T1 T2) = dec_typ l (seal_rec (S n) y T1) (seal_rec (S n) y T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_dec_fld : forall n y (l:fld_label) (T1 T2:typ),
  seal_rec n y (dec_fld l T1 T2) = dec_fld l (seal_rec n y T1) (seal_rec n y T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_dec_met : forall n y (l:met_label) (T1 T2 T3:typ),
  seal_rec n y (dec_met l T1 T2 T3) =
  dec_met l (seal_rec (S n) y T1) (seal_rec n y T2) (seal_rec (S (S n)) y T3).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** typ/dec mutual closedness *)

Lemma typ_dec_seal_closed :
  (forall (T:typ) n y, closed_below n T -> seal_rec n y T = T)
  /\ (forall (D:dec) n y, closed_below n D -> seal_rec n y D = D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n y H. rewrite seal_typ_top. reflexivity.
  - intros n y H. rewrite seal_typ_bot. reflexivity.
  - intros D IH n y H. rewrite seal_typ_rcd. rewrite (IH n y (closed_below_typ_rcd H)). reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n y H. rewrite seal_typ_and.
    rewrite (IH1 n y (closed_below_typ_and_l H)).
    rewrite (IH2 n y (closed_below_typ_and_r H)). reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n y H. rewrite seal_typ_or.
    rewrite (IH1 n y (closed_below_typ_or_l H)).
    rewrite (IH2 n y (closed_below_typ_or_r H)). reflexivity.
  - intros a1 l a2 n y H. rewrite seal_typ_sel.
    rewrite (@avar_seal_closed n y a1 (closed_below_typ_sel_l H)).
    rewrite (@avar_seal_closed n y a2 (closed_below_typ_sel_r H)). reflexivity.
  - intros T IH n y H. rewrite seal_typ_bnd. rewrite (IH (S n) y (closed_below_typ_bnd H)). reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n y H. rewrite seal_typ_fun.
    rewrite (IH1 n y (closed_below_typ_fun_l H)).
    rewrite (IH2 (S n) y (closed_below_typ_fun_r H)). reflexivity.
  - intros n y H. rewrite seal_typ_nocap. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n y H. rewrite seal_dec_typ.
    rewrite (IH1 (S n) y (closed_below_dec_typ_l H)).
    rewrite (IH2 (S n) y (closed_below_dec_typ_r H)). reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n y H. rewrite seal_dec_fld.
    rewrite (IH1 n y (closed_below_dec_fld_l H)).
    rewrite (IH2 n y (closed_below_dec_fld_r H)). reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 n y H. rewrite seal_dec_met.
    rewrite (IH1 (S n) y (closed_below_dec_met_c H)).
    rewrite (IH2 n y (closed_below_dec_met_z H)).
    rewrite (IH3 (S (S n)) y (closed_below_dec_met_r H)). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typ_seal_closed : forall (T:typ) n y,
  closed_below n T -> seal_rec n y T = T.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 typ_dec_seal_closed); assumption. Qed.
Lemma dec_seal_closed : forall (D:dec) n y,
  closed_below n D -> seal_rec n y D = D.
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 typ_dec_seal_closed); assumption. Qed.

(** * Seal equations for trm/lit/def/defs/item *)

Lemma seal_trm_var : forall n y (a:avar), seal_rec n y (trm_var a) = trm_var (seal_rec n y a).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_trm_read : forall n y (a:avar) l, seal_rec n y (trm_read a l) = trm_read (seal_rec n y a) l.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_trm_apply : forall n y (a b:avar),
  seal_rec n y (trm_apply a b) = trm_apply (seal_rec n y a) (seal_rec n y b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma seal_trm_let : forall n y (t1 t2:trm),
  seal_rec n y (trm_let t1 t2) = trm_let (seal_rec n y t1) (seal_rec (S n) y t2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Typing_subst.

(** * Context narrowing

    Replacing the type [S] of a binder [x] by a subtype [W] preserves all
    typing judgments.  The binder is identified by a split
    [G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2], with [x] absent from [G1] and [G2] (so the
    occurrence is unambiguous).  The narrowing hypothesis [W <: S] is stated
    in the narrowed context itself; it can be weakened when fresh binders are
    pushed on top. *)

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Context-shape helpers *)

Lemma ctx_binds_narrow_same : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W y T,
  ctx_binds y T (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  y <> x ->
  ctx_binds y T (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W y T H Hne.
  change (ctx_binds y T ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2)) in H.
  change (ctx_binds y T ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2)).
  revert G1 H.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H.
  - (* empty *)
    cbn in H. cbn.
    inversion H; subst.
    + exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto.
  - (* push *)
    cbn in H. cbn.
    inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_e.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; [ exact H5 | ].
      eapply IH. exact H8.
  - (* stop *) cbn in H. inversion H.
  - (* hide *)
    cbn in H. inversion H; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide. eapply IH. exact H4.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_self_narrow : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W T,
  x \notin ctx_dom G1 -> x \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  T = S.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W T H1 H2 H.
  eapply ctx_binds_self_insert; [ | exact H ].
  eapply notin_dom_concat; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_self_narrowed : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk W,
  x \notin ctx_dom G1 -> x \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x W (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk W H1 H2.
  change (ctx_binds x W ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2)).
  revert G1 H1.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H1.
  - cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
  - cbn. rewrite notin_union in H2. destruct H2 as [H2v H2g].
    rewrite notin_singleton in H2v.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E. subst y. apply H2v. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + eapply IH; eauto.
  - cbn. assumption.
  - cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

(** ctx_vis ignores the binding types entirely. *)
Lemma ctx_vis_narrow_same : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W y,
  ctx_vis (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) y ->
  ctx_vis (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2) y.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W y H.
  change (ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2) y) in H.
  change (ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2) y).
  revert G1 H.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H.
  - cbn in H. cbn. exact H.
  - cbn in H. cbn. exact H.
  - cbn in H. inversion H.
  - cbn in H. cbn in H. inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [ exact H4 | ].
      eapply IH. exact H5.
Qed.

(** ctx_vis under narrowing, with an arbitrary objctx appended. *)
Lemma ctx_vis_narrow_obj : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W (Go:objctx) y,
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) §§& Go) y ->
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2) §§& Go) y.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W Go y H.
  revert H.
  induction Go as [|xz T|yz T]; cbn in *.
  - apply ctx_vis_narrow_same.
  - (* objctx_lit: one binder appended *)
    intro H. inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [ exact H3 | ].
      apply ctx_vis_narrow_same. exact H4.
  - (* objctx_heap: no binder *)
    apply ctx_vis_narrow_same.
Qed.

(** Decomposition of ctx_obj_met at a split. *)
Lemma ctx_obj_met_split : forall (G1 G2:ctx) (Go:objctx) xz TZ xc TC,
  ctx_obj_met typing_mode (G1 §& G2) Go xz TZ xc TC =
  G1 §& ctx_obj_met typing_mode G2 Go xz TZ xc TC.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 Go xz TZ xc TC.
  destruct Go as [|x0 T0|y0 T0]; destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode);
    cbn.
  - apply ctx_met_decomp.
  - rewrite ctx_hide_concat. apply ctx_met_decomp.
  - (* objctx_lit, vis all *)
    change ((G1 §& (G2 § x0 / v_self ~ open x0 T0))
              § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open x0 T0) (open xc T0))
            = G1 §& ((G2 § x0 / v_self ~ open x0 T0)
              § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open x0 T0) (open xc T0)))).
    rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* objctx_lit, vis hide *)
    change (((ctx_hide (G1 §& (G2 § x0 / v_self ~ open x0 T0)))
               § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open x0 T0) (open xc T0)))
            = G1 §& ((ctx_hide (G2 § x0 / v_self ~ open x0 T0))
               § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open x0 T0) (open xc T0)))).
    rewrite ctx_hide_concat. rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - apply ctx_met_refined_decomp.
  - rewrite ctx_hide_concat. apply ctx_met_refined_decomp.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.
