Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence HeapCorrespondence ConfigVarkinds TFree InertContext RecordTypes.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Context_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Lifting facts from the lower context of a ctx_binds_k_after derivation. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y T, ctx_binds y T G2 -> ctx_binds y T G1.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y T Hb.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk' t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. exact Hb.
    + exact Hb.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk' t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom.
      eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y vk', ctx_k G2 y vk' -> ctx_k G1 y vk'.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y vk' Hk.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk'0 t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_k_weaken_push; [exact Hk|exact Hfresh].
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk'0 t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_k_weaken_push.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hk].
    + exact Hfresh.
Qed.

(** 1) Lookup in renv_corr. *)

Lemma renv_corr_lookup : forall G e, ctx_ok G -> renv_corr G e ->
  forall w y, binds w y e ->
    exists Tw Ty,
      ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\
      ctx_binds w Tw G /\ ctx_binds y Ty G /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Hok Hc. induction Hc as
    [G0|G1 G2 G3 e0 w0 y0 Tw Ty Hw Hy Hcorr Hrenv IH]; intros w y Hb.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv. exact Hb.
  - destruct (classicT (w = w0)) as [E|N].
    + subst w. assert (Ey : y = y0) by (eapply binds_push_eq_inv; exact Hb). subst y.
      exists Tw, Ty. split.
      * exists Tw, G2. exact Hw.
      * split.
        -- eapply ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k; [exact Hw|exact Hok|].
           exists Ty, G3. exact Hy.
        -- split.
           ++ eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hw.
           ++ split.
              ** eapply ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds; [exact Hw|exact Hok|].
                 eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hy.
              ** exact Hcorr.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok|]. eapply binds_push_neq_inv; eauto.
Qed.

(** 2) From a v_ref context variable to its heap location and item. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_ref_lookup : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y, binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\ @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma y.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hk.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hxdom : x \in dom e) by (eapply ctx_k_v_ref_in_env_dom; eauto).
  destruct (dom_exists Hxdom) as [y Hy].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists y. split; [exact Hy|]. split.
  - rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
  - apply Hitem. rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
Qed.

(** 3) Inversion of ty_item_s. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_inv : forall G e s x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e s x ->
  (exists S T t L, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G /\
     binds x (item_fun t) s /\
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L -> G § x0 / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x0 t ∶ open x0 T) /\
     all_tfree_k G t v_ref)
  \/
  (exists U S ds T, ctx_binds x T G /\ binds x (item_obj ds) s /\
     T = typ_objref U S /\ G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) /\
     defs_varkinds G ds).
Proof.
  intros G e s x H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. exists S, T, t, L. repeat split; eauto.
  - right. exists U, S, ds, T. repeat split; eauto.
Qed.

(** 4) Environment bindings inherit context kinds/correspondence. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_binds_env : forall G e Sigma w y,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> binds w y e ->
  exists Tw Ty, ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y Hhc Hb.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hb) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists Tw, Ty. split; [exact Kkw|]. split; [exact Kky|exact Tcorr].
Qed.

(** 5) Domain characterizations. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_dom_env : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> dom e = ctx_kdom v_ref G.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma H.
  destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  symmetry. exact Hde.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_dom_heap : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> dom Sigma = ctx_kdom v_loc G.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma H.
  destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  symmetry. exact Hds.
Qed.

(** 6) Projections. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_ctx_ok : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_ok G.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok Hr]. exact Hok. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ctx_weakens : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_weakens G.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk Hr]]. exact Hwk. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ok_env : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ok e.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke Hr]]]]. exact Hoke. Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_ok_heap : forall G e Sigma,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ok Sigma.
Proof. intros. destruct H as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke Hr]]]]. exact Hoks. Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ty_trm_sub_elim : forall G e t U,
  ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t U ->
  exists T, ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e t U H. induction H.
  - (* var *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* apply *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_apply; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* read *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_read; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* write *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_write; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* call *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_call; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* let *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_let; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* lit *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_lit; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* sub *) destruct IHty_trm as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_sub_elim : forall G e x U,
  ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x U ->
  exists T, ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e x U H. induction H.
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_var_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_intro; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_elim; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - exists (typ_and T U); split; [eapply ty_var_and; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - destruct IHty_var as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_var_mut_top; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
Qed.

Lemma trm_empty_head : forall t T,
  ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  (exists s u, t = trm_let s u) \/ (exists l u, t = trm_lit l u).
Proof.
  intros t T H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty empty t T) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  all: try (exfalso;
    match goal with Hx : ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ ?x ∶ _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (ty_var_in_dom Hx) as Hd; cbn in Hd; rewrite in_empty in Hd; assumption end).
  all: try (left; eexists; eexists; reflexivity).
  all: try (right; eexists; eexists; reflexivity).
  all: try (apply IHty_trm; reflexivity).

Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma fresh_two : forall L y w, y \notin L -> w \notin L -> w <> y -> fresh L 2 (y :: w :: nil).
Proof.
  intros L y w Hy Hw Hyw. unfold fresh. cbn. split; [exact Hy|]. split.
  - apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|]. apply notin_singleton. exact Hyw.
  - exact I.
Qed.

Lemma red_let_step : forall (s u:trm) fs Sigma e Lv,
  exists C', (trm_let s u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ C'.
Proof. intros. eexists. eapply red_let_push. Qed.

Lemma red_lit_step : forall (l:lit) (u:trm) fs Sigma e Lv,
  exists C', (trm_lit l u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ C'.
Proof.
  intros l u fs Sigma e Lv.
  set (L := fv_config (trm_lit l u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
  destruct (var_fresh L) as [y Hy].
  destruct (var_fresh (L \u \{y})) as [w Hw].
  rewrite notin_union in Hw. destruct Hw as [HwL Hwy].
  rewrite notin_singleton in Hwy.
  assert (Hf : fresh L 2 (y :: w :: nil)) by (apply fresh_two; auto).
  assert (Hyw : y <> w) by (intro E; subst; apply Hwy; reflexivity).
  destruct l as [T t1|T ds].
  - exists (open w u ; fs ; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1) ; e & w ~ y ;
              fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    eapply red_let_fun.
    + cbn. exact Hf.
    + exact Hyw.
  - exists (open w u ; fs ;
              Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))) ; e & w ~ y ;
              fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    eapply red_let_obj.
    + cbn. exact Hf.
    + intro E. apply Hyw. symmetry. exact E.
Qed.

Section WithTypingMode_step.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma config_initial_step : forall (t:trm) T Lv,
  ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  exists C', (t ; stack_nil ; empty ; empty ; Lv) ↦ C'.
Proof.
  intros t T Lv Hty.
  destruct (trm_empty_head Hty) as [[s [u E]]|[l [u E]]]; subst t.
  - apply red_let_step.
  - apply red_lit_step.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode_step.

Lemma ty_kind_mut :
  (forall G Go e (t:trm) T, ty_trm typing_mode G Go e t T ->
     forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_trm typing_mode G' Go e t T)
  /\ (forall G Go e (l:lit) T, ty_lit typing_mode G Go e l T ->
     forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_lit typing_mode G' Go e l T)
  /\ (forall G Go e (d:def) D, ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D ->
     forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_def typing_mode G' Go e d D)
  /\ (forall G Go e (ds:defs) T, ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
     forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_defs typing_mode G' Go e ds T).
Proof.
  destruct (@var_sub_incap_kind typing_mode) as [Hvar [Hsub Hincap]].
  apply (@rules_mutind typing_mode
    (fun G Go e t T _ => forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_trm typing_mode G' Go e t T)
    (fun G Go e l T _ => forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_lit typing_mode G' Go e l T)
    (fun G Go e d D _ => forall G', ctx_kind_eq G G' -> ty_def typing_mode G' Go e d D)

  - (* trm var *) intros G e x T cv o G' Hke. eapply ty_trm_var.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke G G' Hke). apply cv. exact Hv.
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e x T o G' Hke).
  - (* trm apply *) intros G e x z Sfun Tres ef cvx cvz ox oz G' Hke.
    eapply ty_trm_apply.
    + exact ef.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke G G' Hke). apply cvx. exact Hv.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke G G' Hke). apply cvz. exact Hv.
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e x (typ_fun Sfun Tres) ox G' Hke).
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e z Sfun oz G' Hke).
  - (* trm read *) intros G e x a Sfld Tfld U cv ox vp G' Hke.
    eapply ty_trm_read.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke G G' Hke). apply cv. exact Hv.
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sfld Tfld)) ox G' Hke).
    + exact (@viewpoint_adapt_kind x G objctx_empty e Tfld U vp G' Hke).
  - (* trm write *) intros G e x yv a Sfld Tfld cvx cvy mut ox oy G' Hke.
    eapply ty_trm_write.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke G G' Hke). apply cvx. exact Hv.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke G G' Hke). apply cvy. exact Hv.
    + intro Hm. exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e x (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) (mut Hm) G' Hke).
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sfld Tfld)) ox G' Hke).
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e yv Sfld oy G' Hke).
  - (* trm call *) intros G e x yv m TC TZ TR cvx cvy ox oy sef o1 G' Hke.
    eapply ty_trm_call.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke G G' Hke). apply cvx. exact Hv.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke G G' Hke). apply cvy. exact Hv.
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ox G' Hke).
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e yv TZ oy G' Hke).
    + exact sef.
    + exact (@Hvar G objctx_empty e x (open yv TC) o1 G' Hke).
  - (* trm let *) intros L G e t u T U o IHo o0 IHo0 G' Hke.
    eapply ty_trm_let with (L := L).
    + exact (IHo G' Hke).
    + intro x. intro Hx. exact (IHo0 x Hx (G' § x / v_let ~ T) (@cke_push G G' x v_let v_let T Hke)).
  - (* trm lit *) intros L G e l u T U o IHo o0 IHo0 G' Hke.
    eapply ty_trm_lit with (L := L).
    + exact (IHo G' Hke).
    + intro x. intro Hx. exact (IHo0 x Hx (G' § x / v_let ~ T) (@cke_push G G' x v_let v_let T Hke)).
  - (* trm sub *) intros G e t T U o IHo s G' Hke.
    eapply ty_trm_sub.
    + exact (IHo G' Hke).
    + exact (@Hsub G objctx_empty e T U s G' Hke).
  - (* lit fun *) intros L G e T t U ef o IHo G' Hke.
    eapply ty_lit_fun with (L := L).
    + exact ef.
    + intro x. intro Hx.
      exact (IHo x Hx (G' § x / v_par ~ T) (@cke_push G G' x v_par v_par T Hke)).
  - (* lit obj *) intros L G e T ds o IHo ti G' Hke.
    eapply ty_lit_obj with (L := L).
    + intro x. intro Hx. exact (IHo x Hx G' Hke).
    + exact ti.
  - (* def typ *) intros L G Go e A T U o G' Hke.
    eapply ty_def_typ with (L := L). exact o.
  - (* def fld *) intros G Go e a t T cv o G' Hke.
    eapply ty_def_fld.
    + intro Hv. apply (@ctx_vis_ke (G §§& Go) (G' §§& Go) (@cke_obj G G' Hke Go)).
      apply cv. exact Hv.
    + exact (@Hvar (G §§& Go) objctx_empty e t T o (G' §§& Go) (@cke_obj G G' Hke Go)).
  - (* def met *) intros L G Go e m t TC TZ TR o IHo G' Hke.
    eapply ty_def_met with (L := L).
    intros xz Hxz xc Hxcxz Hxc.
    exact (IHo xz Hxz xc Hxcxz Hxc
             (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G' Go xz TZ xc TC)
             (@ctx_obj_met_ke typing_mode G G' Hke Go xz TZ xc TC)).
  - (* defs one *) intros G Go e d D o IHo G' Hke.
    eapply ty_defs_one. exact (IHo G' Hke).
  - (* defs cons *) intros G Go e ds d T D o IHo o0 IHo0 h G' Hke.
    eapply ty_defs_cons.
    + exact (IHo G' Hke).
    + exact (IHo0 G' Hke).
    + exact h.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_self_narrowed : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk W,
  x \notin ctx_dom G1 -> x \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x W (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk W H1 H2.
  change (ctx_binds x W ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2)).
  revert G1 H1.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H1.
  - cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.

    rewrite notin_singleton in H2v.

Qed.

Theorem soundness_initial_from_progress_preservation
    (progress : forall (c:config) (U:typ),

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_heap x T => objctx_heap x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  end.

Instance ObjctxSealable: Sealable objctx := objctx_seal_rec.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Soundness_generic.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The exact target of the task, reduced to the two operational metatheory
    obligations: progress and preservation for [config_typd]. *)

Theorem soundness_initial_from_progress_preservation
    (Hprogress : forall (c:config) (U:typ),
       config_typd typing_mode c U ->
       answer c \/ (exists c', c ↦ c'))
    (Hpreservation : forall (c c':config) (U:typ),
       config_typd typing_mode c U -> c ↦ c' ->
       config_typd typing_mode c' U)
    (t : trm) (T : typ):
  closed t -> closed T -> ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  exists C, (config_initial t C) /\
    ((exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)) \/
     (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C ⊣n↦* Cn)).
Proof.
  intros Hct _ Hty.
  destruct (var_fresh (fv t \u fv T)) as [null Hnull].
  exists (t ; stack_nil ; empty ; empty ; \{null}).
  split.
  - eapply config_initial_mk.
  - eapply soundness_via_typing with (T := typ_top).
    + eapply config_initial_typing; eauto.
    + intros c Uc Hc. eapply Hprogress. exact Hc.
    + intros c c' Uc Hc Hr. eapply Hpreservation; eassumption.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect Types.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_read  : avar -> fld_label -> trm
  | trm_apply  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_write  : avar -> fld_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_call: avar -> met_label -> avar -> trm

with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_obj  : typ -> defs -> lit

with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_fld  : fld_label -> avar -> def
  | def_met  : met_label -> trm -> def

with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop
with   def_mut  := Induction for def  Sort Prop
with   defs_mut := Induction for defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut, def_mut, defs_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (open_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (open_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmOpenable : Openable trm := open_rec_trm.

Instance LitOpenable : Openable lit := open_rec_lit.

Instance DefOpenable : Openable def := open_rec_def.

Instance DefsOpenable : Openable defs := open_rec_defs.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a         => (fv a)
  | trm_read x m       => (fv x)
  | trm_apply f a       => (fv f) \u (fv a)
  | trm_let t1 t2     => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  | trm_lit l t       => (fv_lit l) \u (fv_trm t)
  | trm_write x m y     => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | trm_call x m y => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  end with
fv_lit (l: lit) : vars :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e    => (fv T) \u (fv_trm e)
  | lit_obj T ds => (fv T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  end with
fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (fv T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (fv v)
  | def_met _ t     => (fv_trm t)
  end with
fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end.

Instance TrmFreeVar : FreeVar trm := fv_trm.

Instance LitFreeVar : FreeVar lit := fv_lit.

Instance DefFreeVar : FreeVar def := fv_def.

Instance DefsFreeVar : FreeVar defs := fv_defs.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: var) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var x        => trm_var (subst_var z u x)
  | trm_read x1 L     => trm_read (subst_var z u x1) L
  | trm_apply x1 x2    => trm_apply (subst_var z u x1) (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => trm_lit (subst_lit z u l) (subst_trm z u t)
  | trm_write x1 L x2  => trm_write (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_call x1 L x2  => trm_call (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  end with
subst_lit (z: var) (u: var) (l: lit) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t   => lit_fun (subst_var z u T) (subst_trm z u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj (subst_var z u T)
            (subst_defs z u ds)
  end with
subst_def (z: var) (u: var) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ l t => def_typ l (subst_var z u t)
  | def_fld l v => def_fld l (subst_var z u v)
  | def_met l t => def_met l (subst_trm z u t)
  end with
subst_defs (z: var) (u: var) (ds: defs) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end.

Instance TrmSubstVar : SubstVar trm := subst_trm.

Instance LitSubstVar : SubstVar lit := subst_lit.

Instance DefSubstVar : SubstVar def := subst_def.

Instance DefsSubstVar : SubstVar defs := subst_defs.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Constructive_sets.

Inductive ctx: Set :=

| ctx_empty

| ctx_push: ctx -> var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx

| ctx_stop: ctx -> ctx

| ctx_hide: ctx -> ctx
.

Notation "G '§' v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push G v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push ctx_empty v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʸ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_loc T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʷ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_ref T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʳ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_recv T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ᶻ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_par T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˢ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_self T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˣ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_let T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1
| ctx_push c v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_concat G1 c) v vk t
| ctx_stop c => ctx_stop (ctx_concat G1 c)
| ctx_hide c => ctx_hide (ctx_concat G1 c)
end.

Notation "E §& F" := (ctx_concat E F)
  (at level 28, left associativity) : env_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_map(fn: typ -> typ)(G: ctx): ctx :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => ctx_empty
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_map fn G1) v vk (fn t)
---
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context Envs.

Notation renv := (env var) (only parsing).

Notation renv_empty := (empty) (only parsing).

Notation renv_bind e v1 v2 := (e & v1 ~ v2) (only parsing).

Definition renv_notin (v: var) (e: renv) := v \notin (dom e \u fv_env e).

Definition renv_idempotent (e: renv) := forall x, x \in dom e -> x \notin fv_env e.

Notation renv_binds v1 v2 e := (binds v1 v2 e) (only parsing).
---
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types Terms Envs.

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj: defs -> item
  | item_fun: trm -> item.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => (fv ds)
  | item_fun t => (fv t)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (open_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (open_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemOpenable : Openable item := open_rec_item.

Definition subst_item x y (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (subst_var x y ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (subst_var x y t)
  end.

Instance ItemSubstVar : SubstVar item := subst_item.

Instance ItemAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax ItemOpenable ItemFreeVar ItemSubstVar := {}.

Definition seal_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (seal_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (seal_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemSealable : Sealable item := seal_rec_item.

Definition collect_item {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (it: item) : C :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (collect df f comb ds)
  | item_fun t => (collect df f comb t)
  end.

Instance ItemCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_item.

Definition transform_item (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (it : item) (n : nat) : item :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (item_obj (transform f ds n))
  | item_fun t => (item_fun (transform f t (S n)))
  end.

Instance ItemTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_item.

Notation heap := (env item).

Notation fv_heap Sigma := ((@dom item Sigma) \u (fv_env Sigma)).

Definition subst_heap x y : heap -> heap := map (subst_var x y).

Notation subheap_unchanged S1 S2 :=
  (forall y itm, binds y itm S1 -> binds y itm S2) (only parsing).

Class Fields (A: Type) :=
  fields: A -> vars.

Definition fields_def d: vars :=
  match d with
    | def_typ A T => \{}
    | def_met a t => \{}
    | def_fld a (avar_f x) => \{x}

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Subst_extra Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Kind_env_stack Typing_subst.

(** * A true variable swap on the syntax.  Unlike [subst_var], this is a
    bijection on free names, so it commutes with opening at every name. *)

Definition swp_var (sx sy z: var) : var :=
  If z = sx then sy else If z = sy then sx else z.

Definition swp_avar (sx sy : var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => avar_b i
  | avar_f z => avar_f (swp_var sx sy z)
  end.

Fixpoint swp_typ (sx sy : var) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (swp_dec sx sy D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => typ_and (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2 => typ_or (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_sel a1 l a2 => typ_sel (swp_avar sx sy a1) l (swp_avar sx sy a2)
  | typ_bnd T => typ_bnd (swp_typ sx sy T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2 => typ_fun (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end
with swp_dec (sx sy : var) (D : dec) {struct D} : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ l T1 T2 => dec_typ l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | dec_fld l T1 T2 => dec_fld l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | dec_met l TC TZ TR =>
      dec_met l (swp_typ sx sy TC) (swp_typ sx sy TZ) (swp_typ sx sy TR)
  end.

(** Lemmas on the variable-level swap. *)

Lemma swp_var_eq_l : forall sx sy, swp_var sx sy sx = sy.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  rewrite (classicT_l (eq_refl sx)). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_eq_r : forall sx sy, swp_var sx sy sy = sx.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  destruct (classicT (sy = sx)) as [E|N].
  - subst. rewrite (classicT_l (eq_refl sx)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (classicT_r N).
    rewrite (classicT_l (eq_refl sy)). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_other : forall sx sy z, z <> sx -> z <> sy -> swp_var sx sy z = z.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  rewrite (classicT_r H). rewrite (classicT_r H0). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_invol : forall sx sy z, swp_var sx sy (swp_var sx sy z) = z.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (classicT (z = sx)) as [E|Nx]; subst.
  - rewrite swp_var_eq_l. apply swp_var_eq_r.
  - destruct (classicT (z = sy)) as [E|Ny]; subst.
    + rewrite swp_var_eq_r. apply swp_var_eq_l.
    + rewrite (swp_var_other Nx Ny). apply swp_var_other; auto.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_fresh : forall sx sy z, sx <> sy ->
  z <> sx -> z <> sy -> swp_var sx sy z <> sx /\ swp_var sx sy z <> sy.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite swp_var_other; auto.
Qed.

Lemma swp_avar_open : forall sx sy n z (a:avar),
  swp_avar sx sy (open_rec n z a) =
  open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_avar sx sy a).
Proof.
  intros. destruct a as [i|u]; cbn.
  - unfold open_rec at 1. cbn.
    destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|N].
    + subst. rewrite (classicT_l (eq_refl i)). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (classicT_r N). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_avar_f : forall sx sy (z:var),
  swp_avar sx sy (avar_f z) = avar_f (swp_var sx sy z).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma swp_avar_b : forall sx sy i,
  swp_avar sx sy (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Opening commutation for types and decs. *)

Lemma swp_open_typ_dec :
  (forall (T:typ) sx sy n z,
    swp_typ sx sy (open_rec n z T) =
    open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_typ sx sy T))
  /\ (forall (D:dec) sx sy n z,
    swp_dec sx sy (open_rec n z D) =
    open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_dec sx sy D)).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros D IH sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros a1 l a2 sx sy n z. cbn.
    rewrite swp_avar_open, swp_avar_open. reflexivity.
  - intros T IH sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2, IH3. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_typ_open : forall sx sy n z (T:typ),
  swp_typ sx sy (open_rec n z T) =
  open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 swp_open_typ_dec); eauto. Qed.

Lemma swp_dec_open : forall sx sy n z (D:dec),
  swp_dec sx sy (open_rec n z D) =
  open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_dec sx sy D).
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 swp_open_typ_dec); eauto. Qed.

(** Constructor equations for [swp_typ]. *)

Lemma swp_typ_top : forall sx sy, swp_typ sx sy typ_top = typ_top.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_bot : forall sx sy, swp_typ sx sy typ_bot = typ_bot.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_nocap : forall sx sy, swp_typ sx sy typ_nocap = typ_nocap.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_rcd : forall sx sy (D:dec),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_rcd D) = typ_rcd (swp_dec sx sy D).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_and : forall sx sy (T1 T2:typ),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_and T1 T2) = typ_and (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_or : forall sx sy (T1 T2:typ),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_or T1 T2) = typ_or (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_sel : forall sx sy (a1:avar) l (a2:avar),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_sel a1 l a2) = typ_sel (swp_avar sx sy a1) l (swp_avar sx sy a2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_bnd : forall sx sy (T:typ),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_bnd T) = typ_bnd (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_fun : forall sx sy (T1 T2:typ),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_fun T1 T2) = typ_fun (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_dec_typ : forall sx sy l (T1 T2:typ),
  swp_dec sx sy (dec_typ l T1 T2) = dec_typ l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_dec_fld : forall sx sy l (T1 T2:typ),
  swp_dec sx sy (dec_fld l T1 T2) = dec_fld l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_dec_met : forall sx sy l (T1 T2 T3:typ),
  swp_dec sx sy (dec_met l T1 T2 T3) =
  dec_met l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2) (swp_typ sx sy T3).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Context and object-context swap. *)

Fixpoint swp_ctx (sx sy:var) (G:ctx) : ctx :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_push G0 v vk T => ctx_push (swp_ctx sx sy G0) (swp_var sx sy v) vk (swp_typ sx sy T)
  | ctx_stop G0 => ctx_stop (swp_ctx sx sy G0)
  | ctx_hide G0 => ctx_hide (swp_ctx sx sy G0)
  end.

Definition swp_objctx (sx sy:var) (Go:objctx) : objctx :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit v T => objctx_lit (swp_var sx sy v) (swp_typ sx sy T)
  | objctx_heap v T => objctx_heap (swp_var sx sy v) (swp_typ sx sy T)
  end.

Lemma swp_ctx_push : forall sx sy G v vk T,
  swp_ctx sx sy (G § v / vk ~ T) =
  swp_ctx sx sy G § swp_var sx sy v / vk ~ swp_typ sx sy T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma swp_ctx_empty : forall sx sy, swp_ctx sx sy ctx_empty = ctx_empty.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Substitution on contexts that also renames push names. *)

Fixpoint ctx_subst_full (sx sy:var) (G:ctx) : ctx :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_push G0 v vk T =>
      ctx_push (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0) (subst_var sx sy v) vk (subst_var sx sy T)
  | ctx_stop G0 => ctx_stop (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0)
  | ctx_hide G0 => ctx_hide (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0)
  end.

Definition objctx_subst_full (sx sy:var) (Go:objctx) : objctx :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit v T => objctx_lit (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T)
  | objctx_heap v T => objctx_heap (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T)
  end.

Lemma ctx_subst_full_push : forall sx sy G v vk T,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (G § v / vk ~ T) =
  ctx_subst_full sx sy G § subst_var sx sy v / vk ~ subst_var sx sy T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_full_empty : forall sx sy,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy ctx_empty = ctx_empty.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Binds/visibility are equivariant. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_swp : forall G v T,
  ctx_binds v T G ->
  forall sx sy, ctx_binds (swp_var sx sy v) (swp_typ sx sy T) (swp_ctx sx sy G).
Proof.
  intros G v T H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_swp : forall G v,
  ctx_vis G v ->
  forall sx sy, ctx_vis (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G v H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_vis_e.
  - apply ctx_vis_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_vis_hide; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_subst_full : forall G v T,
  ctx_binds v T G ->
  forall sx sy,
    ctx_binds (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T) (ctx_subst_full sx sy G).
Proof.
  intros G v T H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_full : forall G v,
  ctx_vis G v ->
  forall sx sy, ctx_vis (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G v H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_vis_e.
  - apply ctx_vis_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_vis_hide; auto.
Qed.

(** Object-context equations. *)

Lemma ctx_obj_swp : forall sx sy G Go,
  swp_ctx sx sy (G §§& Go) = (swp_ctx sx sy G) §§& (swp_objctx sx sy Go).
Proof.
  intros. destruct Go; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite swp_ctx_push. rewrite swp_typ_open. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_obj_subst_full : forall sx sy G Go,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (G §§& Go) =
  (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) §§& (objctx_subst_full sx sy Go).
Proof.
  intros. destruct Go; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite ctx_subst_full_push. rewrite subst_open_commut. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_swp : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC,
  swp_ctx sx sy (ctx_met G x TZ y TC) =
  ctx_met (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy x) (swp_typ sx sy TZ)
          (swp_var sx sy y) (swp_typ sx sy TC).
Proof.
  intros. unfold ctx_met. repeat rewrite swp_ctx_push.
  rewrite swp_typ_open. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_subst_full : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (ctx_met G x TZ y TC) =
  ctx_met (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy x) (subst_var sx sy TZ)
          (subst_var sx sy y) (subst_var sx sy TC).
Proof.
  intros. unfold ctx_met. repeat rewrite ctx_subst_full_push.
  rewrite subst_open_commut. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_swp : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC TC2,
  swp_ctx sx sy (ctx_met_refined G x TZ y TC TC2) =
  ctx_met_refined (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy x) (swp_typ sx sy TZ)
    (swp_var sx sy y) (swp_typ sx sy TC) (swp_typ sx sy TC2).
Proof.
  intros. unfold ctx_met_refined. repeat rewrite swp_ctx_push.
  repeat rewrite swp_typ_open. rewrite swp_typ_and. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_subst_full : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC TC2,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (ctx_met_refined G x TZ y TC TC2) =
  ctx_met_refined (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy x) (subst_var sx sy TZ)
    (subst_var sx sy y) (subst_var sx sy TC) (subst_var sx sy TC2).
Proof.
  intros. unfold ctx_met_refined. repeat rewrite ctx_subst_full_push.
  repeat rewrite subst_open_commut. rewrite subst_typ_and. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_heap_swp : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC z T,
  swp_ctx sx sy (ctx_met_refined_heap G x TZ y TC z T) =
  ctx_met_refined_heap (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy x) (swp_typ sx sy TZ)
    (swp_var sx sy y) (swp_typ sx sy TC) (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof.
  intros. unfold ctx_met_refined_heap, ctx_met_refined. repeat rewrite swp_ctx_push.
  repeat rewrite swp_typ_open. repeat rewrite swp_typ_and. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_heap_subst_full : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC z T,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (ctx_met_refined_heap G x TZ y TC z T) =
  ctx_met_refined_heap (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy x) (subst_var sx sy TZ)
    (subst_var sx sy y) (subst_var sx sy TC) (subst_var sx sy z) (subst_var sx sy T).
Proof.
  intros. unfold ctx_met_refined_heap, ctx_met_refined. repeat rewrite ctx_subst_full_push.
  repeat rewrite subst_open_commut. repeat rewrite subst_typ_and. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Environment support freshness suffices to keep an environment fixed. *)

Definition swp_renv_fixed sx sy e :=
  sx \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) /\ sy \notin (dom e \u fv_env e).

Lemma binds_swp_fixed : forall e v1 v2,
  binds v1 v2 e -> forall sx sy,
  swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
  binds (swp_var sx sy v1) (swp_var sx sy v2) e.
Proof.
  intros e v1 v2 Hb. induction Hb; intros sx sy [Hx Hy]; cbn in *.
  - (* empty *) inversion H.
  - (* push eq *) unfold binds. cbn. reflexivity.
  - (* push neq *) unfold binds. cbn.
    rewrite (classicT_r H0). apply IHHb. exact (conj Hx Hy).
Qed.

Lemma ctx_obj_vis_swp : forall G Go v,
  vis_var typing_mode (G §§& Go) v ->
  forall sx sy, vis_var typing_mode ((swp_ctx sx sy G) §§& (swp_objctx sx sy Go))
                    (swp_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G Go v H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply vis_var_vis. apply ctx_vis_swp. apply H.
  - apply vis_var_hide. apply IHvis_var.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_obj_vis_subst_full : forall G Go v,
  vis_var typing_mode (G §§& Go) v ->
  forall sx sy,
    vis_var typing_mode ((ctx_subst_full sx sy G) §§& (objctx_subst_full sx sy Go))
      (subst_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G Go v H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply vis_var_vis. apply ctx_vis_subst_full. apply H.
  - apply vis_var_hide. apply IHvis_var.
Qed.

    present in [Subst_extra] as [subst_typ_and]. *)

Instance CtxSealable: Sealable ctx := ctx_seal_rec.

Inductive ctx_vis: ctx -> var -> Prop :=
| ctx_vis_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v vk t) v
| ctx_vis_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_vis G v ->
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v2 vk t) v
.
---
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping TypingContext.

Class Unhiding (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  unhiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):
    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b ->
    property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b.

Class Hiding (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  hiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):
    property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b ->
    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Section UnhidingLemmata.

Context {A B: Set}{P: TypingProperty A B}{AW: Unhiding P}.

End UnhidingLemmata.

Section HidingLemmata.

Context {A B: Set}{P: TypingProperty A B}{AW: Hiding P}.

End HidingLemmata.

Definition UnhidingInd (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  forall G Go e (a: A) (b: B),
    property G Go e a b ->
    forall G1 G2,
      G = (ctx_hide G1) §& G2 ->
      property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b.

Definition UnhidingTInd (A: Set) (t: Typing A) := UnhidingInd obj_typing.

Definition UnhidingDInd (A: Set) (t: DecTyping A) := UnhidingInd obj_dec_typing.

Definition UnhidingIncapInd (_ : ReferenceIncapacitate) :=
  UnhidingInd obj_ref_incap.

Definition UnhidingCapbndInd (C : typ_refcap_label) (_ : CapabilityBound C) :=
  UnhidingInd obj_cap_bnd.

Definition HidingInd (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  forall G Go e (a: A) (b: B),
    property G Go e a b ->
    forall G1 G2,
      G = G1 §& G2 ->
      property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Definition HidingTInd (A: Set) (t: Typing A) := HidingInd obj_typing.

Definition HidingDInd (A: Set) (t: DecTyping A) := HidingInd obj_dec_typing.

Definition HidingIncapInd (_ : ReferenceIncapacitate)
  := HidingInd obj_ref_incap.

Definition HidingCapbndInd (C : typ_refcap_label) (_ : CapabilityBound C)
  := HidingInd obj_cap_bnd.

binds_single_eq: forall [A : Type] (x : var) (v : A), binds x v (x ~ v)

  forall [A : Type] [x : var] [v : A], binds x v empty -> False
binds_single_eq_inv:
  forall [A : Type] [x : var] [v1 v2 : A], binds x v1 (x ~ v2) -> v1 = v2
binds_tail:
  forall [A : Type] (x : var) (v : A) (E : env A), binds x v (E & x ~ v)
binds_push_eq:
  forall [A : Type] (x : var) (v : A) (E : env A), binds x v (E & x ~ v)
binds_concat_right:
  binds x v E2 -> binds x v (E1 & E2)
binds_functional:
  binds x v1 E -> binds x v2 E -> v1 = v2
binds_fresh_inv:
  binds x v E -> x # E -> False
binds_single_inv:
  binds x1 v1 (x2 ~ v2) -> x1 = x2 /\ v1 = v2
binds_map:
  binds x v E -> binds x (f v) (map f E)
binds_get_or_arbitrary:
  binds x v E -> get_or_arbitrary x E = v
binds_push_eq_inv:
  binds x v1 (E & x ~ v2) -> v1 = v2
binds_get:
  binds x v E -> get x E = Some v
binds_concat_left_ok:
  ok (E1 & E2) -> binds x v E1 -> binds x v (E1 & E2)
binds_concat_right_inv:
  binds x v (E1 & E2) -> x # E1 -> binds x v E2
fv_in_values_binds:
  binds x v E -> y \notin fv_in_values fv E -> y \notin fv v
binds_concat_left:
  binds x v E1 -> x # E2 -> binds x v (E1 & E2)
binds_concat_left_inv:
  binds x v (E1 & E2) -> x # E2 -> binds x v E1

binds_remove:
  binds x v (E1 & E2 & E3) -> x # E2 -> binds x v (E1 & E3)
binds_weaken:
  binds x a (E & G) -> ok (E & F & G) -> binds x a (E & F & G)

  binds x v (E1 & E2) -> binds x v E2 \/ x # E2 /\ binds x v E1
binds_concat_inv':

binds_subst:
  binds x1 v1 (E1 & x2 ~ v2 & E2) -> x1 <> x2 -> binds x1 v1 (E1 & E2)
binds_middle_eq_inv:
  binds x v1 (E1 & x ~ v2 & E2) -> ok (E1 & x ~ v2 & E2) -> v1 = v2
binds_push_inv:
  binds x1 v1 (E & x2 ~ v2) ->

get_empty: forall (A : Type) (k : var), get k empty = None
binds_get:
  binds x v E -> get x E = Some v
get_none_inv:
  forall [A : Type] [x : var] [E : env A], get x E = None -> x # E

get_some_inv:

get_some:

get_concat:

get_single:

get_push:

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax HeapUpdate.

(** * Replacement of a binding in a TLC environment.

    An environment is semantically a map whose [get] searches the head of the
    underlying list first.  [env_remove] deletes the first (visible) binding of
    a name; [env_set] then conses the new binding at the head. *)

Section EnvSet.

Context {A : Type}.

Fixpoint env_remove (E : env A) (x : var) : env A :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | cons (z, w) tl =>
    match classicT (x = z) with
    | left _ => env_remove tl x
    | right _ => cons (z, w) (env_remove tl x)
    end
  end.

Definition env_set (E : env A) (x : var) (v : A) : env A :=
  (env_remove E x) & (x ~ v).

Lemma binds_env_set_eq : forall E x v,
  binds x v (env_set E x v).
Proof.
  intros E x v. unfold binds, env_set.
  rewrite get_push. rewrite (If_l (P := x = x) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma get_env_remove_neq : forall E x z,
  z <> x -> get z (env_remove E x) = get z E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|(y,w) tl IH]; intros x z Hneq; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. cbn.
      (* RHS: get z ((x,w)::tl) *)
      change (get z (env_remove tl x) =
              get z (tl & (x ~ w))).
      rewrite get_push.
      rewrite (If_r (P := z = x) Hneq).
      apply IH. exact Hneq.
    + cbn.
      change (get z (tl & (y ~ w)) = _) in *.
      rewrite get_push.
      rewrite get_push.
      destruct (classicT (z = y)) as [Ezy|Nzy].
      * rewrite (If_l (P := z = y) Ezy).
        rewrite (If_l (P := z = y) Ezy). reflexivity.
      * rewrite (If_r (P := z = y) Nzy).
        rewrite (If_r (P := z = y) Nzy).
        apply IH. exact Hneq.
Qed.

Lemma get_env_set_neq : forall E x v z,
  z <> x -> get z (env_set E x v) = get z E.
Proof.
  intros E x v z Hneq. unfold env_set.
  rewrite get_push. rewrite (If_r (P := z = x) Hneq).
  apply get_env_remove_neq. exact Hneq.
Qed.

Lemma binds_env_set_neq : forall E x v z w,
  z <> x -> binds z w E -> binds z w (env_set E x v).
Proof.
  intros E x v z w Hneq Hb. unfold binds in *.
  rewrite get_env_set_neq; auto.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_remove : forall E x,
  dom (env_remove E x) = dom E \- \{x}.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|(y,w) tl IH]; intros x.
  - cbn. rewrite <- (empty_def A). rewrite dom_empty. apply fset_extens.
    intros z Hz. rewrite in_remove. rewrite in_empty in Hz. inversion Hz.
  - destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. cbn. rewrite IH.
      change (dom (tl & (x ~ w)) = _) in *.
      rewrite dom_concat. rewrite dom_single.
      apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
      repeat rewrite in_remove in *. repeat rewrite in_union in *.
      repeat rewrite in_singleton in *. tauto.
    + cbn. rewrite IH.
      change (dom (cons (y,w) (env_remove tl x)) = _).
      change (dom ((env_remove tl x) & (y ~ w)) = _).
      rewrite dom_concat. rewrite dom_single.
      change (dom (tl & (y ~ w)) = _) in *.
      rewrite dom_concat in *. rewrite dom_single in *.
      apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
      repeat rewrite in_remove in *. repeat rewrite in_union in *.
      repeat rewrite in_singleton in *. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_set : forall E x v,
  dom (env_set E x v) = dom E \u \{x}.
Proof.
  intros E x v. unfold env_set.
  rewrite dom_concat. rewrite dom_single. rewrite dom_env_remove.
  apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
  repeat rewrite in_union in *. repeat rewrite in_remove in *.
  repeat rewrite in_singleton in *. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_set_mem : forall E x v,
  x \in dom E -> dom (env_set E x v) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E x v Hx. rewrite dom_env_set.
  apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
  rewrite in_union in *. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz]; auto.
  rewrite in_singleton in Hz. subst z. auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_env_remove : forall E x,
  x \notin dom (env_remove E x).
Proof.
  intros E x Hx. rewrite dom_env_remove in Hx. rewrite in_remove in Hx.
  tauto.
Qed.

Lemma ok_env_remove : forall E x, ok E -> ok (env_remove E x).
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|(y,w) tl IH]; intros x Hok; cbn.
  - rewrite <- (empty_def A). apply ok_empty.
  - destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. apply IH.
      eapply ok_concat_inv_l. change (ok (tl & (x ~ w))). exact Hok.
    + apply ok_push.
      * apply IH. eapply ok_concat_inv_l. change (ok (tl & (y ~ w))). exact Hok.
      * intro Hin. apply notin_dom_env_remove with (x:=x) in Hin.
        rewrite dom_env_remove in Hin. rewrite in_remove in Hin. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma ok_env_set : forall E x v, ok E -> ok (env_set E x v).
Proof.
  intros E x v Hok. unfold env_set.
  apply ok_push.
  - apply ok_env_remove. exact Hok.
  - apply notin_dom_env_remove.
Qed.

End EnvSet.

(** * Existence of a heap update for a stored field. *)

Section HeapUpdateExists.

Lemma heap_update_exists : forall (Sigma:heap) yObj a yArg (ds ds':defs),
  ok Sigma ->
  binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  defs_update ds a yArg ds' ->
  heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.
  intros Sigma yObj a yArg ds ds' Hok Hb Hupd.
  unfold heap_update. repeat split.
  - apply ok_env_set. exact Hok.
  - apply ok_env_set. exact Hok.
  - apply dom_env_set_mem. eapply get_some_inv. apply binds_get. exact Hb.
  - intros z v Hz Hbz. eapply binds_env_set_neq; eauto.
  - exists ds, ds'. repeat split; auto. apply binds_env_set_eq.
Qed.

End HeapUpdateExists.

Proof.

  apply ok_push.
  - apply ok_env_remove. exact Hok.
  - apply notin_dom_env_remove.

Lemma heap_update_exists : forall (Sigma:heap) yObj a yArg (ds ds':defs),
  ok Sigma ->

  heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.

  - apply ok_env_set. exact Hok.
  - apply ok_env_set. exact Hok.
  - apply dom_env_set_mem. eapply get_some_inv. apply binds_get. exact Hb.
  - intros z v Hz Hbz. eapply binds_env_set_neq; eauto.
  - exists ds, ds'. repeat split; auto. apply binds_env_set_eq.
Qed.

End HeapUpdateExists.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Equivalence Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Mode facts.  In this project [Mode] is definitionally [mode]. *)

Lemma mode_has_fun_refcaps_none :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode -> mode_refcaps' typing_mode = mode_refcaps_none.
Proof.
  destruct typing_mode; cbn; intro H; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma mode_has_fun_cases :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  (typing_mode = basic \/ typing_mode = basic_sef_typing).
Proof.
  destruct typing_mode; cbn; intro H; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma mode_refcaps_none_inert_type :
  mode_refcaps' typing_mode = mode_refcaps_none ->
  forall T vk, inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  T = typ_top \/ (exists S, T = typ_rcd S) \/
  (exists T1 T2, T = typ_and T1 T2).
Proof.
  intros Hm T vk Hi.
  destruct (inert_typ_inv Hi) as [[S [U HU]]|[U [S [HU _]]]].
  - left. rewrite HU. destruct typing_mode; cbn in Hm; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - right. left. rewrite HU. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** * The empty refcap record is [typ_top]. *)

Lemma fset_singleton_neq_empty : forall (l:label), \{l} <> (\{}:fset label).
Proof.
  intros l H.
  assert (Hin : l \in (\{l}:fset label)) by (rewrite in_singleton; reflexivity).
  rewrite H in Hin. apply (@in_empty_inv label l Hin).
Qed.

Lemma refcap_typ_empty_top :
  forall T, refcap_typ T (\{}:fset label) -> T = typ_top.
Proof.
  intros T H. dependent destruction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply fset_singleton_neq_empty. exact x.
  - exfalso. assert (Hin : l \in (union ls (\{l}:fset label))).
    { rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
    rewrite x in Hin. apply (@in_empty_inv label l Hin).
Qed.

(** * Unfolding inert types in function modes. *)

Lemma inert_typ_fun_mode_shape :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  forall T vk, inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/
  (exists U, T = typ_and (typ_bnd U) typ_top).
Proof.
  intros Hmf T vk Hi.
  destruct (inert_typ_inv Hi) as [[S [U HU]]|[U [S [HU [Hrec Hind]]]]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HU.
  - right. exists U. rewrite HU.
    assert (Href : refcap_inert_type (typing_mode:=typing_mode) S vk).
    { eapply inert_objref_inv in Hi. exact (proj2 (proj2 Hi)). }
    unfold refcap_inert_type in Href.
    rewrite (mode_has_fun_refcaps_none Hmf) in Href. cbn in Href.
    rewrite (refcap_typ_empty_top Href). reflexivity.
Qed.

(** * Refcaps contain no field labels.  Consequently a refcap type is
       never a field record. *)

Lemma refcap_dec_not_fld : forall D, refcap_dec D ->
  forall a S U, D <> dec_fld a S U.
Proof. intros D H. dependent destruction H; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma refcap_typ_not_fld : forall T ls,
  refcap_typ T ls ->
  forall a S U, T <> typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U).
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H; intros a S U E; try discriminate.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct T0; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma refcap_inert_mutability_not_fld : forall S vk,
  refcap_inert_mutability S vk ->
  forall a S0 U0, S <> typ_rcd (dec_fld a S0 U0).
Proof.
  intros S vk H. dependent destruction H; discriminate.
Qed.

(** * Root inversion for inert sources into a function target.

       The only possible last rules are [refl], [fun], [tyq] (all of
       which force the source to be a function), or [trans].  The
       remaining [and11]/[and12] branches are dispatched by inertness:
       the second conjunct of an object reference is a refcap, never a
       function, and the first is [typ_bnd _], never a function. *)

Lemma inert_root_fun :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  forall T vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  forall Sf Tf,
  subtyp typing_mode (ctx_empty) objctx_empty (empty:renv) T (typ_fun Sf Tf) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) T X /\
             subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) X (typ_fun Sf Tf))
  \/ (exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0).
Proof.
  intros Hmf T vk Hi Sf Tf Hsub.
  destruct (inert_typ_fun_mode_shape Hmf Hi) as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|[U0 HT]].
  - right; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.
    eapply objref_fun_root in Hsub. destruct Hsub as [Htr|HS].
    + left; exact Htr.
    + exfalso.
      assert (Href : refcap_inert_type (typing_mode:=typing_mode) typ_top vk).
      { eapply inert_objref_inv in Hi. exact (proj2 (proj2 Hi)). }
      unfold refcap_inert_type in Href.
      rewrite (mode_has_fun_refcaps_none Hmf) in Href. cbn in Href.
      assert (Htop : typ_top = typ_fun Sf Tf) by exact HS.
      rewrite <- Htop in Href.
      eapply refcap_typ_not_fld in Href; [| eexists; eexists; reflexivity ].
      (* [refcap_typ_not_fld] needs a field shape; the function shape is
         dispatched directly by inversion of [refcap_typ]. *)
      clear Href.
      revert Htop. clear. intro Htop. subst.
      (* top is not a function: [typ_top] and [typ_fun] are distinct
         constructors. *)
      discriminate.
Qed.

(** * Root inversion for inert sources into a field-record target.

       Again only [trans] is possible (in function modes the refcap is
       [typ_top], which cannot be a field record; in mutability modes the
       refcap is a refcap record, which has no field label). *)

Lemma inert_root_fld :
  forall T vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  forall a Sf Uf,
  subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) T
    (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sf Uf)) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) T X /\
             subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) X
                (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sf Uf))).
Proof.
  intros T vk Hi a Sf Uf Hsub.
  destruct (inert_typ_inv Hi) as [[S [U HU]]|[U [S [HU [Hrec Hind]]]]].
  - rewrite HU in Hsub.
    dependent destruction Hsub; try discriminate.
    + (* trans *) eexists; split; eassumption.
    + (* fun *) discriminate.
    + (* tyq *) exfalso.
      eapply tyq_rcd_source in H. destruct H as [D' E]. discriminate E.
  - rewrite HU in Hsub.
    eapply objref_rcd_root in Hsub. destruct Hsub as [Htr|HS].
    + eexists; exact Htr.
    + exfalso.
      assert (Href : refcap_inert_type (typing_mode:=typing_mode) S vk).
      { eapply inert_objref_inv in Hi. exact (proj2 (proj2 Hi)). }
      unfold refcap_inert_type in Href.
      destruct (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) eqn:E.
      * cbn in Href. rewrite (refcap_typ_empty_top Href) in HS.
        discriminate HS.
      * cbn in Href. subst S.
        eapply refcap_inert_mutability_not_fld with (vk:=vk); eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Fixpoint env_remove (E : env A) (x : var) : env A :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | cons (z, w) tl =>
    match classicT (x = z) with
    | left _ => env_remove tl x
    | right _ => cons (z, w) (env_remove tl x)
    end
  end.

Definition env_set (E : env A) (x : var) (v : A) : env A :=
  (env_remove E x) & (x ~ v).

Lemma binds_env_set_eq : forall E x v,
  binds x v (env_set E x v).
Proof.
  intros E x v. unfold binds, env_set.
  rewrite get_push. rewrite (classicT_l (P := x = x) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma get_env_remove_neq : forall E x z,
  z <> x -> get z (env_remove E x) = get z E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|(y,w) tl IH]; intros x z Hneq; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. cbn.
      (* RHS: get z ((x,w)::tl) *)
      change (get z (env_remove tl x) =
              get z (tl & (x ~ w))).
      rewrite get_push.
      rewrite (classicT_r (P := z = x) Hneq).
      apply IH. exact Hneq.
    + cbn.
      change (get z (tl & (y ~ w)) = _) in *.
      rewrite get_push.
      rewrite get_push.
      destruct (classicT (z = y)) as [Ezy|Nzy].
      * rewrite (classicT_l (P := z = y) Ezy).
        rewrite (classicT_l (P := z = y) Ezy). reflexivity.
      * rewrite (classicT_r (P := z = y) Nzy).
        rewrite (classicT_r (P := z = y) Nzy).
        apply IH. exact Hneq.
Qed.

Lemma get_env_set_neq : forall E x v z,
  z <> x -> get z (env_set E x v) = get z E.
Proof.
  intros E x v z Hneq. unfold env_set.
  rewrite get_push. rewrite (classicT_r (P := z = x) Hneq).
  apply get_env_remove_neq. exact Hneq.
Qed.

Lemma binds_env_set_neq : forall E x v z w,
  z <> x -> binds z w E -> binds z w (env_set E x v).
Proof.
  intros E x v z w Hneq Hb. unfold binds in *.
  rewrite get_env_set_neq; auto.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_remove : forall E x,
  dom (env_remove E x) = dom E \- \{x}.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|(y,w) tl IH]; intros x.
  - cbn. rewrite <- (empty_def A). rewrite dom_empty. apply fset_extens.
    intros z Hz. rewrite in_remove. rewrite in_empty in Hz. inversion Hz.
  - destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. cbn. rewrite IH.
      change (dom (tl & (x ~ w)) = _) in *.
      rewrite dom_concat. rewrite dom_single.
      apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
      repeat rewrite in_remove in *. repeat rewrite in_union in *.
      repeat rewrite in_singleton in *. tauto.
    + cbn. rewrite IH.
      change (dom (cons (y,w) (env_remove tl x)) = _).
      change (dom ((env_remove tl x) & (y ~ w)) = _).
      rewrite dom_concat. rewrite dom_single.
      change (dom (tl & (y ~ w)) = _) in *.
      rewrite dom_concat in *. rewrite dom_single in *.
      apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
      repeat rewrite in_remove in *. repeat rewrite in_union in *.
      repeat rewrite in_singleton in *. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_set : forall E x v,
  dom (env_set E x v) = dom E \u \{x}.
Proof.
  intros E x v. unfold env_set.
  rewrite dom_concat. rewrite dom_single. rewrite dom_env_remove.
  apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
  repeat rewrite in_union in *. repeat rewrite in_remove in *.
  repeat rewrite in_singleton in *. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_set_mem : forall E x v,
  x \in dom E -> dom (env_set E x v) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E x v Hx. rewrite dom_env_set.
  apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
  rewrite in_union in *. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz]; auto.
  rewrite in_singleton in Hz. subst z. auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_env_remove : forall E x,
  x \notin dom (env_remove E x).
Proof.
  intros E x Hx. rewrite dom_env_remove in Hx. rewrite in_remove in Hx.
  tauto.
Qed.

(** * Root inversion for inert sources into a function target.

       The only possible last rules are [refl], [fun], [tyq] (all of
       which force the source to be a function), or [trans].  The
       remaining [and11]/[and12] branches are dispatched by inertness:
       the second conjunct of an object reference is a refcap, never a
       function, and the first is [typ_bnd _], never a function. *)

Lemma inert_root_fun :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  forall T vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  forall Sf Tf,
  subtyp typing_mode (ctx_empty) objctx_empty (empty:renv) T (typ_fun Sf Tf) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) T X /\
             subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) X (typ_fun Sf Tf))
  \/ (exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0).
Proof.
  intros Hmf T vk Hi Sf Tf Hsub.
  destruct (inert_typ_fun_mode_shape Hmf Hi) as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|[U0 HT]].
  - right; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.
    eapply objref_fun_root in Hsub. destruct Hsub as [Htr|HS].
    + left; exact Htr.
    + exfalso.
      assert (Href : refcap_inert_type (typing_mode:=typing_mode) typ_top vk).
      { rewrite HT in Hi. eapply inert_objref_inv in Hi. exact (proj2 (proj2 Hi)). }
      unfold refcap_inert_type in Href.
      rewrite (mode_has_fun_refcaps_none Hmf) in Href. cbn in Href.
      (* [HS] says directly that the refcap type is a function; in
         function modes it is [typ_top]. *)
      discriminate HS.
Qed.

(** * Root inversion for inert sources into a field-record target.

       Again only [trans] is possible (in function modes the refcap is
       [typ_top], which cannot be a field record; in mutability modes the
       refcap is a refcap record, which has no field label). *)

Lemma inert_root_fld :
  forall T vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  forall a Sf Uf,
  subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) T
    (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sf Uf)) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) T X /\
             subtyp typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty (empty:renv) X
                (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sf Uf))).
Proof.
  intros T vk Hi a Sf Uf Hsub.
  destruct (inert_typ_inv Hi) as [[S [U HU]]|[U [S [HU [Hrec Hind]]]]].
  - rewrite HU in Hsub.
    dependent destruction Hsub; try discriminate.
    + (* trans *) eexists; split; eassumption.
    + (* fun *) discriminate.
    + (* tyq *) exfalso.
      eapply tyq_rcd_source in H. destruct H as [D' E]. discriminate E.
  - rewrite HU in Hsub.
    eapply objref_rcd_root in Hsub. destruct Hsub as [Htr|HS].
    + eexists; exact Htr.
    + exfalso.
      assert (Href : refcap_inert_type (typing_mode:=typing_mode) S vk).
      { rewrite HU in Hi. eapply inert_objref_inv in Hi. exact (proj2 (proj2 Hi)). }
      unfold refcap_inert_type in Href.
      destruct (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) eqn:E.
      * cbn in Href. rewrite (refcap_typ_empty_top Href) in HS.
        discriminate HS.
      * cbn in Href. subst S.
        eapply refcap_inert_mutability_not_fld with (vk:=vk); eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:
  ctx_weakens G ->
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
    rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* objctx_heap, hide *)
    change ((ctx_hide (G1 §& G2) §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open y0 T0) (open xc T0)))))
            = (G1 §& (ctx_hide G2 §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open y0 T0) (open xc T0))))))).
    rewrite ctx_hide_concat. rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_mid_push_narrow2 : forall (G1 G2:ctx) xh vkh Sh x0 vk0 T0 y vk1 T1,
  ((G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2) § x0 / vk0 ~ T0) § y / vk1 ~ T1 =
  G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& ((G2 § x0 / vk0 ~ T0) § y / vk1 ~ T1).
Proof.
  intros.
  change ((((G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) §& (G2 § x0 / vk0 ~ T0)) §& (y / vk1 ~ T1))
          = ((G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) §& ((G2 § x0 / vk0 ~ T0) §& (y / vk1 ~ T1)))).
  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

  binds v1 v2 e -> forall sx sy,
  swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
  binds (swp_var sx sy v1) (swp_var sx sy v2) e.
Proof.
  intros e v1 v2 Hb sx sy [Hx Hy].
  assert (Hv1x : v1 <> sx).

    - left. apply (@binds_in_dom var e v1 v2 Hb).
    - right. exact Hy. }
  assert (Hv2x : v2 <> sx).
  { intro E. subst sx. apply Hy.
    pose proof (@fv_in_values_binds var (@fv var VarFreeVar) v2 v1 e Hb) as Hn.
    apply Hn. exact Hy. }
  assert (Hv2y : v2 <> sy).
  { intro E. subst sy. apply Hy.
    pose proof (@fv_in_values_binds var (@fv var VarFreeVar) v2 v1 e Hb) as Hn.

Lemma binds_swp_fixed : forall (e:renv) (v1 v2:var),
  binds v1 v2 e -> forall sx sy,
  swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
  binds (swp_var sx sy v1) (swp_var sx sy v2) e.
Proof.
  intros e v1 v2 Hb sx sy [Hx Hy].
  rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hxdom Hxfv].
  rewrite notin_union in Hy. destruct Hy as [Hydom Hyfv].
  assert (Hv1x : v1 <> sx).
  { intro E. subst sx. apply Hxdom. apply (@binds_in_dom var e v1 v2 Hb). }
  assert (Hv1y : v1 <> sy).
  { intro E. subst sy. apply Hydom. apply (@binds_in_dom var e v1 v2 Hb). }
  assert (Hsx2 : sx \notin fv v2).
  { exact (@fv_in_values_binds var sx (@fv var VarFreeVar) v1 v2 e Hb Hxfv). }
  assert (Hsy2 : sy \notin fv v2).
  { exact (@fv_in_values_binds var sy (@fv var VarFreeVar) v1 v2 e Hb Hyfv). }
  assert (Hv2x : v2 <> sx).
  { intro E. subst v2. apply Hsx2. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hv2y : v2 <> sy).
  { intro E. subst v2. apply Hsy2. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
  rewrite (swp_var_other Hv1x Hv1y).
  rewrite (swp_var_other Hv2x Hv2y).
  exact Hb.
Qed.

- `fun_rcd_root`, `inert_root_fld :` the analogous trans-predecessor decomposition for an inert source into a field record
- `record_dec_typ_bounds : record_dec (dec_typ A S T) -> S = T \/ S = typ_bot`
- `record_dec_fld_bounds : record_dec (dec_fld a S T) -> S = T`
- `canonical_obj_field_from_binding_label :` given `heap_correspond G e Sigma`, `inert G`, `ctx_k G x v_ref`, `ctx_binds x Tw G`, `Tw = typ_objref U S`, `record_typ U ls`, and `label_fld a \in ls`, produces `y ds v` with `binds x y e`, `binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma`, and `defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v))`. Together with `Canonical.v`'s `canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun`, this assembles both canonical forms once the transport below is supplied.

Residual gaps (documented in the file, not admitted):

- `inert_subtyp_fun : inert_typ T vk -> subtyp G e T (typ_fun S U) -> exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0`.
- `inert_subtyp_not_field : inert_typ T vk -> subtyp G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False`.
- `record-open field-label transport : record_typ U ls -> subtyp G e (open x U) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T)) -> label_fld a \in ls`.

`inert_root_fun`/`inert_root_fld` reduce these to the transitive/selector-reachability induction. The remaining obstruction is the simultaneous `ty_var`/`subtyp`/`ty_incap` induction (`ts_mutind`) tracking reachability through `subtyp_trans` and the receiver bound of `subtyp_sel1/2`; under `inert G` the receiver's record must come from `ty_rec_elim` with `record_dec` equal-or-bottom bounds, which is precisely excluded by the new bound lemmas. This is not a single-step inversion, so I did not claim it proved.

(** ** Hiding a middle segment of the context *)

Lemma ctx_binds_hide_mid : forall (A B C:ctx) x T,
  ctx_binds x T (A §& (B §& C)) ->
  ctx_binds x T (A §& ((ctx_hide B) §& C)).
Proof.
  intros A B C x T H.
  revert A B C H.
  (* Decompose the lookup into the three segments by induction on the
     concatenated context, using the standard ctx_binds inversions. *)
  change (ctx_binds x T (A §& B §& C)) in H.
  revert A B C H.
  induction C as [|C IH y vk S|C IH|C IH]; intros A B C H.
  - (* empty: A §& (B §& empty) *)
    cbn in H. cbn. exact H.
  - (* push *)
    cbn in H. cbn.
    inversion H; subst.
    + (* top *) apply ctx_binds_e.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; [ eassumption | ].
      eapply IH; eassumption.
  - cbn in H. cbn. invert H.
  - cbn in H. cbn.
    inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_e.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; [ eassumption | ].
      eapply IH; eassumption.

inert_typ T vk ->
               subtyp G e T (typ_fun S U) ->
               exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.

         (B) [inert_subtyp_not_field] forall T vk G e a S U,
               inert_typ T vk ->
               subtyp G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.

       [inert_root_fun] and [inert_root_fld] reduce each of them to the
       [trans] predecessor: it suffices to prove that no type reachable
       from an inert binding by a non-empty subtyping chain can be a
       function/field.  The two obstructions to a naive structural
       induction on [subtyp] are:

         - [subtyp_trans]: the intermediate type is not inert, so the
           induction hypothesis for the first premise is not applicable
           to the second premise.

         - [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2]: a selector can be an intermediate
           type.  The counterexample in [Record_subtyp.v] shows that a
           raw record can acquire a field label through a type member.
           Under [inert G] the receiver's record in [ty_var] must come
           from [ty_rec_elim] applied to an object interface whose
           [record_dec] bounds are equal or bottom
           ([record_dec_typ_bounds]), which is exactly what excludes the
           bad-bounds chain.  Formalizing this requires a simultaneous
           induction over [ty_var]/[subtyp]/[ty_incap] (the scheme
           [ts_mutind]) whose motive tracks the receiver bound alongside
           reachability; it is not a single-step inversion.

       The supporting facts needed by that induction are all proved in
       this file: [inert_typ_fun_mode_shape], [refcap_typ_not_fld],
       [refcap_inert_mutability_not_fld], [record_dec_typ_bounds],
       [record_dec_fld_bounds], [inert_root_fun], [inert_root_fld], and
       the assembly [canonical_obj_field_from_binding_label] (which,
       together with [canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun] from [Canonical.v], yields
       both canonical forms once (A)/(B) are available). *)


End WithTypingMode.
---
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->

Proof.
  intros. eapply (proj1 (@var_sub_incap_narrow typing_mode)); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_narrow : forall G e (T U:typ),
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,

    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (proj1 (proj2 (@var_sub_incap_narrow typing_mode))); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_incap_narrow : forall G e (T U:typ),
  ty_incap typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    ty_incap typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros. eapply (proj2 (proj2 (@var_sub_incap_narrow typing_mode))); eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.
