Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Equivalence Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Mode facts.  In this project [Mode] is definitionally [mode]. *)

Lemma mode_has_fun_refcaps_none :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode -> mode_refcaps' typing_mode = mode_refcaps_none.
Proof.
  destruct typing_mode; cbn; intro H; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma mode_has_fun_cases :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  (typing_mode = basic \/ typing_mode = basic_sef_typing).
Proof.
  destruct typing_mode; cbn; intro H; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

(** * The empty refcap record is [typ_top]. *)

Lemma fset_singleton_neq_empty : forall (l:label), \{l} <> (\{}:fset label).
Proof.
  intros l H.
  assert (Hin : l \in (\{l}:fset label)) by (rewrite in_singleton; reflexivity).
  rewrite H in Hin. apply (@in_empty_inv label l Hin).
Qed.

Lemma typ_top_neq_fun : forall S U, (typ_top:typ) <> typ_fun S U.
Proof. intros S U E. discriminate E. Qed.
Lemma typ_top_neq_rcd : forall D, (typ_top:typ) <> typ_rcd D.
Proof. intros D E. discriminate E. Qed.

Lemma refcap_typ_empty_top :
  forall T, refcap_typ T (\{}:fset label) -> T = typ_top.
Proof.
  intros T H. dependent destruction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply fset_singleton_neq_empty. exact x.
  - exfalso. assert (Hin : l \in (union ls (\{l}:fset label))).
    { rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
    rewrite x in Hin. apply (@in_empty_inv label l Hin).
Qed.

(** * Unfolding inert types in function modes. *)

Lemma inert_typ_fun_mode_shape :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  forall T vk, inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/
  (exists U, T = typ_and (typ_bnd U) typ_top).
Proof.
  intros Hmf T vk Hi.
  destruct (inert_typ_inv Hi) as [[S [U HU]]|[U [S [HU [Hrec Hind]]]]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HU.
  - right. exists U. rewrite HU.
    assert (Href : refcap_inert_type (typing_mode:=typing_mode) S vk).
    { rewrite HU in Hi. eapply inert_objref_inv in Hi. exact (proj2 (proj2 Hi)). }
    unfold refcap_inert_type in Href.
    rewrite (mode_has_fun_refcaps_none Hmf) in Href. cbn in Href.
    rewrite (refcap_typ_empty_top Href). reflexivity.
Qed.

(** * Refcaps contain no field labels.  Consequently a refcap type is
       never a field record. *)

Lemma refcap_dec_not_fld : forall D, refcap_dec D ->
  forall a S U, D <> dec_fld a S U.
Proof. intros D H. dependent destruction H; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma refcap_typ_not_fld : forall T ls,
  refcap_typ T ls ->
  forall a S U, T <> typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U).
Proof.
  intros T ls H.
  induction H as [|D l0 Hdec Heq|T0 ls0 D0 l0 Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot];
    intros a S U E.
  - all: inversion E.
  - all: inversion E; subst; inversion Hdec.
  - all: discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma refcap_inert_mutability_not_fld : forall S vk,
  refcap_inert_mutability S vk ->
  forall a S0 U0, S <> typ_rcd (dec_fld a S0 U0).
Proof.
  intros S vk H. dependent destruction H; discriminate.
Qed.

(** * Root inversion for inert sources into a function target.

       The only possible last rules are [refl], [fun], [tyq] (all of
       which force the source to be a function), or [trans].  The
       remaining [and11]/[and12] branches are dispatched by inertness:
       the second conjunct of an object reference is a refcap, never a
       function, and the first is [typ_bnd _], never a function. *)

Lemma inert_root_fun :
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  forall G e T vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  forall Sf Tf,
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T (typ_fun Sf Tf) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T X /\
             subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e X (typ_fun Sf Tf))
  \/ (exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0).
Proof.
  intros Hmf G e T vk Hi Sf Tf Hsub.
  destruct (inert_typ_fun_mode_shape Hmf Hi) as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|[U0 HT]].
  - right; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - rewrite HT in Hsub. rewrite HT.
    eapply objref_fun_root in Hsub. destruct Hsub as [Htr|HS].
    + left; exact Htr.
    + exfalso.
      assert (Href : refcap_inert_type (typing_mode:=typing_mode) typ_top vk).
      { rewrite HT in Hi. eapply inert_objref_inv in Hi. exact (proj2 (proj2 Hi)). }
      unfold refcap_inert_type in Href.
      rewrite (mode_has_fun_refcaps_none Hmf) in Href. cbn in Href.
      exact (@typ_top_neq_fun Sf Tf HS).
Qed.

(** * Root inversion for inert sources into a field-record target.

       Again only [trans] is possible (in function modes the refcap is
       [typ_top], which cannot be a field record; in mutability modes the
       refcap is a refcap record, which has no field label). *)

Lemma fun_rcd_root : forall G e (S U:typ) (D:dec),
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_fun S U) (typ_rcd D) ->
  exists X, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_fun S U) X /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e X (typ_rcd D).
Proof.
  intros G e S U D H. dependent destruction H; try discriminate.
  - eexists; split; eassumption.
  - exfalso. eapply tyq_rcd_source in H. destruct H as [D' E]. discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma inert_root_fld :
  forall G e T vk,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  forall a Sf Uf,
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T
    (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sf Uf)) ->
  (exists X, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T X /\
             subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e X
                (typ_rcd (dec_fld a Sf Uf))).
Proof.
  intros G e T vk Hi a Sf Uf Hsub.
  destruct (inert_typ_inv Hi) as [[S [U HU]]|[U [S [HU [Hrec Hind]]]]].
  - rewrite HU in Hsub. rewrite HU.
    eapply fun_rcd_root; exact Hsub.
  - rewrite HU in Hsub. rewrite HU.
    eapply objref_rcd_root in Hsub. destruct Hsub as [Htr|HS].
    + destruct Htr as [X [H1 H2]]. exists X. split; assumption.
    + exfalso.
      assert (Href : refcap_inert_type (typing_mode:=typing_mode) S vk).
      { rewrite HU in Hi. eapply inert_objref_inv in Hi. exact (proj2 (proj2 Hi)). }
      unfold refcap_inert_type in Href.
      destruct (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) eqn:E.
      * cbn in Href. rewrite (refcap_typ_empty_top Href) in HS.
        exact (@typ_top_neq_rcd _ HS).
      * cbn in Href. subst S.
        eapply refcap_inert_mutability_not_fld with (vk:=vk); eauto.
Qed.


(** * Bounds recorded by [record_dec].  These are the facts that rule
       out the bad-bounds selector path for an object interface. *)

Lemma record_dec_typ_bounds : forall A S T,
  record_dec (dec_typ A S T) -> S = T \/ S = typ_bot.
Proof. intros A S T H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma record_dec_fld_bounds : forall a S T,
  record_dec (dec_fld a S T) -> S = T.
Proof. intros a S T H. inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.

(** * Assembling the object-field canonical form once the label is known.

       This is the composition of [item_canonical] with
       [defs_has_fld_of_label].  The only remaining input for a complete
       canonical-forms theorem is the transport from the direct [ty_var]
       type to the binding label (see the residual note below). *)

Lemma canonical_obj_field_from_binding_label :
  forall G e Sigma x Tw (U:typ) S ls a,
  @heap_correspond typing_mode G e Sigma -> @inert typing_mode G ->
  ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  ctx_binds x Tw G -> Tw = typ_objref U S ->
  record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls ->
  exists y ds v, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                 defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Tw U S ls a Hhc Hinert Hk Bx HTw Hrec Hlab.
  destruct (@item_canonical typing_mode G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk) as
    [y [Tw' [Ty [Hbxy [Hydom [Bx' [Kky [Tcorr Hdisj]]]]]]]].
  assert (E : Tw' = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique;
    [eapply (@heap_correspond_ctx_ok typing_mode G e Sigma); exact Hhc | exact Bx' | exact Bx]).
  subst Tw'.
  destruct Hdisj as [[S0 [T0 [tf [Hmf [HTw' [HTy Bitem]]]]]]
                    |[U0 [S1 [S2 [ds [HTw' [HTy [Bitem [Hrec0 [Hds Hvk]]]]]]]]]].
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. discriminate HTw.
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. injection HTw as HU HS. subst U0.
    destruct Hrec0 as [ls0 Hrec0].
    assert (Hls : ls0 = ls) by (eapply record_typ_labels_eq; eassumption).
    subst ls0.
    destruct (@defs_has_fld_of_label typing_mode G (objctx_heap y U) e ds (open y U) a
                Hds y U ls eq_refl Hrec Hlab Hvk) as [v Hhas].
    exists y, ds, v. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Bitem|exact Hhas].
Qed.


(** * RESIDUAL GAP (precise).

       The following two statements are NOT proved here:

         (A) [inert_subtyp_fun]   forall T vk G e S U,
               inert_typ T vk ->
               subtyp G e T (typ_fun S U) ->
               exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.

         (B) [inert_subtyp_not_field] forall T vk G e a S U,
               inert_typ T vk ->
               subtyp G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.

       [inert_root_fun] and [inert_root_fld] reduce each of them to the
       [trans] predecessor: it suffices to prove that no type reachable
       from an inert binding by a non-empty subtyping chain can be a
       function/field.  The two obstructions to a naive structural
       induction on [subtyp] are:

         - [subtyp_trans]: the intermediate type is not inert, so the
           induction hypothesis for the first premise is not applicable
           to the second premise.

=== Canonical.v relevant
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inertness of a context binding determines the shape of its type. *)

Lemma inert_typ_k_after : forall x vk T G G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2 -> inert G -> inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G G2 H.
  induction H as [a1 a2 a3 a4|b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 b8 b9 b10 IH]; intros Hi.
  - inversion Hi as [|c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9]; subst.
    exact c7.
  - inversion Hi as [|d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 d8 d9]; subst.
    eapply IH. exact d5.
Qed.

Lemma inert_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  inert G -> ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk Hi [T [G2 Hka]].
  exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka.
  - eapply inert_typ_k_after; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_inv : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S T2, T = typ_fun S T2)
  \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U /\ typ_indep_b 0 U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - right. exists T, S. split; [reflexivity|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typ_corr_inv : forall Tw Ty,
  typ_corr Tw Ty ->
  (exists S T, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\ Ty = typ_fun S T)
  \/
  (exists U S1 S2, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2).
Proof.
  intros Tw Ty H. dependent destruction H.
  - right. exists T, S, U. split; [reflexivity|reflexivity].
  - left. exists t1, t2. split; [assumption|]. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** Canonical shape of the heap item reached by a v_ref variable. *)

Lemma item_canonical : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y Tw Ty,
    binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\
    ctx_binds x Tw G /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty /\
    ( (exists S T tf, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\
                       Ty = typ_fun S T /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
      \/ (exists U S1 S2 ds, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2 /\
            binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\ record_type U /\
            G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U /\ defs_varkinds G ds) ).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk.
  pose proof (heap_correspond_ref_lookup Hhc Hk) as Href.
  destruct Href as [y [Hbxy [Hydom Hitem]]].
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitemall]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hbxy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkx [Kky [Bx [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  assert (HinertTw : inert_typ Tw v_ref).
  { destruct Hk as [Tk [G2 Hka]].
    assert (Bk : ctx_binds x Tk G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
    pose proof (inert_typ_k_after Hka Hinert) as Ity.
    assert (Tk = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact Bk|exact Bx]).
    subst. exact Ity. }
  exists y, Tw, Ty. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hydom|].
  split; [exact Bx|]. split; [exact Kky|]. split; [exact Tcorr|].
  destruct (ty_item_s_inv Hitem) as
    [ [S0 [T0 [tf [L [Hmf [Bty [Bitem [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]]
    | [U [Sx [ds [Ty0 [Bty [Bitem [Heq [Hds_ty Hvark]]]]]]]] ].
  - left. exists S0, T0, tf.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_fun S0 T0)
      by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]).
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + injection HTy as HS HT. subst S'. subst T'. split; [exact Hmf'|].
      split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|exact Bitem].
    + discriminate HTy.
  - right.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_objref U Sx).
    { rewrite Heq in Bty. eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]. }
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + discriminate HTy.
    + injection HTy as HU HS. subst U'. subst S2.
      exists U, S1, Sx, ds. split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|].
      assert (HrecU : record_type U).
      { destruct (inert_typ_inv HinertTw) as [[Sf [Tf Hfun]]|[U2 [S3 [Heq2 [Hrec2 _]]]]].
        - rewrite HTw in Hfun. discriminate Hfun.
        - rewrite HTw in Heq2. injection Heq2 as H3 H4. subst U2. exact Hrec2. }
      split; [exact Bitem|]. split; [exact HrecU|].
      split; [exact Hds_ty|exact Hvark].
Qed.

(** ** From a record label to a field definition. *)

Lemma label_of_fld_inv : forall (d:def) a,
  label_of d = label_fld a -> exists v, d = def_fld a v.
Proof.
  intros d a H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma def_varkinds_fld_avar : forall G l (v:avar),
  def_varkinds G (def_fld l v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G l v H. inversion H; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_fld : forall G (ds:defs) a (v:avar),
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_fld a v) -> exists x, v = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros G ds. induction ds as [|tl IH d0]; intros a v Hvk Hhas.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas. discriminate.
  - unfold defs_has in Hhas. cbn in Hhas.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d0 = label_fld a)) as [E|N]; cbn in Hhas.
    + injection Hhas as Hd. subst d0.
      inversion Hvk; subst. eapply def_varkinds_fld_avar; eauto.
    + inversion Hvk; subst. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_fld_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall y (U:typ) ls,
    T = open y U -> record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls ->
    defs_varkinds G ds ->
    exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a Hty y U ls HT Hrec Hlab Hvk. subst T.
  destruct (ty_defs_record Hty) as [Hex Hinvs].
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as Hrec'.
  destruct (Hinvs ls Hrec' (label_fld a) Hlab) as [d [Hhas Hlabel]].
  eapply label_of_fld_inv in Hlabel. destruct Hlabel as [v Hd]. subst d.
  destruct (@defs_varkinds_has_fld G ds a v Hvk Hhas) as [x E]. subst v.
  exists x. exact Hhas.
Qed.

(** ** Conditional canonical forms (the remaining gap is the target-type to
       binding-shape/label connection, which needs inert-source subtyping
       inversion; see the note at the end of the file). *)

Lemma canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun : forall G e Sigma x Tw,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  ctx_binds x Tw G ->
  (exists S0 T0, Tw = typ_fun S0 T0) ->
  exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Tw Hhc Hinert Hk Bx [S0 [T0 HTw]].
  destruct (item_canonical Hhc Hinert Hk) as
    [y [Tw' [Ty [Hbxy [Hydom [Bx' [Kky [Tcorr Hdisj]]]]]]]].
  assert (E : Tw' = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique;
    [eapply heap_correspond_ctx_ok; exact Hhc | exact Bx' | exact Bx]).
  subst Tw'.
  destruct Hdisj as [[S' [T' [tf [Hmf [HTw' [HTy Bitem]]]]]]
                    |[U [S1 [S2 [ds [HTw' [HTy [Bitem _]]]]]]]].
  - exists y, tf. split; assumption.
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. discriminate HTw.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_obj_field_of_label : forall G e Sigma x a y U (ds:defs) (ls:fset label),
  binds x y e -> binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U ->
  record_typ U ls -> label_fld a \in ls -> defs_varkinds G ds ->
  exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x a y U ds ls Hbxy Hitem Hds Hrec Hlab Hvk.
  eapply defs_has_fld_of_label; [exact Hds | reflexivity | exact Hrec | exact Hlab | exact Hvk].
Qed.

(** NOTE / residual gap: the exact statements `canonical_fun` and
    `canonical_obj_field` in the directive additionally need to connect the
    direct `ty_var` type `T0` (and `T0 <: typ_fun S T` / `T0 <: typ_rcd D`) to
    the inert binding type `Tw`.  The naive pure-subtyping record-label lemma
    is false (Record_subtyp.v), and the transport only survives because
    (a) inert context bindings are functions/object-refs, never bare records,
    and (b) object annotations in `ty_item_s` come from *typed* defs whose type
    members have equal bounds, so the `subtyp_sel1/sel2` bad-bound path cannot
    be used to extract a field label absent from the object's record `U`.
    Formalizing that inert-source subtyping inversion is the remaining work.
    The lemmas above give the heap-item canonical shape and the label-to-def
    step; once one proves `Tw = typ_objref U S` (resp. `Tw = typ_fun ...`) and
    `label_of D \in labels U` from the ty_var/subtyp hypotheses, the exact
    canonical forms follow immediately. *)

End WithTypingMode.

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Equivalence Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inert contexts: every binding type is inert. *)

Lemma inert_ctx_all : forall G z T,
  inert G -> ctx_binds z T G -> exists vk, inert_typ T vk.
Proof. intros. eapply inert_binds_typ; eauto. Qed.

(** ** A syntactic "has label" predicate (weaker than [record_typ]). *)

Inductive HasLabel (l:label) : typ -> Prop :=
| hl_rcd : forall (D:dec), label_of D = l -> HasLabel l (typ_rcd D)
| hl_and_l : forall T U, HasLabel l T -> HasLabel l (typ_and T U)
| hl_and_r : forall T U, HasLabel l U -> HasLabel l (typ_and T U).

Lemma record_typ_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls l,
  record_typ T ls -> l \in ls -> HasLabel l T.
Proof.
  intros T ls l H. induction H as [D l0 Hdec Heq|T ls D l0 Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot].
  - intros Hl. rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    eapply hl_rcd. symmetry. exact Heq.
  - intros Hl. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + eapply hl_and_l. eapply IH; eauto.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. eapply hl_and_r. eapply hl_rcd. symmetry. exact Heq.
Qed.

(** ** Inert binding types are functions or object references. *)

Lemma inert_typ_fun_or_obj : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. destruct (inert_typ_inv H) as [[S [U Hu]]|[U [S [Hu [Hrec _]]]]].
  - left; eauto.
  - right; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Target-type inversion for equivalence (needed by subtyp_tyq cases). *)

Lemma tyq_fun_source : forall e (T1:typ) S U,
  typing_equiv e T1 (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S' U', T1 = typ_fun S' U'.
Proof.
  intros e T1 S U H. change (tyq_typ e T1 (typ_fun S U)) in H.
  remember (typ_fun S U) as T2 eqn:E. induction H; subst; try discriminate.
  - inversion H.
  - destruct H; discriminate.
  - eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** RESIDUAL GAP.
    The exact canonical forms require proving, under [inert G] and
    [ctx_binds x Tw G] with [inert_typ Tw vk], that
      (i)  if [ty_var G x T0] and [T0 <: typ_fun S U], then
           [exists S' U', Tw = typ_fun S' U']; and
      (ii) if [ty_var G x T0] and [T0 <: typ_rcd D] with [record_dec D],
           then [Tw = typ_objref U S] and the label of D occurs in
           [U]'s record type.
    The proofs must induct on the [ty_var] derivation (handling
    ty_var_and / ty_var_sub by transitivity on the same target, and
    ty_rec_elim by strengthening the induction hypothesis to targets of
    the form [typ_bnd V]) and then invert the subtyping derivation.
    The subtyping inversion is not a pure syntactic fact: Record_subtyp.v
    contains a counterexample for arbitrary contexts (using sel1/sel2
    through a non-inert record binding).  Under [inert G] that path is
    excluded, but the formal proof requires a transitivity-aware
    induction on the mutual subtyping/typing derivations (a fuel or
    well-founded induction on derivation size), because the only
    obstruction in the naive induction is the [subtyp_trans] constructor,
    whose intermediate type is not itself inert.

    Everything except this type-to-binding-shape transport is proved:
    Canonical.v's [item_canonical] gives the heap item shape from the
    inert binding; [canonical_fun_of_Tw_fun] and
    [canonical_obj_field_of_label] then close the canonical forms once
    the transport is available.  The lemmas above ([tyq_has_label],
    [record_typ_has_label], [tyq_fun_source], [inert_typ_fun_or_obj])
    supply the non-transitive inversion steps. *)

End WithTypingMode.
=== Record_subtyp
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext Defs Defs_lemmas.

(** * Record label structure and subtyping *)

Lemma record_typ_labels_eq : forall (T:typ) ls1 ls2,
  record_typ T ls1 -> record_typ T ls2 -> ls1 = ls2.
Proof.
  intros T ls1 ls2 H1. generalize dependent ls2. induction H1; intros ls2 H2r.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate.
    assert (Hls : ls = ls0) by (apply IHrecord_typ; assumption).
    subst ls0. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_record_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls D,
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of D \in ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrec. generalize dependent D. induction Hrec; intros Dh Hhas.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* andl *) rewrite in_union. left. apply IHHrec. assumption.
    + (* andr *) rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton.
      inversion H5; subst; try discriminate. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** The unrestricted statement
    [record_typ T ls -> T <: typ_rcd D -> record_dec D -> label_of D \in ls]
    is FALSE in the raw subtyping system, because [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2]
    can transport a label out of a type-member bound without the label being
    structurally present in the source record type.  We record an explicit
    counterexample. *)

Section Counterexample.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).
Variables (A: typ_normal_label) (a: fld_label) (x y: var).

Definition ce_target : typ := typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
Definition ce_source : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot ce_target).
Definition ce_G : ctx := ctx_push ctx_empty x v_ref (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) ce_source ce_target)).

Lemma ce_typing : ce_G⁏empty ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) ce_source ce_target).
Proof. eapply ty_var_var. eapply ctx_binds_e. Qed.

Lemma ce_open_source : (ce_source /[-> y]) = ce_source.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ce_open_target : (ce_target /[-> y]) = ce_target.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ce_subtyp : subtyp typing_mode ce_G objctx_empty empty ce_source ce_target.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_normal A) (avar_f y)).
  - eapply subtyp_sel2 with (S := ce_source) (T := ce_target). apply ce_typing.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1 with (S := ce_source) (T := ce_target). apply ce_typing.
Qed.

Lemma ce_record_source : record_typ ce_source (singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))).
Proof.
  eapply rt_one. apply rd_typb. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ce_record_dec_target : record_dec (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
Proof. apply rd_fld. Qed.

Lemma label_fld_not_in_source :
  ~ (label_fld a \in singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))).
Proof.
  rewrite in_singleton. intro E. inversion E.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_record_has_false :
  exists (G:ctx) (e:renv) (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
    record_typ T ls /\ subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T (typ_rcd D) /\
    record_dec D /\ ~ (label_of D \in ls).
Proof.
  exists ce_G, (empty : renv), ce_source, (singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))),
         (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
  split; [apply ce_record_source|]. split; [apply ce_subtyp|]. split.
  - apply ce_record_dec_target.
  - cbn. apply label_fld_not_in_source.
Qed.

End Counterexample.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev5 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Typing_subst.

(** * Context narrowing

    Replacing the type [S] of a binder [x] by a subtype [W] preserves all
    typing judgments.  The binder is identified by a split
    [G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2], with [x] absent from [G1] and [G2] (so the
    occurrence is unambiguous).  The narrowing hypothesis [W <: S] is stated
    in the narrowed context itself; it can be weakened when fresh binders are
    pushed on top. *)

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Context-shape helpers *)

Lemma ctx_binds_narrow_same : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W y T,
  ctx_binds y T (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  y <> x ->
  ctx_binds y T (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W y T H Hne.
  change (ctx_binds y T ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2)) in H.
  change (ctx_binds y T ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2)).
  revert G1 H.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H.
  - (* empty *)
    cbn in H. cbn.
    inversion H; subst.
    + exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto.
  - (* push *)
    cbn in H. cbn.
    inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_e.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; [ eassumption | ].
      eapply IH. eassumption.
  - (* stop *) cbn in H. inversion H.
  - (* hide *)
    cbn in H. cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide.
    inversion H; subst.
    eapply IH. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_self_narrow : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S T,
  x \notin ctx_dom G1 -> x \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  T = S.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S T H1 H2 H.
  eapply (@ctx_binds_self_insert G1 G2 x vk S T); [ | exact H ].
  eapply notin_dom_concat; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_push_inv : forall (G:ctx) y vk S z,
  z \notin ctx_dom (G § y / vk ~ S) -> z \notin ctx_dom G /\ z <> y.
Proof.
  intros G y vk S z H. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H.
  rewrite notin_singleton in H. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_self_narrowed : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W,
  x \notin ctx_dom G1 -> x \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x S (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x W (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W H1 H2 H.
  change (ctx_binds x W ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2)).
  change (ctx_binds x S ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2)) in H.
  revert G1 H1 H.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH y vk2 t|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H1 H.
  - cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply notin_dom_push_inv in H2. destruct H2 as [H2g Hxy].
    cbn in H. inversion H; subst.
    + exfalso. apply Hxy. reflexivity.
    + change (ctx_binds x W (((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2) § y / vk2 ~ t)).
      eapply ctx_binds_n.
      * exact Hxy.
      * eapply IH; eauto.
  - cbn in H. inversion H.
  - cbn in H. inversion H; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

(** ctx_vis ignores the binding types entirely. *)
Lemma ctx_vis_narrow_same : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W y,
  ctx_vis (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) y ->
  ctx_vis (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2) y.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W y H.
  change (ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2) y) in H.
  change (ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2) y).
  revert G1 H.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H.
  - cbn in H. cbn. inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; eauto.
  - cbn in H. cbn. inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [ eassumption | ].
      eapply IH. eassumption.
  - cbn in H. inversion H.
  - cbn in H. inversion H.
Qed.

(** ctx_vis under narrowing, with an arbitrary objctx appended. *)
Lemma ctx_vis_narrow_obj : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W (Go:objctx) y,
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) §§& Go) y ->
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2) §§& Go) y.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W Go y H.
  revert H.
  induction Go as [|xz T|yz T]; cbn in *.
  - eapply (@ctx_vis_narrow_same G1 G2 x vk S W y); eassumption.
  - (* objctx_lit: one binder appended *)
    intro H. inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n.
      * eassumption.
      * eapply (@ctx_vis_narrow_same G1 G2 x vk S W y); eassumption.
  - (* objctx_heap: no binder *)

Lemma ctx_obj_met_split : forall (G1 G2:ctx) (Go:objctx) xz TZ xc TC,

  G1 §& ctx_obj_met typing_mode G2 Go xz TZ xc TC.

  intros G1 G2 Go xz TZ xc TC.
  destruct Go as [|x0 T0|y0 T0];
    case_eq (mode_visibility' typing_mode); intros Evis; cbn; try rewrite Evis in *; cbn.
  - (* empty, all *)
    change (((G1 §& G2) §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ open xz TC)))
            = (G1 §& (G2 §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ open xz TC))))).
    rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* empty, hide *)
    change ((ctx_hide (G1 §& G2) §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ open xz TC)))
            = (G1 §& (ctx_hide G2 §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ open xz TC))))).
    rewrite ctx_hide_concat. rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* objctx_lit, all *)
    change (((G1 §& (G2 § x0 / v_self ~ open x0 T0))
               §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open x0 T0) (open xc T0)))))
            = (G1 §& ((G2 § x0 / v_self ~ open x0 T0)
               §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open x0 T0) (open xc T0))))))).
    rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* objctx_lit, hide *)
    change (((ctx_hide (G1 §& (G2 § x0 / v_self ~ open x0 T0)))
               §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open x0 T0) (open xc T0)))))
            = (G1 §& (ctx_hide (G2 § x0 / v_self ~ open x0 T0)
               §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open x0 T0) (open xc T0))))))).
    rewrite ctx_hide_concat. rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
  - (* objctx_heap, all *)
    change (((G1 §& G2) §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open y0 T0) (open xc T0)))))
            = (G1 §& (G2 §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open y0 T0) (open xc T0))))))).
    rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.

            = (G1 §& (ctx_hide G2 §& ((xz / v_par ~ TZ) §& (xc / v_recv ~ typ_and (open xz TC) (typ_and (open y0 T0) (open xc T0))))))).
    rewrite ctx_hide_concat. rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC TC2 : typ),
  ctx_met_refined (G1 §& G2) xz TZ xc TC TC2 =
  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2).

                  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2)).

Lemma ctx_mid_push : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) y vk (S : typ) x vk' (T : typ),
  (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) § x / vk' ~ T =
  G1 § y / vk ~ S §& (G2 § x / vk' ~ T).
Proof.
  intros. change ((G1 § y / vk ~ S) §& G2 §& (x / vk' ~ T) =
                  (G1 § y / vk ~ S) §& (G2 §& (x / vk' ~ T))).
  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Proof.

  - rewrite in_union. right. assumption.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect Types.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_read  : avar -> fld_label -> trm
  | trm_apply  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_write  : avar -> fld_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_call: avar -> met_label -> avar -> trm

with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_obj  : typ -> defs -> lit

with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_fld  : fld_label -> avar -> def
  | def_met  : met_label -> trm -> def

with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop
with   def_mut  := Induction for def  Sort Prop
with   defs_mut := Induction for defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut, def_mut, defs_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (open_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (open_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmOpenable : Openable trm := open_rec_trm.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Syntax_extra.

(** 1) Opening at depth 0 preserves closedness for lit / defs, and types *)

Lemma closed_lit_open_zero : forall (l:lit) x,
  closed_below 1 l -> closed (open_rec 0 x l).
Proof.
  intros l x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite lit_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@lit_open_commut l (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_defs_open_zero : forall (ds:defs) x,
  closed_below 1 ds -> closed (open_rec 0 x ds).
Proof.
  intros ds x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite defs_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@defs_open_commut ds (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_typ_open_zero : forall (T:typ) x,
  closed_below 1 T -> closed (open_rec 0 x T).
Proof.
  intros T x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite typ_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@typ_open_commut T (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

(** 2) Closedness of items *)

Lemma closed_item_fun : forall (t:trm),
  closed_below 1 t -> closed (item_fun t).
Proof.
  intros t Ht n x. cbn.
  rewrite (Ht (S n) x (Nat.lt_0_succ n)). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_item_obj : forall (ds:defs),
  closed ds -> closed (item_obj ds).
Proof.
  intros ds H n x. cbn. rewrite (H n x). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_avar_f : forall x, closed (avar_f x).
Proof. intros x n y. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma closed_avar_f_inv : forall (a:avar), closed a -> exists x, a = avar_f x.
Proof.
  intros a H. destruct a as [i|v].
  - exfalso. specialize (H i (var_gen \{})).
    cbn in H. rewrite (classicT_l (P := i = i) eq_refl) in H. discriminate H.
  - exists v. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** 3) Deref preserves closedness *)

Lemma closed_def_fld_avar : forall l (a:avar),
  closed (def_fld l a) -> closed a.
Proof.
  intros l a H n x. specialize (H n x). cbn in H. injection H as H1. exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma closed_def_fld_avar_f : forall l y, closed (def_fld l (avar_f y)).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Heap_lookup Context_lemmas Env_set.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Closedness of the avar subterms of a closed term. *)

Lemma closed_trm_var_avar : forall (a:avar),
  closed (trm_var a) -> closed a.
Proof.
  intros a H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_var in H.
  injection H as Ha. exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_read_avar : forall (a:avar) m,
  closed (trm_read a m) -> closed a.
Proof.
  intros a m H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_read in H.
  injection H as Ha. exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_apply_l : forall (a b:avar),
  closed (trm_apply a b) -> closed a.
Proof.
  intros a b H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_apply in H.
  injection H as Ha Hb. exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_apply_r : forall (a b:avar),
  closed (trm_apply a b) -> closed b.
Proof.
  intros a b H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_apply in H.
  injection H as Ha Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_write_l : forall (a:avar) m (b:avar),
  closed (trm_write a m b) -> closed a.
Proof.
  intros a m b H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_write in H.
  injection H as Ha Hb. exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_write_r : forall (a:avar) m (b:avar),
  closed (trm_write a m b) -> closed b.
Proof.
  intros a m b H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_write in H.
  injection H as Ha Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_call_l : forall (a:avar) m (b:avar),
  closed (trm_call a m b) -> closed a.
Proof.
  intros a m b H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_call in H.
  injection H as Ha Hb. exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_call_r : forall (a:avar) m (b:avar),
  closed (trm_call a m b) -> closed b.
Proof.
  intros a m b H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_call in H.
  injection H as Ha Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

(** * Canonical-form interfaces used by progress. *)

Variable canon_fun :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 S U,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_fun S U) ->
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma.

Variable canon_fld :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
    exists y ds v, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                  defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).

Variable canon_met :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ->
    exists y ds t, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                  defs_has ds (def_met m t).

(** * Progress. *)

Lemma progress_from_canon : forall (c:config) (U:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode c U ->
  answer c \/ (exists c', c ↦ c').
Proof.
  intros c U Hcfg. destruct c as [t s Sigma e Lv].
  inversion Hcfg as [G Gc Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct t as [a|a m|a b|t1 t2|l t2|a m b|a m b].
  - (* trm_var *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_var_avar Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct s as [|f fs].
      * left. apply nf_loc.
      * destruct f as [t0]. right. eexists. apply red_let_var.
  - (* trm_read *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_read_avar m Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + right.
      assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_read).
      destruct (ty_trm_read_inv typing_mode Hty) as [S [T [V [Hx [Hd Hs]]]]].
      destruct (ty_var_sub_elim typing_mode Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
      destruct (canon_fld G e Sigma x T0 m S T Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub)
        as [y [ds [v [Hbxy [Hby Hhas]]]]].
      destruct (var_fresh (fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))) as [w Hw].
      exists (trm_var (avar_f w) ; s ; Sigma ; e & w ~ y ;
                fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
      eapply red_read.
      * cbn. exact Hw.
      * exact Hbxy.
      * exact Hby.
      * exact Hhas.
  - (* trm_apply *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_l b Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [n|z].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_r a Hct)) as [y E].
        discriminate E.
      * right.
        assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_apply_l).
        destruct (ty_trm_apply_inv typing_mode Hty) as [S [T [Hx [Hz Hs]]]].
        destruct (ty_var_sub_elim typing_mode Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
        (* mode_has_fun is obtained from the apply typing rule *)
        assert (Hmf : mode_has_fun typing_mode).
        { dependent destruction Hty; assumption. }
        destruct (canon_fun G e Sigma x T0 S T Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub Hmf)
          as [y [tf [Hbxy Hby]]].
        exists (open z tf ; s ; Sigma ; e ;
                  fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        eapply red_apply; eauto.
  - (* trm_let *)
    right. eexists. apply red_let_push.
  - (* trm_lit *)
    right. apply red_lit_step.
  - (* trm_write *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_l m b Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [n|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_r a m Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right.
        assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_write_l).
        assert (Hky : ctx_k G y v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_write_r).
        destruct (ty_trm_write_inv typing_mode Hty) as [S [T [Hx [Hy Hs]]]].
        destruct (ty_var_sub_elim typing_mode Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
        destruct (canon_fld G e Sigma x T0 m S T Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub)
          as [yObj [ds [v [Hbxy [Hby Hhas]]]]].
        destruct (heap_correspond_ref_lookup typing_mode Hhc Hky)
          as [yArg [HbyArg _]].
        destruct (defs_update_at ds m v yArg Hhas) as [ds' Hupd].
        destruct (heap_correspond_ok_heap Hhc) as Hoks.
        assert (HupdHeap : heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg
                            (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds'))).
        { eapply heap_update_exists; eauto. }
        exists (trm_var (avar_f y) ; s ; env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds') ; e ;
                  fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        eapply red_write; eauto.
  - (* trm_call *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_l m b Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [n|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_r a m Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right.
        assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_call_l).
        destruct (ty_trm_call_inv typing_mode Hty) as
          [TC [TZ [TR [Hx [Hy [Hsef [Hxyopen Hs]]]]]]].
        destruct (ty_var_sub_elim typing_mode Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
        destruct (canon_met G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub)
          as [yObj [ds [tm [Hbxy [Hby Hhas]]]]].
        exists (open y (open_rec 1 x tm) ; s ; Sigma ; e ;
                  fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        eapply red_call; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];

  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.

  - (* trm_var *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_var_avar Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct s as [|f fs].
      * left. apply nf_loc.
      * destruct f as [t0]. right. eexists. apply red_let_var.
  - (* trm_read *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_read_avar m Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + right.
      assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_read).
      destruct (ty_trm_read_inv typing_mode Hty) as [S [T [V [Hx [Hd Hs]]]]].
      destruct (ty_var_sub_elim typing_mode Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
      destruct (canon_fld G e Sigma x T0 m S T Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub)

      destruct (var_fresh (fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))) as [w Hw].

                fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).

      * exact Hbxy.
      * exact Hby.
      * exact Hhas.

    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_l b Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [n|z].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_r a Hct)) as [y E].
        discriminate E.
      * right.
        assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_apply_l).
        destruct (ty_trm_apply_inv typing_mode Hty) as [S [T [Hx [Hz Hs]]]].

        (* mode_has_fun is obtained from the apply typing rule *)
        assert (Hmf : mode_has_fun typing_mode).
        { dependent destruction Hty; assumption. }
        destruct (canon_fun G e Sigma x T0 S T Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub Hmf)
          as [y [tf [Hbxy Hby]]].
        exists (open z tf ; s ; Sigma ; e ;
                  fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        eapply red_apply; eauto.
  - (* trm_let *)
    right. eexists. apply red_let_push.
  - (* trm_lit *)
    right. apply red_lit_step.
  - (* trm_write *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_l m b Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [n|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_r a m Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.

        assert (Hky : ctx_k G y v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_write_r).
        destruct (ty_trm_write_inv typing_mode Hty) as [S [T [Hx [Hy Hs]]]].
        destruct (ty_var_sub_elim typing_mode Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
        destruct (canon_fld G e Sigma x T0 m S T Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub)
          as [yObj [ds [v [Hbxy [Hby Hhas]]]]].
        destruct (heap_correspond_ref_lookup typing_mode Hhc Hky)
          as [yArg [HbyArg _]].
        destruct (defs_update_at ds m v yArg Hhas) as [ds' Hupd].
        destruct (heap_correspond_ok_heap Hhc) as Hoks.
        assert (HupdHeap : heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg
                            (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds'))).
        { eapply heap_update_exists; eauto. }
        exists (trm_var (avar_f y) ; s ; env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds') ; e ;
                  fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        eapply red_write; eauto.
  - (* trm_call *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_l m b Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [n|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_r a m Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right.
        assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_call_l).
        destruct (ty_trm_call_inv typing_mode Hty) as
          [TC [TZ [TR [Hx [Hy [Hsef [Hxyopen Hs]]]]]]].
        destruct (ty_var_sub_elim typing_mode Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
        destruct (canon_met G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub)
          as [yObj [ds [tm [Hbxy [Hby Hhas]]]]].
        exists (open y (open_rec 1 x tm) ; s ; Sigma ; e ;
                  fv_config (t0 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        eapply red_call; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Insertion weakening for ty_capbnd *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_weaken_insert : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
  - apply ty_capbnd_top.
  - apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - apply ty_capbnd_typ.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_sel.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_ignore. assumption.
  - apply ty_capbnd_met.
  - apply ty_capbnd_fld.
  - (* sel *) eapply ty_capbnd_sel.
    + destruct (@var_sub_incap_weaken_insert typing_mode) as [Hv _].
      exact (Hv G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T)) H G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHty_capbnd G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - apply ty_capbnd_rec.
  - (* and *) eapply ty_capbnd_and.
    + exact (IHty_capbnd G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHty_capbnd0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - (* or *) eapply ty_capbnd_or.
    + exact (IHty_capbnd G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHty_capbnd0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - apply ty_capbnd_all.
Qed.

(** ** Top-push version for capability bounds *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_weaken : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H y vk S Hn.
  exact (@ty_capbnd_weaken_insert C G Go e T U H G ctx_empty eq_refl
           y vk S (@notin_dom_obj_l y G Go Hn) (@notin_empty var y)).
Qed.

(** ** Insertion weakening for viewpoint adaptation *)

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_cap_weaken_insert : forall C x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros C x G Go e Tf Tr H.
  induction H.
  intros G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
  eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine.
  - destruct (@var_sub_incap_weaken_insert typing_mode) as [_ [_ Hincap]].
    exact (Hincap G Go e T Tstrip H G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - exact (@ty_capbnd_weaken_insert C G Go e T Tcap H0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_cap_weaken : forall C x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros C x G Go e Tf Tr H y vk S Hn.
  exact (@viewpoint_adapt_cap_weaken_insert C x G Go e Tf Tr H G ctx_empty eq_refl
           y vk S (@notin_dom_obj_l y G Go Hn) (@notin_empty var y)).
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_weaken_insert : forall x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros x G Go e Tf Tr H G1 G2 Heq y vk S H1 H2.
  unfold viewpoint_adapt in *.
  destruct (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' typing_mode); cbn in *.
  - exact H.
  - eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_weaken_insert; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_weaken : forall x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
    viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros x G Go e Tf Tr H y vk S Hn.
  exact (@viewpoint_adapt_weaken_insert x G Go e Tf Tr H G ctx_empty eq_refl
           y vk S (@notin_dom_obj_l y G Go Hn) (@notin_empty var y)).
Qed.

(** ** Context algebra helpers for typing weakening *)

Lemma ctx_obj_concat : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) (Go : objctx),
---

| ty_incap_fun G e S T:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶icp typ_fun S T

| ty_incap_nocap G e T:
    mode_incap' typing_mode = mode_incap_nocap ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_nocap <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp T
.

Global Existing Instance ty_var.

Global Existing Instance subtyp.

Global Existing Instance ty_incap.

Inductive ty_capbnd (C : typ_refcap_label) : CapabilityBound C :=
| ty_capbnd_top G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_top ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_bot G e:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_bot

| ty_capbnd_typ G e A S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_cap_sel G e S T:

    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T

| ty_capbnd_cap_ignore G e C' S T:
    C' <> C ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C') S T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_met G e m TC TZ TR:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_fld G e a T1 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_sel G e x B y S T T':
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y T) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T' ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) B (avar_f y) ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T'

| ty_capbnd_rec G e T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bnd T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

| ty_capbnd_and G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and S1 T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_and S2 T2

| ty_capbnd_or G e S1 T1 S2 T2:
    G⁏e ⊢ S1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ S2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S1 T1 ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_or S2 T2

| ty_capbnd_all G e S T:
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ typ_top

.

Global Existing Instance ty_capbnd.

Inductive viewpoint_adapt_cap: typ_refcap_label -> var -> (TypingProperty typ typ) :=
| viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine C x G Go e T Tstrip Tcap:
    G§§Go⁏e ⊢ T ∶icp Tstrip ->
    G§§Go⁏e ⊢ T ∶cpb⟦C⟧ Tcap ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap C x G Go e T (typ_and Tstrip (typ_cap_adapt C x Tcap)).

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=

  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty

  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev5 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Typing_subst Ctx_narrow.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Term-level context narrowing.

    We replace the type [Sh] of a binder [xh] by a subtype [W].  The binder
    occurs at the split [G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2], with [xh] fresh from
    [G1] and [G2].  The hypothesis [W <: Sh] is stated in the narrowed
    context.  The term-level induction is adapted from the insertion
    weakening proof [ty_weaken_insert_mut]; the extra objctx binders are
    handled by the same [ctx_met] decompositions. *)

(** ** Capability bounds and viewpoint adaptation *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_narrow : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub.
  - apply ty_capbnd_top.
  - apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - apply ty_capbnd_typ.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_sel.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_cap_ignore; eauto.
  - apply ty_capbnd_met.
  - apply ty_capbnd_fld.
  - (* sel *) eapply ty_capbnd_sel.
    + eapply (@ty_var_narrow typing_mode G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T)));
        eauto.
    + eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto.
  - apply ty_capbnd_rec.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_and; [ eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto | eapply IHty_capbnd0; eauto ].
  - eapply ty_capbnd_or; [ eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto | eapply IHty_capbnd0; eauto ].
  - apply ty_capbnd_all.
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_cap_narrow : forall C x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros C x G Go e Tf Tr H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub.
  eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine.
  - eapply (@ty_incap_narrow typing_mode G Go e T Tstrip); eauto.
  - eapply (@ty_capbnd_narrow C G Go e T Tcap); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_narrow : forall x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros x G Go e Tf Tr H G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub.
  unfold viewpoint_adapt in *.
  destruct (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' typing_mode); cbn in *.
  - exact H.
  - eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_narrow; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Freshness of objctx binders w.r.t. the narrowing split *)

Definition objctx_fresh (Go:objctx) (xh:var) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  xh \notin objctx_dom Go /\
  (forall y, y \in objctx_dom Go -> y \notin ctx_dom G).

Lemma objctx_fresh_empty : forall xh G,
  objctx_fresh objctx_empty xh G.
Proof. intros. split; [ cbn; auto | intros y Hy; cbn in Hy; rewrite in_empty in Hy; inversion Hy ]. Qed.

Lemma objctx_fresh_lit : forall x T xh G,
  x <> xh -> x \notin ctx_dom G ->
  objctx_fresh (objctx_lit x T) xh G.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - cbn. rewrite notin_singleton. auto.
  - intros y Hy. cbn in Hy. rewrite in_singleton in Hy. subst y. auto.
Qed.

Lemma objctx_fresh_heap : forall y T xh G,
  objctx_fresh (objctx_heap y T) xh G.
Proof. intros. split; [ cbn; auto | intros z Hz; cbn in Hz; rewrite in_empty in Hz; inversion Hz ]. Qed.

Lemma objctx_fresh_dom : forall Go xh G y,
  objctx_fresh Go xh G -> y \in objctx_dom Go -> y \notin ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. apply H. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma objctx_fresh_neq : forall Go xh G y,
  objctx_fresh Go xh G -> y \in objctx_dom Go -> y <> xh.
Proof.
  intros Go xh G y [Hx Hdom] Hy. intro E. subst y.
  apply Hx. exact Hy.
Qed.

(** Weakening the narrowing hypothesis across the objctx binders. *)

Lemma subtyp_weaken_objctx : forall G e W Sh Go,
  (forall y, y \in objctx_dom Go -> y \notin ctx_dom G) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e W Sh ->
  subtyp typing_mode (G §§& Go) objctx_empty e W Sh.
Proof.
  intros G e W Sh Go Hfresh Hsub.
  destruct Go as [|x T|y T]; cbn.
  - exact Hsub.
  - eapply (@subtyp_weaken_push typing_mode); [ exact Hsub | ].
    apply Hfresh. cbn. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - exact Hsub.
Qed.

(** Appending an objctx to a narrowed split. *)

Lemma split_objctx : forall (G1 G2:ctx) xh vkh Sh Go,
  (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2) §§& Go =
  G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& (G2 §§& Go).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (@ctx_obj_concat G1 G2 Go).
  rewrite <- ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes.

Notation typ_objref T S := (typ_and (typ_bnd T) S) (only parsing).

Notation typ_objref_loc typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => (typ_objref T typ_top)
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => (typ_objref T (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end)(only parsing).

Inductive refcap_inert_mutability: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=
| refacp_inert_mutability_loc: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) v_loc
| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

Notation obj_typ_is cond T S vk := (
      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

Notation fun_typ_is cond S T := (
      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

Notation fun_type U := (exists S T, fun_typ_is (eq U) S T) (only parsing).

Notation obj_type typing_mode U := (exists T S, obj_typ_is typing_mode (eq U) T S) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive inert_vk: varkind -> Prop :=
  | inert_vk_loc: inert_vk v_loc
  | inert_vk_ref: inert_vk v_ref.

Inductive inert_typ: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=

  | inert_typ_fun S T vk:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    fun_typ_is inert_typ S T vk

  | inert_typ_obj T S vk:
    obj_typ_is inert_typ T S vk.

Definition inert_type T := exists vk, inert_typ T vk.

Inductive inert: ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty: inert ctx_empty
  | inert_push G x vk T:
      inert G ->
      inert_vk vk ->
      inert_typ T vk ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      inert (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments inert [typing_mode].

Arguments inert_typ {typing_mode}.

Arguments inert_type {typing_mode}.

Inductive fresh_telescope : ctx -> Prop :=
  | fresh_telescope_empty : fresh_telescope ctx_empty
  | fresh_telescope_push : forall G x vk T,
      fresh_telescope G ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      fresh_telescope (G § x / vk ~ T).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.
=== RecordTypes
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

}.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Preservation, split into one obligation per operational rule.

    [red_let_push] is already proved in Dev5; the remaining hypotheses are the
    exact statements that the per-rule preservation proofs must establish. *)

Variable pres_let_var :
  forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_let_fun :
  forall (T:typ) (t1 t2:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
      (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open w t2 ; fs ; Sigma & y ~ item_fun t1 ; e & w ~ y ;
       fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_let_obj :
  forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
      (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open w t ; fs ;
       Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))) ; e & w ~ y ;
       fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_read :
  forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yVal wVal:var) ds fs U,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil)
      (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f wVal) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & wVal ~ yVal ;
       fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_write :
  forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yArg wArg:var) Sigma' fs U,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma' ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_call :
  forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (wArg:var) (t:trm) ds fs U,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_apply :
  forall (yFun wFun wArg:var) Sigma e Lv (t:trm) fs U,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open wArg t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Lemma preservation_from_rules : forall (c c':config) (U:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode c U -> c ↦ c' -> config_typd typing_mode c' U.
Proof.
  intros c c' U Htyp Hred. dependent destruction Hred.
  - eapply pres_let_var; eauto.
  - eapply pres_write; eauto.
  - eapply pres_call; eauto.
  - eapply pres_apply; eauto.
  - eapply pres_let_fun; eauto.
  - eapply pres_let_obj; eauto.
  - eapply pres_let_var; eauto.
  - (* red_let_push *)
    eapply config_typd_c.
    eapply preservation_let_push.
    inversion Htyp as [G0 c0 U0 Hcfg]; subst. exact Hcfg.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Defs_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** [red_let_push] changes the level set to the whole free-variable set of the
    old configuration.  Dev5 proves the same result with the old [Lv]; here we
    transport the freshness invariants along the equality of free variables. *)

Lemma fv_config_let_push_fv_eq : forall (t1 t2:trm) (s:stack) Sigma e Lv,
  fv_config (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
               fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))
  = fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
Proof.
  intros. cbn.
  apply fset_extens; intros z Hz;
    repeat rewrite in_union in *; intuition.
Qed.

Lemma preservation_let_push_fv : forall G (t1 t2:trm) (s:stack) (Sigma:heap) (e:renv) Lv U,
  ty_config G (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  ty_config G (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
                 fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros G t1 t2 s Sigma e Lv U Hcfg.
  inversion Hcfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_let_inv Hty) as [T1 [L [V [Ht1 [Hbody Hsub]]]]].
  assert (Hfv : fv_config
           (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
              fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))
         = fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
  { apply fv_config_let_push_fv_eq. }
  eapply (@ty_config_c typing_mode G e (stack_cons (frame_let t2) s) Sigma
            (fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) t1 T1 U).
  - apply Hir.
  - apply Hhc.
  - eapply ty_stack_let.
    + apply Hst.
    + intros x Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL HxG].
      eapply ty_trm_sub; [ apply (Hbody x HxL) | ].
      eapply subtyp_weaken_push; eauto.
  - apply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_let.
    + apply (@all_tfree_k_trm_let_r G v_ref t1 t2 Htf).
    + apply Hts.
  - apply Ht1.
  - apply (@all_tfree_k_trm_let_l G v_ref t1 t2 Htf).
  - split.
    + split.
      * rewrite Hfv. apply (proj1 (proj1 Hnf)).
      * apply (@nothing_fresh_eq_congr ctx CtxFreeVar G
                 (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
                 (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
                    fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))
                 Hfv (proj2 (proj1 Hnf))).
    + apply (@nothing_fresh_eq_congr typ TypFreeVar U
               (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
               (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
                  fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))
               Hfv (proj2 Hnf)).
  - destruct Hnull as [null Hnull]. exists null.
    rewrite Hfv. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union in *. auto.
  - apply Hsealed.
  - eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    + eapply closed_trm_let_l. apply Hct.
    + eapply closed_stack_cons_let; [apply Hct|apply Hcs].
    + apply Hch.
  - apply HcU.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma ty_trm_kind_change_top : forall G Go e (t:trm) T x vk1 vk2 S,
  ty_trm typing_mode (G § x / vk1 ~ S) Go e t T ->
  ty_trm typing_mode (G § x / vk2 ~ S) Go e t T.
Proof.
  intros. destruct ty_kind_mut as [HT _].
  exact (HT (G § x / vk1 ~ S) Go e t T H (G § x / vk2 ~ S)
           (@cke_push G G x vk1 vk2 S (cke_refl G))).
Qed.

  ty_trm typing_mode (G1 § x / vk2 ~ Tb §& G2) Go e t T.

  @ty_stack typing_mode G0 e0 T0 s0 U0 ->
  forall e', env_binds_more e0 e' -> @ty_stack typing_mode G0 e' T0 s0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G0 e0 T0 s0 U0 H.
  induction H as [G e T U Hsub| L G e s t S T U Htail IHtail Hbody]; intros e' Hee'.
  - eapply ty_stack_nil. exact (@subtyp_env_mono G objctx_empty e T U Hsub e' Hee').
  - eapply ty_stack_let with (L := L).
    + exact (IHtail e' Hee').
    + intros x Hx. exact (@ty_trm_env_mono typing_mode (G § x / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e
                           (open x t) T (Hbody x Hx) e' Hee').
Qed.

Lemma ty_stack_weaken_insert : forall G0 e0 T0 s0 U0,
  @ty_stack typing_mode G0 e0 T0 s0 U0 ->
  forall G1 G2 y vk S' e', G0 = G1 §& G2 ->
  y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 -> env_binds_more e0 e' ->
  @ty_stack typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S' §& G2) e' T0 s0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G0 e0 T0 s0 U0 H.
  induction H as [G e T U Hsub| L G e s t S T U Htail IHtail Hbody];
    intros G1 G2 y vk S' e' Heq Hy1 Hy2 Hee'.
  - (* nil *) subst G.
    destruct (@var_sub_incap_weaken_insert typing_mode) as [_ [Hsubw _]].
    pose proof (Hsubw (G1 §& G2) objctx_empty e T U Hsub G1 G2 eq_refl y vk S' Hy1 Hy2) as Hsub'.
    eapply ty_stack_nil. exact (@subtyp_env_mono (G1 § y / vk ~ S' §& G2) objctx_empty e T U Hsub' e' Hee').
  - (* cons *) subst G.
    eapply ty_stack_let with (L := L \u \{y}).
    + exact (IHtail G1 G2 y vk S' e' eq_refl Hy1 Hy2 Hee').
    + intros x Hx'. rewrite notin_union in Hx'. destruct Hx' as [Hx Hxy].
      rewrite notin_singleton in Hxy.
      assert (HnotY : y \notin ctx_dom ((G1 §& G2) §§& objctx_empty)).
      { cbn. apply (@notin_dom_concat y G1 G2); assumption. }
      assert (HnotYX : y \notin ctx_dom (((G1 §& G2) § x / v_let ~ S) §§& objctx_empty)).
      { cbn. apply (@notin_dom_push y (G1 §& G2) x v_let S HnotY).
        intro E. apply Hxy. symmetry. exact E. }
      assert (Heq' : ((G1 §& G2) § x / v_let ~ S) = G1 §& (G2 § x / v_let ~ S))
        by (exact (@ctx_push_decomp G1 G2 x v_let S)).
      destruct (@ty_weaken_insert_mut typing_mode) as [Htrm _].
      pose proof (Htrm ((G1 §& G2) § x / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open x t) T (Hbody x Hx)
                     G1 (G2 § x / v_let ~ S) Heq' y vk S' HnotYX) as Hty'.
      rewrite ctx_mid_push.
      exact (@ty_trm_env_mono typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S' §& (G2 § x / v_let ~ S))
                objctx_empty e (open x t) T Hty' e' Hee').
Qed.

Lemma ty_stack_weaken : forall G0 e0 T0 s0 U0,
  @ty_stack typing_mode G0 e0 T0 s0 U0 ->
  forall y vk S e', y \notin ctx_dom G0 -> env_binds_more e0 e' ->
  @ty_stack typing_mode (G0 § y / vk ~ S) e' T0 s0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G0 e0 T0 s0 U0 H y vk S e' Hy Hee'.
  refine (@ty_stack_weaken_insert G0 e0 T0 s0 U0 H G0 ctx_empty y vk S e' eq_refl Hy (@notin_empty var y) Hee').
Qed.

End WithTypingMode4.

     forall sx sy, swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
       subtyp typing_mode (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_objctx sx sy Go) e
         (swp_typ sx sy T) (swp_typ sx sy U))
  /\ (forall G Go e (T U:typ), ty_incap typing_mode G Go e T U ->
     forall sx sy, swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
