Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types Terms Envs.

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj: defs -> item
  | item_fun: trm -> item.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => (fv ds)
  | item_fun t => (fv t)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (open_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (open_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemOpenable : Openable item := open_rec_item.

Definition subst_item x y (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (subst_var x y ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (subst_var x y t)
  end.

Instance ItemSubstVar : SubstVar item := subst_item.

Instance ItemAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax ItemOpenable ItemFreeVar ItemSubstVar := {}.

Definition seal_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (seal_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (seal_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemSealable : Sealable item := seal_rec_item.

Definition collect_item {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (it: item) : C :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (collect df f comb ds)
  | item_fun t => (collect df f comb t)
  end.

Instance ItemCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_item.

Definition transform_item (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (it : item) (n : nat) : item :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (item_obj (transform f ds n))
  | item_fun t => (item_fun (transform f t (S n)))
---
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra Vars Terms Heap Env SyntaxClasses TransformCollect Bool.

Inductive frame : Set :=
  | frame_let : trm -> frame.

Inductive stack: Set :=
  | stack_nil: stack
  | stack_cons (f: frame) (fs: stack): stack
.

Fixpoint stack_length (fs : stack) : nat :=
  match fs with
  | stack_nil => 0
  | stack_cons _ fs' => (stack_length fs') + 1
  end.

Definition frame_fv fr := match fr with frame_let c => fv c end.

Instance FrameFreeVar : FreeVar frame := frame_fv.

Fixpoint stack_fv s: vars :=
  match s with
  | stack_nil => \{}
  | stack_cons f fs => (fv f) \u (@fv stack stack_fv fs)
  end.

Instance StackFreeVar : FreeVar stack := stack_fv.

Definition frame_subst_var x y fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (subst_var x y c) end.

Instance FrameSubstVar: SubstVar frame := frame_subst_var.

Fixpoint stack_subst_var x y st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (subst_var x y f) (@subst_var stack stack_subst_var x y fs)
  end.

Instance StackSubstVar: SubstVar stack := stack_subst_var.

Definition frame_open n x fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (open_rec n x c) end.

Instance FrameOpenable: Openable frame := frame_open.

Fixpoint stack_open n x st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (open_rec (S n) x f) (@open_rec stack stack_open n x fs)
  end.

Instance StackOpenable:  Openable stack := stack_open.

Instance FrameAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax FrameOpenable FrameFreeVar FrameSubstVar := {}.

Instance StackAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax StackOpenable StackFreeVar StackSubstVar := {}.

Definition collect_frame {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (fr: frame) : C :=
  match fr with
  | frame_let t => (collect df f comb t)
  end.

Instance FrameCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax FrameAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_frame.

Fixpoint collect_stack {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (st: stack) : C :=
  match st with
  | stack_nil => df
  | (stack_cons fr fs) => comb (collect df f comb fr) (@collect _ _ _ _ AvarAbstractSyntax _ _ _ _ StackAbstractSyntax (@collect_stack) C df f comb fs)
  end.

Instance StackCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax StackAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_stack.

Definition transform_frame (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (fr : frame) (n : nat) : frame :=
  match fr with
  | frame_let t => frame_let (transform f t n)
  end.

Instance FrameTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax FrameAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_frame.

Fixpoint transform_stack (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (st : stack) (n : nat) : stack :=
  match st with
  | stack_nil => stack_nil
  | (stack_cons fr fs) => (stack_cons (transform f fr (S n)) (@transform _ _ _ _ AvarAbstractSyntax _ _ _ _ StackAbstractSyntax transform_stack f fs n))
  end.

Instance StackTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax StackAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_stack.

Fixpoint stack_append (fs1 fs2: stack) :=
  match fs1 with
  | stack_nil => fs2
  | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons f (stack_append fs fs2)
  end.

Definition stack_suffix fs1 fs2 := exists fs3, fs2 = stack_append fs3 fs1.

Inductive ctx_vis: ctx -> var -> Prop :=

    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v2 vk t) v

  | trm_call a l b => trm_call (swp_avar sx sy a) l (swp_avar sx sy b)
  end
with swp_lit (sx sy:var) (l:lit) {struct l} : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t0 => lit_fun (swp_typ sx sy T) (swp_trm sx sy t0)
  | lit_obj T ds => lit_obj (swp_typ sx sy T) (swp_defs sx sy ds)
  end
with swp_def (sx sy:var) (d:def) {struct d} : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ l T => def_typ l (swp_typ sx sy T)
  | def_fld l a => def_fld l (swp_avar sx sy a)
  | def_met l t0 => def_met l (swp_trm sx sy t0)
  end
with swp_defs (sx sy:var) (ds:defs) {struct ds} : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons ds' d => defs_cons (swp_defs sx sy ds') (swp_def sx sy d)
  end.

Definition swp_item (sx sy:var) (it:item) : item :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (swp_defs sx sy ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (swp_trm sx sy t)
  end.

Definition swp_frame (sx sy:var) (fr:frame) : frame :=
  match fr with frame_let t => frame_let (swp_trm sx sy t) end.

Fixpoint swp_stack (sx sy:var) (st:stack) : stack :=
  match st with
  | stack_nil => stack_nil
  | stack_cons fr fs => stack_cons (swp_frame sx sy fr) (swp_stack sx sy fs)
  end.

(** Constructor equations. *)

Lemma swp_trm_var : forall sx sy (a:avar), swp_trm sx sy (trm_var a) = trm_var (swp_avar sx sy a).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_trm_read : forall sx sy (a:avar) l, swp_trm sx sy (trm_read a l) = trm_read (swp_avar sx sy a) l.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_trm_apply : forall sx sy (a b:avar), swp_trm sx sy (trm_apply a b) = trm_apply (swp_avar sx sy a) (swp_avar sx sy b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_trm_let : forall sx sy (t1 t2:trm), swp_trm sx sy (trm_let t1 t2) = trm_let (swp_trm sx sy t1) (swp_trm sx sy t2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_trm_lit : forall sx sy (l:lit) (t:trm), swp_trm sx sy (trm_lit l t) = trm_lit (swp_lit sx sy l) (swp_trm sx sy t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_trm_write : forall sx sy (a:avar) l (b:avar), swp_trm sx sy (trm_write a l b) = trm_write (swp_avar sx sy a) l (swp_avar sx sy b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_trm_call : forall sx sy (a:avar) l (b:avar), swp_trm sx sy (trm_call a l b) = trm_call (swp_avar sx sy a) l (swp_avar sx sy b).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_lit_fun : forall sx sy (T:typ) (t:trm), swp_lit sx sy (lit_fun T t) = lit_fun (swp_typ sx sy T) (swp_trm sx sy t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_lit_obj : forall sx sy (T:typ) (ds:defs), swp_lit sx sy (lit_obj T ds) = lit_obj (swp_typ sx sy T) (swp_defs sx sy ds).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_def_typ : forall sx sy l (T:typ), swp_def sx sy (def_typ l T) = def_typ l (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_def_fld : forall sx sy l (a:avar), swp_def sx sy (def_fld l a) = def_fld l (swp_avar sx sy a).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_def_met : forall sx sy l (t:trm), swp_def sx sy (def_met l t) = def_met l (swp_trm sx sy t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_defs_nil : forall sx sy, swp_defs sx sy (defs_nil:defs) = defs_nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_defs_cons : forall sx sy (ds:defs) (d:def), swp_defs sx sy (defs_cons ds d) = defs_cons (swp_defs sx sy ds) (swp_def sx sy d).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_item_obj : forall sx sy (ds:defs), swp_item sx sy (item_obj ds) = item_obj (swp_defs sx sy ds).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_item_fun : forall sx sy (t:trm), swp_item sx sy (item_fun t) = item_fun (swp_trm sx sy t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_frame_let : forall sx sy (t:trm), swp_frame sx sy (frame_let t) = frame_let (swp_trm sx sy t).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_stack_nil : forall sx sy, swp_stack sx sy (stack_nil:stack) = stack_nil.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_stack_cons : forall sx sy (fr:frame) (fs:stack), swp_stack sx sy (stack_cons fr fs) = stack_cons (swp_frame sx sy fr) (swp_stack sx sy fs).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Opening commutation for the term-level syntax. *)

Lemma swp_open_trm_mut :
  (forall (t:trm) sx sy n z, swp_trm sx sy (open_rec n z t) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_trm sx sy t))
  /\ (forall (l:lit) sx sy n z, swp_lit sx sy (open_rec n z l) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_lit sx sy l))
  /\ (forall (d:def) sx sy n z, swp_def sx sy (open_rec n z d) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_def sx sy d))
  /\ (forall (ds:defs) sx sy n z, swp_defs sx sy (open_rec n z ds) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_defs sx sy ds)).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind.
  - intros a sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_avar_open. reflexivity.
  - intros a l sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_avar_open. reflexivity.
  - intros a b sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_avar_open, swp_avar_open. reflexivity.
  - intros t1 IH1 t2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros l IHl t IHt sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IHl, IHt. reflexivity.
  - intros a l b sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_avar_open, swp_avar_open. reflexivity.
  - intros a l b sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_avar_open, swp_avar_open. reflexivity.
  - intros T t IH sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_typ_open, IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T ds IH sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_typ_open, IH. reflexivity.
  - intros l T sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_typ_open. reflexivity.
  - intros l a sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite swp_avar_open. reflexivity.
  - intros l t IH sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros sx sy n z. reflexivity.
  - intros ds IHd d IH sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IHd, IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_trm_open : forall (t:trm) sx sy n z,
  swp_trm sx sy (open_rec n z t) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_trm sx sy t).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 swp_open_trm_mut); auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_lit_open : forall (l:lit) sx sy n z,
  swp_lit sx sy (open_rec n z l) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_lit sx sy l).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 swp_open_trm_mut)); auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_def_open : forall (d:def) sx sy n z,
  swp_def sx sy (open_rec n z d) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_def sx sy d).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 swp_open_trm_mut))); auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_defs_open : forall (ds:defs) sx sy n z,
  swp_defs sx sy (open_rec n z ds) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_defs sx sy ds).
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 swp_open_trm_mut))); auto. Qed.

Lemma swp_item_open : forall (it:item) sx sy n z,
  swp_item sx sy (open_rec n z it) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_item sx sy it).
Proof. intros [ds|t] sx sy n z; cbn; [rewrite swp_defs_open|rewrite swp_trm_open]; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma swp_frame_open : forall (fr:frame) sx sy n z,
  swp_frame sx sy (open_rec n z fr) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_frame sx sy fr).
Proof. intros [t] sx sy n z; cbn; rewrite swp_trm_open; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma swp_stack_open : forall (st:stack) sx sy n z,
  swp_stack sx sy (open_rec n z st) = open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_stack sx sy st).
Proof.
  intros st. induction st as [|fr fs IH]; intros sx sy n z; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite swp_frame_open, IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)

(** ** Hiding/unhiding of contexts for the variable/subtyping/incap block.

Inductive hidable_rel : ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| hr_empty : hidable_rel ctx_empty ctx_empty
| hr_push : forall G G' x vk S,
    hidable_rel G G' -> hidable_rel (G § x / vk ~ S) (G' § x / vk ~ S)
| hr_stop : forall G G',
    hidable_rel G G' -> hidable_rel (ctx_stop G) (ctx_stop G')
| hr_hide_in : forall G G',
    hidable_rel G G' -> hidable_rel (ctx_hide G) G'
| hr_hide_out : forall G G',

Lemma hidable_refl : forall G, hidable_rel G G.
Proof.

  - apply hr_push. exact IHG.
  - apply hr_stop. exact IHG.
  - apply hr_hide_in. apply hr_hide_out. exact IHG.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Progress Preservation_split Reduction_to_PP.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The task target, reduced to (a) the three canonical-form interfaces used by
    progress and (b) the eight per-rule preservation obligations. *)

Theorem soundness_initial_from_canonical_and_preservation
  (canon_fun :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 S U,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_fun S U) ->
      mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
      exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
  (canon_fld :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
      exists y ds v, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                    defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)))
  (canon_met :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ->
      exists y ds t, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                    defs_has ds (def_met m t))
  (pres_let_push :
    forall (s t:trm) fs Sigma e Lv U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_let s t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (s ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_let s t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_var :
    forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_fun :
    forall (T:typ) (t1 t2:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
      fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
        (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
      y <> w ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open w t2 ; fs ; Sigma & y ~ item_fun t1 ; e & w ~ y ;
         fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_obj :
    forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
      fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
        (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
      w <> y ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open w t ; fs ;
         Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))) ; e & w ~ y ;
         fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_read :
    forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yVal wVal:var) ds fs U,
      fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil)
        (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
      binds wObj yObj e ->
      binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
      defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_var (avar_f wVal) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & wVal ~ yVal ;
         fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_write :
    forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yArg wArg:var) Sigma' fs U,
      heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
      binds wObj yObj e ->
      binds wArg yArg e ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_var (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma' ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_call :
    forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (wArg:var) (t:trm) ds fs U,
      binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
      defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
      binds wObj yObj e ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_apply :
    forall (yFun wFun wArg:var) Sigma e Lv (t:trm) fs U,
      binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
      binds wFun yFun e ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open wArg t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (t : trm) (T : typ):
  closed t -> closed T -> ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  exists C, (config_initial t C) /\
    ((exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)) \/
     (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C ⊣n↦* Cn)).
Proof.
  intros Hct HcT Hty.
  eapply soundness_initial_from_progress_preservation.
  - intros c Uc Hc.
    eapply progress_from_canon; eauto.
  - intros c c' Uc Hc Hr.
    eapply preservation_from_rules; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Selector-free subtyping.

    [subtyp_nosel] is the fragment of subtyping consisting of the rules that
    are available in the function modes and that do not use the selector
    rules [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].  In the function modes the additional
    top/nocap/mutability rules are disabled; the no-capability rules are
    included because [subtyp_nocap_fun] is enabled. *)

Inductive subtyp_nosel : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ns_top : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T typ_top
| ns_bot : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_bot T
| ns_refl : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T T
| ns_trans : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U
| ns_and11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) T
| ns_and12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) U
| ns_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S (typ_and T U)
| ns_or11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_or T U)
| ns_or12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e U (typ_or T U)
| ns_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_or S U) T
| ns_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U1 U2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ns_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ns_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ns_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    subtyp_nosel G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
     subtyp_nosel (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ns_tyq : forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2
| ns_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ns_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ns_nocap_bnd : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ns_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ns_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
.

Lemma subtyp_nosel_sound : forall G e S T,
  subtyp_nosel G e S T -> subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e S T H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - eapply subtyp_and2; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_or11.
  - apply subtyp_or12.
  - eapply subtyp_or2; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fld; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_typ; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fun; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_met; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_tyq; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_typ_and.
  - apply subtyp_dist.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_bnd.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_typ.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_fld.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_met.
  - eapply subtyp_nocap_fun; eassumption.
Qed.

(** * Two context-free "safe source" predicates. *)

Inductive NoFun : typ -> Prop :=
| nf_top : NoFun typ_top
| nf_bnd : forall T, NoFun (typ_bnd T)
| nf_and : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_and T U)
| nf_or_l : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun (typ_or T U)
| nf_or_r : forall T U, NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_or T U).

Inductive NoField : typ -> Prop :=
| nfield_top : NoField typ_top
| nfield_bnd : forall T, NoField (typ_bnd T)
| nfield_fun : forall S T, NoField (typ_fun S T)
| nfield_and : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField U -> NoField (typ_and T U)
| nfield_or_l : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField (typ_or T U)
| nfield_or_r : forall T U, NoField U -> NoField (typ_or T U).

Lemma NoFun_rcd_false : forall D, NoFun (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_fun_false : forall S T, NoFun (typ_fun S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_nocap_false : NoFun typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_sel_false : forall x A y, NoFun (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_bot_false : NoFun typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma NoField_rcd_false : forall D, NoField (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_nocap_false : NoField typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_sel_false : forall x A y, NoField (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_bot_false : NoField typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Equivalence preserves both safety predicates. *)

Lemma NoFun_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoFun T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoFun U.
Proof.
  intros e T U H. induction H; intros Heq;
    dependent destruction Heq; subst; try discriminate; eauto using nf_top, nf_bnd, nf_and, nf_or_l, nf_or_r.
Qed.

Lemma NoField_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoField T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoField U.
Proof.
  intros e T U H. induction H; intros Heq;
    dependent destruction Heq; subst; try discriminate; eauto using nfield_top, nfield_bnd, nfield_fun, nfield_and, nfield_or_l, nfield_or_r.
Qed.

(** * Closure of [NoFun] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoFun_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoFun T -> NoFun U.
Proof with eauto.
  intros G e T U H. induction H; intros Hnf...
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nf_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nf_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nf_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* fun *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_fun_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* tyq *) eapply NoFun_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst. inversion H.
  - (* dist *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply nf_or_l. apply nf_and; assumption.
    + apply nf_or_r. apply nf_and; assumption.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_typ *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fld *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_met *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fun *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Closure of [NoField] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoField_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoField T -> NoField U.
Proof with eauto.
  intros G e T U H. induction H; intros Hnf...
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoField_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nfield_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nfield_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nfield_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* tyq *) eapply NoField_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst. inversion H.
  - (* dist *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply nfield_or_l. apply nfield_and; assumption.
    + apply nfield_or_r. apply nfield_and; assumption.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fun *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Inert sources in function modes are either functions or [NoFun]/[NoField]. *)

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofun : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoFun T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nf_and; [apply nf_bnd|apply nf_top].
Qed.

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofield : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoField T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nfield_and; [apply nfield_bnd|apply nfield_top].
Qed.

(** * The selector-free canonical-form targets. *)

Lemma inert_subtyp_fun_nosel : forall G T vk S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G T vk S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofun T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hnf].
  - exists S0, U0; exact HT.
  - exfalso. apply (@NoFun_fun_false S U).
    eapply (@NoFun_subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U)); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_subtyp_not_field_nosel : forall G T vk a S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G T vk a S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofield T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hf].
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.
    pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S0 U0)
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub nfield_fun) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
  - pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e T
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub Hf) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
Qed.

(** * Method analogue of the record-label transport.

    The label of a method declaration is [label_met m]; the formal transport
    statement is recorded here.  [record_typ_has_label] and
    [Canonical.v]'s [defs_has_fld_of_label] give the field analogue; the
    method version needs the corresponding defs-to-method step below. *)

Lemma label_of_met_inv : forall (d:def) m,
  label_of d = label_met m -> exists t, d = def_met m t.
Proof.
  intros d m H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_met : forall G (ds:defs) m t,
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
  exists t', defs_has ds (def_met m t').
Proof. eauto. Qed.

Lemma defs_has_met_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T m,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall y (U:typ) ls,
    T = open y U -> record_typ U ls -> label_met m \in ls ->
    exists t, defs_has ds (def_met m t).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T m Hty y U ls HT Hrec Hlab. subst T.
  destruct (@ty_defs_record typing_mode G Go e ds (open y U) Hty) as [Hex Hinvs].
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as Hrec'.
  destruct (Hinvs ls Hrec' (label_met m) Hlab) as [d [Hhas Hlabel]].
  eapply label_of_met_inv in Hlabel. destruct Hlabel as [t Hd]. subst d.
  exists t. exact Hhas.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_obj_met_from_binding_label :
  forall G e Sigma x Tw (U:typ) S ls m,
  @heap_correspond typing_mode G e Sigma -> @inert typing_mode G ->
  ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  ctx_binds x Tw G -> Tw = typ_objref U S ->
  record_typ U ls -> label_met m \in ls ->
  exists y ds t, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                 defs_has ds (def_met m t).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Tw U S ls m Hhc Hinert Hk Bx HTw Hrec Hlab.
  destruct (@item_canonical typing_mode G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk) as
    [y [Tw' [Ty [Hbxy [Hydom [Bx' [Kky [Tcorr Hdisj]]]]]]]].
  assert (E : Tw' = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique;
    [eapply (@heap_correspond_ctx_ok typing_mode G e Sigma); exact Hhc | exact Bx' | exact Bx]).
  subst Tw'.
  destruct Hdisj as [[S0 [T0 [tf [Hmf [HTw' [HTy Bitem]]]]]]
                    |[U0 [S1 [S2 [ds [HTw' [HTy [Bitem [Hrec0 [Hds Hvk]]]]]]]]]].
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. discriminate HTw.
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. injection HTw as HU HS. subst U0.
    destruct Hrec0 as [ls0 Hrec0].
    assert (Hls : ls0 = ls) by (eapply record_typ_labels_eq; eassumption).
    subst ls0.
    destruct (@defs_has_met_of_label typing_mode G (objctx_heap y U) e ds (open y U) m
                Hds y U ls eq_refl Hrec Hlab) as [t Hhas].
    exists y, ds, t. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Bitem|exact Hhas].
Qed.

(** * Residual interface.

    The results above cover selector-free subtyping in the function modes.
    Extending [subtyp_nosel] to full [subtyp] requires eliminating
    [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].  The needed additional invariant is that,
    under an inert context, the upper bound [T] of any receiver typed at
    [typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)] is itself [NoFun] whenever the receiver's lower
    bound [S] is [NoFun]; this rules out the bad-bounds path of
    [Record_subtyp.v].  No such elimination is claimed here. *)

End WithTypingMode.

(** * Two context-free "safe source" predicates. *)

Inductive NoFun : typ -> Prop :=
| nf_top : NoFun typ_top
| nf_bnd : forall T, NoFun (typ_bnd T)
| nf_and : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_and T U)
| nf_or_l : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun (typ_or T U)
| nf_or_r : forall T U, NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_or T U).

Inductive NoField : typ -> Prop :=
| nfield_top : NoField typ_top
| nfield_bnd : forall T, NoField (typ_bnd T)
| nfield_fun : forall S T, NoField (typ_fun S T)
| nfield_and : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField U -> NoField (typ_and T U)
| nfield_or_l : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField (typ_or T U)
| nfield_or_r : forall T U, NoField U -> NoField (typ_or T U).

Lemma NoFun_rcd_false : forall D, NoFun (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_fun_false : forall S T, NoFun (typ_fun S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_nocap_false : NoFun typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_sel_false : forall x A y, NoFun (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_bot_false : NoFun typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma NoField_rcd_false : forall D, NoField (typ_rcd D) -> False.

Lemma NoField_nocap_false : NoField typ_nocap -> False.

Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Equivalence preserves both safety predicates. *)

Lemma NoFun_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoFun T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoFun U.
Proof.
  intros e T U H Ht. change (tyq_typ e T U) in Ht.
  revert U Ht. induction H; intros V Heq;
    dependent destruction Heq; subst; try discriminate;
    eauto using nf_top, nf_bnd, nf_and, nf_or_l, nf_or_r.
Qed.

Lemma NoField_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoField T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoField U.
Proof.

  revert U Ht. induction H; intros V Heq;
    dependent destruction Heq; subst; try discriminate;
    eauto using nfield_top, nfield_bnd, nfield_fun, nfield_and, nfield_or_l, nfield_or_r.
Qed.

(** * Closure of [NoFun] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoFun_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoFun T -> NoFun U.
Proof with eauto.
  intros G e T U H. induction H; intros Hnf...
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nf_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nf_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nf_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* fun *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_fun_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* tyq *) eapply NoFun_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst. inversion H.
  - (* dist *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply nf_or_l. apply nf_and; assumption.
    + apply nf_or_r. apply nf_and; assumption.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_typ *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fld *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_met *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fun *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Closure of [NoField] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoField_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoField T -> NoField U.
Proof with eauto.
  intros G e T U H. induction H; intros Hnf...
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoField_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nfield_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nfield_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nfield_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* tyq *) eapply NoField_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst. inversion H.
  - (* dist *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply nfield_or_l. apply nfield_and; assumption.
    + apply nfield_or_r. apply nfield_and; assumption.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fun *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Inert sources in function modes are either functions or [NoFun]/[NoField]. *)

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofun : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoFun T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nf_and; [apply nf_bnd|apply nf_top].
Qed.

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofield : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoField T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nfield_and; [apply nfield_bnd|apply nfield_top].
Qed.

(** * The selector-free canonical-form targets. *)

Lemma inert_subtyp_fun_nosel : forall G T vk S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G T vk S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofun T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hnf].
  - exists S0, U0; exact HT.
  - exfalso. apply (@NoFun_fun_false S U).
    eapply (@NoFun_subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U)); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_subtyp_not_field_nosel : forall G T vk a S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G T vk a S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofield T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hf].
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.
    pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S0 U0)
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub nfield_fun) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
  - pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e T
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub Hf) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
Qed.

Lemma label_of_met_inv : forall (d:def) m,
  label_of d = label_met m -> exists t, d = def_met m t.

(** * Closure of [NoField] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoField_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoField T -> NoField U.
Proof with eauto.
  intros G e T U H. induction H; intros Hnf...
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoField_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nfield_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nfield_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nfield_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.

  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst. inversion H.

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofun : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoFun T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nf_and; [apply nf_bnd|apply nf_top].
Qed.

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofield : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoField T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nfield_and; [apply nfield_bnd|apply nfield_top].
Qed.

(** * The selector-free canonical-form targets. *)

Lemma inert_subtyp_fun_nosel : forall G T vk S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G T vk S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofun T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hnf].
  - exists S0, U0; exact HT.
  - exfalso. apply (@NoFun_fun_false S U).
    eapply (@NoFun_subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U)); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_subtyp_not_field_nosel : forall G T vk a S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G T vk a S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofield T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hf].
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.

                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub nfield_fun) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
  - pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e T
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub Hf) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Small independent facts *)

Lemma ty_stack_input_sub : forall G e (T:typ) s U,
  @ty_stack typing_mode G e T s U ->
  forall V, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V T ->
  @ty_stack typing_mode G e V s U.
Proof.
  intros G e T s U H. induction H as
    [G0 e0 T0 U0 Hsub|L G0 e0 s0 t0 S0 T0 U0 Htail IH Hbody];
    intros V HVT.
  - eapply ty_stack_nil. eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - eapply ty_stack_let; [exact Htail | exact Hbody].
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_fun_mode : forall G e (T:typ) (tf:trm) U,
  @ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_fun T tf) U ->
  mode_has_fun typing_mode.
Proof.
  intros. dependent destruction H. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_two_inv : forall (F:fset var) y w,
  fresh F 2 (y :: w :: nil) -> y \notin F /\ w \notin F.
Proof.
  intros F y w H. unfold fresh in H. cbn in H.
  destruct H as [Hy [Hw _]]. split; [exact Hy|].
  rewrite notin_union in Hw. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_open_zero_below : forall (t:trm) x,
  closed_below 1 t -> closed (open x t).
Proof.
  intros t x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite trm_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@trm_open_commut t (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping ConfigTyping.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The input type of a non-empty stack is the type expected of the let value;
    it is not constrained by the body of the frame.  Consequently it may be
    replaced by any subtype (and, for a non-empty stack, by any type at all;
    we only need the subtype version). *)

Lemma ty_stack_input_sub : forall G e T (s:stack) U,
  @ty_stack typing_mode G e T s U ->
  forall V, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V T ->
    @ty_stack typing_mode G e V s U.
Proof.
  intros G e T s U H. induction H as [G0 e0 T0 U0 Hsub|L G0 e0 s0 t S T0 U0 Htail IHtail Hbody];
    intros V HVT.
  - eapply ty_stack_nil. eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - eapply ty_stack_let with (L := L).
    + exact Htail.
    + exact Hbody.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Heap_fun Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Preservation_split Env_set.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Small independent facts *)

Lemma ty_lit_fun_mode : forall G e (T:typ) (tf:trm) U,
  @ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_fun T tf) U ->
  mode_has_fun typing_mode.
Proof.
  intros. dependent destruction H. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_two_inv : forall (F:fset var) y w,
  fresh F 2 (y :: w :: nil) -> y \notin F /\ w \notin F.
Proof.
  intros F y w H. unfold fresh in H. cbn in H.
  destruct H as [Hy [Hw _]]. split; [exact Hy|].
  rewrite notin_union in Hw. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_open_zero_below : forall (t:trm) x,
  closed_below 1 t -> closed (open x t).
Proof.
  intros t x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite trm_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@trm_open_commut t (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

(** * A label invariant for method records.

    [LabelsIn ls T] over-approximates the method labels that can be exposed
    at the top level by selector-free subtyping from a type built out of
    record components with those labels.  The record components with
    [dec_typ]/[dec_fld] labels impose no constraint on [ls]; only top-level
    [dec_met] labels are tracked. *)

Inductive LabelsIn (ls:fset label) : typ -> Prop :=
| li_rcd_fld : forall a T1 T2, LabelsIn ls (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| li_rcd_typ : forall A T1 T2, LabelsIn ls (typ_rcd (dec_typ A T1 T2))
| li_rcd_met : forall m TC TZ TR,
    label_met m \\in ls -> LabelsIn ls (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR))
| li_and : forall T U,
    LabelsIn ls T -> LabelsIn ls U -> LabelsIn ls (typ_and T U)
| li_or_l : forall T U,
    LabelsIn ls T -> LabelsIn ls (typ_or T U)
| li_or_r : forall T U,
    LabelsIn ls U -> LabelsIn ls (typ_or T U)
| li_top : LabelsIn ls typ_top
| li_bnd : forall T, LabelsIn ls (typ_bnd T)
| li_fun : forall S T, LabelsIn ls (typ_fun S T).

Lemma LabelsIn_mono : forall ls ls' T,
  LabelsIn ls T -> ls \\c ls' -> LabelsIn ls' T.
Proof.
  intros ls ls' T H. induction H; intros Hsub.
  - apply li_rcd_fld.
  - apply li_rcd_typ.
  - apply li_rcd_met. apply Hsub. exact H.
  - apply li_and; auto.
  - apply li_or_l; auto.
  - apply li_or_r; auto.
  - apply li_top.
  - apply li_bnd.
  - apply li_fun.
Qed.

Lemma LabelsIn_equiv : forall e ls T U,
  LabelsIn ls T -> typing_equiv e T U -> LabelsIn ls U.
Proof.

  revert HLI. induction Heq; intros HLI.
  - exact HLI.
  - (* andor *) dependent destruction H.

  - (* fld *) apply li_rcd_fld.
  - (* typ *) apply li_rcd_typ.
  - (* sel normal *) inversion HLI.
  - (* sel *) inversion HLI.
  - (* bnd *) apply li_bnd.
  - (* met *) inversion HLI; subst. apply li_rcd_met; assumption.

  record_typ U ls -> LabelsIn ls (open x U).

  record_typ U ls ->

                (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) Hsub HLI) as Htarget.
  inversion Htarget; subst. assumption.

Definition closed_below (d:nat) {A:Set} {AS:Openable A} (a:A) :=
  forall n x, d <= n -> open_rec n x a = a.

Lemma closed_below_zero : forall {A} {AS:Openable A} (a:A),
  closed a <-> closed_below 0 a.
Proof.
  intros A AS a. split; intros H.
  - intros n x Hn. apply H.
  - intros n x. apply (H n x). apply Nat.le_0_l.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_open_zero : forall (t:trm) x,
  closed_below 1 t -> closed (open_rec 0 x t).
Proof.
  intros t x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite trm_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@trm_open_commut t (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_let_l : forall t1 t2, closed (trm_let t1 t2) -> closed t1.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_let in H.
  injection H as H1 H2. exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_let_body_below : forall t1 t2, closed (trm_let t1 t2) -> closed_below 1 t2.
Proof.
  intros t1 t2 H n x Hn. destruct n as [|n']; [inversion Hn|].
  specialize (H n' x). rewrite open_trm_let in H. injection H as H1 H2. exact H2.

Definition closed_below (d:nat) {A:Set} {AS:Openable A} (a:A) :=
  forall n x, d <= n -> open_rec n x a = a.

Lemma closed_below_zero : forall {A} {AS:Openable A} (a:A),
  closed a <-> closed_below 0 a.
Proof.
  intros A AS a. split; intros H.
  - intros n x Hn. apply H.
  - intros n x. apply (H n x). apply Nat.le_0_l.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Ctx_term_narrow.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma all_tfree_k_stack_cons_tail : forall G vk f (fs:stack),
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G (stack_cons f fs) vk ->
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G fs vk.
Proof.
  intros G vk f fs H v Hv. eapply H. eapply tfree_stack_cons_r. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_stack_cons_frame : forall G vk (t:trm) fs,
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs) vk ->
  @all_tfree_k trm _ G t vk.
Proof.
  intros G vk t fs H v Hv. eapply H. eapply tfree_stack_cons_l. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma fv_config_old_subset_new_let_var : forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv x fs,
  fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
  \c fv_config (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
Proof.
  intros. intros z Hz. cbn in *. repeat rewrite in_union in *.
  tauto.
Qed.

(** The variable-for-variable opening step: instantiating the cofinite body
    premise at the runtime name [x], using [x]'s direct type [T0] and
    [T0 <: S].  This is the single residual lemma isolated by
    Ctx_term_narrow.v; once the typing-swap/renaming library supplies it,
    preservation for [red_let_var] is complete here. *)

Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

Lemma pres_let_var_rule : forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
  config_typd typing_mode
    (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  config_typd typing_mode
    (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
     fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros t Sigma e Lv x fs U Hcfg.
  inversion Hcfg as [G c0 Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  inversion Hst as [G1 e1 T1 U1 Hsubnil|Lst G1 e1 s1 t1 Sframe Tbody U1 Htail Hbody];
    subst.
  - (* empty stack: impossible, the current term is a variable and would be an answer *) admit.
  - (* frame_let *)
    destruct (ty_trm_var_inv Hty) as [T0 [Htyvar Hsub]].
    assert (Hclosedx : closed (avar_f x))
      by (eapply closed_trm_var_avar; exact Hct).
    assert (Hclosedt : closed_below 1 t)
      by (eapply closed_stack_cons_frame_below; exact Hcs).
    eapply config_typd_c.
    eapply (@ty_config_c typing_mode G e fs Sigma
              (fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))
              (open x t) Tbody U0).
    + apply Hir.
    + apply Hhc.
    + apply Htail.
    + eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_tail. exact Hts.
    + eapply open_body_at_bound.
      * intros z Hz. exact (Hbody z Hz).
      * exact Htyvar.
      * exact Hsub.
    + (* all_tfree_k of the opened body *)
      assert (Htf_body : @all_tfree_k trm _ G t v_ref)
        by (eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_frame; exact Hts).
      assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref).
      { eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_var. }
      eapply all_tfree_k_trm_open; eassumption.
    + (* freshness invariant *)
      destruct Hnf as [[Hdom HfvG] HfvU].
      assert (Hsubfv : fv_config
        (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
        \c fv_config (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
             fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)))
        by (apply fv_config_old_subset_new_let_var).
      split.
      * split.
        -- intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply Hdom. exact Hz.
        -- intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply HfvG. exact Hz.
      * intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply HfvU. exact Hz.
    + (* has_null *)
      destruct Hnull as [null Hnull]. exists null.
      apply fv_config_old_subset_new_let_var.
      cbn. repeat rewrite in_union. right; right; right; right; exact Hnull.
    + apply Hsealed.
    + (* config_closed *)
      eapply config_sealed_cfg.
      * apply closed_trm_open_zero. exact Hclosedt.
      * eapply closed_stack_cons_stack. exact Hcs.
      * apply Hch.
    + apply HcU.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Ctx_term_narrow.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma all_tfree_k_stack_cons_tail : forall G vk f (fs:stack),
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G (stack_cons f fs) vk ->
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G fs vk.
Proof.
  intros G vk f fs H v Hv. eapply H. eapply tfree_stack_cons_r. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_stack_cons_frame : forall G vk (t:trm) fs,
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs) vk ->
  @all_tfree_k trm _ G t vk.
Proof.
  intros G vk t fs H v Hv. eapply H. eapply tfree_stack_cons_l. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma fv_config_old_subset_new_let_var : forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv x fs,
  fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
  \c fv_config (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
Proof.
  intros. intros z Hz. cbn in *. repeat rewrite in_union in *.
  tauto.
Qed.

(** The variable-for-variable opening step: instantiating the cofinite body
    premise at the runtime name [x], using [x]'s direct type [T0] and
    [T0 <: S].  This is the single residual lemma isolated by
    Ctx_term_narrow.v; once the typing-swap/renaming library supplies it,
    preservation for [red_let_var] is complete here. *)

Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

Lemma pres_let_var_rule : forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
  config_typd typing_mode
    (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  config_typd typing_mode
    (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
     fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros t Sigma e Lv x fs U Hcfg.
  inversion Hcfg as [G c0 Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  inversion Hst as [G1 e1 T1 U1 Hsubnil|Lst G1 e1 s1 t1 Sframe Tbody U1 Htail Hbody];
    subst.
  - (* frame_let *)
    destruct (ty_trm_var_inv Hty) as [T0 [Htyvar Hsub]].
    assert (Hclosedframe : closed_below 1 (frame_let t))
      by (eapply closed_stack_cons_frame_below; exact Hcs).
    assert (Hclosedt : closed_below 1 t)
      by (eapply closed_frame_let_body_below; exact Hclosedframe).
    eapply config_typd_c.
    eapply (@ty_config_c typing_mode G e fs Sigma
              (fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))
              (open x t) Tbody U).
    + apply Hir.
    + apply Hhc.
    + apply Htail.
    + eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_tail. exact Hts.
    + eapply open_body_at_bound.
      * intros z Hz. exact (Hbody z Hz).
      * exact Htyvar.
      * exact Hsub.
    + (* all_tfree_k of the opened body *)
      assert (Htf_body : @all_tfree_k trm _ G t v_ref)
        by (eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_frame; exact Hts).
      assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref).
      { eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_var. }
      eapply all_tfree_k_trm_open; eassumption.
    + (* freshness invariant *)
      destruct Hnf as [[Hdom HfvG] HfvU].
      assert (Hsubfv : fv_config
        (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
        \c fv_config (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
             fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)))
        by (apply fv_config_old_subset_new_let_var).
      split.
      * split.
        -- intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply Hdom. exact Hz.
        -- intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply HfvG. exact Hz.
      * intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply HfvU. exact Hz.
    + (* has_null *)
      destruct Hnull as [null Hnull]. exists null.
      cbn. repeat rewrite in_union in *. tauto.
    + apply Hsealed.
    + (* config_closed *)
      eapply config_sealed_cfg.
      * apply closed_trm_open_zero. exact Hclosedt.
      * eapply closed_stack_cons_stack. exact Hcs.
      * apply Hch.
    + apply HcU.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Section SoundnessTyped.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** A "typed progress" theorem suffices for the task's dichotomy: at each step
    we may choose a successor which is itself typable, so no preservation for
    arbitrary operational steps is required. *)

Lemma soundness_via_typed_progress : forall (C0:config) (U:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode C0 U ->
  (forall (c:config) (T:typ), config_typd typing_mode c T ->
     answer c \/
     (exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' T /\ c ↦ c')) ->
  (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca) \/
  (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C0 ⊣n↦* Cn).
Proof.
  intros C0 U Hinit Hprog.
  destruct (classic (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config),
              answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca)) as [Hterm|Hnonterm].
  - left. exact Hterm.
  - right. intro n.
    assert (Haux : forall (k:nat), exists Ck:config,
              config_typd typing_mode Ck U /\ C0 ⊣k↦* Ck).
    { induction k as [|k [Ck [Htyp Hreach]]].
      - exists C0. split; [exact Hinit|apply red_refl].
      - destruct (Hprog Ck U Htyp) as [HA|HS].
        + exfalso. apply Hnonterm. exists k, Ck. split; assumption.
        + destruct HS as [Ck' [Htyp' Hstep]].
          exists Ck'. split; [exact Htyp'|].
          eapply red_trans; eassumption. }
    destruct (Haux n) as [Cn [_ Hreach]]. exists Cn. exact Hreach.
Qed.

End SoundnessTyped.

  (Hprogress : forall (c:config) (U:typ),
     config_typd typing_mode c U ->

     (exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\ c ↦ c'))

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Heap_lookup Context_lemmas Env_set Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_var Preservation_let_push_config.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The variable-substitution opening residual exported by Preservation_let_var. *)
Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

(** Per-term-shape typed progress obligations. *)

Variable tp_read :
  forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_write :
  forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_call :
  forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_apply :
  forall (x z:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_lit :
  forall (l:lit) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

(** * Typed progress. *)

Lemma typed_progress : forall (c:config) (U:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode c U ->
  answer c \/
  (exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\ c ↦ c').
Proof.
  intros c U Hcfg. destruct c as [t s Sigma e Lv].
  inversion Hcfg as [G c0 Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct t as [a|a m|a b|t1 t2|l t2|a m b|a m b].
  - (* trm_var *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_var_avar (a:=avar_b n) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct s as [|f fs].
      * left. apply nf_loc.
      * destruct f as [t0]. right.
        exists (open x t0 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
                  fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t0) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        split.
        -- eapply (@pres_let_var_rule typing_mode open_body_at_bound); eauto.
        -- apply red_let_var.
  - (* trm_read *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_read_avar (a:=avar_b n) (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + right. eapply tp_read. eauto.
  - (* trm_apply *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_l Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|z].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_r Hct)) as [y E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_apply. eauto.
  - (* trm_let *)
    right.
    exists (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
              fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    split.
    + eapply pres_let_push_config. eapply config_typd_c. eapply Htycfg.
    + apply red_let_push.
  - (* trm_lit *)
    right. eapply tp_lit. eauto.
  - (* trm_write *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_l (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_r Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_write. eauto.
  - (* trm_call *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_l (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_r Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_call. eauto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Heap_lookup Context_lemmas Env_set Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_var Preservation_let_push_config.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The variable-substitution opening residual exported by Preservation_let_var. *)
Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

(** Per-term-shape typed progress obligations. *)

Variable tp_read :
  forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_write :
  forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_call :
  forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_apply :
  forall (x z:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_lit :
  forall (l:lit) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

(** * Typed progress. *)

Lemma typed_progress : forall (c:config) (U:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode c U ->
  answer c \/
  (exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\ c ↦ c').
Proof.
  intros c U Hcfg. destruct c as [t s Sigma e Lv].
  inversion Hcfg as [G c0 Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct t as [a|a m|a b|t1 t2|l t2|a m b|a m b].
  - (* trm_var *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_var_avar (a:=avar_b n) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct s as [|f fs].
      * left. apply nf_loc.
      * destruct f as [t0]. right.
        exists (open x t0 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
                  fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t0) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        split.
        -- eapply (@pres_let_var_rule typing_mode open_body_at_bound); eauto.
        -- apply red_let_var.
  - (* trm_read *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_read_avar (a:=avar_b n) (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + right. eapply tp_read. eauto.
  - (* trm_apply *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_l Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|z].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_r Hct)) as [y E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_apply. eauto.
  - (* trm_let *)
    right.
    exists (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
              fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    split.
    + eapply pres_let_push_config. eapply config_typd_c. eapply Htycfg.
    + apply red_let_push.
  - (* trm_lit *)
    right. eapply tp_lit. eauto.
  - (* trm_write *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_l (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_r Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_write. eauto.
  - (* trm_call *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_l (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_r Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_call. eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.
Require Import Typed_progress Reduction_typed.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Exact task target from the six typed-progress obligations. *)

Theorem soundness_initial_from_typed_progress_obligations
  (open_body_at_bound :
    forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
      (forall z, z \notin L ->
         ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
      ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody)
  (tp_read :
    forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_write :
    forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_call :
    forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_apply :
    forall (x z:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_lit :
    forall (l:lit) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (t : trm) (T : typ):
  closed t -> closed T -> ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  exists C, (config_initial t C) /\
    ((exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)) \/
     (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C ⊣n↦* Cn)).
Proof.
  intros Hct HcT Hty.
  eapply soundness_initial_from_typed_progress.
  - exact (@typed_progress typing_mode open_body_at_bound tp_read tp_write
             tp_call tp_apply tp_lit).
  - exact Hct.
  - exact HcT.
  - exact Hty.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Require Import Dev5 Typing_weaken Ctx_term_narrow.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The input type of a stack may be replaced by a subtype.  In a cons frame
    the input type is the type of the let value, which is also the type of the
    frame's bound variable; the body is transported by term narrowing. *)

Lemma ty_stack_input_sub : forall G e T (s:stack) U,
  @ty_stack typing_mode G e T s U ->
  forall V, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V T ->
    @ty_stack typing_mode G e V s U.
Proof.
  intros G e T s U H. induction H as
    [G0 e0 T0 U0 Hsub|L G0 e0 s0 t S T0 U0 Htail IHtail Hbody];
    intros V HVT.
  - eapply ty_stack_nil. eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - eapply ty_stack_let with (L := L \u ctx_dom G0).
    + exact Htail.
    + intros y Hy. rewrite notin_union in Hy. destruct Hy as [HyL HyG].
      eapply (@ty_trm_narrow_empty typing_mode).
      * eapply Hbody. exact HyL.
      * reflexivity.
      * exact HyG.
      * apply notin_empty.
      * eapply subtyp_weaken_push; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

    the receiver's interval [lower <: Q <: upper] through
    [ty_rec_elim]/[ty_var_sub].  Consequently the full statements'''
