Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Heap_lookup Context_lemmas Env_set Heap_fun Ctx_narrow Ctx_term_narrow Stack_extra Typed_progress.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Extending heap correspondence by one read value. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_extend_read : forall G e Sigma w v Ty Tw,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  ctx_k G v v_loc -> ctx_binds v Ty G ->
  typ_corr Tw Ty -> inert_typ Tw v_ref ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> w \notin dom e ->
  heap_correspond (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w v Ty Tw Hhc Hkv Hbyv Hcorr Hity HwG Hwe.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (HwdomG : w \notin ctx_dom G) by exact HwG.
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ v)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply Hwe. subst a. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  split.
  - eapply ctx_ok_push; eauto.
  - split.
    + eapply ctx_weakens_push. exact Hwk.
    + split.
      * exact Hoks.
      * split.
        -- eapply ok_push; [exact Hoke|exact Hwe].
        -- split.
           ++ (* ctx_kdom v_loc *) cbn.
              assert (Hneq : v_loc <> v_ref) by (intro E; discriminate).
              rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_neq v_loc v_ref G w Tw Hneq).
              exact Hds.
           ++ split.
              ** (* ctx_kdom v_ref *) cbn.
                 rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_eq v_ref G w Tw).
                 rewrite Hde. rewrite dom_push.
                 apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
                 repeat rewrite in_union in *. repeat rewrite in_singleton in *.
                 tauto.
              ** split.
                 --- (* renv_corr *)
                   destruct (@ctx_k_binds_k_after typing_mode G v v_loc Hkv) as [Ty0 [G2 Hka]].
                   assert (HETy : Ty0 = Ty).
                   { eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok| |exact Hbyv].
                     eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka. }
                   subst Ty0.
                   assert (Hrenv' : renv_corr (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) e).
                   { eapply renv_corr_push; [exact Hrenv|exact HwG]. }
                   eapply (renv_corr_ref (G1 := G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (G2 := G) (G3 := G2)
                                        (Tw := Tw) (Ty := Ty)).
                   +++ eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
                   +++ exact Hka.
                   +++ exact Hcorr.
                   +++ exact Hrenv'.
                 --- (* items *)
                   intros z Hz.
                   unfold ty_item_s in *.
                   eapply (@ty_item_s_weaken_push typing_mode G e Sigma z w v_ref Tw
                             (e & w ~ v) Sigma);
                     [ exact (Hitem z Hz) | exact HwG | exact Hee' |
                       intros z0 it Hb; exact Hb ].
Qed.

(** * Interface for the field value read by [trm_read]. *)

Variable canon_fld_read :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U V Tstack (c:config),
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G ->

  typ_corr Tw Ty -> inert_typ Tw v_ref ->

  heap_correspond (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Sigma.

  intros G e Sigma w v Ty Tw Hhc Hkv Hbyv Hcorr Hity HwG Hwe.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ v)).

    + eapply ctx_weakens_push. exact Hwk.

      * exact Hoks.

                   subst Ty0.
                   assert (Hrenv' : renv_corr (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) e).

                   eapply (renv_corr_ref (G1 := G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (G2 := G) (G3 := G2)
                                        (Tw := Tw) (Ty := Ty)).
                   +++ eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
                   +++ exact Hka.
                   +++ exact Hcorr.
                   +++ exact Hrenv'.
                 --- intros z Hz.
                   eapply (@ty_item_s_weaken_push typing_mode G e Sigma z w v_ref Tw
                             (e & w ~ v) Sigma);

                       intros z0 it Hb; exact Hb ].

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Heap_lookup Context_lemmas Env_set Heap_fun Ctx_narrow Ctx_term_narrow Stack_extra Typed_progress.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Extending heap correspondence by one read value. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_extend_read : forall G e Sigma w v Ty Tw,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  ctx_k G v v_loc -> ctx_binds v Ty G ->
  typ_corr Tw Ty -> inert_typ Tw v_ref ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> w \notin dom e ->
  heap_correspond (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Sigma.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w v Ty Tw Hhc Hkv Hbyv Hcorr Hity HwG Hwe.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (HwdomG : w \notin ctx_dom G) by exact HwG.
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ v)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply Hwe. subst a. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  split.
  - eapply ctx_ok_push; eauto.
  - split.
    + eapply ctx_weakens_push. exact Hwk.
    + split.
      * exact Hoks.
      * split.
        -- eapply ok_push; [exact Hoke|exact Hwe].
        -- split.
           ++ (* ctx_kdom v_loc *) cbn.
              assert (Hneq : v_loc <> v_ref) by (intro E; discriminate).
              rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_neq v_loc v_ref G w Tw Hneq).
              exact Hds.
           ++ split.
              ** (* ctx_kdom v_ref *) cbn.
                 rewrite (@ctx_kdom_push_eq v_ref G w Tw).
                 rewrite Hde. rewrite dom_push.
                 apply fset_extens. intros z Hz.
                 repeat rewrite in_union in *. repeat rewrite in_singleton in *.
                 tauto.
              ** split.
                 --- (* renv_corr *)
                   destruct (@ctx_k_binds_k_after typing_mode G v v_loc Hkv) as [Ty0 [G2 Hka]].
                   assert (HETy : Ty0 = Ty).
                   { eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok| |exact Hbyv].
                     eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka. }
                   subst Ty0.
                   assert (Hrenv' : renv_corr (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) e).
                   { eapply renv_corr_push; [exact Hrenv|exact HwG]. }
                   eapply (renv_corr_ref (G1 := G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (G2 := G) (G3 := G2)
                                        (Tw := Tw) (Ty := Ty)).
                   +++ eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
                   +++ exact Hka.
                   +++ exact Hcorr.
                   +++ exact Hrenv'.
                 --- (* items *)
                   intros z Hz.
                   unfold ty_item_s in *.
                   eapply (@ty_item_s_weaken_push typing_mode G e Sigma z w v_ref Tw
                             (e & w ~ v) Sigma);
                     [ exact (Hitem z Hz) | exact HwG | exact Hee' |
                       intros z0 it Hb; exact Hb ].
Qed.

(** * Interface for the field value read by [trm_read]. *)

Variable canon_fld_read :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U V Tstack (c:config),
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G ->
    ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
    exists y ds v Ty Tw,
      binds x y e /\
      binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
      defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
      ctx_k G v v_loc /\
      ctx_binds v Ty G /\
      typ_corr Tw Ty /\
      inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
      sealed Tw /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack /\
      (fv Tw) \c fv_config c.

(** * Typed progress for [trm_read]. *)

Lemma tp_read_from_canon : forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros x m Sigma e Lv fs U Hcfg.
  set (cold := trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  inversion Hcfg as [G c0 Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref).
  { eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_read. }
  destruct (ty_trm_read_inv Hty) as [S [Tfld [V [Hxread [Hder Hs]]]]].
  destruct (ty_var_sub_elim Hxread) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
  destruct (@canon_fld_read G e Sigma x T0 m S Tfld V Tstack
              (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
              Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub Hs)
    as [y [ds [v [Ty [Tw [Hbxy [Hby [Hhas [Hkv [Hbyv [Hcorr [Hity [HsealedTw [HTwT [HfvTw]]]]]]]]]]]]]]].
  assert (Hfvold_new : fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
         \c fv_config (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ;
              fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))) as Hfvsub.
  { intros z Hz. cbn in *. repeat rewrite in_union in *. tauto. }
Abort.

End WithTypingMode.

(** Cofinite-opening interface: once a fresh comparison name [z] is chosen,
    the swap lemma reduces opening at an arbitrary runtime name [x] to the
    four syntactic fixed-point equations below. *)
Lemma ty_trm_open_swap : forall G Go e vk S L (t:trm) T x z,
  (forall y, y \notin L ->
     ty_trm typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e (open y t) T) ->
  z \notin L ->
  swp_renv_fixed z x e ->
  swp_ctx z x (G § z / vk ~ S) = (G § x / vk ~ S) ->
  swp_objctx z x Go = Go ->
  swp_trm z x (open z t) = open x t ->
  swp_typ z x T = T ->
  ty_trm typing_mode (G § x / vk ~ S) Go e (open x t) T.
Proof.
  intros G Go e vk S L t T x z Hbody HzL Hf Hctx Hgo Htrm Htyp.
  pose proof (@ty_trm_swp (G § z / vk ~ S) Go e (open z t) T
                (Hbody z HzL) z x Hf) as Hs.
  rewrite Hctx, Hgo, Htrm, Htyp in Hs. exact Hs.
Qed.

'''
s=s[:idx]+add+s[idx:]
open(p,'w').write(s)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Subst_extra Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Kind_env_stack Typing_subst.

(** * A true variable swap on the syntax.  Unlike [subst_var], this is a
    bijection on free names, so it commutes with opening at every name. *)

Definition swp_var (sx sy z: var) : var :=
  If z = sx then sy else If z = sy then sx else z.

Definition swp_avar (sx sy : var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => avar_b i
  | avar_f z => avar_f (swp_var sx sy z)
  end.

Fixpoint swp_typ (sx sy : var) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (swp_dec sx sy D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => typ_and (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2 => typ_or (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_sel a1 l a2 => typ_sel (swp_avar sx sy a1) l (swp_avar sx sy a2)
  | typ_bnd T => typ_bnd (swp_typ sx sy T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2 => typ_fun (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end
with swp_dec (sx sy : var) (D : dec) {struct D} : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ l T1 T2 => dec_typ l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | dec_fld l T1 T2 => dec_fld l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | dec_met l TC TZ TR =>
      dec_met l (swp_typ sx sy TC) (swp_typ sx sy TZ) (swp_typ sx sy TR)
  end.

(** Lemmas on the variable-level swap. *)

Lemma swp_var_eq_l : forall sx sy, swp_var sx sy sx = sy.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  rewrite (classicT_l (P := sx = sx) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_eq_r : forall sx sy, swp_var sx sy sy = sx.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  destruct (classicT (sy = sx)) as [E|N].
  - subst sx. cbn. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (classicT_l (P := sy = sy) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_other : forall sx sy z, z <> sx -> z <> sy -> swp_var sx sy z = z.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := z = sx) H).
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := z = sy) H0). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_invol : forall sx sy z, swp_var sx sy (swp_var sx sy z) = z.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (classicT (z = sx)) as [E|Nx]; subst.
  - rewrite swp_var_eq_l. apply swp_var_eq_r.
  - destruct (classicT (z = sy)) as [E|Ny]; subst.
    + rewrite swp_var_eq_r. apply swp_var_eq_l.
    + rewrite (swp_var_other Nx Ny). apply swp_var_other; auto.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_fresh : forall sx sy z, sx <> sy ->
  z <> sx -> z <> sy -> swp_var sx sy z <> sx /\ swp_var sx sy z <> sy.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite swp_var_other; auto.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_inj : forall sx sy v1 v2,
  swp_var sx sy v1 = swp_var sx sy v2 -> v1 = v2.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite <- (swp_var_invol sx sy v1). rewrite H.
  apply swp_var_invol.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_neq : forall sx sy v1 v2,
  v1 <> v2 -> swp_var sx sy v1 <> swp_var sx sy v2.
Proof.
  intros sx sy v1 v2 H E. apply H. exact (swp_var_inj sx sy v1 v2 E).
Qed.

Lemma subst_var_neq_fresh : forall sx sy v1 v2,
  v1 <> v2 -> v1 <> sy -> v2 <> sy ->
  subst_var sx sy v1 <> subst_var sx sy v2.
Proof.
  intros sx sy v1 v2 H12 H1s H2s.
  destruct (classicT (v1 = sx)) as [E1|N1].
  - subst v1. rewrite (@subst_var_eq sx sy).
    destruct (classicT (v2 = sx)) as [E2|N2].
    + subst v2. exfalso. apply H12. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@subst_var_neq sx sy v2 N2). intro E. apply H2s. exact (eq_sym E).
  - rewrite (@subst_var_neq sx sy v1 N1).
    destruct (classicT (v2 = sx)) as [E2|N2].
    + subst v2. rewrite (@subst_var_eq sx sy). exact H1s.
    + rewrite (@subst_var_neq sx sy v2 N2). exact H12.
Qed.

Lemma swp_avar_open : forall sx sy n z (a:avar),
  swp_avar sx sy (open_rec n z a) =
  open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_avar sx sy a).
Proof.
  intros. destruct a as [i|u]; cbn.
  - destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|N].
    + subst i. cbn. reflexivity.
    + cbn. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_avar_f : forall sx sy (z:var),
  swp_avar sx sy (avar_f z) = avar_f (swp_var sx sy z).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma swp_avar_b : forall sx sy i,
  swp_avar sx sy (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Opening commutation for types and decs. *)

Lemma swp_open_typ_dec :
  (forall (T:typ) sx sy n z,
    swp_typ sx sy (open_rec n z T) =
    open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_typ sx sy T))
  /\ (forall (D:dec) sx sy n z,
    swp_dec sx sy (open_rec n z D) =
    open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_dec sx sy D)).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros D IH sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros a1 l a2 sx sy n z. cbn.
    rewrite swp_avar_open, swp_avar_open. reflexivity.
  - intros T IH sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 sx sy n z. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2, IH3. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_typ_open : forall sx sy n z (T:typ),
  swp_typ sx sy (open_rec n z T) =
  open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 swp_open_typ_dec); eauto. Qed.

Lemma swp_dec_open : forall sx sy n z (D:dec),
  swp_dec sx sy (open_rec n z D) =
  open_rec n (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_dec sx sy D).
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 swp_open_typ_dec); eauto. Qed.

(** Constructor equations for [swp_typ]. *)

Lemma swp_typ_top : forall sx sy, swp_typ sx sy typ_top = typ_top.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_bot : forall sx sy, swp_typ sx sy typ_bot = typ_bot.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_nocap : forall sx sy, swp_typ sx sy typ_nocap = typ_nocap.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_rcd : forall sx sy (D:dec),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_rcd D) = typ_rcd (swp_dec sx sy D).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_and : forall sx sy (T1 T2:typ),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_and T1 T2) = typ_and (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_or : forall sx sy (T1 T2:typ),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_or T1 T2) = typ_or (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma swp_typ_sel : forall sx sy (a1:avar) l (a2:avar),
  swp_typ sx sy (typ_sel a1 l a2) = typ_sel (swp_avar sx sy a1) l (swp_avar sx sy a2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Environment support freshness suffices to keep an environment fixed. *)

Definition swp_renv_fixed sx sy (e:renv) :=
  sx \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) /\ sy \notin (dom e \u fv_env e).

Lemma binds_swp_fixed : forall (e:renv) (v1 v2:var),
  binds v1 v2 e -> forall sx sy,
  swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
  binds (swp_var sx sy v1) (swp_var sx sy v2) e.
Proof.
  intros e v1 v2 Hb sx sy [Hx Hy].
  rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hxdom Hxfv].
  rewrite notin_union in Hy. destruct Hy as [Hydom Hyfv].
  assert (Hv1x : v1 <> sx).
  { intro E. subst sx. apply Hxdom. apply (@binds_in_dom var e v1 v2 Hb). }
  assert (Hv1y : v1 <> sy).
  { intro E. subst sy. apply Hydom. apply (@binds_in_dom var e v1 v2 Hb). }
  assert (Hsx2 : sx \notin fv v2).
  { exact (@fv_in_values_binds var sx (@fv var VarFreeVar) v1 v2 e Hb Hxfv). }
  assert (Hsy2 : sy \notin fv v2).
  { exact (@fv_in_values_binds var sy (@fv var VarFreeVar) v1 v2 e Hb Hyfv). }
  assert (Hv2x : v2 <> sx).
  { intro E. subst v2. apply Hsx2. change (sx \in \{sx}). rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hv2y : v2 <> sy).
  { intro E. subst v2. apply Hsy2. change (sy \in \{sy}). rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
  rewrite (swp_var_other Hv1x Hv1y).
  rewrite (swp_var_other Hv2x Hv2y).
  exact Hb.
Qed.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ctx_obj_vis_swp : forall G Go v,
  vis_var typing_mode (G §§& Go) v ->
  forall sx sy, vis_var typing_mode ((swp_ctx sx sy G) §§& (swp_objctx sx sy Go))
                    (swp_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G Go v H sx sy Hm. rewrite <- ctx_obj_swp.
  apply ctx_vis_swp. apply H. exact Hm.
Qed.
    + unfold defs_hasnt. rewrite label_of_swp_def. rewrite get_def_swp. rewrite h. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_trm_swp : forall G Go e (t:trm) T,
  ty_trm typing_mode G Go e t T ->
  forall sx sy, swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
    ty_trm typing_mode (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_objctx sx sy Go) e
      (swp_trm sx sy t) (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 ty_trm_swp_mut); assumption. Qed.
Lemma ty_lit_swp : forall G Go e (l:lit) T,
  ty_lit typing_mode G Go e l T ->
  forall sx sy, swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
    ty_lit typing_mode (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_objctx sx sy Go) e
      (swp_lit sx sy l) (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 ty_trm_swp_mut)); assumption. Qed.
Lemma ty_def_swp : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D ->
  forall sx sy, swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
    ty_def typing_mode (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_objctx sx sy Go) e
      (swp_def sx sy d) (swp_dec sx sy D).
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 ty_trm_swp_mut))); assumption. Qed.
Lemma ty_defs_swp : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  forall sx sy, swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
    ty_defs typing_mode (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_objctx sx sy Go) e
      (swp_defs sx sy ds) (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof. intros. apply (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 ty_trm_swp_mut))); assumption. Qed.

(** Direct cofinite instantiation at a name already outside the finite set. *)
Lemma ty_trm_open_in : forall G Go e vk S L (t:trm) T x,
  (forall z, z \notin L ->
     ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / vk ~ S) Go e (open z t) T) ->
  x \notin L ->
  ty_trm typing_mode (G § x / vk ~ S) Go e (open x t) T.
Proof. intros. exact (H x H0). Qed.


(** Cofinite-opening interface: once a fresh comparison name [z] is chosen,
    the swap lemma reduces opening at an arbitrary runtime name [x] to the
    four syntactic fixed-point equations below. *)
Lemma ty_trm_open_swap : forall G Go e vk S L (t:trm) T x z,
  (forall y, y \notin L ->
     ty_trm typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e (open y t) T) ->
  z \notin L ->
  swp_renv_fixed z x e ->
  swp_ctx z x (G § z / vk ~ S) = (G § x / vk ~ S) ->
  swp_objctx z x Go = Go ->
  swp_trm z x (open z t) = open x t ->
  swp_typ z x T = T ->
  ty_trm typing_mode (G § x / vk ~ S) Go e (open x t) T.
Proof.
  intros G Go e vk S L t T x z Hbody HzL Hf Hctx Hgo Htrm Htyp.
  pose proof (@ty_trm_swp (G § z / vk ~ S) Go e (open z t) T
                (Hbody z HzL) z x Hf) as Hs.
  rewrite Hctx, Hgo, Htrm, Htyp in Hs. exact Hs.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

(** Context and object-context swap. *)

Fixpoint swp_ctx (sx sy:var) (G:ctx) : ctx :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_push G0 v vk T => ctx_push (swp_ctx sx sy G0) (swp_var sx sy v) vk (swp_typ sx sy T)
  | ctx_stop G0 => ctx_stop (swp_ctx sx sy G0)
  | ctx_hide G0 => ctx_hide (swp_ctx sx sy G0)
  end.

Definition swp_objctx (sx sy:var) (Go:objctx) : objctx :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit v T => objctx_lit (swp_var sx sy v) (swp_typ sx sy T)
  | objctx_heap v T => objctx_heap (swp_var sx sy v) (swp_typ sx sy T)
  end.

Lemma swp_ctx_push : forall sx sy G v vk T,
  swp_ctx sx sy (G § v / vk ~ T) =
  swp_ctx sx sy G § swp_var sx sy v / vk ~ swp_typ sx sy T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

- It also requires `swp_renv_fixed z x e`. This requires `x ∉ dom e ∪ fv_env e`; for a runtime heap reference `x`, `x` can be in `dom e`, so this is not available.

ty_var G e x T0 -> subtyp G e T0 S ->
ty_trm (G § x0/v_let~S) e (open x0 t) T ->

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * A weaker configuration invariant.

    Progress (and the operational arguments for each reduction rule) only uses
    inertness of the context, heap correspondence, stack/term typing, the
    tfree-kind facts, and closedness.  In particular the [sealed] and
    [ty_nothing_fresh] fields of [ty_config] are not needed.  Dropping them
    avoids the (formally false) sealedness/freshness preservation obligations
    for freshly-allocated function/object items. *)

Inductive weak_config (G:ctx) (c:config) (U:typ) : Prop :=
| weak_config_c : forall e s Sigma Lv t T,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    @ty_stack typing_mode G e T s U ->
    @all_tfree_k stack _ G s v_ref ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t T ->
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G t v_ref ->
    config_closed (t ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    weak_config G (t ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U.

Definition config_weak_typd (c:config) (U:typ) :=
  exists G, @weak_config typing_mode G c U.

Arguments weak_config {typing_mode}.
Arguments config_weak_typd {typing_mode}.

Lemma weak_config_of_ty_config : forall G c U,
  @ty_config typing_mode G c U -> @weak_config typing_mode G c U.
Proof.
  intros G c U H. inversion H as [G0 e s Sigma Lv t T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  eapply weak_config_c; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma config_weak_typd_of_config_typd : forall c U,
  config_typd typing_mode c U -> config_weak_typd c U.
Proof.
  intros c U [G H]. exists G. eapply weak_config_of_ty_config. exact H.
Qed.

(** * Soundness from weak typed progress. *)

Lemma soundness_via_weak_typed_progress : forall (C0:config) (U:typ),
  config_weak_typd C0 U ->
  (forall (c:config) (T:typ), config_weak_typd c T ->
     answer c \/
     (exists c', config_weak_typd c' T /\ c ↦ c')) ->
  (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca) \/
  (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C0 ⊣n↦* Cn).
Proof.
  intros C0 U Hinit Hprog.
  destruct (classic (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config),
              answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca)) as [Hterm|Hnonterm].
  - left. exact Hterm.
  - right. intro n.
    assert (Haux : forall (k:nat), exists Ck:config,
              config_weak_typd Ck U /\ C0 ⊣k↦* Ck).
    { induction k as [|k [Ck [Htyp Hreach]]].
      - exists C0. split; [exact Hinit|apply red_refl].
      - destruct (Hprog Ck U Htyp) as [HA|HS].
        + exfalso. apply Hnonterm. exists k, Ck. split; assumption.
        + destruct HS as [Ck' [Htyp' Hstep]].
          exists Ck'. split; [exact Htyp'|].
          eapply red_trans; eassumption. }
    destruct (Haux n) as [Cn [_ Hreach]]. exists Cn. exact Hreach.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Defs_lemmas Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_var.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Weak preservation for [red_let_push]. *)

Lemma weak_pres_let_push : forall G (t1 t2:trm) (s:stack) (Sigma:heap) (e:renv) Lv U,
  weak_config G (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  weak_config G (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
                   fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros G t1 t2 s Sigma e Lv U Hcfg.
  inversion Hcfg as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_let_inv Hty) as [T1 [L [V [Ht1 [Hbody Hsub]]]]].
  eapply weak_config_c.
  - exact Hir.
  - exact Hhc.
  - eapply ty_stack_let.
    + exact Hst.
    + intros x Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL HxG].
      eapply ty_trm_sub; [ apply (Hbody x HxL) | ].
      eapply subtyp_weaken_push; eauto.
  - eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_let.
    + apply (@all_tfree_k_trm_let_r G v_ref t1 t2 Htf).
    + exact Hts.
  - exact Ht1.
  - apply (@all_tfree_k_trm_let_l G v_ref t1 t2 Htf).
  - eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    + eapply closed_trm_let_l. exact Hct.
    + eapply closed_stack_cons_let; [exact Hct|exact Hcs].
    + exact Hch.
Qed.

(** * Weak preservation for [red_let_var], modulo the variable-opening lemma. *)

Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

Lemma weak_pres_let_var : forall G (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
  weak_config G
    (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  weak_config G
    (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
     fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros G t Sigma e Lv x fs U Hcfg.
  inversion Hcfg as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  inversion Hst as [G1 e1 T1 U1 Hsubnil|Lst G1 e1 s1 t1 Sframe Tbody U1 Htail Hbody];
    subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_var_inv Hty) as [T0 [Htyvar Hsub]].
  assert (Hclosedframe : closed_below 1 (frame_let t))
    by (eapply closed_stack_cons_frame_below; exact Hcs).
  assert (Hclosedt : closed_below 1 t)
    by (eapply closed_frame_let_body_below; exact Hclosedframe).
  eapply weak_config_c.
  - exact Hir.
  - exact Hhc.
  - exact Htail.
  - eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_tail. exact Hts.
  - eapply open_body_at_bound.
    + intros z Hz. exact (Hbody z Hz).
    + exact Htyvar.
    + exact Hsub.
  - assert (Htf_body : @all_tfree_k trm _ G t v_ref)
      by (eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_frame; exact Hts).
    assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref).
    { eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_var. }
    eapply all_tfree_k_trm_open; eassumption.
  - eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    + apply closed_trm_open_zero. exact Hclosedt.
    + eapply closed_stack_cons_stack. exact Hcs.
    + exact Hch.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * A weaker configuration invariant.

    Progress (and the operational arguments for each reduction rule) only uses
    inertness of the context, heap correspondence, stack/term typing, the
    tfree-kind facts, and closedness.  In particular the [sealed] and
    [ty_nothing_fresh] fields of [ty_config] are not needed.  Dropping them
    avoids the (formally false) sealedness/freshness preservation obligations
    for freshly-allocated function/object items. *)

Inductive weak_config (G:ctx) : config -> typ -> Prop :=
| weak_config_c : forall e s Sigma Lv t T U,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    @ty_stack typing_mode G e T s U ->
    @all_tfree_k stack _ G s v_ref ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t T ->
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G t v_ref ->
    config_closed (t ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    weak_config G (t ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U.

Definition config_weak_typd (c:config) (U:typ) :=
  exists G, weak_config G c U.


Lemma weak_config_of_ty_config : forall G c U,
  @ty_config typing_mode G c U -> weak_config G c U.
Proof.
  intros G c U H. destruct c as [t s Sigma e Lv].
  inversion H as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  eapply weak_config_c; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma config_weak_typd_of_config_typd : forall c U,
  config_typd typing_mode c U -> config_weak_typd c U.
Proof.
  intros c U H. inversion H as [G0 c0 U0 Hty]; subst.
  exists G0. eapply weak_config_of_ty_config. exact Hty.
Qed.

(** * Soundness from weak typed progress. *)

Lemma soundness_via_weak_typed_progress : forall (C0:config) (U:typ),
  config_weak_typd C0 U ->
  (forall (c:config) (T:typ), config_weak_typd c T ->
     answer c \/
     (exists c', config_weak_typd c' T /\ c ↦ c')) ->
  (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca) \/
  (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C0 ⊣n↦* Cn).
Proof.
  intros C0 U Hinit Hprog.
  destruct (classic (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config),
              answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca)) as [Hterm|Hnonterm].
  - left. exact Hterm.
  - right. intro n.
    assert (Haux : forall (k:nat), exists Ck:config,
              config_weak_typd Ck U /\ C0 ⊣k↦* Ck).
    { induction k as [|k [Ck [Htyp Hreach]]].
      - exists C0. split; [exact Hinit|apply red_refl].
      - destruct (Hprog Ck U Htyp) as [HA|HS].
        + exfalso. apply Hnonterm. exists k, Ck. split; assumption.
        + destruct HS as [Ck' [Htyp' Hstep]].
          exists Ck'. split; [exact Htyp'|].
          eapply red_trans; eassumption. }
    destruct (Haux n) as [Cn [_ Hreach]]. exists Cn. exact Hreach.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Heap_fun Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Subst_typing Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_fun.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Unconditional weak typed-progress for the [lit_fun] rule.  The runtime
    names [y,w] are chosen fresh from the configuration and from the types
    exposed by the typing derivation, so no sealedness/freshness invariant is
    needed for the weak configuration. *)

Theorem weak_tp_lit_fun : forall (T:typ) (t1 t2:trm) Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c',
    config_weak_typd c' U /\
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv fs U Hweak.
  destruct Hweak as [G Hwc].
  inversion Hwc as
    [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_lit_inv Hty) as [Tlit [L [Vbody [Hlit [Hbody Hsub]]]]].
  destruct (ty_lit_fun_inv Hlit) as [Lf [Vfun [ETlit Hfun]]].
  subst Tlit.
  set (Tfun := typ_fun T Vfun).
  assert (Hmf : mode_has_fun typing_mode) by (eapply ty_lit_fun_mode; exact Hlit).
  (* Choose y,w fresh from the configuration and from all relevant types. *)
  set (F := fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
              \u (ctx_dom G \u (ctx_fv G \u (fv Tfun \u (L \u Lf))))).
  destruct (var_fresh F) as [y HyF].
  destruct (var_fresh (F \u \{y})) as [w HwFy].
  assert (HwF : w \notin F).
  { intro Hin. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwY : w <> y).
  { intro E. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton.
    symmetry. exact E. }
  assert (HyW : y <> w) by (intro E; apply HwY; symmetry; exact E).
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HyF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HwF.
  destruct HyF as [HyF HyRest].
  destruct HyRest as [HyDom [HyFv [HyTfun [HyL HyLf]]]].
  destruct HwF as [HwF HwRest].
  destruct HwRest as [HwDom [HwFv [HwTfun [HwL HwLf]]]].
  (* Freshness consequences needed for the environment/heap extension. *)
  assert (HySigma : y \notin dom Sigma).
  { intro Hin. apply HyF. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union.
    right. right. left. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwE : w \notin dom e).
  { intro Hin. apply HwF. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union.
    right. right. right. left. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tfun w Hin) as [E|HinG].
    - subst w. apply HwY. reflexivity.
    - apply HwDom. exact HinG. }
  assert (HwFvY : w \notin ctx_fv (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)).
  { cbn. repeat rewrite notin_union. split; [exact HwTfun|exact HwFv]. }
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply HwE. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  (* New heap correspondence. *)
  assert (Htf1 : all_tfree_k_trm G t1 v_ref).
  { intros v Hv. eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_lit_l. apply tfree_lit_fun. exact Hv. }
  assert (Hhc' : heap_correspond
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun § w / v_ref ~ Tfun)
      (e & w ~ y) (Sigma & y ~ item_fun t1)).
  { eapply heap_correspond_extend_fun with (L := Lf); eauto. }
  (* New inert context. *)
  assert (Hityloc : inert_typ Tfun v_loc).
  { unfold Tfun. eapply inert_typ_fun; eassumption. }
  assert (Hityref : inert_typ Tfun v_ref).
  { unfold Tfun. eapply inert_typ_fun; eassumption. }
  assert (Hir' : inert (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun § w / v_ref ~ Tfun)).
  { eapply inert_two_locref; eauto. }
  (* New stack. *)
  assert (HstY : @ty_stack typing_mode (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun) e Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; [exact Hst|exact HyDom|intros a b Hb; exact Hb]. }
  assert (Hst' : @ty_stack typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun § w / v_ref ~ Tfun) (e & w ~ y) Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; [exact HstY|exact HwGy|exact Hee']. }
  assert (Hts' : all_tfree_k_stack
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun § w / v_ref ~ Tfun) fs v_ref).
  { eapply all_tfree_k_stack_weaken; [exact Hts|].
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun) z v_ref w v_ref Tfun).
    - eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref y v_loc Tfun); eassumption.
    - exact HwGy. }
  (* Type the opened outer body. *)
  pose proof (@ty_weaken_insert_mut typing_mode) as Hins.
  destruct Hins as [Htrm_ins _].
  assert (HbodyW : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_let ~ Tfun) objctx_empty e
                     (open w t2) Vbody)
    by (eapply Hbody; exact HwL).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.
Require Import WeakConfig Weak_typed_progress Dev.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Theorem soundness_initial_from_weak_typed_progress
  (open_body_at_bound :
    forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
      (forall z, z \notin L ->
         ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
      ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody)
  (tp_read :
    forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_write :
    forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_call :
    forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_apply :
    forall (x z:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_lit :
    forall (l:lit) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (t : trm) (T : typ):
  closed t -> closed T -> ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  exists C, (config_initial t C) /\
    ((exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)) \/
     (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C ⊣n↦* Cn)).
Proof.
  intros Hct HcT Hty.
  destruct (var_fresh (fv t \u fv T)) as [null Hnull].
  exists (t ; stack_nil ; empty ; empty ; \{null}).
  split.
  - apply (config_initial_mk t (\{null})).
  - eapply soundness_via_weak_typed_progress with (U := typ_top).
    + eapply config_weak_typd_of_config_typd.
      apply (@config_initial_typing typing_mode t T null Hct Hty).
    + intros c Uc Hc.
      eapply (@weak_typed_progress typing_mode open_body_at_bound
                tp_read tp_write tp_call tp_apply tp_lit).
      exact Hc.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Program.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Typed_progress_read Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Heap_lookup Context_lemmas Env_set Heap_fun Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Syntax_extra Ctx_term_narrow Typing_subst.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Variable canon_fld_read_weak :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 (a:fld_label) S U V Tstack,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G ->
    ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
    exists y ds v Ty Tw,
      binds x y e /\
      binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
      defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
      ctx_k G v v_loc /\
      ctx_binds v Ty G /\
      typ_corr Tw Ty /\
      inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack.

Lemma weak_read_step_assembly :
  forall (G:ctx) e Sigma (fs:stack) Lv (x:var) (m:fld_label) Tstack U
         (w y v:var) (ds:defs) Ty Tw,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    @ty_stack typing_mode G e Tstack fs U ->
    @all_tfree_k stack _ G fs v_ref ->
    ctx_k G v v_loc ->
    ctx_binds v Ty G ->
    typ_corr Tw Ty ->
    inert_typ Tw v_ref ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack ->
    binds x y e ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f v)) ->
    w \notin fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    config_weak_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ;
       fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U /\
    (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦
      (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ;
       fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma fs Lv x m Tstack U w y v ds Ty Tw
         Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hkv Hbyv Hcorr Hity HTwT Hbxy Hby Hhas Hwf.
  set (cold := trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  assert (Hwe : w \notin dom e).
  { intro H. apply Hwf. subst cold. apply (@in_fv_config_dom_env_general
                                       (trm_read (avar_f x) m) fs Sigma e Lv w H). }
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ v)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply Hwe. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  assert (Hinert' : inert (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw)).
  { eapply inert_push; eauto using inert_vk_ref. }
  assert (Hhc' : heap_correspond (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Sigma).
  { eapply heap_correspond_extend_read; eassumption. }
  assert (Hst' : @ty_stack typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; eassumption. }
  assert (Hts' : @all_tfree_k stack _ (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) fs v_ref).
  { eapply (@all_tfree_k_stack_weaken G (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) fs v_ref Hts).
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref w v_ref Tw);
      [ exact Hz | exact (proj1 (proj1 (True_rect (fun _ => True) I)) ) ]. }
  assert (Htyw : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) objctx_empty (e & w ~ v)
                   (trm_var (avar_f w)) Tstack).
  { eapply ty_trm_var.
    - intro. apply ctx_vis_e.
    - eapply ty_var_sub.
      + apply ty_var_var. apply ctx_binds_e.
      + eapply subtyp_env_mono.
        * eapply subtyp_weaken_push; eassumption.
        * exact Hee'. }
  assert (Htfw : @all_tfree_k trm _ (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (trm_var (avar_f w)) v_ref).
  { intros z Hz. inversion Hz; subst. exists Tw, G. apply ctx_binds_k_e. }
  assert (Hcc' : config_closed
                   (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ; fv_config cold)).
  { eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    - intros n z. cbn. reflexivity.
    - eapply closed_stack_cons_stack. exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 HccDummy))). }
Abort.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_heap x T => objctx_heap x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  end.

Instance ObjctxSealable: Sealable objctx := objctx_seal_rec.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Typed_progress_read Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Heap_lookup Context_lemmas Env_set Heap_fun Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Syntax_extra Ctx_term_narrow.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Variable canon_fld_read_weak :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 (a:fld_label) S U V Tstack,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G ->
    ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
    exists y ds v Ty Tw,
      binds x y e /\
      binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
      defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
      ctx_k G v v_loc /\
      ctx_binds v Ty G /\
      typ_corr Tw Ty /\
      inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack.

Lemma weak_read_step_assembly :
  forall (G:ctx) e Sigma (fs:stack) Lv (x:var) (m:fld_label) Tstack U
         (w y v:var) (ds:defs) Ty Tw,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    @ty_stack typing_mode G e Tstack fs U ->
    @all_tfree_k stack _ G fs v_ref ->
    ctx_k G v v_loc ->
    ctx_binds v Ty G ->
    typ_corr Tw Ty ->
    inert_typ Tw v_ref ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack ->
    binds x y e ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f v)) ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G -> w \notin ctx_fv G -> w \notin fv Tw -> w \notin dom e ->
    config_weak_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ;
       fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U /\
    (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦
      (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ;
       fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma fs Lv x m Tstack U w y v ds Ty Tw
         Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hkv Hbyv Hcorr Hity HTwT Hbxy Hby Hhas
         HwG HwfvG HwTw Hwe.
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ v)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply Hwe. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  assert (Hinert' : inert (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw)).
  { eapply inert_push; eauto using inert_vk_ref. }
  assert (Hhc' : heap_correspond (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Sigma).
  { eapply heap_correspond_extend_read; eassumption. }
  assert (Hst' : @ty_stack typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; eassumption. }
  assert (Hts' : @all_tfree_k stack _ (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) fs v_ref).
  { eapply (@all_tfree_k_stack_weaken G (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) fs v_ref Hts).
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref w v_ref Tw);
      [ exact Hz | exact HwG ]. }
  assert (Htyw : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) objctx_empty (e & w ~ v)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Independence from the outermost bound variable gives opening identity. *)
Lemma typ_indep_open_inv : forall (v:avar) (T:typ), typ_indep v T ->
  forall n x, v = avar_b n -> open_rec n x T = T.
Proof.
  intros v T H. induction H; intros n x Ev; cbn.
  - (* nulary *) reflexivity.
  - (* and *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; reflexivity|exact Ev|exact Ev].
  - (* or *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; reflexivity|exact Ev|exact Ev].
  - (* fld *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; reflexivity|exact Ev|exact Ev].
  - (* typ f *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; reflexivity|exact Ev|exact Ev].
  - (* typ b *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; reflexivity| | ];
      try (subst v; reflexivity).
    all: subst v; reflexivity.
  - (* fun f *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; reflexivity|exact Ev|exact Ev].
  - (* fun b *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; reflexivity| | ]; subst v; reflexivity.
  - (* sel *) subst v. destruct v1 as [i|y]; destruct v2 as [j|z]; cbn;
      try reflexivity;
      (* the impossible equalities v <> avar_b i etc. were used to rule out replacement *)
      try (exfalso; apply H; reflexivity).
    all: try reflexivity.
  - (* sel normal *) subst v. destruct v2 as [j|z]; cbn; try reflexivity;
      try (exfalso; apply H; reflexivity). reflexivity.
  - (* bnd f *) rewrite IHtyp_indep; [reflexivity|exact Ev].
  - (* bnd b *) rewrite IHtyp_indep; [reflexivity|subst v; reflexivity].
  - (* met f *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; [rewrite IHtyp_indep3; reflexivity|exact Ev]|exact Ev|exact Ev].
  - (* met b *) rewrite IHtyp_indep1; [rewrite IHtyp_indep2; [rewrite IHtyp_indep3; reflexivity|exact Ev]| | ];
      subst v; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typ_indep_b_open0 : forall (T:typ), typ_indep_b 0 T -> forall x,
  open_rec 0 x T = T.
Proof. intros T H x. eapply typ_indep_open_inv; [exact H|reflexivity]. Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tlit w Hin) as [E|HinG].
    - subst w. apply HwY. reflexivity.
    - apply HwDom. exact HinG. }
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply HwE. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  (* Tfun facts for the object body. *)
  assert (HdsW : @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_lit w T) e (open w ds) (open w T))
    by (eapply Hds; exact HwLobj).
  destruct (weak_obj_extension G e Sigma w y T ds Lobj Hir Hhc Hindep Hds HwLobj
              HwDom HyDom HwY HwFv HyFv HwTlit HyTlit HySigma HwE)
    as [Hhc' Hir'].
  (* Stack and tfree propagation. *)
  assert (HstY : @ty_stack typing_mode (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit) e Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; [exact Hst|exact HyDom|intros a b Hb; exact Hb]. }
  assert (Hst' : @ty_stack typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) (e & w ~ y) Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; [exact HstY|exact HwGy|exact Hee']. }
  assert (Hts' : all_tfree_k_stack
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) fs v_ref).
  { eapply all_tfree_k_stack_weaken; [exact Hts|].
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit) z v_ref w v_ref Tlit).
    - eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref y v_loc Tlit); eassumption.
    - exact HwGy. }
  (* Type the opened outer body. *)
  pose proof (@ty_weaken_insert_mut typing_mode) as Hins.
  destruct Hins as [Htrm_ins _].
  assert (HbodyW : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_let ~ Tlit) objctx_empty e
                     (open w t) Vbody)
    by (eapply Hbody; exact HwLbody).
  assert (HbodyRef : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty e
                       (open w t) Vbody).
  { eapply ty_trm_kind_change_top. exact HbodyW. }
  assert (HbodyE : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)
                     (open w t) Vbody)
    by (eapply ty_trm_env_mono; eassumption).
  assert (HyNot : y \notin ctx_dom
      ((G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) §§& objctx_empty)).
  { cbn. intro Hin. change (y \in ctx_dom (G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G w v_ref Tlit y Hin) as [E|HyG].
    - subst y. apply HyW. reflexivity.
    - apply HyDom. exact HyG. }
  pose proof (Htrm_ins (G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)
                (open w t) Vbody HbodyE G (ctx_push ctx_empty w v_ref Tlit)
                eq_refl y v_loc Tlit HyNot) as HtyRaw.
  assert (HtyNew : ty_trm typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)
      (open w t) Vbody).
  { change (ty_trm typing_mode
      ((G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit) §& (ctx_push ctx_empty w v_ref Tlit))
      objctx_empty (e & w ~ y) (open w t) Vbody).
    exact HtyRaw. }
  assert (HsubG' : subtyp typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty e Vbody Tstack).
  { eapply subtyp_weaken_push.
    - eapply subtyp_weaken_push; eassumption.
    - exact HwGy. }
  assert (HsubE : subtyp typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)
      Vbody Tstack)
    by (eapply subtyp_env_mono; eassumption).
  assert (HtyNew' : ty_trm typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)
      (open w t) Tstack).
  { eapply ty_trm_sub; [exact HtyNew|exact HsubE]. }
  (* all-tfree of the opened body. *)
  assert (Htf2 : all_tfree_k_trm G t v_ref).
  { intros v Hv. eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_lit_r. exact Hv. }
  assert (Htf2' : all_tfree_k_trm
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) t v_ref).
  { eapply all_tfree_k_trm_weaken; [exact Htf2|].
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit) z v_ref w v_ref Tlit).
    - eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref y v_loc Tlit); eassumption.
    - exact HwGy. }
  assert (Hctxw : ctx_k (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) w v_ref).
  { exists Tlit, (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit). apply ctx_binds_k_e. }
  assert (HtfNew : all_tfree_k_trm
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) (open w t) v_ref)
    by (eapply all_tfree_k_trm_open; eauto).
  (* Closedness. *)
  assert (HclTerm : closed (open w t)).
  { apply closed_trm_open_zero_below.
    eapply closed_trm_lit_body_below. exact Hct. }
  assert (HclDs : closed_below 1 ds).
  { eapply closed_lit_obj_defs_below.
    eapply closed_trm_lit_l. exact Hct. }
  assert (HclItem : closed
      (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds)))).
  { apply closed_item_obj. eapply deref_closed_defs_open. exact HclDs. }
  assert (Hcc' : config_closed
      (open w t ; fs ; Sigma & y ~ item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds)) ;
       e & w ~ y ; fv_config Cold)).
  { subst Cold. eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    - exact HclTerm.
    - exact Hcs.
    - eapply heap_closed_push; [exact Hch|exact HclItem]. }
  (* Assemble. *)
  exists (open w t ; fs ;
          Sigma & y ~ item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds)) ;
          e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
  split.
  - exists (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit).
    eapply weak_config_c.
    + exact Hir'.
    + exact Hhc'.
    + exact Hst'.
    + exact Hts'.
    + exact HtyNew'.
    + exact HtfNew.
    + exact Hcc'.
  - eapply red_let_obj.
    + eapply fresh_two; [exact HyOld|exact HwOld|exact HwY].
    + exact HwY.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Typed_progress_read Heap_lookup Env_set Heap_fun Ctx_term_narrow Typing_weaken Subst_typing Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Kind_env_stack.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Variable canon_fld_read_weak :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 (a:fld_label) S U V Tstack,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G ->
    ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
    exists y ds v Ty Tw,
      binds x y e /\
      binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
      defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
      ctx_k G v v_loc /\
      ctx_binds v Ty G /\
      typ_corr Tw Ty /\
      inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack.

Lemma weak_read_step_assembly :
  forall (G:ctx) e Sigma (fs:stack) Lv (x:var) (m:fld_label) Tstack U
         (w y v:var) (ds:defs) Ty Tw,
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    @ty_stack typing_mode G e Tstack fs U ->
    @all_tfree_k stack _ G fs v_ref ->
    ctx_k G v v_loc ->
    ctx_binds v Ty G ->
    typ_corr Tw Ty ->
    inert_typ Tw v_ref ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack ->
    binds x y e ->
    binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f v)) ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G ->
    w \notin ctx_fv G ->
    w \notin fv Tw ->
    w \notin dom e ->
    w \notin fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    closed fs ->
    heap_closed Sigma ->
    config_weak_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ;
       fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U /\
    (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦
      (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ;
       fv_config (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma fs Lv x m Tstack U w y v ds Ty Tw
         Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hkv Hbyv Hcorr Hity HTwT Hbxy Hby Hhas
         HwG HwfvG HwTw Hwe Hwf Hcs Hch.
  set (cold := trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ v)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply Hwe. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  assert (Hinert' : inert (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw)).
  { eapply inert_push; eauto using inert_vk_ref. }
  assert (Hhc' : heap_correspond (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Sigma).
  { eapply heap_correspond_extend_read; eassumption. }
  assert (Hst' : @ty_stack typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (e & w ~ v) Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; eassumption. }
  assert (Hts' : @all_tfree_k stack _ (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) fs v_ref).
  { eapply (@all_tfree_k_stack_weaken G (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) fs v_ref Hts).
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref w v_ref Tw);
      [ exact Hz | exact HwG ]. }
  assert (Htyw : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) objctx_empty (e & w ~ v)
                   (trm_var (avar_f w)) Tstack).
  { eapply ty_trm_var.
    - intro. apply ctx_vis_e.
    - eapply ty_var_sub.
      + apply ty_var_var. apply ctx_binds_e.
      + eapply subtyp_env_mono.
        * eapply subtyp_weaken_push; eassumption.
        * exact Hee'. }
  assert (Htfw : @all_tfree_k trm _ (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw) (trm_var (avar_f w)) v_ref).
  { intros z Hz. inversion Hz; subst. exists Tw, G. apply ctx_binds_k_e. }
  assert (Hcc' : config_closed
                   (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ; fv_config cold)).
  { eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    - intros n z. cbn. reflexivity.
    - exact Hcs.
    - exact Hch. }
  split.
  - exists (G § w / v_ref ~ Tw).
    eapply weak_config_c.
    + exact Hinert'.
    + exact Hhc'.
    + exact Hst'.
    + exact Hts'.
    + exact Htyw.
    + exact Htfw.
    + exact Hcc'.
  - eapply red_read.
    + subst cold. cbn. split; [exact Hwf|exact I].
    + exact Hbxy.
    + exact Hby.
    + exact Hhas.
Qed.

Lemma weak_tp_read_from_canon : forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros x m Sigma e Lv fs U Hcfg.
  set (cold := trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  destruct Hcfg as [G Hweak].
  inversion Hweak as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref).
  { eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_read. }
  destruct (ty_trm_read_inv Hty) as [S [Tfld [V [Hxread [Hder Hs]]]]].
  destruct (ty_var_sub_elim Hxread) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
  destruct (@canon_fld_read_weak G e Sigma x T0 m S Tfld V T Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub Hs)
    as [y [ds [v [Ty [Tw [Hbxy [Hby [Hhas [Hkv [Hbyv [Hcorr [Hity HTwT]]]]]]]]]]]].
  destruct (var_fresh (ctx_dom G \u ctx_fv G \u fv Tw \u dom e \u fv_config cold))
    as [w Hw].
  rewrite notin_union in Hw. destruct Hw as [HwG Hw].
  rewrite notin_union in Hw. destruct Hw as [HwfvG Hw].
  rewrite notin_union in Hw. destruct Hw as [HwTw Hw].
  rewrite notin_union in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hwe Hwf].
  exists (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ; fv_config cold).
  eapply weak_read_step_assembly; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section ApplyPart.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

Variable open_body_open_at_par :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S U x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_par ~ S) objctx_empty e
         (open z t) (open z U)) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) (open x U).

Variable canon_fun_apply :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 (Sarg Tres Tstack:typ) (z:var),
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_fun Sarg Tres) ->
    exists y tf S0 T0h L,
      binds x y e /\
      binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma /\
      ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0h) G /\
      (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
         ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
           (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0h)) /\
      @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref /\
      closed_below 1 tf /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack.

Lemma weak_tp_apply_from_canon : forall (x z:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode
    (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros x z Sigma e Lv fs U Hcfg.
  set (cold := trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  destruct Hcfg as [G Hweak].
  inversion Hweak as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_apply_l).
  assert (Hkz : ctx_k G z v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_apply_r).
  destruct (ty_trm_apply_inv Hty) as [Sarg [Tres [Hx [Hz Hs]]]].
  destruct (ty_var_sub_elim Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
  destruct (@canon_fun_apply G e Sigma x T0 Sarg Tres T z Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub)
    as [y [tf [S0 [T0h [L [Hbxy [Hby [Hcby [Hbody [Htf_tf [Hcltf [HsubS Hsubz]]]]]]]]]]]].
  assert (Hbodyz : ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e
                     (open z tf) (open z T0h)).
  { eapply open_body_open_at_par with (G := G) (e := e) (L := L)
      (t := tf) (S := S0) (U := T0h) (x := z) (T0 := Sarg);
      [ exact Hbody | exact Hz | exact HsubS ]. }
  assert (Hnew : ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z tf) T).
  { eapply ty_trm_sub; eassumption. }
  assert (Htfnew : @all_tfree_k trm _ G (open z tf) v_ref).
  { eapply all_tfree_k_trm_open; eassumption. }
  assert (Hcc' : config_closed (open z tf ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; fv_config cold)).
  { eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    - apply closed_trm_open_zero. exact Hcltf.
    - exact Hcs.
    - exact Hch. }
  exists (open z tf ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; fv_config cold).
  split.
  - exists G. eapply weak_config_c.
    + exact Hir.
    + exact Hhc.
    + exact Hst.
    + exact Hts.
    + exact Hnew.
    + exact Htfnew.
    + exact Hcc'.
  - eapply red_apply; eauto.
Qed.

End ApplyPart.

Section CallPart.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Heap_fun Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Subst_typing Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_fun Weak_let_fun.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Object-literal weak progress.

    The only missing ingredient is the object analogue of
    [heap_correspond_extend_fun]: transporting the object-literal body typing
    under [objctx_lit w T] to a heap-item typing under [objctx_heap y T] after
    dereferencing [w] to [y].  It is isolated below as
    [weak_obj_extension].  Everything else is proved unconditionally. *)

Variable weak_obj_extension :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) (ds:defs) (L:fset var),
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_lit x T) e (open x ds) (open x T)) ->
    w \notin L ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
    w \notin ctx_fv G -> y \notin ctx_fv G ->
    w \notin fv T -> y \notin fv T ->
    y \notin dom Sigma -> w \notin dom e ->
    heap_correspond
      (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
         § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T))
      (e & w ~ y)
      (Sigma & y ~ item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds)))
    /\
    inert (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
             § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)).

Theorem weak_tp_lit_obj_cond : forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm)
    Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c',
    config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros T ds t Sigma e Lv fs U Hweak.
  destruct Hweak as [G Hwc].
  inversion Hwc as
    [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_lit_inv Hty) as [Tlit0 [Lbody [Vbody [Hlit [Hbody Hsub]]]]].
  destruct (ty_lit_obj_inv Hlit) as [Lobj [ETlit [Hds Hindep]]].
  subst Tlit0.
  set (Tlit := typ_objlit typing_mode T).
  set (Cold := (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
  set (F := fv_config Cold
              \u (ctx_dom G \u (ctx_fv G \u (fv Tlit \u (Lbody \u Lobj))))).
  destruct (var_fresh F) as [y HyF].
  destruct (var_fresh (F \u \{y})) as [w HwFy].
  assert (HwF : w \notin F).
  { intro Hin. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwY : w <> y).
  { intro E. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. exact E. }
  assert (HyW : y <> w) by (intro E; apply HwY; symmetry; exact E).
  unfold F in HyF. unfold F in HwF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HyF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HwF.
  destruct HyF as [HyOld HyRest].
  destruct HyRest as [HyDom [HyFv [HyTlit [HyLbody HyLobj]]]].
  destruct HwF as [HwOld HwRest].
  destruct HwRest as [HwDom [HwFv [HwTlit [HwLbody HwLobj]]]].
  assert (HyT : y \notin fv T).
  { unfold Tlit in HyTlit. cbn in HyTlit. repeat rewrite notin_union in HyTlit.
    tauto. }
  assert (HwT : w \notin fv T).
  { unfold Tlit in HwTlit. cbn in HwTlit. repeat rewrite notin_union in HwTlit.
    tauto. }
  assert (HySigma : y \notin dom Sigma).
  { intro Hin. apply HyOld. unfold Cold. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union.
    right. right. left. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwE : w \notin dom e).
  { intro Hin. apply HwOld. unfold Cold. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union.
    right. right. right. left. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tlit w Hin) as [E|HinG].
    - subst w. apply HwY. reflexivity.
    - apply HwDom. exact HinG. }
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply HwE. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  assert (HdsW : @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_lit w T) e (open w ds) (open w T))
    by (eapply Hds; exact HwLobj).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Progress Preservation_split Reduction_to_PP.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The task target, reduced to (a) the three canonical-form interfaces used by
    progress and (b) the eight per-rule preservation obligations. *)

Theorem soundness_initial_from_canonical_and_preservation
  (canon_fun :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 S U,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_fun S U) ->
      mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
      exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
  (canon_fld :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
      exists y ds v, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                    defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)))
  (canon_met :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ->
      exists y ds t, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                    defs_has ds (def_met m t))
  (pres_let_push :
    forall (s t:trm) fs Sigma e Lv U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_let s t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (s ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_let s t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_var :
    forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_fun :
    forall (T:typ) (t1 t2:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
      fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
        (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
      y <> w ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open w t2 ; fs ; Sigma & y ~ item_fun t1 ; e & w ~ y ;
         fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_obj :
    forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
      fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
        (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
      w <> y ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open w t ; fs ;
         Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))) ; e & w ~ y ;
         fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_read :
    forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yVal wVal:var) ds fs U,
--- Progress interfaces
  closed (trm_call a m b) -> closed a.
Proof.
  intros a m b H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_call in H.
  injection H as Ha Hb. exact Ha.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_call_r : forall (a:avar) m (b:avar),
  closed (trm_call a m b) -> closed b.
Proof.
  intros a m b H n x. specialize (H n x). rewrite open_trm_call in H.
  injection H as Ha Hb. exact Hb.
Qed.

(** * Canonical-form interfaces used by progress. *)

Variable canon_fun :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 S U,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_fun S U) ->
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma.

Variable canon_fld :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
    exists y ds v, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                  defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)).

Variable canon_met :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ->
    exists y ds t, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                  defs_has ds (def_met m t).

Lemma ty_trm_apply_mode : forall G e x z U,
  ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z)) U ->
  mode_has_fun typing_mode.
Proof.
  intros G e x z U H.
  clear canon_fun canon_fld canon_met.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z)) U) in H.
--- Typed_progress_read canon
  - eapply red_read.
    + subst cold. cbn. split; [exact Hwf|exact I].
    + exact Hbxy.
    + exact Hby.
    + exact Hhas.
Qed.

End ReadAssembly.

Section ReadMainFinal.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Variable canon_fld_read :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 (a:fld_label) S U V Tstack (c:config),
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G ->
    ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
    exists y ds v Ty Tw,
      binds x y e /\
      binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
      defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
      ctx_k G v v_loc /\
      ctx_binds v Ty G /\
      typ_corr Tw Ty /\
      inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
      sealed Tw /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack /\
      (fv Tw) \c fv_config c.

Lemma tp_read_from_canon : forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros x m Sigma e Lv fs U Hcfg.
  set (cold := trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  inversion Hcfg as [G c0 Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref).
  { eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_read. }
  destruct (ty_trm_read_inv Hty) as [S [Tfld [V [Hxread [Hder Hs]]]]].
  destruct (ty_var_sub_elim Hxread) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
  destruct (@canon_fld_read G e Sigma x T0 m S Tfld V Tstack cold
              Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub Hs)
    as [y [ds [v [Ty [Tw [Hbxy [Hby [Hhas [Hkv [Hbyv [Hcorr [Hity [HsealedTw [HTwT HfvTw]]]]]]]]]]]]]].
  destruct (var_fresh (fv_config cold)) as [w Hwf].
  exists (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ; fv_config cold).
  eapply read_step_assembly; eauto.
Qed.

End ReadMainFinal.

Section InertLemmas.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ctx_k_binds_k_after : forall G x vk,
  ctx_k G x vk -> exists T G2, ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2.
Proof. intros G x vk [T [G2 H]]. exists T, G2. exact H. Qed.

Lemma inert_k_typ : forall G x vk T G2,
  inert G -> ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2 -> inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk T G2 Hinert.
  generalize dependent G2; generalize dependent T; generalize dependent vk; generalize dependent x.
  induction Hinert; intros xx vkk TTT GG2 Hafter.
  - inversion Hafter.
  - inversion Hafter; subst.
    + exact H0.
    + eapply IHHinert; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_binds_typ : forall G x T,
  inert G -> ctx_binds x T G -> exists vk, inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x T Hinert.
  generalize dependent T; generalize dependent x.
  induction Hinert; intros xx TT Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hb; subst; eauto.
Qed.

End InertLemmas.

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_insert : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 x T,
  x <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  forall xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hfresh Hc xr.
  change (ctx_binds x T ((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2)) in Hc.
  revert G1 Hc Hfresh.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 Hc Hfresh; cbn in *.

     ------------------------------------------------------------
     ty_var (G1 §& G2) e (subst_var x0 xr x) (subst_var x0 xr T)

   the dummy name [x0] (e.g. a type member selector).  Since the conclusion keeps
   the context unchanged, the stored type [T] would have to be usable both as
   [T] and as [subst_var x0 xr T].  Concretely:

     G1 = ctx_push ctx_empty x1 v_loc (typ_sel (avar_f x0) L z)
     G2 = ctx_empty,  S0 = typ_top,  e = empty,  xr a fresh name,
