     external: ty_var (G1) e xr typ_top (add xr to G1), typ_top <: typ_top.

   The conclusion would be [ty_var G1 e x1 (typ_sel (avar_f xr) L z)], which is
   not derivable: [G1] binds [x1] to [typ_sel (avar_f x0) L z], and no subtyping
   rule relates [typ_sel x0 L z] to [typ_sel xr L z] when [e] does not equate
   [x0] and [xr] (take [e = empty]).

   The corrected statement must also substitute the types stored in the
   context, i.e. conclude under

       subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2).

   The [subst_ctx] development above (lookup removal in a substituted context,
   self-binding identification, freshness identity [subst_ctx_id], fv facts) is
   the infrastructure for that corrected lemma.

   A provable interface for the self-binding case (where the looked-up variable
   is exactly [x0]) additionally needs the substituted variable to be typed at
   the substituted binding type:

       Hxr  : ty_var (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)) e xr (subst_var x0 xr S0)
       Hvis : mode_has_visibility typing_mode ->
                ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)) xr          (for terms)

   and for every fresh-binder rule ([forall y, y\notin L -> ...]) the induction
   hypothesis is applied at the split [(G1, G2 § y)] under the substituted
   context; [Hxr]/[Hvis] must be weakened there with
   [var_sub_incap_weaken] / [ty_weaken_insert_mut] / [ctx_vis_insert].  This
   further requires [y] not to shadow [xr] (i.e. [y] fresh for the base context
   and [xr]); in a derivation the rule's [L] must be enlarged to exclude [xr]
   and all names of the substituted context, which is available from the
   configuration invariants (all fresh binders are chosen outside the config's

   The actual typing-substitution induction (46 cases for ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap

(**

   substitution.

   The rule is (GeneralTyping.v):

     subtyp_typ : (forall x, G ⊢ open x S2 <: open x S1) ->
                  (forall x, G ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
                  G ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

   with an unrestricted [forall x] over names (no freshness set [L]).

   After substituting [x0] by [xr] in the conclusion, the required premise is

     forall x, G'' ⊢ open x (subst S2) <: open x (subst S1).

   For a given [x], the induction hypothesis on the original premise at a name
   [x'] yields

     G'' ⊢ subst (open x' S2) <: subst (open x' S1)
     =  G'' ⊢ open (subst x') (subst S2) <: open (subst x') (subst S1).

   For [x <> x0] we take [x' = x] (so [subst x' = x]).  For [x = x0], however,
   [subst x0 = xr], and the hypothesis gives the statement at [xr], not at [x0].
   There is no subtyping rule that changes the name inserted by [open] (the two
   types differ exactly at the opened bound positions), and the original
   derivation's premise at [x0] was proved under the *unsubstituted* context
   [G], where [x0] was bound; in [G''] the name [x0] is not bound.  Thus this
   case does not close.

   Two possible repairs:

   (H1) Add the global freshness hypothesis that [x0] does not occur free in any
        type occurring in the derivation (in particular in the bounds
        [S1,S2,T1,T2] of every [subtyp_typ] occurrence).  Then [subst] is the
        identity on those types and the original premise at [x0] is exactly the
        required new premise at [x0].

   (H2) Prove a name-renaming lemma for subtyping of opened types: for [T] with
        [x0 \notin fv T] and [x0 \notin ctx_dom G''], derive
        [G'' ⊢ open x0 T <: open x0 U] from [G'' ⊢ open xr T <: open xr U]
        (or from the corresponding closed/parametric form).  Such a lemma is a
        non-trivial substitution/alpha-renaming property of the type system and
        is not available in the current helper files.

   The induction was therefore NOT completed for [subtyp_typ] (and hence for the
   mutual ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap block).  The context infrastructure above is
   complete and usable; the [ty_trm]/[ty_lit]/[ty_def]/[ty_defs] substitution

(** 1) Opening at depth 0 preserves closedness for lit / defs, and types *)

Lemma closed_lit_open_zero : forall (l:lit) x,
  closed_below 1 l -> closed (open_rec 0 x l).
Proof.
  intros l x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite lit_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@lit_open_commut l (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma closed_defs_open_zero : forall (ds:defs) x,
  closed_below 1 ds -> closed (open_rec 0 x ds).
Proof.
(** * Closed below a binder depth *)

Definition closed_below (d:nat) {A:Set} {AS:Openable A} (a:A) :=
  forall n x, d <= n -> open_rec n x a = a.

Lemma closed_below_zero : forall {A} {AS:Openable A} (a:A),
  closed a <-> closed_below 0 a.
Proof.
  intros A AS a. split; intros H.
  - intros n x Hn. apply H.
  - intros n x. apply (H n x). apply Nat.le_0_l.
Qed.

Lemma closed_trm_open_zero : forall (t:trm) x,
  closed_below 1 t -> closed (open_rec 0 x t).
Proof.
  intros t x Ht m z. destruct m as [|m'].
  - rewrite trm_open_twice. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (@trm_open_commut t (S m') 0 z x (Nat.neq_succ_0 m')).
    rewrite (Ht (S m') z (Nat.lt_0_succ m')). reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_heap x T => objctx_heap x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  end.

Instance ObjctxSealable: Sealable objctx := objctx_seal_rec.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Heap_fun Closed_extra Canonical Canonical4 Canonical5.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Closedness of a heap binding. *)

Lemma heap_closed_binds_closed : forall (Sigma:heap) y (it:item),
  heap_closed Sigma -> binds y it Sigma -> closed it.
Proof.
  intros Sigma y it Hch. induction Hch as [|S z i Hch Hcl IH]; intros Hb.
  - eapply binds_empty_inv. exact Hb.
  - destruct (binds_push_inv Hb) as [[Ey Ei]|[Hne HbS]].
    + subst. exact Hcl.
    + eapply IH. exact HbS.
Qed.

Lemma closed_item_fun_inv : forall (t:trm),
  closed (item_fun t) -> closed_below 1 t.
Proof.
  intros t H m x Hm.
  destruct m as [|m']; [inversion Hm|].
  specialize (H m' x). cbn in H. injection H as E. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma closed_below_fun_item_of_bind : forall (Sigma:heap) y tf,
  heap_closed Sigma -> binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma -> closed_below 1 tf.
Proof.
  intros Sigma y tf Hch Hb.
  eapply closed_item_fun_inv.
  eapply heap_closed_binds_closed; eassumption.
Qed.

(** * Static loc-type to ref-type correspondence. *)

Lemma mode_refcap_corr_none :
  mode_refcaps' typing_mode = mode_refcaps_none ->
  mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode = mode_refcap_corr_same.
Proof. destruct typing_mode; cbn; auto. Qed.

Lemma mode_refcap_corr_mutability :
  mode_refcaps' typing_mode = mode_refcaps_mutability ->
  mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode = mode_refcap_corr_ref_mutability.
Proof. destruct typing_mode; cbn; auto. Qed.

Lemma inert_loc_ref_corr : forall T,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T v_loc ->
  typ_corr (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T T /\
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T v_ref.
Proof.
  intros T H. dependent destruction H.
  - split.
    + eapply typ_corr_fun. exact H.
    + eapply inert_typ_fun. exact H.
  - unfold refcap_inert_type in H0.
    destruct (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) eqn:Eref.
    + cbn in H0.
      assert (Ecorr : mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode = mode_refcap_corr_same)
        by (apply mode_refcap_corr_none; exact Eref).
      split.
      * eapply typ_corr_obj. unfold typ_refcap_corr. rewrite Ecorr. reflexivity.
      * eapply inert_typ_obj.
        -- exact H.
        -- unfold refcap_inert_type. rewrite Eref. cbn. exact H0.
        -- exact H1.
    + cbn in H0. dependent destruction H0.
      assert (Ecorr : mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode =
                      mode_refcap_corr_ref_mutability)
        by (apply mode_refcap_corr_mutability; exact Eref).
      split.
      * eapply typ_corr_obj. unfold typ_refcap_corr. rewrite Ecorr.
        exists typ_bot. split; reflexivity.
      * eapply inert_typ_obj.
        -- exact H.
        -- unfold refcap_inert_type. rewrite Eref. cbn.
           eapply refacp_inert_mutability_ref.
        -- exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_of_binds_loc : forall G v Ty,
  ctx_ok G -> inert G -> ctx_k G v v_loc -> ctx_binds v Ty G ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) Ty v_loc.
Proof.
  intros G v Ty Hok Hinert Hk Hb.
  destruct (@ctx_k_binds_k_after typing_mode G v v_loc Hk) as [T [G2 Hka]].
  assert (HbT : ctx_binds v T G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
  assert (Ity : inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T v_loc)
    by (eapply (@inert_k_typ typing_mode G v v_loc T G2); eassumption).
  assert (E : T = Ty) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; eassumption).
  subst. exact Ity.
Qed.

(** * Function-item extraction once the heap item is known to be a function. *)

Lemma fun_item_static_from_bind : forall G e Sigma y tf,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma ->
  exists S0 T0 L,
    ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0) G /\
    (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
         (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0)) /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma y tf Hhc Hb.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hydom : y \in dom Sigma)
    by (eapply get_some_inv; apply binds_get; exact Hb).
  destruct (@ty_item_s_inv typing_mode G e Sigma y (Hitem y Hydom)) as [HF|HO].
  - destruct HF as [S0 [T0 [t0 [L [Hmf [Hcb [Hbind [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]].
    assert (tf = t0) by (eapply binds_functional; eassumption).
    subst t0.
    exists S0, T0, L. split; [exact Hcb|]. split; assumption.
  - destruct HO as [U [S [ds [T [Hcb [Hbind _]]]]]].
    exfalso. pose proof (@binds_functional item _ y (item_fun tf) (item_obj ds) Sigma Hb Hbind) as E.
    discriminate E.
Qed.

(** * Conditional reduction of [canon_fun_apply].

    The remaining inputs are exactly:
      - selector elimination / the choice of the function heap item [tf] for
        [x] (captured by [binds x y e] and [binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma]);
      - the two function-subtyping compatibility facts [Sarg <: S0] and
        [open z T0h <: Tstack] for the static function type of that item;
      - the heap-closedness needed for the [closed_below 1 tf] conclusion,
        which is not implied by [heap_correspond]. *)

Lemma canon_fun_apply_from_item : forall G e Sigma x T0 Sarg Tres Tstack z y tf,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  heap_closed Sigma ->
  binds x y e ->
  binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma ->
  (forall S0 T0h L,
     ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0h) G ->
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
        ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
          (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0h)) ->
     @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref ->
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack) ->
  exists y0 tf0 S0 T0h L,
    binds x y0 e /\
    binds y0 (item_fun tf0) Sigma /\
    ctx_binds y0 (typ_fun S0 T0h) G /\
    (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
         (open x0 tf0) (open x0 T0h)) /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf0 v_ref /\
    closed_below 1 tf0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x T0 Sarg Tres Tstack z y tf Hhc Hch Hbxy Hby Hcompat.
  destruct (@fun_item_static_from_bind G e Sigma y tf Hhc Hby)
    as [S0 [T0h [L [Hcby [Hbody Htf]]]]].
  destruct (Hcompat S0 T0h L Hcby Hbody Htf) as [HsubS Hsubz].
  assert (Hcl : closed_below 1 tf)
    by (eapply closed_below_fun_item_of_bind; eassumption).
  exists y, tf, S0, T0h, L. repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

(** * Conditional reduction of [canon_fld_read_weak].

    The remaining inputs are the field-canonical data (which needs selector
    elimination) and the static stored-type relation [Ty <: V].  The
    [ty_corr]/inertness bridge from the location type to a reference type is
    proved unconditionally by [inert_loc_ref_corr]. *)

Lemma canon_fld_read_weak_from_field_data :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U V Tstack y ds v Ty,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  inert G ->
  ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  binds x y e ->
  binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) ->
  ctx_k G v v_loc ->
  ctx_binds v Ty G ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Ty V ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
  exists y0 ds0 v0 Ty0 Tw,
    binds x y0 e /\
    binds y0 (item_obj ds0) Sigma /\
    defs_has ds0 (def_fld a (avar_f v0)) /\
    ctx_k G v0 v_loc /\
    ctx_binds v0 Ty0 G /\
    typ_corr Tw Ty0 /\
    inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x T0 a S U V Tstack y ds v Ty Hhc Hinert Hkx
         Hbxy Hby Hhas Hkv Hbyv HsubTyV HsubVT.
  assert (Hok : ctx_ok G) by (eapply heap_correspond_ctx_ok; exact Hhc).
  assert (Ity : inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) Ty v_loc)
    by (eapply inert_typ_of_binds_loc; eassumption).
  destruct (@inert_loc_ref_corr Ty Ity) as [Hcorr Hir].
  assert (HTwT : subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Ty Tstack)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption).
  exists y, ds, v, Ty, Ty.
  split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hby|]. split; [exact Hhas|].
  split; [exact Hkv|]. split; [exact Hbyv|]. split; [exact Hcorr|].
  split; [exact Hir|exact HTwT].
Qed.

(** * Residual interface.

    The two requested static interfaces are reduced above to the following
    exact remaining facts.

    [canon_fun_apply] additionally needs:
      (a) [heap_closed Sigma] (or any other source of closedness): it is NOT
          implied by [heap_correspond], yet [closed_below 1 tf] is required;
      (b) selection of a heap item [binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma]
          from [ty_var x T0] and [T0 <: typ_fun Sarg Tres], i.e. the full
          function canonical form;
      (c) the compatibility facts [Sarg <: S0] and
          [open z T0h <: Tstack] for the static function type
          [typ_fun S0 T0h] stored at that item.  The interface as stated has
          no hypothesis relating [Tstack] to [Tres]; a caller normally also
          has [open z Tres <: Tstack] (from [ty_trm_apply_inv]), which is
          absent from the interface.  Hence the interface as written is not
          derivable from its stated hypotheses alone.

    [canon_fld_read_weak] additionally needs:
      (a) the field-canonical data
          [binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\ defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v))]
          for the field label [a], i.e. selector elimination plus item
          canonical forms;
      (b) the static stored-type relation [Ty <: V] for the chosen location
          type [Ty] of [v] (or a direct [Ty <: Tstack] relation).

    Everything else in both interfaces is discharged here:
    [ctx_k]/[ctx_binds] extraction, [inert_typ Ty v_loc -> typ_corr Ty Ty /
    inert_typ Ty v_ref], transitivity [Ty <: V <: Tstack], heap-item function
    body/all-tfree extraction, and heap-closedness to [closed_below 1 tf]. *)

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma tyq_var_swp : forall e (v1 v2:var), typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  forall sx sy, swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
  typing_equiv e (swp_var sx sy v1) (swp_var sx sy v2).
Proof.
  intros e v1 v2 H. induction H; intros sx sy Hf.
  - apply tyq_var_refl.
  - apply tyq_var_binds. eapply binds_swp_fixed; eauto.
  - apply tyq_var_sym. apply IHtyq_var. exact Hf.
  - eapply tyq_var_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma tyq_typ_swp : forall e (T1 T2:typ), typing_equiv e T1 T2 ->
  forall sx sy, swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
  typing_equiv e (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2).
Proof.
  intros e T1 T2 H. induction H; intros sx sy Hf.
  - apply tyq_typ_nulary. apply typ_nulary_swp. exact H.
  - destruct H as [|]; cbn.
    + eapply tyq_typ_andor; [apply typ_andor_and | apply IHtyq_typ; exact Hf | apply IHtyq_typ0; exact Hf].
    + eapply tyq_typ_andor; [apply typ_andor_or | apply IHtyq_typ; exact Hf | apply IHtyq_typ0; exact Hf].
  - eapply tyq_typ_fun.
    + apply IHtyq_typ. exact Hf.
    + intros x. specialize (H1 (swp_var sx sy x) sx sy Hf).
      repeat rewrite swp_typ_open in H1. repeat rewrite swp_typ_open in H1.
      rewrite swp_var_invol in H1. exact H1.
  - eapply tyq_typ_fld; eauto.
  - eapply tyq_typ_typ.
    + intros x. specialize (H0 (swp_var sx sy x) sx sy Hf).
      repeat rewrite swp_typ_open in H0. rewrite swp_var_invol in H0. exact H0.
    + intros x. specialize (H2 (swp_var sx sy x) sx sy Hf).
      repeat rewrite swp_typ_open in H2. rewrite swp_var_invol in H2. exact H2.
  - eapply tyq_typ_sel_normal.
    apply tyq_var_swp; [ exact H | exact Hf ].
  - apply tyq_typ_sel.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev2 Weaken_proof Context_lemmas Typing_subst Subst_extra Subst_typing.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Fresh-name facts for one-way substitution. *)

Lemma typ_x_notin_subst : forall (T:typ) x y,
  y <> x -> x \notin fv (subst_var x y T).
Proof.
  intros T x y Hxy H. apply typ_fv_subst_mem in H.
  destruct H as [E|[H _]]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma dec_x_notin_subst : forall (D:dec) x y,
  y <> x -> x \notin fv (subst_var x y D).
Proof.
  intros D x y Hxy H. apply dec_fv_subst_mem in H.
  destruct H as [E|[H _]]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma trm_x_notin_subst : forall (t:trm) x y,
  y <> x -> x \notin fv (subst_var x y t).
Proof.
  intros t x y Hxy H. apply trm_fv_subst_mem in H.
  destruct H as [E|[H _]]; auto.
Qed.

(** [swp_ctx sx sy] fixes a context when both names are fresh from it. *)

Lemma swp_ctx_fresh_id : forall (G:ctx) sx sy,
  sx \notin ctx_dom G -> sx \notin ctx_fv G ->
  sy \notin ctx_dom G -> sy \notin ctx_fv G ->
  swp_ctx sx sy G = G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|G IH v vk T|G IH|G IH]; intros sx sy
    Hxd Hxf Hyd Hyf; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite notin_union in Hxd, Hxf, Hyd, Hyf.
    destruct Hxd as [Hxd Hvx], Hxf as [Hxf Htx].
    destruct Hyd as [Hyd Hvy], Hyf as [Hyf Hty].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hvx, Hvy.
    assert (Ev : swp_var sx sy v = v).
    { apply swp_var_other; [ exact Hvx | exact Hvy ]. }
    assert (ET : swp_typ sx sy T = T).
    { apply swp_typ_fresh; assumption. }
    rewrite Ev, ET, IH; auto.
  - rewrite IH; auto.
  - rewrite IH; auto.
Qed.

(** The opening-name instance [x = x0] of the [subtyp_typ] substitution case.

    For every target opening name [x], produce the substituted bounding
    subtyping.  The only nontrivial instance is [x = x0]; it is obtained from
    the already-substituted instance at a fresh [y] by swapping [y] and [x0].
    Both names are fresh from the (fixed) target context and environment. *)

Lemma subtyp_typ_open_at_dropped : forall (G:ctx) e x0 z (S1 S2:typ),
  x0 \notin ctx_dom G -> x0 \notin ctx_fv G ->
  x0 \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) ->
  z <> x0 ->
  (forall y, y <> x0 ->
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e
       (open y (subst_var x0 z S2)) (open y (subst_var x0 z S1))) ->
  forall x,
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e

  x <> x0 ->
  subst_var x0 z (open_rec n x T) = open_rec n x (subst_var x0 z T).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (@typ_subst_open_commut T x0 z x n).
  rewrite (@subst_var_neq x0 z x H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_open_met_neq : forall (T:typ) x0 z x y,
  x <> x0 -> y <> x0 ->
  subst_var x0 z (open_met x y T) =
  open_met x y (subst_var x0 z T).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite typ_subst_open_met.
  repeat rewrite (@subst_var_neq x0 z _ H).
  rewrite (@subst_var_neq x0 z _ H0). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tyq_typ_open_at_dropped : forall e x0 z (T U:typ),
  x0 \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) -> z <> x0 ->
  (forall x, x <> x0 ->
     typing_equiv e (open x (subst_var x0 z T))
                    (open x (subst_var x0 z U))) ->
  forall x,
    typing_equiv e (open x (subst_var x0 z T))
                   (open x (subst_var x0 z U)).
Proof.
  intros e x0 z T U Hxe Hzx HIH x.
  destruct (classicT (x = x0)) as [Ex|Nx].
  - subst x.
    destruct (var_fresh (dom e \u fv_env e \u \{x0} \u \{z} \u
                         fv T \u fv U \u fv (subst_var x0 z T) \u
                         fv (subst_var x0 z U))) as [y Hy].
    assert (Hyx0 : y <> x0).
    { intro E. apply Hy. subst y. repeat rewrite in_union.
      repeat rewrite in_union in E. repeat rewrite in_singleton in E.
      repeat rewrite in_singleton. tauto. }
    assert (Hye : y \notin (dom e \u fv_env e)).
    { intro E. apply Hy. repeat rewrite in_union.
      repeat rewrite in_union in E. tauto. }
    assert (HySub2 : y \notin fv (subst_var x0 z T)).
    { intro E. apply Hy. repeat rewrite in_union.
      repeat rewrite in_union in E. tauto. }
    assert (HySub1 : y \notin fv (subst_var x0 z U)).
    { intro E. apply Hy. repeat rewrite in_union.
      repeat rewrite in_union in E. tauto. }
    assert (Hf : swp_renv_fixed y x0 e).

      - rewrite notin_union. rewrite notin_union in Hye. exact Hye.
      - rewrite notin_union. rewrite notin_union in Hxe. exact Hxe. }
    pose proof (@tyq_typ_swp e (open y (subst_var x0 z T))

    repeat rewrite swp_typ_open in Hsw.

    rewrite (@swp_typ_fresh (subst_var x0 z T) y x0 HySub2

    rewrite (@swp_typ_fresh (subst_var x0 z U) y x0 HySub1
               (@typ_x_notin_subst U x0 z Hzx)) in Hsw.
    exact Hsw.
  - apply HIH. exact Nx.
Qed.

Section TyqSubstFinal.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma tyq_var_subst : forall e (v1 v2:var), typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  forall x0 z, x0 \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) ->
    typing_equiv e (subst_var x0 z v1) (subst_var x0 z v2).
Proof.
  intros e v1 v2 H. induction H; intros x0 z Hxe.
  - apply tyq_var_refl.
  - apply tyq_var_binds.
    rewrite notin_union in Hxe. destruct Hxe as [Hxdom Hxfv].
    assert (Hv1 : v1 <> x0).
    { intro E. subst x0. apply Hxdom. eapply binds_in_dom; exact H. }
    assert (Hv2 : v2 <> x0).
    { intro E. subst x0.
      pose proof (@fv_in_values_binds var x0 (@fv var VarFreeVar) v1 v2 e H Hxfv) as Hnv.
      apply Hnv. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
    rewrite (@subst_var_neq x0 z v1 Hv1).
    rewrite (@subst_var_neq x0 z v2 Hv2). exact H.
  - apply tyq_var_sym. apply IHtyq_var. exact Hxe.
  - eapply tyq_var_trans; [ apply IHtyq_var1; exact Hxe | apply IHtyq_var2; exact Hxe ].
Qed.

Lemma tyq_typ_subst : forall e (T1 T2:typ), typing_equiv e T1 T2 ->
  forall x0 z, x0 \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) -> z <> x0 ->
    typing_equiv e (subst_var x0 z T1) (subst_var x0 z T2).
Proof.
  intros e T1 T2 H. induction H; intros x0 z Hxe Hzx.
  - apply tyq_typ_nulary. apply typ_nulary_subst. exact H.
  - destruct H as [|]; cbn.
    + eapply tyq_typ_andor; [apply typ_andor_and | apply IHtyq_typ; auto | apply IHtyq_typ0; auto].
    + eapply tyq_typ_andor; [apply typ_andor_or | apply IHtyq_typ; auto | apply IHtyq_typ0; auto].
  - eapply tyq_typ_fun.
    + apply IHtyq_typ; auto.
    + apply (@tyq_typ_open_at_dropped e x0 z t12 t22); auto.
      intros x Nx.
      pose proof (H1 x x0 z Hxe Hzx) as Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t12 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t22 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
      exact Hx.
  - eapply tyq_typ_fld; eauto.
  - eapply tyq_typ_typ.
    + apply (@tyq_typ_open_at_dropped e x0 z t11 t21); auto.
      intros x Nx.
      pose proof (H0 x x0 z Hxe Hzx) as Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t11 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t21 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
      exact Hx.
    + apply (@tyq_typ_open_at_dropped e x0 z t12 t22); auto.
      intros x Nx.
      pose proof (H2 x x0 z Hxe Hzx) as Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t12 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t22 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
      exact Hx.
  - eapply tyq_typ_sel_normal. apply tyq_var_subst; auto.
  - apply tyq_typ_sel.
  - eapply tyq_typ_bnd.
    apply (@tyq_typ_open_at_dropped e x0 z t1 t2); auto.
    intros x Nx.
    pose proof (H0 x x0 z Hxe Hzx) as Hx.
    rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t1 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
    rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t2 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
    exact Hx.
  - eapply tyq_typ_met.
    + apply (@tyq_typ_open_at_dropped e x0 z t11 t21); auto.
      intros x Nx.
      pose proof (H0 x x0 z Hxe Hzx) as Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t11 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq t21 x0 z x 0 Nx) in Hx.
      exact Hx.
    + apply IHtyq_typ; auto.
    + apply (@tyq_typ_open_met_at_dropped e x0 z t13 t23); auto.
      intros x y Nx Ny.
      pose proof (H3 x y x0 z Hxe Hzx) as Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_met_neq t13 x0 z x y Nx Ny) in Hx.
      rewrite (@subst_open_met_neq t23 x0 z x y Nx Ny) in Hx.
      exact Hx.
Qed.

End TyqSubstFinal.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Selector-free subtyping.

    [subtyp_nosel] is the fragment of subtyping consisting of the rules that
    are available in the function modes and that do not use the selector
    rules [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].  In the function modes the additional
    top/nocap/mutability rules are disabled; the no-capability rules are
    included because [subtyp_nocap_fun] is enabled. *)

Inductive subtyp_nosel : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ns_top : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T typ_top
| ns_bot : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_bot T
| ns_refl : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T T
| ns_trans : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U
| ns_and11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) T
| ns_and12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) U
| ns_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S (typ_and T U)
| ns_or11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_or T U)
| ns_or12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e U (typ_or T U)
| ns_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_or S U) T
| ns_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U1 U2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ns_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ns_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ns_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    subtyp_nosel G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
     subtyp_nosel (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ns_tyq : forall G e T1 T2,

      (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))

Lemma subtyp_nosel_sound : forall G e S T,
  subtyp_nosel G e S T -> subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e S T H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.

  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - eapply subtyp_and2; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_or11.
  - apply subtyp_or12.

(** * Two context-free "safe source" predicates. *)

Inductive NoFun : typ -> Prop :=
| nf_top : NoFun typ_top
| nf_bnd : forall T, NoFun (typ_bnd T)
| nf_and : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_and T U)
| nf_or_l : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun (typ_or T U)
| nf_or_r : forall T U, NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_or T U).

Inductive NoField : typ -> Prop :=
| nfield_top : NoField typ_top
| nfield_bnd : forall T, NoField (typ_bnd T)
| nfield_fun : forall S T, NoField (typ_fun S T)
| nfield_and : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField U -> NoField (typ_and T U)
| nfield_or_l : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField (typ_or T U)
| nfield_or_r : forall T U, NoField U -> NoField (typ_or T U).

Lemma NoFun_rcd_false : forall D, NoFun (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_fun_false : forall S T, NoFun (typ_fun S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_nocap_false : NoFun typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_sel_false : forall x A y, NoFun (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_bot_false : NoFun typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma NoField_rcd_false : forall D, NoField (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_nocap_false : NoField typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_sel_false : forall x A y, NoField (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_bot_false : NoField typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Equivalence preserves both safety predicates. *)

Lemma NoFun_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoFun T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoFun U.
Proof.
  intros e T U Hnf Heq. change (tyq_typ e T U) in Heq.
  revert Hnf. induction Heq; intros Hnf.
  - (* nulary *) exact Hnf.
  - (* andor *) dependent destruction H.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nf_and, nf_or_l, nf_or_r.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nf_and, nf_or_l, nf_or_r.
  - (* fun *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* fld *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* typ *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel normal *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* bnd *) apply nf_bnd.
  - (* met *) inversion Hnf.
Qed.

Lemma NoField_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoField T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoField U.
Proof.
  intros e T U Hnf Heq. change (tyq_typ e T U) in Heq.
  revert Hnf. induction Heq; intros Hnf.
  - (* nulary *) exact Hnf.
  - (* andor *) dependent destruction H.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nfield_and, nfield_or_l, nfield_or_r.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nfield_and, nfield_or_l, nfield_or_r.
  - (* fun *) apply nfield_fun.
  - (* fld *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* typ *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel normal *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* bnd *) apply nfield_bnd.
  - (* met *) inversion Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Closure of [NoFun] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoFun_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoFun T -> NoFun U.
Proof.
  intros G e T U H. dependent induction H; intros Hnf.
  - (* top *) apply nf_top.
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* refl *) exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nf_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nf_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nf_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* fun *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_fun_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* tyq *) eapply NoFun_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst.
    match goal with Hx : NoFun (typ_rcd _) |- _ => inversion Hx end.
  - (* dist *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    match goal with
    | H1 : NoFun ?A, Hor : NoFun (typ_or ?B ?C) |- _ =>
      inversion Hor; subst;
      [ apply nf_or_l; apply nf_and; [exact H1|assumption]
      | apply nf_or_r; apply nf_and; [exact H1|assumption] ]
    end.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_typ *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fld *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_met *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fun *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Closure of [NoField] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoField_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoField T -> NoField U.
Proof.
  intros G e T U H. dependent induction H; intros Hnf.
  - (* top *) apply nfield_top.
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoField_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* refl *) exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nfield_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nfield_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nfield_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* fun *) apply nfield_fun.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* tyq *) eapply NoField_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst.
    match goal with Hx : NoField (typ_rcd _) |- _ => inversion Hx end.
  - (* dist *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    match goal with
    | H1 : NoField ?A, Hor : NoField (typ_or ?B ?C) |- _ =>
      inversion Hor; subst;
      [ apply nfield_or_l; apply nfield_and; [exact H1|assumption]
      | apply nfield_or_r; apply nfield_and; [exact H1|assumption] ]
    end.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fun *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Inert sources in function modes are either functions or [NoFun]/[NoField]. *)

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofun : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoFun T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nf_and; [apply nf_bnd|apply nf_top].
Qed.

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofield : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoField T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nfield_and; [apply nfield_bnd|apply nfield_top].
Qed.

(** * The selector-free canonical-form targets. *)

Lemma inert_subtyp_fun_nosel : forall G e T vk S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G e T vk S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofun T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hnf].
  - exists S0, U0; exact HT.
  - exfalso. apply (@NoFun_fun_false S U).
    eapply (@NoFun_subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U)); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_subtyp_not_field_nosel : forall G e T vk a S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G e T vk a S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofield T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hf].
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.
    pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S0 U0)
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub (nfield_fun S0 U0)) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
  - pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e T
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub Hf) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4 Canonical5.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Opened type-member bounds.

    [OpenedSub G e S T] says that the selector lower bound [S] and upper
    bound [T] are related after opening at every name.  For a record
    declaration with equal (or bottom-lower) bounds, this follows directly
    from the premises of [subtyp_typ]. *)

Definition OpenedSub (G:ctx) (e:renv) (S T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) (open y T).

Lemma opened_sub_of_subtyp_typ : forall G e A Q1 Q2 S T,
  record_dec (dec_typ A Q1 Q2) ->
  (forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) (open y Q1)) ->
  (forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y Q2) (open y T)) ->
  OpenedSub G e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e A Q1 Q2 S T Hdec HS HQ y.
  destruct Hdec.
  - (* equal bounds Q1 = Q2 = Q *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply HS.
    + eapply subtyp_trans.
      * apply HQ.
      * reflexivity.
  - (* lower bound bot, upper Q2 *)
    eapply subtyp_trans.
    + apply HS.
    + eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_bot).
      * apply subtyp_bot.
      * apply HQ.
Qed.

(** If the receiver's declaration admits [OpenedSub S T], then every type
    which the selector subtypes is already a supertype of the opened lower
    bound.  In particular the selector step can be bypassed. *)

Lemma sel_subtyp_bypass : forall G e x A y S T U,
  G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
  OpenedSub G e S T ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)) U ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) U.
Proof.
  intros G e x A y S T U Hx Hop Usel.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := open y T).
  - apply Hop.
  - eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)).
    + eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hx.
    + exact Usel.
Qed.

(** The same statement with the opened upper bound exposed. *)

Lemma sel_target_sub : forall G e x A y S T U,
  G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)) U ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y T) U.
Proof.
  intros. eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)).
  - eapply subtyp_sel1. eassumption.
  - eassumption.
Qed.

(** A selector only extends its lower bound: if the lower bound's opened form
    is [NoFun]/[NoField], then the selector's upper-bound safety is the only
    remaining question.  This is the precise receiver-bound invariant needed
    by Canonical5. *)

Definition ReceiverOpenedSub (G:ctx) (e:renv) : Prop :=
  forall x A S T,
    inert G ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) ->
    OpenedSub G e S T.

(** Under [ReceiverOpenedSub], every selector use can be replaced by the
    corresponding opened-bound subtyping, so any chain that reaches a
    function/field through a selector can be transformed into one whose
    selector detours are transparent.  We record the concrete local
    consequence used by the canonical-form proof. *)

Lemma receiver_opened_sub_elim : forall G e x A S T U,
  inert G ->
  ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) ->
  ReceiverOpenedSub G e ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)) U ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) U.
Proof.
  intros G e x A S T U Hir Hx Hrec Usel.
  eapply sel_subtyp_bypass.
  - eapply (proj1 (ty_var_sub_elim typing_mode Hx)).
    (* the direct type of x is the record; reconstruct the typing premise *)
    admit.
Abort.

End WithTypingMode.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  - reflexivity.
  - apply f_equal. apply swp_var_other.
    + apply notin_singleton in H. intro E. apply H. symmetry. exact E.
    + apply notin_singleton in H0. intro E. apply H0. symmetry. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma swp_typ_dec_fresh :
  (forall (T:typ) sx sy, sx \notin fv T -> sy \notin fv T -> swp_typ sx sy T = T)
  /\ (forall (D:dec) sx sy, sx \notin fv D -> sy \notin fv D -> swp_dec sx sy D = D).
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros D IH sx sy Hx Hy. cbn in Hx, Hy |-. cbn. rewrite (IH sx sy Hx Hy). reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy Hx Hy.
    cbn in Hx, Hy. rewrite notin_union in Hx, Hy. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2]. destruct Hy as [Hy1 Hy2].
    cbn. rewrite (IH1 sx sy Hx1 Hy1), (IH2 sx sy Hx2 Hy2). reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy Hx Hy.
    cbn in Hx, Hy. rewrite notin_union in Hx, Hy. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2]. destruct Hy as [Hy1 Hy2].
    cbn. rewrite (IH1 sx sy Hx1 Hy1), (IH2 sx sy Hx2 Hy2). reflexivity.
  - intros a1 l a2 sx sy Hx Hy. cbn in Hx, Hy |-. cbn.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx, Hy. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2]. destruct Hy as [Hy1 Hy2].
    rewrite (@swp_avar_fresh sx sy a1 Hx1 Hy1), (@swp_avar_fresh sx sy a2 Hx2 Hy2). reflexivity.
  - intros T IH sx sy Hx Hy. cbn in Hx, Hy |-. cbn. rewrite (IH sx sy Hx Hy). reflexivity.
  - intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy Hx Hy.
    cbn in Hx, Hy. rewrite notin_union in Hx, Hy. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2]. destruct Hy as [Hy1 Hy2].
    cbn. rewrite (IH1 sx sy Hx1 Hy1), (IH2 sx sy Hx2 Hy2). reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy Hx Hy. cbn in Hx, Hy |-. cbn.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx, Hy. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2]. destruct Hy as [Hy1 Hy2].
    rewrite (IH1 sx sy Hx1 Hy1), (IH2 sx sy Hx2 Hy2). reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 sx sy Hx Hy. cbn in Hx, Hy |-. cbn.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx, Hy. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2]. destruct Hy as [Hy1 Hy2].
    rewrite (IH1 sx sy Hx1 Hy1), (IH2 sx sy Hx2 Hy2). reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 sx sy Hx Hy. cbn in Hx, Hy |-. cbn.
    change (sx \notin (fv T1 \u fv T2 \u fv T3)) in Hx.
    change (sy \notin (fv T1 \u fv T2 \u fv T3)) in Hy.
    repeat rewrite notin_union in Hx, Hy.
    destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx23]. destruct Hx23 as [Hx2 Hx3].
    destruct Hy as [Hy1 Hy23]. destruct Hy23 as [Hy2 Hy3].
    rewrite (IH1 sx sy Hx1 Hy1), (IH2 sx sy Hx2 Hy2), (IH3 sx sy Hx3 Hy3). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_typ_fresh : forall (T:typ) sx sy,
  sx \notin fv T -> sy \notin fv T -> swp_typ sx sy T = T.
Proof. intros. apply (proj1 swp_typ_dec_fresh); assumption. Qed.

Section OpenInjective.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma avar_open_fresh_injective : forall n (x:var) (a b:avar),
  x \notin fv a -> x \notin fv b ->
  open_rec n x a = open_rec n x b -> a = b.
Proof.
  intros n x a b Ha Hb H.
  destruct a as [i|y]; destruct b as [j|z]; cbn in Ha, Hb.
  - (* b / b *)
    destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [Ei|Ni].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x Ei) in H.
      destruct (classicT (n = j)) as [Ej|Nj].
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq j n x Ej) in H.
        subst i. subst j. reflexivity.
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j n x Nj) in H. discriminate H.
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x Ni) in H.
      destruct (classicT (n = j)) as [Ej|Nj].
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq j n x Ej) in H. discriminate H.
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j n x Nj) in H. injection H as E. subst j. reflexivity.
  - (* b / f *)
    rewrite (avar_open_f z n x) in H.
    destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [Ei|Ni].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x Ei) in H.
      injection H as E. exfalso. cbn in Hb. rewrite notin_singleton in Hb. exact (Hb E).
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x Ni) in H. discriminate H.
  - (* f / b *)
    rewrite (avar_open_f y n x) in H.
    destruct (classicT (n = j)) as [Ej|Nj].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq j n x Ej) in H.
      injection H as E. exfalso. cbn in Ha. rewrite notin_singleton in Ha. exact (Ha (eq_sym E)).
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j n x Nj) in H. discriminate H.
  - (* f / f *)
    rewrite (avar_open_f y n x) in H. rewrite (avar_open_f z n x) in H.
    injection H as E. subst z. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typ_dec_open_indep_injective :
  (forall (T:typ) n x,
      typ_indep (avar_b n) T -> x \notin fv T ->
      forall U, typ_indep (avar_b n) U -> x \notin fv U ->
        open_rec n x T = open_rec n x U -> T = U)
  /\
  (forall (D:dec) n x,
      typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D) -> x \notin fv D ->
      forall D', typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D') -> x \notin fv D' ->
        open_rec n x D = open_rec n x D' -> D = D').
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - (* top *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* bot *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rcd *) intros D IHD n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| |D'| | | | | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as E. f_equal. eapply IHD; eassumption.
  - (* and *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | |U1 U2| | | | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as Ho1 Ho2.
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion HU; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    cbn in Hx, HxU.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in HxU; destruct HxU as [HxU1 HxU2].
    assert (E1 : T1 = U1) by (eapply IH1; eassumption).
    assert (E2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* or *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | |U1 U2| | | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as Ho1 Ho2.
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion HU; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    cbn in Hx, HxU.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in HxU; destruct HxU as [HxU1 HxU2].
    assert (E1 : T1 = U1) by (eapply IH1; eassumption).
    assert (E2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* sel *) intros a1 l a2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | | |b1 l' b2| | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with

  | typ_bot        => typ_bot

  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)

  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with

  intros ds d. unfold defs_has. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := label_of d = label_of d) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_cons_other : forall (ds:defs) (d d':def),
  label_of d <> label_of d' -> defs_has ds d' -> defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d'.
Proof.
  intros ds d d' Hne Hh. unfold defs_has in *. cbn.
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := label_of d = label_of d') Hne).
  assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_has_contra : forall (ds:defs) (d:def) l,
  defs_hasnt ds l -> defs_has ds d -> label_of d = l -> False.
Proof.
  intros ds d l Hn Hh He. unfold defs_hasnt, defs_has in *.
  rewrite He in Hh. rewrite Hh in Hn. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_label : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> label_of d = label_of D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_record_dec : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H.
  - (* def_typ *) apply rd_typ.
  - (* def_fld *) apply rd_fld.
  - (* def_met *) eapply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rcd_inv : forall (D:dec) ls,
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) ls -> ls = singleton (label_of D).
Proof.
  intros D ls H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) ls ->
  exists ls' l, ls = ls' \u singleton l /\ record_typ T ls' /\
                l = label_of D /\ l \notin ls'.
Proof.
  intros T D ls H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  exists ls0, (label_of D). split; [reflexivity|]. split; [eassumption|]. split; [reflexivity|eassumption].
Qed.

  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  (exists ls, record_typ T ls) /\

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma record_typ_has : forall (T:typ) ls,
  record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls -> exists D, record_has T D /\ label_of D = l.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H as [D l0 Hdec Heq|T ls D l0 Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot].
  - intros l Hl. rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    exists D. split; [eapply rh_one|]. symmetry. exact Heq.
  - intros l Hl. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + destruct (IH l Hl) as [D' [Hhas Heq']]. exists D'.
      split; [eapply rh_andl; eauto| exact Heq'].
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. exists D.
      split; [eapply rh_andr; eapply rh_one| symmetry; exact Heq].
Qed.

Lemma label_of_open_dec : forall (D:dec) n x,
  label_of (open_rec n x D) = label_of D.
Proof. intros D n x. destruct D; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open : forall (D:dec) n x, record_dec D -> record_dec (open_rec n x D).
Proof.
  intros D n x H. destruct H.
  - cbn. apply rd_typ.
  - cbn. apply rd_typb.
  - cbn. apply rd_fld.
  - cbn. apply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open : forall (T:typ) ls n x,
  record_typ T ls -> record_typ (open_rec n x T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls n x H. induction H.
  - eapply rt_one; [apply record_dec_open; eauto | rewrite label_of_open_dec; assumption].
  - eapply rt_cons; [exact IHrecord_typ | apply record_dec_open; eauto | rewrite label_of_open_dec; assumption | assumption].

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

Lemma typ_dec_open_indep_injective :
  (forall (T:typ) n x,
      typ_indep (avar_b n) T -> x \notin fv T ->
      forall U, typ_indep (avar_b n) U -> x \notin fv U ->
        open_rec n x T = open_rec n x U -> T = U)
  /\
  (forall (D:dec) n x,
      typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D) -> x \notin fv D ->
      forall D', typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D') -> x \notin fv D' ->
        open_rec n x D = open_rec n x D' -> D = D').
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - (* top *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* bot *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rcd *) intros D IHD n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| |D'| | | | | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    assert (ET2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* sel *) intros a1 l a2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | | |b1 l' b2| | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as E1 El E2. subst l'.
    cbn in Hx, HxU.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in HxU; destruct HxU as [HxU1 HxU2].
    assert (Ea : a1 = b1) by (eapply avar_open_fresh_injective; eassumption).
    assert (Eb : a2 = b2) by (eapply avar_open_fresh_injective; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* bnd *) intros T IH n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | | | |U| |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as E. cbn in Hx, HxU.
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion HU; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    f_equal. eapply IH; eassumption.
  - (* fun *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | | | | |U1 U2|]; cbn in *; try discriminate.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext Indep Equivalence.
Require Import Weak_obj_extension Defs_lemmas.

Section RecordDecOpenInv.

Lemma record_dec_open_inv : forall n x (D:dec),
  typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D) ->
  x \notin fv D ->
  record_dec (open_rec n x D) ->
  record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros n x D Hti Hx Hdec.
  destruct D as [A S T|a S T|m TC TZ TR].
  - (* dec_typ *)
    cbn in Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [HS HT].
    cbn in Hdec. dependent destruction Hdec.
    + (* rd_typ *)
      inversion Hti; subst.
      assert (E : S = T).
      { eapply (proj1 typ_dec_open_indep_injective); eauto. }
      subst. apply rd_typ.
    + (* rd_typb *)
      inversion Hti; subst.
      assert (E : S = typ_bot).
      { eapply (proj1 typ_dec_open_indep_injective) with (U := typ_bot);
          eauto using typ_indep_nulary, typ_nulary_bot.
        cbn. apply notin_empty. }
      subst. apply rd_typb.
  - (* dec_fld *)
    cbn in Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [HS HT].
    cbn in Hdec. dependent destruction Hdec.
    inversion Hti; subst.
    assert (E : S = T).
    { eapply (proj1 typ_dec_open_indep_injective); eauto. }
    subst. apply rd_fld.
  - (* dec_met *)
    dependent destruction Hdec. apply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open_inv : forall (T:typ) ls x,
  typ_indep (avar_b 0) T ->
  x \notin fv T ->
  record_typ (open_rec 0 x T) ls ->
  record_typ T ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls x Hti Hx Hrec. generalize dependent T. generalize dependent x.
  induction Hrec as [D l Hdec Hl | T0 ls0 D l Hrec0 IH Hdec Hl Hnot];
    intros x T Hti Hx.
  - (* rt_one *)
    destruct T as [| |D0|T1 T2|T1 T2|a1 l0 a2|T0|T1 T2|]; cbn in *;
      try (inversion Hrec; fail).
    + (* typ_and *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_or *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_sel *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_bnd *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_fun *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_rcd D0 *)
      injection Hrec as ED. subst D.
      assert (HtiD : typ_indep (avar_b 0) (typ_rcd D0)) by exact Hti.
      assert (HxD : x \notin fv D0).
      { cbn in Hx |- *. exact Hx. }
      assert (Hdec0 : record_dec D0).
      { eapply (record_dec_open_inv 0 x); eauto. }
      assert (Hl0 : l = label_of D0).
      { rewrite <- Hl. rewrite (@label_of_open_dec D0 0 x). reflexivity. }
      eapply rt_one; eauto.
  - (* rt_cons *)
    destruct T as [| |D0|T1 T2|T1 T2|a1 l0 a2|T0|T1 T2|]; cbn in *;
      try (inversion Hrec; fail).
    + (* typ_and T1 T2 *)
      injection Hrec as EU ED. subst T0.
      cbn in Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
      inversion Hti; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary (typ_and _ _) |- _ => inversion Hn end).
      assert (HrecT1 : record_typ T1 ls0).
      { eapply IH; eauto. }
      assert (HrecD : record_typ (typ_rcd D) (singleton l)).
      { eapply rt_one; [ eapply record_dec_open_inv; eauto | reflexivity ]. }
      (* D was obtained by opening T2; invert T2 *)
      admit.
    + (* typ_or *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_sel *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_bnd *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_fun *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_rcd *) inversion Hrec.
Admitted.

End RecordDecOpenInv.

    + (* typ_sel *) inversion Hrec.
    + (* typ_bnd *) inversion Hrec.

    + (* typ_rcd *) inversion Hrec.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Heap_fun Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Subst_typing Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_fun Weak_let_fun.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Object-literal weak progress.

    The only missing ingredient is the object analogue of
    [heap_correspond_extend_fun]: transporting the object-literal body typing
    under [objctx_lit w T] to a heap-item typing under [objctx_heap y T] after
    dereferencing [w] to [y].  It is isolated below as
    [weak_obj_extension].  Everything else is proved unconditionally. *)

Lemma notin_fv_objlit : forall (T:typ) z,
  z \notin fv (typ_objlit typing_mode T) -> z \notin fv T.
Proof.
  intros T z H.
  destruct (mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode); cbn in H;
    repeat rewrite notin_union in H; tauto.
Qed.

Variable weak_obj_extension :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) (ds:defs) (L:fset var),
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_lit x T) e (open x ds) (open x T)) ->
    w \notin L ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
    w \notin ctx_fv G -> y \notin ctx_fv G ->
    w \notin fv T -> y \notin fv T ->
    y \notin dom Sigma -> w \notin dom e ->
    heap_correspond
      (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
         § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T))
      (e & w ~ y)
      (Sigma & y ~ item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds)))
    /\
    inert (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
             § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)).

Theorem weak_tp_lit_obj_cond : forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm)
    Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c',
    config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros T ds t Sigma e Lv fs U Hweak.
  destruct Hweak as [G Hwc].
  inversion Hwc as
    [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_lit_inv Hty) as [Tlit0 [Lbody [Vbody [Hlit [Hbody Hsub]]]]].
  destruct (ty_lit_obj_inv Hlit) as [Lobj [ETlit [Hds Hindep]]].
  subst Tlit0.
  set (Tlit := typ_objlit typing_mode T).
  set (Cold := (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
  set (F := fv_config Cold
              \u (ctx_dom G \u (ctx_fv G \u (fv Tlit \u (Lbody \u Lobj))))).
  destruct (var_fresh F) as [y HyF].
  destruct (var_fresh (F \u \{y})) as [w HwFy].
  assert (HwF : w \notin F).
  { intro Hin. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwY : w <> y).
  { intro E. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. exact E. }
  assert (HyW : y <> w) by (intro E; apply HwY; symmetry; exact E).
  unfold F in HyF. unfold F in HwF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HyF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HwF.
  destruct HyF as [HyOld HyRest].

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma notin_fv_objlit_strong : forall (T:typ) z,
  z \notin fv T -> z \notin fv (typ_objlit typing_mode T).
Proof.
  intros T z H.
  destruct (mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode); cbn;
    repeat rewrite notin_union; repeat split; auto using notin_empty.
Qed.

Lemma objlit_inert_loc : forall (T:typ),
  record_type T -> typ_indep_b 0 T ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) (typ_objlit typing_mode T) v_loc.
Proof.
  intros T Hrec Hind.
  destruct typing_mode; cbn.
  all: eapply inert_typ_obj; [ exact Hrec | | exact Hind ].
  all: try apply refcap_typ_top.
  all: try apply refacp_inert_mutability_loc.
Qed.

Lemma objlit_inert_ref : forall (T:typ),
  record_type T -> typ_indep_b 0 T ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) (typ_objlit typing_mode T) v_ref.
Proof.
  intros T Hrec Hind.
  destruct typing_mode; cbn.
  all: eapply inert_typ_obj; [ exact Hrec | | exact Hind ].
  all: try apply refcap_typ_top.
  all: try (apply refacp_inert_mutability_ref with (Tbnd:=typ_bot)).
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section ExtendRenv.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma renv_corr_extend_obj : forall G e (w y:var) (Tlit:typ),
  renv_corr G e -> typ_corr Tlit Tlit ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
  renv_corr (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) (e & w ~ y).
Proof.
  intros G e w y Tlit Hrenv Hcorr HwG HyG Hwy.
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tlit w Hin) as [E|Hw].
    - subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    - apply HwG. exact Hw. }
  assert (HR : renv_corr (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) e).
  { eapply renv_corr_push.
    - eapply renv_corr_push; [exact Hrenv|exact HyG].
    - exact HwGy. }
  eapply (renv_corr_ref (G1 := G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit)
                        (G2 := G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit) (G3 := G)
                        (Tw := Tlit) (Ty := Tlit)).
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
  - exact Hcorr.
  - exact HR.
Qed.

End ExtendRenv.

Section ObjItem.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma obj_item_typing : forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var)
    (T:typ) (ds':defs),
  w <> y ->
  y \notin ctx_dom G ->
  w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)) ->
  @ty_defs typing_mode
    (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T))
    (objctx_heap y T) (e & w ~ y) ds' (open y T) ->
  defs_varkinds
    (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T))
    ds' ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode
    (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T))
    (e & w ~ y) (Sigma & y ~ item_obj ds') y.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y T ds' Hwy HyG HwGy Hdefs Hvk.
  assert (Hcb : ctx_binds y (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
      (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T))).
  { eapply ctx_binds_n.
    - intro E. apply Hwy. symmetry. exact E.
    - eapply ctx_binds_e. }
  destruct (mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode) eqn:E.
  - cbn in *.
    eapply ty_item_obj_s with (U := T) (S := typ_top).
    + exact Hcb.
    + apply binds_push_eq.
    + reflexivity.
    + exact Hdefs.
    + exact Hvk.
  - cbn in *.
    eapply ty_item_obj_s with (U := T) (S := typ_mut_marker typ_bot).
    + exact Hcb.
    + apply binds_push_eq.
    + reflexivity.
    + exact Hdefs.
    + exact Hvk.
Qed.

End ObjItem.

Section Main.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Definition objlit (T:typ) := typ_objlit typing_mode T.
Definition objG (G:ctx) y w T := (G § y / v_loc ~ objlit T § w / v_ref ~ objlit T).
Definition objE (e:renv) w y := e & w ~ y.
Definition objDS (e:renv) w y (ds:defs) := deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds).
Definition objSigma (Sigma:heap) y e w ds := Sigma & y ~ item_obj (objDS e w y ds).

End Main.

Section OpenInjective.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma avar_open_fresh_injective : forall n (x:var) (a b:avar),
  x \notin fv a -> x \notin fv b ->
  open_rec n x a = open_rec n x b -> a = b.
Proof.
  intros n x a b Ha Hb H.
  destruct a as [i|y]; destruct b as [j|z]; cbn in Ha, Hb.
  - (* b / b *)
    destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [Ei|Ni].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x Ei) in H.
      destruct (classicT (n = j)) as [Ej|Nj].
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq j n x Ej) in H.
        subst i. subst j. reflexivity.
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j n x Nj) in H. discriminate H.
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x Ni) in H.
      destruct (classicT (n = j)) as [Ej|Nj].
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq j n x Ej) in H. discriminate H.
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j n x Nj) in H. injection H as E. subst j. reflexivity.
  - (* b / f *)
    rewrite (avar_open_f z n x) in H.
    destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [Ei|Ni].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x Ei) in H.
      injection H as E. exfalso. cbn in Hb. rewrite notin_singleton in Hb. exact (Hb E).
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x Ni) in H. discriminate H.
  - (* f / b *)
    rewrite (avar_open_f y n x) in H.
    destruct (classicT (n = j)) as [Ej|Nj].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq j n x Ej) in H.
      injection H as E. exfalso. cbn in Ha. rewrite notin_singleton in Ha. exact (Ha (eq_sym E)).
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j n x Nj) in H. discriminate H.
  - (* f / f *)
    rewrite (avar_open_f y n x) in H. rewrite (avar_open_f z n x) in H.
    injection H as E. subst z. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typ_dec_open_indep_injective :
  (forall (T:typ) n x,
      typ_indep (avar_b n) T -> x \notin fv T ->
      forall U, typ_indep (avar_b n) U -> x \notin fv U ->
        open_rec n x T = open_rec n x U -> T = U)
  /\
  (forall (D:dec) n x,
      typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D) -> x \notin fv D ->
      forall D', typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D') -> x \notin fv D' ->
        open_rec n x D = open_rec n x D' -> D = D').
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - (* top *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* bot *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rcd *) intros D IHD n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| |D'| | | | | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as E. f_equal. eapply IHD; eassumption.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ty_trm_sub_elim : forall G e t U,
  ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t U ->
  exists T, ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e t U H. induction H.
  - (* var *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* apply *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_apply; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* read *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_read; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* write *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_write; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* call *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_call; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* let *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_let; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* lit *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_lit; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* sub *) destruct IHty_trm as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_sub_elim : forall G e x U,
  ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x U ->
  exists T, ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e x U H. induction H.
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_var_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_intro; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_elim; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - exists (typ_and T U); split; [eapply ty_var_and; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - destruct IHty_var as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_var_mut_top; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
Qed.

Lemma trm_empty_head : forall t T,
  ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  (exists s u, t = trm_let s u) \/ (exists l u, t = trm_lit l u).
Proof.
  intros t T H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty empty t T) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  all: try (exfalso;
    match goal with Hx : ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ ?x ∶ _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (ty_var_in_dom Hx) as Hd; cbn in Hd; rewrite in_empty in Hd; assumption end).
  all: try (left; eexists; eexists; reflexivity).
  all: try (right; eexists; eexists; reflexivity).
  all: try (apply IHty_trm; reflexivity).

Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma fresh_two : forall L y w, y \notin L -> w \notin L -> w <> y -> fresh L 2 (y :: w :: nil).
Proof.
  intros L y w Hy Hw Hyw. unfold fresh. cbn. split; [exact Hy|]. split.
  - apply notin_union_l; [exact Hw|]. apply notin_singleton. exact Hyw.
  - exact I.
Qed.

Lemma red_let_step : forall (s u:trm) fs Sigma e Lv,
  exists C', (trm_let s u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ C'.
Proof. intros. eexists. eapply red_let_push. Qed.

Lemma red_lit_step : forall (l:lit) (u:trm) fs Sigma e Lv,
  exists C', (trm_lit l u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ C'.
Proof.
  intros l u fs Sigma e Lv.
  set (L := fv_config (trm_lit l u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
  destruct (var_fresh L) as [y Hy].
  destruct (var_fresh (L \u \{y})) as [w Hw].
  rewrite notin_union in Hw. destruct Hw as [HwL Hwy].
  rewrite notin_singleton in Hwy.
  assert (Hf : fresh L 2 (y :: w :: nil)) by (apply fresh_two; auto).
  assert (Hyw : y <> w) by (intro E; subst; apply Hwy; reflexivity).
  destruct l as [T t1|T ds].
  - exists (open w u ; fs ; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1) ; e & w ~ y ;
              fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    eapply red_let_fun.
    + cbn. exact Hf.
    + exact Hyw.
  - exists (open w u ; fs ;
              Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))) ; e & w ~ y ;
              fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) u ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    eapply red_let_obj.
    + cbn. exact Hf.
    + intro E. apply Hyw. symmetry. exact E.
Qed.

Section WithTypingMode_step.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma config_initial_step : forall (t:trm) T Lv,
  ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  exists C', (t ; stack_nil ; empty ; empty ; Lv) ↦ C'.
Proof.
  intros t T Lv Hty.
  destruct (trm_empty_head Hty) as [[s [u E]]|[l [u E]]]; subst t.
  - apply red_let_step.
  - apply red_lit_step.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode_step.
