Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4 Canonical5.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Opened type-member bounds.

    [OpenedSub G e S T] says that the selector lower bound [S] and upper
    bound [T] are related after opening at every name.  For a record
    declaration with equal (or bottom-lower) bounds, this follows directly
    from the premises of [subtyp_typ]. *)

Definition OpenedSub (G:ctx) (e:renv) (S T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) (open y T).

Lemma opened_sub_of_subtyp_typ : forall G e A Q1 Q2 S T,
  record_dec (dec_typ A Q1 Q2) ->
  (forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) (open y Q1)) ->
  (forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y Q2) (open y T)) ->
  OpenedSub G e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e A Q1 Q2 S T Hdec HS HQ y.
  inversion Hdec; subst.
  - (* equal bounds *)
    eapply subtyp_trans; [apply HS|apply HQ].
  - (* lower bound bot *)
    eapply subtyp_trans; [apply HS|apply subtyp_bot].
Qed.

(** The two selector rules say exactly that the lower bound subtypes every
    supertype of the selector, while every subtype of the selector subtypes
    the opened upper bound. *)

Lemma sel_lower_bypass : forall G e x A y S T U,
  G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)) U ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) U.
Proof.
  intros G e x A y S T U Hx Usel.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)).
  - eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Hx.
  - exact Usel.
Qed.

Lemma sel_upper_preimage : forall G e x A y S T U,
  G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (open y T).
Proof.
  intros G e x A y S T U Hx Usel.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)).
  - exact Usel.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hx.
Qed.

(** A selector only extends its lower bound: if the lower bound's opened form
    is [NoFun]/[NoField], then the selector's upper-bound safety is the only
    remaining question.  This is the precise receiver-bound invariant needed
    by Canonical5. *)

Definition ReceiverOpenedSub (G:ctx) (e:renv) : Prop :=
  forall x A S T,
    inert G ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) ->
    OpenedSub G e S T.

(** Under [ReceiverOpenedSub], every selector use can be replaced by the
    corresponding opened-bound subtyping, so any chain that reaches a
    function/field through a selector can be transformed into one whose
    selector detours are transparent.  We record the concrete local
    consequence used by the canonical-form proof. *)

End WithTypingMode.

(** * Residual analysis for the suggested syntax-directed [SafeRec].

    A standalone inductive [SafeRec] on type syntax does not close under
    [subtyp] without additional derivation information.  Two concrete rule
    shapes break a purely syntactic constructor set:

    - [subtyp_or11]/[subtyp_or12]: from a safe source [T] we obtain
      [typ_or T U] for an arbitrary [U].  An [or] is only a usable source
      through [subtyp_or2], which requires BOTH components to subtype the
      target; therefore the safe component set of an [or] cannot simply be
      the union/disjunction of its components, nor can [or] be declared
      unconditionally safe.

    - [subtyp_and2]: an [and] target combines two independent subtyping
      derivations whose targets need not be reachable from the original
      inert source.  Closure again needs the two components' derivations,
      not just their syntax.

    Selector bounds make this worse: [subtyp_sel2] turns a safe lower bound
    into a selector, while [subtyp_sel1] exposes the receiver's upper bound;
    the receiver's safety is a property of a *typing derivation*, not of the
    selector's syntactic arguments.

    The unconditional facts proved above ([OpenedSub] from [record_dec]

    ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap that carries the inert receiver binding and its
    record_dec provenance, i.e. [ReceiverOpenedSub] plus its use in
    eliminating selector detours. *)

(** * Note on Type-valued derivation trees.

    Mirroring the cofinite premises of [subtyp_typ], [subtyp_fun] and
    [subtyp_met] requires constructor fields of the form

      forall x, x \notin L -> subtyp_d (G § x / vk ~ S) ... .

    Such a field is a function returning a recursive tree.  Coq's guard
    checker does not accept a recursive call on the result of applying such a

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Selector-free subtyping.

    [subtyp_nosel] is the fragment of subtyping consisting of the rules that
    are available in the function modes and that do not use the selector
    rules [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].  In the function modes the additional
    top/nocap/mutability rules are disabled; the no-capability rules are
    included because [subtyp_nocap_fun] is enabled. *)

Inductive subtyp_nosel : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ns_top : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T typ_top
| ns_bot : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_bot T
| ns_refl : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T T
| ns_trans : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U
| ns_and11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) T
| ns_and12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) U
| ns_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S (typ_and T U)
| ns_or11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_or T U)
| ns_or12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e U (typ_or T U)
| ns_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_or S U) T
| ns_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U1 U2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ns_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ns_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ns_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    subtyp_nosel G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
     subtyp_nosel (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ns_tyq : forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2
| ns_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ns_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ns_nocap_bnd : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ns_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ns_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
.

Lemma subtyp_nosel_sound : forall G e S T,
  subtyp_nosel G e S T -> subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e S T H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - eapply subtyp_and2; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_or11.
  - apply subtyp_or12.
  - eapply subtyp_or2; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fld; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_typ; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fun; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_met; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_tyq; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_typ_and.
  - apply subtyp_dist.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_bnd.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_typ.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_fld.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_met.
  - eapply subtyp_nocap_fun; eassumption.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Context Defs Heap.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
.

Scheme tfree_trm_mut    := Induction for tfree_trm Sort Prop
with   tfree_lit_mut    := Induction for tfree_lit Sort Prop
with   tfree_def_mut    := Induction for tfree_def Sort Prop
with   tfree_defs_mut   := Induction for tfree_defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme tfree_mutind from tfree_trm_mut, tfree_lit_mut,
tfree_def_mut, tfree_defs_mut.

Inductive tfree_stack: TFree stack :=

| tfree_stack_cons_l v t st:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons (frame_let t) st)
| tfree_stack_cons_r v f st:
  tfree_stack v st ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons f st)
.

Existing Instance tfree_trm.

Existing Instance tfree_lit.

Existing Instance tfree_def.

Existing Instance tfree_defs.

Existing Instance tfree_stack.

Definition all_tfree_k {A: Set} {AT: TFree A} G (t:A) vk :=
  forall v, tfree v t -> ctx_k G v vk.

Notation all_tfree_k_trm := (@all_tfree_k trm _).

Notation all_tfree_k_def := (@all_tfree_k def _).

Notation all_tfree_k_defs := (@all_tfree_k defs _).

Notation all_tfree_k_stack := (@all_tfree_k stack _).

Definition TFreeInFV (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AF: FreeVar A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    v \in fv t.

Local Definition TFreeOpenInvInd (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AO: Openable A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    forall k x tR,
      t = (open_rec k x tR) ->
      tfree v tR \/ v = x.

Class TFreeOpenInv(A : Set)(AT: TFree A){AO: Openable A} :=
  tfree_open_inv v x (t:A) n:
    tfree v (open_rec n x t) ->
    tfree v t \/ v = x
.

Local Definition TFreeOpenInd (A: Set) (AT: TFree A) {AO: Openable A} :=
  forall v t,
    tfree v t ->
    forall k x,
    tfree v (open_rec k x t).

Class TFreeOpen(A : Set)(AT: TFree A){AO: Openable A} :=
  tfree_open v x (t:A) n:
    tfree v t ->
    tfree v (open_rec n x t).

Section TFreeOpenLemmata.

Context (A: Set) {AT: TFree A} {AO: Openable A} {ATO: TFreeOpenInv AT}.

End TFreeOpenLemmata.
===
Lemma fv_open_cases_item : forall (it:item) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x it) = fv it \/ fv (open_rec n x it) = \{x} \u fv it.
Proof.
  intros it n x. destruct it as [ds|t]; cbn.
  - apply fv_open_cases_defs.
  - apply fv_open_cases_trm.
Qed.

(** * tfree for stacks *)

Lemma tfree_stack_open : forall (s:stack) v, tfree_stack v s -> forall n x, tfree_stack v (open_rec n x s).
Proof.
  intros s v H. induction H; intros n x; cbn.
  - eapply tfree_stack_cons_l. apply tfree_trm_open. assumption.
  - eapply tfree_stack_cons_r. apply IHtfree_stack.
Qed.

Lemma tfree_stack_open_inv : forall (s:stack) v x n,
  tfree_stack v (open_rec n x s) -> tfree_stack v s \/ v = x.
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|f fs IH]; intros v x n H.
  - cbn in H. inversion H.
  - destruct f as [t]. cbn in H. inversion H; subst.
    + match goal with
      | Ht : tfree_trm _ (open_rec _ _ t) |- _ =>
        destruct (@tfree_trm_open_inv t _ _ _ Ht) as [H1|H1]; subst;
          [ left; eapply tfree_stack_cons_l; eassumption | right; reflexivity ]
      end.
    + match goal with
      | Hs : tfree_stack _ (open_rec _ _ fs) |- _ =>
        destruct (IH _ _ _ Hs) as [H1|H1]; subst;
          [ left; eapply tfree_stack_cons_r; eassumption | right; reflexivity ]
      end.
Qed.

(** * all_tfree_k transfer *)

Lemma all_tfree_k_trm_weaken : forall G G' t vk,
  all_tfree_k_trm G t vk ->
  (forall z, ctx_k G z vk -> ctx_k G' z vk) ->
  all_tfree_k_trm G' t vk.
Proof. intros G G' t vk H Hk v Hv. apply Hk. apply H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_lit_weaken : forall G G' l vk,
  all_tfree_k_lit G l vk ->
  (forall z, ctx_k G z vk -> ctx_k G' z vk) ->
  all_tfree_k_lit G' l vk.
Proof. intros G G' l vk H Hk v Hv. apply Hk. apply H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_def_weaken : forall G G' d vk,
  all_tfree_k_def G d vk ->
  (forall z, ctx_k G z vk -> ctx_k G' z vk) ->
  all_tfree_k_def G' d vk.
Proof. intros G G' d vk H Hk v Hv. apply Hk. apply H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_defs_weaken : forall G G' ds vk,
  all_tfree_k_defs G ds vk ->
  (forall z, ctx_k G z vk -> ctx_k G' z vk) ->
  all_tfree_k_defs G' ds vk.
Proof. intros G G' ds vk H Hk v Hv. apply Hk. apply H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_stack_weaken : forall G G' s vk,
  all_tfree_k_stack G s vk ->
  (forall z, ctx_k G z vk -> ctx_k G' z vk) ->
  all_tfree_k_stack G' s vk.
Proof. intros G G' s vk H Hk v Hv. apply Hk. apply H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_trm_open : forall G t vk,
  all_tfree_k_trm G t vk -> forall x, ctx_k G x vk ->
  all_tfree_k_trm G (open_rec 0 x t) vk.
Proof.
  intros G t vk H x Hx v Hv.
  destruct (@tfree_trm_open_inv t v x 0 Hv) as [Ht|He]; subst.
  - apply H. assumption.
  - apply Hx.
Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_lit_open : forall G l vk,
  all_tfree_k_lit G l vk -> forall x, ctx_k G x vk ->

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Vars Context Objctx Envs Env Types ConfigNotations.

(** * Basic context facts *)

Lemma ctx_kdom_push_eq : forall vk G v T,
  ctx_kdom vk (ctx_push G v vk T) = singleton v \u ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := vk = vk) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_kdom_push_neq : forall vk vk' G v T,
  vk <> vk' ->
  ctx_kdom vk (ctx_push G v vk' T) = ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_r (P := vk = vk') H). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_binds : forall x vk T G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G1 G2 -> ctx_binds x T G1.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G1 G2 H. induction H.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_kdom : forall x vk T G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G1 G2 -> x \in ctx_kdom vk G1.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v vk0 t G|v v2 vk1 vk2 t t2 G1' G2 Hne H IH].
  - rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - destruct (classicT (vk1 = vk2)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite <- E. rewrite ctx_kdom_push_eq. rewrite in_union. right. exact IH.
    + erewrite ctx_kdom_push_neq; [exact IH|exact N].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ x \in ctx_kdom vk G.
Proof.
  intros G x vk [T [G2 H]]. exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; eauto.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_kdom; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_kdom_in_dom : forall vk G x,
  x \in ctx_kdom vk G -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros vk G. induction G as [|G IH v vk2 T|G IH|G IH]; intros x Hx.

  - cbn in Hx. cbn. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Equivalence Indep.

Require Export TypingMode TypingContext.

Notation EnvProperty A B := (forall (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Notation TypingProperty A B := (forall (G:ctx) (Go: objctx) (e:renv) (v: A) (T: B), Prop).

Class DecTyping (A : Set) := obj_dec_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> dec -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (obj_dec_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Typing (A : Set) := obj_typing: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> A -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (obj_typing G Go e t T) (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation typing G e a t := (obj_typing G objctx_empty e a t).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶' T" := (typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Notation dec_typing G e a d := (obj_dec_typing G objctx_empty e a d).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ t '∶d' T" := (dec_typing G e t T) (at level 40, e at level 39, t at level 59).

Class Subtyping := subtyping: ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '⁏' e '⊢' T '<:' U" := (subtyping G objctx_empty e T U) (at level 40, e at level 39, T at level 59).

Class ReferenceIncapacitate := obj_ref_incap :
                                 ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" := (obj_ref_incap G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation ref_incap G e T1 T2 := (obj_ref_incap G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶icp' T2" :=
  (ref_incap G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Class CapabilityBound (C : typ_refcap_label) :=
  obj_cap_bnd :
     ctx -> objctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop.

Notation "G '§§' Go '⁏' e  ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧  T2" := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G Go e T1 T2)
  (at level 40, Go at level 39, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation cap_bnd C G e T1 T2 := (@obj_cap_bnd C _ G objctx_empty e T1 T2).

Notation "G '⁏' e ⊢ T1 '∶cpb' ⟦ C ⟧ T2" := (cap_bnd C G e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_cap_adapt C x Tcap := (
  typ_cap_marker C (typ_or Tcap
    (typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_refcap C) (avar_b 0))
  )).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y S) <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: (open y T)

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <: typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G⁏e ⊢
     typ_and
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
=====INERT
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes.

Notation typ_objref T S := (typ_and (typ_bnd T) S) (only parsing).

Notation typ_objref_loc typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => (typ_objref T typ_top)
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => (typ_objref T (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end)(only parsing).

Inductive refcap_inert_mutability: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=
| refacp_inert_mutability_loc: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) v_loc
| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

Notation obj_typ_is cond T S vk := (
      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

Notation fun_typ_is cond S T := (
      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

Notation fun_type U := (exists S T, fun_typ_is (eq U) S T) (only parsing).

Notation obj_type typing_mode U := (exists T S, obj_typ_is typing_mode (eq U) T S) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive inert_vk: varkind -> Prop :=
  | inert_vk_loc: inert_vk v_loc
  | inert_vk_ref: inert_vk v_ref.

Inductive inert_typ: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=

  | inert_typ_fun S T vk:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    fun_typ_is inert_typ S T vk

  | inert_typ_obj T S vk:
    obj_typ_is inert_typ T S vk.

Definition inert_type T := exists vk, inert_typ T vk.

Inductive inert: ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty: inert ctx_empty
  | inert_push G x vk T:
      inert G ->
      inert_vk vk ->
      inert_typ T vk ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      inert (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments inert [typing_mode].

Arguments inert_typ {typing_mode}.

Arguments inert_type {typing_mode}.

Inductive fresh_telescope : ctx -> Prop :=
  | fresh_telescope_empty : fresh_telescope ctx_empty
  | fresh_telescope_push : forall G x vk T,
      fresh_telescope G ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      fresh_telescope (G § x / vk ~ T).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

      for
      subst_typ) x0 z S2) /[->
    x] <:
  ((fix subst_typ (z u : var) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
      match T with
      | typ_top => typ_top
      | typ_bot => typ_bot
      | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
      | typ_and T1 T2 => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
      | typ_or T1 T2 => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
      | typ_sel x0 L y => typ_sel x0 /[ z -> u] L y /[ z -> u]
      | typ_bnd T0 => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T0)
      | typ_fun T0 U => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T0) (subst_typ z u U)
      | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
      end
    with subst_dec (z u : var) (D : dec) {struct D} : dec :=
      match D with
      | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
      | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
      | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
          dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
      end
    for
    subst_typ) x0 z S1) /[->
  x]".

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Selector-free subtyping.

    [subtyp_nosel] is the fragment of subtyping consisting of the rules that
    are available in the function modes and that do not use the selector
    rules [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].  In the function modes the additional
    top/nocap/mutability rules are disabled; the no-capability rules are
    included because [subtyp_nocap_fun] is enabled. *)

Inductive subtyp_nosel : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ns_top : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T typ_top
| ns_bot : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_bot T
| ns_refl : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T T
| ns_trans : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U
| ns_and11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) T
| ns_and12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) U
| ns_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S (typ_and T U)
| ns_or11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_or T U)
| ns_or12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e U (typ_or T U)
| ns_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_or S U) T
| ns_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U1 U2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ns_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ns_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ns_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    subtyp_nosel G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
     subtyp_nosel (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ns_tyq : forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2
| ns_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ns_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ns_nocap_bnd : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ns_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ns_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
.

Lemma subtyp_nosel_sound : forall G e S T,
  subtyp_nosel G e S T -> subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e S T H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - eapply subtyp_and2; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_or11.
  - apply subtyp_or12.
  - eapply subtyp_or2; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fld; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_typ; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fun; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_met; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_tyq; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_typ_and.
  - apply subtyp_dist.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_bnd.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_typ.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_fld.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_met.
  - eapply subtyp_nocap_fun; eassumption.
Qed.

(** * Two context-free "safe source" predicates. *)

Inductive NoFun : typ -> Prop :=
| nf_top : NoFun typ_top
| nf_bnd : forall T, NoFun (typ_bnd T)
| nf_and : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_and T U)
| nf_or_l : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun (typ_or T U)
| nf_or_r : forall T U, NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_or T U).

Inductive NoField : typ -> Prop :=
| nfield_top : NoField typ_top
| nfield_bnd : forall T, NoField (typ_bnd T)
| nfield_fun : forall S T, NoField (typ_fun S T)
| nfield_and : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField U -> NoField (typ_and T U)
| nfield_or_l : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField (typ_or T U)
| nfield_or_r : forall T U, NoField U -> NoField (typ_or T U).

Lemma NoFun_rcd_false : forall D, NoFun (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_fun_false : forall S T, NoFun (typ_fun S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_nocap_false : NoFun typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_sel_false : forall x A y, NoFun (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_bot_false : NoFun typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma NoField_rcd_false : forall D, NoField (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_nocap_false : NoField typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_sel_false : forall x A y, NoField (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_bot_false : NoField typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Equivalence preserves both safety predicates. *)

Lemma NoFun_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoFun T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoFun U.
Proof.
  intros e T U Hnf Heq. change (tyq_typ e T U) in Heq.
  revert Hnf. induction Heq; intros Hnf.
  - (* nulary *) exact Hnf.
  - (* andor *) dependent destruction H.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nf_and, nf_or_l, nf_or_r.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nf_and, nf_or_l, nf_or_r.
  - (* fun *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* fld *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* typ *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel normal *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* bnd *) apply nf_bnd.
  - (* met *) inversion Hnf.
Qed.

Lemma NoField_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoField T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoField U.
Proof.
  intros e T U Hnf Heq. change (tyq_typ e T U) in Heq.
  revert Hnf. induction Heq; intros Hnf.
  - (* nulary *) exact Hnf.
  - (* andor *) dependent destruction H.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nfield_and, nfield_or_l, nfield_or_r.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nfield_and, nfield_or_l, nfield_or_r.
  - (* fun *) apply nfield_fun.
  - (* fld *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* typ *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel normal *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* bnd *) apply nfield_bnd.
  - (* met *) inversion Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Closure of [NoFun] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoFun_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoFun T -> NoFun U.
Proof.
  intros G e T U H. dependent induction H; intros Hnf.
  - (* top *) apply nf_top.
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* refl *) exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nf_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nf_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nf_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* fun *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_fun_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* tyq *) eapply NoFun_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst.
    match goal with Hx : NoFun (typ_rcd _) |- _ => inversion Hx end.
  - (* dist *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    match goal with
    | H1 : NoFun ?A, Hor : NoFun (typ_or ?B ?C) |- _ =>
      inversion Hor; subst;
      [ apply nf_or_l; apply nf_and; [exact H1|assumption]
      | apply nf_or_r; apply nf_and; [exact H1|assumption] ]
    end.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_typ *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fld *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_met *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fun *) exfalso; eapply NoFun_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Closure of [NoField] under selector-free subtyping. *)

Lemma NoField_subtyp_nosel : forall G e T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> NoField T -> NoField U.
Proof.
  intros G e T U H. dependent induction H; intros Hnf.
  - (* top *) apply nfield_top.
  - (* bot *) exfalso; eapply NoField_bot_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* refl *) exact Hnf.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
  - (* and11 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion Hnf; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply nfield_and.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact Hnf.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact Hnf.
  - (* or11 *) apply nfield_or_l. exact Hnf.
  - (* or12 *) apply nfield_or_r. exact Hnf.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* fun *) apply nfield_fun.
  - (* met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_rcd_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* tyq *) eapply NoField_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) exfalso. inversion Hnf; subst.
    match goal with Hx : NoField (typ_rcd _) |- _ => inversion Hx end.
  - (* dist *) inversion Hnf; subst.
    match goal with
    | H1 : NoField ?A, Hor : NoField (typ_or ?B ?C) |- _ =>
      inversion Hor; subst;
      [ apply nfield_or_l; apply nfield_and; [exact H1|assumption]
      | apply nfield_or_r; apply nfield_and; [exact H1|assumption] ]
    end.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_typ *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fld *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_met *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
  - (* nocap_fun *) exfalso; eapply NoField_nocap_false; exact Hnf.
Qed.

(** * Inert sources in function modes are either functions or [NoFun]/[NoField]. *)

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofun : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoFun T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nf_and; [apply nf_bnd|apply nf_top].
Qed.

Lemma inert_mode_fun_or_nofield : forall T vk,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  (exists S U, T = typ_fun S U) \/ NoField T.
Proof.
  intros T vk Hmf Hi.
  destruct (@inert_typ_fun_mode_shape typing_mode Hmf T vk Hi) as
    [[S [U HT]]|[U HT]].
  - left; eexists; eexists; exact HT.
  - right. rewrite HT. apply nfield_and; [apply nfield_bnd|apply nfield_top].
Qed.

(** * The selector-free canonical-form targets. *)

Lemma inert_subtyp_fun_nosel : forall G e T vk S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G e T vk S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofun T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hnf].
  - exists S0, U0; exact HT.
  - exfalso. apply (@NoFun_fun_false S U).
    eapply (@NoFun_subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U)); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_subtyp_not_field_nosel : forall G e T vk a S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G e T vk a S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofield T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hf].
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.
    pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S0 U0)
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub (nfield_fun S0 U0)) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
  - pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e T
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub Hf) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
Qed.

(** * Method analogue of the record-label transport.

    The label of a method declaration is [label_met m]; the formal transport
    statement is recorded here.  [record_typ_has_label] and
    [Canonical.v]'s [defs_has_fld_of_label] give the field analogue; the
    method version needs the corresponding defs-to-method step below. *)

Lemma label_of_met_inv : forall (d:def) m,
  label_of d = label_met m -> exists t, d = def_met m t.
Proof.
  intros d m H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_met : forall G (ds:defs) m t,
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
  exists t', defs_has ds (def_met m t').
Proof. eauto. Qed.

Lemma defs_has_met_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T m,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->

  (xs ys: list var) (a: A): A :=
    let (zs, _) := (var_freshes (from_list xs \u from_list ys \u fv a) (length ys))
    in a /[xs --> zs] /[zs --> ys].

  (subst_pvars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

  open_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation open_depth := (open_depth_rec 0).

Arguments open_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Definition closed `{AS: Openable A} a :=
  forall n x, open_rec n x a = a.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0) (only parsing).

  (open_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

  (open y z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

  (open_vars ys z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Function-item extraction once the heap item is known to be a function. *)

Lemma fun_item_static_from_bind : forall G e Sigma y tf,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma ->
  exists S0 T0 L,
    ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0) G /\
    (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
         (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0)) /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma y tf Hhc Hb.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hydom : y \in dom Sigma)
    by (eapply get_some_inv; apply binds_get; exact Hb).
  destruct (@ty_item_s_inv typing_mode G e Sigma y (Hitem y Hydom)) as [HF|HO].
  - destruct HF as [S0 [T0 [t0 [L [Hmf [Hcb [Hbind [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]].
    assert (E : item_fun tf = item_fun t0)
      by (exact (@binds_functional item y (item_fun tf) (item_fun t0) Sigma Hb Hbind)).
    injection E as E. subst t0.
    exists S0, T0, L. split; [exact Hcb|]. split; assumption.
  - destruct HO as [U [S [ds [T [Hcb [Hbind _]]]]]].
    exfalso. pose proof (@binds_functional item y (item_fun tf) (item_obj ds) Sigma Hb Hbind) as E.
    discriminate E.
Qed.

(** * Conditional reduction of [canon_fun_apply].

    The remaining inputs are exactly:
      - selector elimination / the choice of the function heap item [tf] for
        [x] (captured by [binds x y e] and [binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma]);
      - the two function-subtyping compatibility facts [Sarg <: S0] and
        [open z T0h <: Tstack] for the static function type of that item;
      - the heap-closedness needed for the [closed_below 1 tf] conclusion,
        which is not implied by [heap_correspond]. *)

Lemma canon_fun_apply_from_item : forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T0 Sarg Tres Tstack:typ) (z y:var) (tf:trm),
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  heap_closed Sigma ->
  binds x y e ->
  binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma ->
  (forall S0 T0h L,
     ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0h) G ->
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
        ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
          (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0h)) ->
     @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref ->
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack) ->
  exists y0 tf0 S0 T0h L,
    binds x y0 e /\
    binds y0 (item_fun tf0) Sigma /\
    ctx_binds y0 (typ_fun S0 T0h) G /\
    (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
         (open x0 tf0) (open x0 T0h)) /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf0 v_ref /\
    closed_below 1 tf0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x T0 Sarg Tres Tstack z y tf Hhc Hch Hbxy Hby Hcompat.
  destruct (@fun_item_static_from_bind G e Sigma y tf Hhc Hby)
    as [S0 [T0h [L [Hcby [Hbody Htf]]]]].
  destruct (Hcompat S0 T0h L Hcby Hbody Htf) as [HsubS Hsubz].
  assert (Hcl : closed_below 1 tf)
    by (eapply closed_below_fun_item_of_bind; eassumption).
  exists y, tf, S0, T0h, L. repeat split; assumption.
Qed.


(** * Function interface with the result-type hypothesis supplied by the
    caller ([ty_trm_apply_inv] gives [open z Tres <: Tstack]). *)

Lemma canon_fun_apply_from_item_res :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T0 Sarg Tres Tstack:typ)
         (z y:var) (tf:trm),
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  heap_closed Sigma ->
  binds x y e ->
  binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z Tres) Tstack ->
  (forall S0 T0h L,
     ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0h) G ->
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
        ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
          (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0h)) ->
     @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref ->
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) (open z Tres)) ->
  exists y0 tf0 S0 T0h L,
    binds x y0 e /\
    binds y0 (item_fun tf0) Sigma /\
    ctx_binds y0 (typ_fun S0 T0h) G /\
    (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
         (open x0 tf0) (open x0 T0h)) /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf0 v_ref /\
    closed_below 1 tf0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x T0 Sarg Tres Tstack z y tf Hhc Hch Hbxy Hby Hsres Hcompat.
  destruct (@fun_item_static_from_bind G e Sigma y tf Hhc Hby)
    as [S0 [T0h [L [Hcby [Hbody Htf]]]]].
  destruct (Hcompat S0 T0h L Hcby Hbody Htf) as [HsubS Hrel].
  assert (Hcl : closed_below 1 tf)
    by (eapply closed_below_fun_item_of_bind; eassumption).
  assert (Hsubz : subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption).
  exists y, tf, S0, T0h, L. repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

(** * Conditional reduction of [canon_fld_read_weak].

    The remaining inputs are the field-canonical data (which needs selector
    elimination) and the static stored-type relation [Ty <: V].  The
    [ty_corr]/inertness bridge from the location type to a reference type is
    proved unconditionally by [inert_loc_ref_corr]. *)

Lemma canon_fld_read_weak_from_field_data :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T0:typ) (a:fld_label) (S U V Tstack:typ) (y:var) (ds:defs) (v:var) (Ty:typ),
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  inert G ->
  ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  binds x y e ->
  binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) ->
  ctx_k G v v_loc ->
  ctx_binds v Ty G ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Ty V ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
  exists y0 ds0 v0 Ty0 Tw,
    binds x y0 e /\
    binds y0 (item_obj ds0) Sigma /\
    defs_has ds0 (def_fld a (avar_f v0)) /\
    ctx_k G v0 v_loc /\
    ctx_binds v0 Ty0 G /\
    typ_corr Tw Ty0 /\
    inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x T0 a S U V Tstack y ds v Ty Hhc Hinert Hkx
         Hbxy Hby Hhas Hkv Hbyv HsubTyV HsubVT.
  assert (Hok : ctx_ok G) by (eapply heap_correspond_ctx_ok; exact Hhc).
  assert (Ity : inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) Ty v_loc)
    by (eapply inert_typ_of_binds_loc; eassumption).
  destruct (@inert_loc_ref_corr Ty Ity) as [Hcorr Hir].
  assert (HTwT : subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Ty Tstack)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption).
  exists y, ds, v, Ty, Ty.
  split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hby|]. split; [exact Hhas|].
  split; [exact Hkv|]. split; [exact Hbyv|]. split; [exact Hcorr|].
  split; [exact Hir|exact HTwT].
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import LibExtra.

Generalizable Variables A B.

Declare Scope syntax_scope.

Delimit Scope syntax_scope with S.

Open Scope syntax_scope.

Class Openable (A : Set) := open_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Class FreeVar (A : Set) := fv : A -> vars.

Class SubstVar (A : Set) := subst_var : var -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Openable FreeVar SubstVar.

Arguments open_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Arguments fv _ _ !_ /.

Arguments subst_var _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class AbstractSyntax (A : Set) `(Openable A) `(FreeVar A) `(SubstVar A).

Notation "z '/[' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_var x y z) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_vars := (vars_zip_map subst_var) (only parsing).

Notation "z '/[' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_vars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_pvars `{AS: SubstVar A} `{AF: FreeVar A}
  (xs ys: list var) (a: A): A :=
    let (zs, _) := (var_freshes (from_list xs \u from_list ys \u fv a) (length ys))
    in a /[xs --> zs] /[zs --> ys].

Notation "z '//[' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_pvars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation open := (open_rec 0) (only parsing).

Definition open_depth_rec `{AS : Openable A} n x a d :=
  open_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation open_depth := (open_depth_rec 0).

Arguments open_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Definition closed `{AS: Openable A} a :=
  forall n x, open_rec n x a = a.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0) (only parsing).

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->' y ']'" :=
  (open_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[->' y ']'" :=
  (open y z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[#' n '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_rec_vars n ys z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[-->' ys ']'" :=
  (open_vars ys z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Class Sealable (A: Set) := seal_rec: nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Sealable.

Arguments seal_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Notation seal := (seal_rec 0).

Definition sealed `{AS: Sealable A} a :=
  forall x, seal x a = a.

Definition seal_depth_rec `{AS: Sealable A} n x a d := seal_rec (n+d) x a.

Arguments seal_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Notation "z '/[->>' y ']'" :=
  (seal y z) (at level 7) : syntax_scope.

    Two different issues arise, and they should not be conflated.

    (1) Structural recursion through a cofinite premise.  A constructor field
        of the form

          forall x, x \notin L -> subtyp_d (G § x / vk ~ S) ...

        is a function returning a recursive tree.  Both the generated
        induction principle and an explicit [Fixpoint] do support recursion
        on [f x Hx]: the induction principle is, for example,

          forall P, P leaf ->
            (forall f, (forall x, P (f x)) -> P (node f)) -> forall t, P t,

        and the guard checker accepts the corresponding [Fixpoint] under the
        function argument.  Thus the guard checker is not the obstruction.

    (2) The sort of the source judgment.  The supplied [ty_var], [subtyp]
        and [ty_incap] are [Prop]-valued.  A complete translation from those
        judgments into a [Type]-valued tree is a large elimination
        [Prop -> Type] and is therefore unavailable.  A [Prop]-valued mirror
        does admit both a soundness direction and a complete translation by
        structural recursion, including the cofinite rules.

    The remaining selector obstruction is neither of the above: it is the
    semantic provenance of receiver bounds.  In [subtyp_sel1] the result is
    the receiver's opened upper bound, while in [subtyp_sel2] the source is
    the opened lower bound.  A tree for a variable at a record type can
    contain further selector steps whose receiver is another variable, so a
    syntactic predicate on the current type does not retain the fact that
    the two bounds of that other receiver were produced from a common
    [record_dec] source.  A successful induction must carry this provenance
    through [trans], [and]/[or] formation, and the two selector rules; merely
    mirroring the rules as trees does not supply it.  The unconditional
    facts above ([OpenedSub] from [record_dec] sources and the two selector
    transport lemmas) remain the selector-local ingredients, and
    [ReceiverOpenedSub] is the precise global invariant still missing. *)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Deref HeapUpdate.

Reserved Notation "t1 ↦ t2" (at level 40, t2 at level 39).

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_read : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yVal wVal ds fs,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil) (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wVal); fs; Sigma; e & wVal ~ yVal; fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_write : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yArg wArg Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma'; e; fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_call : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv wArg t ds fs,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_apply : forall yFun wFun wArg Sigma e Lv t fs,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_fun : forall T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_obj : forall T ds t Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma e Lv x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_push : forall s t fs Sigma e Lv,
    (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (s; (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext Defs Defs_lemmas.

(** * Record label structure and subtyping *)

Lemma record_typ_labels_eq : forall (T:typ) ls1 ls2,
  record_typ T ls1 -> record_typ T ls2 -> ls1 = ls2.
Proof.
  intros T ls1 ls2 H1. generalize dependent ls2. induction H1; intros ls2 H2r.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate.
    assert (Hls : ls = ls0) by (apply IHrecord_typ; assumption).
    subst ls0. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_record_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls D,
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of D \in ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrec. generalize dependent D. induction Hrec; intros Dh Hhas.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* andl *) rewrite in_union. left. apply IHHrec. assumption.
    + (* andr *) rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton.
      inversion H5; subst; try discriminate. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** The unrestricted statement
    [record_typ T ls -> T <: typ_rcd D -> record_dec D -> label_of D \in ls]
    is FALSE in the raw subtyping system, because [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2]
    can transport a label out of a type-member bound without the label being
    structurally present in the source record type.  We record an explicit
    counterexample. *)

Section Counterexample.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).
Variables (A: typ_normal_label) (a: fld_label) (x y: var).

Definition ce_target : typ := typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
Definition ce_source : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot ce_target).
Definition ce_G : ctx := ctx_push ctx_empty x v_ref (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) ce_source ce_target)).

Lemma ce_typing : ce_G⁏empty ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) ce_source ce_target).
Proof. eapply ty_var_var. eapply ctx_binds_e. Qed.

Lemma ce_open_source : (ce_source /[-> y]) = ce_source.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ce_open_target : (ce_target /[-> y]) = ce_target.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ce_subtyp : subtyp typing_mode ce_G objctx_empty empty ce_source ce_target.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_normal A) (avar_f y)).
  - eapply subtyp_sel2 with (S := ce_source) (T := ce_target). apply ce_typing.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1 with (S := ce_source) (T := ce_target). apply ce_typing.
Qed.

Lemma ce_record_source : record_typ ce_source (singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))).
Proof.
  eapply rt_one. apply rd_typb. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ce_record_dec_target : record_dec (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
Proof. apply rd_fld. Qed.

Lemma label_fld_not_in_source :
  ~ (label_fld a \in singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))).
Proof.
  rewrite in_singleton. intro E. inversion E.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_record_has_false :
  exists (G:ctx) (e:renv) (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
    record_typ T ls /\ subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T (typ_rcd D) /\
    record_dec D /\ ~ (label_of D \in ls).
Proof.
  exists ce_G, (empty : renv), ce_source, (singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))),
         (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
  split; [apply ce_record_source|]. split; [apply ce_subtyp|]. split.
  - apply ce_record_dec_target.
  - cbn. apply label_fld_not_in_source.
Qed.

End Counterexample.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence.

Inductive record_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| rd_typ : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| rd_typb : forall A T, record_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot T)
| rd_fld : forall a T, record_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| rd_met : forall m TC TZ TR, record_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR)
.

Inductive record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| rt_one : forall D l,
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| rt_cons: forall T ls D l,
  record_typ T ls ->
  record_dec D ->
  l = label_of D ->
  l \notin ls ->
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition record_type T := exists ls, record_typ T ls.

Inductive refcap_dec: dec -> Prop :=
  | refcap_dec_typb lt TU:
    refcap_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap lt) typ_bot TU).

Inductive refcap_typ: typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
  | refcap_typ_top:
      refcap_typ typ_top \{}
  | refcap_typ_one D l:
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      refcap_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
  | refcap_typ_cons T ls D l:
      refcap_typ T ls ->
      refcap_dec D ->
      l = label_of D ->
      l \notin ls ->
      refcap_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (union ls \{l}).

Definition refcap_type T := exists ls, refcap_typ T ls.

Inductive record_has: typ -> dec -> Prop :=
| rh_one : forall D,
    record_has (typ_rcd D) D
| rh_andl : forall T U D,
    record_has T D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D
| rh_andr : forall T U D,
    record_has U D ->
    record_has (typ_and T U) D.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

The counterexample uses source with a type member whose bounds are record. But for fld label a, can selectors produce field subtyping? `subtyp_sel1` yields arbitrary `open y T` which could be a field record, then trans from source record to sel to field record. E.g., source record has type member A with lower bound field record. Then source <: sel <: field. So yes, even from structural record source can reach field record not structurally present. That's the selector issue.

So progress really needs to know that if a *well-typed object value* has field a according to its type via subtyping, then heap has that field. In DOT semantics, the type member bounds are inhabited by the actual selection value, which at runtime resolves to another object whose type has field; but the field a returned by selector is a *different object's* field, not a direct field of the receiver. Wait red_read with receiver wObj expects `defs_has ds (def_fld m ...)` in the *receiver's own* ds. Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes.

Notation typ_objref T S := (typ_and (typ_bnd T) S) (only parsing).

Notation typ_objref_loc typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => (typ_objref T typ_top)
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => (typ_objref T (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
  end)(only parsing).

Inductive refcap_inert_mutability: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=
| refacp_inert_mutability_loc: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) v_loc
| refacp_inert_mutability_ref Tbnd: refcap_inert_mutability (typ_mut_marker Tbnd) v_ref
.

Definition refcap_inert_type {typing_mode: Mode} T vk :=
  match (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) with
  | mode_refcaps_none => refcap_typ T \{}
  | mode_refcaps_mutability => refcap_inert_mutability T vk
  end.

Notation obj_typ_is cond T S vk := (
      record_type T ->
      refcap_inert_type S vk ->
      typ_indep_b 0 T ->
      cond (typ_objref T S) vk) (only parsing).

Notation fun_typ_is cond S T := (
      cond (typ_fun S T)) (only parsing).

Notation fun_type U := (exists S T, fun_typ_is (eq U) S T) (only parsing).

Notation obj_type typing_mode U := (exists T S, obj_typ_is typing_mode (eq U) T S) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive inert_vk: varkind -> Prop :=
  | inert_vk_loc: inert_vk v_loc
  | inert_vk_ref: inert_vk v_ref.

Inductive inert_typ: typ -> varkind -> Prop :=

  | inert_typ_fun S T vk:
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    fun_typ_is inert_typ S T vk

  | inert_typ_obj T S vk:
    obj_typ_is inert_typ T S vk.

Definition inert_type T := exists vk, inert_typ T vk.

Inductive inert: ctx -> Prop :=
  | inert_empty: inert ctx_empty
  | inert_push G x vk T:
      inert G ->
      inert_vk vk ->
      inert_typ T vk ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      inert (G § x / vk ~ T).

End WithTypingMode.

Arguments inert [typing_mode].

Arguments inert_typ {typing_mode}.

Arguments inert_type {typing_mode}.

Inductive fresh_telescope : ctx -> Prop :=
  | fresh_telescope_empty : fresh_telescope ctx_empty
  | fresh_telescope_push : forall G x vk T,
      fresh_telescope G ->
      x §# G ->
      x \notin ctx_fv G ->
      x \notin fv T ->
      fresh_telescope (G § x / vk ~ T).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma all_tfree_k_stack_cons_tail : forall G vk f (fs:stack),
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G (stack_cons f fs) vk ->
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G fs vk.
Proof.
  intros G vk f fs H v Hv. eapply H. eapply tfree_stack_cons_r. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma all_tfree_k_stack_cons_frame : forall G vk (t:trm) fs,
  @all_tfree_k stack _ G (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs) vk ->
  @all_tfree_k trm _ G t vk.
Proof.
  intros G vk t fs H v Hv. eapply H. eapply tfree_stack_cons_l. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma fv_config_old_subset_new_let_var : forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv x fs,
  fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
  \c fv_config (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
Proof.
  intros. intros z Hz. cbn in *. repeat rewrite in_union in *.
  tauto.
Qed.

(** The variable-for-variable opening step: instantiating the cofinite body
    premise at the runtime name [x], using [x]'s direct type [T0] and
    [T0 <: S].  This is the single residual lemma isolated by
    Ctx_term_narrow.v; once the typing-swap/renaming library supplies it,
    preservation for [red_let_var] is complete here. *)

Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

Lemma pres_let_var_rule : forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
  config_typd typing_mode
    (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  config_typd typing_mode
    (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
     fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros t Sigma e Lv x fs U Hcfg.
  inversion Hcfg as [G c0 Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  inversion Hst as [G1 e1 T1 U1 Hsubnil|Lst G1 e1 s1 t1 Sframe Tbody U1 Htail Hbody];
    subst.
  - (* frame_let *)
    destruct (ty_trm_var_inv Hty) as [T0 [Htyvar Hsub]].
    assert (Hclosedframe : closed_below 1 (frame_let t))
      by (eapply closed_stack_cons_frame_below; exact Hcs).
    assert (Hclosedt : closed_below 1 t)
      by (eapply closed_frame_let_body_below; exact Hclosedframe).
    eapply config_typd_c.
    eapply (@ty_config_c typing_mode G e fs Sigma
              (fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv))
              (open x t) Tbody U).
    + apply Hir.
    + apply Hhc.
    + apply Htail.
    + eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_tail. exact Hts.
    + eapply open_body_at_bound.
      * intros z Hz. exact (Hbody z Hz).
      * exact Htyvar.
      * exact Hsub.
    + (* all_tfree_k of the opened body *)
      assert (Htf_body : @all_tfree_k trm _ G t v_ref)
        by (eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_frame; exact Hts).
      assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref).
      { eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_var. }
      eapply all_tfree_k_trm_open; eassumption.
    + (* freshness invariant *)
      destruct Hnf as [[Hdom HfvG] HfvU].
      assert (Hsubfv : fv_config
        (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)
        \c fv_config (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
             fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)))
        by (apply fv_config_old_subset_new_let_var).
      split.
      * split.
        -- intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply Hdom. exact Hz.
        -- intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply HfvG. exact Hz.
      * intros z Hz. apply Hsubfv. apply HfvU. exact Hz.
    + (* has_null *)
      destruct Hnull as [null Hnull]. exists null.
      cbn. repeat rewrite in_union in *. tauto.
    + apply Hsealed.
    + (* config_closed *)
      eapply config_sealed_cfg.
      * apply closed_trm_open_zero. exact Hclosedt.
      * eapply closed_stack_cons_stack. exact Hcs.
      * apply Hch.
    + apply HcU.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.
