Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Progress Preservation_split Reduction_to_PP.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The task target, reduced to (a) the three canonical-form interfaces used by
    progress and (b) the eight per-rule preservation obligations. *)

Theorem soundness_initial_from_canonical_and_preservation
  (canon_fun :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 S U,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_fun S U) ->
      mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
      exists y tf, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
  (canon_fld :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
      exists y ds v, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                    defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)))
  (canon_met :
    forall G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR,
      heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ->
      exists y ds t, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                    defs_has ds (def_met m t))
  (pres_let_push :
    forall (s t:trm) fs Sigma e Lv U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_let s t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (s ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_let s t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_var :
    forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_fun :
    forall (T:typ) (t1 t2:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
      fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
        (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
      y <> w ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open w t2 ; fs ; Sigma & y ~ item_fun t1 ; e & w ~ y ;
         fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_let_obj :
    forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
      fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
        (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
      w <> y ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open w t ; fs ;
         Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))) ; e & w ~ y ;
         fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_read :
    forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yVal wVal:var) ds fs U,
      fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil)
        (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
      binds wObj yObj e ->
      binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
      defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_var (avar_f wVal) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & wVal ~ yVal ;
         fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_write :
    forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yArg wArg:var) Sigma' fs U,
      heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
      binds wObj yObj e ->
      binds wArg yArg e ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_var (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma' ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_call :
    forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (wArg:var) (t:trm) ds fs U,
      binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
      defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
      binds wObj yObj e ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (pres_apply :
    forall (yFun wFun wArg:var) Sigma e Lv (t:trm) fs U,
      binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
      binds wFun yFun e ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      config_typd typing_mode
        (open wArg t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
         fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U)
  (t : trm) (T : typ):
  closed t -> closed T -> ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  exists C, (config_initial t C) /\
    ((exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)) \/
     (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C ⊣n↦* Cn)).
Proof.
  intros Hct HcT Hty.
  eapply soundness_initial_from_progress_preservation.
  - intros c Uc Hc.
    exact (@progress_from_canon typing_mode canon_fun canon_fld canon_met c Uc Hc).
  - intros c c' Uc Hc Hr.
    exact (@preservation_from_rules typing_mode pres_let_var pres_let_fun
             pres_let_obj pres_read pres_write pres_call pres_apply pres_let_push
             c c' Uc Hc Hr).
  - exact Hct.
  - exact HcT.
  - exact Hty.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Preservation, split into one obligation per operational rule.

    [red_let_push] is already proved in Dev5; the remaining hypotheses are the
    exact statements that the per-rule preservation proofs must establish. *)

Variable pres_let_var :
  forall (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_let_fun :
  forall (T:typ) (t1 t2:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
      (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open w t2 ; fs ; Sigma & y ~ item_fun t1 ; e & w ~ y ;
       fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_let_obj :
  forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (y w:var) fs U,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
      (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open w t ; fs ;
       Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))) ; e & w ~ y ;
       fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_read :
  forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yVal wVal:var) ds fs U,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil)
      (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f wVal) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & wVal ~ yVal ;
       fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_write :
  forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (yArg wArg:var) Sigma' fs U,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_var (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma' ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_call :
  forall (yObj wObj:var) m Sigma e Lv (wArg:var) (t:trm) ds fs U,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_apply :
  forall (yFun wFun wArg:var) Sigma e Lv (t:trm) fs U,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (open wArg t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Variable pres_let_push :
  forall (s t:trm) fs Sigma e Lv U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_let s t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    config_typd typing_mode
      (s ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ;
       fv_config (trm_let s t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.

Lemma preservation_from_rules : forall (c c':config) (U:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode c U -> c ↦ c' -> config_typd typing_mode c' U.
Proof.
  intros c c' U Htyp Hred. dependent destruction Hred.
  - eapply pres_read; eauto.
  - eapply pres_write; eauto.
  - eapply pres_call; eauto.
  - eapply pres_apply; eauto.
  - eapply pres_let_fun; eauto.
  - eapply pres_let_obj; eauto.
  - eapply pres_let_var; eauto.
  - (* red_let_push *)
    eapply pres_let_push; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Heap_lookup Context_lemmas Env_set Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_var Preservation_let_push_config Progress.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The variable-substitution opening residual exported by Preservation_let_var. *)
Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

(** Per-term-shape typed progress obligations. *)

Variable tp_read :
  forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_write :
  forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_call :
  forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_apply :
  forall (x z:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

Variable tp_lit :
  forall (l:lit) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv fs U,
    config_typd typing_mode (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
    exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
      (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.

(** * Typed progress. *)

Lemma typed_progress : forall (c:config) (U:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode c U ->
  answer c \/
  (exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\ c ↦ c').
Proof.
  intros c U Hcfg. destruct c as [t s Sigma e Lv].
  inversion Hcfg as [G c0 Uc Htycfg]; subst.
  inversion Htycfg as [G0 e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hnf Hnull Hsealed Hcc HcU];
    subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct t as [a|a m|a b|t1 t2|l t2|a m b|a m b].
  - (* trm_var *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_var_avar (a:=avar_b n) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct s as [|f fs].
      * left. apply nf_loc.
      * destruct f as [t0]. right.
        exists (open x t0 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
                  fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t0) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
        split.
        -- eapply (@pres_let_var_rule typing_mode open_body_at_bound); eauto.
        -- apply red_let_var.
  - (* trm_read *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_read_avar (a:=avar_b n) (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + right. eapply tp_read. eauto.
  - (* trm_apply *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_l Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|z].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_r Hct)) as [y E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_apply. eauto.
  - (* trm_let *)
    right.
    exists (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
              fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    split.
    + eapply pres_let_push_config. eapply config_typd_c. eapply Htycfg.
    + apply red_let_push.
  - (* trm_lit *)
    right. eapply tp_lit. eauto.
  - (* trm_write *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_l (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_r Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_write. eauto.
  - (* trm_call *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_l (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|y].
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.
Require Import Typed_progress Reduction_typed.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Exact task target from the six typed-progress obligations. *)

Theorem soundness_initial_from_typed_progress_obligations
  (open_body_at_bound :
    forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
      (forall z, z \notin L ->
         ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
      ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody)
  (tp_read :
    forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_write :
    forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_call :
    forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_apply :
    forall (x z:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_lit :
    forall (l:lit) (t:trm) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_typd typing_mode (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_lit l t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (t : trm) (T : typ):
  closed t -> closed T -> ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  exists C, (config_initial t C) /\
    ((exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)) \/
     (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C ⊣n↦* Cn)).
Proof.
  intros Hct HcT Hty.
  eapply soundness_initial_from_typed_progress.
  - exact (@typed_progress typing_mode open_body_at_bound tp_read tp_write
             tp_call tp_apply tp_lit).
  - exact Hct.
  - exact HcT.
  - exact Hty.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
seal_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (seal_rec_typ k u T)
                            (seal_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (seal_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (seal_rec_typ k u TZ) (seal_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSealable : Sealable typ := seal_rec_typ.

Instance DecSealable : Sealable dec := seal_rec_dec.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Subst_extra Typing_weaken Context_lemmas.

(** * Variable substitution for typing: context infrastructure.

    The task's exact substitution statements keep the ambient context unchanged.
    That form is NOT provable in general: context binder types are syntax and may
    mention the dummy name [x0], so removing the dummy binding and substituting
    [x0] by [xr] must also substitute the *types stored in the context*.

    This file therefore develops the correct interface:
      - [subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)] is the ambient context after substitution;
      - under [x0 \notin ctx_fv (G1 §& G2)] it is equal to [G1 §& G2]
        ([subst_ctx_id]), recovering the unchanged-context form.
    A concrete obstruction (type selectors mentioning [x0]) is documented at the
    end of the file.  *)

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Substitution on contexts *)

Lemma ctx_dom_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr, ctx_dom (subst_ctx x0 xr G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr; cbn; auto;
    rewrite IHG; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_push_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x vk T x0 xr,
  subst_ctx x0 xr (G § x / vk ~ T) =
  subst_ctx x0 xr G § x / vk ~ subst_var x0 xr T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_subst_ctx : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall x0 xr,
  ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr G).
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros x0 xr; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. auto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_id : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr,
  x0 \notin ctx_fv G -> subst_ctx x0 xr G = G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr Hfv; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite notin_union in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hv HT].
    rewrite (IHG x0 xr HT).
    rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh t x0 xr Hv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_fv_subset : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall z, z \in fv T -> z \in ctx_fv G.
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros z Hz; cbn in *.
  - rewrite in_union. left. exact Hz.
  - rewrite in_union. right. auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

(** ** Binding removal when the looked-up name is not the dummy name *)

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_push : forall (H:ctx) x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (H § y / vk ~ S) -> x <> y ->
  forall x0 xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr H).
Proof.
  intros H x T y vk S Hc Hxy x0 xr.
  inversion Hc; subst.
  - exfalso. apply Hxy. reflexivity.
  - apply ctx_binds_subst_ctx. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_insert : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 x T,
  x <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  forall xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hfresh Hc xr.
  change (ctx_binds x T ((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2)) in Hc.
  revert G1 Hc Hfresh.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 Hc Hfresh; cbn in *.
  - (* empty *)
    eapply (@ctx_binds_remove_push G1 x T x0 vk0 S0); eauto.
  - (* push *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    + (* top binding belongs to G2 *)
      cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
    + (* binding is in the inner context *)
      cbn. eapply ctx_binds_n; [ assumption | ].
      apply IH; [ assumption | ].
      cbn in Hfresh. rewrite notin_union in Hfresh. exact (proj2 Hfresh).
  - (* stop: ctx_binds is uninhabited *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc.
  - (* hide *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide.
    apply IH; [ assumption | exact Hfresh ].
Qed.

(** ** Self-binding lookup: the dummy binding is the one found *)

Lemma ctx_binds_self_push : forall (H:ctx) x vk T S,
  ctx_binds x T (H § x / vk ~ S) -> x \notin ctx_dom H -> T = S.
Proof.
  intros H x vk T S Hc Hn.
  inversion Hc; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. match goal with Hn2 : ?a <> ?a |- _ => apply Hn2; reflexivity end.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance VarSubstVar : SubstVar var :=
  fun x y z => If z = x then y else z.

Instance VarSealable: Sealable var :=
  fun n x y => y.

Instance VarOpenable : Openable var :=
  fun n x a => a.

Instance VarFreeVar : FreeVar var := singleton (A:=var).

Instance VarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax VarOpenable VarFreeVar VarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarSealable : Sealable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f y => (If y = x then avar_b n else avar_f y)
    end.

  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance VarSubstVar : SubstVar var :=
  fun x y z => If z = x then y else z.

Instance VarSealable: Sealable var :=
  fun n x y => y.

Instance VarOpenable : Openable var :=
  fun n x a => a.

Instance VarFreeVar : FreeVar var := singleton (A:=var).

Instance VarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax VarOpenable VarFreeVar VarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarSealable : Sealable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n <= i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f y => (If y = x then avar_b n else avar_f y)
    end.

(** ** Recovering the unchanged-context binding lemma *)

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_insert_id : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 x T,
  x <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  x0 \notin ctx_fv (G1 §& G2) ->
  x0 \notin fv S0 ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hdom Hfv HS0 Hc.
  pose proof (@ctx_binds_remove_insert G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hdom Hc x0) as Hr.
  rewrite subst_ctx_id in Hr by exact Hfv.
  assert (HnotT : x0 \notin fv T).
  { intro Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_binds_fv_subset (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) x T Hc x0 Hin) as Hz.
    apply (@ctx_fv_insert_subset G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0) in Hz.
    rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
    - apply Hfv. exact Hz.
    - apply HS0. exact Hz. }
  rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh T x0 x0 HnotT) in Hr. exact Hr.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

(**

   ============================================================================
   WHY THE EXACT TASK STATEMENTS ARE NOT PROVABLE, AND THE CORRECTED INTERFACE
   ============================================================================

   The task asks, for example:

     G = G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2
     x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2)
     ty_var (G1 §& G2) e xr T0
     subtyp (G1 §& G2) e T0 (subst_var x0 xr S0)
     ------------------------------------------------------------
     ty_var (G1 §& G2) e (subst_var x0 xr x) (subst_var x0 xr T)

   This is FALSE.  Context binder types are first-class syntax and may mention
   the dummy name [x0] (e.g. a type member selector).  Since the conclusion keeps
   the context unchanged, the stored type [T] would have to be usable both as
   [T] and as [subst_var x0 xr T].  Concretely:

     G1 = ctx_push ctx_empty x1 v_loc (typ_sel (avar_f x0) L z)
     G2 = ctx_empty,  S0 = typ_top,  e = empty,  xr a fresh name,
     derivation: ty_var_var for x1 at T = typ_sel (avar_f x0) L z,
     external: ty_var (G1) e xr typ_top (add xr to G1), typ_top <: typ_top.

   The conclusion would be [ty_var G1 e x1 (typ_sel (avar_f xr) L z)], which is
   not derivable: [G1] binds [x1] to [typ_sel (avar_f x0) L z], and no subtyping
   rule relates [typ_sel x0 L z] to [typ_sel xr L z] when [e] does not equate
   [x0] and [xr] (take [e = empty]).

   The corrected statement must also substitute the types stored in the
   context, i.e. conclude under

       subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2).

   The [subst_ctx] development above (lookup removal in a substituted context,
   self-binding identification, freshness identity [subst_ctx_id], fv facts) is
   the infrastructure for that corrected lemma.

   A provable interface for the self-binding case (where the looked-up variable
   is exactly [x0]) additionally needs the substituted variable to be typed at
   the substituted binding type:

       Hxr  : ty_var (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)) e xr (subst_var x0 xr S0)
       Hvis : mode_has_visibility typing_mode ->
                ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)) xr          (for terms)

   and for every fresh-binder rule ([forall y, y\notin L -> ...]) the induction
   hypothesis is applied at the split [(G1, G2 § y)] under the substituted
   context; [Hxr]/[Hvis] must be weakened there with
   [var_sub_incap_weaken] / [ty_weaken_insert_mut] / [ctx_vis_insert].  This
   further requires [y] not to shadow [xr] (i.e. [y] fresh for the base context
   and [xr]); in a derivation the rule's [L] must be enlarged to exclude [xr]
   and all names of the substituted context, which is available from the
   configuration invariants (all fresh binders are chosen outside the config's
   free names).

   The actual typing-substitution induction (46 cases for ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap
   and 15 cases for ty_trm/lit/def/defs, plus ty_capbnd/viewpoint) is therefore
   the remaining work; it is NOT completed here.
*)

(**

   ============================================================================
   SECOND OBSTRUCTION: the [subtyp_typ] case cannot be discharged by name-blind
   substitution.
   ============================================================================

   The rule is (GeneralTyping.v):

     subtyp_typ : (forall x, G ⊢ open x S2 <: open x S1) ->
                  (forall x, G ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
                  G ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

   with an unrestricted [forall x] over names (no freshness set [L]).

   After substituting [x0] by [xr] in the conclusion, the required premise is

     forall x, G'' ⊢ open x (subst S2) <: open x (subst S1).

   For a given [x], the induction hypothesis on the original premise at a name
   [x'] yields

     G'' ⊢ subst (open x' S2) <: subst (open x' S1)
     =  G'' ⊢ open (subst x') (subst S2) <: open (subst x') (subst S1).

   For [x <> x0] we take [x' = x] (so [subst x' = x]).  For [x = x0], however,
   [subst x0 = xr], and the hypothesis gives the statement at [xr], not at [x0].
   There is no subtyping rule that changes the name inserted by [open] (the two
   types differ exactly at the opened bound positions), and the original
   derivation's premise at [x0] was proved under the *unsubstituted* context
   [G], where [x0] was bound; in [G''] the name [x0] is not bound.  Thus this
   case does not close.

   Two possible repairs:

   (H1) Add the global freshness hypothesis that [x0] does not occur free in any
        type occurring in the derivation (in particular in the bounds
        [S1,S2,T1,T2] of every [subtyp_typ] occurrence).  Then [subst] is the
        identity on those types and the original premise at [x0] is exactly the
        required new premise at [x0].

   (H2) Prove a name-renaming lemma for subtyping of opened types: for [T] with
        [x0 \notin fv T] and [x0 \notin ctx_dom G''], derive
        [G'' ⊢ open x0 T <: open x0 U] from [G'' ⊢ open xr T <: open xr U]
        (or from the corresponding closed/parametric form).  Such a lemma is a
        non-trivial substitution/alpha-renaming property of the type system and
        is not available in the current helper files.

   The induction was therefore NOT completed for [subtyp_typ] (and hence for the
   mutual ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap block).  The context infrastructure above is
   complete and usable; the [ty_trm]/[ty_lit]/[ty_def]/[ty_defs] substitution
   has the same [subtyp_typ] dependency through [ty_trm_sub] rule premises.
*)

(** Environment support freshness suffices to keep an environment fixed. *)

Definition swp_renv_fixed sx sy (e:renv) :=
  sx \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) /\ sy \notin (dom e \u fv_env e).

Lemma binds_swp_fixed : forall (e:renv) (v1 v2:var),
  binds v1 v2 e -> forall sx sy,
  swp_renv_fixed sx sy e ->
  binds (swp_var sx sy v1) (swp_var sx sy v2) e.
Proof.
  intros e v1 v2 Hb sx sy [Hx Hy].
  rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hxdom Hxfv].
  rewrite notin_union in Hy. destruct Hy as [Hydom Hyfv].
  assert (Hv1x : v1 <> sx).
  { intro E. subst sx. apply Hxdom. apply (@binds_in_dom var e v1 v2 Hb). }
  assert (Hv1y : v1 <> sy).
  { intro E. subst sy. apply Hydom. apply (@binds_in_dom var e v1 v2 Hb). }
  assert (Hsx2 : sx \notin fv v2).
  { exact (@fv_in_values_binds var sx (@fv var VarFreeVar) v1 v2 e Hb Hxfv). }
  assert (Hsy2 : sy \notin fv v2).
  { exact (@fv_in_values_binds var sy (@fv var VarFreeVar) v1 v2 e Hb Hyfv). }
  assert (Hv2x : v2 <> sx).
  { intro E. subst v2. apply Hsx2. change (sx \in \{sx}). rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hv2y : v2 <> sy).

  rewrite (swp_var_other Hv2x Hv2y).
  exact Hb.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4 Canonical5.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Opened type-member bounds.

    [OpenedSub G e S T] says that the selector lower bound [S] and upper
    bound [T] are related after opening at every name.  For a record
    declaration with equal (or bottom-lower) bounds, this follows directly
    from the premises of [subtyp_typ]. *)

Definition OpenedSub (G:ctx) (e:renv) (S T:typ) : Prop :=
  forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) (open y T).

Lemma opened_sub_of_subtyp_typ : forall G e A Q1 Q2 S T,
  record_dec (dec_typ A Q1 Q2) ->
  (forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) (open y Q1)) ->
  (forall y, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y Q2) (open y T)) ->
  OpenedSub G e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e A Q1 Q2 S T Hdec HS HQ y.
  inversion Hdec; subst.
  - (* equal bounds *)
    eapply subtyp_trans; [apply HS|apply HQ].
  - (* lower bound bot *)
    eapply subtyp_trans; [apply HS|apply subtyp_bot].
Qed.

(** The two selector rules say exactly that the lower bound subtypes every
    supertype of the selector, while every subtype of the selector subtypes
    the opened upper bound. *)

Lemma sel_lower_bypass : forall G e x A y S T U,
  G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)) U ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open y S) U.
Proof.
  intros G e x A y S T U Hx Usel.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)).
  - eapply subtyp_sel2. exact Hx.
  - exact Usel.
Qed.

Lemma sel_upper_preimage : forall G e x A y S T U,
  G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (open y T).
Proof.
  intros G e x A y S T U Hx Usel.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)).
  - exact Usel.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1. exact Hx.
Qed.

(** A selector only extends its lower bound: if the lower bound's opened form
    is [NoFun]/[NoField], then the selector's upper-bound safety is the only
    remaining question.  This is the precise receiver-bound invariant needed
    by Canonical5. *)

Definition ReceiverOpenedSub (G:ctx) (e:renv) : Prop :=
  forall x A S T,
    inert G ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) ->
    OpenedSub G e S T.

(** Under [ReceiverOpenedSub], every selector use can be replaced by the
    corresponding opened-bound subtyping, so any chain that reaches a
    function/field through a selector can be transformed into one whose
    selector detours are transparent.  We record the concrete local
    consequence used by the canonical-form proof. *)

End WithTypingMode.

(** * Residual analysis for the suggested syntax-directed [SafeRec].

    A standalone inductive [SafeRec] on type syntax does not close under
    [subtyp] without additional derivation information.  Two concrete rule
    shapes break a purely syntactic constructor set:

    - [subtyp_or11]/[subtyp_or12]: from a safe source [T] we obtain
      [typ_or T U] for an arbitrary [U].  An [or] is only a usable source
      through [subtyp_or2], which requires BOTH components to subtype the
      target; therefore the safe component set of an [or] cannot simply be
      the union/disjunction of its components, nor can [or] be declared
      unconditionally safe.

    - [subtyp_and2]: an [and] target combines two independent subtyping
      derivations whose targets need not be reachable from the original
      inert source.  Closure again needs the two components' derivations,
      not just their syntax.

    Selector bounds make this worse: [subtyp_sel2] turns a safe lower bound
    into a selector, while [subtyp_sel1] exposes the receiver's upper bound;
    the receiver's safety is a property of a *typing derivation*, not of the
    selector's syntactic arguments.

    The unconditional facts proved above ([OpenedSub] from [record_dec]
    sources and the two selector transport lemmas) are the selector-local
    ingredients.  What remains is a simultaneous induction over
    ty_var/subtyp/ty_incap that carries the inert receiver binding and its
    record_dec provenance, i.e. [ReceiverOpenedSub] plus its use in
    eliminating selector detours. *)

(** * Note on derivation-tree encodings.

    Two different issues arise, and they should not be conflated.

    (1) Structural recursion through a cofinite premise.  A constructor field
        of the form

          forall x, x \notin L -> subtyp_d (G § x / vk ~ S) ...

        is a function returning a recursive tree.  Both the generated
        induction principle and an explicit [Fixpoint] do support recursion
        on [f x Hx]: the induction principle is, for example,

          forall P, P leaf ->
            (forall f, (forall x, P (f x)) -> P (node f)) -> forall t, P t,

        and the guard checker accepts the corresponding [Fixpoint] under the
        function argument.  Thus the guard checker is not the obstruction.

    (2) The sort of the source judgment.  The supplied [ty_var], [subtyp]
        and [ty_incap] are [Prop]-valued.  A complete translation from those
        judgments into a [Type]-valued tree is a large elimination
        [Prop -> Type] and is therefore unavailable.  A [Prop]-valued mirror
        does support both a soundness direction and a complete translation by
        structural recursion, including the cofinite rules.

    The remaining selector obstruction is neither of the above: it is the
    semantic provenance of receiver bounds.  In [subtyp_sel1] the result is
    the receiver's opened upper bound, while in [subtyp_sel2] the source is
    the opened lower bound.  A tree for a variable at a record type can
    contain further selector steps whose receiver is another variable, so a
    syntactic predicate on the current type does not retain the fact that
    the two bounds of that other receiver were produced from a common
    [record_dec] source.  A successful induction must carry this provenance
    through [trans], [and]/[or] formation, and the two selector rules; merely
    mirroring the rules as trees does not supply it.  The unconditional
    facts above ([OpenedSub] from [record_dec] sources and the two selector
    transport lemmas) remain the selector-local ingredients, and
    [ReceiverOpenedSub] is the precise global invariant still missing. *)

(** Cofinite-opening interface: once a fresh comparison name [z] is chosen,
    the swap lemma reduces opening at an arbitrary runtime name [x] to the
    four syntactic fixed-point equations below. *)
Lemma ty_trm_open_swap : forall G Go e vk S L (t:trm) T x z,
  (forall y, y \notin L ->
     ty_trm typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e (open y t) T) ->
  z \notin L ->
  swp_renv_fixed z x e ->
  swp_ctx z x (G § z / vk ~ S) = (G § x / vk ~ S) ->
  swp_objctx z x Go = Go ->
  swp_trm z x (open z t) = open x t ->
  swp_typ z x T = T ->
  ty_trm typing_mode (G § x / vk ~ S) Go e (open x t) T.
Proof.
  intros G Go e vk S L t T x z Hbody HzL Hf Hctx Hgo Htrm Htyp.
  pose proof (@ty_trm_swp (G § z / vk ~ S) Go e (open z t) T
                (Hbody z HzL) z x Hf) as Hs.
  rewrite Hctx, Hgo, Htrm, Htyp in Hs. exact Hs.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev5 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Typing_subst Ctx_narrow.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Term-level context narrowing.

    We replace the type [Sh] of a binder [xh] by a subtype [W].  The binder
    occurs at the split [G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2], with [xh] fresh from
    [G1] and [G2].  The hypothesis [W <: Sh] is stated in the narrowed
    context.  The term-level induction is adapted from the insertion
    weakening proof [ty_weaken_insert_mut]; the extra objctx binders are
    handled by the same [ctx_met] decompositions. *)

(** ** Capability bounds and viewpoint adaptation *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_narrow : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub.
  - apply ty_capbnd_top.
  - apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - apply ty_capbnd_typ.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_sel.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_cap_ignore; eauto.
  - apply ty_capbnd_met.
  - apply ty_capbnd_fld.
  - (* sel *) eapply ty_capbnd_sel.
    + eapply (@ty_var_narrow typing_mode G e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T))); eauto.
    + eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto.
  - apply ty_capbnd_rec.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_and; [ eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto | eapply IHty_capbnd0; eauto ].
  - eapply ty_capbnd_or; [ eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto | eapply IHty_capbnd0; eauto ].
  - apply ty_capbnd_all.
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_cap_narrow : forall C x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros C x G Go e Tf Tr H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub.
  eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine.
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (@var_sub_incap_narrow typing_mode)) G Go e T Tstrip H G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub).
  - eapply (@ty_capbnd_narrow C G Go e T Tcap); eauto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev5 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Typing_subst.

(** * Context narrowing

    Replacing the type [S] of a binder [x] by a subtype [W] preserves all
    typing judgments.  The binder is identified by a split
    [G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2], with [x] absent from [G1] and [G2] (so the
    occurrence is unambiguous).  The narrowing hypothesis [W <: S] is stated
    in the narrowed context itself; it can be weakened when fresh binders are
    pushed on top. *)

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Context-shape helpers *)

Lemma ctx_binds_narrow_same : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W y T,
  ctx_binds y T (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  y <> x ->
  ctx_binds y T (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W y T H Hne.
  change (ctx_binds y T ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2)) in H.
  change (ctx_binds y T ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2)).
  revert G1 H.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H.
  - (* empty *)
    cbn in H. cbn.
    inversion H; subst.
    + exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto.
  - (* push *)
    cbn in H. cbn.
    inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_e.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; [ eassumption | ].
      eapply IH. eassumption.
  - (* stop *) cbn in H. inversion H.
  - (* hide *)
    cbn in H. cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide.
    inversion H; subst.
    eapply IH. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_self_narrow : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S T,
  x \notin ctx_dom G1 -> x \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  T = S.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S T H1 H2 H.
  eapply (@ctx_binds_self_insert G1 G2 x vk S T); [ | exact H ].
  eapply notin_dom_concat; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_push_inv : forall (G:ctx) y vk S z,
  z \notin ctx_dom (G § y / vk ~ S) -> z \notin ctx_dom G /\ z <> y.
Proof.
  intros G y vk S z H. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H.
  rewrite notin_singleton in H. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_self_narrowed : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W,
  x \notin ctx_dom G1 -> x \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
  ctx_binds x S (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x W (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W H1 H2 H.
  change (ctx_binds x W ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2)).
  change (ctx_binds x S ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2)) in H.
  revert G1 H1 H.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH y vk2 t|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H1 H.
  - cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply notin_dom_push_inv in H2. destruct H2 as [H2g Hxy].
    cbn in H. inversion H; subst.
    + exfalso. apply Hxy. reflexivity.
    + change (ctx_binds x W (((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2) § y / vk2 ~ t)).
      eapply ctx_binds_n.
      * exact Hxy.
      * eapply IH; eauto.
  - cbn in H. inversion H.
  - cbn in H. inversion H; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

(** ctx_vis ignores the binding types entirely. *)
Lemma ctx_vis_narrow_same : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W y,
  ctx_vis (G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) y ->
  ctx_vis (G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2) y.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W y H.
  change (ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ S) §& G2) y) in H.
  change (ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ W) §& G2) y).
  revert G1 H.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 H.
  - cbn in H. cbn. inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; eauto.
  - cbn in H. cbn. inversion H; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [ eassumption | ].
      eapply IH. eassumption.
  - cbn in H. inversion H.
  - cbn in H. inversion H.
Qed.

(** ctx_vis under narrowing, with an arbitrary objctx appended. *)
Lemma ctx_vis_narrow_obj : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x vk S W (Go:objctx) y,
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ S §& G2) §§& Go) y ->
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x / vk ~ W §& G2) §§& Go) y.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x vk S W Go y H.
  revert H.
  induction Go as [|xz T|yz T]; cbn in *.
  - eapply (@ctx_vis_narrow_same G1 G2 x vk S W y); eassumption.
  - (* objctx_lit: one binder appended *)
    intro H. inversion H; subst.

(** * Fresh-name facts for one-way substitution. *)

Lemma typ_x_notin_subst : forall (T:typ) x y,

Proof.

(** [swp_ctx sx sy] fixes a context when both names are fresh from it. *)

Lemma swp_ctx_fresh_id : forall (G:ctx) sx sy,
  sx \notin ctx_dom G -> sx \notin ctx_fv G ->

Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|G IH v vk T|G IH|G IH]; intros sx sy
    Hxd Hxf Hyd Hyf; cbn in *.

    assert (Ev : swp_var sx sy v = v).
    { apply swp_var_other.

      - intro E. apply Hvy. symmetry. exact E. }
    assert (ET : swp_typ sx sy T = T).

  - rewrite IH; auto.
  - rewrite IH; auto.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Inertness of a context binding determines the shape of its type. *)

Lemma inert_typ_k_after : forall x vk T G G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after x vk T G G2 -> inert G -> inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros x vk T G G2 H.
  induction H as [a1 a2 a3 a4|b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6 b7 b8 b9 b10 IH]; intros Hi.
  - inversion Hi as [|c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 c8 c9]; subst.
    exact c7.
  - inversion Hi as [|d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 d8 d9]; subst.
    eapply IH. exact d5.
Qed.

Lemma inert_k_binds : forall G x vk,
  inert G -> ctx_k G x vk -> exists T, ctx_binds x T G /\ inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk Hi [T [G2 Hka]].
  exists T. split.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hka.
  - eapply inert_typ_k_after; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_inv : forall T vk,
  inert_typ T vk ->
  (exists S T2, T = typ_fun S T2)
  \/
  (exists U S, T = typ_objref U S /\ record_type U /\ typ_indep_b 0 U).
Proof.
  intros T vk H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. eexists; eexists; reflexivity.
  - right. exists T, S. split; [reflexivity|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typ_corr_inv : forall Tw Ty,
  typ_corr Tw Ty ->
  (exists S T, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\ Ty = typ_fun S T)
  \/
  (exists U S1 S2, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2).
Proof.
  intros Tw Ty H. dependent destruction H.
  - right. exists T, S, U. split; [reflexivity|reflexivity].
  - left. exists t1, t2. split; [assumption|]. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

(** ** Canonical shape of the heap item reached by a v_ref variable. *)

Lemma item_canonical : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y Tw Ty,
    binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\
    ctx_binds x Tw G /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty /\
    ( (exists S T tf, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ Tw = typ_fun S T /\
                       Ty = typ_fun S T /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma)
      \/ (exists U S1 S2 ds, Tw = typ_objref U S1 /\ Ty = typ_objref U S2 /\
            binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\ record_type U /\
            G §§ (objctx_heap y U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ open y U /\ defs_varkinds G ds) ).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk.
  pose proof (heap_correspond_ref_lookup Hhc Hk) as Href.
  destruct Href as [y [Hbxy [Hydom Hitem]]].
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitemall]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hbxy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkx [Kky [Bx [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  assert (HinertTw : inert_typ Tw v_ref).
  { destruct Hk as [Tk [G2 Hka]].
    assert (Bk : ctx_binds x Tk G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
    pose proof (inert_typ_k_after Hka Hinert) as Ity.
    assert (Tk = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact Bk|exact Bx]).
    subst. exact Ity. }
  exists y, Tw, Ty. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hydom|].
  split; [exact Bx|]. split; [exact Kky|]. split; [exact Tcorr|].
  destruct (ty_item_s_inv Hitem) as
    [ [S0 [T0 [tf [L [Hmf [Bty [Bitem [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]]
    | [U [Sx [ds [Ty0 [Bty [Bitem [Heq [Hds_ty Hvark]]]]]]]] ].
  - left. exists S0, T0, tf.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_fun S0 T0)
      by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]).
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + injection HTy as HS HT. subst S'. subst T'. split; [exact Hmf'|].
      split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|exact Bitem].
    + discriminate HTy.
  - right.
    assert (ETy : Ty = typ_objref U Sx).
    { rewrite Heq in Bty. eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; [exact Hok|exact By|exact Bty]. }
    subst Ty.
    destruct (typ_corr_inv Tcorr) as
      [[S' [T' [Hmf' [HTw HTy]]]] | [U' [S1 [S2 [HTw HTy]]]]].
    + discriminate HTy.
    + injection HTy as HU HS. subst U'. subst S2.
      exists U, S1, Sx, ds. split; [exact HTw|]. split; [reflexivity|].
      assert (HrecU : record_type U).
      { destruct (inert_typ_inv HinertTw) as [[Sf [Tf Hfun]]|[U2 [S3 [Heq2 [Hrec2 _]]]]].
        - rewrite HTw in Hfun. discriminate Hfun.
        - rewrite HTw in Heq2. injection Heq2 as H3 H4. subst U2. exact Hrec2. }
      split; [exact Bitem|]. split; [exact HrecU|].

Class OpenTwice `(AS: Openable A) :=
  open_twice_comp : forall n x y,
    (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec n x) = (open_rec n x).

Class OpenCommut `(AS: Openable A) :=
    open_commut_comp : forall m n x y,
        m <> n ->
        (open_rec m x) ∘ (open_rec n y) = (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec m x).

Class SubstFresh `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_fresh : forall x y X,
    x \notin fv X -> subst_var x y X = X.

Class SubstOpenCommut `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_open_commut : forall x y z X n,
    subst_var x y (open_rec n z X)
    = open_rec n (z \[x -> y]) (subst_var x y X).

Class SubstCommut `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_commut_comp x y w z:
    x <> w ->
    (y <> w \/ x = z ) ->
    (subst_var x y) ∘ (subst_var w z) = (subst_var w (z \[x -> y])) ∘ (subst_var x y).

Class SubstId `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_id_comp x:
    (subst_var x x) = id.

Class FvOpenCases `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  fv_open_cases : forall x a n,
    fv (open_rec n x a) = fv a \/
    fv (open_rec n x a) = \{ x} \u fv a.

  (forall (T: A) n,
    fv (open_rec n x T) = fv T \/
    fv (open_rec n x T) = \{ x} \u fv T).

  open_close_comp : forall n x,
    (open_rec n x) ∘ (close_rec n x) = open_rec n x.

Class CloseOpen `(Cl: Closing A) :=
  close_open_comp : forall n x,
    (close_rec n x) ∘ (open_rec n x) = close_rec n x.

Class SubstOpenClose `(Cl: Closing A) :=
  subst_open_close_comp : forall n x y,
    (subst_var x y) ∘ (open_rec n x) = (open_rec n y) ∘ (close_rec n x).

  close_subst_comp : forall n x y,

    z <> x -> z <> y ->

  match d with

(** * Variable substitution for typing: context infrastructure.

    The task's exact substitution statements keep the ambient context unchanged.
    That form is NOT provable in general: context binder types are syntax and may
    mention the dummy name [x0], so removing the dummy binding and substituting
    [x0] by [xr] must also substitute the *types stored in the context*.

    This file therefore develops the correct interface:
      - [subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)] is the ambient context after substitution;
      - under [x0 \notin ctx_fv (G1 §& G2)] it is equal to [G1 §& G2]
        ([subst_ctx_id]), recovering the unchanged-context form.
    A concrete obstruction (type selectors mentioning [x0]) is documented at the
    end of the file.  *)

(** ** Substitution on contexts *)

Lemma ctx_dom_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr, ctx_dom (subst_ctx x0 xr G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr; cbn; auto;
    rewrite IHG; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_push_subst_ctx : forall (G:ctx) x vk T x0 xr,
  subst_ctx x0 xr (G § x / vk ~ T) =
  subst_ctx x0 xr G § x / vk ~ subst_var x0 xr T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_subst_ctx : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall x0 xr,
  ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr G).
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros x0 xr; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply ctx_binds_n; auto.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. auto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_id : forall (G:ctx) x0 xr,
  x0 \notin ctx_fv G -> subst_ctx x0 xr G = G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros x0 xr Hfv; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite notin_union in Hfv. destruct Hfv as [Hv HT].
    rewrite (IHG x0 xr HT).
    rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh t x0 xr Hv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHG x0 xr Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_fv_subset : forall G x T,
  ctx_binds x T G -> forall z, z \in fv T -> z \in ctx_fv G.
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intros z Hz; cbn in *.
  - rewrite in_union. left. exact Hz.
  - rewrite in_union. right. auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

(** ** Binding removal when the looked-up name is not the dummy name *)

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_push : forall (H:ctx) x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T (H § y / vk ~ S) -> x <> y ->
  forall x0 xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr H).
Proof.
  intros H x T y vk S Hc Hxy x0 xr.
  inversion Hc; subst.
  - exfalso. apply Hxy. reflexivity.
  - apply ctx_binds_subst_ctx. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_remove_insert : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk0 S0 x T,
  x <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) ->
  forall xr, ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 xr T) (subst_ctx x0 xr (G1 §& G2)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x T Hne Hfresh Hc xr.
  change (ctx_binds x T ((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2)) in Hc.
  revert G1 Hc Hfresh.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 Hc Hfresh; cbn in *.
  - (* empty *)
    eapply (@ctx_binds_remove_push G1 x T x0 vk0 S0); eauto.
  - (* push *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    + (* top binding belongs to G2 *)
      cbn. apply ctx_binds_e.
    + (* binding is in the inner context *)
      cbn. eapply ctx_binds_n; [ assumption | ].
      apply IH; [ assumption | ].
      cbn in Hfresh. rewrite notin_union in Hfresh. exact (proj2 Hfresh).
  - (* stop: ctx_binds is uninhabited *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc.
  - (* hide *)
    cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    cbn. apply ctx_binds_hide.
    apply IH; [ assumption | exact Hfresh ].
Qed.

(** ** Self-binding lookup: the dummy binding is the one found *)

Lemma ctx_binds_self_push : forall (H:ctx) x vk T S,

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
====

Lemma tfree_trm_open_inv : forall (t:trm) v x n, tfree_trm v (open_rec n x t) -> tfree_trm v t \/ v = x.
Proof. intros; eapply tfree_open_inv_mut; eauto. Qed.
Lemma tfree_lit_open_inv : forall (l:lit) v x n, tfree_lit v (open_rec n x l) -> tfree_lit v l \/ v = x.
Proof. intros; eapply tfree_open_inv_mut; eauto. Qed.
Lemma tfree_def_open_inv : forall (d:def) v x n, tfree_def v (open_rec n x d) -> tfree_def v d \/ v = x.
Proof. intros; eapply tfree_open_inv_mut; eauto. Qed.
Lemma tfree_defs_open_inv : forall (ds:defs) v x n, tfree_defs v (open_rec n x ds) -> tfree_defs v ds \/ v = x.

(** * Context basics *)

Lemma ctx_binds_in_dom : forall G x T, ctx_binds x T G -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; cbn.
  - rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - rewrite in_union. right. assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ty_var_in_dom : forall G e x T, G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros G e x T H. induction H; eauto using ctx_binds_in_dom. Qed.

Lemma ctx_dom_push_elim : forall G x vk T y,
  y \in ctx_dom (G § x / vk ~ T) -> y = x \/ y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_singleton in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_dom_vis_hide : forall G, ctx_dom (vis_hide typing_mode G) = ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_dom_obj_lit_elim : forall G x T y,
  y \in ctx_dom (G §§& objctx_lit x T) -> y = x \/ y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_singleton in H. destruct H; auto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_dom_obj_heap_elim : forall G x T y,
  y \in ctx_dom (G §§& objctx_heap x T) -> y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. auto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_dom_obj_empty_elim : forall G y,
  y \in ctx_dom (G §§& objctx_empty) -> y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. auto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_dom_ctx_met_elim : forall G xz TZ xc TC y,
  y \in ctx_dom (ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC) -> y = xz \/ y = xc \/ y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn in H. rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_singleton in H.
  destruct H as [H|H].
  - right. left. auto.
  - rewrite in_union in H. rewrite in_singleton in H. destruct H as [H|H]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_dom_ctx_met_vis_elim : forall G xz TZ xc TC y,
  y \in ctx_dom (ctx_met (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC) ->
  y = xz \/ y = xc \/ y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros. apply (@ctx_dom_ctx_met_elim (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC y) in H.
  destruct H as [H|[H|H]]; auto.
  right; right. rewrite <- ctx_dom_vis_hide. assumption.
Qed.


Lemma ctx_dom_ctx_met_refined_elim : forall G xz TZ xc TC TC2 y,
  y \in ctx_dom (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2) ->
  y = xz \/ y = xc \/ y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros. cbn in *. repeat rewrite in_union in H. repeat rewrite in_singleton in H.
  intuition (subst; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ctx_dom_ctx_met_refined_vis_elim : forall G xz TZ xc TC TC2 y,
  y \in ctx_dom (ctx_met_refined (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC TC2) ->
  y = xz \/ y = xc \/ y \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode); cbn in *.
  - pose proof (@ctx_dom_ctx_met_refined_elim G xz TZ xc TC TC2 y H) as H'.
    destruct H' as [H'|[H'|H']]; auto.
  - pose proof (@ctx_dom_ctx_met_refined_elim (ctx_hide G) xz TZ xc TC TC2 y H) as H'.
    destruct H' as [H'|[H'|H']]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma tfree_dom_mut :
  (forall G Go e t T, G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T -> forall x, tfree_trm x t -> x \in ctx_dom (G §§& Go))
  /\ (forall G Go e l T, G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ l ∶ T -> forall x, tfree_lit x l -> x \in ctx_dom (G §§& Go))
  /\ (forall G Go e d D, G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> forall x, tfree_def x d -> x \in ctx_dom (G §§& Go))
  /\ (forall G Go e ds T, G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T -> forall x, tfree_defs x ds -> x \in ctx_dom (G §§& Go)).
Proof.
  apply (@rules_mutind typing_mode
    (fun G Go e t T _ => forall x, tfree_trm x t -> x \in ctx_dom (G §§& Go))
    (fun G Go e l T _ => forall x, tfree_lit x l -> x \in ctx_dom (G §§& Go))
    (fun G Go e d D _ => forall x, tfree_def x d -> x \in ctx_dom (G §§& Go))
    (fun G Go e ds T _ => forall x, tfree_defs x ds -> x \in ctx_dom (G §§& Go))).
  - (* var *) intros G e x T Hvis Hx y Htf. cbn in Htf. inversion Htf; subst.
    cbn. apply ty_var_in_dom in Hx. assumption.
  - (* apply *) intros G e x z S T Hfun Hvx Hvz Hx Hz y Htf. cbn in Htf.
    inversion Htf; subst.
    + apply ty_var_in_dom in Hx. assumption.
    + apply ty_var_in_dom in Hz. assumption.
  - (* read *) intros G e x a S T U Hvis Hx Hv y Htf. cbn in Htf. inversion Htf; subst.
    cbn. apply ty_var_in_dom in Hx. assumption.
  - (* write *) intros G e x y a S T Hvx Hvy Hmut Hx Hy z Htf. cbn in Htf.
    inversion Htf; subst.
    + apply ty_var_in_dom in Hx. assumption.
    + apply ty_var_in_dom in Hy. assumption.
  - (* call *) intros G e x y m TC TZ TR Hvx Hvy Hx Hy Hsef Hxy z Htf. cbn in Htf.
    inversion Htf; subst.
    + apply ty_var_in_dom in Hx. assumption.
    + apply ty_var_in_dom in Hy. assumption.
  - (* let *) intros L G e t1 t2 T U H1 IH1 H2 IH2 x Htf. cbn in Htf. cbn.
    inversion Htf; subst.
    + cbn. apply IH1; assumption.
    + destruct (var_fresh (L \u \{x})) as [x0 Hx0].
      rewrite notin_union in Hx0. destruct Hx0 as [Hx0 Hx0x].
      rewrite notin_singleton in Hx0x.
      assert (Ht : tfree_trm x (open x0 t2)) by (apply tfree_trm_open; assumption).
      pose proof (IH2 x0 Hx0 x Ht) as Hdom.
      cbn in Hdom.
      pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G x0 v_let T x Hdom) as Hdom'.
      destruct Hdom' as [Hdom'|Hdom']; [subst; contradiction|assumption].
  - (* lit *) intros L G e l u T U Hl IHl Hu IHu x Htf. cbn in Htf. cbn.
    inversion Htf; subst.
    + cbn. apply IHl; assumption.
    + destruct (var_fresh (L \u \{x})) as [x0 Hx0].
      rewrite notin_union in Hx0. destruct Hx0 as [Hx0 Hx0x].
      rewrite notin_singleton in Hx0x.
      assert (Ht : tfree_trm x (open x0 u)) by (apply tfree_trm_open; assumption).
      pose proof (IHu x0 Hx0 x Ht) as Hdom.
      cbn in Hdom.
====
    eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_weaken_push : forall G x T y vk S,
  ctx_binds x T G -> x <> y -> ctx_binds x T (ctx_push G y vk S).
Proof. intros. eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto. Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_in_dom : forall G x, ctx_vis G x -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G x H. induction H.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - cbn. rewrite in_union. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_push_inv : forall G v vk t,
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t) -> ctx_weakens G.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_stop_false : forall G, ctx_weakens (ctx_stop G) -> False.
Proof. intros. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma ctx_weakens_hide_false : forall G, ctx_weakens (ctx_hide G) -> False.
Proof. intros. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Environment facts (binds is get = Some) *)

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall A (E:env A) x v,
  binds x v E -> x \in dom E.
Proof. intros. eapply get_some_inv. apply binds_get. eassumption. Qed.

Lemma dom_exists : forall A (E:env A) x,
  x \in dom E -> exists v, binds x v E.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (@get_some A x E H) as [v Hv]. exists v. apply Hv.
Qed.

  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go -> x0 \notin objctx_fv Go ->

Lemma defs_has_cons_here : forall (ds:defs) (d:def),
  defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d.
Proof.
  intros ds d. unfold defs_has. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := label_of d = label_of d) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_cons_other : forall (ds:defs) (d d':def),
  label_of d <> label_of d' -> defs_has ds d' -> defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d'.
Proof.
  intros ds d d' Hne Hh. unfold defs_has in *. cbn.
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := label_of d = label_of d') Hne).
  assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_has_contra : forall (ds:defs) (d:def) l,
  defs_hasnt ds l -> defs_has ds d -> label_of d = l -> False.
Proof.
  intros ds d l Hn Hh He. unfold defs_hasnt, defs_has in *.
  rewrite He in Hh. rewrite Hh in Hn. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_label : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> label_of d = label_of D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_record_dec : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H.
  - (* def_typ *) apply rd_typ.
  - (* def_fld *) apply rd_fld.
  - (* def_met *) eapply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rcd_inv : forall (D:dec) ls,
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) ls -> ls = singleton (label_of D).
Proof.
  intros D ls H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_and_inv : forall (T:typ) (D:dec) ls,
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) ls ->
  exists ls' l, ls = ls' \u singleton l /\ record_typ T ls' /\
                l = label_of D /\ l \notin ls'.
Proof.
  intros T D ls H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  exists ls0, (label_of D). split; [reflexivity|]. split; [eassumption|]. split; [reflexivity|eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_record : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ty_trm_sub_elim : forall G e t U,
  ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t U ->
  exists T, ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e t U H. induction H.
  - (* var *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* apply *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_apply; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* read *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_read; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* write *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_write; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* call *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_call; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* let *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_let; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* lit *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_lit; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* sub *) destruct IHty_trm as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_sub_elim : forall G e x U,
  ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x U ->
  exists T, ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e x U H. induction H.
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_var_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_intro; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_elim; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - exists (typ_and T U); split; [eapply ty_var_and; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - destruct IHty_var as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_var_mut_top; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
Qed.

Lemma trm_empty_head : forall t T,
  ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  (exists s u, t = trm_let s u) \/ (exists l u, t = trm_lit l u).
Proof.
  intros t T H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty empty t T) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  all: try (exfalso;
    match goal with Hx : ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ ?x ∶ _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (ty_var_in_dom Hx) as Hd; cbn in Hd; rewrite in_empty in Hd; assumption end).
  all: try (left; eexists; eexists; reflexivity).
  all: try (right; eexists; eexists; reflexivity).
  all: try (apply IHty_trm; reflexivity).

Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence HeapCorrespondence ConfigVarkinds TFree InertContext RecordTypes.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Context_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Lifting facts from the lower context of a ctx_binds_k_after derivation. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y T, ctx_binds y T G2 -> ctx_binds y T G1.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y T Hb.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk' t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. exact Hb.
    + exact Hb.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk' t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E; subst. apply Hfresh. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom.
      eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hb].
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k : forall v vk t G1 G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G1 G2 -> ctx_ok G1 ->
  forall y vk', ctx_k G2 y vk' -> ctx_k G1 y vk'.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G1 G2 H.
  induction H as [v0 vk0 t0 G|v0 v2 vk1 vk2 t0 t2 G1' G2 Hne Hrec IH];
    intros Hok y vk' Hk.
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk'0 t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_k_weaken_push; [exact Hk|exact Hfresh].
  - inversion Hok as [|G0 v' vk'0 t' Hok0 Hfresh| |]; subst.
    eapply ctx_k_weaken_push.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok0|exact Hk].
    + exact Hfresh.
Qed.

(** 1) Lookup in renv_corr. *)

Lemma renv_corr_lookup : forall G e, ctx_ok G -> renv_corr G e ->
  forall w y, binds w y e ->
    exists Tw Ty,
      ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\
      ctx_binds w Tw G /\ ctx_binds y Ty G /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Hok Hc. induction Hc as
    [G0|G1 G2 G3 e0 w0 y0 Tw Ty Hw Hy Hcorr Hrenv IH]; intros w y Hb.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv. exact Hb.
  - destruct (classicT (w = w0)) as [E|N].
    + subst w. assert (Ey : y = y0) by (eapply binds_push_eq_inv; exact Hb). subst y.
      exists Tw, Ty. split.
      * exists Tw, G2. exact Hw.
      * split.
        -- eapply ctx_binds_k_after_lift_k; [exact Hw|exact Hok|].
           exists Ty, G3. exact Hy.
        -- split.
           ++ eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hw.
           ++ split.
              ** eapply ctx_binds_k_after_lift_binds; [exact Hw|exact Hok|].
                 eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hy.
              ** exact Hcorr.
    + eapply IH; [exact Hok|]. eapply binds_push_neq_inv; eauto.
Qed.

(** 2) From a v_ref context variable to its heap location and item. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_ref_lookup : forall G e Sigma x,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  exists y, binds x y e /\ y \in dom Sigma /\ @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma y.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Hhc Hk.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hxdom : x \in dom e) by (eapply ctx_k_v_ref_in_env_dom; eauto).
  destruct (dom_exists Hxdom) as [y Hy].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hy) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists y. split; [exact Hy|]. split.
  - rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
  - apply Hitem. rewrite <- Hds. destruct (ctx_k_binds Kky) as [T' [_ Hkd]]. exact Hkd.
Qed.

(** 3) Inversion of ty_item_s. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_inv : forall G e s x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e s x ->
  (exists S T t L, mode_has_fun typing_mode /\ ctx_binds x (typ_fun S T) G /\
     binds x (item_fun t) s /\
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L -> G § x0 / v_par ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x0 t ∶ open x0 T) /\
     all_tfree_k G t v_ref)
  \/
  (exists U S ds T, ctx_binds x T G /\ binds x (item_obj ds) s /\
     T = typ_objref U S /\ G §§ (objctx_heap x U) ⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ (open x U) /\
     defs_varkinds G ds).
Proof.
  intros G e s x H. dependent destruction H.
  - left. exists S, T, t, L. repeat split; eauto.
  - right. exists U, S, ds, T. repeat split; eauto.
Qed.

(** 4) Environment bindings inherit context kinds/correspondence. *)

Lemma heap_correspond_binds_env : forall G e Sigma w y,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma -> binds w y e ->
  exists Tw Ty, ctx_k G w v_ref /\ ctx_k G y v_loc /\ typ_corr Tw Ty.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y Hhc Hb.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  destruct (renv_corr_lookup Hok Hrenv Hb) as
    [Tw [Ty [Kkw [Kky [Bw [By Tcorr]]]]]].
  exists Tw, Ty. split; [exact Kkw|]. split; [exact Kky|exact Tcorr].
Qed.

(** 5) Domain characterizations. *)
