Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Defs GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep.

Fixpoint deref_base A (su: SubstVar A) (e: renv) (X: A): A :=
  match e with
  | nil => X
  | cons (w,y) ys => (deref_base su ys (subst_var w y X))
  end.

Class Deref A :=
  deref (e: renv) (a: A): A.

Instance deref_var: Deref var := deref_base VarSubstVar.

Instance deref_avar: Deref avar := deref_base AvarSubstVar.

Instance deref_def: Deref def :=
fun e d => match d with
| def_fld l x => def_fld l (deref e x)
| def_met l t => def_met l t
| def_typ l T => def_typ l T
end.

Fixpoint deref_defs_fix(e: renv)(ds: defs) :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => defs_nil
| defs_cons ds d => defs_cons (deref_defs_fix e ds) (deref_def e d)
end.

Instance deref_defs: Deref defs := deref_defs_fix.

Class DerefInFv (A: Set) (AD: Deref A) (AF: FreeVar A):=
  deref_in_fv x e (d: A):
    x \in fv (deref e d) ->
    x \in fv d \/ x \in fv_env e.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_heap x T => objctx_heap x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  end.

Instance ObjctxSealable: Sealable objctx := objctx_seal_rec.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Constructive_sets.

Inductive ctx: Set :=

| ctx_empty

| ctx_push: ctx -> var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx

| ctx_stop: ctx -> ctx

| ctx_hide: ctx -> ctx
.

Notation "G '§' v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push G v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push ctx_empty v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʸ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_loc T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʷ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_ref T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʳ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_recv T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ᶻ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_par T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˢ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_self T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˣ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_let T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1
| ctx_push c v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_concat G1 c) v vk t
| ctx_stop c => ctx_stop (ctx_concat G1 c)
| ctx_hide c => ctx_hide (ctx_concat G1 c)
end.

Notation "E §& F" := (ctx_concat E F)
  (at level 28, left associativity) : env_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_map(fn: typ -> typ)(G: ctx): ctx :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => ctx_empty
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_map fn G1) v vk (fn t)
| ctx_stop G1 => ctx_stop (ctx_map fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => ctx_hide (ctx_map fn G1)
end.

Fixpoint ctx_collect_values(A: Set)(fn: typ -> fset A)(G: ctx): fset A :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => (fn t) \u (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_stop G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
end.

Notation ctx_fv := (ctx_collect_values fv).

Instance CtxFreeVar : FreeVar ctx := ctx_fv.

Fixpoint ctx_keys(G: ctx): list var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => nil
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  v :: (ctx_keys G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_keys G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_keys G
end.

Fixpoint ctx_dom(G: ctx): fset var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  \{ v } \u (ctx_dom G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_dom G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_dom G
end.

Notation "x '§#' E" := (x \notin (ctx_dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:
  ctx_weakens G ->
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_hide_push G v vk t:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_weakens_hide_hide G:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds: var -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_binds_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v2 vk t2)
| ctx_binds_hide(v: var)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds_k_after: var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_k_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk t (ctx_push G v vk t) G
| ctx_binds_k_n(v v2: var)(vk1 vk2: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G1 G2: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t G1 G2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t (ctx_push G1 v2 vk2 t2) G2
.

match c with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push c v vk2 t => If (vk = vk2) then (\{ v } \u (ctx_kdom vk c)) else (ctx_kdom vk c)
| ctx_stop c => ctx_kdom vk c
| ctx_hide c => ctx_kdom vk c
end.

Notation "G '/[§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_vars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_vars xs ys)).

Notation "G '/[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_vars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_ctx_pvars xs ys := (ctx_map (subst_pvars xs ys)).

Notation "G '//[§' xs '-->' ys ']'" :=
  (subst_ctx_pvars xs ys G) (xs at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_stop G => ctx_stop (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_hide G => ctx_hide (ctx_seal_rec n x G)
  | ctx_push G y vk t => ctx_push (ctx_seal_rec n x G) y vk (seal_rec n x t)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics ConfigTyping.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Section SoundnessTyped.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** A "typed progress" theorem suffices for the task's dichotomy: at each step
    we may choose a successor which is itself typable, so no preservation for
    arbitrary operational steps is required. *)

Lemma soundness_via_typed_progress : forall (C0:config) (U:typ),
  config_typd typing_mode C0 U ->
  (forall (c:config) (T:typ), config_typd typing_mode c T ->
     answer c \/
     (exists c', config_typd typing_mode c' T /\ c ↦ c')) ->
  (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config), answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca) \/
  (forall (n:nat), exists Cn:config, C0 ⊣n↦* Cn).
Proof.
  intros C0 U Hinit Hprog.
  destruct (classic (exists (n:nat) (Ca:config),
              answer Ca /\ C0 ⊣n↦* Ca)) as [Hterm|Hnonterm].
  - left. exact Hterm.
  - right. intro n.

Lemma ty_trm_sub_elim : forall G e t U,
  ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t U ->
  exists T, ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e t T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e t U H. induction H.
  - (* var *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* apply *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_apply; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* read *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_read; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* write *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_write; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* call *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_call; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* let *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_let; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* lit *) eexists; split; [eapply ty_trm_lit; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - (* sub *) destruct IHty_trm as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_sub_elim : forall G e x U,
  ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x U ->
  exists T, ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T /\
            subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros G e x U H. induction H.
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_var_var; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_intro; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_rec_elim; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - exists (typ_and T U); split; [eapply ty_var_and; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
  - destruct IHty_var as [T0 [Ht Hsub]]. exists T0. split; auto.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eauto.
  - eexists; split; [eapply ty_var_mut_top; eauto | apply subtyp_refl].
Qed.

Lemma trm_empty_head : forall t T,
  ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ t ∶ T ->
  (exists s u, t = trm_let s u) \/ (exists l u, t = trm_lit l u).
Proof.
  intros t T H.
  change (ty_trm typing_mode ctx_empty objctx_empty empty t T) in H.
  dependent induction H.
  all: try (exfalso;
    match goal with Hx : ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ ?x ∶ _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (ty_var_in_dom Hx) as Hd; cbn in Hd; rewrite in_empty in Hd; assumption end).
  all: try (left; eexists; eexists; reflexivity).
  all: try (right; eexists; eexists; reflexivity).
  all: try (apply IHty_trm; reflexivity).

Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_fun t11 t12) (typ_fun t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| tyq_typ_bnd(e: renv)(t1 t2: typ):
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_bnd t1) (typ_bnd t2)
| tyq_typ_met m (e: renv) t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    (forall x y, typing_equiv e (open_met x y t13) (open_met x y t23)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_met m t11 t12 t13)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m t21 t22 t23))
.

Existing Instance tyq_typ.

Inductive tyq_var_alt: renv -> var -> var -> Prop :=
| tyq_var_alt_eq e v:
    tyq_var_alt e v v
| tyq_var_alt_wy e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w y
| tyq_var_alt_yw e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e y w
| tyq_var_alt_ww e w1 w2 y:
    binds w1 y e ->
    binds w2 y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w1 w2.

Variable canon_fun_apply :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 (Sarg Tres Tstack:typ) (z:var),
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_fun Sarg Tres) ->
    exists y tf S0 T0h L,
      binds x y e /\
      binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma /\
      ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0h) G /\
      (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
         ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
           (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0h)) /\
      @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref /\

Lemma weak_tp_apply_from_canon : forall (x z:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode
    (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros x z Sigma e Lv fs U Hcfg.
  set (cold := trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  destruct Hcfg as [G Hweak].
  inversion Hweak as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_apply_l).
  assert (Hkz : ctx_k G z v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_apply_r).
  destruct (ty_trm_apply_inv Hty) as [Sarg [Tres [Hx [Hz Hs]]]].
  destruct (ty_var_sub_elim Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
  destruct (@canon_fun_apply G e Sigma x T0 Sarg Tres T z Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub)
    as [y [tf [S0 [T0h [L [Hbxy [Hby [Hcby [Hbody [Htf_tf [Hcltf [HsubS Hsubz]]]]]]]]]]]].
  assert (Hbodyz : ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e
                     (open z tf) (open z T0h)).
  { eapply open_body_open_at_par with (G := G) (e := e) (L := L)
      (t := tf) (S := S0) (U := T0h) (x := z) (T0 := Sarg);
      [ exact Hbody | exact Hz | exact HsubS ]. }
  assert (Hnew : ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z tf) T).
  { eapply ty_trm_sub; eassumption. }
  assert (Htfnew : @all_tfree_k trm _ G (open z tf) v_ref).
  { eapply all_tfree_k_trm_open; eassumption. }
  assert (Hcc' : config_closed (open z tf ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; fv_config cold)).
  { eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    - apply closed_trm_open_zero. exact Hcltf.
    - exact Hcs.
    - exact Hch. }
  exists (open z tf ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; fv_config cold).
  split.
  - exists G. eapply weak_config_c.
    + exact Hir.
    + exact Hhc.
    + exact Hst.
    + exact Hts.
    + exact Hnew.
    + exact Htfnew.
    + exact Hcc'.
  - eapply red_apply; eauto.
Qed.

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Heap_fun Closed_extra Canonical Canonical4 Canonical5.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Closedness of a heap binding. *)

Lemma heap_closed_binds_closed : forall (Sigma:heap) y (it:item),
  heap_closed Sigma -> binds y it Sigma -> closed it.
Proof.
  intros Sigma y it Hch. induction Hch as [|S z i Hch IH]; intros Hb.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv. exact Hb.
  - destruct (binds_push_inv Hb) as [[Ey Ei]|[Hne HbS]].
    + subst. match goal with Hcl : closed i |- _ => exact Hcl end.
    + eapply IH. exact HbS.
Qed.

Lemma closed_item_fun_inv : forall (t:trm),
  closed (item_fun t) -> closed_below 1 t.
Proof.
  intros t H m x Hm.
  destruct m as [|m']; [inversion Hm|].
  specialize (H m' x). cbn in H. injection H as E. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma closed_below_fun_item_of_bind : forall (Sigma:heap) y tf,
  heap_closed Sigma -> binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma -> closed_below 1 tf.
Proof.
  intros Sigma y tf Hch Hb.
  eapply closed_item_fun_inv.
  eapply heap_closed_binds_closed; eassumption.
Qed.

(** * Static loc-type to ref-type correspondence. *)

Lemma mode_refcap_corr_none :
  mode_refcaps' typing_mode = mode_refcaps_none ->
  mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode = mode_refcap_corr_same.
Proof. destruct typing_mode; cbn; intros H; try discriminate; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma mode_refcap_corr_mutability :
  mode_refcaps' typing_mode = mode_refcaps_mutability ->
  mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode = mode_refcap_corr_ref_mutability.
Proof. destruct typing_mode; cbn; intros H; try discriminate; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma inert_loc_ref_corr : forall T,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T v_loc ->
  typ_corr (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T T /\
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T v_ref.
Proof.
  intros T H. dependent destruction H.
  - split.
    + eapply typ_corr_fun. exact H.
    + eapply inert_typ_fun. exact H.
  - unfold refcap_inert_type in H0.
    destruct (mode_refcaps' typing_mode) eqn:Eref.
    + cbn in H0.
      assert (Ecorr : mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode = mode_refcap_corr_same)
        by (apply mode_refcap_corr_none; exact Eref).
      split.
      * eapply typ_corr_obj. rewrite Ecorr. reflexivity.
      * eapply inert_typ_obj.
        -- exact H.
        -- unfold refcap_inert_type. rewrite Eref. cbn. exact H0.
        -- exact H1.
    + cbn in H0. dependent destruction H0.
      assert (Ecorr : mode_refcap_corr' typing_mode =
                      mode_refcap_corr_ref_mutability)
        by (apply mode_refcap_corr_mutability; exact Eref).
      split.
      * eapply typ_corr_obj. rewrite Ecorr. cbn.
        exists typ_bot. split; reflexivity.
      * eapply inert_typ_obj.
        -- exact H.
        -- unfold refcap_inert_type. rewrite Eref. cbn.
           eapply refacp_inert_mutability_ref.
        -- exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma inert_typ_of_binds_loc : forall G v Ty,
  ctx_ok G -> inert G -> ctx_k G v v_loc -> ctx_binds v Ty G ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) Ty v_loc.
Proof.
  intros G v Ty Hok Hinert Hk Hb.
  destruct (@ctx_k_binds_k_after G v v_loc Hk) as [T [G2 Hka]].
  assert (HbT : ctx_binds v T G) by (eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds; exact Hka).
  assert (Ity : inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T v_loc)
    by (eapply (@inert_k_typ typing_mode G v v_loc T G2); eassumption).
  assert (E : T = Ty) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique; eassumption).
  subst. exact Ity.
Qed.

(** * Function-item extraction once the heap item is known to be a function. *)

Lemma fun_item_static_from_bind : forall G e Sigma y tf,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma ->
  exists S0 T0 L,
    ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0) G /\
    (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
         (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0)) /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma y tf Hhc Hb.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  assert (Hydom : y \in dom Sigma)
    by (eapply get_some_inv; apply binds_get; exact Hb).
  destruct (@ty_item_s_inv typing_mode G e Sigma y (Hitem y Hydom)) as [HF|HO].
  - destruct HF as [S0 [T0 [t0 [L [Hmf [Hcb [Hbind [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]].
    assert (E : item_fun tf = item_fun t0)
      by (exact (@binds_functional item y (item_fun tf) (item_fun t0) Sigma Hb Hbind)).
    injection E as E. subst t0.
    exists S0, T0, L. split; [exact Hcb|]. split; assumption.
  - destruct HO as [U [S [ds [T [Hcb [Hbind _]]]]]].
    exfalso. pose proof (@binds_functional item y (item_fun tf) (item_obj ds) Sigma Hb Hbind) as E.
    discriminate E.
Qed.

(** * Conditional reduction of [canon_fun_apply].

    The remaining inputs are exactly:
      - selector elimination / the choice of the function heap item [tf] for
        [x] (captured by [binds x y e] and [binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma]);
      - the two function-subtyping compatibility facts [Sarg <: S0] and
        [open z T0h <: Tstack] for the static function type of that item;
      - the heap-closedness needed for the [closed_below 1 tf] conclusion,
        which is not implied by [heap_correspond]. *)

Lemma canon_fun_apply_from_item : forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T0 Sarg Tres Tstack:typ) (z y:var) (tf:trm),
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  heap_closed Sigma ->
  binds x y e ->
  binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma ->
  (forall S0 T0h L,
     ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0h) G ->
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
        ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
          (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0h)) ->
     @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref ->
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack) ->
  exists y0 tf0 S0 T0h L,
    binds x y0 e /\
    binds y0 (item_fun tf0) Sigma /\
    ctx_binds y0 (typ_fun S0 T0h) G /\
    (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
         (open x0 tf0) (open x0 T0h)) /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf0 v_ref /\
    closed_below 1 tf0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x T0 Sarg Tres Tstack z y tf Hhc Hch Hbxy Hby Hcompat.
  destruct (@fun_item_static_from_bind G e Sigma y tf Hhc Hby)
    as [S0 [T0h [L [Hcby [Hbody Htf]]]]].
  destruct (Hcompat S0 T0h L Hcby Hbody Htf) as [HsubS Hsubz].
  assert (Hcl : closed_below 1 tf)
    by (eapply closed_below_fun_item_of_bind; eassumption).
  exists y, tf, S0, T0h, L. repeat split; assumption.
Qed.


(** * Function interface with the result-type hypothesis supplied by the
    caller ([ty_trm_apply_inv] gives [open z Tres <: Tstack]). *)

Lemma canon_fun_apply_from_item_res :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T0 Sarg Tres Tstack:typ)
         (z y:var) (tf:trm),
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  heap_closed Sigma ->
  binds x y e ->
  binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z Tres) Tstack ->
  (forall S0 T0h L,
     ctx_binds y (typ_fun S0 T0h) G ->
     (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
        ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
          (open x0 tf) (open x0 T0h)) ->
     @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf v_ref ->
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) (open z Tres)) ->
  exists y0 tf0 S0 T0h L,
    binds x y0 e /\
    binds y0 (item_fun tf0) Sigma /\
    ctx_binds y0 (typ_fun S0 T0h) G /\
    (forall x0, x0 \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e
         (open x0 tf0) (open x0 T0h)) /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G tf0 v_ref /\
    closed_below 1 tf0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Sarg S0 /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x T0 Sarg Tres Tstack z y tf Hhc Hch Hbxy Hby Hsres Hcompat.
  destruct (@fun_item_static_from_bind G e Sigma y tf Hhc Hby)
    as [S0 [T0h [L [Hcby [Hbody Htf]]]]].
  destruct (Hcompat S0 T0h L Hcby Hbody Htf) as [HsubS Hrel].
  assert (Hcl : closed_below 1 tf)
    by (eapply closed_below_fun_item_of_bind; eassumption).
  assert (Hsubz : subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open z T0h) Tstack)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption).
  exists y, tf, S0, T0h, L. repeat split; assumption.
Qed.

(** * Conditional reduction of [canon_fld_read_weak].

    The remaining inputs are the field-canonical data (which needs selector
    elimination) and the static stored-type relation [Ty <: V].  The
    [ty_corr]/inertness bridge from the location type to a reference type is
    proved unconditionally by [inert_loc_ref_corr]. *)

Lemma canon_fld_read_weak_from_field_data :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (x:var) (T0:typ) (a:fld_label) (S U V Tstack:typ) (y:var) (ds:defs) (v:var) (Ty:typ),
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  inert G ->
  ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  binds x y e ->
  binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) ->
  ctx_k G v v_loc ->
  ctx_binds v Ty G ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Ty V ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
  exists y0 ds0 v0 Ty0 Tw,
    binds x y0 e /\
    binds y0 (item_obj ds0) Sigma /\
    defs_has ds0 (def_fld a (avar_f v0)) /\
    ctx_k G v0 v_loc /\
    ctx_binds v0 Ty0 G /\
    typ_corr Tw Ty0 /\
    inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw Tstack.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x T0 a S U V Tstack y ds v Ty Hhc Hinert Hkx
         Hbxy Hby Hhas Hkv Hbyv HsubTyV HsubVT.
  assert (Hok : ctx_ok G) by (eapply heap_correspond_ctx_ok; exact Hhc).
  assert (Ity : inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) Ty v_loc)
    by (eapply inert_typ_of_binds_loc; eassumption).
  destruct (@inert_loc_ref_corr Ty Ity) as [Hcorr Hir].
  assert (HTwT : subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Ty Tstack)
    by (eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption).
  exists y, ds, v, Ty, Ty.
  split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Hby|]. split; [exact Hhas|].
  split; [exact Hkv|]. split; [exact Hbyv|]. split; [exact Hcorr|].
  split; [exact Hir|exact HTwT].
Qed.

(** * Residual interface.

    The two requested static interfaces are reduced above to the following
    exact remaining facts.

    [canon_fun_apply] additionally needs:
      (a) [heap_closed Sigma] (or any other source of closedness): it is NOT
          implied by [heap_correspond], yet [closed_below 1 tf] is required;
      (b) selection of a heap item [binds x y e /\ binds y (item_fun tf) Sigma]
          from [ty_var x T0] and [T0 <: typ_fun Sarg Tres], i.e. the full
          function canonical form;
      (c) the compatibility facts [Sarg <: S0] and
          [open z T0h <: open z Tres] for the static function type
          [typ_fun S0 T0h] stored at that item.  Given the caller's
          [Hsres : open z Tres <: Tstack] (from [ty_trm_apply_inv]),
          [canon_fun_apply_from_item_res] derives the required
          [open z T0h <: Tstack] by transitivity.  The original interface is
          not derivable from its stated hypotheses alone because it has no
          hypothesis relating [Tstack] to [Tres]; the corrected interface
          with [Hsres] is [canon_fun_apply_from_item_res].

    [canon_fld_read_weak] additionally needs:
      (a) the field-canonical data
          [binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\ defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v))]
          for the field label [a], i.e. selector elimination plus item
          canonical forms;
      (b) the static stored-type relation [Ty <: V] for the chosen location
          type [Ty] of [v] (or a direct [Ty <: Tstack] relation).

    Everything else in both interfaces is discharged here:
    [ctx_k]/[ctx_binds] extraction, [inert_typ Ty v_loc -> typ_corr Ty Ty /
    inert_typ Ty v_ref], transitivity [Ty <: V <: Tstack], heap-item function
    body/all-tfree extraction, and heap-closedness to [closed_below 1 tf]. *)

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Selector-free subtyping.

    [subtyp_nosel] is the fragment of subtyping consisting of the rules that
    are available in the function modes and that do not use the selector
    rules [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].  In the function modes the additional
    top/nocap/mutability rules are disabled; the no-capability rules are
    included because [subtyp_nocap_fun] is enabled. *)

Inductive subtyp_nosel : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ns_top : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T typ_top
| ns_bot : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_bot T
| ns_refl : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T T
| ns_trans : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U
| ns_and11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) T
| ns_and12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) U
| ns_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S (typ_and T U)
| ns_or11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_or T U)
| ns_or12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e U (typ_or T U)
| ns_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_or S U) T
| ns_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U1 U2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ns_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ns_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ns_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    subtyp_nosel G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
     subtyp_nosel (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ns_tyq : forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2
| ns_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ns_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ns_nocap_bnd : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ns_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ns_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
.

Lemma subtyp_nosel_sound : forall G e S T,
  subtyp_nosel G e S T -> subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e S T H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - eapply subtyp_and2; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_or11.
  - apply subtyp_or12.
  - eapply subtyp_or2; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fld; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_typ; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fun; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_met; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_tyq; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_typ_and.
  - apply subtyp_dist.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_bnd.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_typ.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_fld.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_met.
====
Lemma record_dec_typ_safepair_field : forall A S T,
  record_dec (dec_typ A S T) -> SafePairF S T.
Proof.
  intros A S T Hrd Hnf.
  destruct (record_dec_typ_bounds Hrd) as [E|E]; subst; auto.
  exfalso. eapply NoField_bot_false. exact Hnf.
Qed.

Lemma NoFun_open : forall T n x,
  NoFun T -> NoFun (open_rec n x T).
Proof.
  intros T n x H. induction H; cbn.
  - apply nf_top.
  - apply nf_bnd.
  - apply nf_and; assumption.
  - apply nf_or_l; assumption.
  - apply nf_or_r; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma NoField_open : forall T n x,
  NoField T -> NoField (open_rec n x T).
Proof.
  intros T n x H. induction H; cbn.
  - apply nfield_top.
  - apply nfield_bnd.
  - apply nfield_fun.
  - apply nfield_and; assumption.
  - apply nfield_or_l; assumption.
  - apply nfield_or_r; assumption.
Qed.

(** * Residual interface.

    The results above cover the fragment [subtyp_nosel]: all function-mode
    subtyping rules except the selector rules [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].
    They include transitive chains.  [inert_subtyp_fun_nosel] and
    [inert_subtyp_not_field_nosel] are the canonical-form shape statements
    for that fragment; [record_open_met_label_nosel] is the method-label
    transport for a record source in that fragment.  The defs-label to
    [def_met] step is unconditional ([defs_has_met_of_label]), and
    [canonical_obj_met_from_binding_label] assembles the heap witness once
    the binding label is known.

    Extending these statements from [subtyp_nosel] to full [subtyp] requires
    eliminating [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].  The exact missing invariants are
    the receiver-upper statements

      SafeFunReceiver: inert G ->
        ty_var G e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) -> NoFun S -> NoFun T
      SafeFieldReceiver: inert G ->
        ty_var G e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) -> NoField S -> NoField T

    A context-free [NoFun]/[NoField] is not closed under full subtyping:
    [subtyp_sel2] turns a safe lower bound [open y S] into a selector type,
    and the safety of the selector's upper bound is only known from the
    receiver's typing.  The object-interface bound facts above
    ([SafePair]/[SafePairF] and [record_dec_typ_safepair]) are the base case
    of the receiver proof.  A naive pairwise invariant is insufficient at
    [subtyp_typ_and]: two projected type members with the same label may have
    different safe-pair bounds, while the hidden common [record_dec] bound is
    what makes both upper bounds safe.  A correct proof needs a simultaneous
    [ts_mutind]/fuel induction over [ty_var]/[subtyp]/[ty_incap] that carries
    the receiver's interval [lower <: Q <: upper] through
    [ty_rec_elim]/[ty_var_sub].  Consequently the full statements
    [inert_subtyp_fun], [inert_subtyp_not_field],
    [record_open_met_label] (for full [subtyp]), and the exact
    [ty_var_met_canonical] / [ty_var_field_canonical] / [ty_var_fun_canonical]
    are not claimed here. *)

End WithTypingMode.

(** * The selector-free canonical-form targets. *)

Lemma inert_subtyp_fun_nosel : forall G e T vk S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.
Proof.
  intros G e T vk S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofun T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hnf].
  - exists S0, U0; exact HT.
  - exfalso. apply (@NoFun_fun_false S U).
    eapply (@NoFun_subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_fun S U)); eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_subtyp_not_field_nosel : forall G e T vk a S U,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.
Proof.
  intros G e T vk a S U Hmf Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofield T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hf].
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.
    pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S0 U0)
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub (nfield_fun S0 U0)) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
  - pose proof (@NoField_subtyp_nosel G e T
                  (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub Hf) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
Qed.

(** * Method analogue of the record-label transport.

    The label of a method declaration is [label_met m]; the formal transport
    statement is recorded here.  [record_typ_has_label] and
    [Canonical.v]'s [defs_has_fld_of_label] give the field analogue; the
    method version needs the corresponding defs-to-method step below. *)

Lemma label_of_met_inv : forall (d:def) m,
  label_of d = label_met m -> exists t, d = def_met m t.
Proof.
  intros d m H. destruct d; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  injection H as E. subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma defs_varkinds_has_met : forall G (ds:defs) m t,
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
  exists t', defs_has ds (def_met m t').
Proof. eauto. Qed.

Lemma defs_has_met_of_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T m,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  forall y (U:typ) ls,
    T = open y U -> record_typ U ls -> label_met m \in ls ->
    exists t, defs_has ds (def_met m t).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T m Hty y U ls HT Hrec Hlab. subst T.
  destruct (@ty_defs_record typing_mode G Go e ds (open y U) Hty) as [Hex Hinvs].
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as Hrec'.
  destruct (Hinvs ls Hrec' (label_met m) Hlab) as [d [Hhas Hlabel]].
  eapply label_of_met_inv in Hlabel. destruct Hlabel as [t Hd]. subst d.
  exists t. exact Hhas.
Qed.

Lemma canonical_obj_met_from_binding_label :
  forall G e Sigma x Tw (U:typ) S ls m,
  @heap_correspond typing_mode G e Sigma -> @inert typing_mode G ->
  ctx_k G x v_ref ->
  ctx_binds x Tw G -> Tw = typ_objref U S ->
  record_typ U ls -> label_met m \in ls ->
  exists y ds t, binds x y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
                 defs_has ds (def_met m t).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x Tw U S ls m Hhc Hinert Hk Bx HTw Hrec Hlab.
  destruct (@item_canonical typing_mode G e Sigma x Hhc Hinert Hk) as
    [y [Tw' [Ty [Hbxy [Hydom [Bx' [Kky [Tcorr Hdisj]]]]]]]].
  assert (E : Tw' = Tw) by (eapply ctx_ok_binds_unique;
    [eapply (@heap_correspond_ctx_ok typing_mode G e Sigma); exact Hhc | exact Bx' | exact Bx]).
  subst Tw'.
  destruct Hdisj as [[S0 [T0 [tf [Hmf [HTw' [HTy Bitem]]]]]]
                    |[U0 [S1 [S2 [ds [HTw' [HTy [Bitem [Hrec0 [Hds Hvk]]]]]]]]]].
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. discriminate HTw.
  - rewrite HTw' in HTw. injection HTw as HU HS. subst U0.
    destruct Hrec0 as [ls0 Hrec0].
    assert (Hls : ls0 = ls) by (eapply record_typ_labels_eq; eassumption).
    subst ls0.
    destruct (@defs_has_met_of_label G (objctx_heap y U) e ds (open y U) m
                Hds y U ls eq_refl Hrec Hlab) as [t Hhas].
    exists y, ds, t. split; [exact Hbxy|]. split; [exact Bitem|exact Hhas].
Qed.



(** * Reduction of the full canonical-form targets to full safety closure.

    The only difference between these and [inert_subtyp_fun_nosel] /
    [inert_subtyp_not_field_nosel] is the closure hypothesis, which is exactly
    what selector elimination must supply. *)

Lemma inert_subtyp_fun_of_nofun_closed :
  (forall G e T U,
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U -> NoFun T -> NoFun U) ->
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  forall G e T vk S U,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T (typ_fun S U) ->
  exists S0 U0, T = typ_fun S0 U0.
Proof.
  intros Hclosed Hmf G e T vk S U Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofun T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hnf].
  - exists S0, U0; exact HT.
  - exfalso. apply (@NoFun_fun_false S U).
    eapply Hclosed; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma inert_subtyp_not_field_of_nofield_closed :
  (forall G e T U,
     subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T U -> NoField T -> NoField U) ->
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  forall G e T vk a S U,
  inert_typ (typing_mode:=typing_mode) T vk ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T
    (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hclosed Hmf G e T vk a S U Hi Hsub.
  destruct (@inert_mode_fun_or_nofield T vk Hmf Hi)
    as [[S0 [U0 HT]]|Hf].
  - rewrite HT in Hsub.
    pose proof (Hclosed G e (typ_fun S0 U0) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U))
                  Hsub (nfield_fun S0 U0)) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
  - pose proof (Hclosed G e T (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) Hsub Hf) as Hbad.
    eapply NoField_rcd_false. exact Hbad.
Qed.

(** * A label invariant for method records.

    [LabelsIn ls T] over-approximates the method labels that can be exposed
    at the top level by selector-free subtyping from a type built out of
    record components with those labels.  The record components with
    [dec_typ]/[dec_fld] labels impose no constraint on [ls]; only top-level
    [dec_met] labels are tracked. *)

Inductive LabelsIn (ls:fset label) : typ -> Prop :=
| li_rcd_fld : forall a T1 T2, LabelsIn ls (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| li_rcd_typ : forall A T1 T2, LabelsIn ls (typ_rcd (dec_typ A T1 T2))
| li_rcd_met : forall m TC TZ TR,
    label_met m \in ls -> LabelsIn ls (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR))
| li_and : forall T U,
    LabelsIn ls T -> LabelsIn ls U -> LabelsIn ls (typ_and T U)
| li_or_l : forall T U,
    LabelsIn ls T -> LabelsIn ls (typ_or T U)
| li_or_r : forall T U,
    LabelsIn ls U -> LabelsIn ls (typ_or T U)
| li_top : LabelsIn ls typ_top
| li_bnd : forall T, LabelsIn ls (typ_bnd T)
| li_fun : forall S T, LabelsIn ls (typ_fun S T).

Lemma LabelsIn_mono : forall ls ls' T,
  LabelsIn ls T -> ls \c ls' -> LabelsIn ls' T.
Proof.

Lemma LabelsIn_equiv : forall e ls T U,
  LabelsIn ls T -> typing_equiv e T U -> LabelsIn ls U.
Proof.
  intros e ls T U HLI Heq. change (tyq_typ e T U) in Heq.
  revert HLI. induction Heq; intros HLI.
  - exact HLI.
  - (* andor *) dependent destruction H.
    + inversion HLI; subst;
        eauto using li_rcd_fld, li_rcd_typ, li_rcd_met, li_and, li_or_l, li_or_r, li_top, li_bnd, li_fun.
    + inversion HLI; subst;
        eauto using li_rcd_fld, li_rcd_typ, li_rcd_met, li_and, li_or_l, li_or_r, li_top, li_bnd, li_fun.
  - (* fun *) apply li_fun.
  - (* fld *) apply li_rcd_fld.
  - (* typ *) apply li_rcd_typ.
  - (* sel normal *) inversion HLI.
  - (* sel *) inversion HLI.
  - (* bnd *) apply li_bnd.
  - (* met *) inversion HLI; subst. apply li_rcd_met; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma LabelsIn_subtyp_nosel : forall G e ls T U,
  subtyp_nosel G e T U -> LabelsIn ls T -> LabelsIn ls U.
Proof.
  intros G e ls T U H. dependent induction H; intros HLI.
  - (* top *) apply li_top.
  - (* bot *) inversion HLI.
  - (* refl *) exact HLI.
  - (* trans *) apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. exact HLI.
  - (* and11 *) inversion HLI; subst; assumption.
  - (* and12 *) inversion HLI; subst; assumption.
  - (* and2 *) apply li_and.

    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. exact HLI.
  - (* or11 *) apply li_or_l. exact HLI.
  - (* or12 *) apply li_or_r. exact HLI.
  - (* or2 *) inversion HLI; subst.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel1. assumption.
    + apply IHsubtyp_nosel2. assumption.
  - (* fld *) apply li_rcd_fld.
  - (* typ *) apply li_rcd_typ.
  - (* fun *) apply li_fun.
  - (* met *) inversion HLI; subst. apply li_rcd_met. assumption.
  - (* tyq *) eapply LabelsIn_equiv; eassumption.
  - (* typ_and *) inversion HLI; subst. apply li_rcd_typ.
  - (* dist *) inversion HLI; subst.

    | H1 : LabelsIn ls ?A, Hor : LabelsIn ls (typ_or ?B ?C) |- _ =>
      inversion Hor; subst;
      [ apply li_or_l; apply li_and; [exact H1|assumption]

    end.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) inversion HLI.
  - (* nocap_typ *) inversion HLI.
  - (* nocap_fld *) inversion HLI.
  - (* nocap_met *) inversion HLI.
  - (* nocap_fun *) inversion HLI.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_labelsin_open : forall (U:typ) ls x,
  record_typ U ls -> LabelsIn ls (open x U).
Proof.
  intros U ls x Hrec. induction Hrec as [D l Hdec Heq|T ls D l Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot].
  - subst l. cbn. dependent destruction Hdec.
    + cbn. apply li_rcd_typ.
    + cbn. apply li_rcd_typ.
    + cbn. apply li_rcd_fld.
    + cbn. apply li_rcd_met. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - cbn. apply li_and.
    + eapply LabelsIn_mono; [exact IH|].

    + subst l. dependent destruction Hdec.

      * cbn. apply li_rcd_typ.
      * cbn. apply li_rcd_fld.
      * cbn. apply li_rcd_met.

Instance CtxSealable: Sealable ctx := ctx_seal_rec.

Inductive ctx_vis: ctx -> var -> Prop :=
| ctx_vis_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v vk t) v
| ctx_vis_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_vis G v ->
    ctx_vis (ctx_push G v2 vk t) v

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** ** Insertion weakening for ty_capbnd *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_weaken_insert : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
  - apply ty_capbnd_top.
  - apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - apply ty_capbnd_typ.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_sel.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_ignore. assumption.
  - apply ty_capbnd_met.
  - apply ty_capbnd_fld.
  - (* sel *) eapply ty_capbnd_sel.
    + destruct (@var_sub_incap_weaken_insert typing_mode) as [Hv _].
      exact (Hv G objctx_empty e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T)) H G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHty_capbnd G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - apply ty_capbnd_rec.
  - (* and *) eapply ty_capbnd_and.
    + exact (IHty_capbnd G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHty_capbnd0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - (* or *) eapply ty_capbnd_or.
    + exact (IHty_capbnd G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
    + exact (IHty_capbnd0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - apply ty_capbnd_all.
Qed.

(** ** Top-push version for capability bounds *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_weaken : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H y vk S Hn.
  exact (@ty_capbnd_weaken_insert C G Go e T U H G ctx_empty eq_refl
           y vk S (@notin_dom_obj_l y G Go Hn) (@notin_empty var y)).
Qed.

(** ** Insertion weakening for viewpoint adaptation *)

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_cap_weaken_insert : forall C x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros C x G Go e Tf Tr H.
  induction H.
  intros G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2.
  eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine.
  - destruct (@var_sub_incap_weaken_insert typing_mode) as [_ [_ Hincap]].
    exact (Hincap G Go e T Tstrip H G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
  - exact (@ty_capbnd_weaken_insert C G Go e T Tcap H0 G1 G2 Heq z vkz Sz H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_cap_weaken : forall C x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros C x G Go e Tf Tr H y vk S Hn.
  exact (@viewpoint_adapt_cap_weaken_insert C x G Go e Tf Tr H G ctx_empty eq_refl
           y vk S (@notin_dom_obj_l y G Go Hn) (@notin_empty var y)).
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_weaken_insert : forall x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros x G Go e Tf Tr H G1 G2 Heq y vk S H1 H2.
  unfold viewpoint_adapt in *.
  destruct (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' typing_mode); cbn in *.
  - exact H.
  - eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_weaken_insert; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_weaken : forall x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
    viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros x G Go e Tf Tr H y vk S Hn.
  exact (@viewpoint_adapt_weaken_insert x G Go e Tf Tr H G ctx_empty eq_refl
           y vk S (@notin_dom_obj_l y G Go Hn) (@notin_empty var y)).
Qed.

(** ** Context algebra helpers for typing weakening *)

Lemma ctx_obj_concat : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) (Go : objctx),
  (G1 §& G2) §§& Go = G1 §& (G2 §§& Go).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 Go. destruct Go; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply ctx_push_decomp.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC TC2 : typ),
  ctx_met_refined (G1 §& G2) xz TZ xc TC TC2 =
  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2).
Proof.
  intros. change (G1 §& G2 §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2 =
                  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2)).
  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_mid_push : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) y vk (S : typ) x vk' (T : typ),
  (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) § x / vk' ~ T =
  G1 § y / vk ~ S §& (G2 § x / vk' ~ T).
Proof.
  intros. change ((G1 § y / vk ~ S) §& G2 §& (x / vk' ~ T) =
                  (G1 § y / vk ~ S) §& (G2 §& (x / vk' ~ T))).
  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_in_dom : forall (G : ctx) x, ctx_vis G x -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G x H. induction H; cbn.
  - rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - rewrite in_union. right. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_insert_direct : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x,
  ctx_vis (G1 §& G2) x ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
    ctx_vis (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) x.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2. revert G1.
  induction G2; intros G1 x Hv y vk S Hn.
  - cbn in *. cbn.
    assert (Hxy : x <> y).
    { intro E. subst y. apply Hn. apply ctx_vis_in_dom. exact Hv. }
    eapply ctx_vis_n; [ exact Hxy | exact Hv ].
  - cbn in Hn. rewrite notin_union in Hn.
    destruct Hn as [Hnv Hnc]. cbn. cbn in Hv.
    inversion Hv; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + rewrite notin_singleton in Hnv.
      eapply ctx_vis_n; [ exact H4 | ].
      eapply IHG2; [ exact H5 | exact Hnc ].
  - cbn in Hv. inversion Hv.
  - cbn in Hv. inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_insert : forall (C : ctx) x, ctx_vis C x ->
  forall G1 G2 : ctx, C = G1 §& G2 ->
  forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom C -> ctx_vis (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) x.
Proof.
  intros C x Hv G1 G2 Heq y vk S Hn. subst C.
  eapply ctx_vis_insert_direct; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_met : forall y (G : ctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC : typ),
  y \notin ctx_dom G -> y <> xz -> y <> xc ->
  y \notin ctx_dom (ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC).
Proof.
  intros. apply notin_dom_push; [|exact H1].
  apply notin_dom_push; [|exact H0]. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_met_refined : forall y (G : ctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC TC2 : typ),
  y \notin ctx_dom G -> y <> xz -> y <> xc ->
  y \notin ctx_dom (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2).
Proof.
  intros. apply notin_dom_push; [|exact H1].
  apply notin_dom_push; [|exact H0]. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_obj_met : forall y (G : ctx) (Go : objctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC : typ),
  y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) -> y <> xz -> y <> xc ->
  y \notin ctx_dom (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G Go xz TZ xc TC).
Proof.
  intros y G Go xz TZ xc TC Hn Hxz Hxc.
  destruct Go as [|x0 T0|y0 T0]; destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode);
    cbn in *; repeat rewrite notin_union in *; repeat rewrite notin_singleton in *;
    intuition (subst; auto).
  all: try (rewrite ctx_dom_vis_hide in *; auto).
  all: try (apply notin_dom_push; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ctx_hide_concat : forall (G1 G2 : ctx),
  ctx_hide (G1 §& G2) = G1 §& ctx_hide G2.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_hide_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC : typ),
  ctx_met (ctx_hide (G1 §& G2)) xz TZ xc TC =
  G1 §& (ctx_hide G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite ctx_hide_concat.
  apply ctx_met_decomp.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_hide_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) xz (TZ : typ) xc (TC TC2 : typ),
  ctx_met_refined (ctx_hide (G1 §& G2)) xz TZ xc TC TC2 =
  G1 §& (ctx_hide G2 §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite ctx_hide_concat.
  apply ctx_met_refined_decomp.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Trm_inv Closed_extra Kind_env_stack Heap_lookup.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ty_item_s_weaken_push : forall G e Sigma x y vk S e' Sigma',
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma x ->
  y \notin ctx_dom G ->
  env_binds_more e e' ->
  (forall z it, binds z it Sigma -> binds z it Sigma') ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) e' Sigma' x.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma x y vk S e' Sigma' Hitem Hy Hee' HSig.
  destruct (@ty_item_s_inv typing_mode G e Sigma x Hitem) as [HF|HO].
  - (* function item *)
    destruct HF as [S0 [T0 [t [L [Hmf [Hcb [Hbind [Hbody Htf]]]]]]]].
    assert (Hxy : x <> y).
    { intro E. subst y. apply Hy. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. exact Hcb. }
    eapply ty_item_fun_s.
    + exact Hmf.
    + eapply ctx_binds_weaken_push; eauto.
    + apply HSig; exact Hbind.
    + intros x0 Hx0. rewrite notin_union in Hx0. destruct Hx0 as [Hx0L Hx0y].
      pose proof (@ty_weaken_insert_mut typing_mode) as [Wtrm _].
      assert (Hyfull : y \notin ctx_dom ((G § x0 / v_par ~ S0) §§& objctx_empty)).
      { intro Hin. change (y \in ctx_dom (G § x0 / v_par ~ S0)) in Hin.
        pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G x0 v_par S0 y Hin) as [E|HinG].
        - subst y. apply Hx0y. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
        - apply Hy. exact HinG. }
      specialize (Wtrm _ _ _ _ _ (Hbody x0 Hx0L) G (ctx_push ctx_empty x0 v_par S0) eq_refl
                    y vk S Hyfull).
      pose proof (@ty_trm_env_mono typing_mode _ _ _ _ _ Wtrm e' Hee') as Wtrm'.
      change (ty_trm typing_mode ((G § y / vk ~ S) § x0 / v_par ~ S0) objctx_empty e'
                (open_rec 0 x0 t) (open_rec 0 x0 T0)).
      exact Wtrm'.
    + eapply all_tfree_k_trm_weaken; [exact Htf|].
      intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref y vk S); eauto.
  - (* object item *)
    destruct HO as [U0 [S0 [ds [T0 [Hcb [Hbind [Heq [Hds Hvk]]]]]]]].
    assert (Hxy : x <> y).
    { intro E. subst y. apply Hy. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. exact Hcb. }
    eapply ty_item_obj_s.
    + eapply ctx_binds_weaken_push; eauto.
    + apply HSig; exact Hbind.
    + exact Heq.
    + pose proof (@ty_defs_weaken typing_mode G (objctx_heap x U0) e ds (open_rec 0 x U0) Hds
                    y vk S Hy) as Hds'.
      pose proof (@ty_defs_env_mono typing_mode _ _ _ _ _ Hds' e' Hee') as Hds''.
      exact Hds''.
    + eapply (@defs_varkinds_weaken G ds y vk S); eauto.
Qed.


(** * renv_corr is monotone under pushing fresh context bindings *)

Lemma renv_corr_push : forall G e x vk T,
  renv_corr G e -> x \notin ctx_dom G -> renv_corr (G § x / vk ~ T) e.
Proof.
  intros G e x vk T H. induction H as [G0|G1 G2 G3 e0 w0 y0 Tw Ty Hw Hy Hcorr Hrenv IH]; intros Hx.
  - eapply renv_corr_empty.
  - eapply renv_corr_ref with (G2:=G2) (G3:=G3) (Tw:=Tw) (Ty:=Ty).
    + eapply ctx_binds_k_n.
      * intro E. subst x. apply Hx. eapply ctx_binds_in_dom. eapply ctx_binds_k_after_binds. exact Hw.
      * exact Hw.
    + exact Hy.
    + exact Hcorr.
    + eapply IH. exact Hx.
Qed.

(** * New function item in the extended context *)

Lemma ty_item_s_new_fun : forall G e Sigma w y (L:fset var) T0 V tf,
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T0 ⁏e ⊢ open_rec 0 x tf ∶ open_rec 0 x V) ->
  all_tfree_k_trm G tf v_ref ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
  env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y) ->
  (forall z it, binds z it Sigma -> binds z it (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf)) ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode
    (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
    (e & w ~ y) (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf) y.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y L T0 V tf Hmf Hbody Htf HwG HyG Hwy Hee' HSig.
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V))).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V))) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc (typ_fun T0 V) w Hin) as [E|Hw].
    - subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    - apply HwG. exact Hw. }
  eapply ty_item_fun_s with (L := L \u (singleton w \u singleton y)).
  - exact Hmf.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E. subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    + eapply ctx_binds_e.
  - apply binds_push_eq.
  - intros x0 Hx0. rewrite notin_union in Hx0. destruct Hx0 as [Hx0L Hx0wy].
    rewrite notin_union in Hx0wy. destruct Hx0wy as [Hx0w Hx0y].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hx0w. rewrite notin_singleton in Hx0y.
    pose proof (@ty_weaken_insert_mut typing_mode) as [Wtrm _].
    (* insert y at split (G, x0-binding) *)
    assert (Hyfull : y \notin ctx_dom ((G § x0 / v_par ~ T0) §§& objctx_empty)).
    { intro Hin. change (y \in ctx_dom (G § x0 / v_par ~ T0)) in Hin.
      pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G x0 v_par T0 y Hin) as [E|Hy].
      - subst y. apply Hx0y. reflexivity.
      - apply HyG. exact Hy. }
    pose proof (Wtrm _ _ _ _ _ (Hbody x0 Hx0L) G (ctx_push ctx_empty x0 v_par T0) eq_refl
                  y v_loc (typ_fun T0 V) Hyfull) as W1.
    (* insert w at split ((G§y), x0-binding) *)
    assert (Hwfull : w \notin ctx_dom (((G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) § x0 / v_par ~ T0) §§& objctx_empty)).
    { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom ((G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) § x0 / v_par ~ T0)) in Hin.
      pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) x0 v_par T0 w Hin) as [E|Hw].
      - subst w. apply Hx0w. reflexivity.
      - apply HwGy. exact Hw. }
    pose proof (Wtrm _ _ _ _ _ W1 (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
                  (ctx_push ctx_empty x0 v_par T0) eq_refl
                  w v_ref (typ_fun T0 V) Hwfull) as W2.
    pose proof (@ty_trm_env_mono typing_mode _ _ _ _ _ W2 (e & w ~ y) Hee') as Wtrm'.
    change (ty_trm typing_mode
              (((G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
                 § x0 / v_par ~ T0)
              objctx_empty (e & w ~ y) (open_rec 0 x0 tf) (open_rec 0 x0 V)).
    exact Wtrm'.
  - eapply all_tfree_k_trm_weaken; [exact Htf|].
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) z v_ref w v_ref (typ_fun T0 V)).
    + eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref y v_loc (typ_fun T0 V)); [exact Hz|exact HyG].
    + exact HwGy.
Qed.

(** * Helper: renv_corr after the double push *)

Lemma renv_corr_extend_fun : forall G e w y T0 V,
  renv_corr G e -> mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
  renv_corr (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) (e & w ~ y).
Proof.
  intros G e w y T0 V Hrenv Hmf HwG HyG Hwy.
  set (Tfun := typ_fun T0 V).
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tfun w Hin) as [E|Hw].
    - subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    - apply HwG. exact Hw. }
  assert (HR : renv_corr ((G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun) § w / v_ref ~ Tfun) e).
  { eapply renv_corr_push.
    - eapply renv_corr_push; [exact Hrenv|exact HyG].
    - exact HwGy. }
  unfold Tfun in *.
  eapply renv_corr_ref with (G2:=G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) (G3:=G)
     (Tw:=typ_fun T0 V) (Ty:=typ_fun T0 V).
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_k_e.
  - eapply typ_corr_fun. exact Hmf.
  - exact HR.
Qed.

(** * Helper: all items of the extended heap *)

Lemma ty_item_s_extend_items : forall G e Sigma w y (L:fset var) T0 V tf,
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
  (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T0 ⁏e ⊢ open_rec 0 x tf ∶ open_rec 0 x V) ->
  all_tfree_k_trm G tf v_ref ->
  w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
  y \notin dom Sigma -> w \notin dom e ->
  forall z, z \in dom (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf) ->
    @ty_item_s typing_mode
      ((G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_fun T0 V)) § w / v_ref ~ (typ_fun T0 V))
      (e & w ~ y) (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf) z.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma w y L T0 V tf Hhc Hmf Hbody Htf HwG HyG Hwy HySigma Hwe z Hz.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hds [Hde [Hrenv Hitem]]]]]]].
  set (Tfun := typ_fun T0 V).
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tfun)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tfun w Hin) as [E|Hw].
    - subst w. apply Hwy. reflexivity.
    - apply HwG. exact Hw. }
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply Hwe. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  assert (HSig : forall z0 it, binds z0 it Sigma -> binds z0 it (Sigma & y ~ item_fun tf)).
  { intros z0 it Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply HySigma. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  rewrite dom_push in Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hz|Hz].
  - rewrite in_singleton in Hz. subst z. unfold Tfun.
    eapply ty_item_s_new_fun with (L:=L); eauto.
  - assert (HzSigma : z \in dom Sigma) by exact Hz.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Context Defs Heap.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
.

Scheme tfree_trm_mut    := Induction for tfree_trm Sort Prop
with   tfree_lit_mut    := Induction for tfree_lit Sort Prop
with   tfree_def_mut    := Induction for tfree_def Sort Prop

| tfree_stack_cons_l v t st:

  tfree_stack v (stack_cons (frame_let t) st)
| tfree_stack_cons_r v f st:
  tfree_stack v st ->

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Heap_fun Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Subst_typing Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_fun Weak_let_fun.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Object-literal weak progress.

    The only missing ingredient is the object analogue of
    [heap_correspond_extend_fun]: transporting the object-literal body typing
    under [objctx_lit w T] to a heap-item typing under [objctx_heap y T] after
    dereferencing [w] to [y].  It is isolated below as
    [weak_obj_extension].  Everything else is proved unconditionally. *)

Lemma notin_fv_objlit : forall (T:typ) z,
  z \notin fv (typ_objlit typing_mode T) -> z \notin fv T.
Proof.
  intros T z H.
  destruct (mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode); cbn in H;
    repeat rewrite notin_union in H; tauto.
Qed.

Variable weak_obj_extension :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) (ds:defs) (L:fset var),
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_lit x T) e (open x ds) (open x T)) ->
    w \notin L ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
    w \notin ctx_fv G -> y \notin ctx_fv G ->
    w \notin fv T -> y \notin fv T ->
    y \notin dom Sigma -> w \notin dom e ->
    heap_correspond
      (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
         § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T))
      (e & w ~ y)
      (Sigma & y ~ item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds)))
    /\
    inert (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
             § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)).

Theorem weak_tp_lit_obj_cond : forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm)
    Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c',
    config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros T ds t Sigma e Lv fs U Hweak.
  destruct Hweak as [G Hwc].
  inversion Hwc as
    [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_lit_inv Hty) as [Tlit0 [Lbody [Vbody [Hlit [Hbody Hsub]]]]].
  destruct (ty_lit_obj_inv Hlit) as [Lobj [ETlit [Hds Hindep]]].
  subst Tlit0.
  set (Tlit := typ_objlit typing_mode T).
  set (Cold := (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
  set (F := fv_config Cold
              \u (ctx_dom G \u (ctx_fv G \u (fv Tlit \u (Lbody \u Lobj))))).
  destruct (var_fresh F) as [y HyF].
  destruct (var_fresh (F \u \{y})) as [w HwFy].
  assert (HwF : w \notin F).
  { intro Hin. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwY : w <> y).
  { intro E. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. exact E. }
  assert (HyW : y <> w) by (intro E; apply HwY; symmetry; exact E).
  unfold F in HyF. unfold F in HwF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HyF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HwF.
  destruct HyF as [HyOld HyRest].
  destruct HyRest as [HyDom [HyFv [HyTlit [HyLbody HyLobj]]]].
  destruct HwF as [HwOld HwRest].
  destruct HwRest as [HwDom [HwFv [HwTlit [HwLbody HwLobj]]]].
  assert (HyT : y \notin fv T).
  { unfold Tlit in HyTlit. apply notin_fv_objlit. exact HyTlit. }
  assert (HwT : w \notin fv T).
  { unfold Tlit in HwTlit. apply notin_fv_objlit. exact HwTlit. }
  assert (HySigma : y \notin dom Sigma).
  { intro Hin. apply HyOld. unfold Cold. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union.
    right. right. left. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwE : w \notin dom e).
  { intro Hin. apply HwOld. unfold Cold. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union.
    right. right. right. left. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tlit w Hin) as [E|HinG].
    - subst w. apply HwY. reflexivity.
    - apply HwDom. exact HinG. }
  assert (Hee' : env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y)).
  { intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply HwE. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  assert (HdsW : @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_lit w T) e (open w ds) (open w T))
    by (eapply Hds; exact HwLobj).
  destruct (@weak_obj_extension G e Sigma w y T ds Lobj
              Hir Hhc Hindep Hds HwLobj HwDom HyDom HwY HwFv HyFv HwT HyT HySigma HwE)
    as [Hhc' Hir'].
  assert (HstY : @ty_stack typing_mode (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit) e Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; [exact Hst|exact HyDom|intros a b Hb; exact Hb]. }
  assert (Hst' : @ty_stack typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) (e & w ~ y) Tstack fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; [exact HstY|exact HwGy|exact Hee']. }
  assert (Hts' : all_tfree_k_stack
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) fs v_ref).
  { eapply all_tfree_k_stack_weaken; [exact Hts|].
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit) z v_ref w v_ref Tlit).
    - eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref y v_loc Tlit); eassumption.
    - exact HwGy. }
  pose proof (@ty_weaken_insert_mut typing_mode) as Hins.
  destruct Hins as [Htrm_ins _].
  assert (HbodyW : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_let ~ Tlit) objctx_empty e
                     (open w t) Vbody)
    by (eapply Hbody; exact HwLbody).
  assert (HbodyRef : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty e
                       (open w t) Vbody).
  { eapply ty_trm_kind_change_top. exact HbodyW. }
  assert (HbodyE : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)
                     (open w t) Vbody)
    by (eapply ty_trm_env_mono; eassumption).
  assert (HyNot : y \notin ctx_dom
      ((G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) §§& objctx_empty)).
  { cbn. intro Hin. change (y \in ctx_dom (G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G w v_ref Tlit y Hin) as [E|HyG].
    - subst y. apply HyW. reflexivity.
    - apply HyDom. exact HyG. }
  pose proof (Htrm_ins (G § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)
                (open w t) Vbody HbodyE G (ctx_push ctx_empty w v_ref Tlit)
                eq_refl y v_loc Tlit HyNot) as HtyRaw.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Object-literal weak progress.

    The only missing ingredient is the object analogue of
    [heap_correspond_extend_fun]: transporting the object-literal body typing
    under [objctx_lit w T] to a heap-item typing under [objctx_heap y T] after
    dereferencing [w] to [y].  It is isolated below as
    [weak_obj_extension].  Everything else is proved unconditionally. *)

Lemma notin_fv_objlit : forall (T:typ) z,
  z \notin fv (typ_objlit typing_mode T) -> z \notin fv T.
Proof.
  intros T z H.
  destruct (mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode); cbn in H;
    repeat rewrite notin_union in H; tauto.
Qed.

Variable weak_obj_extension :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) (ds:defs) (L:fset var),
    inert G ->
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    all_tfree_k_defs G ds v_ref ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_lit x T) e (open x ds) (open x T)) ->
    w \notin L ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G -> y \notin ctx_dom G -> w <> y ->
    w \notin ctx_fv G -> y \notin ctx_fv G ->
    w \notin fv T -> y \notin fv T ->
    y \notin dom Sigma -> w \notin dom e ->
    heap_correspond
      (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
         § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T))
      (e & w ~ y)
      (Sigma & y ~ item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds)))
    /\
    inert (G § y / v_loc ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)
             § w / v_ref ~ (typ_objlit typing_mode T)).

Theorem weak_tp_lit_obj_cond : forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) (t:trm)
    Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c',
    config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros T ds t Sigma e Lv fs U Hweak.
  destruct Hweak as [G Hwc].
  inversion Hwc as
    [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_lit_inv Hty) as [Tlit0 [Lbody [Vbody [Hlit [Hbody Hsub]]]]].
  destruct (ty_lit_obj_inv Hlit) as [Lobj [ETlit [Hds Hindep]]].
  subst Tlit0.
  set (Tlit := typ_objlit typing_mode T).
  set (Cold := (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
  set (F := fv_config Cold
              \u (ctx_dom G \u (ctx_fv G \u (fv Tlit \u (Lbody \u Lobj))))).
  destruct (var_fresh F) as [y HyF].
  destruct (var_fresh (F \u \{y})) as [w HwFy].
  assert (HwF : w \notin F).
  { intro Hin. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwY : w <> y).
  { intro E. apply HwFy. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. exact E. }
  assert (HyW : y <> w) by (intro E; apply HwY; symmetry; exact E).
  unfold F in HyF. unfold F in HwF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HyF.
  repeat rewrite notin_union in HwF.
  destruct HyF as [HyOld HyRest].
  destruct HyRest as [HyDom [HyFv [HyTlit [HyLbody HyLobj]]]].
  destruct HwF as [HwOld HwRest].
  destruct HwRest as [HwDom [HwFv [HwTlit [HwLbody HwLobj]]]].
  assert (HyT : y \notin fv T).
  { unfold Tlit in HyTlit. apply notin_fv_objlit. exact HyTlit. }

  { unfold Tlit in HwTlit. apply notin_fv_objlit. exact HwTlit. }
  assert (HySigma : y \notin dom Sigma).
  { intro Hin. apply HyOld. unfold Cold. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union.
    right. right. left. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwE : w \notin dom e).
  { intro Hin. apply HwOld. unfold Cold. cbn. repeat rewrite in_union.
    right. right. right. left. left. exact Hin. }
  assert (HwGy : w \notin ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit)).
  { intro Hin. change (w \in ctx_dom (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit)) in Hin.
    pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G y v_loc Tlit w Hin) as [E|HinG].

  assert (HtyNew : ty_trm typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)

  { change (ty_trm typing_mode

  assert (HsubG' : subtyp typing_mode

    by (eapply subtyp_env_mono; eassumption).
  assert (HtyNew' : ty_trm typing_mode
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) objctx_empty (e & w ~ y)
      (open w t) Tstack).
  { eapply ty_trm_sub; [exact HtyNew|exact HsubE]. }
  assert (Htf2 : all_tfree_k_trm G t v_ref).
  { intros v Hv. eapply Htf. apply tfree_trm_lit_r. exact Hv. }
  assert (Htf2' : all_tfree_k_trm
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) t v_ref).
  { eapply all_tfree_k_trm_weaken; [exact Htf2|].
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit) z v_ref w v_ref Tlit).
    - eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref y v_loc Tlit); eassumption.
    - exact HwGy. }
  assert (Hctxw : ctx_k (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) w v_ref).
  { exists Tlit, (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit). apply ctx_binds_k_e. }
  assert (HtfNew : all_tfree_k_trm
      (G § y / v_loc ~ Tlit § w / v_ref ~ Tlit) (open w t) v_ref)
    by (eapply all_tfree_k_trm_open; eauto).
  assert (HclTerm : closed (open w t)).

    eapply closed_trm_lit_body_below. exact Hct. }
  assert (HclDs : closed_below 1 ds).
  { eapply closed_lit_obj_defs_below.
    eapply closed_trm_lit_l. exact Hct. }

      (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds)))).

  exists (open w t ; fs ;

Variable canon_met_call :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR (y:var),
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e y TZ ->
    exists yObj ds tm L Go,
      binds x yObj e /\
      binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
      defs_has ds (def_met m tm) /\
      (forall xz, xz \notin L -> forall xc, xc <> xz -> xc \notin L ->
         ty_trm typing_mode (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G Go xz TZ xc TC) objctx_empty e
           (open_met xz xc tm) (open_met xz xc TR)).

Variable open_call_body :
  forall G e (L:fset var) tm (Go:objctx) TZ TC TR (x y:var) Tstack,
    (forall xz, xz \notin L -> forall xc, xc <> xz -> xc \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G Go xz TZ xc TC) objctx_empty e
         (open_met xz xc tm) (open_met xz xc TR)) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e y TZ ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x (open y TC) ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open_met y x TR) Tstack ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open_met y x tm) Tstack /\
    @all_tfree_k trm _ G (open_met y x tm) v_ref /\
    closed (open_met y x tm).

Lemma weak_tp_call_from_canon : forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode
    (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros x m y Sigma e Lv fs U Hcfg.
  set (cold := trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  destruct Hcfg as [G Hweak].
  inversion Hweak as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_call_l).
  destruct (ty_trm_call_inv Hty) as [TC [TZ [TR [Hx [Hy [Hsef [Hxyopen Hs]]]]]]].
  destruct (ty_var_sub_elim Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
  destruct (@canon_met_call G e Sigma x T0 m TC TZ TR y
              Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub Hy)
    as [yObj [ds [tm [L [Go [Hbxy [Hby [Hhas Hbody]]]]]]]].
  destruct (@open_call_body G e L tm Go TZ TC TR x y T
              Hbody Hy Hxyopen Hs)
    as [Hnew [Htfnew Hclosednew]].
  assert (Hcc' : config_closed (open_met y x tm ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; fv_config cold)).
  { eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    - exact Hclosednew.
    - exact Hcs.
    - exact Hch. }
  exists (open_met y x tm ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; fv_config cold).
  split.
  - exists G. eapply weak_config_c.
    + exact Hir.
    + exact Hhc.
    + exact Hst.
    + exact Hts.
    + exact Hnew.
    + exact Htfnew.
    + exact Hcc'.
  - eapply red_call; eauto.
Qed.

End CallPart.

Section WritePart.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Variable canon_fld_write :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 (m:fld_label) S U (y:var),
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G -> ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
