    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e y S ->
    exists yObj ds v yArg ds',
      binds x yObj e /\
      binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
      binds y yArg e /\
      defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f v)) /\
      defs_update ds m yArg ds' /\
      heap_correspond G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) /\
      heap_closed (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S U.

Lemma weak_tp_write_from_canon : forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode
    (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros x m y Sigma e Lv fs U Hcfg.
  set (cold := trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  destruct Hcfg as [G Hweak].
  inversion Hweak as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_write_l).
  assert (Hky : ctx_k G y v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_write_r).
  destruct (ty_trm_write_inv Hty) as [S [Tfld [Hx [Hy Hs]]]].
  destruct (ty_var_sub_elim Hx) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
  destruct (@canon_fld_write G e Sigma x T0 m S Tfld y Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub Hy)
    as [yObj [ds [v [yArg [ds' [Hbxy [Hby [HbyArg [Hhas [Hupd [Hhc' [Hhclosed' Hfieldsub]]]]]]]]]]]].
  assert (Hky_dom : y \in ctx_dom G).
  { destruct (ctx_k_binds Hky) as [Tk [Hbk Hkdom]].
    eapply ctx_kdom_in_dom. exact Hkdom. }
  assert (Hnew : ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (trm_var (avar_f y)) T).
  { eapply ty_trm_var.
    - intro. exact (@inert_ctx_vis typing_mode G Hir y Hky_dom).
    - eapply ty_var_sub; [exact Hy|].
      eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hfieldsub|exact Hs]. }
  assert (Htfnew : @all_tfree_k trm _ G (trm_var (avar_f y)) v_ref).
  { intros z Hz. inversion Hz; subst. exact Hky. }
  assert (Hnewclosed : closed (trm_var (avar_f y))).
  { intros n z. cbn. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hcc'' : config_closed
                    (trm_var (avar_f y) ; fs ; env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds') ; e ; fv_config cold)).
  { eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    - exact Hnewclosed.
    - exact Hcs.
    - exact Hhclosed'. }
  assert (HupdHeap : heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg
                       (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds'))).
  { eapply heap_update_exists.
    - eapply heap_correspond_ok_heap. exact Hhc.
    - exact Hby.
    - exact Hupd. }
  exists (trm_var (avar_f y) ; fs ; env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds') ; e ; fv_config cold).
  split.
  - exists G. eapply weak_config_c.
    + exact Hir.
    + exact Hhc'.
    + exact Hst.
    + exact Hts.
    + exact Hnew.
    + exact Htfnew.
    + exact Hcc''.
  - eapply red_write.
    + exact HupdHeap.
    + exact Hbxy.
    + exact HbyArg.
Qed.

End WritePart.

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev5 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Typing_subst Ctx_narrow.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Term-level context narrowing.

    We replace the type [Sh] of a binder [xh] by a subtype [W].  The binder
    occurs at the split [G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2], with [xh] fresh from
    [G1] and [G2].  The hypothesis [W <: Sh] is stated in the narrowed
    context.  The term-level induction is adapted from the insertion
    weakening proof [ty_weaken_insert_mut]; the extra objctx binders are
    handled by the same [ctx_met] decompositions. *)

(** ** Capability bounds and viewpoint adaptation *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_narrow : forall C G Go e T U,
  ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T U ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    ty_capbnd typing_mode C (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e T U.
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T U H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub.
  - apply ty_capbnd_top.
  - apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - apply ty_capbnd_typ.
  - apply ty_capbnd_cap_sel.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_cap_ignore; eauto.
  - apply ty_capbnd_met.
  - apply ty_capbnd_fld.
  - (* sel *) eapply ty_capbnd_sel.
    + eapply (@ty_var_narrow typing_mode G e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T))); eauto.
    + eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto.
  - apply ty_capbnd_rec.
  - eapply ty_capbnd_and; [ eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto | eapply IHty_capbnd0; eauto ].
  - eapply ty_capbnd_or; [ eapply IHty_capbnd; eauto | eapply IHty_capbnd0; eauto ].
  - apply ty_capbnd_all.
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_cap_narrow : forall C x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    viewpoint_adapt_cap typing_mode C x (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros C x G Go e Tf Tr H.
  induction H; intros G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub.
  eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine.
  - exact (proj2 (proj2 (@var_sub_incap_narrow typing_mode)) G Go e T Tstrip H G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub).
  - eapply (@ty_capbnd_narrow C G Go e T Tcap); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_narrow : forall x G Go e Tf Tr,
  viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x G Go e Tf Tr ->
  forall G1 G2 (xh:var) vkh Sh W,
    G = G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2 ->
    xh \notin ctx_dom G1 -> xh \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
    subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
    viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e Tf Tr.
Proof.
  intros x G Go e Tf Tr H G1 G2 xh vkh Sh W Heq H1 H2 Hsub.
  unfold viewpoint_adapt in *.
  destruct (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' typing_mode); cbn in *.
  - exact H.
  - eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_narrow; eauto.
Qed.

(** ** Freshness of objctx binders w.r.t. the narrowing split *)

Definition objctx_fresh (Go:objctx) (xh:var) (G:ctx) : Prop :=
  xh \notin objctx_dom Go /\
  (forall y, y \in objctx_dom Go -> y \notin ctx_dom G).

Lemma objctx_fresh_empty : forall xh G,
  objctx_fresh objctx_empty xh G.
Proof. intros. split; [ cbn; auto | intros y Hy; cbn in Hy; rewrite in_empty in Hy; inversion Hy ]. Qed.

Lemma objctx_fresh_lit : forall x T xh G,
  x <> xh -> x \notin ctx_dom G ->
  objctx_fresh (objctx_lit x T) xh G.
Proof.
  intros. split.
  - cbn. rewrite notin_singleton. auto.
  - intros y Hy. cbn in Hy. rewrite in_singleton in Hy. subst y. auto.
Qed.

Lemma objctx_fresh_heap : forall y T xh G,
  objctx_fresh (objctx_heap y T) xh G.
Proof. intros. split; [ cbn; auto | intros z Hz; cbn in Hz; rewrite in_empty in Hz; inversion Hz ]. Qed.

Lemma objctx_fresh_dom : forall Go xh G y,
  objctx_fresh Go xh G -> y \in objctx_dom Go -> y \notin ctx_dom G.
Proof. intros. apply H. exact H0. Qed.

Lemma objctx_fresh_neq : forall Go xh G y,
  objctx_fresh Go xh G -> y \in objctx_dom Go -> y <> xh.
Proof.
  intros Go xh G y [Hx Hdom] Hy. intro E. subst y.
  apply Hx. exact Hy.
Qed.

(** Weakening the narrowing hypothesis across the objctx binders. *)

Lemma subtyp_weaken_objctx : forall G e W Sh Go,
  (forall y, y \in objctx_dom Go -> y \notin ctx_dom G) ->
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e W Sh ->
  subtyp typing_mode (G §§& Go) objctx_empty e W Sh.
Proof.
  intros G e W Sh Go Hfresh Hsub.
  destruct Go as [|x T|y T]; cbn.
  - exact Hsub.
  - eapply (@subtyp_weaken_push typing_mode); [ exact Hsub | ].
    apply Hfresh. cbn. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - exact Hsub.
Qed.

(** Appending an objctx to a narrowed split. *)

Lemma split_objctx : forall (G1 G2:ctx) xh vkh Sh Go,
  (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2) §§& Go =
  G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& (G2 §§& Go).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (@ctx_obj_concat (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) G2 Go).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section MoreHelpers.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma subtyp_weaken_met : forall G e W Sh xz TZ xc TC,
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e W Sh ->
  xz \notin ctx_dom G -> xc <> xz -> xc \notin ctx_dom G ->
  subtyp typing_mode (ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC) objctx_empty e W Sh.
Proof.
  intros G e W Sh xz TZ xc TC Hsub Hxz Hxcxz Hxc.
  eapply (@subtyp_weaken_push typing_mode); [ | ].
  - eapply (@subtyp_weaken_push typing_mode); [ exact Hsub | exact Hxz ].
  - apply notin_dom_push; [ exact Hxc | intro E; apply Hxcxz; exact E ].
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_weaken_met_refined : forall G e W Sh xz TZ xc TC TC2,
  subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e W Sh ->
  xz \notin ctx_dom G -> xc <> xz -> xc \notin ctx_dom G ->
  subtyp typing_mode (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2) objctx_empty e W Sh.
Proof.
  intros G e W Sh xz TZ xc TC TC2 Hsub Hxz Hxcxz Hxc.
  eapply (@subtyp_weaken_push typing_mode); [ | ].
  - eapply (@subtyp_weaken_push typing_mode); [ exact Hsub | exact Hxz ].
  - apply notin_dom_push; [ exact Hxc | intro E; apply Hxcxz; exact E ].
Qed.

Lemma split_met_empty : forall (G1 G2:ctx) xh vkh Sh xz TZ xc TC,
  ctx_met (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2) xz TZ xc TC =
  G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (@ctx_met_decomp (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) G2 xz TZ xc TC).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma split_metref_empty : forall (G1 G2:ctx) xh vkh Sh xz TZ xc TC TC2,
  ctx_met_refined (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2) xz TZ xc TC TC2 =
  G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& (G2 §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (@ctx_met_refined_decomp (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) G2 xz TZ xc TC TC2).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma split_met_empty_hide : forall (G1 G2:ctx) xh vkh Sh xz TZ xc TC,
  ctx_met (ctx_hide (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2)) xz TZ xc TC =
  G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& (ctx_hide G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (ctx_hide_concat (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) G2).
  rewrite (@ctx_met_decomp (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) (ctx_hide G2) xz TZ xc TC).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma split_metref_empty_hide : forall (G1 G2:ctx) xh vkh Sh xz TZ xc TC TC2,
  ctx_met_refined (ctx_hide (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2)) xz TZ xc TC TC2 =
  G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& (ctx_hide G2 §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite (ctx_hide_concat (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) G2).
  rewrite (@ctx_met_refined_decomp (G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh) (ctx_hide G2) xz TZ xc TC TC2).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma split_metref_lit : forall (G1 G2:ctx) xh vkh Sh x0 vk0 T0 xz TZ xc TC TC2,
  ctx_met_refined ((G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& G2) § x0 / vk0 ~ T0) xz TZ xc TC TC2 =
  G1 § xh / vkh ~ Sh §& ((G2 § x0 / vk0 ~ T0) §& ctx_met_refined ctx_empty xz TZ xc TC TC2).
Proof.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax HeapUpdate.

(** * Replacement of a binding in a TLC environment.

    An environment is semantically a map whose [get] searches the head of the
    underlying list first.  [env_remove] deletes the first (visible) binding of
    a name; [env_set] then conses the new binding at the head. *)

Section EnvSet.

Context {A : Type}.

Fixpoint env_remove (E : env A) (x : var) : env A :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | cons (z, w) tl =>
    match classicT (x = z) with
    | left _ => env_remove tl x
    | right _ => cons (z, w) (env_remove tl x)
    end
  end.

Definition env_set (E : env A) (x : var) (v : A) : env A :=
  (env_remove E x) & (x ~ v).

Lemma cons_concat_single : forall (y:var) (w:A) (tl:env A),
  cons (y,w) tl = tl & (y ~ w).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite concat_def. rewrite single_def. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_env_set_eq : forall E x v,
  binds x v (env_set E x v).
Proof.
  intros E x v. unfold binds, env_set.
  rewrite get_push. rewrite (If_l (P := x = x) (Some v) (get x (env_remove E x)) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma get_env_remove_neq : forall E x z,
  z <> x -> get z (env_remove E x) = get z E.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|(y,w) tl IH]; intros x z Hneq; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. cbn.
      rewrite (cons_concat_single x w tl).
      rewrite get_push.
      rewrite (If_r (P := z = x) (Some w) (get z tl) Hneq).
      apply IH. exact Hneq.
    + cbn.
      rewrite (cons_concat_single y w (env_remove tl x)).
      rewrite (cons_concat_single y w tl).
      rewrite get_push.
      rewrite get_push.
      apply (If_eq (P := z = y) (P' := z = y)
                   (x := Some w) (x' := Some w)
                   (y := get z (env_remove tl x)) (y' := get z tl)).
      * split; auto.
      * intros _; reflexivity.
      * intros _; apply IH; exact Hneq.
Qed.

Lemma get_env_set_neq : forall E x v z,
  z <> x -> get z (env_set E x v) = get z E.
Proof.
  intros E x v z Hneq. unfold env_set.
  rewrite get_push. rewrite (If_r (P := z = x) (Some v) (get z (env_remove E x)) Hneq).
  apply get_env_remove_neq. exact Hneq.
Qed.

Lemma binds_env_set_neq : forall E x v z w,
  z <> x -> binds z w E -> binds z w (env_set E x v).
Proof.
  intros E x v z w Hneq Hb. unfold binds in *.
  rewrite get_env_set_neq; auto.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_remove : forall E x,
  dom (env_remove E x) = dom E \- \{x}.
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|(y,w) tl IH]; intros x.
  - cbn. rewrite <- (empty_def A). rewrite dom_empty.
    apply fset_extens; intros z Hz;
      repeat rewrite in_remove in *; repeat rewrite in_empty in *; intuition.
  - destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := x = x) eq_refl). rewrite IH.
      rewrite (cons_concat_single x w tl).
      repeat rewrite dom_concat in *; repeat rewrite dom_single in *.
      apply fset_extens.
      * intros z Hz.
        rewrite in_remove in Hz.
        repeat rewrite in_remove; repeat rewrite in_union;
        repeat rewrite in_singleton; repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
        destruct Hz as [HA HN].
        assert (HNx : z <> x) by (first [exact HN | (intro E; apply HN; rewrite in_singleton; exact E)]).
        split; [left; exact HA | exact HNx].
      * intros z Hz.
        repeat rewrite in_remove in Hz; repeat rewrite in_union in Hz;
        repeat rewrite in_singleton in Hz; repeat rewrite notin_singleton in Hz.
        repeat rewrite in_remove; repeat rewrite in_union;
        repeat rewrite in_singleton; repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
        destruct Hz as [[HA|Hy] HN].
        -- assert (HNx : z <> x) by (first [exact HN | (intro E; apply HN; rewrite in_singleton; exact E)]).
           split; [exact HA | exact HNx].
        -- subst z. exfalso. first [ (apply HN; rewrite in_singleton; reflexivity) | (apply HN; reflexivity) ].
    + cbn. rewrite (classicT_r (P := x = y) Nxy). cbn.
      rewrite (cons_concat_single y w (env_remove tl x)).
      rewrite (cons_concat_single y w tl).
      repeat rewrite dom_concat in *; repeat rewrite dom_single in *.
      rewrite IH.
      apply fset_extens.
      * intros z Hz.
        rewrite in_union in Hz.
        destruct Hz as [Hin|Hy].
        -- rewrite in_remove in Hin. destruct Hin as [HA HN].
           repeat rewrite in_remove; repeat rewrite in_union;
           repeat rewrite in_singleton; repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
           assert (HNx : z <> x) by (first [exact HN | (intro E; apply HN; rewrite in_singleton; exact E)]).
           split; [left; exact HA | exact HNx].
        -- rewrite in_singleton in Hy. subst z.
           repeat rewrite in_remove; repeat rewrite in_union;
           repeat rewrite in_singleton; repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
           split; [right; reflexivity | intro E; apply Nxy; symmetry; exact E].
      * intros z Hz.
        repeat rewrite in_remove in Hz; repeat rewrite in_union in Hz;
        repeat rewrite in_singleton in Hz; repeat rewrite notin_singleton in Hz.
        repeat rewrite in_remove; repeat rewrite in_union;
        repeat rewrite in_singleton; repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
        destruct Hz as [[HA|Hy] HN].
        -- assert (HNx : z <> x) by (first [exact HN | (intro E; apply HN; rewrite in_singleton; exact E)]).
           left. rewrite in_remove.
           assert (HNnot : z \notin \{x}) by (intro E; apply HNx; rewrite in_singleton in E; exact E).
           split; [exact HA | exact HNnot].
        -- subst z. right. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_set : forall E x v,
  dom (env_set E x v) = dom E \u \{x}.
Proof.
  intros E x v. unfold env_set.
  rewrite dom_concat. rewrite dom_single. rewrite dom_env_remove.
  apply fset_extens.
  - intros z Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hin|Hx].
    + rewrite in_remove in Hin. destruct Hin as [HA HN].
      rewrite in_union. left. exact HA.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hx. subst z.
      rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - intros z Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [HA|Hx].
    + destruct (classicT (z = x)) as [Ezx|Nzx].
      * subst z. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
      * rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_remove. split; [exact HA|].
        intro Hin. apply Nzx. rewrite in_singleton in Hin. exact Hin.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hx. subst z.
      rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_env_set_mem : forall E x v,
  x \in dom E -> dom (env_set E x v) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E x v Hx. rewrite dom_env_set.
  apply fset_extens.
  - intros z Hz. rewrite in_union in Hz. destruct Hz as [HA|Hx2].
    + exact HA.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hx2. subst z. exact Hx.
  - intros z HA. rewrite in_union. left. exact HA.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_env_remove : forall E x,
  x \notin dom (env_remove E x).
Proof.
  intros E x Hx. rewrite dom_env_remove in Hx. rewrite in_remove in Hx.
  destruct Hx as [_ HN]. apply HN. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_remove_of_notin : forall E y x,
  y \notin dom E -> y \notin dom (env_remove E x).
Proof.
  intros E y x Hy Hin. rewrite dom_env_remove in Hin.
  rewrite in_remove in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin _]. apply Hy. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma ok_push_inv_notin : forall E (y:var) (v:A),
  ok (E & (y ~ v)) -> y # E.
Proof.
  intros E y v H. exact (proj2 (ok_push_inv H)).
Qed.

Lemma ok_env_remove : forall E x, ok E -> ok (env_remove E x).
Proof.
  intros E. induction E as [|(y,w) tl IH]; intros x Hok; cbn.
  - rewrite <- (empty_def A). apply ok_empty.
  - rewrite (cons_concat_single y w tl) in Hok.
    destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. cbn. apply IH. eapply ok_concat_inv_l. exact Hok.
    + cbn. rewrite (cons_concat_single y w (env_remove tl x)).
      apply ok_push.
      * apply IH. eapply ok_concat_inv_l. exact Hok.
      * apply notin_dom_remove_of_notin.
        eapply ok_push_inv_notin. exact Hok.
Qed.

Lemma ok_env_set : forall E x v, ok E -> ok (env_set E x v).
Proof.
  intros E x v Hok. unfold env_set.
  apply ok_push.
  - apply ok_env_remove. exact Hok.
  - apply notin_dom_env_remove.
Qed.

End EnvSet.

(** * Existence of a heap update for a stored field. *)

Section HeapUpdateExists.

Lemma heap_update_exists : forall (Sigma:heap) yObj a yArg (ds ds':defs),
  ok Sigma ->
  binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  defs_update ds a yArg ds' ->
  heap_update Sigma yObj a yArg (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.
  intros Sigma yObj a yArg ds ds' Hok Hb Hupd.
  unfold heap_update. repeat split.
  - exact Hok.
  - apply ok_env_set. exact Hok.
  - symmetry. apply dom_env_set_mem. eapply get_some_inv. apply binds_get. exact Hb.
  - intros z v Hz Hbz. eapply binds_env_set_neq; eauto.
  - exists ds, ds'. repeat split; auto. apply binds_env_set_eq.
Qed.

End HeapUpdateExists.

(** Replacing one heap item keeps the item-level typing of all other
    locations, provided the new item at the replaced location is typed. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_binds_eq : forall G e Sigma Sigma' x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma x ->
  (forall it, binds x it Sigma -> binds x it Sigma') ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma' x.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma Sigma' x H Hbind.
  dependent destruction H.
  - eapply ty_item_fun_s; eauto.
  - eapply ty_item_obj_s; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_env_set_item : forall G e Sigma yObj ds ds',
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) yObj ->
  heap_correspond G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma yObj ds ds' Hhc Hb Hitem.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hkv [Hke [Hrenv Hitems]]]]]]].
  assert (HyDom : yObj \in dom Sigma) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
  assert (Hoks' : ok (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')))
    by (apply ok_env_set; exact Hoks).
  assert (Hdom' : dom (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) = dom Sigma).
  { symmetry. apply dom_env_set_mem. exact HyDom. }
  assert (Hitems' : forall z, z \in dom (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) ->
                          @ty_item_s typing_mode G e
                            (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) z).
  { intros z Hz.
    destruct (classicT (z = yObj)) as [->|Hneq].
    - exact Hitem.
    - assert (HzS : z \in dom Sigma).
      { rewrite Hdom' in Hz. exact Hz. }
      eapply ty_item_s_binds_eq with (Sigma := Sigma).
      + eapply Hitems. exact HzS.
      + intros it Hit. eapply binds_env_set_neq; [exact Hneq|exact Hit]. }
  repeat split; try assumption.
  - rewrite Hdom'. exact Hkv.
Qed.

(** Heap closedness is stable under replacing one object item by a closed
    item. *)

Lemma heap_closed_push_inv_head : forall Sigma x it,
  heap_closed (Sigma & x ~ it) -> heap_closed Sigma /\ closed it.
Proof.
  intros Sigma x it H. inversion H; subst. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma heap_closed_env_remove : forall Sigma x,
  heap_closed Sigma -> heap_closed (env_remove Sigma x).
Proof.
  intros Sigma. induction Sigma as [|(y,it) tl IH]; intros x H.
  - cbn. rewrite <- (empty_def item). apply heap_closed_empty.
  - rewrite (cons_concat_single y it tl) in H.
    destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. simpl. apply IH. eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
    + simpl. rewrite (cons_concat_single y it (env_remove tl x)).
      apply heap_closed_push.
      * apply IH. eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
      * eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma heap_closed_env_set_item : forall Sigma yObj ds',
  heap_closed Sigma ->
  closed (item_obj ds') ->
  heap_closed (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.
  intros Sigma yObj ds' Hh Hcl. unfold env_set.
  apply heap_closed_push.
  - apply heap_closed_env_remove. exact Hh.
  - exact Hcl.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4 Canonical5 Canonical_static.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Typed records: the exact shape produced by [ty_defs].

    [record_dec] permits [dec_typ A bot T] (constructor [rd_typb]) and thus
    records whose type-member bounds are inconsistent.  The type of a
    well-typed sequence of definitions never uses [rd_typb]: [ty_def_typ]
    produces equal bounds, and [ty_def_fld] equal bounds.  We record this
    stronger structure, which is what rules out phantom field labels. *)

Inductive typed_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| td_typ : forall A T,
    typed_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| td_fld : forall a T,
    typed_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| td_met : forall m TC TZ TR,
    typed_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR).

Inductive typed_record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| trt_one : forall D l,
    typed_dec D ->
    l = label_of D ->
    typed_record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| trt_cons : forall T ls D l,
    typed_record_typ T ls ->
    typed_dec D ->
    l = label_of D ->
    l \notin ls ->
    typed_record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (ls \u \{l}).

Definition typed_record_type T := exists ls, typed_record_typ T ls.

Lemma typed_dec_record_dec : forall D,
  typed_dec D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros D H. dependent destruction H.
  - apply rd_typ.
  - apply rd_fld.
  - apply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_record_typ : forall T ls,
  typed_record_typ T ls -> record_typ T ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - eapply rt_one; [apply typed_dec_record_dec; eassumption|assumption].
  - eapply rt_cons; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_labels_eq : forall T ls1 ls2,
  typed_record_typ T ls1 -> typed_record_typ T ls2 -> ls1 = ls2.
Proof.
  intros T ls1 ls2 H1. generalize dependent ls2. induction H1; intros ls2 H2.
  - inversion H2; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - inversion H2; subst; try discriminate.
    assert (E : ls = ls0) by (apply IHH1; assumption). subst ls0. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** A record component with a given label can be recovered from the label
    set, and every component declaration is [typed_dec]. *)

Lemma typed_record_typ_label_dec : forall T ls l,
  typed_record_typ T ls -> l \in ls ->
  exists D, typed_dec D /\ l = label_of D.
Proof.
  intros T ls l H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - rewrite in_singleton in Hin. subst l. exists D. split; assumption.
  - rewrite in_union in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + destruct (IHtyped_record_typ l Hin) as [D' [Htd Heq]].
      exists D'. split; assumption.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hin. subst l. exists D. split; assumption.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section TypedDefs.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ty_def_typed_dec : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D -> typed_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H. induction H.
  - apply td_typ.
  - apply td_fld.
  - apply td_met.
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_typed_record : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  exists ls, typed_record_typ T ls.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T H. induction H.
  - exists (singleton (label_of D)).
    eapply trt_one; [eapply ty_def_typed_dec; exact H|reflexivity].
  - destruct IHty_defs as [ls' Hrec'].
    destruct (ty_defs_record H) as [_ Hinvs].
    assert (Hnotin : label_of D \notin ls').
    { intro Hl. destruct (Hinvs ls' (typed_record_typ_record_typ Hrec') (label_of D) Hl)
        as [d' [Hhas Heq]].
      eapply (@defs_hasnt_has_contra ds d' (label_of D));
        [ | exact Hhas | exact Heq ].
      unfold defs_hasnt.
      match goal with Hn : defs_hasnt ds (label_of D) |- _ => exact Hn end. }
    exists (ls' \u singleton (label_of D)).
    eapply trt_cons; [exact Hrec'|eapply ty_def_typed_dec; exact H0|reflexivity|exact Hnotin].
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_typed_record_type : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T -> typed_record_type T.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (ty_defs_typed_record H) as [ls Hls]. eexists. exact Hls.
Qed.

End TypedDefs.

Section TypedWeaken.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Typed records are closed under the structural record operations we need. *)

Lemma typed_record_typ_open : forall T ls x,
  typed_record_typ T ls -> typed_record_typ (open x T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls x H. induction H.
  - cbn. eapply trt_one; [|reflexivity].
    dependent destruction H; cbn; constructor.
  - cbn. eapply trt_cons; [exact IHtyped_record_typ| |reflexivity|exact H0].
    dependent destruction H; cbn; constructor.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_type_open : forall T x,
  typed_record_type T -> typed_record_type (open x T).
Proof.
  intros T x [ls H]. exists ls. eapply typed_record_typ_open; exact H.
Qed.

End TypedWeaken.

End WithTypingMode.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Env_set.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Replacing one heap item keeps the item-level typing of all other
    locations, provided the new item at the replaced location is typed. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_binds_eq : forall G e Sigma Sigma' x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma x ->
  (forall it, binds x it Sigma -> binds x it Sigma') ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma' x.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma Sigma' x H Hbind.
  dependent destruction H.
  - eapply ty_item_fun_s; eauto.
  - eapply ty_item_obj_s; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_env_set_item : forall G e Sigma yObj ds ds',
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) yObj ->
  heap_correspond G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma yObj ds ds' Hhc Hb Hitem.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hkv [Hke [Hrenv Hitems]]]]]]].
  assert (HyDom : yObj \in dom Sigma) by (eapply binds_in_dom; exact Hb).
  assert (Hoks' : ok (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')))
    by (apply ok_env_set; exact Hoks).
  assert (Hdom' : dom (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) = dom Sigma).
  { symmetry. apply dom_env_set_mem. exact HyDom. }
  assert (Hitems' : forall z, z \in dom (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) ->
                          @ty_item_s typing_mode G e
                            (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) z).
  { intros z Hz.
    destruct (classicT (z = yObj)) as [->|Hneq].
    - exact Hitem.
    - assert (HzS : z \in dom Sigma).
      { rewrite Hdom' in Hz. exact Hz. }
      eapply ty_item_s_binds_eq with (Sigma := Sigma).
      + eapply Hitems. exact HzS.
      + intros it Hit. eapply binds_env_set_neq; [exact Hneq|exact Hit]. }
  repeat split; try assumption.
  - rewrite Hdom'. exact Hkv.
Qed.

(** Heap closedness is stable under replacing one object item by a closed
    item. *)

Lemma heap_closed_push_inv_head : forall Sigma x it,
  heap_closed (Sigma & x ~ it) -> heap_closed Sigma /\ closed it.
Proof.
  intros Sigma x it H. inversion H; subst. split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma heap_closed_env_remove : forall Sigma x,
  heap_closed Sigma -> heap_closed (env_remove Sigma x).
Proof.
  intros Sigma. induction Sigma as [|(y,it) tl IH]; intros x H.
  - cbn. rewrite <- (empty_def item). apply heap_closed_empty.
  - rewrite (cons_concat_single y it tl) in H.
    destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. simpl. apply IH. eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
    + simpl. rewrite (cons_concat_single y it (env_remove tl x)).
      apply heap_closed_push.
      * apply IH. eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
      * eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma heap_closed_env_set_item : forall Sigma yObj ds',
  heap_closed Sigma ->
  closed (item_obj ds') ->
  heap_closed (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.
  intros Sigma yObj ds' Hh Hcl. unfold env_set.
  apply heap_closed_push.
  - apply heap_closed_env_remove. exact Hh.
  - exact Hcl.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma ty_item_s_binds_eq : forall G e Sigma Sigma' x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma x ->
  (forall it, binds x it Sigma -> binds x it Sigma') ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma' x.

  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->

  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) yObj ->
  heap_correspond G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).

  heap_closed Sigma -> heap_closed (env_remove Sigma x).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Env_set.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Replacing one heap item keeps the item-level typing of all other
    locations, provided the new item at the replaced location is typed. *)

Lemma ty_item_s_binds_eq : forall G e Sigma Sigma' x,
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma x ->
  (forall it, binds x it Sigma -> binds x it Sigma') ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e Sigma' x.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma Sigma' x H Hbind.
  dependent destruction H.
  - eapply ty_item_fun_s; eauto.
  - eapply ty_item_obj_s; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma heap_correspond_env_set_item : forall G e Sigma yObj ds ds',
  heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
  binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) yObj ->
  heap_correspond G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma yObj ds ds' Hhc Hb Hitem.
  destruct Hhc as [Hok [Hwk [Hoks [Hoke [Hkv [Hke [Hrenv Hitems]]]]]]].
  assert (HyDom : yObj \in dom Sigma)
    by (eapply get_some_inv; apply binds_get; exact Hb).
  assert (Hoks' : ok (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')))
    by (apply ok_env_set; exact Hoks).
  assert (Hdom' : dom (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) = dom Sigma).
  { apply dom_env_set_mem. exact HyDom. }
  assert (Hitems' : forall z, z \in dom (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) ->
                          @ty_item_s typing_mode G e
                            (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) z).
  { intros z Hz.
    destruct (classicT (z = yObj)) as [->|Hneq].
    - exact Hitem.
    - assert (HzS : z \in dom Sigma).
      { rewrite Hdom' in Hz. exact Hz. }
      eapply ty_item_s_binds_eq with (Sigma := Sigma).
      + eapply Hitems. exact HzS.
      + intros it Hit. eapply binds_env_set_neq; [exact Hneq|exact Hit]. }
  repeat split; try assumption.
  - rewrite Hdom'. exact Hkv.
Qed.

(** Heap closedness is stable under replacing one object item by a closed
    item. *)

Lemma heap_closed_push_inv_head : forall Sigma x it,
  heap_closed (Sigma & x ~ it) -> heap_closed Sigma /\ closed it.
Proof.
  intros Sigma x it H.
  dependent destruction H.
  split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma heap_closed_env_remove : forall Sigma x,
  heap_closed Sigma -> heap_closed (env_remove Sigma x).
Proof.
  intros Sigma. induction Sigma as [|(y,it) tl IH]; intros x H.
  - cbn. rewrite <- (empty_def item). apply heap_closed_empty.
  - rewrite (cons_concat_single y it tl) in H.
    destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [Exy|Nxy].
    + subst y. simpl. apply IH. eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
    + simpl. rewrite (cons_concat_single y it (env_remove tl x)).
      apply heap_closed_push.
      * apply IH. eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
      * eapply heap_closed_push_inv_head; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma heap_closed_env_set_item : forall Sigma yObj ds',
  heap_closed Sigma ->
  closed (item_obj ds') ->
  heap_closed (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')).
Proof.
  intros Sigma yObj ds' Hh Hcl. unfold env_set.
  apply heap_closed_push.
  - apply heap_closed_env_remove. exact Hh.
  - exact Hcl.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma tyq_var_env_mono : forall e e', env_binds_more e e' ->
  forall (v1 v2:var), typing_equiv e v1 v2 -> typing_equiv e' v1 v2.
Proof.
  intros e e' Hee' v1 v2 H. change (tyq_var e v1 v2) in H.
  induction H.
  - apply tyq_var_refl.
  - eapply tyq_var_binds; eauto.
  - eapply tyq_var_sym; eauto.
  - eapply tyq_var_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma tyq_typ_env_mono : forall e e', env_binds_more e e' ->
  forall T1 T2, typing_equiv e T1 T2 -> typing_equiv e' T1 T2.
Proof.
  intros e e' Hee' T1 T2 H.
  revert e' Hee'.
  apply (tyq_typ_ind (fun e0 A B => forall e'0, env_binds_more e0 e'0 -> typing_equiv e'0 A B)).
  - intros e0 T Hnul e'0 Hee0. apply tyq_typ_nulary. assumption.
  - intros T e0 t11 t12 t21 t22 Handor H1 IH1 H2 IH2 e'0 Hee0.
    eapply tyq_typ_andor.
    + exact Handor.
    + apply IH1; exact Hee0.
    + apply IH2; exact Hee0.
  - intros e0 t11 t12 t21 t22 H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody e'0 Hee0.
    eapply tyq_typ_fun.
    + apply IH1; exact Hee0.
    + intro x. apply (IHbody x e'0 Hee0).
  - intros e0 a t11 t12 t21 t22 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 e'0 Hee0.
    eapply tyq_typ_fld.
    + apply IH1; exact Hee0.
    + apply IH2; exact Hee0.
  - intros e0 B t11 t12 t21 t22 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 e'0 Hee0.
    eapply tyq_typ_typ.
    + intro x. apply (IH1 x e'0 Hee0).
    + intro x. apply (IH2 x e'0 Hee0).
  - intros e0 v1 v2 v3 l Hvar e'0 Hee0.
    eapply tyq_typ_sel_normal. apply tyq_var_env_mono with (e:=e0); assumption.
  - intros e0 v1 v2 l e'0 Hee0. apply tyq_typ_sel.
  - intros e0 t1 t2 Hbody IHbody e'0 Hee0.
    eapply tyq_typ_bnd. intro x. apply (IHbody x e'0 Hee0).
  - intros m e0 t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 H3 IH3 e'0 Hee0.

  - exact H.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).
transform_dec (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (D : dec) (n : nat) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (transform_typ f T (S n)) (transform_typ f U (S n))
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typ f U n)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (transform_typ f TC (S n)) (transform_typ f TZ n) (transform_typ f TR (S (S n)))
  end.

Instance TypTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typ.

Instance DecTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_dec.

Inductive typ_nulary: typ -> Prop :=
| typ_nulary_top: typ_nulary typ_top
| typ_nulary_bot: typ_nulary typ_bot
| typ_nulary_nocap: typ_nulary typ_nocap
.

Inductive typ_andor: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_andor_and: typ_andor typ_and
| typ_andor_or: typ_andor typ_or
.

Notation typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A :=
  (fun t1 t2 => typ_rcd (dec_typ A t1 t2)).

Notation typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A :=
  (fun t1 t2 => typ_rcd (dec_fld A t1 t2)).

Inductive typ_binary: (typ -> typ -> typ) -> Prop :=
| typ_binary_and: typ_binary typ_and
| typ_binary_or: typ_binary typ_or
| typ_binary_fun: typ_binary typ_fun
| typ_binary_rcd_typ(A: typ_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_typ_ctor A)
| typ_binary_rcd_fld(A: fld_label): typ_binary (typ_binary_rcd_fld_ctor A)
.

Notation typ_notor B := (forall T U, B <> typ_or T U) (only parsing).

Notation typ_notand T := (forall S1 S2, T <> typ_and S1 S2) (only parsing).

Definition typ_notlog T := typ_notor T /\ typ_notand T.

Lemma typ_dec_open_indep_injective :
  (forall (T:typ) n x,
      typ_indep (avar_b n) T -> x \notin fv T ->
      forall U, typ_indep (avar_b n) U -> x \notin fv U ->
        open_rec n x T = open_rec n x U -> T = U)
  /\
  (forall (D:dec) n x,
      typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D) -> x \notin fv D ->
      forall D', typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D') -> x \notin fv D' ->
        open_rec n x D = open_rec n x D' -> D = D').
Proof.
  apply typ_mutind.
  - (* top *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* bot *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rcd *) intros D IHD n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| |D'| | | | | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as E. f_equal. eapply IHD; eassumption.
  - (* and *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | |U1 U2| | | | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as Ho1 Ho2.
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion HU; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    cbn in Hx, HxU.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in HxU; destruct HxU as [HxU1 HxU2].
    assert (ET1 : T1 = U1) by (eapply IH1; eassumption).
    assert (ET2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* or *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | |U1 U2| | | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as Ho1 Ho2.
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion HU; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    cbn in Hx, HxU.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in HxU; destruct HxU as [HxU1 HxU2].
    assert (ET1 : T1 = U1) by (eapply IH1; eassumption).
    assert (ET2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* sel *) intros a1 l a2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | | |b1 l' b2| | |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as E1 El E2. subst l'.
    cbn in Hx, HxU.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in HxU; destruct HxU as [HxU1 HxU2].
    assert (Ea : a1 = b1) by (eapply avar_open_fresh_injective; eassumption).
    assert (Eb : a2 = b2) by (eapply avar_open_fresh_injective; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* bnd *) intros T IH n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | | | |U| |]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as E. cbn in Hx, HxU.
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion HU; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    f_equal. eapply IH; eassumption.
  - (* fun *) intros T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U as [| | | | | | |U1 U2|]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as Ho1 Ho2.
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion HU; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    cbn in Hx, HxU.
    rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in HxU; destruct HxU as [HxU1 HxU2].
    assert (ET1 : T1 = U1) by (eapply IH1; eassumption).
    assert (ET2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* nocap *) intros n x Hi Hx U HU HxU Ho.
    destruct U; cbn in *; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* dec_typ *) intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x Hi Hx D' Hi' Hx' Ho.
    destruct D' as [l' U1 U2|l' U1 U2|l' U1 U2 U3]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as El E1 E2. subst l'.
    cbn in Hx, Hx'. rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in Hx'; destruct Hx' as [Hx1' Hx2'].
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion Hi'; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    assert (ET1 : T1 = U1) by (eapply IH1; eassumption).
    assert (ET2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* dec_fld *) intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 n x Hi Hx D' Hi' Hx' Ho.
    destruct D' as [l' U1 U2|l' U1 U2|l' U1 U2 U3]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as El E1 E2. subst l'.
    cbn in Hx, Hx'. rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    rewrite notin_union in Hx'; destruct Hx' as [Hx1' Hx2'].
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion Hi'; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    assert (ET1 : T1 = U1) by (eapply IH1; eassumption).
    assert (ET2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2; eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - (* dec_met *) intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 n x Hi Hx D' Hi' Hx' Ho.
    destruct D' as [l' U1 U2|l' U1 U2|l' U1 U2 U3]; cbn in *; try discriminate.
    injection Ho as El E1 E2 E3. subst l'.
    cbn in Hx, Hx'. repeat rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 [Hx2 Hx3]].
    repeat rewrite notin_union in Hx'; destruct Hx' as [Hx1' [Hx2' Hx3']].
    inversion Hi; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    inversion Hi'; subst; try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    assert (ET1 : T1 = U1) by (eapply IH1 with (n:=S n); eassumption).
    assert (ET2 : T2 = U2) by (eapply IH2 with (n:=n); eassumption).
    assert (ET3 : T3 = U3) by (eapply IH3 with (n:=S (S n)); eassumption).
    subst; reflexivity.
Qed.

End OpenInjective.

Lemma open_rec_bot_inv : forall (T:typ) n x,
  open_rec n x T = typ_bot -> T = typ_bot.
Proof.
  intros T n x H. destruct T; cbn in H; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open_indep_inv : forall (D:dec) n x,
  record_dec (open_rec n x D) ->
  typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd D) ->
  x \notin fv D ->
  record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros D n x Hdec Hind Hx.
  destruct D as [A T1 T2|a T1 T2|m TC TZ TR]; cbn in Hdec, Hx.
  - (* dec_typ *)
    inversion Hind; subst;
      try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    cbn in Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    inversion Hdec; subst.
    + (* rd_typ *) 
      assert (ET : T1 = T2)
        by (eapply (proj1 typ_dec_open_indep_injective); eassumption).
      subst T2. apply rd_typ.
    + (* rd_typb *)
      assert (E1 : T1 = typ_bot) by (eapply open_rec_bot_inv; symmetry; eassumption).
      subst T1. apply rd_typb.
  - (* dec_fld *)
    inversion Hind; subst;
      try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    cbn in Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    inversion Hdec; subst.
    assert (ET : T1 = T2)
      by (eapply (proj1 typ_dec_open_indep_injective); eassumption).
    subst T2. apply rd_fld.
  - (* dec_met *) apply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open_fresh_inv : forall (T:typ) n x ls,
  typ_indep (avar_b n) T ->
  x \notin fv T ->
  record_typ (open_rec n x T) ls ->
  record_typ T ls.
Proof.
  induction T; intros n x ls Hi Hx Hrt; cbn in Hrt, Hx.
  - (* top *) inversion Hrt.
  - (* bot *) inversion Hrt.
  - (* rcd *) inversion Hrt; subst.
    eapply rt_one.
    + eapply record_dec_open_indep_inv; eassumption.
    + rewrite label_of_open_dec. reflexivity.
  - (* and *)
    destruct T2; cbn in Hrt, Hx; try (inversion Hrt; fail).
    inversion Hrt as [D' l' Hdec0 Heq0|T' ls' D' l' Hrec Hdec Heq Hnot]; subst.
    inversion Hi; subst;
      try (exfalso; match goal with Hn : typ_nulary _ |- _ => inversion Hn end).
    cbn in Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx; destruct Hx as [Hx1 Hx2].
    assert (Hrec1 : record_typ T1 ls') by (eapply IHT1; eassumption).
    assert (HdecD : record_dec d) by (eapply record_dec_open_indep_inv; eassumption).
    eapply rt_cons.
    + exact Hrec1.
    + exact HdecD.
    + rewrite label_of_open_dec. reflexivity.
    + eassumption.
  - (* or *) inversion Hrt.
  - (* sel *) inversion Hrt.
  - (* bnd *) inversion Hrt.
  - (* fun *) inversion Hrt.
  - (* nocap *) inversion Hrt.
Qed.

  - inversion H2; subst.
    + exfalso. exact (Hne eq_refl).

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

  match T with

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Syntax_extra Closed_extra Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Weak_obj_extension.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Side conditions for object-literal heap allocation. *)

Definition obj_heap_side (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  inert G /\
  heap_correspond G e Sigma /\
  w \notin ctx_dom G /\ y \notin ctx_dom G /\ w <> y /\
  w \notin ctx_fv G /\ y \notin ctx_fv G /\
  w \notin fv T /\ y \notin fv T /\
  y \notin dom Sigma /\ w \notin dom e.

(** * Renaming interfaces for the literal-to-heap conversion.

    These are the three semantic facts that depend on the renaming of the
    object's self/reference variables to heap locations and on the change of
    the object context from [objctx_lit] to [objctx_heap].  Their proofs are
    independent of the [ty_defs] induction below; isolating them makes the
    structural conversion unconditional. *)

Variable obj_heap_var_transfer :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) (x:var) (Tx:typ),
    obj_heap_side G e Sigma w y T ->
    @ty_var typing_mode (G § w / v_self ~ open w T) objctx_empty e x Tx ->
    @ty_var typing_mode (objG typing_mode G y w T) objctx_empty (objE e w y)
      (deref (objE e w y) x) Tx.

Variable obj_heap_vis_transfer :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) (x:var),
    obj_heap_side G e Sigma w y T ->
    vis_var typing_mode (G § w / v_self ~ open w T) x ->
    vis_var typing_mode (objG typing_mode G y w T) (deref (objE e w y) x).

Variable obj_heap_met_transfer :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ)
         (xz:var) (TZ:typ) (xc:var) (TC:typ) (t:trm) (TR:typ),
    obj_heap_side G e Sigma w y T ->
    @ty_trm typing_mode
      (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G (objctx_lit w T) xz TZ xc TC)
      objctx_empty e (open_met xz xc t) (open_met xz xc TR) ->
    @ty_trm typing_mode
      (ctx_obj_met typing_mode (objG typing_mode G y w T) (objctx_heap y T) xz TZ xc TC)
      objctx_empty (objE e w y) (open_met xz xc t) (open_met xz xc TR).

(** * Basic lemmas about [deref]. *)

Lemma deref_push_self_var : forall (e:renv) w y,
  deref (e & w ~ y) w = y.
Proof. intros. cbn. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma label_of_deref_def : forall (e:renv) (d:def),
  label_of (deref e d) = label_of d.
Proof. intros e d. destruct d; cbn; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_deref_defs : forall (e:renv) (ds:defs) l,
  defs_hasnt ds l -> defs_hasnt (deref_defs e ds) l.
Proof.
  intros e ds. induction ds as [|ds IH d]; intros l H; cbn.
  - exact H.
  - unfold defs_hasnt in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d = l)) as [E|N].
    + cbn in H. rewrite E in H. rewrite E. exact H.
    + cbn in H. rewrite (label_of_deref_def e d). rewrite N. exact (IH l H).
Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_deref_label : forall (e:renv) (ds:defs) (d:def),
  defs_hasnt ds (label_of d) ->
  defs_hasnt (deref_defs e ds) (label_of (deref_def d)).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite label_of_deref_def. eapply defs_hasnt_deref_defs; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma env_binds_more_push_neq : forall (e:renv) w y,
  w \notin dom e -> env_binds_more e (e & w ~ y).
Proof.
  intros e w y Hw a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
  intro E. apply Hw. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb.
Qed.

(** * Structural conversion of definitions. *)

Lemma ty_def_obj_heap_transfer :
  forall (G0:ctx) (Go0:objctx) (e:renv) (d:def) D,
    @ty_def typing_mode G0 Go0 e d D ->
    forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ),
      G0 = G ->
      Go0 = objctx_lit w T ->
      obj_heap_side G e Sigma w y T ->
      @ty_def typing_mode (objG typing_mode G y w T) (objctx_heap y T)
        (objE e w y) (deref (objE e w y) d) D.
Proof.
  intros G0 Go0 e d D Hty. induction Hty;
    intros G Sigma w y T EG EGo Hside; subst G0; subst Go0;
    destruct Hside as [Hinert [Hhc [HwG [HyG [Hwy [HwFv [HyFv [HwT [HyT [HySig HwE]]]]]]]]]].
  - (* def_typ *)
    eapply ty_def_typ.
    intros x Hx.
    eapply tyq_env_mono.
    + eapply env_binds_more_push_neq. exact HwE.
    + apply H.
  - (* def_fld *)
    cbn.
    eapply ty_def_fld.
    + eapply obj_heap_vis_transfer; eauto.
    + eapply obj_heap_var_transfer; eauto.
  - (* def_met *)
    cbn.
    eapply ty_def_met.
    intros xz Hxz xc Hxcxz Hxc.
    eapply obj_heap_met_transfer; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_obj_heap_transfer :
  forall (G0:ctx) (Go0:objctx) (e:renv) (ds:defs) T,
    @ty_defs typing_mode G0 Go0 e ds T ->
    forall (G:ctx) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (Tobj:typ),
      G0 = G ->
      Go0 = objctx_lit w Tobj ->
      obj_heap_side G e Sigma w y Tobj ->
      @ty_defs typing_mode (objG typing_mode G y w Tobj) (objctx_heap y Tobj)
        (objE e w y) (deref_defs (objE e w y) ds) T.
Proof.
  intros G0 Go0 e ds T Hty. induction Hty;
    intros G Sigma w y Tobj EG EGo Hside; subst G0; subst Go0.
  - (* defs_one *)
    cbn. eapply ty_defs_one.
    eapply ty_def_obj_heap_transfer; eauto.
  - (* defs_cons *)
    cbn.
    eapply ty_defs_cons.
    + eapply IHHty; eauto.
    + eapply ty_def_obj_heap_transfer; eauto.
    + eapply defs_hasnt_deref_label; exact H.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics HeapUpdate.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Updating a field by a value of the field's own declared type preserves
    the typing of the whole definition list.  The extra hypothesis [Hreplace]
    is exactly the typing of the new field value at the old field type. *)

Lemma defs_update_hasnt_neq : forall (ds:defs) a (x:var) ds' l,
  defs_update ds a x ds' ->
  l <> label_fld a ->
  defs_hasnt ds l ->
  defs_hasnt ds' l.
Proof.
  intros ds a x ds' l Hupd. induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros Hne Hhas.
  - unfold defs_hasnt, get_def in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_fld a0 = l)) as [E|N].
    + subst l. exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + exact Hhas.
  - unfold defs_hasnt, get_def in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d = l)) as [E|N].
    + exact Hhas.
    + apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_update_typing : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a (y:var) ds',
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  defs_update ds a y ds' ->
  (forall (t:var Tf:typ),
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f t)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf) ->
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f y)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf)) ->
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds' T.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a y ds' Hty Hupd.
  induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros Hreplace.
  - (* replace the head field *)
    dependent destruction Hty.
    named_goal_defs_one: Hty.
  - (* push into the tail *)
    dependent destruction Hty.
    eapply ty_defs_cons.
    + eapply IH. exact Hty.
    + exact Hdef.
    + eapply defs_update_hasnt_neq; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics HeapUpdate.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Updating a field by a value of the field's own declared type preserves
    the typing of the whole definition list.  The extra hypothesis [Hreplace]
    is exactly the typing of the new field value at the old field type. *)

Lemma defs_update_hasnt_neq : forall (ds:defs) a (x:var) ds' l,
  defs_update ds a x ds' ->
  l <> label_fld a ->
  defs_hasnt ds l ->
  defs_hasnt ds' l.
Proof.
  intros ds a x ds' l Hupd. induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros Hne Hhas.
  - unfold defs_hasnt, get_def in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_fld a0 = l)) as [E|N].
    + subst l. exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + exact Hhas.
  - unfold defs_hasnt, get_def in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d = l)) as [E|N].
    + exact Hhas.
    + apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_update_typing : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a (y:var) ds',
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  defs_update ds a y ds' ->
  (forall (t:var Tf:typ),
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f t)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf) ->
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f y)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf)) ->
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds' T.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a y ds' Hty Hupd.
  induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros Hreplace.
  - (* replace the head field *)
    inversion Hty as [G1 Go1 e1 d1 D1 Hdef1
                    |G1 Go1 e1 ds1 d1 T1 D1 Hty1 Hdef1 Hhasnt1];
      subst.
    + eapply ty_defs_one.
      inversion Hdef1; subst.
      eapply (Hreplace t T0). exact Hdef1.
    + eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * exact Hty1.
      * inversion Hdef1; subst.
        eapply (Hreplace t T0). exact Hdef1.
      * exact Hhasnt1.
  - (* push into the tail *)
    inversion Hty as [G1 Go1 e1 d1 D1 Hdef1
                    |G1 Go1 e1 ds1 d1 T1 D1 Hty1 Hdef1 Hhasnt1];
      subst.
    + (* an empty tail cannot be updated *)
      inversion Hupd0.
    + eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * eapply IH. exact Hty1.
      * exact Hdef1.
      * eapply defs_update_hasnt_neq; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics HeapUpdate.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Updating a field by a value of the field's own declared type preserves
    the typing of the whole definition list.  The extra hypothesis [Hreplace]
    is exactly the typing of the new field value at the old field type. *)

Lemma defs_update_hasnt_neq : forall (ds:defs) a (x:var) ds' l,
  defs_update ds a x ds' ->
  l <> label_fld a ->
  defs_hasnt ds l ->
  defs_hasnt ds' l.
Proof.
  intros ds a x ds' l Hupd. induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros Hne Hhas.
  - unfold defs_hasnt, get_def in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_fld a0 = l)) as [E|N].
    + subst l. exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + exact Hhas.
  - unfold defs_hasnt, get_def in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d = l)) as [E|N].
    + exact Hhas.
    + apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_update_typing : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a (y:var) ds',
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  defs_update ds a y ds' ->
  (forall (t:var Tf:typ),
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f t)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf) ->
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f y)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf)) ->
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds' T.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a y ds' Hty Hupd.
  induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros Hreplace.
  - (* replace the head field *)
    dependent destruction Hty.
    named_goal_defs_one: Hty.
  - (* push into the tail *)
    dependent destruction Hty.
    eapply ty_defs_cons.
    + eapply IH. exact Hty.
    + exact Hdef.
    + eapply defs_update_hasnt_neq; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

(** The heap item obtained by replacing one stored field is well typed,

Lemma ty_item_obj_update : forall G e Sigma yObj U S (ds:defs) ds' a (yArg:var),
  ctx_binds yObj (typ_objref U S) G ->

Section ConditionalCanonical.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Residual selector elimination, stated at the typed-record level.

    [typed_record_fld_bounds] is the exact remaining semantic fact: a
    well-typed object record [U] (all type members have equal bounds) can
    only subtype a field record if the field is structurally present, and
    then the field's declared type [W] sits between the lower and upper
    bounds.  This is the point where the phantom-label counterexample of
    [Record_subtyp.v] is excluded by the equal-bound provenance from
    [ty_defs_typed_record]. *)

Variable typed_record_fld_bounds :
  forall G e (U:typ) ls a S T,
    typed_record_typ U ls ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T)) ->
    exists W,
      label_fld a \in ls /\
      typed_dec (dec_fld a W W) /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S W /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e W T.

Variable typed_record_met_label :
  forall G e (U:typ) ls m TC TZ TR,
    typed_record_typ U ls ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ->
    label_met m \in ls.

(** Selector elimination at the variable-to-binding transport level: if a
    variable whose context binding is the object-reference type [and (bnd U) S]
    is typed at [T0], and [T0] subtypes [Tgt], then the object record [U]
    itself subtypes [Tgt].  The bad selector chains of [Record_subtyp.v]
    either cannot start from a binding, or reduce to a strictly smaller
    subtyping derivation between typed records. *)

Variable var_binding_record_subtyp :
  forall G e x T0 Tw (U:typ) Sref Tgt,
    inert G ->
    ctx_binds x Tw G ->
    Tw = typ_objref U Sref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 Tgt ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U Tgt.

(** Data about the actual reference stored in the field: [Tw] is the
    reference type of the location kept in the definition, [Ty] its
    location type.  The two bounds are exactly what a field read/write
    needs: the contravariant lower bound lets a write argument of type [S]
    be stored, and the covariant upper bound types the value produced by a
    read. *)

Variable ref_value_field_bounds :
  forall G e Sigma yObj ds (U:typ) ls a v S T,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_heap yObj U) e ds (open yObj U) ->
    typed_record_typ U ls ->
    label_fld a \in ls ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) ->
    exists Ty Tw,
      ctx_k G v v_loc /\
      ctx_binds v Ty G /\
      typ_corr Tw Ty /\
      inert_typ Tw v_ref /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S Tw /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tw T.

Lemma typed_record_fld_defs :
  forall G e Sigma yObj ds (U:typ) ls a S T,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_heap yObj U) e ds (open yObj U) ->
    typed_record_typ U ls ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T)) ->
    exists W v,
      defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
      label_fld a \in ls /\
      typed_dec (dec_fld a W W) /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S W /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e W T.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma yObj ds U ls a S T Hhc Hby Hds Hrec Hsub.
  destruct (@typed_record_fld_bounds G e U ls a S T Hrec Hsub)
    as [W [Hlab [Htd [HST HWT]]]].
  assert (Hrt : record_typ U ls) by (apply typed_record_typ_record_typ; exact Hrec).
  destruct (@defs_has_fld_of_label G (objctx_heap yObj U) e ds (open yObj U) a
              Hds yObj U ls eq_refl Hrt Hlab) as [v Hhas].
  (* [defs_has_fld_of_label] needs [defs_varkinds]; recover it from the item. *)
  exists W, v. split; [exact Hhas|].
  split; [exact Hlab|]. split; [exact Htd|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

End ConditionalCanonical.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma defs_has_cons_here : forall (ds:defs) (d:def),
  defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d.
Proof.
  intros ds d. unfold defs_has. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l (P := label_of d = label_of d) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma defs_has_cons_other : forall (ds:defs) (d d':def),
  label_of d <> label_of d' -> defs_has ds d' -> defs_has (defs_cons ds d) d'.
Proof.
  intros ds d d' Hne Hh. unfold defs_has in *. cbn.
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := label_of d = label_of d') Hne).
  assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_hasnt_has_contra : forall (ds:defs) (d:def) l,
  defs_hasnt ds l -> defs_has ds d -> label_of d = l -> False.
Proof.
  intros ds d l Hn Hh He. unfold defs_hasnt, defs_has in *.
  rewrite He in Hh. rewrite Hh in Hn. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_label : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> label_of d = label_of D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_record_dec : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H.
  change (ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D) in H.
  induction H.
  - (* def_typ *) apply rd_typ.
  - (* def_fld *) apply rd_fld.
  - (* def_met *) eapply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_rcd_inv : forall (D:dec) ls,
  record_typ (typ_rcd D) ls -> ls = singleton (label_of D).
Proof.
  intros D ls H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_and_inv : forall (T:typ) (D:dec) ls,
  record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) ls ->
  exists ls' l, ls = ls' \u singleton l /\ record_typ T ls' /\
                l = label_of D /\ l \notin ls'.
Proof.
  intros T D ls H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  exists ls0, (label_of D). split; [reflexivity|]. split; [eassumption|]. split; [reflexivity|eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_record : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
  (exists ls, record_typ T ls) /\
  (forall ls, record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls ->
     exists d, defs_has ds d /\ label_of d = l).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T H.
  change (ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T) in H.
  induction H.
  - (* one *) pose proof (ty_def_record_dec H) as Hdec.
    pose proof (ty_def_label H) as Hlab.
    split.
    + exists (singleton (label_of D)). eapply rt_one; eauto.
    + intros ls Hrec l Hl. rewrite (record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) in Hl.
      rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. exists d. split.
      * apply defs_has_cons_here.
      * exact Hlab.
  - (* cons *) pose proof (ty_def_record_dec H0) as Hdec.
    pose proof (ty_def_label H0) as Hlab.
    destruct IHty_defs as [Hex Hinvs].
    split.
    + destruct Hex as [ls' Hrec'].
      assert (Hnotin : label_of D \notin ls').
      { intro Hl. destruct (Hinvs ls' Hrec' (label_of D) Hl) as [d' [Hhas Heq]].
        eapply (@defs_hasnt_has_contra ds d' (label_of D));
          [ match goal with Hn : defs_hasnt ds (label_of d) |- _ =>
              rewrite <- Hlab; exact Hn end
          | exact Hhas | exact Heq ]. }
      exists (ls' \u singleton (label_of D)).
      eapply rt_cons; [exact Hrec'|exact Hdec|reflexivity|exact Hnotin].
    + intros ls Hrec l Hl.
      destruct (record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as [ls' [l' [Hls [Hrec' [Hl' Hnot]]]]].
      subst ls. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
      * destruct (Hinvs ls' Hrec' l Hl) as [d' [Hhas Heq]]. exists d'. split; auto.
        eapply defs_has_cons_other.
        -- intro E. apply Hnot. rewrite Hl'. rewrite <- Hlab. rewrite E. rewrite Heq. exact Hl.
        -- exact Hhas.
      * rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
        exists d. split.
        -- apply defs_has_cons_here.
        -- rewrite Hlab. symmetry. exact Hl'.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma record_typ_has : forall (T:typ) ls,
  record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls -> exists D, record_has T D /\ label_of D = l.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H as [D l0 Hdec Heq|T ls D l0 Hrec IH Hdec Heq Hnot].
  - intros l Hl. rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    exists D. split; [eapply rh_one|]. symmetry. exact Heq.
  - intros l Hl. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + destruct (IH l Hl) as [D' [Hhas Heq']]. exists D'.
      split; [eapply rh_andl; eauto| exact Heq'].
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l. exists D.
      split; [eapply rh_andr; eapply rh_one| symmetry; exact Heq].
Qed.

Lemma label_of_open_dec : forall (D:dec) n x,
  label_of (open_rec n x D) = label_of D.
Proof. intros D n x. destruct D; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma record_dec_open : forall (D:dec) n x, record_dec D -> record_dec (open_rec n x D).
Proof.
  intros D n x H. destruct H.
  - cbn. apply rd_typ.
  - cbn. apply rd_typb.
  - cbn. apply rd_fld.
  - cbn. apply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_open : forall (T:typ) ls n x,
  record_typ T ls -> record_typ (open_rec n x T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls n x H. induction H.
  - eapply rt_one; [apply record_dec_open; eauto | rewrite label_of_open_dec; assumption].
  - eapply rt_cons; [exact IHrecord_typ | apply record_dec_open; eauto | rewrite label_of_open_dec; assumption | assumption].
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext.
Require Import Defs_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** At every label present in the record type of a well-typed definition
    list, the corresponding definition itself is well typed, and its label
    is the requested one. *)

Lemma ty_defs_label_def_typing : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  forall ls, record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls ->
    exists (d:def) D,
      defs_has ds d /\ label_of d = l /\
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D /\ label_of D = l /\ record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T Hty.
  induction Hty as [G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef
                  |G0 Go0 e0 ds0 d T0 D Hty0 IH Hdef Hhasnt];
    intros ls Hrec l Hl.
  - pose proof (record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) as Hls. subst ls.
    rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    exists d, D. split; [apply defs_has_cons_here|].
    split; [apply ty_def_label; exact Hdef|].
    split; [exact Hdef|]. split; [apply ty_def_label; exact Hdef|].
    apply ty_def_record_dec; exact Hdef.
  - destruct (record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as
      [ls' [l' [Hls [Hrec' [Hl' Hnot]]]]].
    subst ls. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + destruct (IH ls' Hrec' l Hl) as
        [d' [D' [Hhas [Hlabd [Htyd [HlabD Hdec]]]]]].
      exists d', D'. split; [|split; [exact Hlabd|]].
      * eapply defs_has_cons_other.
        -- intro E. apply Hnot. rewrite Hl'. rewrite <- (ty_def_label Hdef).
           rewrite E. rewrite Hlabd. exact Hl.
        -- exact Hhas.
      * split; [exact Htyd|]. split; [exact HlabD|exact Hdec].
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
      exists d, D. split; [apply defs_has_cons_here|].
      split; [apply ty_def_label; exact Hdef|].
      split; [exact Hdef|]. split.
      * rewrite Hl'. apply ty_def_label; exact Hdef.
      * apply ty_def_record_dec; exact Hdef.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma deref_avar_b : forall (e:env var) i, deref e (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof.
  intros e. induction e as [|e w y IH] using env_ind; intros i.
  - rewrite empty_def. reflexivity.
  - rewrite push_cons_var. cbn. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma deref_avar_f : forall (e:env var) (x:var),
  deref e (avar_f x) = avar_f (deref e x).
Proof.
  intros e. induction e as [|e w y IH] using env_ind; intros x.
  - rewrite empty_def. reflexivity.
  - rewrite push_cons_var. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_var_same : forall (w v:var), subst_var w v w = v.
Proof. intros. unfold subst_var, VarSubstVar. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l eq_refl). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_var_neq : forall (w v z:var), z <> w -> subst_var w v z = z.
Proof. intros. unfold subst_var, VarSubstVar. cbn. rewrite (classicT_r H). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_var_cases : forall (w v x:var), subst_var w v x = v \/ subst_var w v x = x.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (classicT (x = w)) as [E|N].
  - left. subst x. apply subst_var_same.
  - right. apply subst_var_neq. assumption.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

(** ** Head inversion for literal typing (no subtyping constructor) *)

Lemma ty_lit_fun_inv : forall G e T t U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ U ->
  exists L V,
    U = typ_fun T V /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x V).
Proof.
  intros G e T t U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_fun T t) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x ?vy) |- _ =>
    exists ly, vy; split; [reflexivity|exact H1]
  end.
Qed.

Lemma ty_lit_obj_inv : forall G e T ds U,
  G⁏e ⊢ lit_obj T ds ∶ U ->
  exists L,
    U = typ_objlit typing_mode T /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) /\
    typ_indep_b 0 T.
Proof.
  intros G e T ds U H.
  change (ty_lit typing_mode G objctx_empty e (lit_obj T ds) U) in H.
  dependent destruction H.
  match goal with
  | H1 : (forall x : var, x \notin ?ly -> G §§ objctx_lit x T ⁏e ⊢ open x ds ∶ open x T) |- _ =>
    match goal with
    | H2 : typ_indep_b 0 T |- _ =>
      exists ly; split; [reflexivity|]; split; [exact H1|exact H2]
    end
  end.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext.
Require Import Defs_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** At every label present in the record type of a well-typed definition
    list, the corresponding definition itself is well typed, and its label
    is the requested one. *)

Lemma ty_defs_label_def_typing : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  forall ls, record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls ->
    exists (d:def) D,
      defs_has ds d /\ label_of d = l /\
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D /\ label_of D = l /\ record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T Hty.
  induction Hty as [G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef
                  |G0 Go0 e0 ds0 d T0 D Hty0 IH Hdef Hhasnt];
    intros ls Hrec l Hl.
  - pose proof (record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) as Hls. subst ls.
    rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    assert (Hlabd : @label_of def DefLabelOf d = @label_of dec DecLabelOf D)
      by exact (@ty_def_label typing_mode G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef).
    exists d, D. repeat split; eauto.
  - destruct (record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as
      [ls' [l' [Hls [Hrec' [Hl' Hnot]]]]].
    subst ls. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + destruct (IH ls' Hrec' l Hl) as
        [d' [D' [Hhas [Hlabd [Htyd [HlabD Hdec]]]]]].
      exists d', D'. split.
      * eapply defs_has_cons_other.
        -- intro E. apply Hnot. rewrite Hl'.
           rewrite <- (@ty_def_label typing_mode G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef).
           rewrite E. rewrite Hlabd. exact Hl.
        -- exact Hhas.
      * repeat split; eauto.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
      assert (Hlabd : @label_of def DefLabelOf d = @label_of dec DecLabelOf D)
        by exact (@ty_def_label typing_mode G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef).
      exists d, D. repeat split; eauto.
      rewrite Hl'. symmetry. exact Hlabd.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.
