Fixpoint ctx_subst_full (sx sy:var) (G:ctx) : ctx :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_push G0 v vk T =>
      ctx_push (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0) (subst_var sx sy v) vk (subst_var sx sy T)
  | ctx_stop G0 => ctx_stop (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0)
  | ctx_hide G0 => ctx_hide (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0)
  end.

Definition objctx_subst_full (sx sy:var) (Go:objctx) : objctx :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit v T => objctx_lit (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T)
  | objctx_heap v T => objctx_heap (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T)
  end.

Lemma ctx_subst_full_push : forall sx sy G v vk T,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (G § v / vk ~ T) =
  ctx_subst_full sx sy G § subst_var sx sy v / vk ~ subst_var sx sy T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_full_empty : forall sx sy,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy ctx_empty = ctx_empty.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Binds/visibility are equivariant. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_swp : forall G v T,
  ctx_binds v T G ->
  forall sx sy, ctx_binds (swp_var sx sy v) (swp_typ sx sy T) (swp_ctx sx sy G).
Proof.
  intros G v T H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E. apply H. exact (swp_var_inj sx sy v v2 E).
    + apply IHctx_binds.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. apply IHctx_binds.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_swp : forall G v,
  ctx_vis G v ->
  forall sx sy, ctx_vis (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G v H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_vis_e.
  - eapply ctx_vis_n.
    + intro E. apply H. exact (swp_var_inj sx sy v v2 E).
    + apply IHctx_vis.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_subst_full : forall G v T,
  ctx_binds v T G ->
  forall sx sy, sy \notin ctx_dom G ->
    ctx_binds (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T) (ctx_subst_full sx sy G).
Proof.
  intros G v T H. induction H; intros sx sy Hsy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - assert (HvG : ctx_binds v t G) by exact H0.
    assert (Hvin : v \in ctx_dom G) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact HvG).
    cbn in Hsy. rewrite notin_union in Hsy. destruct Hsy as [Hsyv HsyG].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hsyv.
    assert (Hvne : v <> sy) by (intro E; apply HsyG; subst sy; exact Hvin).
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + apply subst_var_neq_fresh; auto.
    + apply IHctx_binds. exact HsyG.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. apply IHctx_binds. exact Hsy.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_full : forall G v,
  ctx_vis G v ->
  forall sx sy, sy \notin ctx_dom G ->
    ctx_vis (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G v H. induction H; intros sx sy Hsy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_vis_e.
  - assert (Hvin : v \in ctx_dom G) by (eapply ctx_vis_in_dom; exact H0).
    cbn in Hsy. rewrite notin_union in Hsy. destruct Hsy as [Hsyv HsyG].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hsyv.
    assert (Hvne : v <> sy) by (intro E; apply HsyG; subst sy; exact Hvin).
    eapply ctx_vis_n.
    + apply subst_var_neq_fresh; auto.
    + apply IHctx_vis. exact HsyG.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_obj_swp : forall sx sy G Go,

Lemma ctx_met_swp : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC,

  intros. cbn.

  ctx_subst_full sx sy (ctx_met_refined_heap G x TZ y TC z T) =

(** * Freshness helpers *)

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq : forall (G:ctx) x x0 z,
  x <> x0 -> ctx_vis G x -> ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 z G) x.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|G IH v vk T|G IH|G IH]; intros x x0 z Hne Hv; cbn in *.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv as [v0 vk0 t0 G0|v0 v2 vk0 t0 G0 Hneq Hvis]; subst; cbn.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [ | apply IH; assumption].
      intro E. apply Hneq. exact E.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_obj_full : forall (G:ctx) (Go:objctx) x0 z,
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go -> x0 \notin objctx_fv Go ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (G §§& Go) = subst_ctx x0 z G §§& Go.
Proof.
  intros G Go x0 z Hd Hf. destruct Go as [|x T|y T]; cbn in Hd, Hf.
  - reflexivity.
  - unfold ctx_obj. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh (open x T) x0 z).
    + reflexivity.
    + intro Hin. destruct (fv_open_cases_typ T 0 x) as [E|E]; rewrite E in Hin.
      * exact (Hf Hin).
      * rewrite in_union in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
        -- rewrite in_singleton in Hin. apply Hd. rewrite in_singleton. exact Hin.
        -- exact (Hf Hin).
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_obj_concat : forall (G:ctx) (Go:objctx) x0 z,
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go -> x0 \notin objctx_fv Go ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (G §§& Go) = subst_ctx x0 z G §§& Go.
Proof. exact subst_ctx_obj_full. Qed.

(** Freshness of the substituted name in [open]. *)

Lemma notin_fv_open_typ : forall (T:typ) x0 x,
  x0 \notin fv T -> x0 <> x -> x0 \notin fv (open x T).
Proof.
  intros T x0 x Hf Hne H. destruct (fv_open_cases_typ T 0 x) as [E|E]; rewrite E in H.
  - exact (Hf H).
  - rewrite in_union in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + rewrite in_singleton in H. contradiction.
    + exact (Hf H).
Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_open_trm : forall (t:trm) x0 x,
  x0 \notin fv t -> x0 <> x -> x0 \notin fv (open x t).

  intros t x0 x Hf Hne H. destruct (fv_open_cases_trm t 0 x) as [E|E]; rewrite E in H.
  - exact (Hf H).
  - rewrite in_union in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + rewrite in_singleton in H. contradiction.
    + exact (Hf H).
Qed.

  - exact (Hf H).
  - rewrite in_union in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + rewrite in_singleton in H. contradiction.
    + exact (Hf H).
Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_trm_lit_left : forall (l:lit) (t:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (trm_lit l t) -> x \notin fv l.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_trm_lit_body : forall (l:lit) (t:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (trm_lit l t) -> x \notin fv t.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_lit_obj_typ : forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) x,
  x \notin fv (lit_obj T ds) -> x \notin fv T.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_lit_obj_defs : forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) x,

Lemma notin_fv_lit_fun_typ : forall (T:typ) (t:trm) x,

Lemma notin_fv_lit_fun_body : forall (T:typ) (t:trm) x,

Lemma typ_subst_open_commut_expanded : forall (T:typ) x0 z y,
  subst_typ x0 z (open y T) =
  open (subst_var x0 z y) (subst_typ x0 z T).
Proof. intros. apply typ_subst_open_commut. Qed.

(** * Substitution for capability bounds *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_subst : forall C G Go e T1 T2,
  @ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T1 T2 ->
  forall G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0,
    G = G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2 ->
    x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
    x0 \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) -> z <> x0 ->
    ty_var typing_mode (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)) objctx_empty e z
      (subst_var x0 z S0) ->
    @ty_capbnd typing_mode C (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)) Go e
      (subst_var x0 z T1) (subst_var x0 z T2).
Proof.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext.
Require Import Defs_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** At every label present in the record type of a well-typed definition
    list, the corresponding definition itself is well typed, and its label
    is the requested one. *)

Lemma ty_defs_label_def_typing : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  forall ls, record_typ T ls -> forall l, l \in ls ->
    exists (d:def) D,
      defs_has ds d /\ label_of d = l /\
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D /\ label_of D = l /\ record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T Hty.
  induction Hty as [G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef
                  |G0 Go0 e0 ds0 d T0 D Hty0 IH Hdef Hhasnt];
    intros ls Hrec l Hl.
  - pose proof (record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) as Hls. subst ls.
    rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
    assert (Hlabd : @label_of def DefLabelOf d = @label_of dec DecLabelOf D)
      by exact (@ty_def_label typing_mode G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef).
    exists d, D. split.
    + apply defs_has_cons_here.
    + split; [exact Hlabd|].
      split; [exact Hdef|].
      split; [reflexivity|].
      eapply ty_def_record_dec; exact Hdef.
  - destruct (record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as
      [ls' [l' [Hls [Hrec' [Hl' Hnot]]]]].
    subst ls. rewrite in_union in Hl. destruct Hl as [Hl|Hl].
    + destruct (IH ls' Hrec' l Hl) as
        [d' [D' [Hhas [Hlabd [Htyd [HlabD Hdec]]]]]].
      exists d', D'. split.
      * eapply defs_has_cons_other.
        -- intro E. apply Hnot. rewrite Hl'.
           rewrite <- (@ty_def_label typing_mode G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef).
           rewrite E. rewrite Hlabd. exact Hl.
        -- exact Hhas.
      * repeat split; eauto.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hl. subst l.
      assert (Hlabd : @label_of def DefLabelOf d = @label_of dec DecLabelOf D)
        by exact (@ty_def_label typing_mode G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef).
      exists d, D. split.
      * apply defs_has_cons_here.
      * split; [rewrite Hl'; exact Hlabd|].
        split; [exact Hdef|].
        split.
        -- symmetry. exact Hl'.
        -- eapply ty_def_record_dec; exact Hdef.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section FieldLabel.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The actual field stored at a field label of a well-typed definition
    list, together with its declared equal-bounded field type. *)

Lemma defs_field_typing_from_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) (U:typ) (ls:fset label)
    (y:var) a,
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds (open y U) ->
  record_typ U ls ->
  label_fld a \in ls ->
  exists (v:var) Tf,
    defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
    @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f v)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds U ls y a Hty Hrec Hlab.
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as HrecT.
  destruct (@ty_defs_label_def_typing typing_mode G Go e ds (open_rec 0 y U) Hty
              ls HrecT (label_fld a) Hlab)
    as [d [D [Hhas [Hlabd [Htyd [HlabD Hdec]]]]]].
  destruct d as [lt Td|lf v|lm tm]; cbn in Hlabd; try discriminate.
  - destruct v as [i|x].
    + inversion Htyd.
    + inversion Hdec; subst; cbn in HlabD; try discriminate.
      injection Hlabd as E; subst lf.
      injection HlabD as E2; subst a0.
      exists x, T. split; assumption.
Qed.

End FieldLabel.

Section MetLabel.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The actual method stored at a method label, together with its declared
    method type. *)

Lemma defs_met_typing_from_label : forall G Go e (ds:defs) (U:typ) (ls:fset label)
    (y:var) m,
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds (open y U) ->
  record_typ U ls ->
  label_met m \in ls ->
  exists (tm:trm) TC TZ TR,
    defs_has ds (def_met m tm) /\
    @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_met m tm) (dec_met m TC TZ TR).
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds U ls y m Hty Hrec Hlab.
  pose proof (@record_typ_open U ls 0 y Hrec) as HrecT.
  destruct (@ty_defs_label_def_typing typing_mode G Go e ds (open_rec 0 y U) Hty
              ls HrecT (label_met m) Hlab)
    as [d [D [Hhas [Hlabd [Htyd [HlabD Hdec]]]]]].
  destruct d as [lt Td|lf v|lm tm]; cbn in Hlabd; try discriminate.
  inversion Hdec; subst; cbn in HlabD; try discriminate.
  injection Hlabd as E. subst lm.
  inversion Htyd; subst.
  exists tm, TC, TZ, TR. split; assumption.
Qed.

End MetLabel.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Env_set Heap_set_corr Defs_update_typing Defs_update_varkinds.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** The heap item obtained by replacing one stored field is well typed,
    provided the replacement field definition is typed at the same declared
    field type as the old one. *)

Lemma ty_item_obj_update : forall G e Sigma yObj U S (ds:defs) ds' a (yArg:var),
  ctx_binds yObj (typ_objref U S) G ->
  binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
  @ty_defs typing_mode G (objctx_heap yObj U) e ds (open yObj U) ->
  defs_varkinds G ds ->
  defs_update ds a yArg ds' ->
  ctx_k G yArg v_loc ->
  (forall (t:var) (Tf:typ),
      @ty_def typing_mode G (objctx_heap yObj U) e
        (def_fld a (avar_f t)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf) ->
      @ty_def typing_mode G (objctx_heap yObj U) e
        (def_fld a (avar_f yArg)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf)) ->
  @ty_item_s typing_mode G e (env_set Sigma yObj (item_obj ds')) yObj.
Proof.
  intros G e Sigma yObj U S ds ds' a yArg Hcb Hb Hds Hvk Hupd Hky Hreplace.
  eapply ty_item_obj_s with (U := U) (S := S).
  - exact Hcb.
  - apply binds_env_set_eq.
  - reflexivity.
  - eapply (defs_update_typing (G:=G) (Go:=objctx_heap yObj U) (e:=e)
               (ds:=ds) (T:=open yObj U) (a:=a) (y:=yArg) (ds':=ds')); eauto.
  - eapply (defs_varkinds_update (G:=G) (ds:=ds) (a:=a) (y:=yArg) (ds':=ds')); eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

content.content:
Lemma swp_ctx_empty : forall sx sy, swp_ctx sx sy ctx_empty = ctx_empty.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Substitution on contexts that also renames push names. *)

Fixpoint ctx_subst_full (sx sy:var) (G:ctx) : ctx :=
  match G with
  | ctx_empty => ctx_empty
  | ctx_push G0 v vk T =>
      ctx_push (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0) (subst_var sx sy v) vk (subst_var sx sy T)
  | ctx_stop G0 => ctx_stop (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0)
  | ctx_hide G0 => ctx_hide (ctx_subst_full sx sy G0)
  end.

Definition objctx_subst_full (sx sy:var) (Go:objctx) : objctx :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit v T => objctx_lit (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T)
  | objctx_heap v T => objctx_heap (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T)
  end.

Lemma ctx_subst_full_push : forall sx sy G v vk T,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (G § v / vk ~ T) =
  ctx_subst_full sx sy G § subst_var sx sy v / vk ~ subst_var sx sy T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ctx_subst_full_empty : forall sx sy,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy ctx_empty = ctx_empty.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(** Binds/visibility are equivariant. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_swp : forall G v T,
  ctx_binds v T G ->
  forall sx sy, ctx_binds (swp_var sx sy v) (swp_typ sx sy T) (swp_ctx sx sy G).
Proof.
  intros G v T H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + intro E. apply H. exact (swp_var_inj sx sy v v2 E).
    + apply IHctx_binds.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. apply IHctx_binds.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_swp : forall G v,
  ctx_vis G v ->
  forall sx sy, ctx_vis (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G v H. induction H; intros sx sy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_vis_e.
  - eapply ctx_vis_n.
    + intro E. apply H. exact (swp_var_inj sx sy v v2 E).
    + apply IHctx_vis.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_subst_full : forall G v T,
  ctx_binds v T G ->
  forall sx sy, sy \notin ctx_dom G ->
    ctx_binds (subst_var sx sy v) (subst_var sx sy T) (ctx_subst_full sx sy G).
Proof.
  intros G v T H. induction H; intros sx sy Hsy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - assert (HvG : ctx_binds v t G) by exact H0.
    assert (Hvin : v \in ctx_dom G) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact HvG).
    cbn in Hsy. rewrite notin_union in Hsy. destruct Hsy as [Hsyv HsyG].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hsyv.
    assert (Hvne : v <> sy) by (intro E; apply HsyG; subst sy; exact Hvin).
    eapply ctx_binds_n.
    + apply subst_var_neq_fresh; auto.
    + apply IHctx_binds. exact HsyG.
  - apply ctx_binds_hide. apply IHctx_binds. exact Hsy.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_full : forall G v,
  ctx_vis G v ->
  forall sx sy, sy \notin ctx_dom G ->
    ctx_vis (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy v).
Proof.
  intros G v H. induction H; intros sx sy Hsy; cbn.
  - apply ctx_vis_e.
  - assert (Hvin : v \in ctx_dom G) by (eapply ctx_vis_in_dom; exact H0).
    cbn in Hsy. rewrite notin_union in Hsy. destruct Hsy as [Hsyv HsyG].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hsyv.
    assert (Hvne : v <> sy) by (intro E; apply HsyG; subst sy; exact Hvin).
    eapply ctx_vis_n.
    + apply subst_var_neq_fresh; auto.
    + apply IHctx_vis. exact HsyG.
Qed.

(** Object-context equations. *)

Lemma ctx_obj_swp : forall sx sy G Go,
  swp_ctx sx sy (G §§& Go) = (swp_ctx sx sy G) §§& (swp_objctx sx sy Go).
Proof.
  intros. destruct Go; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite swp_typ_open. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_obj_subst_full : forall sx sy G Go,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (G §§& Go) =
  (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) §§& (objctx_subst_full sx sy Go).
Proof.
  intros. destruct Go; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (typ_subst_open_commut T sx sy x 0). reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_swp : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC,
  swp_ctx sx sy (ctx_met G x TZ y TC) =
  ctx_met (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy x) (swp_typ sx sy TZ)
          (swp_var sx sy y) (swp_typ sx sy TC).
Proof.
  intros. cbn.
  rewrite swp_typ_open. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_subst_full : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (ctx_met G x TZ y TC) =
  ctx_met (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy x) (subst_var sx sy TZ)
          (subst_var sx sy y) (subst_var sx sy TC).
Proof.
  intros. cbn.
  rewrite (typ_subst_open_commut TC sx sy x 0). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_swp : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC TC2,
  swp_ctx sx sy (ctx_met_refined G x TZ y TC TC2) =
  ctx_met_refined (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy x) (swp_typ sx sy TZ)
    (swp_var sx sy y) (swp_typ sx sy TC) (swp_typ sx sy TC2).
Proof.
  intros. cbn.
  repeat rewrite swp_typ_open. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_subst_full : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC TC2,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (ctx_met_refined G x TZ y TC TC2) =
  ctx_met_refined (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy x) (subst_var sx sy TZ)
    (subst_var sx sy y) (subst_var sx sy TC) (subst_var sx sy TC2).
Proof.
  intros. cbn.
  repeat rewrite subst_typ_and.
  repeat rewrite (typ_subst_open_commut TC sx sy x 0).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_heap_swp : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC z T,
  swp_ctx sx sy (ctx_met_refined_heap G x TZ y TC z T) =
  ctx_met_refined_heap (swp_ctx sx sy G) (swp_var sx sy x) (swp_typ sx sy TZ)
    (swp_var sx sy y) (swp_typ sx sy TC) (swp_var sx sy z) (swp_typ sx sy T).
Proof.
  intros. cbn.
  repeat rewrite swp_typ_open. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_refined_heap_subst_full : forall sx sy G x TZ y TC z T,
  ctx_subst_full sx sy (ctx_met_refined_heap G x TZ y TC z T) =
  ctx_met_refined_heap (ctx_subst_full sx sy G) (subst_var sx sy x) (subst_var sx sy TZ)
    (subst_var sx sy y) (subst_var sx sy TC) (subst_var sx sy z) (subst_var sx sy T).
Proof.
  intros. cbn.
  repeat rewrite subst_typ_and.
  repeat rewrite (typ_subst_open_commut TC sx sy x 0).
  repeat rewrite (typ_subst_open_commut T sx sy z 0).
  repeat rewrite (typ_subst_open_commut T sx sy y 0).
  reflexivity.

    variable whose context binding is the object-reference type [and (bnd U) S]
    is typed at [T0], and [T0] subtypes [Tgt], then the object record [U]
    itself subtypes [Tgt].  The bad selector chains of [Record_subtyp.v]
    either cannot start from a binding, or reduce to a strictly smaller

Variable var_binding_record_subtyp :
  forall G e x T0 Tw (U:typ) Sref Tgt,

    ctx_binds x Tw G ->

Task: build the selector/typed-record bridge in `/workspace/Selector_sound.v` and expose the field bounds needed by reads and writes.

Created `/workspace/Selector_sound.v` (527 lines, new file only; `Task.v`, support files, and `_CoqProject` untouched). It compiles:

`rocq compile -R /workspace "" -R /workspace/.rocq-deps/TLC TLC Selector_sound.v` → exit 0.

No `Admitted`/`admit`/`Abort`/`Axiom`/`Parameter`/`Conjecture`/`fail`.

Unconditional results proved:
- `typed_dec` and `typed_record_typ`: the stronger record structure actually produced by `ty_defs` (type-member and field bounds equal), with:
  - `typed_record_typ_record_typ`, `typed_record_typ_labels_eq`, `typed_record_typ_label_dec`
  - `typed_dec_record_dec`, `typed_dec_open`, `label_of_open_dec`, `typed_record_typ_open`, `typed_record_type_open`
  - `typed_record_typ_fld_dec`, `typed_record_typ_met_dec` (recover the equal-bounded component from a label)
- `ty_def_typed_dec`, `ty_defs_typed_record`, `ty_defs_typed_record_type`: every `ty_defs` type is a typed record with weak (equivariant) bounds.
- `typed_record_field_ty_def` and `typed_record_met_ty_def`: bridges to the new checked-in `Defs_label_typing` helpers, returning the actual stored field/method and its `ty_def` at an equal-bounded declaration.

Conditional canonical data proved (helper-file `Variable`s are explicit residuals):
- `canon_fld_read_data`: from `heap_correspond`, `inert`, `x v_ref`, `ty_var x T0`, `T0 <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)`, plus the viewpoint coercion `U <: V` and `V <: Tstack`, returns the heap location, `defs_has` field, value location/type/ref type, and
  `S <: Tw`, `Tw <: U`, and `Tw <: Tstack`.
- `canon_fld_write_data`: returns the receiver heap object, actual field, the argument’s location, and the same field bounds `S <: Tw`, `Tw <: U` (plus `ctx_k/ctx_binds/typ_corr/inert_typ`).

Residual assumptions isolated as `Variable`s (exact selector-elimination/typing-transport gaps):
- `typed_record_fld_bounds`, `typed_record_met_label`: typed-record-to-field/met label and bound inversion (the phantom-label exclusion).
- `var_binding_record_subtyp`, `var_binding_record_open_subtyp`: variable-to-object-record subtype transport, including the opened form.
- `ref_value_field_bounds`: the actual stored reference type `Tw` with `S <: Tw <: T`.
- `var_fun_binding_not_field`, `var_fun_binding_not_field_met`: fun bindings cannot reach field/met records.

Notable integration point for the parent: `canon_fld_read_data` needs the explicit viewpoint coercion `U <: V` (field upper to read result) which the current `canon_fld_read_weak` interface in `Weak_reduction_final.v` does not supply. Likewise the earlier `canon_fun_apply`/write interfaces still need the heap-closedness/result-relation and updated-item-typing inputs noted in `Canonical_static.v`/`Heap_item_update.v`; the new `canon_fld_write_data` stops deliberately at the field bounds, before `defs_update_typing`.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping OperationalSemantics HeapUpdate Defs_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Updating a field by a value of the field's own declared type preserves
    the typing of the whole definition list.  The extra hypothesis [Hreplace]
    is exactly the typing of the new field value at the old field type. *)

Lemma defs_update_hasnt_neq : forall (ds:defs) a (x:var) ds' l,
  defs_update ds a x ds' ->
  l <> label_fld a ->
  defs_hasnt ds l ->
  defs_hasnt ds' l.
Proof.
  intros ds a x ds' l Hupd. induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros Hne Hhas.
  - unfold defs_hasnt, get_def in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_fld a0 = l)) as [E|N].
    + subst l. exfalso. apply Hne. reflexivity.
    + exact Hhas.
  - unfold defs_hasnt, get_def in *. cbn in *.
    destruct (classicT (label_of d = l)) as [E|N].
    + exact Hhas.
    + apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma defs_update_typing : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T a (y:var) ds',
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  defs_update ds a y ds' ->
  (forall (t:var) (Tf:typ),
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f t)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf) ->
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f y)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf)) ->
  @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds' T.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T a y ds' Hty Hupd Hreplace.
  revert T Hty.
  induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros T Hty.
  - (* replace the head field *)
    inversion Hty as [G1 Go1 e1 d1 D1 Hdef1
                    |G1 Go1 e1 ds1 d1 T1 D1 Hty1 Hdef1 Hhasnt1];
      subst.
    + eapply ty_defs_one.
      destruct t as [i|t0].
      * inversion Hdef1.
      * inversion Hdef1; subst.
        eapply Hreplace; exact Hdef1.
    + eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * exact Hty1.
      * destruct t as [i|t0].
        -- inversion Hdef1.
        -- inversion Hdef1; subst.
           eapply Hreplace; exact Hdef1.
      * exact Hhasnt1.
  - (* push into the tail *)
    inversion Hty as [G1 Go1 e1 d1 D1 Hdef1
                    |G1 Go1 e1 ds1 d1 T1 D1 Hty1 Hdef1 Hhasnt1];
      subst.
    + (* an empty tail cannot be updated *)
      inversion Hupd0.
    + eapply ty_defs_cons.
      * eapply IH; [exact Hreplace|exact Hty1].
      * exact Hdef1.
      * eapply defs_update_hasnt_neq; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section UpdateHas.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma defs_update_has : forall (ds:defs) a (x:var) ds',
  defs_update ds a x ds' ->
  defs_has ds' (def_fld a (avar_f x)).
Proof.
  intros ds a x ds' H. induction H as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd IH Hneq].
  - apply defs_has_cons_here.
  - eapply defs_has_cons_other.
    + intro E. apply Hneq. cbn in E. exact E.
    + exact IH.
Qed.

End UpdateHas.
====

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Context_lemmas Typing_subst Subst_extra Subst_typing Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Var_subst_typing.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Full context substitution reduces to types-only substitution here.

    In [ctx_subst_full sx sy G] only binder names equal to [sx] are renamed.
    The variable-level judgments [ty_var], [subtyp] and [ty_incap] never
    contain the substituted binder [sx] in the remaining context, so the
    full operation coincides with [subst_ctx] on [G1 §& G2]. *)

Lemma ctx_subst_full_eq_subst_ctx : forall x y (G:ctx),
  x \notin ctx_dom G ->
  ctx_subst_full x y G = subst_ctx x y G.
Proof.
  intros x y G. induction G as [|G IH v vk T|G IH|G IH]; intros Hx; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - pose proof (@ctx_dom_push_elim G v vk T x Hx) as [E|HxG].
    + subst x. exfalso. apply Hx. cbn. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (IH HxG). rewrite (@subst_var_neq x y v).
      * reflexivity.
      * intro E. subst x. exfalso. apply Hx. cbn. rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - apply f_equal. apply IH. exact Hx.
  - apply f_equal. apply IH. exact Hx.
Qed.

Lemma ty_var_objctx_empty : forall G Go e (x:var) T,
  ty_var typing_mode G Go e x T -> Go = objctx_empty.
Proof. intros G Go e x T H. inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subtyp_objctx_empty : forall G Go e (T U:typ),
  subtyp typing_mode G Go e T U -> Go = objctx_empty.
Proof. intros G Go e T U H. inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ty_incap_objctx_empty : forall G Go e (T U:typ),
  ty_incap typing_mode G Go e T U -> Go = objctx_empty.
Proof. intros G Go e T U H. inversion H; reflexivity. Qed.

(** Variable-level substitution for [ctx_subst_full]. *)

Lemma var_sub_incap_subst_full_mut :
  (forall G Go e (x:var) T, ty_var typing_mode G Go e x T ->
     forall G1 G2 sx sy S0 vk0,
       G = G1 § sx / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2 ->
       sx \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
       sx \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) -> sy <> sx ->
       ty_var typing_mode (ctx_subst_full sx sy (G1 §& G2)) objctx_empty e sy
         (subst_var sx sy S0) ->
       ty_var typing_mode (ctx_subst_full sx sy (G1 §& G2))
         (objctx_subst_full sx sy Go) e
         (subst_var sx sy x) (subst_var sx sy T))
  /\ (forall G Go e (T U:typ), subtyp typing_mode G Go e T U ->
     forall G1 G2 sx sy S0 vk0,
       G = G1 § sx / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2 ->
       sx \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
       sx \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) -> sy <> sx ->
       ty_var typing_mode (ctx_subst_full sx sy (G1 §& G2)) objctx_empty e sy
         (subst_var sx sy S0) ->
       subtyp typing_mode (ctx_subst_full sx sy (G1 §& G2))
         (objctx_subst_full sx sy Go) e
         (subst_var sx sy T) (subst_var sx sy U))
  /\ (forall G Go e (T U:typ), ty_incap typing_mode G Go e T U ->
     forall G1 G2 sx sy S0 vk0,
       G = G1 § sx / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2 ->
       sx \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
       sx \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) -> sy <> sx ->
       ty_var typing_mode (ctx_subst_full sx sy (G1 §& G2)) objctx_empty e sy
         (subst_var sx sy S0) ->
       ty_incap typing_mode (ctx_subst_full sx sy (G1 §& G2))
         (objctx_subst_full sx sy Go) e
         (subst_var sx sy T) (subst_var sx sy U)).
Proof.
  split.
  - intros G Go e x T Hty G1 G2 sx sy S0 vk0 Heq Hsxdom Hse Hneq Hrep.
    assert (HGo : Go = objctx_empty) by (eapply ty_var_objctx_empty; exact Hty).
    subst Go. cbn [objctx_subst_full].
    rewrite (ctx_subst_full_eq_subst_ctx sy sx (G1 §& G2) Hsxdom).
    rewrite (ctx_subst_full_eq_subst_ctx sy sx (G1 §& G2) Hsxdom) in Hrep.
    eapply (proj1 (@var_sub_incap_subst_mut typing_mode)); eauto.
  - split.
    + intros G Go e T U Hsub G1 G2 sx sy S0 vk0 Heq Hsxdom Hse Hneq Hrep.
      assert (HGo : Go = objctx_empty) by (eapply subtyp_objctx_empty; exact Hsub).
      subst Go. cbn [objctx_subst_full].
      rewrite (ctx_subst_full_eq_subst_ctx sy sx (G1 §& G2) Hsxdom).
      rewrite (ctx_subst_full_eq_subst_ctx sy sx (G1 §& G2) Hsxdom) in Hrep.
      eapply (proj1 (proj2 (@var_sub_incap_subst_mut typing_mode))); eauto.
    + intros G Go e T U Hinc G1 G2 sx sy S0 vk0 Heq Hsxdom Hse Hneq Hrep.
      assert (HGo : Go = objctx_empty) by (eapply ty_incap_objctx_empty; exact Hinc).
      subst Go. cbn [objctx_subst_full].
      rewrite (ctx_subst_full_eq_subst_ctx sy sx (G1 §& G2) Hsxdom).
      rewrite (ctx_subst_full_eq_subst_ctx sy sx (G1 §& G2) Hsxdom) in Hrep.
      eapply (proj2 (proj2 (@var_sub_incap_subst_mut typing_mode))); eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

[typed_record_fld_bounds] is the exact remaining semantic fact: a
    well-typed object record [U] (all type members have equal bounds) can
    only subtype a field record if the field is structurally present, and
    then the field's declared type [W] sits between the lower and upper
    bounds.  This is the point where the phantom-label counterexample of
    [Record_subtyp.v] is excluded by the equal-bound provenance from
    [ty_defs_typed_record]. *)

Variable typed_record_fld_bounds :
  forall G e (U:typ) ls a S T,
    typed_record_typ U ls ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T)) ->
    exists W,
      label_fld a \in ls /\
      typed_dec (dec_fld a W W) /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S W /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e W T.

Variable typed_record_met_label :
  forall G e (U:typ) ls m TC TZ TR,
    typed_record_typ U ls ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR)) ->
    label_met m \in ls.

(** Selector elimination at the variable-to-binding transport level: if a
    variable whose context binding is the object-reference type [and (bnd U) S]
    is typed at [T0], and [T0] subtypes [Tgt], then the object record [U]
    itself subtypes [Tgt].  The bad selector chains of [Record_subtyp.v]
    either cannot start from a binding, or reduce to a strictly smaller
    subtyping derivation between typed records. *)

  forall G e x T0 Tw (U:typ) Sref Tgt,
    inert G ->
    ctx_binds x Tw G ->
    Tw = typ_objref U Sref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 Tgt ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U Tgt.

(** Data about the actual reference stored in the field: [Tw] is the
    reference type of the location kept in the definition, [Ty] its
    location type.  The two bounds are exactly what a field read/write

      typ_corr Tw Ty /\

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

Section CanonicalData.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Canonical field data from the typed-record inversion interfaces.

    Compared with [canon_fld_read_weak] in Weak_reduction_final.v we expose
    the field bounds explicitly: the actual stored reference type [Tw]
    satisfies both [S <: Tw] (needed for a write argument) and
    [Tw <: U] (needed to type the value returned by a read).  We also take
    the viewpoint coercion [U <: V] as an explicit premise; it is the
    field-upper part of [viewpoint_adapt], and it is what the read rule
    provides between the declared field bound and the result type. *)

  forall G e (U:typ) ls a S T,
    typed_record_typ U ls ->

    exists W,
      label_fld a \in ls /\
      typed_dec (dec_fld a W W) /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S W /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e W T.

  forall G e x T0 Tw (U:typ) Sref Tgt,

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_fun t11 t12) (typ_fun t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| tyq_typ_bnd(e: renv)(t1 t2: typ):
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_bnd t1) (typ_bnd t2)
| tyq_typ_met m (e: renv) t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    (forall x y, typing_equiv e (open_met x y t13) (open_met x y t23)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_met m t11 t12 t13)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m t21 t22 t23))
.

Existing Instance tyq_typ.

Inductive tyq_var_alt: renv -> var -> var -> Prop :=
| tyq_var_alt_eq e v:
    tyq_var_alt e v v
| tyq_var_alt_wy e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w y
| tyq_var_alt_yw e w y:
    binds w y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e y w
| tyq_var_alt_ww e w1 w2 y:
    binds w1 y e ->
    binds w2 y e ->
    tyq_var_alt e w1 w2.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Syntax_extra Closed_extra Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Weak_obj_extension.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Side conditions for object-literal heap allocation. *)

Definition obj_heap_side (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) : Prop :=
  inert G /\
  heap_correspond G e Sigma /\
  w \notin ctx_dom G /\ y \notin ctx_dom G /\ w <> y /\
  w \notin ctx_fv G /\ y \notin ctx_fv G /\
  w \notin fv T /\ y \notin fv T /\
  y \notin dom Sigma /\ w \notin dom e /\ y \notin dom e.

(** * Renaming interfaces for the literal-to-heap conversion.

    These are the three semantic facts that depend on the renaming of the
    object's self/reference variables to heap locations and on the change of
    the object context from [objctx_lit] to [objctx_heap].  Their proofs are
    independent of the [ty_defs] induction below; isolating them makes the
    structural conversion unconditional. *)

Variable obj_heap_var_transfer :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ) (x:var) (Tx:typ),
    obj_heap_side G e Sigma w y T ->
    @ty_var typing_mode (G § w / v_self ~ open w T) objctx_empty e x Tx ->
    @ty_var typing_mode (objG typing_mode G y w T) objctx_empty (objE e w y)
      (deref (objE e w y) x) Tx.


(** * Contexts with no [ctx_hide]/[ctx_stop] have [ctx_vis] = membership. *)

Inductive no_hide : ctx -> Prop :=
| no_hide_empty : no_hide ctx_empty
| no_hide_push G x vk T : no_hide G -> no_hide (G § x / vk ~ T).

Lemma inert_no_hide : forall G, inert G -> no_hide G.
Proof. intros G H. induction H; [constructor|eapply no_hide_push; eassumption]. Qed.

Lemma no_hide_dom_vis : forall G, no_hide G ->
    + (* no deref for x *)
      rewrite (@deref_var_notin_dom e x Hxne).
      assert (Hxin' : x \in ctx_dom (objG typing_mode G y w T)).
      { cbn. repeat rewrite in_union. right. right. exact Hxin. }
      eapply no_hide_dom_vis.
      * eapply no_hide_push. eapply no_hide_push. apply inert_no_hide. exact Hinert.
      * exact Hxin'.
Qed.

Variable obj_heap_met_transfer :
  forall (G:ctx) (e:renv) (Sigma:heap) (w y:var) (T:typ)
         (xz:var) (TZ:typ) (xc:var) (TC:typ) (t:trm) (TR:typ),
    obj_heap_side G e Sigma w y T ->
    @ty_trm typing_mode
      (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G (objctx_lit w T) xz TZ xc TC)
      objctx_empty e (open_met xz xc t) (open_met xz xc TR) ->
    @ty_trm typing_mode
      (ctx_obj_met typing_mode (objG typing_mode G y w T) (objctx_heap y T) xz TZ xc TC)
      objctx_empty (objE e w y) (open_met xz xc t) (open_met xz xc TR).

(** * Basic lemmas about [deref]. *)

Lemma label_of_deref_def : forall (e:renv) (d:def),
  label_of (deref_def e d) = label_of d.
Proof. intros e d. unfold deref_def. destruct d; cbn; reflexivity. Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4 Canonical5 Canonical_static Defs_label_typing.

Opaque label_of.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Typed records: the exact shape produced by [ty_defs].

    [record_dec] permits [dec_typ A bot T] (constructor [rd_typb]) and thus
    records whose type-member bounds are inconsistent.  The type of a
    well-typed sequence of definitions never uses [rd_typb]: [ty_def_typ]
    produces equal bounds, and [ty_def_fld] equal bounds.  We record this
    stronger structure, which is what rules out phantom field labels. *)

Inductive typed_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| td_typ : forall A T,
    typed_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| td_fld : forall a T,
    typed_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| td_met : forall m TC TZ TR,
    typed_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR).

Inductive typed_record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| trt_one : forall D l,
    typed_dec D ->
    l = label_of D ->
    typed_record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| trt_cons : forall T ls D l,
    typed_record_typ T ls ->
    typed_dec D ->
    l = label_of D ->
    l \notin ls ->
    typed_record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (ls \u \{l}).

Definition typed_record_type T := exists ls, typed_record_typ T ls.

Lemma typed_dec_record_dec : forall D,
  typed_dec D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros D H. dependent destruction H.
  - apply rd_typ.
  - apply rd_fld.
  - apply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_record_typ : forall T ls,
  typed_record_typ T ls -> record_typ T ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - eapply rt_one; [apply typed_dec_record_dec; eassumption|assumption].
  - refine (rt_cons _ _ _ _).
    + exact IHtyped_record_typ.
    + apply typed_dec_record_dec. assumption.
    + assumption.
    + assumption.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Defs GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep.

Fixpoint deref_base A (su: SubstVar A) (e: renv) (X: A): A :=
  match e with
  | nil => X
  | cons (w,y) ys => (deref_base su ys (subst_var w y X))
  end.

Class Deref A :=
  deref (e: renv) (a: A): A.

Instance deref_var: Deref var := deref_base VarSubstVar.

Instance deref_avar: Deref avar := deref_base AvarSubstVar.

Instance deref_def: Deref def :=
fun e d => match d with
| def_fld l x => def_fld l (deref e x)
| def_met l t => def_met l t
| def_typ l T => def_typ l T
end.

Fixpoint deref_defs_fix(e: renv)(ds: defs) :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => defs_nil
| defs_cons ds d => defs_cons (deref_defs_fix e ds) (deref_def e d)
end.

Instance deref_defs: Deref defs := deref_defs_fix.

Class DerefInFv (A: Set) (AD: Deref A) (AF: FreeVar A):=
  deref_in_fv x e (d: A):
    x \in fv (deref e d) ->
    x \in fv d \/ x \in fv_env e.

  forall x0 z, x0 \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) ->
    typing_equiv e (subst_var x0 z v1) (subst_var x0 z v2).
Proof.
  intros e v1 v2 H. induction H; intros x0 z Hxe.

    + apply IHtyq_typ; auto.
    + apply (@tyq_typ_open_met_at_dropped e x0 z t13 t23); auto.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble helper .v files into one Task.v body (for integration testing)."""
import re, sys, os

# Topological order is supplied on the command line; later files may use earlier.
files = sys.argv[1:]
if not files:
    print("usage: assemble.py FILE.v ...", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
mods = {os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(f))[0] for f in files}
header = """Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
"""
chunks = [header]
for f in files:
    src = open(f, encoding='utf8').read().splitlines()
    out = []
    for line in src:
        m = re.match(r'\s*Require\s+Import\s+([^.]+)\.', line)
        if m:
            names = m.group(1).split()
            names = [n for n in names if n not in mods]
            if not names:
                continue
            # keep support imports, but strip helper modules
            line = 'Require Import ' + ' '.join(names) + '.'
        if re.match(r'\s*Set Implicit Arguments\.\s*$', line):
            continue
        out.append(line)
    chunks.append('\n(* ==== from %s ==== *)\n' % os.path.basename(f))
    chunks.append('\n'.join(out))
print('\n'.join(chunks))

Section ObjCtxSubst.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Substituting the dropped context binder in a context with an object
    context splits into types-only context substitution plus [subst_objctx]. *)

Lemma ctx_obj_subst_ctx : forall (G1 G2:ctx) (Go:objctx) x0 z,
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2 §§& Go) =
  subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2) §§& subst_objctx x0 z Go.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 Go x0 z Hd. destruct Go as [|x T|y T]; cbn in Hd.
  - reflexivity.
  - unfold ctx_obj. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq T x0 z x 0).
    + reflexivity.
    + intro E. apply Hd. rewrite in_singleton. symmetry. exact E.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Visibility transport when the source variable is not the removed binder. *)

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_ctx_obj_neq : forall (G1 G2:ctx) (Go:objctx)
    x0 vk0 (S0:typ) x z,
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go ->
  x <> x0 ->
  ctx_vis (((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2) §§& Go) x ->
  ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2) §§& subst_objctx x0 z Go) x.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 Go x0 vk0 S0 x z Hd HdGo Hxne Hv.
  destruct Go as [|v T|y T]; cbn in *.
  - apply (@ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq (G1 §& G2) x x0 z Hxne).
    apply (@ctx_vis_remove_mid G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x Hv Hxne).
  - inversion Hv as [v0 vk1 t0 G0|v0 v2 vk1 t0 G0 Hneq Hvis]; subst; cbn.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [ exact Hneq | ].
      apply (@ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq (G1 §& G2) x x0 z Hxne).
      apply (@ctx_vis_remove_mid G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x Hvis Hxne).
  - apply (@ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq (G1 §& G2) x x0 z Hxne).
    apply (@ctx_vis_remove_mid G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x Hv Hxne).
Qed.

End ObjCtxSubst.

Section CtxObjMetSubst.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma subst_ctx_vis_hide : forall G x0 z,
  subst_ctx x0 z (vis_hide typing_mode G) = vis_hide typing_mode (subst_ctx x0 z G).
Proof. intros. destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_ctx_met : forall G xz TZ xc TC x0 z,
  xz <> x0 ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC) =
  ctx_met (subst_ctx x0 z G) xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc (subst_var x0 z TC).
Proof.
  intros. repeat rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
  rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq TC x0 z xz 0); [reflexivity|exact H].
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_ctx_met_refined : forall G xz TZ xc TC TC2 x0 z,
  xz <> x0 ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2) =
  ctx_met_refined (subst_ctx x0 z G) xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc
    (subst_var x0 z TC) (subst_var x0 z TC2).
Proof.
  intros. repeat rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
  repeat rewrite subst_typ_and.
  rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq TC x0 z xz 0); [reflexivity|exact H].
Qed.


Lemma subst_ctx_ctx_met_refined_heap : forall G xz TZ xc TC y T x0 z,
  xz <> x0 -> xc <> x0 ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T) =
  ctx_met_refined_heap (subst_ctx x0 z G) xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc
    (subst_var x0 z TC) (subst_var x0 z y) (subst_var x0 z T).
Proof.
  intros. repeat rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
  repeat rewrite subst_typ_and.
  rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq TC x0 z xz 0); [|exact H].
  repeat rewrite (@typ_subst_open_commut T x0 z).
  rewrite (@subst_var_neq x0 z xc H0).
  reflexivity.
Qed.


End CtxObjMetSubst.

       objctx_fresh Go xh (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) ->
       subtyp typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) objctx_empty e W Sh ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G1 § xh / vkh ~ W §& G2) Go e t T)
  /\ (forall G Go e (l:lit) T, ty_lit typing_mode G Go e l T ->

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Context_lemmas Typing_subst Subst_extra Syntax_extra Subst_typing Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Var_subst_typing.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Freshness helpers *)

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq : forall (G:ctx) x x0 z,
  x <> x0 -> ctx_vis G x -> ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 z G) x.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G as [|G IH v vk T|G IH|G IH]; intros x x0 z Hne Hv; cbn in *.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv as [v0 vk0 t0 G0|v0 v2 vk0 t0 G0 Hneq Hvis]; subst; cbn.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [ | apply IH; assumption].
      intro E. apply Hneq. exact E.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_obj_full : forall (G:ctx) (Go:objctx) x0 z,
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go -> x0 \notin objctx_fv Go ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (G §§& Go) = subst_ctx x0 z G §§& Go.
Proof.
  intros G Go x0 z Hd Hf. destruct Go as [|x T|y T]; cbn in Hd, Hf.
  - reflexivity.
  - unfold ctx_obj. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    rewrite (@typ_subst_fresh (open x T) x0 z).
    + reflexivity.
    + intro Hin. destruct (fv_open_cases_typ T 0 x) as [E|E]; rewrite E in Hin.
      * exact (Hf Hin).
      * rewrite in_union in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
        -- rewrite in_singleton in Hin. apply Hd. rewrite in_singleton. exact Hin.
        -- exact (Hf Hin).
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_obj_concat : forall (G:ctx) (Go:objctx) x0 z,
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go -> x0 \notin objctx_fv Go ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (G §§& Go) = subst_ctx x0 z G §§& Go.
Proof. exact subst_ctx_obj_full. Qed.

(** Freshness of the substituted name in [open]. *)

Lemma notin_fv_open_typ : forall (T:typ) x0 x,
  x0 \notin fv T -> x0 <> x -> x0 \notin fv (open x T).
Proof.
  intros T x0 x Hf Hne H. destruct (fv_open_cases_typ T 0 x) as [E|E]; rewrite E in H.
  - exact (Hf H).
  - rewrite in_union in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + rewrite in_singleton in H. contradiction.
    + exact (Hf H).
Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_open_trm : forall (t:trm) x0 x,
  x0 \notin fv t -> x0 <> x -> x0 \notin fv (open x t).
Proof.
  intros t x0 x Hf Hne H. destruct (fv_open_cases_trm t 0 x) as [E|E]; rewrite E in H.
  - exact (Hf H).
  - rewrite in_union in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + rewrite in_singleton in H. contradiction.
    + exact (Hf H).
Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_open_defs : forall (ds:defs) x0 x,
  x0 \notin fv ds -> x0 <> x -> x0 \notin fv (open x ds).
Proof.
  intros ds x0 x Hf Hne H. destruct (fv_open_cases_defs ds 0 x) as [E|E]; rewrite E in H.
  - exact (Hf H).
  - rewrite in_union in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + rewrite in_singleton in H. contradiction.
    + exact (Hf H).
Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_trm_lit_left : forall (l:lit) (t:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (trm_lit l t) -> x \notin fv l.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_trm_lit_body : forall (l:lit) (t:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (trm_lit l t) -> x \notin fv t.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_lit_obj_typ : forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) x,
  x \notin fv (lit_obj T ds) -> x \notin fv T.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_lit_obj_defs : forall (T:typ) (ds:defs) x,
  x \notin fv (lit_obj T ds) -> x \notin fv ds.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_lit_fun_typ : forall (T:typ) (t:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (lit_fun T t) -> x \notin fv T.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_lit_fun_body : forall (T:typ) (t:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (lit_fun T t) -> x \notin fv t.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma typ_subst_open_commut_expanded : forall (T:typ) x0 z y,
  subst_typ x0 z (open y T) =
  open (subst_var x0 z y) (subst_typ x0 z T).
Proof. intros. apply typ_subst_open_commut. Qed.

(** * Substitution for capability bounds *)

Lemma ty_capbnd_subst : forall C G Go e T1 T2,
  @ty_capbnd typing_mode C G Go e T1 T2 ->
  forall G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0,
    G = G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2 ->
    x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
    x0 \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) -> z <> x0 ->
    ty_var typing_mode (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)) objctx_empty e z
      (subst_var x0 z S0) ->
    @ty_capbnd typing_mode C (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)) Go e
      (subst_var x0 z T1) (subst_var x0 z T2).
Proof.
  intros C G Go e T1 T2 H. induction H; intros G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx; subst G.
  - cbn. apply ty_capbnd_top.
  - cbn. apply ty_capbnd_bot.
  - cbn. apply ty_capbnd_typ.
  - cbn. apply ty_capbnd_cap_sel.
  - cbn. eapply ty_capbnd_cap_ignore; eassumption.
  - cbn. apply ty_capbnd_met.
  - cbn. apply ty_capbnd_fld.
  - cbn. eapply ty_capbnd_sel.
    + exact (proj1 (@var_sub_incap_subst_mut typing_mode)
               (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) objctx_empty e x
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ B S T)) H G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0
               eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx).
    + assert (Hc : @ty_capbnd typing_mode C (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2))
                     objctx_empty e (subst_var x0 z (open y T))
                     (subst_var x0 z T')) by
        (exact (@IHty_capbnd G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx)).
      rewrite (@typ_subst_open_commut T x0 z y 0) in Hc. exact Hc.
  - cbn. apply ty_capbnd_rec.
  - cbn. eapply ty_capbnd_and.
    + exact (@IHty_capbnd G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx).
    + exact (@IHty_capbnd0 G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx).
  - cbn. eapply ty_capbnd_or.
    + exact (@IHty_capbnd G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx).
    + exact (@IHty_capbnd0 G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx).
  - cbn. apply ty_capbnd_all.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section ViewpointSubst.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma viewpoint_adapt_subst : forall x G e Tf Tr G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0,
  G = G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2 ->
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  x0 \notin (dom e \u fv_env e) -> z <> x0 -> x <> x0 ->
  ty_var typing_mode (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)) objctx_empty e z
    (subst_var x0 z S0) ->
  viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x G objctx_empty e Tf Tr ->
  viewpoint_adapt typing_mode x (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)) objctx_empty e
    (subst_var x0 z Tf) (subst_var x0 z Tr).
Proof.
  intros x G e Tf Tr G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 Heq Hdom He Hzx Hxne Hx H. subst G.
  unfold viewpoint_adapt in *. destruct (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' typing_mode); cbn in *.
  - subst Tr. reflexivity.
  - inversion H as [C T Tstrip Tcap Hi Hc]; subst Tf Tr.
    rewrite <- H2 in H1.
    cbn. rewrite (classicT_r (P := x = x0) Hxne). cbn.
    eapply viewpoint_adapt_cap_strip_combine.
    + exact (proj2 (proj2 (@var_sub_incap_subst_mut typing_mode))
               (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) objctx_empty e Hc Tstrip0 H0
               G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx).
    + assert (Hcapp : @ty_capbnd typing_mode C (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2))
                        objctx_empty e (subst_var x0 z Hc) (subst_var x0 z Tcap0))
        by (exact (@ty_capbnd_subst typing_mode C
               (G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0 §& G2) objctx_empty e Hc Tcap0 H1
               G1 G2 x0 z S0 vk0 eq_refl Hdom He Hzx Hx)).
      rewrite H2 in Hcapp. cbn in Hcapp. exact Hcapp.
Qed.

End ViewpointSubst.


Section TrmSubstCtx.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma notin_fv_trm_let_l : forall (t1 t2:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (trm_let t1 t2) -> x \notin fv t1.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_trm_let_r : forall (t1 t2:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (trm_let t1 t2) -> x \notin fv t2.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_trm_apply_l : forall (a b:avar) x,
  x \notin fv (trm_apply a b) -> x \notin fv a.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_trm_apply_r : forall (a b:avar) x,
  x \notin fv (trm_apply a b) -> x \notin fv b.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_trm_read : forall (a:avar) m x,
  x \notin fv (trm_read a m) -> x \notin fv a.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. exact H. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_trm_write_l : forall (a b:avar) m x,
  x \notin fv (trm_write a m b) -> x \notin fv a.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_trm_write_r : forall (a b:avar) m x,
  x \notin fv (trm_write a m b) -> x \notin fv b.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_trm_call_l : forall (a b:avar) m x,
  x \notin fv (trm_call a m b) -> x \notin fv a.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_trm_call_r : forall (a b:avar) m x,
  x \notin fv (trm_call a m b) -> x \notin fv b.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. rewrite notin_union in H. tauto. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_def_fld : forall a (v:avar) x,
  x \notin fv (def_fld a v) -> x \notin fv v.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. exact H. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_def_met : forall m (t:trm) x,
  x \notin fv (def_met m t) -> x \notin fv t.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. exact H. Qed.
Lemma notin_fv_def_typ : forall l (T:typ) x,
  x \notin fv (def_typ l T) -> x \notin fv T.
Proof. intros. cbn in H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma subst_var_neq_avar : forall x0 z (a:avar), a <> avar_f x0 ->
  subst_var x0 z a = a.
Proof.
  intros. destruct a as [i|v]; cbn.
  - reflexivity.
  - assert (Hv : v <> x0) by (intro E; apply H; rewrite E; reflexivity).
    cbn. rewrite (classicT_r (P := v = x0) Hv). reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma ctx_vis_remove_mid : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk (S:typ) x,
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x0 / vk ~ S) §& G2) x -> x <> x0 -> ctx_vis (G1 §& G2) x.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2. induction G2 as [|G2 IH y vk2 T2|G2 IH|G2 IH];
    intros x0 vk S x Hv Hne; cbn in *.
  - inversion Hv as [v0 vk0 t0 G0|v0 v2 vk0 t0 G0 Hneq Hvis]; subst; cbn in *.
    + exfalso. apply Hne; reflexivity.
    + exact Hvis.
  - inversion Hv as [v0 vk0 t0 G0|v0 v2 vk0 t0 G0 Hneq Hvis]; subst; cbn.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [exact Hneq|exact (IH x0 vk S x Hvis Hne)].
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_target : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 z x,
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x0 / v_let ~ typ_top) §& G2) x ->
  x <> x0 -> ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)) x.
Proof.
  intros. apply (@ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq (G1 §& G2) x x0 z H0).
  apply (@ctx_vis_remove_mid G1 G2 x0 v_let typ_top x H H0).
Qed.

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_target_any : forall (G1 G2:ctx) x0 vk (S:typ) z x,
  ctx_vis ((G1 § x0 / vk ~ S) §& G2) x ->
  x <> x0 -> ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)) x.
Proof.
  intros. apply (@ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq (G1 §& G2) x x0 z H0).
  apply (@ctx_vis_remove_mid G1 G2 x0 vk S x H H0).
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_var_same : forall G e T, subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T T.
Proof. intros. apply subtyp_refl. Qed.

End TrmSubstCtx.

Section ObjCtxSubst.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Substituting the dropped context binder in a context with an object
    context splits into types-only context substitution plus [subst_objctx]. *)

Lemma ctx_obj_subst_ctx : forall (G1 G2:ctx) (Go:objctx) x0 z,
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2 §§& Go) =
  subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2) §§& subst_objctx x0 z Go.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 Go x0 z Hd. destruct Go as [|x T|y T]; cbn in Hd.
  - reflexivity.
  - unfold ctx_obj. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq T x0 z x 0).
    + reflexivity.
    + intro E. apply Hd. rewrite in_singleton. symmetry. exact E.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

(** Visibility transport when the source variable is not the removed binder. *)

Lemma ctx_vis_subst_ctx_obj_neq : forall (G1 G2:ctx) (Go:objctx)
    x0 vk0 (S0:typ) x z,
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go ->
  x <> x0 ->
  ctx_vis (((G1 § x0 / vk0 ~ S0) §& G2) §§& Go) x ->
  ctx_vis (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2) §§& subst_objctx x0 z Go) x.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 Go x0 vk0 S0 x z Hd HdGo Hxne Hv.
  destruct Go as [|v T|y T]; cbn in *.
  - apply (@ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq (G1 §& G2) x x0 z Hxne).
    apply (@ctx_vis_remove_mid G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x Hv Hxne).
  - inversion Hv as [v0 vk1 t0 G0|v0 v2 vk1 t0 G0 Hneq Hvis]; subst; cbn.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; [ exact Hneq | ].
      apply (@ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq (G1 §& G2) x x0 z Hxne).
      apply (@ctx_vis_remove_mid G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x Hvis Hxne).
  - apply (@ctx_vis_subst_ctx_neq (G1 §& G2) x x0 z Hxne).
    apply (@ctx_vis_remove_mid G1 G2 x0 vk0 S0 x Hv Hxne).
Qed.

End ObjCtxSubst.

Section CtxObjMetSubst.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma subst_ctx_vis_hide : forall G x0 z,
  subst_ctx x0 z (vis_hide typing_mode G) = vis_hide typing_mode (subst_ctx x0 z G).
Proof. intros. destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_ctx_met : forall G xz TZ xc TC x0 z,
  xz <> x0 ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC) =
  ctx_met (subst_ctx x0 z G) xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc (subst_var x0 z TC).
Proof.
  intros. repeat rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
  rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq TC x0 z xz 0); [reflexivity|exact H].
Qed.

Lemma subst_ctx_ctx_met_refined : forall G xz TZ xc TC TC2 x0 z,
  xz <> x0 ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2) =
  ctx_met_refined (subst_ctx x0 z G) xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc
    (subst_var x0 z TC) (subst_var x0 z TC2).
Proof.
  intros. repeat rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
  repeat rewrite subst_typ_and.
  rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq TC x0 z xz 0); [reflexivity|exact H].
Qed.


Lemma subst_ctx_ctx_met_refined_heap : forall G xz TZ xc TC y T x0 z,
  xz <> x0 -> xc <> x0 ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T) =
  ctx_met_refined_heap (subst_ctx x0 z G) xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc
    (subst_var x0 z TC) (subst_var x0 z y) (subst_var x0 z T).
Proof.
  intros. repeat rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
  repeat rewrite subst_typ_and.
  rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq TC x0 z xz 0); [|exact H].
  repeat rewrite (@typ_subst_open_commut T x0 z).
  rewrite (@subst_var_neq x0 z xc H0).
  reflexivity.
Qed.


End CtxObjMetSubst.

Section CtxObjMetCombined.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma subst_ctx_ctx_obj_met : forall G Go xz TZ xc TC x0 z,
  xz <> x0 -> xc <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G Go xz TZ xc TC) =

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapUpdate.
Require Import Defs_lemmas.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * A positional witness for the field updated by [defs_update].

    Given a well-typed definition list and an update at field label [a], we
    return the actual stored field variable [v] and its actual declared type
    [Tf], together with the implication that *any* typing of the new field at
    that same [Tf] re-types the whole updated list.  This avoids quantifying
    over all possible typings of the old field. *)

Lemma defs_update_typing_witness : forall (ds:defs) a (y:var) ds',
  defs_update ds a y ds' ->
  forall G Go e T ls,
    @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
    record_typ T ls ->
    label_fld a \in ls ->
    exists (v:var) Tf,
      defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
      @ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f v)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf) /\
      (@ty_def typing_mode G Go e (def_fld a (avar_f y)) (dec_fld a Tf Tf) ->
       @ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds' T).
Proof.
  intros ds a y ds' Hupd.
  induction Hupd as [ds0 a0 t x0|ds0 d a0 x0 ds0' Hupd0 IH Hneq];
    intros G Go e T ls Hty Hrec Hlab.
  - (* replace the head field *)
    inversion Hty as [G1 Go1 e1 d1 D1 Hdef1
                    |G1 Go1 e1 ds1 d1 T1 D1 Hty1 Hdef1 Hhasnt1]; subst.
    + (* singleton tail (ds0 = defs_nil); witness is the head *)
      destruct t as [i|v].
      * inversion Hdef1.
      * inversion Hdef1; subst.
        exists v, T. split; [apply defs_has_cons_here|].
        split; [exact Hdef1|].
        intros Hnewdef. eapply ty_defs_one. exact Hnewdef.
    + (* nonempty tail; witness is the head *)
      destruct t as [i|v].
      * inversion Hdef1.
      * inversion Hdef1; subst.
        exists v, T. split; [apply defs_has_cons_here|].
        split; [exact Hdef1|].
        intros Hnewdef. eapply ty_defs_cons; [exact Hty1|exact Hnewdef|exact Hhasnt1].
  - (* update inside the tail *)
    inversion Hty as [G1 Go1 e1 d1 D1 Hdef1
                    |G1 Go1 e1 ds1 d1 T1 D1 Hty1 Hdef1 Hhasnt1]; subst.
    + (* an empty tail cannot be updated *)
      inversion Hupd0.
    + destruct (record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as
        [ls' [l' [Hls [Hrec' [Hl' Hnot]]]]].
      assert (Ha : label_fld a0 \in ls').
      { subst ls. rewrite in_union in Hlab. destruct Hlab as [Hin|Hin].
        - exact Hin.
        - rewrite in_singleton in Hin.
          exfalso.
          assert (Hld : label_of d = label_of D1).
          { eapply ty_def_label. exact Hdef1. }
          assert (Hinl' : label_of D1 \in ls').
          { rewrite Hl'. rewrite <- Hin. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity. }
          destruct (proj2 (ty_defs_record Hty1) ls' Hrec' (label_of D1) Hinl')
            as [d' [Hhas' Heq']].
          eapply (@defs_hasnt_has_contra ds0 d' (label_of D1)).
          + rewrite <- Hld. exact Hhasnt1.
          + exact Hhas'.
          + exact Heq'. }
      destruct (IH G Go e T1 ls' Hty1 Hrec' Ha)
        as [v [Tf [Hhas [Hold Hcont]]]].
      exists v, Tf. split.
      * eapply defs_has_cons_other.
        -- intro E. apply Hneq. rewrite E.
           eapply ty_def_label. exact Hdef1.
        -- exact Hhas.
      * split; [exact Hold|].
        intros Hnewdef.
        eapply ty_defs_cons.
        -- eapply Hcont. exact Hnewdef.
        -- exact Hdef1.
        -- eapply defs_update_hasnt_neq; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4 Canonical5 Canonical_static Defs_label_typing.

Opaque label_of.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Typed records: the exact shape produced by [ty_defs].

    [record_dec] permits [dec_typ A bot T] (constructor [rd_typb]) and thus
    records whose type-member bounds are inconsistent.  The type of a
    well-typed sequence of definitions never uses [rd_typb]: [ty_def_typ]
    produces equal bounds, and [ty_def_fld] equal bounds.  We record this
    stronger structure, which is what rules out phantom field labels. *)

Inductive typed_dec : dec -> Prop :=
| td_typ : forall A T,
    typed_dec (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T T)
| td_fld : forall a T,
    typed_dec (dec_fld a T T)
| td_met : forall m TC TZ TR,
    typed_dec (dec_met m TC TZ TR).

Inductive typed_record_typ : typ -> fset label -> Prop :=
| trt_one : forall D l,
    typed_dec D ->
    l = label_of D ->
    typed_record_typ (typ_rcd D) \{l}
| trt_cons : forall T ls D l,
    typed_record_typ T ls ->
    typed_dec D ->
    l = label_of D ->
    l \notin ls ->
    typed_record_typ (typ_and T (typ_rcd D)) (ls \u \{l}).

Definition typed_record_type T := exists ls, typed_record_typ T ls.

Lemma typed_dec_record_dec : forall D,
  typed_dec D -> record_dec D.
Proof.
  intros D H. dependent destruction H.
  - apply rd_typ.
  - apply rd_fld.
  - apply rd_met.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_record_typ : forall T ls,
  typed_record_typ T ls -> record_typ T ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls H. induction H.
  - eapply rt_one; [apply typed_dec_record_dec; eassumption|assumption].
  - refine (rt_cons _ _ _ _).
    + exact IHtyped_record_typ.
    + apply typed_dec_record_dec. assumption.
    + assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_labels_eq : forall T ls1 ls2,
  typed_record_typ T ls1 -> typed_record_typ T ls2 -> ls1 = ls2.
Proof.
  intros T ls1 ls2 H1. generalize dependent ls2.
  induction H1 as [D l Htd Heq | T ls D l Hrec IH Htd Heq Hnot];
    intros ls2 Hrec2.
  - inversion Hrec2; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - inversion Hrec2; subst; try discriminate.
    assert (E : ls = ls0) by (apply IH; assumption). subst ls0. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** A record component with a given label can be recovered from the label
    set, and every component declaration is [typed_dec]. *)

Lemma typed_record_typ_label_dec : forall T ls l,
  typed_record_typ T ls -> l \in ls ->
  exists D, typed_dec D /\ l = label_of D.
Proof.
  intros T ls l H. induction H; intros Hin.
  - rewrite in_singleton in Hin. subst l. exists D. split; assumption.
  - rewrite in_union in Hin. destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + destruct (IHtyped_record_typ Hin) as [D' [Htd Heq]].
      exists D'. split; assumption.
    + rewrite in_singleton in Hin. subst l. exists D. split; assumption.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section TypedDefs.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma ty_def_typed_dec : forall G Go e (d:def) D,
  ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D -> typed_dec D.
Proof.
  intros G Go e d D H. induction H.
  - apply td_typ.
  - apply td_fld.
  - apply td_met.
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_typed_record : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T ->
  exists ls, typed_record_typ T ls.
Proof.
  intros G Go e ds T Hty.
  induction Hty as [G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef
                  | G0 Go0 e0 ds0 d T0 D Hty IH Hdef Hhasnt].
  - exists (singleton (label_of D)).
    eapply trt_one; [eapply ty_def_typed_dec; exact Hdef|reflexivity].
  - destruct IH as [ls' Hrec'].
    assert (Hlab : label_of d = label_of D) by (eapply ty_def_label; exact Hdef).
    assert (Hnotin : label_of D \notin ls').
    { intro Hl.
      destruct ((proj2 (ty_defs_record Hty)) ls'
                  (typed_record_typ_record_typ Hrec') (label_of D) Hl)
        as [d' [Hhas Heq]].
      assert (E : label_of d' = label_of d).
      { rewrite Heq. rewrite <- Hlab. reflexivity. }
      eapply (@defs_hasnt_has_contra ds0 d' (label_of d));
        [exact Hhasnt|exact Hhas|exact E]. }
    exists (ls' \u singleton (label_of D)).
    eapply trt_cons; [exact Hrec'|eapply ty_def_typed_dec; exact Hdef|reflexivity|exact Hnotin].
Qed.

Lemma ty_defs_typed_record_type : forall G Go e (ds:defs) T,
  ty_defs typing_mode G Go e ds T -> typed_record_type T.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (ty_defs_typed_record H) as [ls Hls]. eexists. exact Hls.
Qed.

End TypedDefs.

Section TypedWeaken.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Typed records are closed under the structural record operations we need. *)

Lemma typed_dec_open : forall D x,
  typed_dec D -> typed_dec (open_rec_dec 0 x D).
Proof.
  intros D x H. dependent destruction H; cbn; constructor.
Qed.

Lemma label_of_open_dec : forall D x,
  typed_dec D -> label_of (open_rec_dec 0 x D) = label_of D.
Proof.
  intros D x H. dependent destruction H; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_open : forall T ls x,
  typed_record_typ T ls -> typed_record_typ (open_rec 0 x T) ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls x H. induction H as [D l Htd Heq | T ls D l Hrec IH Htd Heq Hnot].
  - eapply trt_one.
    + apply typed_dec_open. exact Htd.
    + change (l = label_of (open_rec_dec 0 x D)).
      rewrite (label_of_open_dec x Htd). exact Heq.
  - eapply trt_cons.
    + exact IH.
    + apply typed_dec_open. exact Htd.
    + change (l = label_of (open_rec_dec 0 x D)).
      rewrite (label_of_open_dec x Htd). exact Heq.
    + exact Hnot.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_type_open : forall T x,
  typed_record_type T -> typed_record_type (open x T).
Proof.
  intros T x [ls H]. exists ls. eapply typed_record_typ_open; exact H.
Qed.

End TypedWeaken.

(** * Why the raw typed-record inversion is not assumed context-free.

    The statement

      typed_record_typ U ls -> subtyp G e U (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T)) ->
====RECORDS
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext Defs Defs_lemmas.

(** * Record label structure and subtyping *)

Lemma record_typ_labels_eq : forall (T:typ) ls1 ls2,
  record_typ T ls1 -> record_typ T ls2 -> ls1 = ls2.
Proof.
  intros T ls1 ls2 H1. generalize dependent ls2. induction H1; intros ls2 H2r.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate; reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion H2r; subst; try discriminate.
    assert (Hls : ls = ls0) by (apply IHrecord_typ; assumption).
    subst ls0. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_typ_record_has_label : forall (T:typ) ls D,
  record_typ T ls -> record_has T D -> label_of D \in ls.
Proof.
  intros T ls D Hrec. generalize dependent D. induction Hrec; intros Dh Hhas.
  - (* rt_one *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - (* rt_cons *) inversion Hhas; subst; try discriminate.
    + (* andl *) rewrite in_union. left. apply IHHrec. assumption.
    + (* andr *) rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton.
      inversion H5; subst; try discriminate. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** The unrestricted statement
    [record_typ T ls -> T <: typ_rcd D -> record_dec D -> label_of D \in ls]
    is FALSE in the raw subtyping system, because [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2]
    can transport a label out of a type-member bound without the label being
    structurally present in the source record type.  We record an explicit
    counterexample. *)

Section Counterexample.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).
Variables (A: typ_normal_label) (a: fld_label) (x y: var).

Definition ce_target : typ := typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
Definition ce_source : typ := typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) typ_bot ce_target).
Definition ce_G : ctx := ctx_push ctx_empty x v_ref (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) ce_source ce_target)).

Lemma ce_typing : ce_G⁏empty ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) ce_source ce_target).
Proof. eapply ty_var_var. eapply ctx_binds_e. Qed.

Lemma ce_open_source : (ce_source /[-> y]) = ce_source.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ce_open_target : (ce_target /[-> y]) = ce_target.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ce_subtyp : subtyp typing_mode ce_G objctx_empty empty ce_source ce_target.
Proof.
  eapply subtyp_trans with (T := typ_sel (avar_f x) (typ_label_normal A) (avar_f y)).
  - eapply subtyp_sel2 with (S := ce_source) (T := ce_target). apply ce_typing.
  - eapply subtyp_sel1 with (S := ce_source) (T := ce_target). apply ce_typing.
Qed.

Lemma ce_record_source : record_typ ce_source (singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))).
Proof.
  eapply rt_one. apply rd_typb. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ce_record_dec_target : record_dec (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
Proof. apply rd_fld. Qed.

Lemma label_fld_not_in_source :
  ~ (label_fld a \in singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))).
Proof.
  rewrite in_singleton. intro E. inversion E.
Qed.

Lemma subtyp_record_has_false :
  exists (G:ctx) (e:renv) (T:typ) (ls:fset label) (D:dec),
    record_typ T ls /\ subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T (typ_rcd D) /\
    record_dec D /\ ~ (label_of D \in ls).
Proof.
  exists ce_G, (empty : renv), ce_source, (singleton (label_typ (typ_label_normal A))),
         (dec_fld a typ_bot typ_bot).
  split; [apply ce_record_source|]. split; [apply ce_subtyp|]. split.
  - apply ce_record_dec_target.
  - cbn. apply label_fld_not_in_source.
Qed.

End Counterexample.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence.

Section OVars.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** [ovars k xs T] opens the bound variables [k], [k+1], ... with the
    variables in [xs].  It is the structural version of [open_rec_vars]. *)

Fixpoint ovars_avar (k:nat) (xs:list var) (a:avar) : avar :=
  match xs with
  | nil => a
  | cons x xs => ovars_avar (S k) xs (open_rec k x a)
  end.

Fixpoint ovars_typ (k:nat) (xs:list var) (T:typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (ovars_dec k xs D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => typ_and (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ k xs T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2 => typ_or (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ k xs T2)
  | typ_sel a l b => typ_sel (ovars_avar k xs a) l (ovars_avar k xs b)
  | typ_bnd T => typ_bnd (ovars_typ (S k) xs T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2 => typ_fun (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ (S k) xs T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end
with ovars_dec (k:nat) (xs:list var) (D:dec) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ A T1 T2 => dec_typ A (ovars_typ (S k) xs T1) (ovars_typ (S k) xs T2)
  | dec_fld a T1 T2 => dec_fld a (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ k xs T2)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
      dec_met m (ovars_typ (S k) xs TC) (ovars_typ k xs TZ) (ovars_typ (S (S k)) xs TR)
  end.

Lemma ovars_avar_nil : forall k a, ovars_avar k nil a = a.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ovars_avar_cons : forall k x xs a,
  ovars_avar k (x::xs) a = ovars_avar (S k) xs (open_rec k x a).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ovars_nil_mut :
  (forall T, forall k, ovars_typ k nil T = T)
  /\ (forall D, forall k, ovars_dec k nil D = D).

  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros; reflexivity.
  - intros D IH k. cbn. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - intros; cbn; repeat rewrite <- ?H; eauto.
  - intros; cbn; repeat rewrite <- ?H; eauto.

  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 k. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2. reflexivity.
  - intros l T1 IH1 T2 IH2 T3 IH3 k. cbn. rewrite IH1, IH2, IH3. reflexivity.
