Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref ConfigNotations.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Record_subtyp Canonical Canonical2 Canonical3 Canonical4.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Selector-free subtyping.

    [subtyp_nosel] is the fragment of subtyping consisting of the rules that
    are available in the function modes and that do not use the selector
    rules [subtyp_sel1]/[subtyp_sel2].  In the function modes the additional
    top/nocap/mutability rules are disabled; the no-capability rules are
    included because [subtyp_nocap_fun] is enabled. *)

Inductive subtyp_nosel : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ns_top : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T typ_top
| ns_bot : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_bot T
| ns_refl : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e T T
| ns_trans : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U
| ns_and11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) T
| ns_and12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_and T U) U
| ns_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S U ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S (typ_and T U)
| ns_or11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e T (typ_or T U)
| ns_or12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e U (typ_or T U)
| ns_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_nosel G e S T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U T ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_or S U) T
| ns_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e U1 U2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ns_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, subtyp_nosel G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ns_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ns_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    subtyp_nosel G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      subtyp_nosel (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
     subtyp_nosel (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    subtyp_nosel G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ns_tyq : forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    subtyp_nosel G e T1 T2
| ns_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ A (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ns_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    subtyp_nosel G e
      (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ns_nocap_bnd : forall G e T,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ns_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ns_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ns_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_nosel G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
.

Lemma subtyp_nosel_sound : forall G e S T,
  subtyp_nosel G e S T -> subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e S T.
Proof.
  intros G e S T H. induction H.
  - apply subtyp_top.
  - apply subtyp_bot.
  - apply subtyp_refl.
  - eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_and11.
  - apply subtyp_and12.
  - eapply subtyp_and2; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_or11.
  - apply subtyp_or12.
  - eapply subtyp_or2; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fld; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_typ; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_fun; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_met; eassumption.
  - eapply subtyp_tyq; eassumption.
  - apply subtyp_typ_and.
  - apply subtyp_dist.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_bnd.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_typ.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_fld.
  - apply subtyp_nocap_met.
  - eapply subtyp_nocap_fun; eassumption.
Qed.

(** * Two context-free "safe source" predicates. *)

Inductive NoFun : typ -> Prop :=
| nf_top : NoFun typ_top
| nf_bnd : forall T, NoFun (typ_bnd T)
| nf_and : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_and T U)
| nf_or_l : forall T U, NoFun T -> NoFun (typ_or T U)
| nf_or_r : forall T U, NoFun U -> NoFun (typ_or T U).

Inductive NoField : typ -> Prop :=
| nfield_top : NoField typ_top
| nfield_bnd : forall T, NoField (typ_bnd T)
| nfield_fun : forall S T, NoField (typ_fun S T)
| nfield_and : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField U -> NoField (typ_and T U)
| nfield_or_l : forall T U, NoField T -> NoField (typ_or T U)
| nfield_or_r : forall T U, NoField U -> NoField (typ_or T U).

Lemma NoFun_rcd_false : forall D, NoFun (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_fun_false : forall S T, NoFun (typ_fun S T) -> False.
Proof. intros S T H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_nocap_false : NoFun typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_sel_false : forall x A y, NoFun (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoFun_bot_false : NoFun typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma NoField_rcd_false : forall D, NoField (typ_rcd D) -> False.
Proof. intros D H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_nocap_false : NoField typ_nocap -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_sel_false : forall x A y, NoField (typ_sel x A y) -> False.
Proof. intros x A y H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma NoField_bot_false : NoField typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intro H. inversion H. Qed.

(** * Equivalence preserves both safety predicates. *)

Lemma NoFun_equiv : forall e T U,
  NoFun T -> typing_equiv e T U -> NoFun U.
Proof.
  intros e T U Hnf Heq. change (tyq_typ e T U) in Heq.
  revert Hnf. induction Heq; intros Hnf.
  - (* nulary *) exact Hnf.
  - (* andor *) dependent destruction H.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nf_and, nf_or_l, nf_or_r.
    + inversion Hnf; subst; eauto using nf_and, nf_or_l, nf_or_r.
  - (* fun *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* fld *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* typ *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel normal *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* sel *) inversion Hnf.
  - (* bnd *) apply nf_bnd.
  - (* met *) inversion Hnf.
Qed.

(** * OpenTwice for avar/typ/dec/trm/lit/def/defs *)

Lemma avar_open_b_eq : forall i n x, n = i -> open_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_f x.
Proof. intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l H). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_b_neq : forall i n x, n <> i -> open_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof. intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_r H). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_f : forall v n x, open_rec n x (avar_f v) = avar_f v.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_twice : forall (a:avar) n x y,
  open_rec n y (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n x a.
Proof.
  intros a n x y. destruct a as [i|v].
  - destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x E). cbn. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x N). rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n y N). reflexivity.
  - cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext Equivalence.
Require Import Selector_sound Record_subtyp.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * The structural core of subtyping (no [trans], no selectors, no [tyq]).

    This is the fragment in which field/met label preservation for typed
    records is purely structural and can be proved by rule induction.  The
    remaining task for the full statement is to normalize selector/trans
    chains to this core; that normalization is the selector-elimination
    invariant isolated by the parent development. *)

Inductive subtyp_struct : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ss_top : forall G e T,
    subtyp_struct G e T typ_top
| ss_bot : forall G e T,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_bot T
| ss_refl : forall G e T,
    subtyp_struct G e T T
| ss_and11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_and T U) T
| ss_and12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_and T U) U
| ss_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_struct G e S T ->
    subtyp_struct G e S U ->
    subtyp_struct G e S (typ_and T U)
| ss_or11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_struct G e T (typ_or T U)
| ss_or12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_struct G e U (typ_or T U)
| ss_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_struct G e S T ->
    subtyp_struct G e U T ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_or S U) T
| ss_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    subtyp_struct G e T1 T2 ->
    subtyp_struct G e U1 U2 ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ss_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, subtyp_struct G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, subtyp_struct G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ss_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_struct G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_struct (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ss_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    subtyp_struct G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_struct (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
     subtyp_struct (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e
       (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ss_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    subtyp_struct G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ss_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    subtyp_struct G e
      (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ss_nocap_bnd : forall G e T,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ss_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ss_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ss_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ss_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
.

(** Inversion of a typed record into its top-level right-nested shape. *)

Lemma typed_record_typ_rcd_inv : forall D ls,
  typed_record_typ (typ_rcd D) ls ->
  ls = singleton (label_of D) /\ typed_dec D.
Proof.
  intros D ls H. inversion H; subst. split; reflexivity || assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_and_inv : forall T U ls,
  typed_record_typ (typ_and T U) ls ->
  exists lsT l,
    ls = lsT \u singleton l /\
    typed_record_typ T lsT /\
    l = label_of U /\
    typed_dec U /\
    l \notin lsT.
Proof.
  intros T U ls H. inversion H; subst.
  exists ls0, (label_of U). repeat split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_label_mem_mono : forall T ls1 ls2,
  typed_record_typ T ls1 -> ls1 = ls2 -> forall l, l \in ls1 -> l \in ls2.
Proof. intros. subst. exact H0. Qed.

(** Structural label preservation for a field target. *)

Lemma subtyp_struct_fld_label : forall G e S T,
  subtyp_struct G e S T ->
  forall ls, typed_record_typ S ls ->
  forall a U V, T = typ_rcd (dec_fld a U V) -> label_fld a \in ls.
Proof.
  intros G e S T H. induction H; intros ls Hrec a U V Heq.
  - discriminate.
  - inversion Hrec.
  - (* refl *) subst T. subst S in Hrec.
    destruct (typed_record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) as [Hls Htd].
    subst ls. rewrite in_singleton.
    inversion Heq; subst.
    eapply typed_record_typ_label_dec; eassumption || reflexivity.
  - (* and11 *) destruct (typed_record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as
      [lsT [l [Hls [HrecT [Hl Htd Hnot]]]]].
    subst ls. rewrite in_union.
    left. eapply IHsubtyp_struct; eassumption.
  - (* and12 *) destruct (typed_record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as
      [lsT [l [Hls [HrecT [Hl Htd Hnot]]]]].
    subst ls. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton.
    inversion Heq; subst.
    eapply typed_record_typ_label_dec; eassumption || reflexivity.
  - (* and2 *) discriminate.
  - (* or11 *) discriminate.
  - (* or12 *) discriminate.
  - (* or2 *) inversion Hrec.
  - (* fld *) subst S in Hrec.
    destruct (typed_record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) as [Hls Htd].
    subst ls. rewrite in_singleton.
    inversion Heq; subst. reflexivity.
  - (* typ *) discriminate.
  - (* fun *) discriminate.
  - (* met *) discriminate.
  - (* typ_and *) discriminate.
  - (* dist *) discriminate.
  - (* nocap_bnd *) inversion Hrec.
  - (* nocap_typ *) inversion Hrec.
  - (* nocap_fld *) inversion Hrec.
  - (* nocap_met *) inversion Hrec.
  - (* nocap_fun *) inversion Hrec.
Qed.

(** Structural label preservation for a method target. *)

Lemma subtyp_struct_met_label : forall G e S T,
  subtyp_struct G e S T ->
  forall ls, typed_record_typ S ls ->
  forall m TC TZ TR, T = typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) -> label_met m \in ls.
Proof.
  intros G e S T H. induction H; intros ls Hrec m TC TZ TR Heq.
  - discriminate.
  - inversion Hrec.
  - subst T. subst S in Hrec.
    destruct (typed_record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) as [Hls Htd].
    subst ls. rewrite in_singleton.
    inversion Heq; subst.
    eapply typed_record_typ_label_dec; eassumption || reflexivity.
  - destruct (typed_record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as
      [lsT [l [Hls [HrecT [Hl Htd Hnot]]]]].
    subst ls. rewrite in_union.
    left. eapply IHsubtyp_struct; eassumption.
  - destruct (typed_record_typ_and_inv Hrec) as
      [lsT [l [Hls [HrecT [Hl Htd Hnot]]]]].
    subst ls. rewrite in_union. right. rewrite in_singleton.
    inversion Heq; subst.
    eapply typed_record_typ_label_dec; eassumption || reflexivity.
  - discriminate.
  - discriminate.
  - discriminate.
  - inversion Hrec.
  - (* fld *) inversion Heq.
  - (* typ *) discriminate.
  - (* fun *) discriminate.
  - (* met *) subst S in Hrec.
    destruct (typed_record_typ_rcd_inv Hrec) as [Hls Htd].
    subst ls. rewrite in_singleton.
    inversion Heq; subst. reflexivity.
  - (* typ_and *) discriminate.
  - (* dist *) discriminate.
  - inversion Hrec.
  - inversion Hrec.
  - inversion Hrec.
  - inversion Hrec.
  - inversion Hrec.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext Equivalence.
Require Import Selector_sound Record_subtyp Indep.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * The structural core of subtyping (no [trans], no selectors, no [tyq]).

    This is the fragment in which field/met label preservation for typed
    records is purely structural and can be proved by rule induction.  The
    remaining task for the full statement is to normalize selector/trans
    chains to this core; that normalization is the selector-elimination
    invariant isolated by the parent development. *)

Inductive subtyp_struct : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ss_top : forall G e T,
    subtyp_struct G e T typ_top
| ss_bot : forall G e T,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_bot T
| ss_refl : forall G e T,
    subtyp_struct G e T T
| ss_and11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_and T U) T
| ss_and12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_and T U) U
| ss_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_struct G e S T ->
    subtyp_struct G e S U ->
    subtyp_struct G e S (typ_and T U)
| ss_or11 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_struct G e T (typ_or T U)
| ss_or12 : forall G e T U,
    subtyp_struct G e U (typ_or T U)
| ss_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    subtyp_struct G e S T ->
    subtyp_struct G e U T ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_or S U) T
| ss_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    subtyp_struct G e T1 T2 ->
    subtyp_struct G e U1 U2 ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ss_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, subtyp_struct G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, subtyp_struct G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ss_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_struct G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_struct (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ss_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    subtyp_struct G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       subtyp_struct (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
     subtyp_struct (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e
       (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    subtyp_struct G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1))
                       (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ss_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    subtyp_struct G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ss_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    subtyp_struct G e
      (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ss_nocap_bnd : forall G e T,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ss_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ss_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ss_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ss_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    subtyp_struct G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
.

(** Inversion of a typed record into its top-level right-nested shape. *)

Lemma typed_record_typ_rcd_inv : forall D ls,
  typed_record_typ (typ_rcd D) ls ->
  ls = singleton (label_of D) /\ typed_dec D.
Proof.
  intros D ls H. inversion H; subst. split; reflexivity || assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typed_record_typ_and_inv : forall T U ls,
  typed_record_typ (typ_and T U) ls ->
  exists lsT D l,
    ls = lsT \u singleton l /\
    typed_record_typ T lsT /\
    U = typ_rcd D /\
    typed_dec D /\
    l = label_of D /\
    l \notin lsT.
Proof.
  intros T U ls H. inversion H; subst.
  exists ls0, D, (label_of D). repeat split; eassumption.

  intros T D0 D H.

(** ** Insertion-based weakening for ty_var / subtyp / ty_incap *)

Lemma ctx_push_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x vk T,
  (G1 §& G2) § x / vk ~ T = G1 §& (G2 § x / vk ~ T).
Proof.
  intros. change ((G1 §& G2) §& (x / vk ~ T) = G1 §& (G2 §& (x / vk ~ T))).
  rewrite <- ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ctx_met_empty : forall w x (TZ : typ) z (TC : typ),
  w <> x -> w <> z -> w \notin ctx_dom (ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC).
Proof.
  intros. cbn. repeat rewrite notin_union. repeat rewrite notin_singleton.
  split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_met_decomp : forall (G1 G2 : ctx) x (TZ : typ) z (TC : typ),
  ctx_met (G1 §& G2) x TZ z TC =
  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC).
Proof.
  intros. change (G1 §& G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC =
                  G1 §& (G2 §& ctx_met ctx_empty x TZ z TC)).
  rewrite ctx_concat_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma var_sub_incap_weaken_insert :
  (forall G Go e x T (H:ty_var typing_mode G Go e x T),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       ty_var typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e x T)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:subtyp typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       subtyp typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:ty_incap typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
       ty_incap typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U).
Proof.
  apply (@ts_mutind typing_mode
    (fun G Go e x T _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
         ty_var typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e x T)
    (fun G Go e T U _ => forall G1 G2 : ctx, G = G1 §& G2 ->
       forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom G1 -> y \notin ctx_dom G2 ->
         subtyp typing_mode (G1 § y / vk ~ S §& G2) Go e T U)
  - assumption.
  - rewrite notin_union in H. destruct H as [Hx HG].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hx. assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma var_sub_incap_weaken :
  (forall G Go e x T (H:ty_var typing_mode G Go e x T),
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
       ty_var typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e x T)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:subtyp typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
       subtyp typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e T U)
  /\ (forall G Go e T U (H:ty_incap typing_mode G Go e T U),
     forall y vk S, y \notin ctx_dom (G §§& Go) ->
       ty_incap typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ S) Go e T U).
Proof.
  destruct var_sub_incap_weaken_insert as [Hvar [Hsub Hinc]].
  split; [| split].
  - intros G Go e x T H y vk S Hn.
    refine (Hvar G Go e x T H G ctx_empty eq_refl y vk S _ _).

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Symmetry of type equivalence. *)

Lemma tyq_typ_sym : forall e (T U:typ), typing_equiv e T U -> typing_equiv e U T.
Proof.
  intros e T U H. induction H.
  - eapply tyq_typ_nulary. exact H.
  - eapply tyq_typ_andor; [exact H | exact IHtyq_typ | exact IHtyq_typ0].
  - eapply tyq_typ_fun.
    + exact IHtyq_typ.
    + intros x. apply H0.
  - eapply tyq_typ_fld; [exact IHtyq_typ | exact IHtyq_typ0].
  - eapply tyq_typ_typ.
    + intros x. apply H.
    + intros x. apply H0.
  - eapply tyq_typ_sel_normal. apply tyq_var_sym. exact H.
  - eapply tyq_typ_sel.
  - eapply tyq_typ_bnd. intros x. apply H.
  - eapply tyq_typ_met.
    + intros x. apply H.
    + exact IHtyq_typ.
    + intros x yy. apply H1.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

(** * The general retargeting statement is false.

    [ty_def_fld] always produces equal field bounds.  A type equivalence can
    change a field declaration into one with unequal bounds, and such a
    declaration cannot be produced by any [ty_def] rule.  Consequently the
    proposed [ty_def_tyq_retype]/[ty_defs_tyq_retype] is not provable. *)

Section Counterexample.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).
Variables (w y t z : var) (l : typ_normal_label) (a : fld_label).
Hypothesis Hwy : w <> y.

Definition ce_e : renv := empty & w ~ y.
Definition ce_T : typ := typ_sel (avar_f w) (typ_label_normal l) (avar_f z).
Definition ce_T' : typ := typ_sel (avar_f y) (typ_label_normal l) (avar_f z).
Definition ce_G : ctx := ctx_push ctx_empty t v_ref ce_T.
Definition ce_D : dec := dec_fld a ce_T ce_T.
Definition ce_D' : dec := dec_fld a ce_T ce_T'.

Lemma ce_tyq : typing_equiv ce_e (typ_rcd ce_D) (typ_rcd ce_D').
Proof.
  unfold ce_D ce_D'.
  eapply tyq_typ_fld.
  - eapply tyq_typ_sel.
  - eapply tyq_typ_sel_normal.
    apply tyq_var_binds.
    unfold ce_e. apply binds_push_eq.
Qed.

Lemma ce_ty_def : @ty_def typing_mode ce_G objctx_empty ce_e
                   (def_fld a (avar_f t)) ce_D.
Proof.
  unfold ce_D, ce_G.
  eapply ty_def_fld.
  - intro Hm. apply ctx_vis_e.
  - eapply ty_var_var. apply ctx_binds_e.
Qed.

Lemma ce_T_neq_T' : ce_T <> ce_T'.
Proof.
  unfold ce_T, ce_T'. intro H.
  apply Hwy. injection H as H1 H2. injection H1 as H3. exact H3.
Qed.

Lemma ce_no_retype : ~ @ty_def typing_mode ce_G objctx_empty ce_e
                       (def_fld a (avar_f t)) ce_D'.
Proof.
  intros H. inversion H; subst; try discriminate.
  (* the only possible shape is def_fld with equal bounds *)
  unfold ce_D' in *. cbn in *.
  assert (Heq : ce_T = ce_T').
  { injection H2 as E1 E2. exact E1. }
  exact (ce_T_neq_T' Heq).
Qed.

Lemma ce_no_defs : ~ @ty_defs typing_mode ce_G objctx_empty ce_e
                     (defs_cons defs_nil (def_fld a (avar_f t)))
                     (typ_rcd ce_D').
Proof.
  intros H. inversion H as [G0 Go0 e0 d D Hdef
                           |G0 Go0 e0 ds0 d T0 D Hty0 Hdef Hhasnt]; subst.
  - apply ce_no_retype. exact Hdef.
  - inversion Hty0.
Qed.

Lemma ty_def_tyq_retype_false :
  exists G Go e (d:def) D D',
    @ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D /\
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd D) (typ_rcd D') /\
    ~ @ty_def typing_mode G Go e d D'.
Proof.
  exists ce_G, objctx_empty, ce_e, (def_fld a (avar_f t)), ce_D, ce_D'.
  split; [exact ce_ty_def|]. split; [exact ce_tyq|exact ce_no_retype].
Qed.

End Counterexample.

End WithTypingMode.
EOF

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * A context relation that removes one binder [x0] and substitutes its type.

    The source context contains exactly one binding of [x0] (constructor
    [srr_pop]); every other binder keeps its name and has its type
    substituted.  The target context does not bind [x0].  The relation is
    closed under [ctx_hide]/[ctx_stop], which is the point: the source context
    may have [x0] buried under a [ctx_hide] (as in [vis_hide G] inside
    [ctx_obj_met]), so no syntactic decomposition is available. *)

Inductive subst_rel (x0 z:var) (S0:typ) : ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| srr_empty : subst_rel x0 z S0 ctx_empty ctx_empty
| srr_pop : forall C C' vk,
    subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 (C § x0 / vk ~ S0) C'
| srr_push : forall C C' y vk T,
    y <> x0 -> y <> z ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 (C § y / vk ~ T) (C' § y / vk ~ subst_var x0 z T)
| srr_hide : forall C C',
    subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 (ctx_hide C) (ctx_hide C')
| srr_stop : forall C C',
    subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 (ctx_stop C) (ctx_stop C').

Arguments subst_rel _ _ _ _ _.

(** The target of the basic decomposition [G = G1 § x0 ~ S0 §& G2]. *)
Lemma subst_rel_decomp : forall G1 G2 x0 z vk S0,
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  subst_rel x0 z S0 (G1 § x0 / vk ~ S0 §& G2)
    (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 z vk S0 Hd.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH y vk2 T|G2 IH|G2 IH].
  - cbn. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    eapply srr_pop. eapply srr_empty.
  - (* G2 = old G2 with a push; concatenation on the right *)
    cbn. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    eapply srr_push; [ | | exact IH ].
    + intro E. apply Hd. subst y. repeat rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + intro E. apply Hd. subst y. repeat rewrite in_union. left. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
  - cbn. eapply srr_hide. exact IH.
  - cbn. eapply srr_stop. exact IH.
Qed.

(** The specialized decomposition from the statement of [def_met_case]:
    [G = G1 § x0 ~ S0 §& G2], target [subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)]. *)
Lemma subst_rel_decomp' : forall G1 G2 x0 z vk S0,
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  subst_rel x0 z S0 (G1 § x0 / vk ~ S0 §& G2)
    (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)).
Proof. apply subst_rel_decomp. Qed.

(** Bindings transport, except for the removed variable [x0]. *)
Lemma ctx_binds_subst_rel : forall C C' x0 z S0 (x:var) T,
  subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
  x <> x0 ->
  ctx_binds x T C ->
  ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 z T) C'.
Proof.
  intros C C' x0 z S0 x T Hrel. induction Hrel as
    [|C C' vk Hrel IH |C C' y vk T0 Hyx0 Hyz Hrel IH |C C' Hrel IH |C C' Hrel IH];
    intros Hx Hb; cbn in *.
  - inversion Hb.
  - (* x0 popped: x is a different variable *)
    apply ctx_binds_n; [ exact Hx | ]. apply IH; exact Hb.
  - (* pushed y *)
    destruct (classicT (x = y)) as [E|N].
    + subst x. apply ctx_binds_e.
    + apply ctx_binds_n; [ exact N | ]. apply IH; [ exact Hx | exact Hb ].
      (* use the source binding below the push *)
      (* [inversion Hb] handled by destruct? *)
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis].
    all: subst.
    + (* impossible: top push in C'? C' is ctx_hide, source is ctx_hide so no top push *)
      idtac.
  - inversion Hb.
Admitted.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Context_lemmas Typing_subst Subst_extra Syntax_extra Subst_typing Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Var_subst_typing.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * A context relation removing one binder [x0] and substituting its type.

    [srr_pop] marks the unique occurrence of [x0] (whose binding type is
    [S0]); [srr_push] preserves every other binder and substitutes its type.
    The relation is closed under [ctx_hide]/[ctx_stop], so a binder buried
    under a [ctx_hide] (as in [vis_hide G]) can still be related without a
    syntactic decomposition.  We allow a pushed binder to have name [z]: the
    replacement variable then uses that very binding in the target context
    (this is what happens for the runtime variable in [open_body_at_bound]). *)

Inductive subst_rel (x0 z:var) (S0:typ) : ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| srr_empty : subst_rel x0 z S0 ctx_empty ctx_empty
| srr_pop : forall C C' vk,
    subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 (C § x0 / vk ~ S0) C'
| srr_push : forall C C' y vk T,
    y <> x0 ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 (C § y / vk ~ T) (C' § y / vk ~ subst_var x0 z T)
| srr_hide : forall C C',
    subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 (ctx_hide C) (ctx_hide C')
| srr_stop : forall C C',
    subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
    subst_rel x0 z S0 (ctx_stop C) (ctx_stop C').

Arguments subst_rel _ _ _ _ _.

(** Contexts without [x0] are related to their substituted version. *)
Lemma subst_rel_no_pop : forall C x0 z S0,
  x0 \notin ctx_dom C ->
  subst_rel x0 z S0 C (subst_ctx x0 z C).
Proof.
  intros C. induction C as [|C IH y vk T|C IH|C IH]; intros x0 z S0 Hnot.
  - cbn. eapply srr_empty.
  - cbn in Hnot. rewrite notin_union in Hnot. destruct Hnot as [Hnot Hnoty].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hnot. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    eapply srr_push; [ exact Hnot | eapply IH; exact Hnoty ].
  - cbn in Hnot. cbn. eapply srr_hide. eapply IH. exact Hnot.
  - cbn in Hnot. cbn. eapply srr_stop. eapply IH. exact Hnot.
Qed.

(** The basic decomposition [G1 § x0 ~ S0 §& G2]. *)
Lemma subst_rel_decomp : forall G1 G2 x0 z vk S0,
  x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  subst_rel x0 z S0 (G1 § x0 / vk ~ S0 §& G2)
    (subst_ctx x0 z (G1 §& G2)).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 x0 z vk S0 Hd.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH y vk2 T|G2 IH|G2 IH].
  - cbn. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    assert (HdG1 : x0 \notin ctx_dom G1)
      by (eapply notin_dom_concat_inv_l; exact Hd).
    eapply srr_pop. eapply subst_rel_no_pop. exact HdG1.
  - cbn. rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
    assert (Hd2 : x0 \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2))
      by (eapply notin_dom_concat_inv_r; exact Hd).
    eapply srr_push.
    + intro E. subst y. apply Hd. rewrite ctx_dom_push. rewrite in_union.
      right. rewrite in_singleton. reflexivity.
    + eapply IH. exact Hd2.
  - cbn. eapply srr_hide. eapply IH. exact Hd.
  - cbn. eapply srr_stop. eapply IH. exact Hd.
Qed.

(** The binding type of the unique [x0] occurrence. *)
Lemma ctx_binds_pop_inv : forall C C' x0 z S0 (x:var) T,
  subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
  ctx_binds x T C ->
  x = x0 -> T = S0.
Proof.
  intros C C' x0 z S0 x T Hrel. induction Hrel as
    [|C C' vk Hrel IH |C C' y vk T0 Hy Hrel IH |C C' Hrel IH |C C' Hrel IH];
    intros Hb Ex.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis]; subst.
    + reflexivity.
    + subst x. exfalso. apply Hneq. reflexivity.
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis]; subst.
    + subst x. exfalso. apply Hy. reflexivity.
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis]; subst.
    eapply IH; eassumption.
  - inversion Hb.
Qed.

(** Bindings other than [x0] transport through the relation. *)
Lemma ctx_binds_subst_rel : forall C C' x0 z S0 (x:var) T,
  subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->
  x <> x0 ->
  ctx_binds x T C ->
  ctx_binds x (subst_var x0 z T) C'.
Proof.
  intros C C' x0 z S0 x T Hrel. induction Hrel as
    [|C'0 vk Hrel IH |C'0 y vk T0 Hy Hrel IH |C'0 Hrel IH |C'0 Hrel IH];
    intros Hx Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis]; subst.
    + apply IH; assumption.
    + exact (@ctx_binds_n x x y vk T0 C'0 Hneq (IH Hx Hvis)).
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis]; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_e.
    + apply ctx_binds_n; [ exact Hneq | apply IH; assumption ].
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis]; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_hide. apply IH; assumption.
    + apply ctx_binds_hide. apply IH; assumption.
  - inversion Hb.
Qed.

(** Visibility other than [x0] transports through the relation. *)
Lemma ctx_vis_subst_rel : forall C C' x0 z S0 (x:var),
  subst_rel x0 z S0 C C' ->

Fixpoint collect_trm {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (t: trm) : C :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a       => (f a)
  | trm_read x m      => (f x)
  | trm_apply f' a      => comb (f f') (f a)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => comb (collect_trm df f comb t1) (collect_trm df f comb t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => comb (collect_lit df f comb l) (collect_trm df f comb t)
  | trm_write x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | trm_call x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  end with
collect_lit {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (l: lit) : C :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e  => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_trm df f comb e)
  | lit_obj T ds => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_defs df f comb ds)
  end with
collect_def {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (d: def) : C :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (collect df f comb T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (f v)
  | def_met _ t     => (collect_trm df f comb t)
  end with
collect_defs {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (ds : defs) : C  :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => df
  | defs_cons tl d   => comb (collect_defs df f comb tl) (collect_def df f comb d)
  end.

Instance TrmCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_trm.

Instance LitCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_lit.

Instance DefCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_def.

Instance DefsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_defs.

Fixpoint transform_trm (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (t : trm) (n : nat) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (f a n)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (f v n) m

Instance LitOpenable : Openable lit := open_rec_lit.

Instance DefOpenable : Openable def := open_rec_def.

Instance DefsOpenable : Openable defs := open_rec_defs.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a         => (fv a)
  | trm_read x m       => (fv x)
  | trm_apply f a       => (fv f) \u (fv a)
  | trm_let t1 t2     => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  | trm_lit l t       => (fv_lit l) \u (fv_trm t)
  | trm_write x m y     => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | trm_call x m y => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  end with
fv_lit (l: lit) : vars :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e    => (fv T) \u (fv_trm e)
  | lit_obj T ds => (fv T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  end with
fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (fv T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (fv v)
  | def_met _ t     => (fv_trm t)
  end with
fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end.

Instance TrmFreeVar : FreeVar trm := fv_trm.

Instance LitFreeVar : FreeVar lit := fv_lit.

Instance DefFreeVar : FreeVar def := fv_def.

Instance DefsFreeVar : FreeVar defs := fv_defs.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.

(** * TFree interaction with open *)

Lemma tfree_open_mut :
  (forall (t:trm) v, tfree_trm v t -> forall n x, tfree_trm v (open_rec n x t))
  /\ (forall (l:lit) v, tfree_lit v l -> forall n x, tfree_lit v (open_rec n x l))
  /\ (forall (d:def) v, tfree_def v d -> forall n x, tfree_def v (open_rec n x d))
  /\ (forall (ds:defs) v, tfree_defs v ds -> forall n x, tfree_defs v (open_rec n x ds)).
Proof.
  apply trm_mutind.
  - intros a v H n x. cbn. destruct a; cbn; inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_trm.
  - intros a m v H n x. cbn. destruct a; cbn; inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_trm.
  - intros a1 a2 v H n x. cbn. destruct a1; destruct a2; cbn in *;
      inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_trm.
  - intros t1 t2 IH1 IH2 v H n x. cbn. inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_trm.
  - intros l t IHl IHt v H n x. cbn. inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_trm.
  - intros a m b v H n x. cbn. destruct a; destruct b; cbn in *;
      inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_trm.
  - intros a m b v H n x. cbn. destruct a; destruct b; cbn in *;
      inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_trm.
  - intros T t IH v H n x. cbn. inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_lit.
  - intros T ds IH v H n x. cbn. inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_lit.
  - intros l T v H n x. cbn. inversion H.
  - intros l a v H n x. cbn. destruct a; cbn; inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_def.
  - intros m t IH v H n x. cbn. inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_def.
  - intros v H n x. cbn. inversion H.
  - intros ds d IHds IHd v H n x. cbn. inversion H; subst; eauto using tfree_defs.
Qed.

Lemma tfree_trm_open : forall (t:trm) v, tfree_trm v t -> forall n x, tfree_trm v (open_rec n x t).
Proof. intros; eapply tfree_open_mut; eauto. Qed.
Lemma tfree_lit_open : forall (l:lit) v, tfree_lit v l -> forall n x, tfree_lit v (open_rec n x l).
Proof. intros; eapply tfree_open_mut; eauto. Qed.
Lemma tfree_def_open : forall (d:def) v, tfree_def v d -> forall n x, tfree_def v (open_rec n x d).
Proof. intros; eapply tfree_open_mut; eauto. Qed.
Lemma tfree_defs_open : forall (ds:defs) v, tfree_defs v ds -> forall n x, tfree_defs v (open_rec n x ds).
Proof. intros; eapply tfree_open_mut; eauto. Qed.

(** * TFree open inversion *)

Ltac solve_ih_gen IH H' :=
  let Hs := fresh "Hs" in
  destruct (IH _ _ _ H') as [Hs|Hs]; subst;
    first [ left; econstructor; eassumption | right; reflexivity | assumption ].
Ltac use_ih_trm IH :=
  match goal with H' : tfree_trm _ _ |- _ => solve_ih_gen IH H' end.
Ltac use_ih_lit IH :=
  match goal with H' : tfree_lit _ _ |- _ => solve_ih_gen IH H' end.
Ltac use_ih_def IH :=
  match goal with H' : tfree_def _ _ |- _ => solve_ih_gen IH H' end.
Ltac use_ih_defs IH :=
  match goal with H' : tfree_defs _ _ |- _ => solve_ih_gen IH H' end.

Lemma tfree_open_inv_mut :
  (forall (t:trm) v x n, tfree_trm v (open_rec n x t) -> tfree_trm v t \/ v = x)

  /\ (forall (d:def) v x n, tfree_def v (open_rec n x d) -> tfree_def v d \/ v = x)

Proof.

    + destruct (classicT (n = i)); cbn in *; inversion H; subst; auto.
    + inversion H; subst; auto using tfree_trm.
  - intros a1 a2 v x n H. cbn in H. destruct a1 as [i|y]; destruct a2 as [j|z]; cbn in *;

      try (destruct (classicT (n = j)); cbn in *);

  - intros a m b v x n H. cbn in H. destruct a as [i|y]; destruct b as [j|z]; cbn in *;
      try (destruct (classicT (n = i)); cbn in *);

(** * fv / open cases *)

Lemma fv_open_cases_avar : forall (a:avar) n x,
  fv (open_rec n x a) = fv a \/ fv (open_rec n x a) = \{x} \u fv a.
Proof.
  intros a n x. destruct a as [i|v].
  - destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x E). right. cbn. rewrite union_empty_r. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x N). left. reflexivity.
  - cbn. left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_cases_typ_mut :
  (forall (T:typ) n x,
     fv (open_rec n x T) = fv T \/ fv (open_rec n x T) = \{x} \u fv T)
  /\ (forall (D:dec) n x,
     fv (open_rec n x D) = fv D \/ fv (open_rec n x D) = \{x} \u fv D).
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev.

(** * OpenTwice for avar/typ/dec/trm/lit/def/defs *)

Lemma avar_open_b_eq : forall i n x, n = i -> open_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_f x.
Proof. intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_l H). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_b_neq : forall i n x, n <> i -> open_rec n x (avar_b i) = avar_b i.
Proof. intros. cbn. rewrite (classicT_r H). reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_f : forall v n x, open_rec n x (avar_f v) = avar_f v.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma avar_open_twice : forall (a:avar) n x y,
  open_rec n y (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n x a.
Proof.
  intros a n x y. destruct a as [i|v].
  - destruct (classicT (n = i)) as [E|N].
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i n x E). cbn. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n x N). rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n y N). reflexivity.
  - cbn. reflexivity.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence Dev2.
Require Import Lia.

Section OVars.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** [ovars k xs T] opens the bound variables [k], [k+1], ... with the
    variables in [xs].  It is the structural version of [open_rec_vars]. *)

Fixpoint ovars_avar (k:nat) (xs:list var) (a:avar) : avar :=
  match xs with
  | nil => a
  | cons x xs => ovars_avar (S k) xs (open_rec k x a)
  end.

Fixpoint ovars_typ (k:nat) (xs:list var) (T:typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (ovars_dec k xs D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => typ_and (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ k xs T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2 => typ_or (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ k xs T2)
  | typ_sel a l b => typ_sel (ovars_avar k xs a) l (ovars_avar k xs b)

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Env_set.
Require Import Typed_progress_read Ctx_term_narrow Typing_weaken Subst_typing.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Strong field-read data: the value stored in the field is the location
    [v] with location type [Ty], and its value type [Tf] lies below the
    declared field upper bound [U]. *)

Variable canon_fld_read_strong :
  forall G e Sigma x T0 a S U V Tstack,
    heap_correspond G e Sigma -> inert G ->
    ctx_k G x v_ref ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 (typ_rcd (dec_fld a S U)) ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e U V ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e V Tstack ->
    exists y ds v Tf Ty,
      binds x y e /\
      binds y (item_obj ds) Sigma /\
      defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f v)) /\
      ctx_k G v v_loc /\
      ctx_binds v Ty G /\
      ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e v Tf /\
      subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tf U.

(** Renaming a reference [v] to a fresh reference [w] bound to the same
    location type, keeping the (sub)type target. *)

Variable open_ref_type_var :
  forall G e v Ty T Tstack w,
    inert G ->
    ctx_k G v v_loc ->
    ctx_binds v Ty G ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e v T ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T Tstack ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G -> w \notin ctx_fv G -> w \notin fv Ty ->
    ty_var typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty) (e & w ~ v) w Tstack.

Lemma weak_tp_read_rename : forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
  config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
    (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c'.
Proof.
  intros x m Sigma e Lv fs U Hcfg.
  set (cold := trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv).
  destruct Hcfg as [G Hweak].
  inversion Hweak as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  assert (Hkx : ctx_k G x v_ref) by (eapply Htf; apply tfree_trm_read).
  destruct (ty_trm_read_inv Hty) as [Sf [Tfld [V [Hxread [Hder Hs]]]]].
  destruct (ty_var_sub_elim Hxread) as [T0 [Htv Hsub]].
  destruct (@canon_fld_read_strong G e Sigma x T0 m Sf Tfld V T
              Hhc Hir Hkx Htv Hsub Hder Hs)
    as [y [ds [v [Tval [Ty [Hbxy [Hby [Hhas [Hkv [Hbyv [Htyv HTval]]]]]]]]]]].
  assert (Hok : ctx_ok G) by (eapply heap_correspond_ctx_ok; exact Hhc).
  assert (Hityloc : inert_typ Ty v_loc)
    by (eapply (@inert_typ_of_binds_loc typing_mode); eassumption).
  destruct (@inert_loc_ref_corr typing_mode Ty Hityloc) as [Hcorr Hityref].
  assert (HTstack : subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e Tval T).
  { eapply subtyp_trans; [exact HTval|].
    eapply subtyp_trans; [exact Hder|exact Hs]. }
  destruct (var_fresh (ctx_dom G \u ctx_fv G \u fv Ty \u dom e \u fv_config cold))
    as [w Hw].
  repeat rewrite notin_union in Hw.
  destruct Hw as [HwG Hw]; destruct Hw as [HwFvG Hw].
  destruct Hw as [HwTy Hw]; destruct Hw as [Hwe Hwf].
  assert (Hvisw : ty_var typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty) (e & w ~ v) w T).
  { eapply (@open_ref_type_var G e v Ty Tval T w Hir Hkv Hbyv Htyv HTstack);
      assumption. }
  assert (Hnew : ty_trm typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty) objctx_empty (e & w ~ v)
                   (trm_var (avar_f w)) T).
  { eapply ty_trm_var.
    - intro. apply ctx_vis_e.
    - exact Hvisw. }
  assert (Hinert' : inert (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty)).
  { eapply inert_push; eauto using inert_vk_ref. }
  assert (Hhc' : heap_correspond (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty) (e & w ~ v) Sigma).
  { eapply heap_correspond_extend_read; eassumption. }
  assert (Hst' : @ty_stack typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty) (e & w ~ v) T fs U).
  { eapply ty_stack_weaken; [exact Hst|exact HwG|].
    intros a b Hb. eapply binds_push_neq; [exact Hb|].
    intro E. apply Hwe. rewrite <- E. eapply binds_in_dom. exact Hb. }
  assert (Hts' : @all_tfree_k stack _ (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty) fs v_ref).
  { eapply (@all_tfree_k_stack_weaken G (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty) fs v_ref Hts).
    intros z Hz. eapply (@ctx_k_weaken_push G z v_ref w v_ref Ty);
      [exact Hz|exact HwG]. }
  assert (Htfw : @all_tfree_k trm _ (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty) (trm_var (avar_f w)) v_ref).
  { intros z Hz. inversion Hz; subst. exists Ty, G. apply ctx_binds_k_e. }
  assert (Hcc' : config_closed
                   (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ; fv_config cold)).
  { eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    - intros n z. cbn. reflexivity.
    - exact Hcs.
    - exact Hch. }
  exists (trm_var (avar_f w) ; fs ; Sigma ; e & w ~ v ; fv_config cold).
  split.
  - exists (G § w / v_ref ~ Ty).
    eapply weak_config_c; eassumption.
  - eapply red_read.
    + subst cold. cbn. split; [exact Hwf|exact I].
    + exact Hbxy.
    + exact Hby.
    + exact Hhas.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Section HideRemove.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Structural relation: the target context is obtained from the source by
    deleting zero or more [ctx_hide] nodes (all other constructors and
    binder names/types are preserved). *)
Inductive hide_rm : ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| hrm_empty : hide_rm ctx_empty ctx_empty
| hrm_push : forall C C' y vk T,
    hide_rm C C' -> hide_rm (C § y / vk ~ T) (C' § y / vk ~ T)
| hrm_stop : forall C C',
    hide_rm C C' -> hide_rm (ctx_stop C) (ctx_stop C')
| hrm_hide : forall C C',
    hide_rm C C' -> hide_rm (ctx_hide C) (ctx_hide C')
| hrm_drop : forall C C',
    hide_rm C C' -> hide_rm (ctx_hide C) C'.

Lemma hrm_suffix : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall H, hide_rm (C §& H) (C' §& H).
Proof.
  intros C C' Hrel. induction H as [|H IH y vk T|H IH|H IH]; intros.
  - cbn. exact Hrel.
  - cbn. apply hrm_push. apply IH.
  - cbn. apply hrm_stop. apply IH.
  - cbn. apply hrm_hide. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma hrm_binds : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall x T, ctx_binds x T C -> ctx_binds x T C'.
Proof.
  intros C C' Hrel. induction Hrel as [|C C' y vk T Hrel IH|C C' Hrel IH|C C' Hrel IH|C C' Hrel IH];
    intros x Tx Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis]; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_e.
    + apply ctx_binds_n; [ exact Hneq | apply IH; exact Hvis ].
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hb as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis|v t G0 Hvis]; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_hide. apply IH; exact Hvis.
    + apply ctx_binds_hide. apply IH; exact Hvis.
  - apply IH. apply ctx_binds_hide. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma hrm_vis : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall x, ctx_vis C x -> ctx_vis C' x.
Proof.
  intros C C' Hrel. induction Hrel as [|C C' y vk T Hrel IH|C C' Hrel IH|C C' Hrel IH|C C' Hrel IH];
    intros x Hv.
  - exact Hv.
  - inversion Hv as [v vk0 t G0|v v2 vk0 t G0 Hneq Hvis]; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + apply ctx_vis_n; [ exact Hneq | apply IH; exact Hvis ].
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
Qed.

Lemma hidable_of_hide_rm : forall C C', hide_rm C C' -> hidable_rel C C'.
Proof.
  intros C C' H. induction H.
  - apply hidable_refl.
  - apply hr_push. exact IHH.
  - apply hr_stop. exact IHH.
  - eapply hr_hide_in. eapply hr_hide_out. exact IHH.
  - eapply hr_hide_in. exact IHH.
Qed.

(** Full context of an objctx, kept unchanged except for hidden nodes. *)
Lemma hrm_full : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall Go, hide_rm (C §§ Go) (C' §§ Go).
Proof.
  intros C C' Hrel. destruct Go as [|x T|y T].
  - cbn. exact Hrel.
  - cbn. unfold ctx_obj. apply hrm_push. exact Hrel.
  - cbn. exact Hrel.
Qed.

(** Body context of a method definition. *)
Lemma hrm_obj_met : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall Go xz TZ xc TC,
    hide_rm (ctx_obj_met typing_mode C Go xz TZ xc TC)
            (ctx_obj_met typing_mode C' Go xz TZ xc TC).
Proof.
  intros C C' Hrel. destruct Go as [|x T|y T]; intros xz TZ xc TC.
  - cbn [ctx_obj_met].
    destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode) eqn:Evis.
    + cbn. eapply hrm_suffix. eapply hrm_suffix. exact Hrel.
    + cbn. eapply hrm_suffix. eapply hrm_suffix.
      eapply hrm_hide. exact Hrel.
  - cbn [ctx_obj_met]. unfold ctx_obj.
    destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode) eqn:Evis.
    + cbn. eapply hrm_suffix. eapply hrm_suffix.
      eapply hrm_push. exact Hrel.
    + cbn. eapply hrm_suffix. eapply hrm_suffix.
      eapply hrm_hide. eapply hrm_push. exact Hrel.
  - cbn [ctx_obj_met].
    destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode) eqn:Evis.
    + cbn. eapply hrm_suffix. eapply hrm_suffix. exact Hrel.
    + cbn. eapply hrm_suffix. eapply hrm_suffix.
      eapply hrm_hide. exact Hrel.
Qed.

End HideRemove.
EOF

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Dev Dev2 Weaken_proof Subst_extra Typing_weaken Context_lemmas Kind_env_stack Typing_subst.

(** * A true variable swap on the syntax.  Unlike [subst_var], this is a
    bijection on free names, so it commutes with opening at every name. *)

Definition swp_var (sx sy z: var) : var :=
  If z = sx then sy else If z = sy then sx else z.

Definition swp_avar (sx sy : var) (a: avar) : avar :=
  match a with
  | avar_b i => avar_b i
  | avar_f z => avar_f (swp_var sx sy z)
  end.

Fixpoint swp_typ (sx sy : var) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (swp_dec sx sy D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => typ_and (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2 => typ_or (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_sel a1 l a2 => typ_sel (swp_avar sx sy a1) l (swp_avar sx sy a2)
  | typ_bnd T => typ_bnd (swp_typ sx sy T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2 => typ_fun (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end
with swp_dec (sx sy : var) (D : dec) {struct D} : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ l T1 T2 => dec_typ l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | dec_fld l T1 T2 => dec_fld l (swp_typ sx sy T1) (swp_typ sx sy T2)
  | dec_met l TC TZ TR =>
      dec_met l (swp_typ sx sy TC) (swp_typ sx sy TZ) (swp_typ sx sy TR)
  end.

(** Lemmas on the variable-level swap. *)

Lemma swp_var_eq_l : forall sx sy, swp_var sx sy sx = sy.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  rewrite (classicT_l (P := sx = sx) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_eq_r : forall sx sy, swp_var sx sy sy = sx.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  destruct (classicT (sy = sx)) as [E|N].
  - subst sx. cbn. reflexivity.
  - rewrite (classicT_l (P := sy = sy) eq_refl). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_other : forall sx sy z, z <> sx -> z <> sy -> swp_var sx sy z = z.
Proof.
  intros. unfold swp_var.
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := z = sx) H).
  rewrite (classicT_r (P := z = sy) H0). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_invol : forall sx sy z, swp_var sx sy (swp_var sx sy z) = z.
Proof.
  intros. destruct (classicT (z = sx)) as [E|Nx]; subst.
  - rewrite swp_var_eq_l. apply swp_var_eq_r.
  - destruct (classicT (z = sy)) as [E|Ny]; subst.
    + rewrite swp_var_eq_r. apply swp_var_eq_l.
    + rewrite (swp_var_other Nx Ny). apply swp_var_other; auto.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_fresh : forall sx sy z, sx <> sy ->
  z <> sx -> z <> sy -> swp_var sx sy z <> sx /\ swp_var sx sy z <> sy.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite swp_var_other; auto.
Qed.

Lemma swp_var_inj : forall sx sy v1 v2,
  swp_var sx sy v1 = swp_var sx sy v2 -> v1 = v2.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite <- (swp_var_invol sx sy v1). rewrite H.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re, sys, os

files = sys.argv[1:]
mods = {os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(f))[0] for f in files}
header = """Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
"""
# top-level declaration names
decl_re = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:Local\s+|Global\s+|Polymorphic\s+|Monomorphic\s+|Program\s+)*(Lemma|Theorem|Definition|Fixpoint|CoFixpoint|Inductive|Variant|Record|Class|Instance|Corollary|Example|Fact|Remark)\s+([^\s:{(\[]+)')
seen = set()
out = [header]
for f in files:
    src = open(f, encoding='utf8').read()
    # strip helper Require Import lines and Set Implicit Arguments
    lines=[]
    for line in src.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'\s*Require\s+Import\s+(.*?)\.\s*$', line)
        if m:
            names=[n for n in m.group(1).split() if n not in mods]
            if not names: continue
            line='Require Import '+' '.join(names)+'.'
        if re.match(r'\s*Set Implicit Arguments\.\s*$', line): continue
        lines.append(line)
    text='\n'.join(lines)
    # detect this file's top-level decls and rename duplicates
    local_decls=[]
    for line in lines:
        m=decl_re.match(line)
        if m:
            local_decls.append(m.group(2))
    renames={}
    for name in local_decls:
        if name in seen:
            newname=name+'__'+re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_]','_',os.path.basename(f)[:-2])
            # ensure unique
            base=newname; i=1
            while newname in seen or newname in renames.values():
                i+=1; newname=base+'_'+str(i)
            renames[name]=newname
        else:
            seen.add(name)
    # apply renaming word-boundary
    for old,new in renames.items():
        text=re.sub(r'\b'+re.escape(old)+r'\b', new, text)
    out.append('\n(* ==== from %s ==== *)\n'%os.path.basename(f))
    out.append(text)
print('\n'.join(out))

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep.
Require Import Subst_typing Var_subst_typing Tyq_open_fresh Ty_defs_tyq.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Renaming a variable through the swap operation.

    The following are unconditional consequences of the equivariance of
    [ty_var] under the bijective swap [swp_*].  When the variable [v] is the
    last binding of the context and [v,w] are fresh from the rest, the target
    context is exactly the expected [G1 § w / v_ref ~ Tv].  The target type
    is the swapped source type; it is the source type itself when [T] does
    not mention [v] or [w]. *)

Lemma ty_var_rename_last_binding :
  forall (G1:ctx) e (v w:var) (Tv T:typ),
    ty_var typing_mode (G1 § v / v_ref ~ Tv) objctx_empty e v T ->
    v \notin ctx_dom G1 ->
    v \notin ctx_fv G1 ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G1 ->
    w \notin ctx_fv G1 ->
    v \notin fv Tv ->
    w \notin fv Tv ->
    w <> v ->
    swp_renv_fixed w v e ->
    ty_var typing_mode (G1 § w / v_ref ~ Tv) objctx_empty e w
      (swp_typ w v T).
Proof.
  intros G1 e v w Tv T Hty Hvd Hvf Hwd Hwf HvTv HwTv Hwv Hfixed.
  pose proof (@ty_var_swp typing_mode
                (G1 § v / v_ref ~ Tv) objctx_empty e v T Hty w v Hfixed)
    as Hswp.
  cbn [swp_objctx] in Hswp.
  rewrite (swp_ctx_push w v G1 v v_ref Tv) in Hswp.
  rewrite (@swp_var_eq_r w v) in Hswp.
  rewrite (@swp_typ_fresh Tv w v HwTv HvTv) in Hswp.
  rewrite (@swp_ctx_fresh_id G1 w v Hwd Hwf Hvd Hvf) in Hswp.
  exact Hswp.
Qed.

(** If additionally the result type mentions neither variable, the successor
    gets literally the same type. *)

Lemma ty_var_rename_last_binding_same_type :
  forall (G1:ctx) e (v w:var) (Tv T:typ),
    ty_var typing_mode (G1 § v / v_ref ~ Tv) objctx_empty e v T ->
    v \notin ctx_dom G1 ->
    v \notin ctx_fv G1 ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G1 ->
    w \notin ctx_fv G1 ->
    v \notin fv Tv ->
    w \notin fv Tv ->
    v \notin fv T ->
    w \notin fv T ->
    w <> v ->
    swp_renv_fixed w v e ->
    ty_var typing_mode (G1 § w / v_ref ~ Tv) objctx_empty e w T.
Proof.
  intros. erewrite <- (@swp_typ_fresh T w v H0 H1).
  - eapply ty_var_rename_last_binding; eassumption.
Qed.

(** A binding of the successor [w] directly at the type [T] is always
    available; this is useful when [T] is already known to be inert. *)

Lemma ty_var_rename_bind_at_type :
  forall G e (v w:var) T,
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e v T ->
    w \notin ctx_dom G ->
    ty_var typing_mode (G § w / v_ref ~ T) objctx_empty e w T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply ty_var_var. apply ctx_binds_e.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma fv_avar_open_cover : forall (a:avar) v,
  v \in fv a -> forall n x, v \in fv (open_rec n x a).
Proof.
  intros a v H n x. destruct a as [i|y]; cbn in *.
  - rewrite in_empty in H. inversion H.
  - destruct (classicT (n = 0)) as [E|N] in *.
    (* open only at index n; but avar_b i branch is impossible for fv; this line is not needed for a=avar_f *)
    all: cbn; rewrite in_singleton in *; subst; rewrite in_singleton; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tv_open_cover_mut :
  (forall (t:trm) n x v, v \in tv_trm t -> v \in tv_trm (open_rec n x t))
  /\ (forall (l:lit) n x v, v \in tv_lit l -> v \in tv_lit (open_rec n x l))
  /\ (forall (d:def) n x v, v \in tv_def d -> v \in tv_def (open_rec n x d))
  /\ (forall (ds:defs) n x v, v \in tv_defs ds -> v \in tv_defs (open_rec n x ds)).

  - intros a n x v H. cbn in *. eapply fv_avar_open_cover; exact H.
  - intros a m n x v H. cbn in *. eapply fv_avar_open_cover; exact H.

  forall e x T, ty_var typing_mode C objctx_empty e x T ->
    ty_var typing_mode C' objctx_empty e x T.
Proof.
  intros C C' S H e x T Hty.
  destruct (@hidable_var_sub_incap typing_mode) as [Hv _].
  eapply Hv; [ exact Hty | apply hidable_of_hide_add; exact H ].
Qed.

Lemma hide_add_subtyp : forall C C' S, hide_add C C' S ->
  forall e T U, subtyp typing_mode C objctx_empty e T U ->
    subtyp typing_mode C' objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros C C' S H e T U Hty.
  destruct (@hidable_var_sub_incap typing_mode) as [_ [Hs _]].
  eapply Hs; [ exact Hty | apply hidable_of_hide_add; exact H ].
Qed.

Lemma hide_add_incap : forall C C' S, hide_add C C' S ->
  forall e T U, ty_incap typing_mode C objctx_empty e T U ->
    ty_incap typing_mode C' objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros C C' S H e T U Hty.
  destruct (@hidable_var_sub_incap typing_mode) as [_ [_ Hi]].
  eapply Hi; [ exact Hty | apply hidable_of_hide_add; exact H ].

  forall (Go:objctx), hide_add (C §§& Go) (C' §§& Go) S.
Proof.
  intros C C' S H. destruct Go as [|x T|y T].
  - cbn. exact H.
  - cbn. unfold ctx_obj. apply ha_push. exact H.
  - cbn. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma hide_add_met : forall C C' S, hide_add C C' S ->
  forall xz TZ xc TC,
    hide_add (ctx_met C xz TZ xc TC) (ctx_met C' xz TZ xc TC) S.
Proof.
  intros C C' S H xz TZ xc TC.
  change (hide_add (C § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ open xz TC)
                   (C' § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ open xz TC) S).
  apply ha_push. apply ha_push. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma hide_add_met_refined : forall C C' S, hide_add C C' S ->
  forall xz TZ xc TC TC2,
    hide_add (ctx_met_refined C xz TZ xc TC TC2)
             (ctx_met_refined C' xz TZ xc TC TC2) S.
Proof.
  intros C C' S H xz TZ xc TC TC2.
  change (hide_add (C § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2))
                   (C' § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)) S).
  apply ha_push. apply ha_push. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma hide_add_obj_met : forall C C' S, hide_add C C' S ->
  forall Go xz TZ xc TC,
    hide_add (ctx_obj_met typing_mode C Go xz TZ xc TC)
             (ctx_obj_met typing_mode C' Go xz TZ xc TC) S.
Proof.
  intros C C' S H. destruct Go as [|x T|y T]; intros xz TZ xc TC.
  - cbn [ctx_obj_met].
    destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode) eqn:Evis.
    + cbn. eapply hide_add_met. exact H.
    + cbn. eapply hide_add_met. eapply ha_hide. exact H.
  - cbn [ctx_obj_met]. unfold ctx_obj.
    destruct (mode_visibility' typing_mode) eqn:Evis.
    + cbn. eapply hide_add_met_refined. eapply ha_push. exact H.

    + cbn. eapply hide_add_met_refined. eapply ha_hide. exact H.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence.
Require Import Selector_sound Record_label_inert.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Symmetry of type equivalence. *)

Lemma tyq_typ_sym : forall e (T U:typ), typing_equiv e T U -> typing_equiv e U T.
Proof.
  intros e T U H. induction H.
  - eapply tyq_typ_nulary. exact H.
  - eapply tyq_typ_andor; [exact H | exact IHtyq_typ | exact IHtyq_typ0].
  - eapply tyq_typ_fun.
    + exact IHtyq_typ.
    + intros x. apply H1.
  - eapply tyq_typ_fld; [exact IHtyq_typ | exact IHtyq_typ0].
  - eapply tyq_typ_typ.
    + intros x. apply H0.
    + intros x. apply H2.
  - eapply tyq_typ_sel_normal. apply tyq_var_sym. exact H.
  - eapply tyq_typ_sel.
  - eapply tyq_typ_bnd. intros x. apply H0.
  - eapply tyq_typ_met.
    + intros x. apply H0.
    + exact IHtyq_typ.
    + intros x yy. apply H3.

Section Trans.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma tyq_typ_trans : forall e (T U V:typ),
  typing_equiv e T U -> typing_equiv e U V -> typing_equiv e T V.
Proof.
  intros e T U V H1. revert V.
  induction H1; intros V HV;
    try (match goal with H : typ_andor ?T |- _ => destruct H as [|]; cbn in * end);
    inversion HV; subst; try discriminate;
    try (match goal with H : typ_andor ?T |- _ => destruct H as [|]; cbn in * end); try discriminate;
    eauto 12 using tyq_typ_nulary, tyq_typ_andor, tyq_typ_fun, tyq_typ_fld,
      tyq_typ_typ, tyq_typ_sel_normal, tyq_typ_sel, tyq_typ_bnd, tyq_typ_met,
      tyq_var_trans.
  all: try (match goal with H : typ_and _ _ = typ_and _ _ |- _ => injection H; intros; subst end);
    try (match goal with H : typ_or _ _ = typ_or _ _ |- _ => injection H; intros; subst end);
    try (eapply tyq_typ_andor; [constructor| |]; eauto 20);
    try (eapply tyq_typ_andor; [constructor| |]; eauto 20).
Qed.

Lemma open_rec_avar_comm_neq : forall i n x y (a:avar),
  i <> n -> open_rec i x (open_rec n y a) = open_rec n y (open_rec i x a).
Proof.
  intros i n x y a Hne. destruct a as [j|v].
  - destruct (classicT (n = j)) as [Enj|Nnj].
    + subst j.
      rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq n n y eq_refl).
      rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq n i x Hne).
      cbn. rewrite (If_l (P := n = n) (avar_f y) (avar_b n) eq_refl). reflexivity.
    + destruct (classicT (i = j)) as [Eij|Nij].
      * subst j.
        rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq i n y Nnj).
        rewrite (@avar_open_b_eq i i x eq_refl).
        cbn. reflexivity.
      * rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j n y Nnj).
        rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j i x Nij).
        rewrite (@avar_open_b_neq j n y Nnj). reflexivity.
  - cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence.
Require Import Ty_defs_tyq Tyq_open_fresh.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Compatibility of type equivalence with opening. *)

Lemma tyq_typ_open_rec : forall e (T U:typ),
  typing_equiv e T U ->
  forall k x, typing_equiv e (open_rec k x T) (open_rec k x U).
Proof.
  intros e T U H. induction H; intros k x.
  - (* top/bot/nocap *)
    dependent destruction H; cbn; constructor.
  - (* and/or *)
    destruct H as [|]; cbn; eapply tyq_typ_andor;
      [constructor| apply IHtyq_typ | apply IHtyq_typ0].
  - (* fun *)
    cbn. eapply tyq_typ_fun.
    + apply IHtyq_typ.
    + intros y.
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t12 ltac:(lia))).
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t22 ltac:(lia))).
      apply H1.
  - (* field record *)
    cbn. eapply tyq_typ_fld; [apply IHtyq_typ|apply IHtyq_typ0].
  - (* type-member record *)
    cbn. eapply tyq_typ_typ.
    + intros y.
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t11 ltac:(lia))).
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t21 ltac:(lia))).
      apply H0.
    + intros y.
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t12 ltac:(lia))).
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t22 ltac:(lia))).
      apply H2.
  - (* normal selector *)
    cbn. eapply tyq_typ_sel_normal. exact H.
  - (* selector *)
    cbn. eapply tyq_typ_sel.
  - (* bnd *)
    cbn. eapply tyq_typ_bnd. intros y.
    rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t1 ltac:(lia))).
    rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t2 ltac:(lia))).
    apply H0.
  - (* method record *)
    cbn. eapply tyq_typ_met.
    + intros y.
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t11 ltac:(lia))).
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S k) y x t21 ltac:(lia))).
      apply H0.
    + apply IHtyq_typ.
    + intros y z.
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S (S k)) y x (open_rec 1 z t13) ltac:(lia))).
      (* first open at 1 z, then outer open at 0 y, commute with open at S(S k) x *)
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 1 (S (S k)) z x t13 ltac:(lia))).
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 0 (S (S k)) y x (open_rec 1 z t23) ltac:(lia))).
      rewrite (proj1 (@open_rec_typ_comm_neq_mut 1 (S (S k)) z x t23 ltac:(lia))).
      (* goal: tyq (open_rec (S (S k)) x (open y (open z t13))) ...? adjust *)
      apply H3.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Fixpoint ovars_avar (k:nat) (xs:list var) (a:avar) : avar :=
  match xs with
  | nil => a
  | cons x xs => ovars_avar (S k) xs (open_rec k x a)
  end.

Fixpoint ovars_typ (k:nat) (xs:list var) (T:typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (ovars_dec k xs D)
  | typ_and T1 T2 => typ_and (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ k xs T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2 => typ_or (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ k xs T2)
  | typ_sel a l b => typ_sel (ovars_avar k xs a) l (ovars_avar k xs b)
  | typ_bnd T => typ_bnd (ovars_typ (S k) xs T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2 => typ_fun (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ (S k) xs T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end
with ovars_dec (k:nat) (xs:list var) (D:dec) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ A T1 T2 => dec_typ A (ovars_typ (S k) xs T1) (ovars_typ (S k) xs T2)
  | dec_fld a T1 T2 => dec_fld a (ovars_typ k xs T1) (ovars_typ k xs T2)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
      dec_met m (ovars_typ (S k) xs TC) (ovars_typ k xs TZ) (ovars_typ (S (S k)) xs TR)
  end.

Lemma ovars_avar_nil : forall k a, ovars_avar k nil a = a.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma avar_open_neq : forall k x (a:avar),
  a <> avar_b k -> open_rec k x a = a.

  - destruct (classicT (k = i)) as [E|N].
    + exfalso. apply H. subst i. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import TypingMode.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Notation vis_hide typing_mode G := (
  match (mode_visibility' typing_mode) with
  | mode_visibility_all => G
  | mode_visibility_hide_method => (ctx_hide G)
  end
  ) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj_met typing_mode (G: ctx)(Go: objctx)(xz: var)(TZ: typ)(xc: var)(TC: typ) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => ctx_met (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC
  | objctx_lit x T => ctx_met_refined (vis_hide typing_mode (G § x / v_self ~ open x T)) xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open x T) (open xc T))
  | objctx_heap y T => ctx_met_refined_heap (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC y T

  end.
  intros. repeat rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
  repeat rewrite subst_typ_and.
  rewrite (@subst_open_typ_neq TC x0 z xz 0); [|exact H].
  repeat rewrite (@typ_subst_open_commut T x0 z).
  rewrite (@subst_var_neq x0 z xc H0).
  reflexivity.
Qed.


End CtxObjMetSubst.

Section CtxObjMetCombined.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Lemma subst_ctx_ctx_obj_met : forall G Go xz TZ xc TC x0 z,
  xz <> x0 -> xc <> x0 ->
  x0 \notin objctx_dom Go ->
  subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_obj_met typing_mode G Go xz TZ xc TC) =
  ctx_obj_met typing_mode (subst_ctx x0 z G) (subst_objctx x0 z Go)
    xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc (subst_var x0 z TC).
Proof.
  intros G Go xz TZ xc TC x0 z Hxz Hxc Hd.
  destruct Go as [|v Tv|yy Tu].
  - case_eq (mode_visibility' typing_mode); intros Evis.
    + cbn [ctx_obj_met subst_objctx]. rewrite Evis.
      change (subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC) =
              ctx_met (subst_ctx x0 z G) xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc
                (subst_var x0 z TC)).
      apply subst_ctx_ctx_met. exact Hxz.
    + cbn [ctx_obj_met subst_objctx]. rewrite Evis.
      change (subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_met (ctx_hide G) xz TZ xc TC) =
              ctx_met (subst_ctx x0 z (ctx_hide G)) xz (subst_var x0 z TZ) xc
                (subst_var x0 z TC)).
      apply subst_ctx_ctx_met. exact Hxz.
  - case_eq (mode_visibility' typing_mode); intros Evis.
    + cbn [ctx_obj_met subst_objctx]. rewrite Evis.
      rewrite subst_ctx_ctx_met_refined; [|exact Hxz].
      rewrite ctx_push_subst_ctx. cbn.
      repeat rewrite subst_typ_and.
      repeat rewrite (@typ_subst_open_commut Tv x0 z).
      assert (Hvx : v <> x0) by (intro E; apply Hd; rewrite E; cbn; rewrite in_singleton; reflexivity).
  forall (Go:objctx), hide_rm (C §§& Go) (C' §§& Go).
Proof.
  intros C C' Hrel. destruct Go as [|x T|y T].
  - cbn. exact Hrel.
  - cbn. unfold ctx_obj. apply hrm_push. exact Hrel.
  - cbn. exact Hrel.
Qed.

(** Body context of a method definition. *)
Lemma hrm_met : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall xz TZ xc TC,
    hide_rm (ctx_met C xz TZ xc TC) (ctx_met C' xz TZ xc TC).

content.content:
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import ConfigNotations WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Weaken_proof Typing_weaken Trm_inv Closed_extra Syntax_extra Defs_lemmas Ctx_term_narrow Preservation_let_var.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** * Weak preservation for [red_let_push]. *)

Lemma weak_pres_let_push : forall G (t1 t2:trm) (s:stack) (Sigma:heap) (e:renv) Lv U,
  weak_config typing_mode G (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  weak_config typing_mode G (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
                   fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros G t1 t2 s Sigma e Lv U Hcfg.
  inversion Hcfg as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_let_inv Hty) as [T1 [L [V [Ht1 [Hbody Hsub]]]]].
  eapply weak_config_c.
  - exact Hir.
  - exact Hhc.
  - eapply ty_stack_let.
    + exact Hst.
    + intros x Hx. rewrite notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [HxL HxG].
      eapply ty_trm_sub; [ apply (Hbody x HxL) | ].
      eapply subtyp_weaken_push; eauto.
  - eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_let.
    + apply (@all_tfree_k_trm_let_r G v_ref t1 t2 Htf).
    + exact Hts.
  - exact Ht1.
  - apply (@all_tfree_k_trm_let_l G v_ref t1 t2 Htf).
  - eapply config_sealed_cfg.
    + eapply closed_trm_let_l. exact Hct.
    + eapply closed_stack_cons_let; [exact Hct|exact Hcs].
    + exact Hch.
Qed.

(** * Weak preservation for [red_let_var], modulo the variable-opening lemma. *)

Variable open_body_at_bound :
  forall G e (L:fset var) (t:trm) S Tbody x T0,
    inert G ->
    (forall z, z \notin L ->
       ty_trm typing_mode (G § z / v_let ~ S) objctx_empty e (open z t) Tbody) ->
    ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e x T0 ->
    subtyp typing_mode G objctx_empty e T0 S ->
    ty_trm typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x t) Tbody.

Lemma weak_pres_let_var : forall G (t:trm) Sigma e Lv (x:var) fs U,
  weak_config typing_mode G
    (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
  weak_config typing_mode G
    (open x t ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
     fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U.
Proof.
  intros G t Sigma e Lv x fs U Hcfg.
  inversion Hcfg as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 Tstack U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  inversion Hst as [G1 e1 T1 U1 Hsubnil|Lst G1 e1 s1 t1 Sframe Tbody U1 Htail Hbody];
    subst.
  destruct (ty_trm_var_inv Hty) as [T0 [Htyvar Hsub]].
  assert (Hclosedframe : closed_below 1 (frame_let t))
    by (eapply closed_stack_cons_frame_below; exact Hcs).
  assert (Hclosedt : closed_below 1 t)
    by (eapply closed_frame_let_body_below; exact Hclosedframe).
  eapply weak_config_c.
  - exact Hir.
  - exact Hhc.
  - exact Htail.
  - eapply all_tfree_k_stack_cons_tail. exact Hts.
  - eapply open_body_at_bound.
    + exact Hir.
    + intros z Hz. exact (Hbody z Hz).

(** * Typed progress. *)

Lemma weak_typed_progress : forall (c:config) (U:typ),
  config_weak_typd typing_mode c U ->
  answer c \/
  (exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\ c ↦ c').
Proof.
  intros c U Hcfg. destruct c as [t s Sigma e Lv].
  destruct Hcfg as [G Hweak].
  inversion Hweak as [e0 s0 Sigma0 Lv0 t0 T U0 Hir Hhc Hst Hts Hty Htf Hcc]; subst.
  inversion Hcc as [t0 s0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 Hct Hcs Hch]; subst.
  destruct t as [a|a m|a b|t1 t2|l t2|a m b|a m b].
  - (* trm_var *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    { exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_var_avar (a:=avar_b n) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E. }
    destruct s as [|f fs].
    { left. apply nf_loc. }
    destruct f as [t0]. right.
    exists (open x t0 ; fs ; Sigma ; e ;
              fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t0) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    split.
    { exact (ex_intro (fun G0 => @weak_config typing_mode G0 (t0 /[-> x] ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x) ; stack_cons (frame_let t0) fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)) U) G (@weak_pres_let_var typing_mode open_body_at_bound G t0 Sigma e Lv x fs U Hweak)). }
    { exact (red_let_var t0 Sigma e Lv x fs). }
  - (* trm_read *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_read_avar (a:=avar_b n) (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + right. eapply tp_read. exists G. exact Hweak.
  - (* trm_apply *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_l Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|z].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_apply_r Hct)) as [y E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_apply. exists G. exact Hweak.
  - (* trm_let *)
    right.
    exists (t1 ; stack_cons (frame_let t2) s ; Sigma ; e ;
              fv_config (trm_let t1 t2 ; s ; Sigma ; e ; Lv)).
    split.
    + exists G. eapply (@weak_pres_let_push typing_mode G t1 t2 s Sigma e Lv U); eauto.
    + apply red_let_push.
  - (* trm_lit *)
    right. eapply tp_lit. exists G. exact Hweak.
  - (* trm_write *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_l (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_write_r Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_write. exists G. exact Hweak.
  - (* trm_call *)
    destruct a as [n|x].
    + exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_l (m:=m) Hct)) as [y E].
      discriminate E.
    + destruct b as [nb|y].
      * exfalso. destruct (closed_avar_f_inv (closed_trm_call_r Hct)) as [z E].
        discriminate E.
      * right. eapply tp_call. exists G. exact Hweak.
Qed.

  (tp_read :
    forall (x:var) m Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_read (avar_f x) m ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
  (tp_write :
    forall (x:var) m (y:var) Sigma e Lv fs U,
      config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_write (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->

      config_weak_typd typing_mode (trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) U ->
      exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\

      exists c', config_weak_typd typing_mode c' U /\
        (trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ; fs ; Sigma ; e ; Lv) ↦ c')
