Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Indep Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext OperationalSemantics HeapCorrespondence HeapUpdate EnvCorrespondence ConfigTyping ConfigVarkinds TFree Deref.
Require Import Weaken_proof WeakConfig Dev Dev2 Dev3 Dev4 Dev5 Dev6 Dev7 Dev8 Defs_lemmas Context_lemmas Heap_lookup Syntax_extra Closed_extra Kind_env_stack Typing_weaken Weak_obj_extension Obj_heap_typing Obj_heap_var_final Subst_typing Var_subst_typing Var_rename_tyq Tyq_open_fresh Ty_defs_tyq.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Replace the type of the unique binding [w] in a context decomposition. *)

Lemma ctx_binds_replace_distinguished : forall (G1 G2:ctx) w vk S S' x T,
  w \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  x <> w ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § w / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds x T (G1 § w / vk ~ S' §& G2).
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 w vk S S' x T. revert G1.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH y vk2 T2|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 Hw Hxw Hc.
  - cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    + exfalso. apply Hxw. reflexivity.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; eassumption.
    + eapply ctx_binds_hide. exact Hc0.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn in Hw. rewrite notin_union in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hy Hw].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hy.
    inversion Hc; subst.
    + apply ctx_binds_e.
    + eapply ctx_binds_n; [exact H4|].
      eapply IH; eassumption.
    + eapply ctx_binds_hide. exact Hc0.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn in Hw.
    inversion Hc; subst; [| | eapply ctx_binds_stop; eapply IH; eassumption].
    + exact Hc0.
    + exact Hc0.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn in Hw.
    inversion Hc; subst; [| | eapply ctx_binds_hide; eapply IH; eassumption].
    + exact Hc0.
    + exact Hc0.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_binds_distinguished_type : forall (G1 G2:ctx) w vk S T,
  w \notin ctx_dom (G1 §& G2) ->
  ctx_binds w T (G1 § w / vk ~ S §& G2) ->
  T = S.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 w vk S T. revert G1.
  induction G2 as [|G2 IH y vk2 T2|G2 IH|G2 IH]; intros G1 Hw Hc.
  - cbn in Hc. inversion Hc; subst.
    + reflexivity.
    + exfalso. assert (Hin : w \in ctx_dom G1) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact Hc0).
      apply Hw. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin.
    + exfalso. assert (Hin : w \in ctx_dom G1) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact Hc0).
      apply Hw. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn in Hw. rewrite notin_union in Hw. destruct Hw as [Hy Hw].
    rewrite notin_singleton in Hy.
    inversion Hc; subst.
    + exfalso. apply Hy. reflexivity.
    + eapply IH; eassumption.
    + assert (Hin : w \in ctx_dom G1) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact Hc0).
      exfalso. apply Hw. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn in Hw.
    inversion Hc; subst; [| | eapply IH; eassumption].
    + assert (Hin : w \in ctx_dom G1) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact Hc0).
      exfalso. apply Hw. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin.
    + assert (Hin : w \in ctx_dom G1) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact Hc0).
      exfalso. apply Hw. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin.
  - cbn in Hc. cbn in Hw.
    inversion Hc; subst; [| | eapply IH; eassumption].
    + assert (Hin : w \in ctx_dom G1) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact Hc0).
      exfalso. apply Hw. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin.
    + assert (Hin : w \in ctx_dom G1) by (eapply ctx_binds_in_dom; exact Hc0).
      exfalso. apply Hw. rewrite in_union. left. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma tyv_weaken_one : forall (G:ctx) e (w:var) S y vk T,
  y \notin ctx_dom G ->
  ty_var typing_mode G objctx_empty e w S ->
  ty_var typing_mode (G § y / vk ~ T) objctx_empty e w S.
Proof.
  intros. destruct var_sub_incap_weaken as [Hvar _].
  eapply Hvar; eauto.
Qed.

End WithTypingMode.

Lemma hrm_var : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall e (x:var) T, ty_var typing_mode C objctx_empty e x T ->
    ty_var typing_mode C' objctx_empty e x T.
Proof.
  intros C C' H e x T Hty.
  destruct (@hidable_var_sub_incap typing_mode) as [Hv _].
  eapply Hv; [ exact Hty | apply hidable_of_hide_rm; exact H ].
Qed.

Lemma hrm_subtyp : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall e T U, subtyp typing_mode C objctx_empty e T U ->
    subtyp typing_mode C' objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros C C' H e T U Hty.
  destruct (@hidable_var_sub_incap typing_mode) as [_ [Hs _]].
  eapply Hs; [ exact Hty | apply hidable_of_hide_rm; exact H ].
Qed.

Lemma hrm_incap : forall C C', hide_rm C C' ->
  forall e T U, ty_incap typing_mode C objctx_empty e T U ->
    ty_incap typing_mode C' objctx_empty e T U.
Proof.
  intros C C' H e T U Hty.
  destruct (@hidable_var_sub_incap typing_mode) as [_ [_ Hi]].
  eapply Hi; [ exact Hty | apply hidable_of_hide_rm; exact H ].
Qed.

Lemma hrm_capbnd : forall (Cap:typ_refcap_label) C Go e T1 T2,
  @ty_capbnd typing_mode Cap C Go e T1 T2 ->
  forall C', hide_rm C C' -> @ty_capbnd typing_mode Cap C' Go e T1 T2.
Proof.
  intros Cap C Go e T1 T2 H. induction H; intros G' Hr; econstructor; eauto using hrm_var.
  all: try (eapply hrm_var; eassumption).

Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence RecordTypes InertContext.
Require Import Selector_sound Record_label_inert Selector_cut.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Indexed Type-valued derivation trees for the variable/subtyping fragment.
    The indices are exactly the judgments; [sound_sub]/[sound_var] below
    reconstruct the Prop derivations. *)

Inductive DSub : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Type :=
| ds_top : forall G e T, DSub G e T typ_top
| ds_bot : forall G e T, DSub G e typ_bot T
| ds_refl : forall G e T, DSub G e T T
| ds_trans : forall G e S T U, DSub G e S T -> DSub G e T U -> DSub G e S U
| ds_and11 : forall G e T U, DSub G e (typ_and T U) T
| ds_and12 : forall G e T U, DSub G e (typ_and T U) U
| ds_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    DSub G e S T -> DSub G e S U -> DSub G e S (typ_and T U)
| ds_or11 : forall G e T U, DSub G e T (typ_or T U)
| ds_or12 : forall G e T U, DSub G e U (typ_or T U)
| ds_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    DSub G e S T -> DSub G e U T -> DSub G e (typ_or S U) T
| ds_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    DSub G e T1 T2 -> DSub G e U1 U2 ->
    DSub G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ds_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, DSub G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, DSub G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    DSub G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ds_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    DSub G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> DSub (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    DSub G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ds_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    DSub G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> DSub (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_sef' typing_mode = mode_sef_guarantee ->
     typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
       DSub (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    DSub G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ds_tyq : forall G e T U, typing_equiv e T U -> DSub G e T U
| ds_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    DSub G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ds_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    DSub G e (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ds_nocap_bnd : forall G e T, DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ds_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ds_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ds_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ds_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode -> DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
| ds_nocap_mut_top_boundless : forall G e T1 T2,
    mode_has_top_nm_subtype_boundless typing_mode ->
    DSub G e typ_top (typ_or typ_nocap
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap typ_refcap_mutability) T1 T2)))
| ds_nocap_mut_top_complement : forall G e,
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    DSub G e typ_top (typ_or typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot))
| ds_nocap_mut_bot : forall G e,
    mode_has_top_nm_complement typing_mode ->
    DSub G e (typ_and typ_nocap (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) typ_bot
| ds_mut_top : forall G e,
    mode_has_mut_top typing_mode ->
    DSub G e typ_top (typ_mut_marker typ_top)
| ds_sel1 : forall G e x A y S T,
    DVar G e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) ->
    DSub G e (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)) (open y T)
| ds_sel2 : forall G e x A y S T,
    DVar G e x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) ->
    DSub G e (open y S) (typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y))
with DVar : ctx -> renv -> var -> typ -> Type :=
| dv_var : forall G e x T, ctx_binds x T G -> DVar G e x T
| dv_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    (mode_has_incap typing_mode ->
      ty_incap typing_mode G objctx_empty e (open x T) (open x T)) ->
    DVar G e x (open x T) -> DVar G e x (typ_bnd T)
| dv_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    typ_indep_b 0 T -> DVar G e x (typ_bnd T) -> DVar G e x (open x T)
| dv_and : forall G e x T U,
    DVar G e x T -> DVar G e x U -> DVar G e x (typ_and T U)
| dv_sub : forall G e x T U,
    DVar G e x T -> DSub G e T U -> DVar G e x U
| dv_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    DVar G e x T -> DVar G e x (typ_mut_marker typ_top)
.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra.
Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import TLC.LibChoice.
Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep RecordTypes InertContext.
Require Import Selector_sound Record_label_inert Selector_cut.

Section WithTypingMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).

(** Indexed Type-valued derivation trees for the variable/subtyping fragment.
    The indices are exactly the judgments; [sound_sub]/[sound_var] below
    reconstruct the Prop derivations. *)

Inductive DSub : ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Type :=
| ds_top : forall G e T, DSub G e T typ_top
| ds_bot : forall G e T, DSub G e typ_bot T
| ds_refl : forall G e T, DSub G e T T
| ds_trans : forall G e S T U, DSub G e S T -> DSub G e T U -> DSub G e S U
| ds_and11 : forall G e T U, DSub G e (typ_and T U) T
| ds_and12 : forall G e T U, DSub G e (typ_and T U) U
| ds_and2 : forall G e S T U,
    DSub G e S T -> DSub G e S U -> DSub G e S (typ_and T U)
| ds_or11 : forall G e T U, DSub G e T (typ_or T U)
| ds_or12 : forall G e T U, DSub G e U (typ_or T U)
| ds_or2 : forall G e S T U,
    DSub G e S T -> DSub G e U T -> DSub G e (typ_or S U) T
| ds_fld : forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    DSub G e T1 T2 -> DSub G e U1 U2 ->
    DSub G e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2))
| ds_typ : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, DSub G e (open x S2) (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, DSub G e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    DSub G e (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| ds_fun : forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    DSub G e S2 S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> DSub (G § x / v_par ~ S2) e (open x T1) (open x T2)) ->
    DSub G e (typ_fun S1 T1) (typ_fun S2 T2)
| ds_met : forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    DSub G e TZ2 TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> DSub (G § x / v_par ~ TZ2) e (open x TC2) (open x TC1)) ->
    (mode_sef' typing_mode = mode_sef_guarantee ->
     typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L -> forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
       DSub (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) e (open_met x y TR1) (open_met x y TR2)) ->
    DSub G e (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2))
| ds_tyq : forall G e T U, typing_equiv e T U -> DSub G e T U
| ds_typ_and : forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    DSub G e
      (typ_and (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S1 T1))
               (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) S2 T2)))
      (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) (typ_or S1 S2) (typ_and T1 T2)))
| ds_dist : forall G e T1 T2 T3,
    DSub G e (typ_and T1 (typ_or T2 T3))
      (typ_or (typ_and T1 T2) (typ_and T1 T3))
| ds_nocap_bnd : forall G e T, DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_bnd T)
| ds_nocap_typ : forall G e A T1 T2,
    DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) T1 T2))
| ds_nocap_fld : forall G e a T1 T2,
    DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 T2))
| ds_nocap_met : forall G e a TC TZ TR,
    DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_rcd (dec_met a TC TZ TR))
| ds_nocap_fun : forall G e TZ TR,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode -> DSub G e typ_nocap (typ_fun TZ TR)
